Four Games. Infinite replayability.

Don't mess with Rick (90s Beat 'em Up)

Step into the golden era of the arcade brawler. Kicked out of his own mob family, Rick is on a bloody quest for revenge across four grueling stages. This isn't just button-mashing; master a deep combat system featuring combos, clinches, parries, and counterattacks. Fill your super meter to unleash screen-clearing special moves as you fight through replicant ninjas, rabid dogs, and massive bosses.

Crescent Moon (Sci-Fi Shoot 'em Up)

A fast, frantic, horizontal bullet hell. The cosmic tyrant Trixion is invading, and you are the only defense. Memorize environmental traps, collect and swap between five distinct weapon types, and utilize support pods to survive. Built for high-score chasers: master the "No-Miss" multiplier system and dodge your way to the top of the leaderboards.

Heist of the Ninja (83' stealth arcade)

Experience classic single-screen arcade tension! Play as Koji the Ninja in an alternate-1983 heist. Navigate tightly guarded rooms, jump obstacles, and dig through furnishings for hidden loot. Use your shurikens wisely, outsmart the guards, and secure the treasure without triggering the alarm.

Peng Peng (Co-Op precision platformer)

Don't let the cute aesthetic fool you—Peng Peng is built for casuals, speedrunners, and hardcore score-catchers alike. Wipe out monsters across four worlds to rescue the kidnapped Frost Orb. Play solo or grab a friend in Local Co-Op. Will you rush to the end for a speed bonus, or meticulously clear enemies for maximum points? Hunt for secret rooms, special events, and uncover the hidden ending!

Step Into the Holua Universe...

Holua's Arcades is just the beginning. Meet Lyn, the vivacious gamer actually playing these arcade machines! Lyn is also the protagonist of our upcoming high-resolution metroidvania, FANTASY NETWORK.

Discover the meta-narrative linking these arcade classics to a much larger world. Play the hidden Demo level located just outside the virtual arcade room, and don't forget to wishlist Fantasy Network!

2303470.name: Wildwood: A Town Building Game
2303470.about_the_game:
Wildwood is a city building strategy game that is all about expansion. Start from nothing. As you gather resources and progress through the Tech Tree you will unlock new technologies that will help you survive. To reach more valuable resources you will need to expand. Deploy a logistics network of Trains and Wagons to connect your settlement together. As you continue to gather, build, expand, and connect you will be able to turn your surviving settlement into a thriving town.


Help your citizens thrive by building homes and workplaces for them. As you progress through the tech tree you will unlock new items and buildings that will help you in your quest to expand your settlement


The procedurally generated world of Wildwood is infinite. Explore new areas and take advantage of the resources available there. Expand your settlement as far as your heart desires and discover the endless possibilities of Wildwood.


Connect your settlement with a logistics network of trains and wagons. Move resources to where they are needed to ensure the survival of your settlement and to keep your citizens well provided for

Wildwood provides a unique challenge for players who want a survival city builder that allows you to endlessly expand your world. Start building your settlement today!

2303480.name: ZOM: Rise of the Apocalypse
2303480.about_the_game:
ZOM: Rise of the Apocalypse is a dynamic Trading and Collecting Card Game set in a post-apocalyptic world. With both strategic PvP multiplayer battles and an immersive RPG single player story, you'll be fully immersed in the universe of Zom.

Embark on a thrilling journey in the online universe of Zom. Choose your side and engage in strategic battles, using your wits and cunning to outwit your opponents.

Outside of battle, unleash your inner scientist and design custom abilities to dominate the battlefield with the simple yet powerful Ability Graph system. With the power of gene programming at your fingertips, you can create a deck that truly represents you and showcase your unique strategies. The Ability Graph system not only adds an extra layer of depth and customization to the gameplay, but also presents a thrilling opportunity for players to learn and apply concepts common in computer programming.

Join minds with other players to create powerful alliances, or go it alone and forge your own path to glory. The choice is yours.

2303500.name: MF-01 Aerostrike
2303500.about_the_game:
Alone in a far away planet. Surrounded by hostile pilots. The only way out is through sheer skill. Jump into the MF-01 Aerostrike and fight for survival. Fight to return to your family.

Big dogfights await you. Hundreds of enemy ships, of all kinds and sizes. You must make your way through a large underground complex. Find a way to escape the planet alive.

Along the way you may find useful equipment. Weapons for various roles and purposes. Modules to give you an edge in combat. Upgrades to enhance your capabilities.

Beware of experienced foes. Opponents that have made a name for themselves, flying unique vessels with their own set of powerful gear. Mercenaries, ace warriors, and leaders.

Now it is up to you. Fly into the great unknown, into the depths of steel and iron, and meet your fate.

2303530.name: Cowboys & Rustlers
2303530.about_the_game:
A man and a horse walk into a saloon…


Experience the story of two outlaw friends - an overly joyful rustler and a talking, cynical horse - told through the magic of a top-down action video game. Rob banks and roller-coasters summon ghosts at cemeteries, all while helping your horse friend in writing his revolutionary science-fiction novel.

Kinda Wild, Somewhat Weird West


That’s what the outsiders call it, interchangeably with Kinda Wild, Boy Do They Smell There West. It’s full of cowboys, skater(cow)boys, dusty towns, and photovoltaics. Everyone is weirdly enamored with spitting into spittoons and their favorite soup is whisky. Yet there’s also beauty. Some have honest work and don’t overwater their cactuses. There are even people with hobbies besides not starving to death.

Universal tools of communication


In a place as kinda wild and somewhat weird, it’s good to know how to communicate. Revolvers usually make the most convincing argument, especially with the help of swift fingers and good use of ricochet physics. A few lasso tricks and a Gatling gun will be irreplaceable in more complex discussions. It’s also worth remembering that nothing’s more powerful than friendship and a kick of a 1000-pound horse.

2303550.name: Zehlar
2303550.about_the_game:
Zehlar is an open world full of secrets and magic. Explore the different biomes, each with its own challenges and rewards, filled with creatures with unique abilities. The world is procedurally generated, so each player can experience a different world.

The creatures in the world have the ability to control different elements, allowing them to adapt to their environment. With their abilities, they can move through the area, protect themselves from threats, or even modify the terrain when necessary.

Humans do not have these powers, but they can acquire some of the creature's abilities through different methods, such as specialized technology. Although they will not be as strong as the powers of the creatures.

It is possible to ally with the creatures in the world. They can help you with many of the tasks and challenges that arise in the world. From building a base, protecting yourself from threats, accessing areas impossible for humans, caring for your crops, or simply helping with household tasks, you can always count on the help of allied creatures.



Both you and your captured creatures will need to train to become stronger and overcome the challenges that will arise in the world. And they can also learn increasingly specialized and more powerful abilities.

2303560.name: Best Pearl
2303560.about_the_game:
Best Pearl is a shooter where one of the sea inhabitants repels attacks, protecting the pearl he found. Be careful the steering wheel landing can hurt you. Don't let them get it. They must not reach her. You can handle it.

Features of the game:

- Beautiful Pixel-Art
- Music
- Simple operation
- Complexity

2303570.name: Crazy Clown
2303570.about_the_game:
Crazy Clown - Top Down Shooter, a game in which you need to take your own and destroy all your abusers. You have not only a machine gun in your arsenal. Use all the variety of weapons and crush your enemies. Take revenge on them, clowns can not only make fun!

2303610.name: Fragrance Point
2303610.about_the_game:
We are speechless. After a hundred years of silence, research station Fragrance Point starts sending signals to earth. What does it mean? We are sending our most advanced security robot. Armed with lipstick, snazzy boots and a big heart, we are sure it will do the right thing. What will it find?

Fragrance Point is a digital paradise where you can do everything you want: Dress up, dance with aliens, and knock big things over. Make new friends, embarrass yourself in front of everyone, and you might just find a way into the station's core.

2303620.name: Turn on the lights carefully
2303620.about_the_game:
Turn on the lights carefully is a disassemble puzzle game that features a recursive mechanics in which the player has to explore micro pieces to connect a circuit and solve the main puzzle.

Key features


  • Minimalist design and colors
  • Relaxing soundtrack
  • Chill game
  • No time pressure
  • Steam achievements

2303630.name: Saint Warner's Angels
2303630.about_the_game:
Saint Warner's Angels is an action packed coming-of-age story of enormous proportions.
Experience the gripping epic of Mya Oakley in a retro-pixel world accompanied with cutscenes that are brought to life with hand-drawn illustrations and animations.



Welcome to 1985! Since you'll be living in Warner's Pass in the great Lone Star State, let's take a little tour. Would you like to admire the mayor’s house and marvel at how rich he is compared to the rest of the town? Or maybe visit the trailer park; if you are lucky enough you won’t get hit with a flung beer bottle as you pass by the Reagan ‘88 sign.

If you're strapped for cash, you can pick up odd jobs, diner shifts, or even requests on your local job board.

When you're not doing that, you will join in the fight against the growing threat of a Cryptid invasion though gorgeously hand drawn turn based battles. To pose a real threat, timing your attacks through action commands will surely give those monsters a run for their money.

Team up with up to 2 party members that make up Mya’s brother and her friends. And when the battles get rough and your energy surges, unleash your group’s fury through Special Attacks and Duo Special Attacks: animated assaults of multiple characters combining their strengths to leave their enemies devastated. Push back against the impossible odds along side the people who have always been by your side.

2303670.name: Escape From The Sun
2303670.about_the_game:
Dash through levels.
Escape the emerging suns.
Shoot everything in sight.

Escape from the Sun is a speedrun shooter all about avoiding our Suns! as they're very evil!!

Choose from over 30 weapons to shoot anything in sight. Your inventory can only hold 10 items so it will be wise to use the most effective weapons later in the game.

Each level is a chase sequence, where you run away from the emerging 4 suns in the solar system through over 20+ levels. Shooting knocks them back but it only makes them come back stronger.

Prepare to die alot with lots of challenging bosses to fight, each with their own gimmick.

2303720.name: Multiplayer Cowboys
2303720.about_the_game:
Multiplayer Cowboys

The Town is being taken over by Ghosts. Can You and Your Posse Survive ?

This is a Fast Paced RPG Survival game.

The game includes a Single & Multiplayer CO-OP system via Steam.

You can Invite Your Steamy Friends with the ' + ' Icon on the Main Menu and Team Up !

The Game is packed with a complete inventory management and crafting system, missions, building system, environmental harvesting, and looting system, swimming system, level-ups, and AI, combat mechanics, and many more features provided down below, tested online with clients under server-load. Compatible with Steam online subsystem.

* NOTE : You should have a Stable & Fast Internet Connection for Best Results *

Features:

Advanced Inventory and Crafting System

Inventory Quickslots

Inventory Extension / Backpack System

Item Durability with Repair Functionality

Vast building with a privilege system, including furniture

Building health destruction system alongside repair ability

Advanced Mission/Quest System with invitations

Fully Server-based Saving System

Complex Holstering System

Entity and Loot spawning system

Advanced Skill and Level Up system

Survival Stats (Health, Hunger, and Thirst)

Percentual Reward Division (Based on Damage)

Player Lobby and Menu system

Dynamic Crosshair System

Unique 3D environment (including Tutorial map)

Environment Harvesting System with respawning (mining, wood cutting, etc.)

Gardening & Farming System with plant growing stages

Range and Melee weapons with damage, ammunition handling, and FX.

Throwable Explosives

AI and Enemy camp system

Advanced Damage System

Advanced Player knockout and death system

Full SFX + Music

Interaction system

Advanced optimized Minimap System

Character Add-ons (Hats, etc)

Holdable Items

Dynamic foliage interaction with SFX

Advanced Dialogue System merged with Mission System

Human NPCs

Fully interactable Water system with Swimming and Diving

Sniper Rifle scoping (zooming) mechanics

Large Map

Lots of Enemies to battle

Animals to Hunt

Horse & Wagon to Travel around

2303730.name: Magnetik
2303730.about_the_game:
In this game you play as a robot who has the skill to generate an electric field that attracts or repulses a magnet presented in each level. The goal is to make the magnet reach its right target, sometimes there will be multiple magnets and here is where the puzzle gets more exciting.

Boxes, blocks, keys, potions, conveyor belts, holes, teleportation, levers and many more items combined make each level unique. It is up to you how to solve each puzzle, have fun!

Move around

Think

Try

Choose

Enjoy it

Challenge yourself and your friends, have fun!

2303740.name: Virtual Families 3
2303740.about_the_game:
The Mountain Resort is here! Take your family on a trip to this scenic mountain getaway and renovate this old Resort in need of repair into a popular vacation destination! AI Guests will visit and stay at the Resort, so decorate it creatively to give them a unique and enjoyable experience!

ADOPT YOUR FAMILY TODAY!

Adopt a little person from the thousands living inside your mobile device! In this life simulation game, help them choose a husband or wife and start their virtual family! Make babies and pass the house on to the kids! Help nurture and guide generations, managing your own beautiful family story.

DESIGN YOUR DREAM HOME

Expand and renovate your virtual house. Your adoptee’s new home has a lot of potential, but they need your help to fix it up! Imagine your dream home and make it a reality. Add bedrooms, a garden, a home theater, or even a game room! Collect decorations to customize and design each room.

MAKE A HAPPY, PROSPEROUS LIFE

Train your little people from babies to adulthood to take care of their home and make the best choices in life. Encourage them to work on their career and earn money for decorations, necessities, and luxuries. Upgrade your virtual family to be the best versions of themselves. Your little people will send you messages, thanking, pleading, and praising you for caring for them. Don’t forget to check in on them, because they miss you and become very sad!

LIFE SIMULATION RUNS IN REAL TIME!

Your little family continues to live, eat, grow, and work when the app is switched off. Along the way, there will be many different random events to respond to, all of them adding surprise to this simulation game and unexpected elements to routine, daily virtual life. Find highly varied, unpredictable game play. No two games run the same; the story unfolds differently for everyone who plays it. This simulation game is designed to have a life of its own!

2303770.name: Fling D'Block
2303770.about_the_game:
Beware the Obstacles as you Fling D’Block!

Fling D'Block is a physics-based precision time trial and speedrunning game that puts your skills to the ultimate test. Propel and bounce your block through a series of treacherous levels, striving to achieve the fastest time possible. Along the way, collect valuable crystals, navigate perilous obstacles, and avoid fatal mistakes.

This fast-paced game challenges your speed, dexterity, and strategy as you master each level. Sharpen your reflexes, optimize your routes, and race to the exit with flawless precision. Can you conquer the clock and claim your spot as the ultimate speedrunner?

And whatever you do… Go as Fast as You Can!

Traverse

Fling and bounce across perilous levels as you learn to master movement over time and dedication.

Avoid

Spikes, Death Wheels, Spiked Pendulums, Auto-Tracking Turrets, and Spinning Lasers. There are dangers all around you so be careful where you fling.

Create

Fling D’Block comes with a built-in level editor for those of you that wish to create fun, exciting and challenging custom levels.

2303780.name: PHOTONS
2303780.about_the_game:
Photons is a cooperative multiplayer horror game, in which you and your friends are destined to work underground, while trying to live in total darkness beneath the earth’s surface. The only way to navigate your areas is to use specialized tools, in order to control the area around you. The job is to maintain the excavation equipment, explore vast cave systems, loot for items and to not die. Succeeded tasks will be awarded in credits, with which you’ll be able to buy tools, upgrade them, and expand your base, just for the sake of a safer place to work.


Go on a trip into the dark recesses of caverns in this underground maze where light is now just a memory. To navigate through the areas, use a variety of tools, ranging from sound wave distributors, to handheld scanners that will reveal to you the nuances of the surrounding world. Remember, that you are not alone in this impenetrable darkness. Danger can lurk around every corner, and unknown creatures see you through the shadows.




Explore a network of procedurally generated caves hiding diverse biomes filled with abandoned structures and undiscovered anomalies. Watch out for increasingly dangerous threats located in the ever-distant depths of the tunnels. With randomly generated undergrounds, everyone will experience the terror of the void in a unique way.


Embark on exciting expeditions equipped with a range of practical tools and effective weaponry that you can obtain, ensuring you're well-prepared for the challenges of exploration and combat in uncharted territories. Equip surface scanners to map your environment, available in different forms like handheld devices or scanning grenades, helping you understand and navigate your surroundings. Set up stationary machinery for strategic exploration to unravel larger areas and aid in strategizing your exploration efforts, or go mobile with the assistance of autonomous robotic helpers. Customize your weapons with a user-friendly attachment system and keep track of your equipment using a personal tablet, making inventory management straightforward and effective.




In the meantime, you can fight your friends in various Arcade experiences like classic Deathmatch to more tactical one’s like Team Deathmatch. There are plenty of them, and they could serve as a “break” from the horrors that are waiting for you in the real game.

2303800.name: My Life as a Cult Leader
2303800.about_the_game:
When a terrible turn of events causes you to lose your job and get evicted from your apartment, you're left with nothing to your name. You find yourself on a cold park bench, miserable and exhausted with nowhere else to turn. As you curse your fate, dark thoughts cloud your mind, wishing things would turn out differently. Suddenly, a mysterious woman approaches you, introducing herself as Shima Itsuki and asking you to take over as the new leader of a cult. She explains that their current leader is dying and needs you to act as a substitute. With nothing to lose and an empty stomach to fill, you decide to take her up on her offer, but who would've guessed the sort of cult you'd end up leading...

A Thrilling Mystery to Unravel

What's Shima's true aim? What put your predecessor on his deathbed? Seek the answers to the many questions surrounding your cult as you tend to your followers and juggle your daily duties!

A Fierce Battle for Survival

Unfortunately, running a cult isn't all fun and games. External forces threaten your cult's very existence at every turn. Thwart those who challenge your authority and let nothing stop your rise to power!

Gorgeous Character Art

Fall in love with this colorful cast of characters and the beautiful, expressive art that brings them to life and lets their personalities shine!

2303810.name: Obscurite Magie: The Blood of Kings
2303810.about_the_game:
Fifteen years ago, the ruler of the Giselian Empire was deposed in a coup d'etat. The current ruler, Valon, imposes heavy taxes on the people, but the imperial army is strong and the nation is secure. The people suffer from the steep taxes, but very few dare speak out.

Lietta Fane is a girl who works as an adventurer in the Giselian Empire. She was raised by her swordmaster Negel for as long as she can remember. She never knew her parents. In addition to her adventurer work, she's also searching for the person who killed Negel.

One day she receives a request from the guild to escort a nobleman. On the way to their destination, she is attacked, and must now confront her destiny...

Take off for adventure through the Giselian Empire while uncovering the truth behind Negel's murder in this timeless turn-based RPG. Face off against a diverse set of enemies and bosses, discover and gain a wide variety of loot, and level up to overpower your foes!

2303820.name: VERUM
2303820.about_the_game:
Introducing VERUM - an interactive experience that will challenge the way you see the world. This game goes beyond just entertainment and invites players to explore important ethical issues surrounding giant tech corporations and the usage of personal data by companies and governments.

Through VERUM's gameplay, you will embark on a journey to understand the story behind the game. As you progress, you will encounter multiple side stories that cover different aspects of the main plot and present different perspectives. By seeing the same plot through these different lenses, you will gain a more diverse understanding of the topics presented.

Each side story consists of a series of scenes followed by unique endings, providing valuable information for players to understand the main plot. The best part? The player can visualize these endings in any order without respecting their chronological timeline.

As the player traverses through unique scenes related to side stories, they will unlock one of VERUM's multiple endings. The game always starts (restarts) at the same initial scene, and the player can jump between side stories to reach different endings.

VERUM's gameplay is simple yet immersive. Players must find a gate to move from one scene to another, and interaction with these gates is as simple as a click or click and hold. The narrative of each scene gives a clue to what that specific scene represents and indicates what can be a gate there.

With its beautiful and captivating graphics, VERUM is an experience like no other. It challenges players to question their own beliefs and to look at the same topic from different perspectives. There are no right or wrong answers, only valuable insights that will leave you thinking long after the game is over.

Are you ready to challenge your beliefs and explore the world of VERUM? Get ready to dive into this thought-provoking experience and unlock multiple endings to uncover the full story.

English*, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support

2303850.name: Toxic Crusaders
2303850.about_the_game:
Toxic Crusaders is an action-packed beat 'em up game where players take control of one of seven playable characters, each with their own unique moves and abilities. The game features up to four-player, local co-op -- allowing friends to team up and take on hordes of Radiation Rangers, mutated thugs, and zombie chickens across seven disgusting levels, rendered in beautiful full-color pixel-art graphics.

FOUR PLAYERS AND SEVEN PLAYABLE CHARACTERS

Toxic Crusaders allows up to four players to battle together in local co-op, making it a perfect game for a group of friends. Players can choose from seven playable characters, each with their own unique moves and powers, including the beloved Toxie, No-Zone, Junkyard, Major Disaster, Headbanger, and (for the first time) Yvonne and Mrs. Junko!

FIGHT THROUGH CARTOON AND MOVIE LEVELS

Season 2 of the 1990s Toxic Crusaders cartoon sadly never happened, but this game continues the cartoon's plot! This original storyline is also packed with references to the iconic Troma cult movies, complete with hilarious Easter eggs and cameos from fan-favorite characters. Whether you're a die-hard Troma fan or a newcomer, you'll enjoy the off-beat humor.

FULLY VOICE ACTED WITH MOTION COMICS CUTSCENES

Toxic Crusaders features fully voice-acted motion comic cutscenes that add depth and immersion to the game's story, creating a cohesive and immersive experience that will keep players engaged from start to finish. Voice acting by TeamFourStar, industry veterans, and actual Troma film actors.

FULLY APPROVED BY LLOYD KAUFMAN AND THE ANGRY VIDEO GAME NERD!!

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Russian

2303910.name: Chrono Rift
2303910.about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a wizard in Chrono Rift and embark on a thrilling adventure to defend the world from monster invasions caused by mysterious spatiotemporal breaches! Join the Breach Hunter Guild and team up with other players online to take on the challenge. With a mix of fantasy, action, and roguelike elements, get ready to unleash your magic and destroy the breaches before it's too late. Will you be the one to uncover the truth behind this crazy phenomenon and save the world? Play Chrono Rift now!

Replay the game an infinite amount of time by testing different combinations of spells and effect. Wanna go full DPS? Then get the "duplicate projectile" effect to multiply your damage! Wanna deal massive damage to a large crowd of enemies? Why not opt for the "projectile ricochet" effect and AOE spells! Each enemies have elemental strength and weaknesses. Choose your elemental type of damage wisely depending on your teammates and the opponents you will be facing.

It is your duty as Breach Hunters to face invaders of different universes and timelines. Determined to destroy your kingdom, an evil entity opens portals to realms where all sorts of evil creatures reside: Zombies, Aliens, Robots, Orcs and even Pirates! Each of these species have their own behaviors and will use different tactics to try to destroy you. Zombies are slows but numerous melee foes. Aliens are fast but afraid of fire. Robots use futuristic tech and more tactical strategies. Orcs are walking tanks who gets close and personal with his enemies. Finally, pirates are... Well they are pirates!

Team up with up to 3 other Breach Hunters and stop the evils that are invading your realm!

Purchase of this game contains the main game only.

2303940.name: Head Coach Tactics
2303940.about_the_game:
Head Coach Tactics uses a unique combination of real-time animation and turn-based strategy to create an exciting and strategic brand of football. It makes you think about your moves on the field, but doesn't make it boring.



The process is simple, but also tactically deep. You call the plays by selecting a personnel package and formation to send out onto the field. At the snap, the game's real-time animation takes over and simulates the first couple seconds of the play as a way to making sure you always have something interesting and new to start with. Then, the turn-based part kicks in, and you need to figure out how to get the most out of your players, given the situation on the field.



The unique style of tactics is an effective balance of decision making and simplicity. Something like the passing game in football can be exciting, so we tried to pull out all the unneeded complexity and focus on the strategy. Everything can be done with just a couple clicks! This allows you to focus on what really matters, which is putting your players in situations with the best matchups.



For those who love a power running game, we got you covered too! Running the game has been made just as fun as the passing game. Blocking is an important part of running the ball effectively, so you'll need to plan out your moves to create running lanes for your star RB. If everything goes according to plan, you could end up with massive holes and dominating on the ground!

Roster Building and Franchise!


Your success on the field depends largely on your ability to field a great team. To that end, we've created a robust franchise mode for you to craft your team to play the style of football you love.





Whether it's drafting players for the future, signing that high-priced free agent for right now, or making trades to reshape the franchise, you have a deep and exciting franchise mode to flex your strategic muscles. Each phase of building your roster has been designed to provide a strategic challenge, but in a way that is easy to understand and not overly complicated. We've taken the approach that a streamlines and focused roster-building experience is more fun than complicated systems that are hard to understand. Since you will intuitively know what's important for each phase, you can spend all your energy coming up with the best strategy.

Even though we've streamlined franchise mode, we made sure to keep it deep and engaging. The other teams will always be looking for a edge, and keeping all your star players is going to be difficult. Sometimes you're going to have to make hard choices in order to assure long-term franchise health!

Turn-Based Football?

Why turn-based football? Well, it's something that hasn't really been done before. If you think about it, there's so much strategy that happens on the football field during a play. All the micro-second decisions that every player makes, how each player works within the system, and how the individual matchups play out, feels like it's the perfect candidate for a turn-based strategy game. We want to really explore what happens within a play, but in a deliberate fashion.

2303950.name: TRAUMA Broken Paradise
2303950.about_the_game:
Welcome to TRAUMA Broken Paradise

🎭A true Psychological Survival Horror experience!🩸


🎭 Psychological Horror – A subgenre of horror that focuses on the player’s mind, creating fear through tension, atmosphere, and storytelling. Instead of relying on direct jump scares, it explores deep themes like paranoia, insanity, and the unknown, making the player question reality within the game.

🩸 Survival Horror – A genre centered on surviving against terror, where resources are limited, and every decision matters. The player must face terrifying threats, either through combat or specific mechanics to fight back. Fear comes not only from the enemies but also from the character’s vulnerability and constant tension.

Both genres can blend, creating unique experiences where the player not only survives but also feels the psychological weight of horror. 👁️

Step into a World of Unseen Terror 🕯️🖤


Enter the haunting world of TRAUMA Broken Paradise, where every corner of the mansion whispers secrets and its walls are steeped in tragedy. As Sophia Markwell, explore the dark, decaying halls of a forgotten legacy. The air is thick with the echoes of the past, and the deeper you venture, the more the lines between reality and nightmare begin to blur.

Unravel a Tale of Madness and Loss 📜🧠


TRAUMA Broken Paradise isn’t just a journey through a haunted mansion—it's a descent into the fractured mind of Sophia Markwell. Influenced by the unnerving atmosphere of Stephen King’s "The Shining", this psychological survival horror game challenges your perception, as you piece together the riddles of a shattered past. Solve cryptic puzzles and face mind-bending challenges that will keep you questioning what’s real.

A Silent Battle with the Mind 🧩💀


Forget the loud jumpscares. In TRAUMA Broken Paradise, the true horror lies within the silence—the quiet hum of your heartbeat, the rustling of a note or photograph that might hold the key to your survival. Navigate through fixed camera angles and tense, atmospheric environments, as you piece together clues that will either guide you to safety or lead you into deeper despair.

Every Decision Counts 🔐💭


Your choices are not just choices—they are decisions that will echo through your fate. Multiple endings await, each one shaped by the paths you take and the clues you uncover. Every note, every photograph you collect may hold the key to your survival, but in this mansion, knowledge may also be the most dangerous weapon.

Explore the Unseen, Discover the Unknown 👀🔎


The mansion is full of secrets, and no two journeys are alike. Hidden passages, concealed achievements, and mysterious objects are scattered throughout. The more you discover, the more you’ll begin to understand the twisted reality that holds Sophia captive. The question is: Are you ready to face what’s buried in the darkness?

A Masterpiece of Psychological Horror 🎮👻


TRAUMA Broken Paradise is more than a game—it’s a passion project that brings together a love for survival horror and a deep respect for the genre’s roots. Every corner of this game is meticulously crafted to draw you into its haunting world. Will you dare to uncover the truths hidden in the shadows?

2304030.name: 天下霸圖
2304030.about_the_game:
大型武俠經營策略遊戲

從招收弟子分派職務開始，挖礦伐木織造煉丹，打造武器鑽研武學，培養人才設立分舵，妥善的門派經營及地盤擴張，你將逐步提昇門派的威望，與其他正邪勢力一較高下！
武當、峨嵋、丐幫、魔教….等十二個各具特色的門派，你可以挑選自己喜愛的門派來經營，也可以自創與眾不同的新門派！

經營門派，擴大地盤，成為武林霸主

玩家可由少林、武當、峨嵋、華山、丐幫、魔教等等十二個各具特色的門派中，挑選自己喜愛的門派來進行遊戲，也可以自行設定各種條件，創造出與眾不同的新門派，然後透過招收弟子、設立分舵、打造武器、鑽研武學、培養人才、訂立盟約、剷奸除惡等等方式，與其他正邪勢力一較高下。

採集資源，製造物品，善用經營技巧

在遊戲中共有五種資源，分別是金礦、木材、石礦、鐵礦和藥材，而每個地點所蘊藏的資源情況皆不相同。利用這五種資源為原料，玩家便能生產武器、暗器、衣服、鞋子、飾品、丹藥等各種用品，除了提供門派所需，多餘物品還可以用來交易賺取銀兩。

兩派交戰，聯盟會戰，戰局詭譎多變

武林中各門派間的關係可分為同盟、敵對、主從﹙就是收服或屈從其他門派之意﹚等三種，玩家如果實力強大，可以單獨向某個甚至數個門派宣戰﹙千萬別學慈禧太后沒本錢還向八國宣戰﹚，當然也可以聯合同盟的門派大舉向敵人進攻，實現金庸小說倚天屠龍記中「六大派圍攻光明頂」的雄偉戰爭場面。

刀光劍影，見招拆招，勝負全憑實力

當玩家派遣門下弟子出外行俠仗義遭遇戰鬥，或者門派受到攻擊，以及進攻敵對門派時，便會切入戰鬥模式。戰鬥模式以回合制方式進行，每回合雙方各攻擊一次，攻擊者可以選擇最有利的武功招式進行攻擊，而防守方也能選擇防禦或閃躲的招式加以回應，以減少損傷。

四大劇本，勢力消長，體驗不同挑戰

遊戲中共有四個劇本提供選擇，而每個劇本都以不同的起始條件來挑戰玩家的智慧：劇本一門派眾多，各派實力有限，勝負孰難預料，劇本二正邪兩大勢力的對抗，劇本三是傳統門派與新興門派的爭雄，劇本四的門派雖然只有五個，然而每個門派都擁有極為雄厚的實力

招收弟子，設置分舵，奠定霸業基礎

由於每個地點所能招收弟子的資質是不同的，因此如何因材施教，選擇適當的培育方式就相當重要了。有了弟子之後，玩家還可以任命優秀的弟子擔任各種適合的職務，例如舵主會影響領導、生產、練功、採集四種工作的效率；左堂主影響練功效率；右堂主影響採集效率。

勤練武藝，探究絕學，練得傲世神功

在武功方面，共分為拳法、掌法、腿法、刀法、劍法、槍法、棍法、點穴、暗器等九門功夫，每種武功都有其獨到之處，而每個門派也都有與眾不同的武學系統，並精通不同的武功。當人物某項武功的經驗值甚高時，便可派至閉關有可能悟出更厲害的新武學，或者撰寫出武功秘笈，只要將武功秘笈交由其他同門師兄弟閱讀，便可迅速提昇該武功的經驗值。

威鎮武林，號令天下，孰能與我爭雄

當想要在遊戲中獲得勝利，除了消滅其他門派一統江湖之外，還可以靠增加實力提高聲望後，讓其他門派從屬於我方，只要被所有門派遵奉為武林霸主，同樣可以贏得勝利。

2304090.name: Wars of Cards: ROMA
2304090.about_the_game:
Hello everyone. Wars of Cards: ROMA is a multiplayer strategy game created by our small team. Compared with the high-fidelity, brain-burning strategy game masterpieces produced by big companies, Wars of Cards adopts a minimalist gameplay of maps and cards, which can easily satisfy the desire of strategy lovers to color the map.

The background of the game is the late period of the Roman republic. The sudden death of the former dictator plunged the city of Rome into a power vacuum and chaos. Governors with some ideas raised troops everywhere in the name of the Senate and the Roman people.

The game is turn-based. Multiple players start the game from the base camps of their respective starting plots. Each player starts with 4 cards, and draws another 1 card each round. When it’s your turn to play cards, just choose which cards to play and where to attack and you’re done. After the defender also plays cards, the system will automatically calculate the outcome of the battle. Capturing another player’s stronghold can annex their entire territory. On the contrary, if the base camp is occupied by other players, they will be eliminated and can only watch the battle. According to our tests, it takes about thirty minutes for four players to complete a round. Yes, thirty minutes, make Rome great again!

Cards are divided into troop cards, general cards, auxiliary cards, and special cards. Simply speaking, in a set of cards, the command value of a general card multiplied by the sum of the attack value or defense value of all troop cards is the combat power of this set of cards. Auxiliary cards will provide additional bonuses to the value of troop cards and general cards. Each special card has its own special way of playing. For example, when the defense fails, the Vestal Virgin can persuade the opponent to surrender a card; the Chief High Priest will prevent the battle; the Senate will encourage military expansion or force sanctions, etc.

At the beginning of the game, there are many neutral plots on the map, which represent small groups of separatist forces. Some plots have clan logos on them. If you have such a land, after the cards belonging to the clan are played, as long as the battle is won, they can be returned to the hand.

The maximum number of cards you can hold is 5. When each neutral plot is occupied for the first time, the occupant can draw an extra card. However, if the occupant’s hand is full at this time, no cards will be drawn.

All territories must have access to the base camp. If the road between the two is severed, the resulting enclave becomes a neutral plot. The neutral plot is darker in color than a neutral plot that has never been occupied, and a player who recapturing that plot does not gain additional draws. If territory is found to be cut off or the base camp is at risk of falling, you can choose to move the base camp earlier.

There is a saying that a tiger is hard against a pack of wolves. Diplomacy is also a big factor in winning the game. Players in the game can type and chat. How to avoid multi-line combat depends on your diplomatic communication skills.

The above is a brief introduction to the gameplay of the strategy game Wars of Cards: ROMA. In addition to playing against humans, you can also choose AI as your opponent.

If the game can get initial approval from all players, then we will make more maps, cards and upgraded gameplay, and even mods with new themes in the future.
We welcome your suggestions for improving the game. We look forward to meeting and learning from each other in the multiplayer battle of Wars of Cards: Rome.

Clarity is a powerful magic that emanates from Demons and their spawn. Once a foe is defeated Clarity is collected to power magic spells. These spells will be needed as you venture into dungeons populated with savage enemies and merciless monsters.



Game Features
  • Classic 2D side-scrolling platform action.

  • 7 unique levels and Bosses to defeat.

2304230.name: I'm On Merrymaking Watch
2304230.about_the_game:

Festivities can be anything from presents and Christmas trees, to gingerbread cookies and Santa's elves. Or maybe even Santa Claus himself? Moving Through Life is a game about nostalgia, creativity, and identity. It invites you to reflect on your own life choices and imagine different possibilities. It’s a game that celebrates the joy of moving through life.

BookyPets Legends transports children to the other side of the universe, the magical kingdom of Imaginatios which is inhabited by all the characters from fairy tales, and by magical creatures with book-shaped wings, the BookyPets!

The game consists of freeing the BookyPets, who have been trapped by 3 evil monsters (Fear, Laziness, and Selfishness), by reading hundreds of proverbs, fables, tales, legends and children's novels, in order to get keys and open the cages in which they are locked up. BookyPets seamlessly blends reading into the gameplay and narrative of the video game to encourage children to read. Now, reading and playing will be one and the same.

Key features:

  • More than 50 BookyPets to rescue, collect and evolve. The Tyrannosaurus Rex, the Unicorn, the Blue Mermaid and the Winged Lion are just some of them - children won't stop reading until they manage to rescue them! The habit and passion for reading are already underway!
  • Character editor with dozens of customizable elements to create your own in-game avatars.
  • More than 2,200 fantasy readings: traditional proverbs and sayings, classic and modern tales, fables, and children's novels.
  • Your children will get rewards for each reading: spells, energy and keys to free their BookyPets. In addition, there are special rewards for daily reading.
  • Information about the children's progress and the readings they have done: number of words read, new vocabulary, type of readings done...

In this game you play as a mental patient lost in a world of chaos and confusion, it's almost impossible to tell apart reality from figments of your imagination, but you'd better believe that they're equally as dangerous!

  • Procedural Generation!

A bit about the gameplay


Work your way through cage after cage to escape your own mind. Living in a world of your own creation, you fight endless amounts of creatures that you may not even be able to comprehend. In a world where you are so fragile, it's hard to trust anything, or anyone. This game features a fully destructible world, you can build anything, anywhere, everywhere. You need to protect yourself from the various creatures that roam around, it's kill or be killed. You can mine into the depths of the world, getting ore, forging weapons and tools, and finding hidden treasures. If you choose to explore rather than stay in one spot, you can find different structures, some of which are underground, such as the Catacombs. Increase your power with various weapons, equipment, and unlockable skills. Buy items from Professor Jitters, the local trader, using cash and ciggies that you've earned from looting enemies and pilfering around the world. And once all is said and done and you've escaped the cages you will- Hmm... maybe I shouldn't spoil it. I suppose you'll have to find out on your own how this story ends!

2304440.name: Creatures of Ava
2304440.about_the_game:
Features:

  • Join a young nature explorer, Vic, on her expedition to planet Ava
  • Explore 4 distinct and colorful ecosystems bustling with life
  • Tame over 20 wild creatures with the music of a special flute
  • Meet the naam, Ava’s inhabitants, and learn their unique customs
  • Save the planet’s inhabitants from an infection called “the withering”
  • Help Vic solve the secrets of Ava and her own troubled past

Can you save a life?

Welcome to Creatures of Ava, a unique creature-saver game inviting you to explore a world brimming with wild beings. Instilling joy and wonder, they provide a unique bond that enables you to utilize their skills for traversing the planet and solving environmental challenges. Once peaceful creatures, they now succumb to an unknown infection driving them to behave aggressively, which makes your mission to save them an urgent necessity.

Exploration-driven Gameplay

The gameplay encourages curiosity-driven exploration of its distinct ecosystems—such as the colorful Nari jungle or mysterious Mâruba swamp—creating an interconnected world. With non-aggressive combat mechanics designed for healing rather than defeating and indigenous Flute melodies that you play to tame creatures, the game further highlights the creature-saver nature of the experience.

Meaningful Narrative

Step into the shoes of Vic, a 22-year-old nature adventurer as she navigates through the immersive expedition alongside Tabitha, a composed and astute researcher. Together, you confront the recurring infection—called “the withering” by the local race of Naam—threatening Ava’s inhabitants. The game's narrative, co-created by Rhianna Pratchett, is a journey of wonder and mystery but also discovery, leading to the revelation of the planet's captivating secrets.

Saving Through Understanding

Creatures of Ava is a game featuring a dense, populated world of rich ecosystems filled with creatures that play a vital role in the planet’s natural balance. It goes beyond traditional creature-related genres, offering a deeper understanding and connection with the things you’ll encounter on Ava. Once you come to understand the true meaning of the infection, you will be challenged to step out of the human-centric point of view and learn about the real toll it takes to preserve the primal beauty at the very roots of Ava.

After all, can you save something you don't understand?

2304450.name: Thalassic
2304450.about_the_game:
Thalassic is a VR underwater horror survival game where you explore a planet a few thousand years after its evacuation. Venture through the depths of this new ocean world with your capsule communicator George who is on the radio to guide you on your mission. You must take radiation tests every 200 meters you go to ensure that you are not risking your safety and to see if the planet would be suitable for human life to inhabit the planet once more. Encounter different creatures long thought to be extinct as you go deeper and find what lurks down in the depths.

You play the entire game inside your submarine and the only way you can move your lever is down. George your capsule communicator will be guiding you on the way to prevent you from getting lost in what you're doing. He will guide you through puzzles such as finding hologram discs and working other parts of the ship. You must also manage your hunger and vitals during the trip. If they get too low, you will die. Food can be acquired through fishing and the vending machine.



There are 4 main rooms in the ship that you must use. The first being the bridge, the bridge is where you control the movement of your submarine, it is a semi-circular glass dome so it is also the best view for the environment around you. The radio that George uses to communicate with you is in this room so being in the bridge is the only way to hear him.

The next most important room is the research room, this contains the hologram pad which you use to display radiation levels, fishing and many more hologram discs. This is your living quarters and where you spend most of your time on the journey there. It also holds the vending machine which is your main source of food during the expedition.

The next room is the engine room, it is where the engine powering the ship is held, there isn't much else in that room but you want to keep an eye on it because it can overheat sometimes. lastly is the ballast tank, this is what controls the buoyancy allowing the ship to go down.

2304480.name: Elite Rogue
2304480.about_the_game:
CHOOSE YOUR CONTRACT

Every mission is a gamble—select from three randomized contracts before entering a new dimension. Each contract has a unique objective, from high-risk assassinations to dangerous extractions. Adapt, strategize, and survive against escalating threats. Succeed, and you’ll earn Darkmatter, a permanent currency that can be spent anywhere—during a mission or between runs—to unlock game-changing abilities, new classes, and cosmetics. But beware—the Contractor isn’t always on your side. Hidden risks lurk within each deal, and betrayal may come when you least expect it.

DEAL WITH SHADY TRADERS

Across dimensions, mysterious traders offer powerful gear—if you can afford their price. Weapon upgrades, gadgets, and rare artifacts can shift the odds in your favor, but some deals come with unseen consequences. Every item holds a piece of the world’s history, and hidden within their descriptions are cryptic clues about Mr. B, the enigmatic Contractor who controls your fate. Who is he? Why does he know so much? And more importantly—can he be trusted?

EVOLVE YOUR PLAYSTYLE

Choose from four unique characters, each with their own playstyle, strengths, and special abilities. Every dimension is different—face rogue AI warlords, space pirates, loot goblins, and other unpredictable threats. Side quests and hidden objectives reward risk-takers with rare loot and deeper secrets. With every contract, the universe reshapes itself, ensuring no two missions are ever the same.

PLAY SOLO OR WITH A CREW

Take on contracts alone or with up to 10 players in chaotic co-op action. Team up, combine abilities, and adapt to the ever-changing threats of each dimension. Choose from four distinct characters: Jack, the Scarecrow Bandit, a trickster with deadly precision; Roxan, the Time-Warped Mercenary, wielding futuristic tech; Roth, the Demigod, a force of raw destruction; and Bob, the Military Mechanic, a master of gadgets and heavy firepower.

2304600.name: Stack Masters
2304600.about_the_game:
Do you enjoy playing around with the physics in games? Then this is the game for you. Stack Masters is built around exploring that concept in a competitive way. Including a built in level editor and Steam Workshop support, the game offers a never ending supply of physics sandbox gameplay to explore.

Compete to build crazy structures in order to climb the leaderboards or simply work your way through over 100 levels to beat the campaign.


A low price was always the plan but that does not mean low quality.

We want you to be able to buy the game whenever you want, without needing to wait for a sale, or to grab a bunch of copies and share them with friends so you can all compete for the top spot on the leaderboards.



However you choose to play the game, we want you to play the game, and didn't want price to ever be an issue.

Oh, and don't worry, there are no microtransations either.



Nope, far from it. The game is split into different categories each exploring a different game mechanic or theme.



You'll start with the simplest of towers, but you'll soon be dealing with drop zones, time manipulation, logic puzzles, gravity sliders, multi-zones, pivot blocks, ungrabbable blocks, interlocking blocks, bridges, weights and even a level built to play like a pachinko machine.

There are over one hundred levels already and we've only just begun to scratch the surface of what's possible.

Better yet, everyone can explore those possibilities with an in-game level editor. See below for details.


Play together with children to teach them the basics of physics, or use your engineering degree to push things to the extreme.

Every category contains a selection of levels, from easy to hard, to allow everyone to explore the whole game.



You only need to beat one or two levels in each category to unlock the next, which allows players from all skill levels to easily progress through the game and explore the different themes and game mechanics.

Most levels are designed to be solvable in anything from five to thirty minutes but if you want to compete for the best possible scores you can expect to spend hours on each level in order to find the ultimate solution.


Each level can have up to three leaderboards, allowing you to compete with your Steam friends or push yourself towards a world record for ultimate glory.


Every level was built using the game's super easy to use level editor. A single click of a button can allow you to begin editing the level you are currently playing or to start a brand new one from scratch.

Choose an arena, choose a location, choose from hundreds of block shapes, drag and drop them wherever you like, and start playing your creation instantly right there in the editor. A couple of clicks and you've added a new goal zone. A couple of drags and you resized and moved it to the perfect position.

Want a new wall here or there? No problem. Click click.
Want a drop zone here, or to change a block to a different type? No problem. Click click.



Once done, you can share your levels instantly via the Steam Workshop.


Two clicks is all it takes to upload your creations, and one click to download each new community created level you want to play. It couldn't be easier.




Have you got what it takes to become the next Stack Master?

2305050.name: Phase Line: Raider Assault
2305050.about_the_game:
**Game Update and Improved Features**

Dear players and supporters,

I want to express my sincere gratitude for your patience and understanding during the initial delay of my game’s launch. As a solo developer, I faced many unique challenges, including limited resources and time constraints. However, I firmly believe that quality should never be compromised, and I dedicated every available moment to enhancing the game.

The Good News: Dramatic Improvements!

I’m thrilled to announce that the past several months has been very transformative. The game now boasts significant enhancements across various aspects, including gameplay mechanics, modes, graphics, and overall performance. Your feedback has been invaluable, and I’ve taken it to heart to take extra time to improve the gameplay and work towards a successful launch. We have been actively testing the game online and are making major progress towards the early access release.

*Features*

True Third-Person Perspective:

See the Action Unfold: Dive into intense firefights from a dynamic third-person viewpoint. Whether you’re sprinting, crouching, proning, leaning, climbing, rolling, flying, riding, driving, sky diving or parachuting, the third-person perspective puts you right in the heart of the battle.

Dedicated Servers:
Seamless Multiplayer: Our game runs on robust dedicated servers, ensuring smooth gameplay, minimal lag and large player counts all across the globe.

-A MASSIVE 1,400 square mile sand box with nearly two dozen conquerable islands that is slated to support up to 200 concurrent players in single server. This sandbox mode features a dynamic day/night cycle and will act as a free-roam objective-based domination game mode with the full feature set of various aircraft, vehicles, boats and equipment to traverse the vast area.

-18 different drivable aircraft, tanks, vehicles and boats await your specific gameplay preferences. All with various different weapons and damage profiles, featuring munitions crate loading and unloading, aircraft refueling, ammunition reloading, passenger support, fast roping, sky diving, explosive projectiles, missiles, rockets, miniguns, machine guns, cannons and more.

-Over a dozen different player weapons with various different optics and suppressor options with individual damage and ballistic profiles. Anti-tank projectiles, fragmentation grenades, claymores, smoke grenades, Mk-19 automatic grenade launchers with many more weapons planned to be added in future updates.

-The game modes will include Domination, Team deathmatch, Deathmatch, Elimination as well as our newest flagship mode: Phase Line— with epic battles that should support up to 100 v 100. Team Deathmatch and Elimination support 12 v 12 with Deathmatch supporting up to 24 individual players.

Many of us are familiar with some of the traditional game modes available in Phase Line: Raider Assault, but I want to take a moment to emphasize the newest signature game mode Phase Line.

**Phase Line Mode**

Here's how it works:

-Teams vie for control of a mobile flag that shifts the front line. The flag bearer becomes the moving front line. The teams support the flag bearer in an effort to move the front line to the enemy phase line.

-Once the flag reaches the enemy’s phase line, a capture objective appears. Your team must capture it to secure victory.

-Dropping the flag halts objective progress. To continue, the flag must be picked up and moved past the enemy phase line to continue to capture the enemy objective.

-Players dynamically respawn behind the moving frontline on their respective team's side ensuring the battle continues to rage on and opposition is always nearby.

-Each team receives two highly important command trucks. These mobile bases spawn vehicles and outposts with munitions caches and Mk-19 automatic grenade launchers. These are critical for defense, offense and your team's overall success. Protect them.

-Finite Resources: Choose wisely—there’s a limit to the vehicles you can deploy.

-Frontline Tactics: Command trucks are lifelines. Use them strategically to move troops back to the battle, provide essential equipment and keep your team in play.

-Team effort and strategy are paramount to the success of your team's victory. This mode is designed to be played as a 360-degree security head-on-a-swivel strategy. Teams must play defense and offense in tandem to secure victory. Slip up and the enemy will run through your team and capture your objective.

-Feel your contribution to the collective effort: An individual player can have a dramatic effect on the battlefield. By eliminating enemy offense, capturing the objective or being responsible for moving the frontline for the entire team, your role will be vital and seen in the overall mission.

Phase Line: Raider Assault isn’t just a singular game; it’s vastly encompassing online multiplayer battle experience from the individual all the way up to the team effort. A multitude of mechanics, aircraft, vehicles and strategies exist to create a winning formula. Alliances are forged, strategies are tested, and legends are born. Rally your troops, capture the objective, and secure the win.

Are you ready to claim victory? Wishlist today!
