During a level, you might come across certain Pastries, you can eat them to gain powers, or you can combine TWO OF THEM and gain even more POWERFUL abilities!

• Up to 3 PLAYERS can join in for a fun MULTIPLAYER experience!
Help Loppy & Co. gather collectibles like Coins and Gem Medals, place Platforms to assist the Player in reaching hard-to-reach areas or use Bombs to defeat enemies! (Or... if you're feeling mischievous, use them to prank the main player!)

~ SPECIAL THANKS ~
HUGE thanks to Edward K. Stuart for providing most of the music, PST can be heard here -

2305110.name: Photon Engineer
2305110.about_the_game:
Gameplay

During your journey, you will be confronted with a variety of original and challenging puzzles. You will be required to form ingenious systems by building blocks having different abilities, such as deflecting and merging laser beams, turning and pushing other blocks.

Unleash your creativity and problem-solving skills to progress through the game, unravel the mysteries of your surroundings and unlock new information as you delve deeper into the unknown.

The laser puzzles are interspersed with sliding puzzles that require strategic moves to solve.

Story

In 2075, a space probe saw a strange platform floating in space near Jupiter. The government has decided to finance a space mission to send you on this platform to elucidate the mystery. Your mission is to discover why this platform exists and who built it.

Further details

  • 40 levels/platforms to discover.
  • 95 puzzles (45 puzzles with lasers and 50 sliding puzzles).
  • 20 puzzle achievements that extend the game experience.
  • Each puzzle is unique and provides a new idea.
  • Lasers are all marked with symbols for colorblind players.
2305110.supported_languages: English, French, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America

2305130.name: The Danger Zone
2305130.about_the_game:
Discover the new game universe of The Danger Zone:

  • A unique gameplay based shooter with side view, horror elements and immersive survival mechanics in a post-apocalypse setting.

  • Free Game Mode: A huge, uninhabited concrete shelter in which the player has to set up his life.

  • A world map with lots of sub-locations and points of interest. Explore unique, memorable places, discover hidden locations and geocaches.

  • Realistic and scenic environments. Changing weather, the cycle of day and night will increase immersion in the setting.

  • Realistic artificial intelligence systems that are on par with the constant lack of ammunition will keep even the most hardened players in suspense.

  • Over 200 in-game items and gear.

  • A large arsenal of weapons and a modding system.

Welcome to the new world

After thousands of intercontinental nuclear missiles had split the earth, enough time had passed: the era of eternal and cold winters was gone. The radioactive background has slowly drifted downward. And the people who had been living in underground shelters for a dozen years opened the gates of the seals again, smoldering with the hope of regaining control over the previously destroyed and lost world.

And in the end, we ended up back in the bunker

Having broken out of the underground dungeon, we were once again buried under a dense layer of earth in a concrete box - a bunker. It's dark, wet and incredibly cold. We're here for the long haul, so it would be nice to set up our new home and finally fix the hole in this rusty pipe.

This oppressive sky

As a result of global conflict, the world has undergone major changes. By pressing the red buttons, the leaders of the superpowers did not hesitate to exchange the most advanced means of destruction. The previously white-blue sky was forever colored in bright yellow shades, the radioactive background jumped dozens of times, and the district was filled with previously unknown and not very friendly creatures.

Outside the asylum is a huge open world

Around the refuge stretches a massive uncharted territory. Behind the edge of the forest area there may be a small abandoned village or a huge city, where everyone will find what they are looking for.

Attention! The global map will be changed and supplemented in each major content update.

There's danger all around

Widespread radioactive contamination is only one of the consequences of nuclear conflict. In addition to nuclear weapons, previously banned biological weapons have changed the fauna around you. Prepare to encounter creepy, frightening, and very unfriendly creatures along the way.

Every rifle is important

In a world where every piece of small arms is of great value, it is important to keep an eye on your equipment. The most detailed system of modifications will allow you to create a truly devastating means of defeat, even from weapons that have served their time. In pursuit of expanding the capabilities of their weapons can change anything. All accessories are based on real or close to real weapon prototypes and mods, which makes the game even more realistic.

2305160.name: Manabi SandBox
2305160.about_the_game:
Puzzle action game Manabi Sandbox


This is an action game in which you control a knight and explore unknown ruins.
The objective is to collect all the fruits on the map while exterminating monsters.
Overcome various difficulties with simple actions and ingenuity. You can also clear the game by jumping alone.
The knight never dies, so don't give up and solve all the puzzles.
The player's point of view hardly moves, so players who get drunk when playing 3D action games can enjoy the game without worry.

Game Controls


■Keyboard & Mouse
Quit （終了）: esc
Jump:Space
Move:WASD
Shot:R-Shift , R-Ctrl , LMB
Cam:←↑↓→ , Mouse Move
Restart : R


■Game Pad
Move:　Left Analog Stick
Shot:Y
Jump:B
Cam:Right Analog Stick
Restart : R1+L1

Features


Fruits
Fruits disappear upon contact or shot.
The number of remaining on the field is indicated by the UI.

Monsters
Beastmen and dragons stand in your way. They can be very damaging, but they always have a weak spot somewhere, and you can defeat them with a shot.
Sometimes you need to be tactful and move on without fighting.

moving floor
When you get on a moving floor, you can move to another stage. Some floors even move on contact.

Stones that can be moved
There are stones that can be moved by hitting them with your body. Even if you think you are trapped in a room, do not give up and find a way to get out.

Player Controls


Jump (Space)
Most obstacles on the field can be overcome by jumping.
Sometimes, a large jump can be made by using the moving floor.

Shot (R-Ctrl,R-Shift）
You can catch fruits or defeat monsters. You cannot shoot continuously, so please aim at the target well. You can adjust the trajectory by moving the camera.

Camera（←↑↓→）
Sometimes you want to look around, but you can hardly move the camera. This is because I sometimes get drunk when I operate the camera in 3D action games.

About clearing games


Play time is 5 to 10 minutes, so feel free to play.
Once you take all the fruits, you will have the ending of the game. After that, you can try as many times as you want.

2305180.name: You are the Judge!
2305180.about_the_game:
YOU ARE THE JUDGE!

For years, Kobardde has been the scene of various conflicts. You witnessed a lot of these conflicts in your youth. This situation in your country is one of the biggest reasons for your fondness for the concepts of justice and law. You have now concluded your long and successful career as a lawyer and are about to begin your first day of employment as a judge. You will examine dozens of realistic, complex, and carefully prepared case files, consult witnesses and try to make a decision. In your decision-making process, you will become familiar with the various factors in your country. The decisions you make will directly affect the lives of one or both parties to the case. The decisions you make over time can directly impact your life. What kind of a career as a judge will you pursue?

WHO IS THE RICHARD ANDERSON?

Your career as a judge is directly related to your past life. For this reason, the game starts with a story where you will make choices based on the events in your country and your life, from Richard's youth to the day he passed the judge's exam. Your preferences will be effective in your career as a judge. This is an excellent opportunity for you to shape your career.

WHO WILL CHALLENGE YOU THE MOST?

Kobardde got a new order after many years. Your role as a judge in this order puts you in a powerful position. However, there may be parties that may feel uncomfortable with your position. Although your decisions ease your conscience, they may not be considered appropriate by various segments. There will be situations where you will have to choose how much to compromise your values when deciding. You must identify your friends and foes for a long career as a judge.

HOW WILL YOU DECIDE?

  • Feel like a real judge with carefully prepared case files of tens of thousands of words inspired by actual events.
  • Experience a unique courtroom experience with realistic scene designs and animations.
  • The choices you make will take you to different ends of the game, have the chance to experience each one.
  • Resolve case files prepared with bribery and many other unique mechanics.
  • See the direct impact of the decisions and choices you make on your judge career.
2305180.supported_languages:
English*, Turkish, Russian, German
*languages with full audio support

2305190.name: Limbo Control
2305190.about_the_game:
Limbo Control — a tense asymmetric multiplayer horror experience (1v4).

One player becomes the Entity — an otherworldly force that has broken into reality. The other four are SSA agents, elite operatives sent to reclaim a location that’s slipping out of control.

Every match is a fight for territory and survival.

You are a supernatural creature, slowly takes over the world around you.

Manipulate the environment, sow fear, and expand your influence until nothing remains but your domain.

Key Features:

  • Begin as an invisible force, warping reality from the shadows

  • Trigger haunting events, set traps, and sabotage the agents' plans

  • Gather power and manifest physically to begin the hunt

  • Choose your path to victory: dominate the territory or eliminate resistance

You are part of an elite response team tasked with containing the anomaly and banishing the Entity.

Stay sharp, adapt fast, and take back the space before it’s too late.

Key Features:

  • Operate as a team or split up to complete critical objectives

  • Scan anomalies to uncover distortions in reality

  • Repair infrastructure to stabilize the environment

  • Use SSA technology to locate and weaken the Entity

2305210.name: Skyformer
2305210.about_the_game:
You are a robot sent to a planet to set up a system to make it habitable for your creators:

  • Design factories run by drones.

  • Create bases to craft and shelter in.

  • Upgrade your abilities and terraform to expand the area you can explore. You have both a health and charge meter that can get heavily upgraded over time. 

  • Set up systems to monitor storms and deploy resources to protect buildings in their path.

  • Build out a skybase that houses a data center and launches rockets.

  • Discover and grow various plants and stabilize the climate to make the planet habitable. Watch as the visibility increases to reveal your creation and the planet transforms dramatically from a barren to lush environment.

Build factories automated entirely by drones!

Create systems to mine and process materials in automated pipelines. Configure drones to easily handle the logistics.

Skyformer’s automation is different from that of similar games. Resource deposits provide an infinite supply of resources, but as you get further into the game it challenges and rewards you for utilizing the production rates that you have and the entire map the best that you can. At the same time, it keeps calculations straightforward with simple ratios and round numbers. There are also quality of life features that make it easy to understand what's going on; you can come back to old saves and quickly pick up where you left off.

Terraform and track the weather!

The processed materials allow you to create and run a system that controls the climate, tracks the weather, and terraforms the planet. As you terraform, the planet becomes more capable of producing weather systems, some of which being quite destructive. This game has a dynamic weather system that interacts with the geography, producing microclimates in each region based on the current global climate.

Survive the process and achieve habitability!

Changing the climate of the planet can allow access to previously inhospitable regions, but can also do the opposite. Observing the weather and how the geography influences it is important to surviving the terraforming process. A blend of strategies can be used to survive storms, such as building up an expansive automated drone defense system, strategically positioning buildings, or simply maximizing the power of your tools and taking storms head-on. The energy produced by the storms can also be harnessed!

The goal of the game is to achieve a climate that maximizes biomass across each region, and stabilize the atmosphere to the point at which storms are no longer destructive.

Development

Skyformer is a debut game made with passion with both the game engine and all the art handmade by one developer over several years. It's being worked on intensely to 1.0 in 2026!

Music and sound by Marty Meinerz.
2305210.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Russian, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain

2305310.name: Blind and Schizophrenic
2305310.about_the_game:
Sixty-nine year old Richard Cox is a washed up schizophrenic, who also happens to be blind on account of his constant absinthe consumption. Worse still, fate forces him to prolong his pitiful existence in spite of his handicaps. The only thing left to chance now is how he will spend the little time he has left......

- Explore the dark streets of your hometown using primarily sound and your schizophrenia

- Survive as many days as you can without dying or going insane

- See how much respect you can accumulate by completing quests for the denizens of the town, or by indulging in your own vices

- Smoke weed, collect welfare, or just shoot up the town, it's your sandbox!


What would you do if you were blind and schizophrenic?

2305320.name: 平凡的我與幽靈的同居生活
2305320.about_the_game:
《平凡的我與幽靈的同居生活》是講述一位青年因命運的安排而住進了一間存在幽靈的房間，並與該幽靈展開同居生活的戀愛題材的視覺小說遊戲。



故事簡介
物部才人在參加完父母的葬禮後回到家裡，但由於才人打算到東京找工作，於是便到東京尋找新居住的地方，在找了幾天後才人終於找到了一個便宜而且不錯的地方，因此爽快簽約並從原先的地方搬走，但入住後靈異事件不斷，打電話詢問經紀才知道這裡的上一手女主人死在這裡，簽約前也有跟主角說過，這時主角也隱約記起，就這樣開始了與幽靈的同居生活。


伊藤綾瀨
在才人搬過來之前的一年在家中死去，對於自己為什麼突然間離世沒有記憶，而且在此之後就一直待在這裡，也沒辦法離開，一直以來都是自己一個人，直至才人搬過來
擅長照顧人，而且因為自己一個人太久了，因此遇到才人後偶爾會捉弄一下他，與自己的媽媽吵架後獨自搬了出來

本作可攻略角色只有伊藤綾瀨，劇情為單向路線

本作遊戲時長大約為兩個小時







企劃&製作人：近火
劇本：近火
原畫：大白HT
編程：GAMLIC Studio
語音翻譯：柴
CV：月島クロス

殿下的配音感想

大家好，這邊是香港個人勢Vtuber月島クロス，你們超級高～貴又優雅的月島殿下です。
很高興能獲邀擔任女主角伊藤綾瀬的ＣＶ一役(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧
除了日常的歌曲錄製外，這是本殿第一次以VO的身份進錄音室，拿著台本的感覺很新奇及緊張呢！
女主角綾瀬是位十分直率，喜怒哀樂都表現在臉上的女生，所以在錄製聲演方面亦需要很明確地表現出各種感情。
配合著遊戲中劇情的發展而萌生的代入感令本殿很享受整個錄音過程，是一次非常有趣及寶貴的體驗。

謝謝監製一直給本殿很多自由度去發揮（所以中途亦因此出現了許許多多奇怪的演出ｗ）
很喜歡遊戲的劇本以及內心描寫，本殿在配音時已經常常在腦內幻想著一個又一個的場景，令人更期待實際遊玩時的感動。

希望各位都能喜歡及享受這個遊戲！謝謝大家(•ө•)♡
2305320.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305320/平凡的我與幽靈的同居生活/

2305330.name: Car Dealer's Life
2305330.about_the_game:
Do you want to come to this city? Let me tell you from the beginning that this city has its own unique rules. If you want to do car trading in this city, you need to establish a company and obtain a license. After doing these, it would be nice to buy yourself a gallery. If your money is not enough, it's easy to get a loan from a bank. You can start trading by buying one of the cars for sale on the city's streets. Everyone's story starts on the streets anyway. Would you like me to give you more information? Sure, but first click on the Wishlist button above to follow me.If you follow me, I already share everything that's happening in the city, so you can learn from there.


While you are driving around the city with your car, you can go hunting for vehicles, if you haven't bought a house yet, you can go to a hotel and spend the night. Since you will spend a lot of time in the city with your car, a fast vehicle will return to you as more snow.



Develop your showroom and ensure that more customers visit you. Seize the opportunity to earn more income with the additional features you will gain.



Customize your cars and sell them at a higher price. Selling customized cars will gain you popularity in the city and bring you customers who want to customize their cars.




Looking for some excitement? Then the black market is just for you. Some cars can only be obtained through the black market.
Remember, these vehicles are illegal and there is always a risk of being scammed while trying to obtain them!




The city junkyard will be an essential destination for you. You will obtain the parts you need for vehicle repairs from here.


    KEY FEATURES
  • You can drive any car that belongs to you, and having a fast car while driving around the city can help you earn more money.
  • Selling a car directly may not always yield a good profit. You can make more money by repairing or customizing a car, or even obtaining a rental license to rent it out.
  • Some cars may have a much higher actual value, and you need to work with an expert company to learn about it.
  • You need to have a license for many operations you will perform in the city, and you can do any job that you can obtain a license for. While some licenses are easy to obtain, for others, you need to win an auction.
  • You will participate in auctions and bid at many points in the game, which may be for a lost profession license or a seized car.
  • You can improve your garage, and these improvements will give you extra features.
  • It is possible to make money through some illegal methods in the game, such as stealing cars at night and selling them. You can see more in the game.
  • You can reduce your workload in the game by finding colleagues to work with.

2305360.name: Velo
2305360.about_the_game:
Velo is a unique cycling game that combines the thrill of virtual cycling with an engaging story-driven experience. Unlike other cycling games, Velo is a single-player adventure that takes you on a journey through a beautifully crafted virtual world, filled with stunning scenery and compelling characters.

Using smart trainers connected via Bluetooth, players must pedal their way through the game's challenging terrain, unlocking new areas and missions as they progress through the game's story. With a variety of missions and quests to complete, players will be challenged both physically and mentally as they explore the game's world.

The story of Velo is immersive and captivating, with a cast of characters and a richly detailed world that will keep players engaged and motivated to keep pedaling. With each mission, players will uncover more of the game's story, unlocking new areas and discovering the secrets hidden within the game's world.

No schedules, no training plans, no workouts, no competitions, just the joy of riding through a beautiful world while delivering important packages to its inhabitants. Velo is the perfect game for anyone looking for a way to stay active that is so fun to play that it draws them back in.

So if you're ready for a cycling adventure like no other, it's time to start your journey through this exciting new world.

2305380.name: Attack on Hex Island
2305380.about_the_game:
A cute and approachable turn-based deck builder/card battler that combines the battle systems from Tetra Master/Triple Triad and Pokémon. Collect, upgrade, and customize your party to strategically defeat your opponents and save them from the attack on Hex Island.

Use your arrows to capture the opponent's tokens and convert them into your color. The player with the most tokens in their color at the end of the match wins.

When arrows connect, a battle is triggered and dice are rolled. Battles may add risk, but allow for additional captures through combos. Element types are vital to your success, and will provide an attack boost when used against weaker elements.

Discover different ways to outwit your opponent and secure the win. Some tokens contain Special Abilities, each with its own unique effect.

Keep an eye out for Walls, Field Elements, Bombs, and other obstacles found on the board that can also be used to your advantage.

Grow your collection of tokens and critters by looting your opponent after a victory, opening booster packs, and finding treasure chests.

Tokens come in a variety of designs, elements, abilities, and arrow compositions, allowing you to create a unique party that best fits your playstyle. You can also upgrade and modify your tokens in order to have the upper hand during your next match.

Engage in friendly exhibition matches against other players, or put your friendship to the test by looting all of their tokens! Customize the board to your advantage, or leave it to chance and adapt your strategy as you play.

Join our Discord to leave feedback and get updates, and subscribe to our YouTube channel to see what games we're working on next!
2305380.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Russian

2305400.name: Seed of the World
2305400.about_the_game:
Introduction:
This game was created by someone with no prior game development experience. The goal was to create an ambitious RPG game set in a fictional world of swords and magic and embark on an adventure in the continent of Palembar.

Many Classes to Play:
You will explore the world and yourself during your travels. We offer over 130 classes (with 300+ in the full game) to choose from, ranging from front-line warriors to chefs or miners. Some classes have similar playing styles, while others require skills or luck that can only be discovered through exploring the continent of Palembar.

Choice Matters:
On your journey, you will encounter multiple paths and storylines to choose from. However, you must keep in mind that you are only one player in a larger conflict, and at times you may be swept away by its current. So, what choices will you make?

Available Content in Early Access:

50% of the game's storyline
130+ classes with complete skills in tiers 1-2
75% of the Palembar continent ready for exploration

Roadmap for the Game until it Leaves Early Access:

Short-Term Goals:

Weekly bug fixes and balance adjustments

Medium-Term Goals:

Monthly updates that add new classes, weapons, armor, and monsters.

Long-Term Goals:

6-10 months after release, the game will exit Early Access with the following:
All 300 classes with skills and weapons/armor
All exploration areas open
The full game story
Lots of side quests
Unique bosses and monsters
Increased flexibility and variety of options
Improved graphics and effects

Goals Based on Sales:

200 sales: new monster art
400 sales: new monster and NPC art
600 sales: new monster, NPC, and background art
800 sales: new game art
1000 sales: new game art and music

***The game was released in Early Access to gauge the direction and potential of this game genre. Currently, the game's artwork is from RPG Maker and third-party sources. If the game receives positive feedback, the assets will be modified to be more unique.

2305420.name: The Lithium Moon Incident
2305420.about_the_game:
A VISUAL JOURNEY ABOUT LOVE AND SCIENCE

Follow Eve through her journey to discover the truth behind her world.
Solve Puzzles, do science and meet robots !

The Lithium moon incident is a 2D side scrolling game that will transport you inside a different world.
A world where robots and people shares the same streets and the same feelings.

WHAT HAPPENED TO GAL ?
Piece after piece, complete the puzzle in order to find out where is Gal, then, solve the mystery.

COMPLETE THE LITHIUM MOON
Gal the scientist left some clues, will you be able to put the thing together and complete his masterpiece ?

ROBOTS ARE PEOPLE
ROBOTS ARE PEOPLE, STOP SAYING THE OPPOSITEEEE !!!!!!!!!
2305420.supported_languages:
English*, Italian
*languages with full audio support

2305480.name: 觅光：第一章 - Seeking Light : Chapter 1
2305480.about_the_game:
【故事介绍】

在和平的葡葡果蜜花园小镇，有一个热心的勇者叫做莱特。他十分喜欢帮助别人，在小镇中过着快乐而自在的生活。
直到某天，他的朋友向他道出一个秘密……
“莱特，你一定要……”

【玩法介绍】

这是一个轻松可爱的剧情向rpg游戏，玩家将与勇者莱特一起在温馨小镇进行愉快生活！
  • 你可以与小镇的朋友聊天，探索发现新风景~
  • 帮助居民们完成他们的请求，这是勇者该做的事！
  • 在粉红沙滩钓鱼享受悠闲时光。
  • 烹饪美味食物来送给居民吧。
  • 不过在那之前得先种植作物哦。
  • 对了，再帮镇长做一件新衣服吧！

【游戏特色】

  • 独特的世界观与可爱剧情，内含furry与GB元素，调查发现更多惊喜！

  • 丰富的小游戏和轻松互动，你可以在这里自由探索，完成各种有趣的任务！

  • 清新优美的美术风格，游戏中涵盖大量动画，CG与美丽地图场景哦！

【关于游玩】


「游戏时长」
2小时

「结局数量」
2个结局
解锁特殊回忆剧情且在游戏内达成2个结局将自动进入附赠房间

「操作方式」
方向键/鼠标：移动
Shift+方向键： 跑步
空格/鼠标：对话/调查物品（长按空格跳过对话）
ESC/鼠标右键：取消/打开菜单

【staff】

制作人、剧本：lidogegg

美术：lidogegg、伊柚
发行：梦结界工作室

特别感谢：
音乐感谢Alexander Nakarada，更多引用素材来源详见游戏内ED
本游戏使用GameCreator开发

2305490.name: THE SEGMENT TWINS
2305490.about_the_game:
The Segment World, Unique Tag Action
In The Segment World, Each stage has two backgrounds that coexist in a segmented form. Each background separates into the twin zones. You can do tag action through segments and use each style of attack.




The Mush Hunter Twins, "Matilda" and "Amanda"
These are twin girls who make a living by eradicating Mush. The twin girls have a "Sword Master" and "Gunslinger" attack style.


Stylish and Hit Satisfaction
The game is fast-paced in classic arcade format. You can feel a good hit satisfaction as the battle is the main one.


Toon Style Graphics
It features unique graphics that mimic Comics' feelings, including halftone and glitch effects.




Various Mush and Five Charming Bosses
Defeat various types of mush and defeat overwhelming bosses!
2305490.supported_languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

2305500.name: FAIRY TAIL: DUNGEONS
2305500.about_the_game:
Fairy Tail: Dungeons sets the characters of the Fairy Tail series exploring a dungeon using only a limited number of moves and a strategically built deck of skill cards to take down foes as they make for the deepest depths.

Features an All-new Story


One day, Natsu and Happy discover a mysterious door has suddenly appeared below the guild.
Inside, they find a strange, expansive dungeon that saps all intruders of their powers.
With no means to defend themselves, the two seem doomed until an Exceed called Labi comes to their aid.
Once they hear about Labi's missing friend, Natsu and Happy decide to head for the deepest depths themselves.

Labyrinth (Solo Dungeon)


Use the cards in your deck to attack, defend, cast magic, and more.
Power up your deck further with cards won in battle or found in treasure chests.
Use cards in a specific order to activate Magic Chains for punishing amounts of damage.


Explore the solo dungeon and unlock powerful skills before your lantern goes out. If you're lucky,
you might even run into fellow guild members who can join up with you!


Even if you fall in battle, the points you earn exploring will unlock amulets which will aid in future runs through the dungeon.
Don't let defeat stop you. Try and try again!

Characters


Each character has their own fighting style and fortes.
Natsu, a balanced all-rounder.
Lucy, who calls on her unique celestial spirits to wreak havoc on the battlefield.
Gray, who uses diverse molding magic to gain tactical advantage, and many more!
Discover how to use each effectively and earn the upper hand in battle.

Labyrinth Depths (Team Dungeon)


Form a team with 3 characters you've trained in the solo dungeon, and dive deep into the depths.
Find tomes inside to power up your team's stats.
Don't miss out on the final boss—an original character illustrated by Fairy Tail creator Hiro Mashima himself!

Music

Features a soundtrack produced by Secret of Mana composer Hiroki Kikuta.
The world of Fairy Tail comes alive through Celtic-inspired sounds that add a vibrant backdrop to the battles and story scenes.

2305510.name: Deaded

DEADED Is a Third Person Survival game where you scavenge, build, survive and thrive through the zombie infested post apocalyptic world. With heavy emphasis on physics and ragdoll - block, push and move objects to manipulate zombies to gain an advantage against them.

Physics and Ragdoll
DEADED aims to create an environment in which realistic zombies interact with. Block door ways with couches, barricade doors with wood and have the ability to push zombies over. These zombies will attack you head on, ignoring objects in their way so use it to your advantage.



Save Survivors
Save survivros you find throughout the city and assign them jobs at your base to produce valuable resources. Make them cut wood, scavenge scrap piles or set them as a security gaurd to help defend against the undead.



Scavenge
Scavenge the city for valuable loots and rummage through housese to find materials to help you and your community survive.



Combat
Shoot, slice and stomp your way through the infected with a variety of weapons such as the machete and pistol, damage any zombies limb enough and it will pop off!



The Fog City
With the ever changing fog city, discover a way to navigate through it without getting lost. As with each entry something always changes, and its up to you to find out why and how to solve a route of safety through the city.

2305640.name: Bladesong
2305640.about_the_game:
The Songs have fallen silent and the world lies in ruin, lost to madness and despair. But within the high walls of Eren Keep, life persists – held together by unbreakable will and the iron fist of the Masked King, ruler and tyrant, savior and messiah.

As the swordsmith of Eren Keep, you turn steel into something more precious than gold. Customers come with coin in their hands and demands on their lips, seeking blades of deadly precision, balance, and beauty. Meet their requests, perfect your craft and find trusted companions in one of the last beacons of civilization.

Yet in the dark corners of Eren Keep, whispers of rebellion stir. The former blacksmith’s mysterious disappearance looms as an ill omen over the role you play. But play it you must, for in Eren Keep, the right blade in the right hand will change everything.

Craft swords your way using freeform blade shaping and an intricate modular building system. Create the weapons of any world – East to West, history to fantasy – with every detail customized, every piece meticulously crafted and adorned. Explore a vast library of sword parts and engravings, with plenty of materials like metal, leather, wood, obsidian and ivory to choose from. No two creations are the same.

Take commissions from warriors, nobles, and mercenaries. Use innovative tools to design and craft each sword, balancing ratings and requirements with precision to meet your customers’ specific needs and expectations. Learn how to curve blades and carve engravings, acquire rare materials, and expand your arsenal of sword parts. Keep up with demand by hiring unique characters to your forge, each with their own ambitions and stories.

Visit beautifully illustrated locations around Eren Keep, from the bustling Citadel Square to the local tavern The Den, to find opportunity, alliances, or merely a moment of respite. As you craft blades for Eren Keep’s various factions – like the scavenging Crows or the scholars of the Magisterium – will you be drawn into their visions for reclaiming the fallen world? Or will your growing influence risk attracting the Masked King’s silent gaze?

Grow your collection of sword parts in Campaign Mode and forge without limits in Creative Mode, a deep swordmaking sandbox featuring a vast library of sword parts, tools, materials, and engravings. Use Magic Words to easily share creations among Bladesong’s active community of swordsmiths, and print models of your in-game creations by exporting STL files for 3D printing. Find inspiration in regular community challenges and join the club of champions!

We think you'll love Bladesong if you enjoy…

Kingdom Come: Deliverance II, Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord, Baldur’s Gate 3, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Hellish Quart, Half Sword, Blade and Sorcery, PC Building Simulator, Potion Craft, Disco Elysium, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Total War: MEDIEVAL II, Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder.

Your destination is the clone adult park built by Mozi Technology Co., Ltd., where you will play a character of the Three Kingdoms. I wish you a pleasant trip, thank you!

Each park has a unique landscape and ecological environment, as well as unique cloned creatures. These cloned creatures are assigned to each park according to the level, for the entertainment of players of different levels. You can kill them at will, and for this purpose, you will also provide rich trophies to reward players



The clones controlled by "players" and AI clones in the park are essentially artificial intelligence products produced by Mozi Company, so the human legal system has no ethical and moral constraints on these products. "players" can play heroes and demons here, either right or evil, and even you are allowed to kill clones of other players here, The park strives to let players establish rules here by themselves. In addition to the innate background of heroes of the Three Kingdoms and some unique characteristics, each clone controlled by "players" can be redefined by players, that is, his ability, skills, equipment and other elements are all optional for players. Zhao Yun with a spear is not necessarily a soldier, but also a mage. Zhuge Liang with a feather fan and a silk scarf is not necessarily a mage, but also a soldier! Cao Cao can be a shooter and Liu Bei can also be an assassin, Lv Bu can be the strongest shield, Diao Chan can also be the strongest output, and so on. City siege competition, sword point Chang'an, write your name in the history of the Three Kingdoms



When you can go to Cyberpunk's Chang'an City Park, you can participate in the all-weather Chang'an City siege war. If you are strong enough, you can take down the city alone in a thousand. 2305720.name: Whispering Shadows
2305720.about_the_game:
Whispering Shadows is not your typical Horror game. Whispering Shadows is a worlds first for video games. Every year throughout Halloween Millions visit Horror theme parks around the world with Universal Studios alone receiving 1.5 million visitors throughout their Halloween event. So what happens when Halloween is over and you want that scare maze/ Horror fix, well most turn to their favourite forms of media being that Movies and Video games. Whispering Shadows is designed to give you that horror fix all year round with constant updates and changes to attractions and mazes so you never know what could be lurking around the next corner.

The Theme Park
The Theme Park is being created in a space of roughly 3 km² with 10 scare attractions on release and a planned 12 scare attractions within the first year. We plan to release at least 1 new scare attraction into the park every month whilst making ongoing changes to current attractions. The park will not just have scare mazes and haunts but also fun and interactive shows to watch and fairground style Halloween themed games to play i.e. A Thrilling show in our graveyard amphitheatre or our Zombie shooting gallery where you can unlock additional content throughout the park.


The Plague Doctors Spinner

Grab a bite at the Diner
The Scare Mazes
We already have 8 scare mazes in place with more to be implemented before release with changes and new mazes every month after release.

The Family: Venture into the foreboding depths of The Family's haunted abode, where the air is thick with an unshakable sense of dread. Brave souls are beckoned by curiosity, enticed by the enigma surrounding this malevolent residence. Whispers permeate the air, tales of the village folk who ventured in and never returned, their fates entwined with the sinister secrets hidden within these walls. Rumours speak of unholy rituals, demonic pacts, and shadows that dance in the moonlight, only daring to emerge when darkness blankets the world. The local community, gripped by fear, hints at unspeakable horrors, the very mention of The Family sending shivers down their spines. As you cross the threshold, every creaking floorboard and flickering candlelight tells a chilling tale. Will you brave the unknown, unravel the mysteries that shroud this ominous mansion, and confront the darkness that resides within The Family's cursed legacy? The choice is yours, but be warned: once you enter, there may be no escape from the haunting secrets that await.


The home of The Family
Carnival of Grins: A chilling journey into the heart of fear, where the echoing laughter of sinister clowns mingles with the screams of the brave souls who dare to enter. As visitors navigate the twisting, dimly lit corridors, they encounter a surreal world of grotesque carnival games and eerie illusions. Sinister clowns, with their painted smiles and malevolent eyes, lurk around every corner, ready to unleash their nightmarish tricks on unsuspecting victims. The air is thick with anticipation, and the line between reality and nightmare blurs in this terrifying maze, leaving visitors questioning what is real and what is an illusion. Will you escape the clutches of these malevolent jesters, or will you become another twisted spectacle in their demented carnival?


The Carnival of Grins
The Backwoods: Enter the heart of terror in "The Backwoods" a spine-chilling maze experience inspired by a gruesome tale from the rural depths. Step into the eerie, dilapidated farmhouse of a deranged family, where the echoes of revving chainsaws fill the air, and the line between hunter and prey blurs into a nightmarish frenzy. As you navigate the labyrinth of decaying rooms and twisted corridors.

Solitary Confinement: The Isolation Experience,' a harrowing journey inside the confines of a stark, unforgiving container. In this immersive encounter, participants find themselves alone in an unsettling, dimly lit space, The silence is deafening, broken only by the sound of your own heartbeat, echoing in the enclosed space. Shadows dance, and the mind plays tricks, blurring the line between reality and imagination. As time stretches, the isolation becomes a tangible presence, testing your sanity and resolve. Will you endure the solitude, or will the confinement break your spirit, leaving you forever changed by the experience?

Tunnel of Despair: Love's Twisted Embrace: where romance and horror entwine in a chilling dance. What appears to be a charming boat ride for couples takes an ominous turn as you glide through dimly lit waters, surrounded by the echoes of haunting whispers and ghostly apparitions. As the boat drifts deeper into the tunnel, the air becomes thick with an inexplicable sense of dread. Shadows flicker, and the once enchanting music distorts into a dissonant melody. Love-struck couples are replaced by ghastly spectre's, their hollow eyes fixated on you, their tragic love stories unfolding in eerie vignettes along the walls.

Labyrinth of the Damned: The Slasher experience where fear takes physical form in the twisting corridors of a forsaken maze. As you step into this nightmarish realm, you find yourself pursued by a notorious serial killer. The maze is alive with the chilling presence of the murderer, who watches your every move, leaving cryptic clues and taunting messages along the way. As you progress, You'll encounter eerily realistic crime scenes, each more terrifying than the last, forcing you to confront the depths of human depravity.


The Slaughter house
Themed Scare Zones: As well as the mazes and attractions the park is littered with themed scare zones. in one area you could be wandering through a Zombie Apocalypse and another A Cursed Village.


The Gloomy Woods, home to the twisted Ghost train
Shows and games: When you step away away from the main attractions to take a breather you will find our side shows dotted around the park along with carnival games and easter egg hunts.

Game Modes
There will be three ways to play Whispering Shadows:

Fear Mode for those that want a challenge and earn there way around the parks attractions. You will start with small amount of cash but will need to earn more via carnival games, Easter egg hunts and challenges. You will need to pay your way onto the rides and scare mazes and will need to keep your 'Fear meter' high enough to be able to make it through the scare mazes.

Adventure Mode this will be for those that want to experience all the park has to offer without being held back. Ride the coasters, play the carnival games, view all the shows, take a tour through all the scare mazes and enjoy a meal free of charge in the Hogs Diner.

4 player Co-op Mode Invite up to 3 friends to join you in your park. Experience all the park has to offer in Adventure Mode with your friends at your side... or for those with a devious side you can control how the scare mazes play out, control the jump scares, layout and lighting while you watch and listen from the comfort of the control room. You can even dress as the scare actors if you want live out that inner Movie serial killer role.

Throughout our development process, we are working to add new features and content to the game and taking feedback from our players into consideration. We will be releasing a demo for our game, which is still in development, soon. If you'd like to be notified when the demo is available, please don't forget to add our game to your Wishlist!

Valdoron was an ancient kingdom that had lived in peace and prosperity for many years. But everything changed with the rise of a dark evil from the east. The kingdom's cities began to fall one by one, its people slaughtered, and even the dead were turned into soldiers for the darkness as cursed spirits possessed their bodies.

Zalbanor, the kingdom's last line of defense, eventually fell. The king and most of his people were either killed or taken captive. Far in the northern lands, Arndur—the exiled heir to the throne—had been watching the kingdom’s slow descent into chaos. Though far from home, he had not turned his back on his people. Gathering strength and forging alliances in secret, he had been preparing for the day he would return.

When Zalbanor fell, Arndur knew the time had come. He could wait no longer. He set out on a perilous journey to reclaim his homeland and face the ancient enemies that had brought ruin to Valdoron.

But the darkness Arndur was about to confront was far greater than he had imagined. Witnessing the brutality of war up close, he found himself fighting not only an overwhelming enemy beyond his borders, but also a growing shadow within his own heart.

As Arndur gathered his courage and strength to save Valdoron, every step became a desperate struggle for survival. In this battle, Arndur wasn’t just fighting to restore a kingdom—he was fighting to save his very soul.

2305800.name: Anipocalypse
2305800.about_the_game:
The Animal Apocalypse has begun!
Play thrhough the epic, totally normal and definitly 100% serious storyline of Anipocalypse!
Shoot your way through hordes of zombies and mutated animals of all kinds. Go in guns blazing in the forest, or go stealth mode with a sniper on a rooftop.

PVP against your friends!

2305810.name: Low Oxygen
2305810.about_the_game:

RETURN OF THE CAT

Delve into a paw-geous new world with varied dungeons and biomes to explore, and encounter fierce battles with the newly refined combat system featuring tighter attack combos and weapon swapping. SAIL THROUGH THE PURRIBEAN

Street Basket Challenge is a 2-on-2 SD-style basketball game featuring charismatic characters and a gameplay system inspired by classic arcade beat ’em ups.

As usual for the series, traditional sports rules don’t apply. Players can steal the ball from opponents by any means necessary.

Each team has a basket on three different backboards—high, medium, and low. Once a basket receives enough points, it breaks off the backboard. You can pick it up and repair it… or take it and attach it to your opponent’s board.

Stages include unique features such as traps and boost zones, and each character comes equipped with distinct abilities, special techniques, and powerful super shots.

The game also includes a full tournament mode where players can level up, unlock improvements, and customize their playstyle. 2306010.name: Surviving The Fall
2306010.about_the_game:
In this game, players take on the role of a nordic soldier in a post-apocalyptic world where a mysterious virus has wiped out most of the population. As the player navigates through the ruins of their once-great city, they must scavenge for resources, defend themselves against dangerous scavengers and mutated creatures, and uncover the truth about the virus and its origins. The game is set in a sprawling, open-world landscape that has been ravaged by a virus. The player starts in their apartment, which serves as a safe haven and base of operations. From there, they can explore the city and the landscape, which is filled with abandoned buildings, overgrown streets, and other hazards. The player will encounter other survivors along the way, some of whom are friendly and willing to trade or provide information about the virus or the mutated, while others are hostile and will attack on sight. The gameplay in "Surviving the Fall" is a mix of survival, exploration, and combat. The player will need to gather resources such as food, water, and medical supplies to stay alive. They can scavenge for these items in abandoned buildings and on the streets, or trade with other survivors for them. The player will also need to defend themselves against scavengers and mutated creatures, using a variety of weapons such as guns, melee weapons, and traps.
As the player progresses through the game, they will uncover clues about the virus and its origins. The player will have to decide whether to try to expose the truth and bring those responsible to justice, or to focus on simply surviving in this new, dangerous world.
Overall, "Surviving the Fall" is a tense and immersive survival game that puts players in the shoes of a lone soldier fighting to stay alive in a post-apocalyptic world. With its open-world setting, deep survival mechanics, and compelling story.

2306150.name: CryoNation

In the far reaches of space, a dying star threatens the existence of a once-thriving colony. "Cryo Nation" is a sci-fi simulation and strategy game that places you in the role of a colony commander, tasked with leading your people to safety and prosperity. As the commander, you'll navigate a complex web of decisions, challenges, and opportunities.

Your primary mission is to manage resources, making sure your colony has enough food, water, and energy to survive. You'll command dropship missions to explore the planet's surface, uncover valuable resources, and fend off threats from the unforgiving environment. As you expand, base building becomes a crucial part of your strategy, with the construction of vital facilities like housing, power plants, and research centers.

To thrive, you must invest in research and technology, unlocking new possibilities and ways to improve your colony's efficiency. Diplomacy and trade will play a pivotal role as you interact with other factions on the planet, forming alliances or engaging in conflicts based on your choices.

Exploration is a key aspect of "Cryo Nation." The dying star hides many secrets, both fascinating and dangerous. Your decisions will shape the narrative as you uncover the mysteries of the cosmos.

Ultimately, the fate of the colony is in your hands. "Cryo Nation" offers a dynamic and immersive experience that challenges players to balance resource management, strategic planning, and discovery. Will you rise to the occasion and lead your colony to success, or will you succumb to the intrigue and uncertainties of the cosmos? The story is yours to own in this gripping sci-fi adventure.

2306240.name: Hustlerix
2306240.about_the_game:
Ancient Horse Theft

Hustlerix is an open-world, top-down action game, where you step into the sandals of Gaul, a hero molded in the crucible of adversity. Jump straight into a stunningly detailed, isometric world inspired by ancient Rome, teeming with vibrant landscapes, bustling cities, and deadly arenas. Challenge the authority of the corrupt Senate, and etch your legacy into this epic period. It's your destiny to uncover the truth behind the mysterious forces that are secretly manipulating the course of history.

Slay Mythical Beasts

Engage in riveting dialogues, interspersed with philosophical debates that will test your knowledge and cunning. Stand up against oppressive laws, stone villains to ensure justice, and best monstrous beasts straight out of the folklore of the time. Encounter the infamous Minotaur, the relentless Hydra, and a plethora of other mythological adversaries on your quest to become a true legend.

Master the Art of War

Hone your combat prowess as you duel against Roman soldiers, utilizing a robust combat system that combines strategic decision-making with reflex-based action. Wrestle against fierce gladiators in the blood-soaked sands of the Colosseum, stake your claim in exhilarating chariot races, and hurl massive menhirs at those who dare to challenge you.

Shape Your Destiny

Embark on thrilling quests, each more perilous than the last, as you navigate this ruthless world. Face off against infamous historical figures, outwit cunning thieves, and brawl with patrolling legionnaires. Indulge your rebellious side by becoming a notorious horse thief, or direct your rage towards the corrupt, plundering wealthy civilians to distribute wealth among the needy.

Find Peace Amidst the Chaos

But it's not all battle and bloodshed. Hustlerix also offers quieter moments to unwind. Experience the simple pleasures of the era, be it relishing a hearty meal in a roadside tavern, enjoying the melodious tunes of wandering bards, or participating in lively banter with citizens around the campfire. You can even take a moment to appreciate the stunning vistas, thanks to the game's dynamic day-night cycle and weather system.

Satire and Wisdom in a Game That Blurs Eras

This rich open-world experience is further enhanced with an undercurrent of contemporary satire, seamlessly weaving allusions to our modern world into the fabric of ancient Rome. Hustlerix is more than just a game - it's a window to the past, a challenging philosophical journey, and a poignant commentary on our own time.



With an array of audacious tasks to undertake, epic figures to confront, and an immersive world to explore, Hustlerix promises an unforgettable gaming experience that appeals to the inner hustler in everyone.

2306380.name: Sally Can't Sleep
2306380.about_the_game:
You read the freakin' title!! Help her out!

Sally Summers, an average Jill living in her apartment in L.A, has trouble getting to sleep one night. As it turns out, her favourite pillow needs some new feathers! Are you a bad enough dude to collect the feathers in this First-person Dream exploration Collectathon Platformer?

EXPLORE A LABYRINTH OF DREAM WORLDS

A massive world with 40+ interconnected levels to explore, fully open from the start and brimming with secrets.

DISCOVER NEW ABILITIES

Steadily unlock an advanced repertoire of new movement abilities as you explore, from thrusters, to grapple hands, and even transforming into a marble!

VALIDATE YOUR GAMER LICENSE

Not all of the feathers come easy! The world is chock-full of challenges to put your movement to the test, as well as secret challenge levels full of tricky platforming and hazards; all of which can be tackled at any point!

BONUS CONTENT

Unlock a score attack mode with over 20 stages to chase S-ranks in, as well as other modes and fun extras.

2306390.name: Soul Knight: The Forest of Spirits
2306390.about_the_game:
A lone knight finds himself lost in the abyss of an enigmatic cave. Your mission is to walk the path forward and discover a way out, facing challenges at every step. With unique abilities, the knight must progress through the sinister darkness, avoiding obstacles and finding innovative solutions to his puzzles. The knight can only count on his unshakable soul to face the uncertainties of the unknown and unravel the secrets hidden in the depths of the cave in this journey that requires cunning and bravery.

The controls are the mouse to control the knight's soul and move it where you want, keyboard to move in the desired directions and space for acquired skills.

Be sure to use your soul wisely to advance the paths.


With each different room you'll find new challenges, be it different mechanics or suspicious paths. Make sure you make the best decision or you will end up dying!


There will be 75 different levels in which there will be progressive difficulty, exciting music on your journey and highly challenging but rewarding gameplay.

2306400.name: Lost Surreal Hell
2306400.about_the_game:
A Surreal Horror Game Inspired By Reoccurring Dreams.


Lost Surreal Hell is a Turn Based RPG, where you collect elements, and evolve your attacks, BUT if you wander too far off the path, you may end up stuck in a strange surreal hell full of aesthetic clashing, disjointed worlds full of surreal comedy shows, brainwashing, a strange company running a dying MMO in the backrooms and a dark truth.

A game world left to rot.


Follow the journey of the main character as they "mysteriously appear" in a colourful, dream-like world.
It is clear that there is something wrong with this world however, only you can unravel the truth.




Combat can take a while to learn and has difficult survival horror resource management elements to it.

Every fight in this game is winnable, no matter how impossible some of them may seem.

There are no luck based misses in this game, if the opponent wants to dodge a bullet, they must have a higher speed stat than the speed of sound, otherwise it will hit them 100% of the time.

Each element has it's own evolution tree, attack evolutions can be purchased from the evolution menu, and you can only equip 6 attacks at a time from your list allowing for many different options and playing styles.

2306450.name: Tartarus Longo Itinere
2306450.about_the_game:
Tartarus is a DungeonCrawler in Card format that will drop you into the fiery Inferno. Use your skills to kill as many creatures as possible and successfully pass the Mephisto's test... The Long Itinere. Harness the power of Virgo's light, the strength of Gabriel's shields, the ingenuity of Diocles' tricks or the mercenary techniques of Eris to show Mephisto what you're made of!!!

FEATURES


  • Unique progression system : Make your way through the dungeon by choosing from different paths with 3 cards each turn, but choose the best path, staying on sides is not always advantageous!

  • Tactics : With each action you will have to make decisions that will change the fate of the game. A merchant will help you in your hellish journey and much more to be discovered.

  • Procedural Generation : Thanks to this system, Gameplay will always be different but also increasingly complex. This will give you a chance to get to know your heroes better with each game.

What you'll find in Tartarus


  • 4 heroes to discover with compelling stories.

  • 4 different abilities for each hero.

  • Endless monsters and bosses to defeat.

  • 1 merchant who will offer you his goods for a few coins... Items that are sometimes FUNDAMENTAL to your path in the Long Itinere.

  • 4 types of items with different uses that will help you in your adventure.

  • 1 different inventory system for each hero...

This and Tartarus a Dungeon Crawler with a unique pixel art style of graphics

Our history


What is Tartarus - Longo Itinere? It is a dream of two boys, it is an opportunity to change their lives, it is their effort, it is their commitment, it is the desire to evolve and not give up.

Tartarus after years of development and challenges because none believed in them and in their abilities. This led Giacomo and Michael to try to publish their game on Steam with the hope of making their dream come true.

Enjoy 9 levels, solve puzzles, each of which is unique and difficult in its own way, and the solution of which will give you an incredible experience and a new exhibit in your personal gallery.

2306490.name: GNAW
2306490.about_the_game:
Meet Mack Ripley! He’s got short arms, a big heart, and dreams of being something… more.

New Dino City is the heart of saurian civilization; a bustling metropolis filled with dinosaurs large and small. Creatures of all species live together in peace… or they did until something began upsetting the natural order. Now, thrown into a strange situation filled with weird science and even stranger events, it’s up to Mack Ripley to unravel the mystery and save the world from extinction.

Not Your Average ‘Saur Anymore

Mack Ripley was just a guy living his life, wishing he could be something special. Thanks to a freak encounter of the science kind, Mack has been transformed. If you’ve never seen a dinosaur with otherworldly powers, get ready to be amazed as Mack chomps, spits, and devours his foes.

Strange Powers: You Can Gnaw Your Own Way

With each new skill, you’ll be able to unlock new ways to customize your playstyle. Whether you prefer to get up close and personal with those nasty critters, hang back and deal with them at a distance, or mix it up, you can make Mack your very own.

New Dino City: Enjoy the Bright Lights and Dangerous Underbelly

New Dino City has as many stories as it does dinos. Meet strange allies, twisted villains, and altered creatures as you uncover a diabolical mystery. How are all of the strange happenings connected? That’s for you to discover, but move quickly or else it may be lights out for the big city.

It’s Not Parkour, It’s ParkSaur: Getting Around New Dino City

Tall buildings, dark alleys, and some water that looks a little… off. New Dino City has it all!

Traverse a world of densely interconnected skyscrapers, darkened alleys, and strange locales as you dive deeper into the weird happenings in the City. But be careful, there are threats around every corner just waiting to be discovered.

Myth or Fact? New Dino City has Alligators in the Sewers

What’s caused the peaceful critters of New Dino City to begin terrorizing the population? You’ll need to use all of Mack’s abilities, create clever combinations, and push yourself to the limit to overcome challenging foes and terrifying bosses.

Game Features

  • Chomp through a prehistoric metroidvania 200 million years in the making

  • Experiment with an arsenal of 16 combat and traversal abilities

  • Weave your way through dozens of regions as new abilities open new areas

  • Look more than 150 snarling creatures right in the eye… then beat them up

  • Meet interesting denizens of New Dino City. And Gus. He’s… you’ll see.

150+ Enemies to Vanquish

2306590.name: Apewar
2306590.about_the_game:
Apewar is an online tactical and action FPS/TPS monkey war game adapted from real life. Build your monkey team and fight against your enemies. Defend the bananas! By playing the game in a coordinated way, you can have fun and win with a good strategy. You can have fun moments in the game with many map options. Remember the saying: Monkeys are strong together!

Get support from artificial intelligence bots while building your team in the game. Place bot players on your team to strengthen your army. Find and drive and control a number of vehicles only in certain areas of the maps. You can crush the monkeys in the enemy team with your vehicle. You can taste the realism in the game. For example, if you stay too long in the sea, you will drown and die.

The game has Free for All, Team Deathmatch and a Grab Banana mode. The most entertaining one among these modes is that both teams are trying to reach. You have limited time to seize these bananas and take them to your area. Since these bananas are located in the area of the map where there is the most combat and action, you may be shot and killed by the enemies while you pick up the banana and transport it to your area!

The Gombe Chimpanzee War is a series of violent conflicts between two chimpanzee communities in Gombe National Park, Tanzania, that lasted from 1974 to 1978. Researcher Jane Goodall, director of the Gombe Stream Research Center, wrote in her memoir “Through a Window: My Thirty Years with the Chimpanzees of Gombe”: “For several years I struggled to face this new reality. Most of the time I woke up at night because of scary images coming to my mind. Satan [one of the monkeys] clasped his hand under his chin to drink the blood gushing from a large wound on the Sniff's face... Old Rodolf, who was mostly kind and calm, slammed Godi's slumped body with a four-pound stone. . Jomeo rips a piece of meat from Dé's thigh... Figan repeatedly attacks and hits the scarred, trembling body of Goliath, one of his childhood heroes... »

2306630.name: Frontline: Panzers & Generals Vol. I

Take command of your army and lead them to victory by employing any strategy of your choice! Outwit and outmaneuver your opponents to claim objectives and ultimately emerge victorious.

Units become even more powerful and unlock new, invaluable abilities as they gain experience in battle; these new behaviors will be essential in ensuring victory: Camouflage, Sabotage, Over-watch, Smoke, AT grenades, Artillery barrage, Shell Shock, Transport, Special Panzers, APCR, Suppressed, Routed, M.I.A, K.I.A, Infantry Charge.

Take command of your military force and plan your strategy to achieve victory in this exciting world-at-war strategy game!
Lead your troops to victory and secure your place in history!

2306670.name: Better Me Tree: Daily Affirmations
2306670.about_the_game:
Better Me Tree: Daily Affirmations is a self development application that includes simple objectives that are spoken aloud by the user to promote daily positive reflection, motivation, encouragement and edification. When all objectives are completed for each day, you will watch your seed of progress grow from a seed into a full tree. Each completed tree is added to the background scenery as you begin a new tree. Each session lasts from 5-12 minutes a day and each tree progression lasts a total of 14 days.

*Your application progress is stored to your device (PC) and is private. You can have your progress points recorded to your profile if you are logged in or if you are using a download. Your points are the only application data that can be stored to our cloud. Journals and profile progress can be made private from your privacy settings if you choose to use our community features. 

*Our applications can work directly with our online community platform where you can earn growth points on your profile as you progress each day (free to join).

Daily Objectives Include:

1. Daily Gratitude and Appreciation
2. Daily Letting Go
3. Daily Overcoming
4. Daily Affirmation
5. Daily Commitments

Better Me Tree can Encourage, Motivate or Guide the User to:

✔️ Overcome doubt and fear
✔️ Increase Positive Motivation
✔️ Increase Daily Encouragement
✔️ Increase Personal Reflection and Awareness
✔️ Increase Courage, Focus and Determination

…and much more.

Progress and results are based upon each individual. We make no claims or guarantees for any personal success or prevention of failure.

2306710.name: Enigma Manor
2306710.about_the_game:
Enigma Manor is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game. Navigate your way through the procedurally generated manor, fend off monsters, solve puzzles and find a way to escape.



  • Limited Resources: Scavenge the manor for ammunition and health items to protect yourself from the monsters that lie within, but use them wisely as resources are limited.
  • Puzzles: Collect keys around the area to unlock new rooms, find more items and get access to a variety of different puzzles. Solve these puzzles to get one step closer to escaping.
  • Hardcore: Getting out alive won't be easy, there are no checkpoints and no saves. You only get one chance to escape, and you'll receive a final rank based on your performance.



  • Rooms: The layout of the manor is procedurally generated each time, so players must learn how to navigate through the area as they play.
  • Items: Keys, resources and other such items are spawned in different locations of the map for every playthrough. Search rooms carefully for everything you need to survive.
  • Enemies: Monsters are randomly selected and spawned around the area, so you never know what might be waiting for you on the other side of a door.
  • Locks: Doors can be assigned with various different lock types, or even without a lock entirely. Remember which keys are required and only carry what is needed.
  • Puzzles: Puzzles are chosen at random and their solutions are changed each time, which makes problem solving necessary to escape.



  • 4 Players: Play alone or with up to 3 other people, invite players to a private server only accessible to you and your friends.
  • Co-operative: Work together to escape and leave no one behind, share resources among each other to ensure everyone has a fighting chance.
  • Proximity Chat: Use the in-game proximity voice chat for the best experience, listen closely as your friends scream in the distance.

2306850.name: Parcel Problems
2306850.about_the_game:
Your boss’s words were clear, “If we don’t have a package leaving this building every ten seconds, I’m going to have to make some changes around here“. This was quite a time crunch, but you can’t afford to lose your job.

You can do it… Right?

2306900.name: Abyss of Light
2306900.about_the_game:
"Back then, with my pretty hair tie, standing on tiptoe at the porthole of the colonial ship, gazing at the stars, I could never have imagined that the thriving Colony Three before my eyes would one day turn into scorched earth. Just like now, as I write these words, I still find it hard to believe that I have become the only survivor of the entire colonial ship."

"Abyss of Light" is a narrative-driven sci-fi adventure game. In this story, you play as a stranded interstellar colonist who crash-landed on a mysterious planet and struggles to find a way home. In the peculiar ruins lies the planet’s forgotten history, and within the abandoned research station, something faintly stirs your consciousness. Deeper still, in the glowing depths of the abyss, hidden secrets await your arrival.

The story is set in the near future, when human civilization has already stretched across the solar system. Then, on an otherwise ordinary day, a dazzling light suddenly erupted from behind Saturn, followed by a strange, indecipherable signal that echoed across the stars, unchanging and undiminished for years.

In response, humanity launched an unprecedented mission: The Light-Chasing Project. Its goal was ambitious——construct a generational colony ship, establish settlements on habitable worlds along the way, and ultimately reach the source of the anomaly to build a deep-space research station.

At first, the journey progressed smoothly. But from Colony Three onward, something began to go terribly wrong...

2306960.name: Tower Survivor

Step into the blood-soaked boots of Shevchenko, a battle-hardened nurse caught in the chaos of a zombie apocalypse.
As the world crumbles, Shevchenko clings to one fragile hope — finding a cure. To do so, she must brave ruined cities, explore mysterious dungeons, and face off against grotesque undead nightmares. Survival is no guarantee. Curiosity is your only compass.

But this isn’t just your average dungeon crawler. Between ambushes and scavenging, you’ll also be answering delightfully absurd quizzes that reveal hidden sides of your personality—even the ones you didn’t know existed.

Key Features

  • Classic turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG with a post-apocalyptic twist

  • Bizarre personality quizzes

  • Loot, gear up, and face a terrifying variety of zombies and monsters

2307020.name: Alien Boom Boom
2307020.about_the_game:
The aliens are invading your small town, they seem to be everywhere, but a mysterious transmission is guiding you to fight back!




It's time to take the fight to them! Put a stop to their plans by travelling through their network of interconnected ships, bringing you to new destinations such as moon bases, space stations, the white house, exotic runes, your small town and more!




Your ability to utilize your weapons effectively, control recoil, and place those much needed headshots is great and all, but you're still going to have to master the movement! Dash, jump and time your attacks effectively to ensure you tip the scales in Earth's favor.




The mysterious voice in your head needs your help! There is more here than meets the eye, and some how you are central to stopping this invasion.
The truth is UP there!

Overview:


Alien Boom Boom is a shooter that embraces exaggerated action over realism.

Master your movement and powerful weapons such as explosive shotguns, powerful plasma rifles, railguns that rip through enemies and more. Visit many locations, while battling the alien threat including: moon bases, space stations, the white house and exotic locales.

Features:


  • Fast-paced FPS gameplay with a classic feel.
  • Fight off hordes of aliens across a variety of locales, from your hometown to space stations.
  • Use an arsenal of weapons, from shotguns to grenade launchers to rail guns and more, to take down the invaders..

2307030.name: YEET
2307030.about_the_game:
Adrenaline fueled, fast paced combat with a satisfying twist


Battle your friends by yeeting, dashing, and flying around an arena with devastating strength and speed!
YEET is a cross-play PvP game about throwing giant objects at other players in an arena. Flatscreen and VR players are all able to play with each other for a seamless experience.

Features available on Launch:


The aim of the game is to simply throw objects at other players in an effort to destroy them. When you are hit by an object, you will die. It's that simple.

Player controls and Interaction
Take control of a gladiator robot, where you can fly with your jetpack, dash to dodge obstacles, and pick-up and throw objects with your own robot hands! During gameplay you will be able to pick-up objects, throw them, and even steal them from enemies by simply grabbing them yourself. Be careful though, as even objects you throw can be dangerous.

Multiple Arenas
On launch, you will be able to play in three different arenas, with multiple different gamemodes. These gamemodes include an endless mode, lives mode, team deathmatch, hide and seek, and infected.

Dynamic objects and environments
YEET is designed to be a fast-paced online game, and therefore features many dynamic objects and environments. Throwable objects are of different shapes and sizes, some objects will explode on impact, and some will even move to target the player and seek to destroy them! All objects are throwable, so there is no escaping the mayhem!

Online Cross-play
Online multiplayer supports VR and flatscreen players at the same time, so YEET is designed to be balanced to play on both platforms.

YEET is an experimental game coming soon.

2307160.name: Yukiiro Sign
2307160.about_the_game:
A romantic comedy visual novel that occurs one winter in a snowy country town.

FEATURES

  • 20+ hours of story
  • Three branching heroine routes
  • Full Japanese voice acting by seasoned professionals

SUMMARY

This is the story of a single season—

Minamiouse is one of Japan's smallest towns,
located in one of its most frigid regions.

This year's snows are the earliest they've come in decades.
There's change in the air, for better or worse.

With two months left on the calendar, both of them looking wintry,
Munefuyu plans to spend the time with his friends just like always.

There's the taciturn, direct, and somewhat wild Miku,
his childhood companion who's just covering up her kindness.

The shy and eccentric exchange student, Svetlana,
is fresh off the plane from Russia but no stranger to the cold.

Meanwhile, the transfer student Kako Takahagi
has known Munefuyu forever, but he's forgotten her...

Luckily, his best friend and confidante Hironaka has his back.

This winter won't be long, but it won't be forgotten,
and every everyday moment it will look like
a miracle in the rear-view mirror.

It's where we've been and where we're going.

2307170.name: Everwarder
2307170.about_the_game:
In Everwarder there's you, and a procedurally-generated world covered in darkness. Touch it - and it will spawn a creature that will try to destroy your most precious thing – a crystal with your friend trapped inside.

Every run starts with your crystal and a supply of energy. Then it's up to you how to fight the darkness. Do you steadily expand, clearing the darkness, harvesting its energy, and carefully deploying defenders to deal with whatever emerges from the dark? Or do you play it fast and loose, striking out to locate ancient structures and powerful artifacts hidden within?

Failure is just another word for learning. With every run you gather minerals and unlock new options on the upgrade tree, allowing you to become stronger and last longer against the darkness. After all, time is not on your side: Enemies grow stronger as the seconds tick on - but so do you, gathering new resources, boosts, and upgrading your defenders to last just a bit longer.

Every run is randomly generated, with its own set of challenges and twists that will keep you on your toes. Every upgrade tweaks the experience, creating various synergies. So even if you struggle to keep up with the pressure, there’s always a way to turn the tides of the battle!

Can you climb to the top of the leader board and claim the title of the ultimate color-matching champion? Play now and find out if you are the King Clicker!

With intuitive controls and a simple premise, this game is easy to pick up but offers endless hours of strategic gameplay. Can you outwit your opponents and become the King Clicker?

Features:

* Leaderboard - A central leaderboard stores the scores of all players; see if you can become the #1 King Clicker!

2307350.name: Into the Radius 2
2307350.about_the_game:
KEY FEATURES

  • Solo or Co‑op Survival
  • Deep Modular Weapon System
  • Realistic Weapon Maintenance
  • Fully Customizable Loadouts
  • Challenging Hostile Entities
  • Deadly Anomalies and Changing Environment

ALONE OR ALLIED…




You can explore the altered zone on your own for a tense and atmospheric solo experience, or join forces with a friend in two-player co-op to take on missions together. Both modes share the same gameplay and story, so you can experience the full journey however you prefer. Communication is key, and proximity voice chat lets you coordinate or warn each other in real time while navigating each mission. Once you complete the tutorial mission, you can host a co-op session and head into the Radius with a friend.

…THOSE WHO MASTER THEIR ARSENAL…




In Into the Radius 2, every weapon is built with realistic detail and distinct handling. A wide range of classic and modern firearms can be customized as full builds or part‑by‑part to suit the way you play. The modular weapon system lets you swap and combine barrels, stocks, handguards, optics, and other attachments until the setup feels right, whether you lean toward mobility, control, or precision.

Weapon maintenance is an essential part of survival. Every firearm in the game deteriorates over time, and if you don’t keep it clean and in good condition, it can jam or fail at the worst possible moment. To stay reliable in the field, you need to monitor the state of your weapons and perform regular cleaning and maintenance, so your gear won’t let you down when you need it most.

This hands‑on control over your weapons carries over to the rest of your gear. Chest rigs, armor vests, and backpacks can be used as pre‑configured setups or arranged from scratch. Pouches and holsters can be placed exactly where you want them and adjusted to the angle that feels most natural, giving you a loadout tailored to both your playstyle and your comfort.

You can also change the look of your equipment with the spray paint system. Repaint backpacks, vests, pouches, magazines, attachments, weapon parts, helmets, the tablet, and even the Explorer’s Uniform. Use solid colors for a clean finish or layer camouflage patterns across different pieces of gear to create a look of your own.

…MAY ENDURE THE SHADOWS OF THE RADIUS




The Radius is filled with hostile entities born from distortion, each with unique behavior, movement, and weaknesses. You will encounter Mimics that stalk the fog in eerie human form, their types defined by unique weapons, tactics, and strategies. Also you will face distorted Fragments that rush at you without fear, their invisible Phantom variants that only reveal themselves if you stay completely focused, and elusive Creeps emerging from rifts in reality, fragile yet dangerous in numbers.

Mimics approach combat intelligently. They search for you instead of firing blindly, take cover under pressure, and change positions or rebuild ambushes when they lose the advantage. At close range, they become more aggressive, adjusting accuracy, timing, and firing mode depending on the situation. Enemies react consistently to what they can see and hear, noticing flashlights and laser sights if you use them nearby.

Beyond enemies, you will face a variety of anomalies. Some explode into shrapnel on contact, others build charge and release an electric shock, suppress all nearby light sources, or attach themselves to you before detonating for extra damage. Certain types trigger powerful electric bursts when entered, and others violently push you away while dealing damage.

Distortion Zones pose an even greater threat, dealing severe damage every second you’re inside them. To move through these zones safely, you’ll need special anti‑distortion headgear.

The Radius changes with time, from day to night and from one Tide cycle to the next. The Tide is a recurring in-world event that resets each location, though every area follows its own schedule. Some tidal anomalies remain untouched by the Tide, and within them, Explorers can find shelters to prepare and wait out the reset.

To survive, you must adapt your tactics, stay aware of light and sound, and use your surroundings wisely. Every encounter in the Radius tests your precision, focus, and instinct.
