2307400.name: The Last King
2307400.about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey to ancient Greece in The Last King, an immersive open world survival game. As a courageous warrior, you must navigate a war-ravaged land teeming with enemies, including Persians, barbarians, and untamed wilderness. Forge your own destiny as you build a formidable base, recruit a mighty army, and liberate Greek villages from the clutches of oppression.

Key Features:

Rebuild your kingdom

The great Persian force have destroyed you, your army, your morale and your kingdom. Rebuild your kingdom brick by brick and see the citizens growing once more.
Build resource gathering stations and create jobs in your kingdom.

Battle Against Fierce Foes:

Engage in intense combat against a diverse range of enemies. From relentless Persian forces to brutal barbarian tribes, every encounter is a test of skill and strategy. Command your army with precision, employing a variety of tactics and formations to outmaneuver and overpower your adversaries.

Recruit, Train, and Equip Your Army:

Assemble a loyal band of warriors from different backgrounds and specialties. Recruit skilled soldiers, train them in the art of war, and equip them with powerful weapons and armor. Develop unique strategies to utilize their strengths and unleash devastating attacks on your enemies.

Build Your Marching camps:

Construct and fortify your own base, shaping it into a bastion of power and safety. Customize your defenses, establish resource production, and strategize to withstand enemy assaults. Your base is the heart of your operations and the key to your survival.

Survive and Thrive in an Open World: Explore a sprawling and dynamic open world, ravaged by war. Adapt to the harsh conditions of the wilderness, scavenge for resources, and master the art of survival in an unforgiving open world.

Free Greek Villages: Fight to liberate Greek villages that have fallen under enemy control. Storm enemy camps, destroy their strongholds, and rescue innocent civilians from oppression. Your heroic deeds will inspire hope and rally the people to your cause.

Play Your Way: Choose your preferred playstyle and specialize in a variety of combat roles. Master the art of the spear, wield a mighty sword, or rain death from afar as a skilled archer. Tailor your skills and abilities to suit your personal combat preferences and become a legendary warrior of ancient Greece.

In The Last King the fate of ancient Greece rests in your hands. Will you rise as a legendary hero, leading your army to victory and ensuring the survival of your people? Unleash your strategic prowess, harness your combat skills, and forge your own path in this immersive and challenging ancient Greek adventure.

2307430.name: GHOST: AC-130 Close Air Support
2307430.about_the_game:
Understand first that this is as of now a simple, mindless shooter with two endless levels. The will be Campaign Mode implemented soon. Now, there is no story, no progression and no way to die (except shooting the friendlies). It's the kind of game you might want to play after a long day at work where you just want to just hunt people down and blow shit up. I want my players to know this going into it because if this doesn't sound like what you're looking for - please don't buy it. For me, satisfaction is paramount.

You are the gunner of the AC-130 Gunship. One of the most lethal war machines ever made. Use your skill with thermal optics and three of the biggest and most lethal guns ever produced to stop the enemy cold- and without warning. A Simulation in its presentation with arcade-like gameplay.

Three Types of Weapons on the AC-130 accurately recreated

Take control of the three guns mounted on the AC-130 variant: a 25mm cannon, a 40mm cannon and a 105mm Howitzer. Use the 25mm cannon that shoots 200 rounds per minute and each round has the equivalent blast of a hand grenade. This is your first go-to to ferret out hiding enemies under trees or in the cover of a structure. Take control of the 40mm cannon to give yourself a less accurate but more lethal blast - especially if there are 2 or 3 enemies close together. And the 105mm Howitzer is capable of leveling the largest of structures in the game.

White hot and black hot thermal imaging

You will have complete control over what you see and how you see it, and because these missions take place under the cover of darkness you will have to utilize the embedded thermal imaging cameras that can sense human bodies through heat. It is a strategy to learn when to use white hot and when to use black hot. GHOST gives you that strategic opportunity to explore and discover the possibilities using either mode.

Two Infinite Respawn Wave levels

The game in it's current state has two Infinite Respawn Wave levels where you are scored and the enemies continue to respawn. You will find that White Hot Thermal and Black Hot Thermal have their distinct uses based on the geography of both levels. This mode is a more arcade experience of the game.

Real audio of the crew of an AC-130 Gunship

I have not attempted to recreate what the crew exchanges are like back and forth on my own because I wanted to give the player authenticity. Audio barks are taken from actual live and dangerous missions that have been flown by the Air Force.

Addicting and seamless gameplay

GHOST- AC-130 has been designed for ease of use even in its simulation state. It provides a quick and easy way to conquer the controls immediately so that there is no learning curve to have fun.

  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2307550.name: Elysium Restaurant
2307550.about_the_game:
游戏介绍：

你苏醒后，身处餐馆之中。你忘记了自己的身份，记不清往事，这段时间照顾你的人，只有极乐餐馆的店长。然而，你的眼睛似乎出了一些问题，你看不见任何存在过生命气息的东西，包括人、动物、血液、食物。店长似乎有意隐瞒什么，这座餐馆的秘密，餐馆里杀手的存在，还有那九位顾客。你根据每个人不同的特性和身份，分别给他们起了好记的名字：渣男、小女孩、白领、等等。
店长所说的报纸，为什么我需要去拯救这些顾客，通过与顾客的对话渐渐明白了那些道理，明白了这个世界原本的样子。
你在餐馆中需要与顾客对话，并且在对话的选择和谜题的破解中将顾客拯救，以免被杀手杀害。顺利度过第三天，那么游戏将迎来最终结局，你的意识也会被颠覆，你讲明白拯救和“被救赎”的意义。
游戏采用最新引擎UE5研发，画质顶级真实，并且要求配置更低。

开玩提醒：

刚开始进入游戏是谜题模式，如果智商不够的话需要在餐馆的电脑上切换成无谜题模式
该游戏采用类似原神的可选择对话系统，对话的选择会影响到客人对你的亲密度，于是在一天天的日子里，如何讨好客人让他们活下来，破解报纸上的谜题得到杀手刺杀的地点，便是一门十分的学问。

交流和联系方式：

QQ群：754725430

人物一览：

1.渣男:(有点虚，爱学习，爱富婆)
真是本好书，每天看一遍都能学到不少知识

真诚和勇敢永远都是爱情的必杀技

冬天有个保温杯，泡枸杞就是方便

2.哲学家:(暗恋的人死了，从此心也死在这里了)
只可惜故人，何时能再相见

彩袖殷勤捧玉钟。当年拚却醉颜红。舞低杨柳楼心月，歌尽桃花扇底风。
从别后，忆相逢。几回魂梦与君同。今宵剩把银釭照，犹恐相逢是梦中。

如果我不好好吃东西，你还会不会责怪我

3.白领(失业，不会讲话，职场针对)
摆烂并非我意，只是这世代，真难让人顺心

要是有点闲钱，我也不会低三下四地讨要工作。要是还未成家，我也照样潇洒

这桌椅，怎么跟我过不去，刚想吃口饭，它就搞我

妈妈生日那天送了我这个王冠，这是我收到过最棒的礼物了。只是，妈妈你怎么还不回来

妈妈常说，家庭的不幸，害了我。但是每次有妈妈在我身边，我就很安心

那个服务员大哥哥也是好人，妈妈说，遇到对你好的人，以后要好好报答

5.纯情女孩

Welcome to Speedrush!

Speedrush is a 2D sandbox platforming game which can be played alone, or with other users. It is the perfect game to chill out with friends on, to challenge yourself, or to practice your platforming skills.

Mechanics

Spike - Instantly kills you when you hit one!

Acid block - Instantly kills you when you either land on top of one, or simply touch the acidic top of the block!

Glue Block - Stops your movement while you are grounded!

Controls

Dash - Acquire a small boost of speed for a short period of time, can only be used once while airborne (Grounding will allow you to use it again).

Run - Move across the map at normal speed on the X axis!

Jump - Jump over obstacles and blocks!

FAQ:

How do I join a friend's server?

Your friend must first be hosting a server, which can easily be done by checking the "Host" checkbox when joining in multiplayer mode, if so, ask them for their P u b l i c IP address, as this is a requirement to connect to the server. Ask your friend to port forward their router if they are comfortable doing so, and ask them to send you the port they chose.

If all these steps are completed, you can open up speedrush, select multiplayer after hitting the play button on the title screen, and enter the info you have obtained into the "Server Address" text box in the following format

{Server Address}:{Server port}

Why do the animations look wobbly?

This is intentional, as the animations are frame by framed.

What engine was used to make the game?
Unity.

2308120.name: Dark Rift
2308120.about_the_game:
Dark Rift - The Secret of The Prime Element

According to Legend, When this Universe Was Created, A Master Key was Forged to Lock Away All Ancient Secrets and Infinite Powers The Cosmos Had to Offer.

The Key was then divided and cast into different circles of reality for safe keeping. These realities are joined together by one-way portals, or Dark Rifts, and only the individual who possesses a piece of the Master Key may cross the threshold into the next dimension. Upon crossing, the Dark Rift will seal itself and disappear.

It is said that when the pieces of the Master Key are reunited, the dimensions will converge to reveal the true center of the universe. The point of convergence is known as the Vortex. However, only the holder of the entire, re-forged Master Key may enter the Vortex and claim its immeasurable power.

STORY

When the Hyperions accidentally acquired a piece of the Master Key, now named the Core Prime Element, they abused its power and proclaimed themselves the Chosen Ones. After many years of tyrannical rule, their society became morally destitute and internally corrupt. In the midst of this political and social chaos, Sonork Nezom arose as the Chosen One's demented Emperor. With the help of his sordid followers, Sonork enslaved the mass populace, murdered any possible opposition, and claimed the Core Primer Element as his own.

For many years, the Chosen Ones' malevolent rule was noted throughout the universe, and while many desired the Core Prime Element, only one entity sought the prize with vitilant fervor. Demitron, the Lord Demon of the Dark Dimension, waited until the time was right to demand the invaluable prize from the envied Chosen Ones. When Snork Nezom came into power, Demitron knew his chance had come.

In an effort to retrieve the Core Prime Element and assassinate Sonork, Demitron sent his most hideous servant, Demonica Gkroux, through the dimensional portal to do his bidding. When the Arch Demon Demonica failed her mission to murder Sonork, she unhesitatingly exchanged secret information for her life. She told Sonork that, aside from his Core Prime Element, there were at least two other known pieces of the Master Key. Demonica also revealed that while the Light Prime Element's Location had never been discovered, the Dark Prime Element was embedded in her lord master's head.

After listening to Demonica's tale, Sonork resolved to procure the Light Prime Element and combine its powers with the Core Prime Element already in his possession. Hereasoned that if he had two pieces of Master Key, his powers would be so ominous that he would be able to seize Demitron's Dark Prime Element effortlessly.

THE TOURNAMENT

Because warriors from around the universe have continuously failed in their attempt to obtain the Core Prime Element and usurp Sonork, he is confident that there is no being who can overpower him in his dimension. With this belief, Sonork has created the most lethal and prestigious battle, The Tournament. Play as Darius, recently crowned Demon King of Withergate, Lucia, Archmage of Sun Haven, and Jas, Master Summoner, or Artemis, Amari Bounty Hunter. With the help of over 13 unique abilities, defend your home against hordes of quirky yet dangerous monsters by using weapons and spells such as:

After every loss, make sure to use the weapons rack and anvil to unlock and upgrade your character and ability stats across all 4 characters permanently! Grow in strength, create your perfect build, and send those monsters packing!


Use your limited daytime hours wisely to craft, collect resources, and access the shop – or you may end up overrun by monsters. You’ll face constant waves of enemies during the day, and once Sun Down comes, the fighting gets even tougher!


Collect resources to build over 35 crafting items. By growing and selling crops, ore, and animal products, you can earn gold to purchase spell, weapon, and ability upgrades! The upgrades you purchase with money stack indefinitely!

2308430.name: G-MODEアーカイブス+ 探偵・癸生川凌介事件譚 Vol.10「永劫会事件」
2308430.about_the_game:
The year is 1999, and ominous prophecies and incidents are swirling around the end of the century.
What is the purpose of the "Eigo-kai", an unidentified organization involved...

【Game System】

This is a mystery adventure game in which the player solves a series of difficult cases that occur in a fictional town called Marihama City in K Prefecture.

The player controls the main character in the scenario and solves the mystery by selecting commands in the conversation and deduction parts, and by gathering information and evidence that will provide clues to solving the case.

The story progresses by selecting commands, so even beginners can easily play the game.

【Story】

In the seventh month of 1999, the human race will be destroyed.

The world is in a state of instability at the end of the century because of this terrible prophecy and many eerie rumors.

People are looking for a "savior" as a source of spiritual support, and various new groups have sprung up all over the country.

This incident took place in early July, the month of the prophecy. It begins with the discovery of a man's body in a river in Marihama-dai.

The man was a leader of a certain new religion, and at first it was thought that the murder was caused by trouble with that religion.

However, a "black card" discovered at the same time as the body leads to a huge conspiracy lurking behind the scenes...

A rookie detective, a freelance writer, a college girl, and a mysterious informant.

Switching between the perspectives of four characters with various agendas, you will unravel the whole story of this complex and intertwined case.

The encounter between Masao Ikurumi, the scenario writer of this series, and detective Ryosuke Kibukawa is also finally revealed in this title...!

【Character】

◆Ryosuke Kibukawa (癸生川凌介)

The director of the Kibukawa Detective Agency and a detective himself.

However, he is quite an eccentric character, often causing trouble and confusion for those around him, though he doesn't seem to care about it at all.

It’s completely unclear what he's thinking, but he has led the resolution of numerous difficult cases up to now.

◆Izuna Sagishima (白鷺洲 伊綱)

A detective assistant at the Kibukawa Detective Agency.

Though she is an assistant, she is exceptionally capable, and could likely solve most cases on her own.

However, like her superior, she is unaware of her own quirks. She has a rather eccentric personality, sometimes clumsy, but also sharp enough to make one wonder if it's all part of a calculated act.

◆Masao Ikurumi (生王 正生)

A game scenario writer.

Recently, he has mostly been working on mobile app projects, including turning cases involving the Kibukawa Detective Agency into adventure games for public release.

Because of this "favor," he can never quite stand up to Kibukawa or Izuna, and is always flattered by them, which leads to him being made to work for free.

2308630.name: Dawnfolk
2308630.about_the_game:
In a world of darkness, you are the ruler of a kingdom lost to shadows. On a quest to save your people, you have found the mythical creature called “Lueur,” a fiery companion who will light your way. But what kind of ruler will you be?

In Dawnfolk, you will explore an uncharted medieval fantasy world, manage resources, build cities, and survive against many dangers.

Minigames add a unique challenge to supporting your people. The better you are at the minigames, the more resources you get and the more likely your community will weather the darkness.

Every choice matters as you explore different strategies and play styles in Dawnfolk.

Not everyone has time to invest hundreds of hours into learning how to play a grand strategy game. You can dive right in and start building your settlement immediately, going from a handful of tents to a big city in less than an hour.

Dawnfolk was designed to feel familiar, yet unlike any building strategy game you’ve ever played before. Unwind and play with ease, whether you’re at home or on the go, with your gamepad, keyboard, or handheld console. Go back to the roots of gaming, where exploration and experimentation are the key to fun and discovery.

Decades ago, titanic obsidian monoliths rained down from the sky. A raging tempest of unfathomable darkness gathered around them, slowly crawling across the world and consuming all in its path. You are the ruler of this land, once mighty and resolute, now broken and wounded. But not defeated! You intend to reclaim the realm and bring back light to the world.

After years of wandering, your story begins as you finally find the Lueur, a mythical creature able to radiate a powerful enough brightness to dissipate darkness. It is time to explore the shadows and rebuild your realm.

This darkly cute survival city-builder has been created with much love by a very French developer named Darenn Keller.

After working in the game industry for a few years, Darenn set off on an adventure into indie dev land. Originally called Lueur and then Lueur and the Dim Settlers (as Darenn’s initial goal was to make non-French-speakers sound like complete morons attempting to say the name of the game), the idea for Dawnfolk came about in the LOWREZJAM in 2022 as the challenge was to make a game in one week with a resolution of 64x64 pixels.

Darenn has chosen all elements of creative direction and design. He has mixed the music, molded the sprites, and shaped the game to be reflective of his game design philosophy. But no game is made in a vacuum - Dawnfolk wouldn’t be the amazing game it is without the support of the playtesters and community. The game continues to grow and evolve thanks to players like you so check out the Discord for ways to provide feedback straight to Darenn!

Your choices determine the fate of your realm and its inhabitants.

Will you turn a blind eye to impending disasters, or will you face them head-on? How will you handle the tough moral choices that define your legacy? Can you grow and optimize your cities not just survive, but to thrive as a shining beacon for future settlers?

Will you succeed in bringing light back to the world?

2308650.name: Golgotha
2308650.about_the_game:
Golgotha is a short first person horror game that delves deep into creeping fear and severe paranoia as you traverse through the sinister grounds of Black Waters Station. Along the way you will discover the horrors that lie within and ultimately disturb those who are not at rest.

The lantern and dim lights will guide your way through the station as you explore and find your way towards the exit.
There are multiple cutscenes to encounter and items to discover.
Golgotha features no combat. This game focuses primarily on atmosphere and dread.
The game's main features are realistic immersion, fantastic sound design and disturbing imagery throughout.
Black Waters Station is a large vicinity, and it will require some exploring and searching to progress through the game. (Security Cards, Keys Etc.)


In 1942, Black Waters Station was overcome by a toxic and poisonous fog that killed thousands of people as they slept in the tunnels and platforms of the station to escape the war. After the horrific ordeal the authorities closed the doors to Black Waters and sealed it off to the public.

In 2003 the station was officially reopened to the public. But after several freak accidents and unexplainable deaths, it was once again closed for good.

It has been abandoned and undisturbed for over 20 years.

Until now…

2308670.name: Card Detective
2308670.about_the_game:
Crime, criminal investigation, interrogation. Can these elements, commonly found in mystery dramas and cop movies, be presented in a game?
Out of a strong interest in the subject matter, the production team studied a large number of books on criminal psychology and consulted with professionals in the field, seeking to understand the discipline as deeply as possible. We have brought our findings to "Card Detective", integrating them deeply with the plot and gameplay.

During our research, we also considered which art style would best fit the story atmosphere. Ultimately, we chose a realistic comic style, using rich variations in shadows, lines, and tones to present the overall atmosphere and foreshadow the plot direction. This is a new attempt for us on the artistic level, and we hope everyone will like it!

story

Players will take on the role of newspaper reporter Hazel Gong, who was originally covering a practice exercise at an abandoned building site, but stumbles upon a mysterious corpse in an accidental collapse!

Faced with the subjective statements of the witnesses from different perspectives, to uncover the truth, Hazel Gong turns to a mysterious bar owner to learn criminal investigation and psychology, and questions the witnesses. Confronted with complex relationships and a series of emergencies, will Hazel Gong be able to uncover the truth of the case?

art

Based on a realistic comic style, the story's atmosphere is depicted through changes in shadows and tones, suggesting the plot's direction.

In terms of character animation, we aim to replicate the real reactions of people being interrogated through the nuanced depiction of micro-expressions, linking character movements and expressions with gameplay.

gameplay

Build your deck flexibly, deliver an OTK, and break through the psychological defenses of the witnesses!

Pay close attention to the story, analyze the veracity of the testimonies, and win easily with non-traditional card game strategies.


Detectives, are you ready to solve the case?

2308690.about_the_game:
Welcome to GROUND OF ACES

It is the dawn of World War II, and you take command of a remote military air base.

Prepare for missions, send out pilots and fend off attacks

Engulf yourself in the Second World War and experience its battles from the perspective of your air base crew. It is your responsibility to make sure everybody is physically and mentally prepared to fulfil their duties.

Plan, build and shape your very own air base

Build up and manage a World War II air base. Your personal home for your planes and your crew members. Complete freedom of how you want to build. You will plan and place every wall.

Manage iconic World War II aircraft

Enjoy a variety of accurate fighter airplanes. A joy for aviation aficionados who know the difference between a Hurricane and a Spitfire. But consider: bigger airplanes will need bigger infrastructure. So make sure you can house some of WW2's most impressive airplanes.

Take care of your pilots and crew

Experience personal stories of your air base crew members. On your base every person matters and has their own personality. The game takes huge inspiration from the everyday life of airplane bases in remote locations and how it felt to live there, in good and bad times.

In the style of Franco-Belgian bande dessinée

The game is built from the ground up to look like a living and breathing comic book, bringing the style of these timeless art pieces to life. From Bergèse to Hergé, the attention to detail and love for planes of the old masters is what we strive for.

GB BASIC is programmable in a brand new BASIC dialect. The integrated assets editors are intuitive to use. You can generate real ROMs and play on any GB emulator or hardware.

  • GB BASIC compiles fast
  • GB BASIC generates ROMs for various mappers, devices and emulators

Features

  • Programmable in BASIC, an easy to learn and fun to use programming language
  • Easy to use API for graphics, input, audio, and other facilities
  • Built-in libraries for scene, actor, controllers, GUI
  • Built-in libraries for collision detection, persistence, RTC, etc.
  • Extension feature including mouse & touch, shell command, debugging, etc.
  • Handy tools for editing tiles, map, scene, actor, font, sound, etc.
  • Project can be exported into real ROM
  • Dozens of example projects

Specs

  • CPU: 4.19MHz/8.38MHz for classic/colored respectively
  • Threads: up to 16 concurrent execution contexts
  • Display: 160x144px
  • Code: BASIC, supports multiple source pages
  • Gamepad: 8 buttons (D-Pad + A/B + Select/Start)
  • Mouse and touch: supported by extension
  • Tiles: up to 256 units per page
  • Map: up to 255 tiles in one dimension per page; two layers (graphics, attributes)
  • Sprite: supports 8x8 and 8x16 sprites
  • Scene: up to 255 tiles in one dimension per page; four layers (map, attributes, properties, actors)
  • Actor: up to 8x8 tiles per frame; up to 256 frames per page
  • Font: supports TrueType (.ttf) and bitmap-based (.png .jpg .bmp .tga); up to 16px; 1bpp or 2bpp
  • Audio: 4 channels; supports importing from JSON, VGM, WAV, FxHammer
  • Palette: 2bit (4 colors) per tile, palette of map and actor is configurable for colored device
  • GUI: supports label, progress bar, menu, etc.
  • Persistence: supported
  • RTC: supported
  • Serial port: supported

Programming Paradigms

  • Imperative paradigm
    • Non-structured programming
    • Concurrent processing approach
  • Declarative paradigm
    • Data driven approach

2308710.name: Green Valley County
2308710.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the colorful world of Green Valley County. Do farm chores, take orders and make money. To fulfill your dream and go to a paradise island, you need to contact a travel agency and complete tasks from an agent.

Execute orders:

Take orders to make money on fulfilling your dreams. At the beginning, you will have nothing but a pack of seeds and a small amount of money, you will have to wisely spend this money, buy the essentials and start fulfilling the first orders. Use your home kitchen to fulfill your first orders.

Earn your first large amount and improve your production to fulfill larger orders. The more your production, the more money you will earn.

Develop the farm:

Orders require a lot of resources, improve your farm, so you will have more animals and raw materials that you need in the production of farm products. Feed and drink animals.

Develop a vegetable garden:

Buy seeds at the nearest store or buy a car and go to the city to a major seller. Improve your vegetable garden, this will allow you to get more crops and fulfill more orders that will bring you a lot of money.

Fishing:

In production, you will also need sea and river fish. At the entry level, you can fish with a fishing rod, but when your production becomes more, you can no longer do without fishing nets, which automate the process of fishing. Fry the fish on the stove or send it to production to fulfill the order.

Character needs:

Monitor the needs of the character, satisfy hunger and thirst, go to the toilet during the time to avoid embarrassment, wash in the bathroom. Watch for the purity of the character otherwise he can get an infection from severe pollution. Avoid the cold, low temperatures will lead to hypothermia and illness. Buy and take medicines to maintain immunity, if you get sick, you can go to the city hospital and get treatment. Improve your home, this will help reduce the needs of the character.

  • Search the surrounding area, so you will find useful resources for improving buildings. Or buy them from a merchant.

  • Buy a car with a trailer from a local merchant, so you will be more comfortable shopping in the city.

  • On the road you can find rubble of stones or fallen trees, take tools with you to clear the rubble.

  • The game has dynamic weather: rain, fog, storm.

  • You won't be bored, you can play with another network mode.

2308770.name: Escape From The Depth

Escape From the Depth is an interactive 3D horror game. You navigate through the submarine level trying to collect items to escape from a monster that roams the hallways of the submarine. The player is armed with a map and is told where to go and which items they will need to grab, all while trying to avoid the monster.

2308810.name: San Fernando
2308810.about_the_game:
A picturesque rural town with plenty of yet undiscovered potential. It is up to you to reveal it.



San Fernando is a choice-driven narrative game. Step into the shoes of an anthropologist studying and documenting the culture of this titular town from the Philippines before it completely disappears. Learn more than you set out to learn, form deep relationships with the townsfolk, and come across revelations that derail your scholarly pursuits. How much of this town’s secrets will you discover?



A good researcher takes note of everything crucial to their study. In San Fernando, one must determine what details are essential and write them down in a journal. Collate pieces of San Fernando culture and lifestyle through research notes. What do they eat? What music do they play? How do they express their love? You gain these notes when relevant information is revealed to you by the townsfolk. Gather up all the information you can to create a full report!





Observing and participating are the anthropologist’s best methods in the field. You need to gain your subject’s trust before they can be interviewed for information. Become part of San Fernando by forming and nurturing relationships with the townsfolk. The people of San Fernando are always changing their impression of you and the same choice may have different outcomes depending on how they see you.



This game features paintings by the Grand Old Man of Philippine Art, the country’s first National Artist: Fernando Amorsolo. Fernando Amorsolo is known for his vibrant and idyllic rural landscapes, often depicting Filipino people and scenes of everyday life. San Fernando allows players to immerse themselves within a world rendered by a master’s imagination and his skillful hand, brought further to life with modern technology.





What’s so important about this town? What kind of people live here? How do they sustain themselves without modern practices? And more importantly, are there more secrets yet to be uncovered?

You have been given the chance of a lifetime: to be the first to answer these burning questions.

2308820.name: Qualification as Rogue

Traverse various landscapes including hills and underwater and defeat the monsters!
Solve the puzzles and save the Princess from the Dark King!

An adventure platformer game with a new concept of combining brain puzzle elements to solve various traps and devices. Find hidden routes or open treasure chests to defeat the monsters while passing through various landscapes including rocks, hills, or underwater!

An exciting adventure with pocket dot heroes!
You will confront many pocket monsters with hundreds of abilities that will get in your way.

Elegant yet powerful super dot heroes!

Dynamic dungeons await you!
When players successfully clear a dungeon, they will be rewarded with money to obtain more powerful swords.

Turn these brave dot heroes into super heroes!

Focus and keep trying until you reach the highest dungeons.

Never give up!

A game with simple controls that can easily be played by anyone
With an unbelievable addiction factor.

Elite Heroes is a love letter to the classic retro platformers of the past.

Trek across various terrains and use your sword to defeat the enemies in the dungeons.

Dungeon Adventure

Magic Skills and Swords

Side-scrolling Platformer

Puzzle Dungeon Crawler

2308920.about_the_game:
Car games produced in today's technology have many features. Its colorful graphics, the multitude of tasks, and openness to unique designs attract the players' attention. Classic Car Drive Simulator game with such characteristics is waiting for you.

Classic car simulator game is a game preferred by many players. Having more than one speed task in the game makes the game enjoyable. There are various speed missions in this simulator game. In addition, car modification options are also available. In other words, it is possible to organize your car or cars according to yourself.

With Classic car America, it is possible to race cars on streets similar to America and enjoy the car simulator. Likewise, it is possible to create an American-style classic car. Whatever task you want to do in the game, you can do it with your vehicle.

People who love old cars can also choose the old classic car. You can drive three different classic cars in total. Each classic car has its speed, brake, and drift ability. Before starting the game, choosing the vehicle that suits you is helpful. There are various speed missions in the game. These tasks include completing the speed task without crashing into other cars in the traffic.

It is possible to play this game in a 3d way. Therefore, classic car games 3d offer you better graphics quality. You can easily and quickly change your graphic settings in the game according to your device in the settings section. You can reach high-resolution graphics with the classic car driving game. All images are of high quality on the game screen.

Classic car driving has quality graphics and the city so that you can have a good ride. Since the game is 3D, all the pictures will come to your eyes vividly. 2308960.name: Zlime Arena
2308960.about_the_game:
Welcome to Zlime Arena, the game that tests your strategy planning ability.

Player Amount : Currently, Zlime Arena allows 1v1 (You vs AI or your friend) & 2v2 mode.

Basic Rule : A match consists of 15 rounds. Whoever wins 8 rounds will considered as the winner of the match.

Drafting


Each player can ban and pick 3 Zlimes each. Analyze the strengths and weaknesses of the Zlime to make sure that it is good for your team.
You should pick the Zlimes carefully, as you cannot change them between the rounds.

Preparation


Each round, you will be provided with resources to buy the items for your Zlime. Some Zlimes are strong with certain items. Buy the necessary items for your Zlimes, or your team will be struggling in the battle.

Setting their target priorities is also important, as you can choose to finish off the enemy injured Zlime or aim the tanky Zlime with the stackable debuffs.

Arrange the position of the Zlimes wisely, so you could gain an advantage in battle. For example, Rod of Barrier can increase defense and magic defense to all allied Zlime in the back. This can make some Zlimes tougher in combat.

Battle


During the battle, you cannot command any of your Zlimes, as you have already told them how they should select their target. Just sit and watch how well your Zlimes perform in combat. Take the time to think how you can improve the strategy for the next round.

2309010.name: Geko: Entering The Pipe
2309010.about_the_game:
Geko: Entering The Pipe is a challenging and fast-paced game where you play Geko, an unlucky lizard who ends up in two plumbing pipes while trying to catch a fly. Help Geko dodge all enemies and obstacles. Cockroaches, rats, scorpions and jets of steam are just some of the difficulties that Geko will encounter along the way. So slide and jump until you finally manage to escape the pipes, so that Geko can finally get back to his hunt (and if he's lucky, he won't fall into another pipe).



In this game, your only objective is to jump from one side to the other, dodging everything and everyone. It also requires you to slide faster along walls when necessary.



Features:

  • Precise Gameplay: Responsive controls to bounce back and forth on walls and slide faster;
  • Fast and frantic levels: you'll never stand still. You'll always have to test your reflexes dodging enemies;
  • A cute game with beautiful retro art, yet challenging;
  • An adaptable adventure to play on keyboard and gamepad;
  • Short gameplay: There are only 26 levels, but that will also depend on you, can you finish the game before losing all your lives?
  • Challenge for speedrunners: Complete the game as quickly as possible and with as many points as you can;
  • Challenging achievements;



Although this game has easy-to-learn controls, you'll need to learn from your mistakes until you've mastered each level. Are you ready for this reflex challenge?

Survive in a new hostile and arid environment, lost in the middle of the dunes. You will have to face sandstorms and high temperatures. Find an oasis, explore wildlife and collect resources.

2309060.name: Roterra 3 - A Sovereign Twist
2309060.about_the_game:
Enter the magical world of Roterra® where up is relative and the path ahead may actually be behind. Rotate, flip, and shift to change your perspective, find your way out of complex mazes, and claim the crown of Roterra.



Sometimes changing your point of view makes all the difference.



Main characters, Angelica and Orlando face off to rule the floating cube world where gravity is no obstacle. Challenges await players as they turn and flip cubes to move the ground, open pathways, and overcome barriers in 24 levels containing over 50 hand-crafted puzzles.

With numerous puzzles, pick-up and play design, innovative gameplay and imaginative level design, Roterra 3—A Sovereign Twist will excite puzzle game fans. Remember, all puzzles are solvable but getting from start to finish takes many steps as you flip paths and toggle switches to shift the world and clear your route. Advanced planning is highly recommended with these perspective-changing maps that include hidden paths, hard to reach switches, and path-changing gems. You may get lost trying to figure out the impossible-looking puzzles, but you will never get stuck!

  • 50 hand-built puzzles over 24 levels
  • Beautifully decorated levels with updated art styles
  • New swamp environment - avoid the frogs and bees
  • New snow and ice worlds will bring a chill to your play
  • Explore new areas in the world of Roterra



New music from award-winning composer Tapani Siirtola accompanies players on their journey through the twists and turns of Roterra 3 – A Sovereign Twist. Tapani's past work includes the trailer for the season finale of HBO's Game of Thrones series.

DiG-iT! Games® is a small, woman-run, independent game studio in Bethesda, MD dedicated to creating innovative indie game experiences.



Roterra 3 is a continuation in a series of games originally launched for mobile devices. Roterra 3 and Roterra 4 are the first games available on Steam.

2309070.name: The Monke Games
2309070.about_the_game:
Welcome to The Monke Games.

In this colorful wacky Virtual Reality game, you are able to take the perspective of a "monke". Similar to a monkey, however, this creature has no legs. You must use your hands to traverse your environments, and reign dominance amongst others through the fun of multiple different game modes. These game modes will help you advance in this beautiful, low-poly world.

  • Casual: Need a break? Socialize and have fun in the Casual game mode. Nothing to see here!

While The Monke Games can be fun with the current game modes, many game modes aren't released yet, which we would like to present. These are modes such as...

  • Horror: With multiple maps to choose from, select a group of monke buddies to dive deep into the true horrors of The Monke Games. Meet unknown creatures, that may in fact just swallow you whole if you get too close! Stay safe as you traverse through creepy environments to escape and complete your tasks. Oh, and try not to be too loud, they can hear you...

  • Racing: Hop in your monke kart and get rolling on the road! In this fast-pace game mode, you will attempt to gain distance on your opponents using a vehicle of your choice! Complete all laps first, and you may win a Grand Prix!

  • Battle: No more messing around, we are in war! Gun class types are given to you for you to choose. Once you have selected, try and shoot any monke on sight! Of course, the monkes wouldn't actually hurt each other, they are peaceful and instead would like to use toy guns.

Presented are the modes coming in the near future.

Stick around in this silly little monke world, and perhaps you will make some friends, some enemies, and some new memories.

Welcome to The Monke Games.

2309090.name: Erin and the Otherworld
2309090.about_the_game:
Draw constellations to defeat Celtic monsters with powerful magic in this roguelike deckbuilder.

Theme

Inspired by recorded Celtic mythology. Play as a druidess and save your homeland from Celtic monsters.

Gameplay

  • Connect stars to create constellations
  • Power up rituals to attack and defend

2309120.name: My Fake Goblin Wife
2309120.about_the_game:
"My Fake Goblin Wife" is a story with a place for fatal and gorgeous girls, an intriguing dramatic romance, and a distinctive visual style. It is a kinetic graphic novel. You don't have to make much effort to make your way through the story. Just enjoy reading it.

Game features:

  • Exquisite imagery, and unique visual presentation.

2309230.name: Sweet Science – The Girls of Silversee Castle
2309230.about_the_game:
What if...

...you went back in time to a place you never wanted to go to?
And there you are: at a weird science camp in a prestigious boarding school in Silversee Castle in the 1990s. Will you solve the mystery of how you ended up there? And will you be able to return to your time? And maybe find love?

In this visual novel you will meet four extraordinary (and quirky) girls, learn more about your world and uncover the mystery. On the way, original puzzles are challenging you. Master them – or simply chicken out.

Dive into the story and find out how sweet science can be!

Features & Gameplay:

The visual novel includes eight good endings and a few bad ones. Make the right decisions and master the minigames to reach the ending of your choice! The minigames feature unique, science inspired puzzles that will challenge your mind (but you can skip them if it's too hard for you). Moreover, in one of the minigames you will challenge your favorite character to a game of Go, but don't worry: Mr Young is going to explain the rules to you before the game.
Sweet Science contains several interwoven story lines. To uncover them all, you will play more than one route. One route contains around 5 hours of gameplay, for all routes we estimate 15-20 hours of game play. On the way, you will encounter hundreds of graphics and a full soundtrack, featuring the song "Butterfly Lullaby" composed for this game by Alec Weesner, and the song "Time", sung by Emilia.
"Sweet Science" is waiting for you. – Will you uncover all its secrets?

Cast:





Artificial Intelligence


This is one of the first real AI-generated visual novels: nearly all artwork was generated by AI artists (NovelAI, DALL-E 2, Diffusion Bee). But is this artwork art? The story touches on this and many other questions in an entertaining and open-minded way.

Steam Release Special

To celebrate the Steam release, we have added one extra scene. You can access it from the main menu at "Extra+". It contains mild spoilers, so better watch after finishing at least the first three days of the game. Enjoy! :)

2309240.name: Digital Eclipse Arcade: Q.P.I.D.
2309240.about_the_game:
Happy Valentine's Day! Q.P.I.D. is the latest release from Digital Eclipse Arcade, a series of all-new games inspired by classic '80s arcade vibes.

Like everyone else on the internet, Q.P.I.D. loves cats. Unfortunately, the cats that the Quadrangular Programmable Inversion Device has been sworn to protect have gotten themselves into places they shouldn't be. With nerves of steel and a heart of gold, Q.P.I.D. is determined to rescue as many of them as possible, even if he has to bend the laws of physics to do it. Toggle gravity, blast enemies, avoid hazards, and collect cats before your battery runs out. Part platformer, part puzzler, Q.P.I.D. delivers a hero who's state of the heart.

Instructions

  • Flip gravity to move objects, enemies, and obstacles
  • Rescue cats on each level
  • Collect all hearts for a perfect score
  • Keep Q.P.I.D. juiced with charging stations

Hazards & Helpers

  • LOLLIDROPS aren't tasty — they're nasty. These mines will explode when you get near, but they won't be triggered by swapping gravity.
  • HEARTACHERS demand their personal space; get too close to these shuffling scorpions, and they'll zap you. They also devour hearts!
  • BEAM UPS shoot deadly laser light straight out when they're activated — but you can flip their switches when you flip the gravity.
  • WUVLIES make their way the only way they know how: End over end. You can blast these flipping foes, but beware — shortly after being incapacitated, they explode!
  • BIG CRUSHERS do exactly what their name implies: They crush (on) you big time. Don't get trapped beneath them!
  • HEARTIANS attack in swarms when disturbed and slow you down, so be ready to blast them all before they reach you.
  • SPEED ROLLERS give you a turbo boost. Walk through a light-blue column and get ready for a rapid ride!
  • BOUNCE PADS put a spring in your step, sending you skyward when shifting gravity might have some negative effects.
  • TETHERS automatically collect nearby hearts. Avoid entering dangerous spaces just by tugging on these heartstrings.

Gameplay Hints

  • Q.P.I.D. might fall faster or slower than some of the enemies and obstacles. Use that to sneak past them during gravity shifts.
  • Sometimes flipping gravity will put hearts right in the path of a Heartacher. Look for alternate locomotion paths like bounce pads and speed rollers to avoid that risk.
  • Lollidrops can't be destroyed by blasting them, but they can be deflected with a barrage of shots. Use this to create opportunities to sneak past them.

Game Controls

  • Move: Joystick/WASD
  • Blaster: Button 1/Mouse Button 1
  • Flip Gravity: Button 2/Mouse Button 2
  • Self Destruct: Button 1/Mouse Button 1 + Button 2/Mouse Button 2

Additional Options

  • F1 toggles CRT scanlines on/off
  • F2 toggles CRT curvature on/off
  • F3 switches in window size in windowed mode
  • Back button on controller accesses CRT/windowed options
  • F9 resets the game
  • Alt-Enter toggles between 16:9 fullscreen and 4:3 windowed mode

About Digital Eclipse Arcade


A series of throwback games made for the Digital Eclipse community, Digital Eclipse Arcade is a celebration of pure arcade gameplay. Sign up for the Digital Eclipse email newsletter to be the first to get exclusive drops.

2309250.name: Tribefort
2309250.about_the_game:
In Tribefort, you fight for survival on a vast island. Explore the lands to gather information. Mine and gather resources that you will need for your base. Farm and keep animals to survive. Strategize to win over your opponents.

The first game from C77 Entertainment, Combat Champions puts you in the spotlight as your team dominates corporate campuses turned game show arenas, performing crowd-pleasing over-the-top stunts and arena-altering destruction, all while holding key points and outshooting the opposition. Be the star of the show
Your corporate overlords don’t pay you to be boring; luckily the CMA (Corporate Mediation Alliance) cameras are rolling and they’ve set the stage for your success. Maps full of destroyable terrain are littered with game show props like corporate mascots, exploding fuel drums, air rams, human slingshots, and slides incentivize you to rack up stunts, catch the attention of the CMA play-by-play commentators, and be handsomely rewarded.

2309630.name: The Devilry Reservation
2309630.about_the_game:
The Devilry Reservation is a place of exile and residence for various members of the paranormal population, most of whom are monsters of varying degrees of danger. These reservations are hidden from the general public and kept under the control of government agencies.

The player takes on the role of a detective from the Paranormal Security Service (PSS), tasked with investigating acts of vandalism in one of these reservations. The investigation is made more difficult by the residents’ hostility and unwillingness to cooperate. Each of them is a unique individual, and it’s your job to find the right approach for each one. You’ll have to complete their requests to earn their trust — or use your official status to extract the information you need.

The main character is one of the few agents of the Paranormal Security Service who isn't human. He is just as otherworldly as the residents of the reservation, but unlike most demons, he possesses supernatural abilities that are invaluable in investigations. Beings like him are known as The Faceless — rare entities with no face who communicate through telepathy.

You'll explore the apartments of a towering panel housing block and converse with various creatures, uncovering new information. This will help you reveal the true situation within the reservation and gain deeper insight into the structure of the paranormal world.

GAMEPLAY

You're in for a slow-paced, exploration-driven journey. With a side-view perspective and pixel art visuals, the game lets you move through a multi-story apartment block. Exploration and interaction with characters take place through text-based narration and a dialogue choice system.

Your goal is to solve all assigned tasks while learning about the local otherworldly inhabitants. Helping you along the way is your Personal Pocket Computer (PPC), which can scan paranormal entities and store useful case-related information.

2309720.name: From the Streets to the Script - A Carabanchel Story
2309720.about_the_game:
The game is still in production. Some features are subject to change during the remaining development period.

About this game

From the Streets to the Script - A Carabanchel Story is a fun narrative experience set in modern day Madrid. Be thrilled by the characters and situations you will meet throughout this animated Visual Novel where you will not stop making decisions. Your actions will not only affect your friendships and romances, but also your big project and the multiple endings of the plot.

Storyline

After creating your character, you will be forced to move into a tiny shared flat in Madrid. There you will have to study in an eccentric vocational training centre where you will meet all kinds of classmates with whom you will share a passion: Japanese animation. Together you will make a crazy decision, you will create an anime before finishing your student years and going out into the working world. The project will gain importance and you will be in charge of making the decisions that, after several difficulties and triumphs, will lead to hatreds, friendships and more than one passionate romance.

Diverse relationships

You don't have to fall in love with anyone or establish any kind of romantic or sex-affective relationship in the video game; but depending on your decisions you can choose to have a relationship among 8 characters, but you can also seek to have a polyamorous relationship. The romances will be independent of the sex/gender you choose for your character; this aspect is intended to enjoy relationships across the LGBTIAQ+ spectrum.

Consent

.In this video game, consent is addressed and encouraged in all aspects of relationships between characters. In romantic relationships there is no obligation to have sex and refusing sex has no negative repercussions.

Characters

There is a great diversity of charismatic characters in the game. Throughout the story you will be able to choose who you spend time with so that you can get to know and bond with all the characters. However, you will have to choose who you spend the most time with and if you want to have a romantic relationship you will have to have your priorities straight.

Endings

.There are no bad decisions or bad endings in this game, have fun and make the decisions you want to make and find out what the repercussions of your actions are. There are not yet a definite number of endings, but depending on the decisions you make, we can divide them into three categories:

-The kind of relationship you will end up having with each character.
-What the project you end up creating will be like and whether it will succeed according to the goals you have set for yourselves.
-The end of your own story and your future.

Accessibility

The game can be played with just one click, quick time event and no skill is required to finish the game.
Several official translations are being considered in addition to English and Spanish, but the necessary files for fan translations will be made available in order to increase the accessibility of the game as much as possible.
We are working on a font that makes the game easier to read for people with dyslexia.
You can consult the character files at any time and their names appear every time they speak.
The game does not have voice acting, but work is being done to make the game fully accessible to visually impaired or blind people through text narration and audio descriptions. Currently available in English only.

ZOMBI ROCKSTAR is a 2D platform hack and slash video game that will make a hellish riff unleashing the old school + rock + zombie epidemic through a fast-paced and frenetic story.

Help Punkrocker send deadly riffs to the zombies... the vibration and power of punk music will drive them crazy and destroy them. The environment will be one of your best weapons, destroy vehicles, barricades, tombstones and a host of other environmental elements that will damage the hordes of zombies that try to stop you.

You'll use unique moves in strategic combos to charge up your electric guitar and use the ultimate musical trick that will make all the zombies around you dance. And remember, stay undefeated in damage to earn a radio with power ups that will save your winning streak.

The decision is in your hands and in your brain... The die is cast, the zombies are waiting in the darkness... What are you waiting for to unleash rock, the best antidote against the undead? How will you do it? YOU ALREADY HAVE THE GUYS TO DO IT!!! Keep rocking, fast fingers, show that you are a gentleman with your girl and survive the zombie apocalypse!

2309900.name: Shadows Of Deceit
2309900.about_the_game:
1999 – HAVENBROOK, UNITED STATES.

Journalist Janet Sheperd returns to her hometown to find a photograph. It's the only recent photo of her best friend, Isabelle Nox, who disappeared two years ago.

A memorial is being prepared. Janet needs that photo.

The photo is hidden somewhere inside her family's old hotel, now abandoned and awaiting demolition. With her is Lucas, a childhood friend, and their old walkie-talkies.

But as Janet searches through dusty rooms and forgotten corridors, something shifts. Hallways repeat. Time fractures. Events loop. Voice on the walkie-talkie begins to change, saying things he shouldn't know.

And other places start to bleed through the hotel: a university campus, a hospital, a school. Places where Janet lost something more than a friend. Places where she lost herself.

The deeper she goes, the more the building remembers.

And so does she.

To find the photo, Janet must uncover what really happened the night Isabelle vanished. The night her mind chose to forget.

Some places are abandoned.
Others are waiting.

2309920.name: Lost Veridian
2309920.about_the_game:
Craft the perfect deck in this exciting new 3D roguelike action card game!

Lost Veridian is a 3D Deckbuilding game where you and up to 4 friends embark on a quest through magical lands, dark dungeons, and battle epic bosses. Position your party well for success! Play with up to 4 friends in online co-op. Travel through exotic overworlds and delve into dark dungeons.

  • Play solo or join with up to 4 friends in online co-op
  • Hundreds of unique cards to discover

Please join our discord to provide feedback.

2310010.name: RuneRampage
2310010.about_the_game:
Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled, heart-pounding experience like no other in Rune Rampage! Step into the shoes of a skilled and agile warrior, ready to embark on a thrilling journey through dynamic and challenging environments.

In this single-player, fast-paced movement game, the objective is clear: compete to achieve the fastest times on a variety of meticulously designed maps. With each successful run, your times will be proudly displayed on the global leaderboards, showcasing your skills to the world. The pursuit of perfection and the desire to be at the top will drive your every move.

Rune Rampage revolves around a unique and exhilarating set of movement mechanics. As a player, you'll master the art of kicking, utilizing it to knock down doors and propel yourself off walls with breathtaking speed. The seamless combination of kicking and wall running allows for fluid, acrobatic maneuvers, giving you an edge as you navigate through complex obstacle courses.

Immerse yourself in a world that pushes the boundaries of your agility, reflexes, and strategic thinking. Each map presents a distinct challenge, with meticulously placed obstacles and strategic routes, demanding split-second decisions to maintain your momentum and shave off precious seconds from your time. Experiment with different paths, discover hidden shortcuts and uncover the most efficient routes to outperform your rivals.

Are you ready to embark on this unparalleled quest for speed, precision, and glory? Brace yourself for the ultimate Rune Rampage experience and leave your mark as a true champion of the leaderboard!

2310100.about_the_game:
Your mission as the mercenary is to clean the unforeseen consequences of the dangerous experiment resulting in the vast majority of mutants in the area. You have access to the self-recharging jetpack, a variety of flamethrowers and other fire weapons, beware of the traps and monsters on the levels.

  • Wade through hazardous stages with the multi-mode jetpack.

And many more.

2310130.name: Spinshot Party
2310130.about_the_game:
Join the excitement of a real-life table football game! This game is easy to learn, but challenging to master, making it perfect for players of all skill levels. The intuitive controls will test your hand-eye coordination and finger dexterity. It's a family-friendly game that's sure to liven up any party.

The game can be played with up to four players as well as Solo and Coop versus AI opponents in various difficulties. For the best experience though, you better have two or more Controllers playing with friends on site, shouting and shoving each other. You can use Steam Remote play to play with up to three friends online. Get ready to show off your table football skills!

2310150.name: Tome of Fates
2310150.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in Tome of Fates, an Adventure Gamebook: create, play, and share unique stories through the built-in story editor. Play solo or co-op with friends, craft epic narratives without any coding, then share them on the Steam Workshop for others to enjoy.

  • EDITOR - Story Creation, Simplified

Dive into the powerful yet intuitive story editor. This tool allows you to design branching narratives without any programming knowledge, making it easy to bring your imagination to life.


  • WORKSHOP- Share Your Stories

Share your stories on Steam Workshop and discover new adventures from the community.


  • MULTIPLAYER - Co-op / Twitch viewer interaction

Don't want to play alone? Our unique CO-OP system allows you and your chosen friends to vote on the path the story takes and what choices to make. Bit of a streamer? Use our Twitch Integration system to allow viewers to join in on the fun and influence your story!

2310160.name: Operation: Polygon Storm
2310160.about_the_game:
Become a master general. Strategically assemble your army from a selection of unique units and abilities to deploy into fast-paced battles. Watch your master plan play out, and adapt as the battle progresses, all with minimal micromanagement.


Mix and match units from a selection of infantry and armor alongside artillery and air support to push into the enemy's base and fight off any counterattacks. Tap into multiple upgrade trees for each unit and unlock additional abilities to fine-tune your army.




No base building or resource harvesting required. Focus on the battle as your army can advance, attack and take cover all on their own. Take command when needed to adapt and control the overall situation as your units either follow your masterplan or your direct orders




Balance your resources to pick an army composition suited for each mission. A deep and complex battle system means you’ll need to react quickly, choose the right mix of soldiers and Killstreak rewards, and utilise complementary unit synergies to gain any advantage.




Highly destructible environments, covers, ragdoll physics and a dash of gore all bring the battlefield to life.

As you explore, you'll encounter and catch new monsters, each with their own unique abilities and personalities. And with a range of items and upgrades available, you can make your favorite monsters reach the ultimate level.


With just a few clicks, you can set your monsters to battle automatically, allowing you to sit back and enjoy the progression. 2310220.name: Knight Raider
2310220.about_the_game:
Knight Raider is a wave-based game set in a dungeon aesthetic environment. How fast can you defeat the hordes of enemies? Are you more of a chill easy raider or down for a challenge? You have to act fast in hard mode, those enemies are almost as quick as you! Do you even have what it takes to defeat the grueling boss that spawns fire right from beneath your feet!?!?!



Knight Raider has 4 unique levels, all of which have timers so that you can race yourself to be able to defeat the level at the shortest time possible. Do you have the guts to speedrun the ultimate dungeon vanquishment experience? Couple the clock ticking and the hard-mode option and you have yourself a real trial that is no easy task to the light-hearted!



Finding yourself in a bit of a pickle with all of this difficulty? No worries, we got you covered! There is an in-game shop with different abilities to aid you in your journeys that are even upgradable!

The dungeon needs cleansing, only you can save it! Safe travels.

2310230.name: Finding Fern
2310230.about_the_game:
Embark on an epic adventure with Finding Fern, an immersive Action Adventure RPG that takes you on an epic story of discovery and excitement. Take a journey with Fern and Momo, across a world of mystery and intrigue, as they search for their mother.



As you travel through a vast, fantastical realm, you'll encounter a diverse cast of characters, both friend and foe. Engage in thrilling battles with powerful enemies, and acquire potent magical abilities to aid you on your quest.

With Finding Fern, you'll enjoy the freedom to switch between multiple party members at will, each with their unique play styles and abilities. You'll also have the opportunity to meet new allies along the way, expanding your party and enhancing your gameplay experience.



But Finding Fern isn't just about combat - it's a game that places a strong emphasis on story and dialogue. Your party members will engage in conversations with each other, as well as with the many fascinating individuals and creatures you encounter on your journey.

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure with Finding Fern. Explore a rich and immersive world, engage in thrilling battles, and uncover the truth behind Fern's quest to find her mother. With its unique gameplay mechanics, captivating story, and diverse cast of characters, Finding Fern has a little something for everyone.

2310260.name: Super Smash Asteroids
2310260.about_the_game:
Welcome to "Super Smash Asteroids", a high-octane, top-down, dual-stick, rogue-like space shooter set in a futuristic universe. Choose from six unique ships, each with their own starting statistics and special abilities, and blast your way through hordes of enemies and epic bosses.

As you play, level up and choose from a pool of over 70+ items to upgrade your ship and modify your base stats, unlocking game-changing abilities that will help you survive the intense combat. With a wave shooter style of play, "Super Smash Asteroids" offers a challenging, fast-paced and action-packed experience.

So, buckle up and prepare for a journey filled with adrenaline-fueled battles and an endless pursuit for glory. Get ready to experience an epic space adventure like never before!


"Super Smash Asteroids" has a Discord community where players can connect with one another, share tips and strategies, and discuss all things related to the game. Whether you're looking for a co-op partner, want to share your latest high score, or just want to chat with fellow fans, the "Super Smash Asteroids" Discord server is the place to be. Join the community today and become a part of the ever-growing community of space shooter fans!


In "Super Smash Asteroids", you have the ability to upgrade your ship with over 70+ items to enhance your base stats and modify your ship's abilities. As you progress through the game and defeat enemies, you will earn experience points, which will allow you to level up and unlock new abilities.

Choose from a variety of upgrades such as better weapons, faster engines, and stronger shields to tailor your ship to your playstyle. Want to focus on speed and evasion? Equip engines that increase your ship's mobility and equip shields that allow you to dodge enemy fire. Prefer a more offensive playstyle? Equip weapons that deal more damage and upgrade your ship's power systems for increased energy regeneration.

Additionally, as you progress through the game, you will encounter rare and powerful items that offer unique and game-changing abilities. These items can completely change the way you play and offer strategic advantages in combat.

In "Super Smash Asteroids", upgrading your ship is crucial for surviving the intense combat and defeating the epic bosses that await you. So, choose your upgrades wisely and prepare for an endless pursuit for glory in this adrenaline-fueled space adventure!


In "Super Smash Asteroids", you can choose from six unique ships, each with their own starting statistics and special abilities. These ships offer a variety of playstyles and can be tailored to your preferences as you progress through the game.

Each ship has its own strengths and weaknesses, and choosing the right ship for your playstyle is crucial for success in "Super Smash Asteroids". Do you prefer to be a tank and absorb enemy fire, or do you like to zip around the battlefield and take down enemies with hit-and-run tactics? The choice is yours.

So, experiment with different ships and upgrades to find the perfect combination for your playstyle, and prepare to blast your way through hordes of enemies and epic bosses in this fast-paced space shooter.


In "Super Smash Asteroids", you have the ability to permanently upgrade your ship through the Everlast system. Everlast is a permanent upgrade system that allows you to choose and unlock bonuses that persist through all of your playthroughs.

As you progress through the game, you will earn Everlasting Gold, which can be used to unlock bonuses such as increased damage, faster movement, and stronger shields. These upgrades will remain with you through all your playthroughs, even if you die or start a new game.

With the Everlast system, you can tailor your ship to your playstyle and make it even more powerful with each playthrough. Want to focus on offense and deal more damage? Unlock bonuses that increase your weapon power and damage. Prefer to be a more defensive player? Choose bonuses that increase your shield strength and durability.

The Everlast system is a great way to make progress through the game more rewarding and provide long-term goals for players. With over 19 bonuses to choose from, there's a lot of room for experimentation and customization. So, use your Everlast points wisely and build the ultimate space-faring machine in "Super Smash Asteroids"!


"Super Smash Asteroids" features a number of rogue-like elements that make each playthrough feel fresh and exciting. The game is runs on a never-ending wave system which progressively gets harder the longer you play.

The environment in "Super Smash Asteroids" is procedurally generated, meaning that each time you play, the stars, planets and series of which enemies are produced and power-ups are produced will all be at random. This randomness keeps the game feeling fresh and unpredictable, and ensures that no two playthroughs are exactly the same.

In addition to the randomly generated levels, "Super Smash Asteroids" also features permadeath. If you die during a run, you'll need to start over from the beginning, losing all of your progress and upgrades. While this may seem daunting, it also adds an extra layer of challenge and excitement to the game, as you never know when your next run could be the one where you achieve glory.

To help you on your journey, "Super Smash Asteroids" offers a variety of unlockable ships and upgrades that can be discovered as you play. These ships and upgrades can offer unique abilities and advantages that can help you overcome even the toughest challenges. With so many ships and upgrades to discover, there's always a new strategy to try and a new build to experiment with.

Overall, the rogue-like elements in "Super Smash Asteroids" provide a sense of unpredictability and excitement that keeps the game fresh and challenging, even after multiple playthroughs. So, prepare to blast your way through a galaxy filled with danger and adventure, and see how far you can make it in this high-octane space shooter.

2310290.name: Otokiyome
2310290.about_the_game:
Story


You live in a village deep in the mountains, and a personal computer is delivered to you.
The display on it shows "Shirakawa Yuri," a being who claims to be the end of the Gods.
You are to cooperate with Shirakawa Yuri's sound purification
As you escape from the monster, and as you purify the sound, you will gradually remember the truth.

What you will see when you purify the sound and get rid of the stain...

"Otokiyome" is a bizarre horror adventure based on the original idea of VTuber "Shirakawa Yuri".

Overview


"Otokiyome" is a first-person 3D horror adventure game featuring real-life Vtubers.
The voice actors are provided by Tamiyasu Tomoe and other people who are mainly active in the virtual world, and you will be able to enjoy the sound throughout the game.

You, the main character, together with the support character "Shirakawa Yuri," collect necessary items from your house or village, go to the place where the sound is polluted, put down your PC, and purify the pollution together with Shirakawa Yuri.

Then a monster will appear and attack the computer to destroy it.

You must run away from the monster while protecting your computer.
While the monster is far away, place the computer again in the place where the sound is polluted repeatedly until the purification gauge is full, the uncleanness will be exorcised and the sound will be purified.

There are a total of five locations for sound purification.
As you purify the sound, exorcise the uncleanness, and eliminate the apparition, you will remember the truth.

How to play


  • Move - WASD
  • Action - Left click
  • Run - Shift
  • Select Item - Wheel
  • Use Item - Right click
  • Option - ESC
  • Skip Talk - Space
  • Capture - P
.

About Live Streaming


We welcome live streaming and play-by-play of this work. We welcome live streaming and play-by-play of this game on any monetized platform. We hope you can enjoy this game with many people.
