2310300.name: THE MEME HUNTER
2310300.about_the_game:
THE MEME HUNTER is a dynamic first–person shooter in which you will exterminate crowds of evil memes. You appear in a large, open-to-explore arena and you need to find five drawings of an old oak tree to complete the level. However, it's not that simple. Evil memes are everywhere. They're out for your blood. They will chase you wherever you go and of course they will stop you from collecting drawings. Use a wide arsenal of firearms to get rid of these annoying entities. Collect all the oak drawings and defeat the boss!



The essence of the gameplay:
At the very beginning, you have a choice of 3 game levels, as well as a training level where you can try out all available weapons and train your accuracy. Once at the game level, you need to explore it to find 5 pieces of the oak image. Funny entities that periodically appear in random places will interfere with you. If you still manage to find all the pictures, you will have a battle with the boss.

2310360.name: Up All Night: Daybreak
2310360.about_the_game:
Night after night, nightmare after nightmare.

Despite the passage of time, Nick Torres just can’t seem to shake the ghosts of his past… and one ghost in particular -- much to Nick’s chagrin -- has found his way back to the waking world.

Felix returns in this short kinetic novel, eager for a conversation.

Will Nick indulge him? ...Does he have a choice?

Up All Night: Daybreak is a direct spin-off of Up All Night, and contains a multitude of spoilers. As such, players are encouraged to experience Up All Night before proceeding with Daybreak.




Kinetic story
5,000+ words
Custom artwork
Original soundtrack
Emotionally traumatized Nick Torres

2310400.name: Gender Dysphoria
2310400.about_the_game:
A short 20 minute non-linear narrative game about negative experiences after coming out as transgender.

Developer's Note: This is a rather indulgent and unforgiving game, at least for me, as it only contains negative experiences. I recommend you only consider playing this game if you have the emotional capacity for it. I hope that it can give cisgender people an idea of what being transgender is like and for those who are transgender themselves that they are not alone in their experiences and that there's someone else who has felt the pain too. But, I also made this game for myself. I've made this game the same way you might write about the painful, dark memories you have in a journal to help process it and move on.

2310430.name: Arrows and Antiquity
2310430.about_the_game:
Arrows and Antiquity is an archery speedrunning FPS where mastering unique arrows and uncovering hidden shortcuts will let you conquer trials at breakneck speed. Artemis possesses a legendary bow fit for only a true master of archery. Can you complete her trials?

AIM FOR PERFECTION

Wield an arsenal of unique arrows, each with powerful abilities. Discover shortcuts, invent clever tricks, and refine your routes to earn medals and climb the leaderboards! Miss a shot? Restart instantly and chase the perfect run.

ONLINE GHOSTS

Race against ghostly replays of other archers. Learn their routes, shots, and tricks. Then beat them.

COLLECTABLES

Hunt for hidden presents and scrolls to unlock game-changing relics. Earn medals to claim rare bows from Artemis’ personal arsenal!

MASTER ARCHERY

Tackle diverse landscapes with unique challenges. No one has mastered them all. Will you be the first?
2310430.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian

2310440.name: Cryspace
2310440.about_the_game:
WELCOME TO CRYSPACE

Welcome to Cryspace. Fresh out of college, you decide to make an account on the new social media platform. Upon joining, your lifelong friend, Paul Meyer, adds you, and invites you to a house party. Could this be your chance to live the "college lifestyle" you always dreamed of?

If only it were that simple. You may have had enough drinks to feel confident at that party, enough to the point where you could even ask out Sam, someone you've had a crush on for quite a while, but Paul's nowhere to be found.

Making your way upstairs in your search, you're met with a frightening scene. Paul is being pressed by a man, Jordan Myra, who happens to be the ex-boyfriend of Paul's current girlfriend, Crystal Mendez. He's threatening violence against Paul, seemingly out of pure jealousy. Will you call the cops on him? Take on the fight for yourself? Maybe you decide to leave the party and not get involved at all?

The choice is yours. In this game of tense and fragile relationships, the fate of your friend group and new relationship rests purely in your hands. Will you be able to secure a future for yourself and your significant other? What's really going on behind the scenes in Paul's relationship with Crystal? With countless branching paths, over seventy different endings, and a narrative where rising conflicts are always around the corner, your critical thinking and ability to empathize will be tested thoroughly. One misstep may be all it takes for everything to come crashing down.

INFINITE CUSTOMIZATION

Make Cryspace your own with many settings available to make the site look just the way you like it. Introduce your character to the world of Cryspace with a custom profile picture, name, and alter the appearance/behavior of the website to your liking. You may also play as either a male or a female, giving you an immersive experience from start-to-finish as you pursue the truth.

2310500.name: Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session
2310500.about_the_game:
Get ready to rock and groove with Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session! This rhythm-based game takes you on a musical adventure through dimensions, with striking visuals that will keep you mesmerized for hours. Unique gameplay mechanics challenge you to switch between three rows, pressing the action button in time with falling arrows that match your guitar pick. Precision and quick reflexes are key to success as you navigate through each song, avoiding obstacles such as spikes that threaten to disrupt your performance.

MAKE YOUR OWN LEVELS:

With two exciting charting modes, Drag & Drop and Play-Through, you can create your own custom levels with ease.
  • In Drag & Drop Charting Mode, simply place notes on a grid to build your own song.

  • For a more immersive experience, switch to Play-Through Charting Mode and chart your inputs as you play through the song, letting your musical abilities guide the way.



UNIQUE AND INTENSIVE GAMEPLAY:

In Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session, you'll experience unique and intense gameplay as you navigate through a world of rhythm and sound. To succeed, you'll need to be quick on your feet and avoid spikes that threaten to disrupt the beat. But what sets this game apart from others is its interdimensional twist – you'll travel through different dimensions, each with its own unique rhythm and challenges. Whether you're a seasoned rhythm game player or a newcomer to the genre, Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is sure to keep you on the edge of your seat with its innovative and addictive gameplay.

EXPERIENCE THE PSYCHEDELIC VISUALS:

The game is a spin-off of the Ortheo franchise, and is free to play. The game also supports Gamebanana, making it easy to share your custom levels and songs with other players. Get ready to feel the beat and experience the ultimate rhythm-based gameplay with Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session!

INSPIRED BY THE GREATS:

Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is a rhythm game that draws inspiration from some of the greatest rhythm games in the genre. The visual design takes cues from Everhood, offering a psychedelic and trippy experience. The health meter system is inspired by PaRappa the Rapper, adding an additional layer of challenge to the game. Additionally, the game is influenced by the looks of the upcoming Rift of The Necrodancer and Muse Dash. With these great games as inspirations, Ortheo's Interdimensional Jam Session is set to offer players a unique and unforgettable rhythm experience.

CREDITS:

Programmer: Dallen Larson

Art Director: ZachJaDa
Composer: Anthony Hampton

2310550.name: SWAP
2310550.about_the_game:
Hello, it’s nice to meet you. We have a simple task for you:

1) Swap the 3 color blocks to hit the matching falling colors.
2) Don't listen to the AI.

That's it!

Thank you,
- The Management

Welcome to SWAP

A simple yet brutally difficult game that will undoubtedly frustrate and personally insult you. Uncover a story full of psychological manipulation and emotional warfare while banging your head against unfairly designed levels. Sound like fun? Great! Let's see how that optimism is doing for you in a few hours.

81 Story Levels

81 challenging levels broken into 9 chapters. Each chapter has their own unique gameplay challenges and insanely good music by DANCE WITH THE DEAD to match the emotion of the story.

Speedrun / Timed Run Mode

Do you love pain? Play timed run and see if you can beat each chapter with no mistakes. Good luck.

Custom Level Editor

Create your own levels and share them with friends.

Soundtrack

Amazing soundtrack by DANCE WITH THE DEAD.

2310590.name: Depths of Insanity
2310590.about_the_game:
When a Space Marine named Slaug, strangely loses control of his Spacecraft and is forced to crash-land on Planet Earth.

He quickly becomes aware of some WEIRD THINGS HAPPENING IN THE AREA [Or is it just inside his head?]

A Sinister force is threatening his life and he doesn't even know it!

Do what you must to get that Spacecraft spaceworthy again. Is he just dreaming?
What really happened after the crash?

  • First person 2.5D Adventure

  • Action with different weapons

  • Explore the world in any direction

  • No hand-holding. Just pure fun!

  • A bunch of cool Quests

  • Build a House and furnish it

  • Secrets everywhere

  • 100 Songs to find and play in game as you play

  • Mini-Games

  • Weird & Quirky Cozy Fun!

3D First-Person Adventure with exploration and uncovering secrets of the areas surrounding your crash site.

Collect all necessary materials to craft a temporary home and hopefully find a way to rebuild your Spacecraft and return home before it's too late.

The Universe is in your hands (head)!

Depths of Insanity 1 is a delirious fantasy made up in Slaug's head when being knocked out.
Depths of Insanity 2 is just a side story in the same franchise.
Depths of Insanity 3 is the Origin Story where everything starts after waking up from a knockout.

2310610.name: Vessel Blue
2310610.about_the_game:
You've found a mysterious computer, and whilst you don't know why, you try to solve the mysteries of "Vessel Blue", a cryptic company, through the data and files you find on the machine. However, you are not alone.

INTERACT WITH THE ENVIRONMENT

Solve text-based puzzles using your computer. Explore the mysterious software of the device by reading documents, encrypting files and entering codes into databases.

SOLVE PUZZLES WITH YOUR COMPUTER

Examine items that are located on your desk to help you proceed through the game. Read documents to find even more clues. But be aware: while you're trying to solve the mysteries, you're hunted by an evil walking pumpkin monster.

DEFEND YOURSELF, YOU CANNOT MOVE

You CANNOT MOVE in this game! You're glued to your chair, and have to constantly watch your back to scare the pumpkin man away while solving the puzzles.

2310620.name: Ballooni - balloon homunculus
2310620.about_the_game:
Welcome! You are Ballooni, a charming little character in a fabulous computer game.

🎈 Jump into the colorful adventure with the brave Balloon Man!

Explore a vibrant jump-and-run universe full of fast-paced arcade action, where each chamber presents a new challenge. With simple controls, you can make your balloon hero run, jump, and float – perfect for quick, casual sessions.

💨 Fast, fun, retro-inspired

The mix of classic platforming and modern, colorful worlds evokes the timeless vibes of Mario and Pac classics – easy to play, but sometimes difficult to master. Skill, timing, and a little bit of courage are key, as each chamber demands new skills and quick reflexes.

🌈 For anyone who needs a splash of color

This game is fun. The simple controls, fast gameplay, and lovingly designed levels make it the ideal companion for kids, casual gamers, and retro fans alike.

🎮 Easy to start – hard to stop

Run, jump, be happy – and start all over again. Every lap is a little adventure that will instantly captivate you.

Ballooni runs and jumps through crackling, colorful levels, firing his magic with precision.

Ballooni's task is to collect valuable coins in a series of challenging levels full of obstacles and crazy enemies.

However, this is no easy task, as the environment is roamed by enemies. Along the way, Ballooni solves small puzzles and receives rewards for doing so. He enters and uses portals to reach otherwise inaccessible areas of the map.

Ballooni has a lot of fun jumping on conveyor belts and floating platforms and using magic against enemies to temporarily freeze them or banish them from the stage.

Each level of the game has its own theme and distinctive look. To win the game, Ballooni must master the Tower of Bats, the Acid Flood Pyramid with jumping portals, the Labyrinth of Madness, and other levels.

A ticker with funny tips and sayings at the bottom of the screen encourages Ballooni.

Ballooni must beware of kRACH, Tennismorph, De Flurp, Black Tomato, and other madmen...

COMMON TIPPS

  • When Ballooni's life energy is depleted, Ballooni restarts the level with a little more life energy. The exact details are explained to Ballooni in the game. The “coach” will tell Ballooni helpful things.

  • Ballooni tries hard to collect the letters that appear in the correct order. When the word is complete, Ballooni is rewarded with a little more life energy and points!

  • When Ballooni collects the green coin, enemies tend to flee. However, Ballooni's vitality still decreases in this mode when he touches an enemy.

  • When Ballooni collects a red coin, enemies tend to chase Ballooni!

PREFER to play with a GAMEPAD anyway.

YOU DON'T HAVE A GAMEPAD? That is the keyboard support as visualized in the game...

  • Shoot spell: The key next to the left or right shift key/Shift

  • Climb ladder: arrow keys, w, s

  • Walk: arrow keys, a, d

  • Jump: left or right shift key

  • Cancel game: ESC

AND IN THE MENU...

  • Navigate: Arrow keys

  • Trigger button: Return/Enter, Spacebar

  • Exit game: ESC

2310630.name: Citizens: On Mars
2310630.about_the_game:
Experience the ultimate turn-based puzzle-style colony building game in Citizens: On Mars! As the leader of a fledgling Martian settlement, your mission is to develop a thriving colony amidst the harsh and unforgiving environment of the Red Planet.



  • Unique mix of a logical puzzle and city building gameplay
  • Manage your colony's resources, expand your territory, and develop your colony as you plan each turn carefully
  • Random events: Face unpredictable challenges such as Worker Strikes and Smuggler Dominance, forcing you to adapt and overcome adversity
  • Faction system: Balance the interests of the Social, Scientific and Industrial leaders to maintain harmony and progress in your colony
  • Hand-crafted campaign: Embark on an engaging campaign that will test your leadership and decision-making abilities
  • Random map generator: For endless replayability, venture into the unknown in the Single Scenario mode



Take charge of your colony's future, and navigate the intricate web of social, scientific, and industrial factions as you lead your citizens through a new era of Martian history. With each turn, you'll make decisions that shape the development of your settlement, while managing resources to ensure its survival and growth.

Explore the endless possibilities of Mars with the random map generator, ensuring no two playthroughs are the same. Discover new challenges, strategic opportunities, and untapped resources as you forge your colony's destiny on a constantly evolving Martian frontier.

In Citizens: On Mars, the future of humanity rests in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge and build a thriving Martian civilization, or succumb to the harsh realities of life on the Red Planet? The choice is yours.

English*, Polish

2310660.name: Dead eat dead
2310660.about_the_game:
This is a retro style 2D pixel art survival adventure shooter. You control a character armed with a shotgun and grenades. You need to search level for supplies and keys to open locked doors. You can push and move boxes and fuel barrels located on game levels.
Plot. Mutated virus of rabies turned population of your town into dangerous zombies. Your motorbike is out of fuel and you desperately need to leave the zone of contamination. Get your shotgun, collect supplies and spend munition carefully. You can push forward boxes and barrels or move blocked cars and use them against the infected or groups of marauders. Watch out for shaking garbage cans. They can hide a supply or an ambush. It is better to be stealth and avoid enemies.

2310670.name: Midnight Arrow
2310670.about_the_game:
Midnight Arrow is an atmospheric puzzle platformer that uses a retro art style. Hop on platforms and jump on walls to explore a vast immersive platforming world. Discove the different types of arrows and use them to solve puzzles and illuminate the darkened world around you! Oh and did I mention you can now create your own levels? 👀



Features


  • Tight smooth platforming 🦘
  • Optional quests 🏆
  • Collectables 🍭
  • Skins 👕
  • 6 areas with new mechanics 🏔️
  • New Puzzles in every area 🧩
  • Level Editor 🛠️
  • Speedrunning Stuff ⏰

Light up your path

through the dark caverns using fire arrows.

Solve puzzles

than test your aim, platforming, and dexterity abilities, all at the same time. You need to do both puzzle-solving and platforming at the same time and if you are extra good at platforming you can even cheese the game for some speedrunning advantage! 🧀
Each area brings new mechanics that add to the complexity of the platforming and the challenges of the puzzles. The game has a total of 6 areas each with its unique mood and playstyle.

Use different arrows


Solve optional quests!

And Make your own levels!🤩

The game comes with the level editor integrated! You have all the features accessible (except NPCs) so you can create your own levels as cool as the original ones! Check this tutorial out!

2310690.name: Extra Lives
2310690.about_the_game:
See how long you can survive in a world full of brainless zombies and heartless humans! Develop unique relationships with 200 other characters spread across 8 warring factions - each with their own beliefs about what the problem is and how to solve it. Explore over 50 different locations on your journey to reclaim every corner of the city, with hundreds of interactive objects to help you survive in real-time. Inheriting the combat system from the wrestling games, tearing enemies apart has never been so satisfying! For the 1st time ever, the original touch-screen concept has been adapted for a controller.

Fully unlocked as standard, you can start with a character of your creation and save your changes to all others to make the world your own. You can even choose how many zombies you start with to either dive in at the deep end or ensure a slow build. If you prefer, a whole other "Deathmatch" mode gives you all the fun of slaying zombies with none of the pressure!

  • Survive among 200 other characters spread across 8 warring factions!
  • Explore over 50 locations to reclaim every corner of a huge city!
  • Immersive gameplay challenges you to survive each day in real-time!
  • Dozens of interactive weapons & objects that can be used for crafting!
  • Wrestling-based combat system makes it satisfying to tear enemies apart!
  • Atmospheric music reflects the danger of every moment!
  • Stylized 2D visuals draw inspiration from pop culture!
  • Edit every character to make the world your own!
  • Act out your own scenarios in the "Deathmatch" mode!

2310700.name: Shadow Corridor 2 雨ノ四葩
2310700.about_the_game:
The scariest randomly generated horror game is back and better than ever! The app is currently in development

■More randomly generated dungeons!
The massive corridors change with each play.
There's no one right way to progress.
Make your way to the goal while carefully dealing with ever-changing circumstances!
This time, get ready for many more randomly
generated dungeons rich in variation!

■Karuta System
Collect Karuta cards that produce all kinds of special effects!
Find your own favorite combination
and create your very own playstyle!

■A plethora of new items!
Find even more items than the previous game!
This time they're even weirder!
Use the items to find a way to survive!

■New Apparitions
The new Apparitions are stronger and scarier than ever!
They'll test your wits, your strength, and your ability to stare fear in the face!
Use all your abilities to escape a grim fate!

■A new story
Discover the story of the girl Shigure in this title.
She thought to end her own life and embrace the sweet release of death. However...
You can enjoy the new story without any knowledge of the previous title.
Of course, those who have played the last game might get even more enjoyment out of it!

■For beginners and advanced players alike.
Select from even more dynamic difficulties with this title.
The game has been made easier to play through to the ending, even for those who are not good at games.
And for those who want it, you can experience an even grimmer hell than before.

2310710.name: VONA / She
2310710.about_the_game:
Vona is a point and click game where the player will perform a Ukrainian housewife’s life and her attempt to “escape” from her house, breaking the daily life loop and obtaining all the Gender Museums' pieces.



The game takes place in a house, where the player has to do the housework: cleaning, cooking, doing the laundry… step by step and in time. But, at the moment when the player does something different (take a relaxing bath, wear too much make-up, drink vodka…), the player will open a museum inside a hole in her kitchen.



There is a lot of housework and the player must do everything before the day ends. This can feel oppressive. If the player doesn’t make perfect, she will run out of time. But, it’s in this imperfection where the player can find more fun and when the player will progress in the game.

2310720.name: Real-Time Assist Replay Time　～1 minute until closing～
2310720.about_the_game:
Experience the near-future slot game "Untap, Girls" featuring infinite ART with no wait time for non-stop spinning!

Follow the push-order navigation, and you can earn endlessly until the store closes!

Just when you enter the dream-like infinite ART, there's only one minute left until closing time...

Every Japanese slot player has gone through the "bonus rush just before closing."

With frustration and haste, accurately press the lever, bet, and buttons!

Show off your concentration and see how much you can collect in a short amount of time!

No need for timing precision!

By following the on-screen instructions and pressing buttons, you can increase your medals in this game that focuses solely on the most satisfying part of slots - the "Assist Replay Time (ART)."

After launching the game, hit the lever to start! Try to earn as many medals as you can before the time displayed in the upper left corner runs out!

Follow the push order navigation (*)

There's also an online ranking to see how much you can earn in one minute!

Use the medals you collect for the "Gratitude Lottery"!

Aim to complete all 60 items!

*Push Order Navigation:

The numbers "1," "2," and "3" displayed above the three stop buttons.

The character will navigate you to press the "left," "middle," or "right" buttons next.

By pressing the stop buttons in the order shown, you can line up winning combinations and increase your medals.

If you press the buttons in the wrong order, the combination won't be successful, and you won't gain any medals.

2310730.name: Legends
2310730.about_the_game:
The story begins with a massive fire that destroyed an ongoing ritual,
causing ghosts and ghouls to run rampant in both the celestial and mortal realms.

To restart the ritual, the protagonist "Hong-Niang" must assist her parents in purchasing the ingredients required for the ceremony in town.
And with the assistance of two mythical creatures, "Taotie" and "Fu-Xi," complete the mission;
thwart the mischief-makers disrupting the ceremony, restoring order to both the celestial and mortal realms.

Features



  • Chinese-style art and architectural scenes.
Whether it's the magnificent Jiu Ge Restaurant or the uniquely themed town, every map is worth exploring and savoring.


  • Shadow puppetry stories and real recipes.
Legendary stories presented through paper-cut shadow puppetry and actual mooncake recipes used in the game provide you with a deeper sense of immersion and surprises!


  • Two battle modes and four difficulty levels to choose from.
Different choices will affect the gameplay; we offer three difficulty levels and a non-combat version for you to choose freely.

  • Parodying mythical stories.
A funny and entertaining plot that breaks the established impression of mythical stories! Suitable for players who enjoy lighthearted and cheerful narratives.

Special Thanks

Assistance with publishing the game on Steam:
Maker製造機- Chimaki

Multi-language system plugins:
Mirai

Promotional video BGM:

2310770.name: Intergalactic Genocide
2310770.about_the_game:
NOTE

The game is currently in early access. If you purchase the game during this phase, please remember that it is still in development and may change based on your feedback.

STORY

With a strong military career, Selin finds herself in the midst of a conflict between humanity and aliens after receiving an urgent mission call while preparing dinner with her family. Investigating a mysterious object that crashed on Earth, Selin forms alliances to uncover the aliens' true intentions and guide humanity.

ABOUT THIS GAME

Intergalactic Genocide is a single-player action-adventure game that explores the struggle between humans and aliens. Players will experience various levels filled with combat, puzzles, and the challenge of forming alliances. Throughout the early access phase, we plan to introduce new levels, story elements, and challenges based on player feedback.

WARNING

This game may contain content that triggers sensitivity in players, including scenes of intense conflict and potential epileptic triggers.

2310780.name: Vincent's Horror Story
2310780.about_the_game:
In VINCENT'S HORROR STORY, players are placed in a haunting and surreal environment filled with terrifying creatures and puzzles. The player must navigate through each level, using their wits and problem-solving skills to find the way out and overcome obstacles.

The graphics are realistically dark and eerie, helping to create a truly immersive experience.

The game is a linear horror experience, with each level offering unique challenges and obstacles to overcome. Players must face their fears and confront the monsters that lurk in the shadows in order to reach the end of Vincent's journey and uncover the truth about his subconscious.

In this game, the player must rely on their instincts, quick thinking, and resourcefulness to survive. With each level offering different challenges, the player will be constantly on edge, never knowing what horrors may be waiting around the next corner.
The game is designed to create a tense and frightening atmosphere, making it a must-play for fans of horror games. Whether it's solving puzzles, avoiding traps, or escaping from monsters, Vincent's Horror Story will test the player's courage and determination.



So, if you're looking for an adrenaline-fueled and truly frightening gaming experience, give Vincent's Horror Story a try.

highlighted.name: THE QUIETER YOU GO, THE FURTHER YOU'LL GET

2310810.name: Tents and Trees
2310810.about_the_game:
Tents and Trees offers a chill experience, subtly touched by the spirit of Picross.

Your mission is simple: place tents next to trees in a nature-filled grid.
The numbers around the grid tell you how many tents must be placed in each row and column, but be careful: tents can’t touch each other. Each level has only one unique solution, so take your time and carefully plan your every move.

  • As you progress through the game, you’ll encounter larger grids and more challenging levels that will require you to come up with your own strategies.
  • With a variety of music tracks and themes to unlock, including dark mode, you can personalize your gameplay experience even further.
  • Invite your camping buddies to join the fun in the local multiplayer mode, where up to 4 players can work together to solve puzzles.
  • With new daily levels to keep things fresh, the fun never ends.

Features


  • Hundreds of levels
  • Limitless content with daily puzzles
  • Helpful hint system explaining the process
  • Local coop multiplayer
  • Cozy and catchy music tracks
  • Various themes and dark mode
  • Cloud save
  • Achievements
  • Leaderboards
  • Grid size up to 20x20
  • No rush: play at your own pace, start a level and complete it later
  • Mouse and gamepad support

Get ready to pitch your tent and take on the challenge! Happy camping!

95/100 – NintendoWorldReport

2310830.name: Slayer Souls
2310830.about_the_game:
Slayer Souls is a roguelike deckbuilder where you open card packs, fight dangerous enemies, and progress through an open node map.

OPEN CARD PACKS

Open card packs during your run to gain new cards and shape your build.

Each pack offers different options, forcing you to adapt your strategy.

OPEN NODE MAP

Choose your path through an open node map filled with enemies, events, and rewards.

Earn insignias to unlock new nodes and reach stronger encounters.

COMBAT

Fight enemies, elites, and bosses in turn-based combat.

Every encounter requires planning, timing, and careful decisions.

DECK BUILDING

Upgrade, remove, and combine cards to refine your deck.

Build powerful combinations to survive increasingly difficult runs.

Every run offers new nodes, rewards, and challenges.
2310830.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil

2310840.name: Mechafare
2310840.about_the_game:
The early stages of an RTS I created in a gap year.
Create your loadout from a wide assortment of mechs, including some that shoot, some that slash and some that do way to much damage. Send your mechs to battle, capture objectives, to improve your stats and destroy the enemy base. Generate alloys from playing matches to improve your loadout by purchasing mechs from the armoury. Have fun, it will be hard to but have fun

Planned updates:
-A lot more Mechs
-Smoother animations
-Cleaner UI
-Ability to Purchase Neonites
-Colour variants for Mechs
- Improved balance

“Amazing. A pioneer of the RTS genre, A refreshing take that is for sure not league of legends + clash royale with extra steps”
1000/10 – Very Real Organization That Reviews Games I Think

2310850.name: Sophie's Grids
2310850.about_the_game:
Can you align all dice in a grid only by turning rows and columns?

And once you figure out the trick, how quickly can you do it?

Challenge Yourself

Sophie's Grids provides challenges for every step of your improvement, from when you don't have a clue - to when you have spent hours mastering your skills and the greatest opponent is your own best time.

To ramp up the difficulty try including fast and slow dice in your grids, dice with pegs and locks on their sides, and when you are truly a master - try to memorise a grid before you begin and solve it without even seeing it!

Once you are ready for a deeper challenge try Nodes mode, where a greater understanding of grid control is required to solve the puzzles.

Grid Series

Most grids are randomly generated, providing endless play, however there are included series which are authored challenges that await the adventurous!

Once you're comfortable solving grids, do your best each day with The Daily - a short series of grids available for one day only, where your first completion is the only one that counts!

Improve

Sophie's Grids includes modes to help you develop: Practice mode has no timer or tracking, and Drill mode will teach you short algorithms and how to recognise when to use them.

2310860.name: Radical Road
2310860.about_the_game:
Turn, grind, and drive your way to the top. Radical Road is an easy to learn but hard to master single button arcade game!
The objective is to go as far as you can on an infinitely procedurally generated road!
Along the way you will have to turn and grind with the correct timing to avoid bailing out!
The further you go the faster the car goes and the more points you rack up!


The further you go the more coins you will collect!
You can then use said coins to unlock a variety of EPIC skins for your vehicle
so you can ride in style. All the skins you unlock feature distinct visual effects and more!
Besides coins you have 15 Achievements to attain and a sprinkel of some Cool Secrets to find.


Compete with your friends or take on the world on the global leaderboard, see if you have what it takes to be the MOST RADICALLEST roader around!

2310870.name: Plastic Soul
2310870.about_the_game:
Plastic Soul is a daily life simulation about living with an android. You play as a man who gets an android from you son to help you move on from your deceased wife. Take care of her and she will take care of you! Progress through the story by interacting with your android and discover the secret behind your wife's death.

Features
  • Busty and THICC android that can interact with!
  • Over 70 2D hand-drawn animated scenes to unlock!
  • A story that'll make you feel probably...

Gameplay
  • Point and click to explore your apartment!
  • Upgrade your android to do more lewd stuff by doing lewd stuff!
  • Train your stamina and strength to last longer and unlock more skills!
  • Progress the story by gaining motivation points and unlocking skills!

2310880.name: Cursor Story
2310880.about_the_game: Cursor story is a cool and fun game where you play as a cursor (You don't control it with your cursor) in small Bullet-hell-ish levels about precision and timing. You explore all kinds of cool places (like the void and an island inhabited by dinosaurs) and meet cool, interesting, weird and funny characters (like a floating voice, three pirates and a frog). The cursor has lost it's memories so it teams up with the voice to get them back, and get the voice a new body. There's a lot of cool and unusual concepts that will for sure suprise you on your journey and there's about a 95% chance that you will have a good time. (Fun fact: The game was originally made in PowerPoint)

2310900.name: Hedge Fund Tycoon
2310900.about_the_game:
Step into the cutthroat world of high finance with this tycoon-simulation game. The goal is to become the richest hedge fund in the world. In a market where the stakes are high and the competition is fierce, you'll need to be strategic, aggressive, and willing to take risks to come out on top.

Buy and Sell

You'll have access to a wide range of financial tools to help you make the most of every opportunity. From stocks and bonds to derivatives and options, you'll have the tools you need to make smart investments and maximize your returns.

Manage multi-billion Corporations

But simply having access to the right tools isn't enough. In order to succeed in this game, you'll need to be willing to manage billion-dollar corporations, take calculated risks, and be aggressive in your pursuit of wealth.
As you build your empire, you'll need to manage your assets and make strategic decisions to ensure your continued success. You'll have to keep an eye on the markets, track your profits and losses, and adjust your strategy as necessary.
Whether you're looking to dominate a particular market or diversify your portfolio, you'll need to be constantly on the lookout for new opportunities and be ready to act when they arise.

Use power and corruption

And when the going gets tough, you'll need to be willing to use your power and influence to bend the rules in your favor. Whether you're engaging in insider trading, manipulating the market, or using your connections to gain an edge, you'll need to be bold and unafraid to push the boundaries of what's legal if you want to make it to the top.

Be ruthless

But be careful, your opponents will also be doing everything they can to outsmart you. So you'll need to stay one step ahead, be always informed, and make the right decisions at the right time. As you amass wealth and influence, you will be able to engage in corrupt deals and backroom negotiations to gain an unfair advantage over your rivals. But be careful, as these actions will also come with consequences.

With realistic market simulations, engaging gameplay, and endless opportunities for wealth and power, this game will keep you hooked for hours on end. The competition is fierce, but with the right strategy and a bit of luck, you can become the wealthiest hedge fund manager in the world.

2310920.name: THE EDITOR
2310920.about_the_game:
"In 1996, a congressman was murdered...
The prime suspect is a congressman's aide.
As the suspicious article was published
the story begins"

Assume the role of Chief Editor at a newspaper company
As the Chief Editor, you are responsible for writing the daily front-page article.
Decide your approach and choose a headline.
Edit photos to match the title.

Your edits will change the course of the outcome
How you decide to edit the articles will determine the fate

2311140.about_the_game:
“Does the flap of a butterfly’s wings in Brazil set off a tornado in Texas?” –Edward Lorenz, “The Butterfly Effect”

Natural Disaster: A Butterfly’s Guide to Mass Destruction is a slapstick puzzle game with inspiration from point-and-click classics of how one very evil butterfly can bring down an empire. 2311150.name: Wooden Battles: Spec Ops
2311150.about_the_game:
Take control of a group of 4 special forces characters to infiltrate an enemy base without being detected. The group includes the Brute, the Demo, the Spy and the Sniper, each with their own unique set of abilities. The missions require you to avoid enemy patrol, set traps, assassinate enemy generals, and destroy enemy objectives. You will need to use the unique abilities of each of your units in order to achieve this task, stealth is key. Take out the enemies in silences, and hide the bodies to avoid being detected. Use the in-game level editor to create your own custom missions and share them on the Steam Workshop.



The Brute is the leader of the group. His abilities are stealthy knife kills, climbing wooden blocks, pushing small objects around, and constructing obstacles that obscure the enemy field of view.



The Demo specializes in explosives, His abilities are laying a silent trap, throwing firecrackers to distract enemies, placing mines, and placing bombs to destroy mission objectives..



The Spy is the master of disguise. His abilities are stealthy knife kills, disguising himself as the enemy, distracting the enemy, and ordering an enemy to go to a specific area. Watch out though, enemy Generals are able to spot the Spy even in disguise.



The Sniper is all about killing his target from a distance. His abilities are disguising himself as a bush, climbing wooden blocks, sniping enemies from a distance, and using a crossbow for silent kills.



Use the level editor to create your very own custom levels. Place game objects, log cabins, wooden blocks, wooden walls, obstacles, enemy units, friendly units, and define mission objectives. You can set patrol paths for enemies, including the desired waiting times at each node. Share your creations on the Steam Workshop, and see what other users have created.

2311210.name: Line Defense
2311210.about_the_game:
Overwhelmed. Outnumbered. Still standing.

A defensive line is all that stands between you and total collapse—but it won’t hold forever.

Enemies swarm from every direction in relentless waves, and survival depends on one thing: your skill. Dodge through impossible patterns, react in split seconds, and outplay overwhelming odds as the battlefield spirals into chaos.

Line Defense is a high-speed arena survival game where you are always in motion. There are no safe zones, no downtime—just constant pressure, escalating intensity, and the need to adapt or fall.

Survive the Swarm

Face ever-growing waves of enemies that evolve, overwhelm, and force you to think fast. The longer you last, the more intense it becomes.

Master Movement

Every second matters. Dodge, dash, reposition, and weave through danger with precision. Survival isn’t about stats—it’s about execution.

Break the Game with Builds

Stack perks, upgrade abilities, and create powerful synergies each run. Experiment, adapt, and discover combinations that push you beyond the limit.

Play Your Way

Choose from unique characters with distinct mechanics and playstyles that completely change how you approach combat.

Solo or Co-op Chaos

Take on the swarm alone or team up with up to 4 players locally. More players means more chaos—and more to survive.

Push Beyond

Endless scaling difficulty, postgame challenges, and performance-based outcomes ensure no run ever feels the same.

Key Features:

• Fast-paced, skill-driven combat

• Constant movement—no passive play

• Short, intense, replayable runs

• Deep perk and upgrade system

• Multiple unique characters

• Dynamic enemies, bosses, and hazards

• Endless and postgame content

2311530.name: Princess Maker 2 Regeneration
2311530.about_the_game:
To commemorate the 30th anniversary of “Princess Maker 2,” Bliss Brain Co., Ltd. is releasing “Princess Maker 2: Regeneration”.

The “Princess Maker” series pioneered the social simulation genre, allowing the player to act as a father who raises a young girl, and it continues to be popular to this day.
Among the many titles in the series, “Princess Maker 2” is the most popular. This year marks 30 years since the original release of “Princess Maker 2” (PC-9801 ed.) in 1993. In this title, the graphics were newly redrawn by Takami Akai, who directed production and worked on character design for the original “Princess Maker” series at Gainax.

About “Princess Maker 2”

“Princess Maker 2” is a childrearing simulation game in which the player experiences being the father to a daughter granted to them by the stars.
They raise the girl for eight years, from ages ten to eighteen. Your daughter grows up to be an adult through various experiences in the game. The girl’s dream is to become a princess, but a wide variety of opportunities await depending on how you raise her. What kind of dream will you make come true for this girl?

Redrawing the graphics

This title is based on “Princess Maker 2: Refine,” released in 2004. Especially important graphics were redrawn by Takami Akai in a style similar to the PC-98 version. The graphics are drawn in high resolution befitting modern game systems, with a commitment to quality in the details.

Addition of an opening animation

An opening animation by Yonago Gainax has been added to the game. The animation, drawn by a team led by Takami Akai, envisions the future the player will have as the “father” with their “daughter”.

Knowing how your daughter is doing is the first step in raising her

This title is a social simulation, so it is very important to always be aware of your daughter's status and use this to raise her.
In “Regeneration”, parameters for assessing your daughter's status are always available, so you can check on her at a glance. Check what you should do for your daughter’s future, and raise her carefully.

Message from Takami Akai
I am deeply grateful to see that “Princess Maker 2”, which came out 30 years ago, is still so beloved by so many fans that we can release a new version. This time I was finally able to redo the graphics, which I had always wanted to do. Please enjoy the newly redrawn vacations and endings.

2312040.name: L/Right Reflection
2312040.about_the_game:
"L/Right Reflection" is an RPG game in which the main character, who is unable to use offensive sorcery, battles by reflecting enemy attacks.




The player controls Lumis, a girl who is a sorcerer but cannot use offensive sorcery. How will Lumis defeat the enemies even if she can't attack?
The way Lumis defeats the enemies is through reflection sorcery. You can damage the enemy by reflecting the enemy's attack at the right moment.

In the battle, enemy attacks are represented by a skill cursor, which looks like a magic circle. At the center of the battle screen, there is an area called a marker. When the skill cursor is just over the marker, press the button for a successful reflection. The game is designed in the style of a rhythm game, in which the player parries the movement of the skill cursor to move in various ways, such as straight lines, curves, waves, and rotations.

Also, there is not only one button to press but three different buttons. The enemies use three types of attacks: blows, slashes, and magic, so press the button corresponding to each attack to reflect them.

Sorcery
In addition to reflection sorcery, Lumis can also use sorcery to advance the battle. Such as,

  • Reflective damage is reduced but slows down the enemy's attack.
  • Reduces HP by half but increases reflective damage
  • Automatically reflect all enemy attacks for one turn, but reflective damage becomes a little

These consume MP, but many of them have more powerful effects.

Characters
This game uses Live2D, so the characters move vividly in conversation and battle scenes! Especially in conversation scenes, the characters' expressions change in detail, making the story more enjoyable.

Once the Word of the Day has been played, players can enjoy unlimited play in the freeplay mode. This mode offers endless opportunities for players to hone their vocabulary skills and improve their scores.

Image Gallery:

pWordle features a browsable image gallery where players can view the images they have unlocked. With fullscreen, zooming, panning, and slideshow controls, players can enjoy their images in detail and relive their achievements.

Steam Achievements:

pWordle includes Steam achievements for players to unlock as they progress through the game. These achievements offer a sense of accomplishment and provide a reason for players to keep coming back to the game.

Player Stats:

pWordle tracks player stats for both the Word of the Day and Freeplay modes. Players can view their stats to see how they are improving over time and compare their scores with others.

Jukebox:

pWordle allows players to customize their gaming experience with the Jukebox feature. Players can choose which songs are played by toggling them on or off in the options. With the ability to create a personalized playlist, players can enjoy their favorite tunes while they play.

Summary:

pWordle is a fun family friendly word puzzle game with beautiful pictures to unlock. Improving on the original hit game WORDLE with many new innovative features, including language support, virtual keyboard, Word of the Day, freeplay mode, image gallery, Steam achievements, player stats, and jukebox, pWordle offers endless hours of entertainment and the opportunity to improve vocabulary skills. Get ready to put your vocabulary to the test with pWordle!

2312270.name: Collect Call
2312270.about_the_game:
Collect Call is a puzzle platformer game. You might work through the puzzles on your own, or you might talk to other characters to piece together a mystery.

Features


Gameplay

Puzzles gradually introduce new mechanics so you learn at a comfortable pace with intuitive elements, including levers, buttons, physics objects, bridges, and more.

The game also includes a story told through dialogue with other characters and lore hints hidden in the levels. Your dialogue choices do matter.

Steam Deck
Works fine on my Steam Deck. The game runs natively on Linux and Windows, controllers are detected automatically, and it will use 800p by default. My Steam Deck gets about two-thousand fps with vsync and the frame-rate limit turned off.

Graphics & Performance
The game may use pixel art, but there are still graphical options to configure. The game supports most common resolutions all the way up to 8K. You can also toggle v-sync or set a frame rate limit.

Modding & Steam Workshop
Collect Call can play custom levels from the Steam Workshop. Custom levels can include custom dialogue, puzzle elements, graphics, and more. Levels can even be chained in a sequence for a custom campaign just like the included one. Custom levels can also be installed manually.

You will need map editing software to make your own levels. I used Tiled and suggest you do the same, it is free and open-source. You should also format your levels similar to the included ones for compatibility.

2312280.name: 7 Days Blood Moons
2312280.about_the_game:
Embark on an adrenaline-fueled 4v1 survivor (PVP) or go against AI Zombie Master (PVE) experience in 7 Days Blood Moons, published by The Fun Pimps, creators of 7 Days to Die, and developed by iLLOGIKA. The game brings a unique combination of FPS, survival horror, RTS, tower defense and a robust progression system.

Will you become a brave survivor or will you crush all humanity’s hopes?

Game Features

  • Choose: Be one of the brave survivors and fight for what remains of humanity or be the dominating Zombie Hive Master and purge all humanity on earth.

Survivors

As survivors you’ll survive, scavenge, build, progress, craft, and customize to live another day.

  • Survive: Work with other survivors to mow down hordes of zombies, repair your defenses and heal your fallen teammates to last until morning.

  • Scavenge: Search your surroundings for useful building supplies, ammunition and health kits to prepare for the night. Find rare resources to craft, unlock better gear for your next match.

  • Build: Locate and fortify a nearby structure with the resources you scavenged. Lay down traps and bolster your defenses as waves of the undead come for you in this destructible voxel world.

  • Progress: Pick your loadout from a large arsenal of unlockable unique weapons and perks to prepare for your next match.

  • Craft: Get more firepower and hit harder by crafting and unlocking new weapons. Craft and unlock new constructibles to bolster your defenses for your next match.

  • Customize: Pick and choose your unique look from a wide variety of character customization options. Dress your character to show your style choosing unique outfit pieces from a wide variety of clothing options.

Zombie Hive Master

As the Zombie Hive Master, you’ll strategize, command, possess, harvest, and progress in this thrilling genre mash-up.

  • Strategize: From the sky in command view, search and find the survivors' base. Plan where your horde will be summoned from and dominate the field by giving them orders during the bloodmoon.

  • Command: Give orders to your horde to strategize a coordinated attack.

  • Possess: Take possession of zombies in third person to fight the survivors on the field.

  • Harvest: Harvest human remains to unlock new zombie minions to unleash in your next match.

  • Progress: Choose from a wide variety of unlockable zombie archetypes with unique special abilities to help crush the survivors in your next match.

2312340.name: Nyan-Nyan Punch!
2312340.about_the_game:
냥냥펀치(Nyan-Nyan Punch!)는 귀여운 동물귀 소녀들이 공중에서 1대 1 싸움을 벌이는 액션 게임입니다. 언뜻 보면 슈팅 게임처럼 보이지만 펀치를 날려 시원한 근접 공격으로 싸워야 합니다!

시놉시스

자칭 고양이들의 신, '냥신'의 가보인 '냥냥이 볼'이 어느 날 사라지게 됩니다. 게다가 주변에 있던 다른 물건도 하나 둘 사라져버리기까지... 범인의 정체는 누구일까요? 그리고 그 목적은 무엇일까요? 냥냥 펀치를 날리며 사건의 진실을 파헤쳐 봅시다!

게임 설명

모든 전투는 공중에서 진행되며, 플레이어는 방향키를 통해 8방향으로 날아다닐 수 있고 Z혹은 Space로 펀치를 날려 적을 공격할 수 있습니다. 이 때 키를 꾹 누르고 있으면 러시라는 강력한 공격을 충전할 수 있는데, 충전 도중에는 아무것도 할 수 없지만 충전을 완료하고 나면 좀 더 넓은 범위에 연속 공격을 가하게 됩니다.


좌측 상단 위쪽 게이지는 플레이어의 생명력(HP), 아래쪽 게이지는 플레이어의 에너지를 나타냅니다. 에너지는 적을 공격하다 보면 얻게 되고, 에너지를 소모하여 강력한 기술을 사용할 수 있습니다. 에너지를 소모하는 기술들은 보스와 싸워 이기면 획득할 수 있습니다!

게임모드

  • 이지 모드: 초보 플레이어를 위한 게임모드입니다. 플레이어가 조금 더 많은 생명력(HP)을 가지고 시작합니다.
  • 노멀 모드: 일반적인 플레이어를 위한 게임모드입니다.

Original버전은 무료로 즐길 수 있으며 Remake 버전은 더욱 멋진 그래픽과 추가 요소를 즐길 수 있습니다.

2312360.name: THE ABYSS
2312360.about_the_game:
THE ABYSS is a 2D puzzle about descent, in order to pass the levels you need to score a certain number of points and choose the right ways to pass the level.
Someone threw a ball into a tunnel dug to the center of the Earth. But will he be able to get to the end?
Falling into the abyss is a runner with puzzle elements on the configuration, in which you have to control a ball flying down. The goal of the game is to save at least one ball to the finish line and collect all the necessary crystals. There are many dangers waiting for you at the levels, which you must carefully think about in advance. Eventually, get to the center of the Earth!

2312370.name: Bloodcrave
2312370.about_the_game:
A thrilling vampire-themed visual novel, Bloodcrave is a tale of love, corruption, and deceit. Player choices have a drastic impact on the outcome of the game, featuring multiple endings and epilogues for each character. Will you lead your companions down the path of virtue, or will you make them succumb to the lure of darkness?

Alex is a young engineer who is saved by Chloe, a fierce vampire hunter, and discovers that his blood holds a secret that could change the balance of power in a war between vampires and vigilantes. Will he use his newfound strength to help Chloe rid the city of the ruthless blood suckers, or will he succumb to his dark desires and become a force of destruction?

As you plan your actions for each day, you'll discover hidden quests, events, and animated scenes that bring this captivating world to life.

  • ROMANCE: multiple love interests, each with their own unique branching storyline

  • INTRIGUE: an expansive main story with multiple possible different endings

  • LOGISTICS: plan your days carefully, where will you go? who will you spend time with?

  • THEATRICS: fully voice acted scenes which bring the world and characters to life

2312380.name: Steel Racer
2312380.about_the_game:
Steel Racer is a 2D pixelated old school racing game, inspired by classics from the 80s and 90s era, featuring great chiptune music, arcade gameplay style and high speed cars!

Race through 50 different circuits along 5 racing seasons! On each season, you can choose the order of the races you want to compete! Win races and money to improve and customize your car and become a racing legend!

You'll be able to choose between 3 difficulty settings and 3 levels of traction assist, which makes your car easier or harder to control on curves, and make the game as challenging as you would like!

Are you ready to become the "Steel Racer"!?

FEATURES
- 50 different tracks;
- 5 racing seasons featuring different scenarios;
- 2D retro style graphics;
- Different items to buy and improve/customize your car;
- Great chiptune style music;

2312390.name: Ghosts from the House of Flesh
2312390.about_the_game:
Ghosts from the House of Flesh is a horror puzzle game made in 2D pixel art. In the game, you have to collect hidden totems in the forest with ghosts of all kinds.

History:

You play as a man named Dave, who has a terminal illness, but one night he has a dream in which an incomprehensible creature offers help, but whether this help will be without a catch or you will be deceived, you will find out if you experience long nights with ghosts.

Remember forgotten fears ...

2312400.name: Money Maker
2312400.about_the_game: Embark on a journey to build the greatest empire ever known by simply clicking your mouse. Your goal is to amass as much wealth as possible, and you'll do so by starting small and gradually expanding your empire one click at a time.

2312430.name: Makato: Your Fantasy Shop
2312430.about_the_game:
Welcome to Makato! Here you can fulfill your dream of managing your very own shop for adventurers.

Sell goods to earn money, expand your shop, send out your adventurers to get new goods, and combine them to powerful weapons, armors, potions and more. You want to offer a broad spectrum of equipment, tools and other goods to your customers? You want to specialize in selling equipment for powerful warriors? No problem! It's your shop and your choice how you want to run it.

Build the shop of your dreams


You're the owner so you decide how your shop should look. Add more shelves and tables to place more goods. Design a room for each category of goods. Decorate the shop to attract more customers.

Expand your shop


You ran out of space? You want to display more goods at once? No problem! Just expand your shop and acquire more space. The city Thorek has enough space so go and earn enough money and expand your shop.


Hire craftsmen to create high quality goods


You don't have to make all by yourself. Get some help from the local folks and hire them. You'd be surprised how many specialists live in Thorek. Build them a place where they can perform their crafts, and tell them what you need.

2312450.name: Slime Slayer
2312450.about_the_game:
Slime Slayer is an action-packed roguelite where you exterminate EVERY LAST SLIME! Craft unique character builds in every run with compounding modifier runes.

Features

  • 7 Base Abilities, each with 5 Elemental Variants Create your spells with a base and element! Fireball? LightningBall? Ice Meteor? Void Meteor? Build your spell how you want it!  

  • Pick Your Element: Every spell can be evolved with every element, and every element is mechanically distinct! Learn the strengths and weaknesses of each element and how to best combo them to craft a slime-killing machine!

  • Build Your Spells: All modifier runes can apply to all skills, and each rune compounds in a way where sequence matters. Learning how different runes build off of each other allows you to create unique and incredibly deadly combinations to slay even the most powerful slimes!

  • 11 Unique slimes, and 7 different bosses Traverse between the Forest, Desert, Crystal Caves, Floating Isles, Arctic, Volcano, and Void Zones to encounter unique slimes and bosses! Each Combat room can RuneCharged and HeartCharged, empowering all slimes inside. The more powerful the enemies in a room, the greater the reward! 

  • Relics: Take your build to the next level with distinct Relics! Relics are non-stacking unique global modifiers that empower your builds, giving you new paths to power with every run!

  • Multiple Gameplay Difficulties: Up for the challenge? Test your skills in making the strongest build you can in Hard mode or Hell mode! Then test your build's power in the Gauntlet!

2312490.name: Beaming Stingray
2312490.about_the_game:
Beaming Stingray is an approachable and fluid shoot 'em up about time and aging. Soraya's life hangs in the balance following a reckless act of revenge. Can she find peace with the time she has left?

FIGHT ALONGSIDE YOURSELF

Fill Soraya's TimeStone by absorbing green time-bullets and play alongside past versions of yourself. Double up on a shielded enemy to expose a weak point or dance together with your time ghost to rack up combos that would be impossible in linear time. With forward-thinking strategy, many ghosts can be stacked for truly dizzying action. Exploiting the possibilities of the TimeStone is key to your success and your survival.

BRAIN-BENDING ACTION

Face complex, puzzle-like bosses and string together three enemies of the same color/symbol to net a score-amplifying COMBO. Maintaining a COMBO throughout an entire level requires multiple play sessions, thoughtful strategy, and multi-ghost coordination.

FLY WITH POWER AND GRACE

Dash and back blast between walls of bullets as you take out waves of tanks and war machines. The little Deity you fly has a unique move set that enables creativity and rapid-fire damage dealing. Shooting at point-blank range does double damage and ending a combo with a back blast will net you a COMBO+ for extra points and a TimeStone boost.

SAVE THE ANIMALS

The Raeshah Revolutionary Army (RRA) has captured many of the mystical creatures in the land. Find a way to free them and they might just return the favor. Saving all of the animals unlocks a secret level and minigame inside of Soraya's mind...

2312500.name: Hidden World 3 Top-Down 3D
2312500.about_the_game:
Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

The game is a Hidden Object Game.
In which you need to find objects with a certain design in beautiful locations, and click on them with the mouse.


The game is a 3D level game in which objects and characters are frozen in the picture, you have to find 20 different objects. The system automatically determines which object you need to find at the moment, so the game has a high replay value, you will need to search for different objects each time.

2312520.name: Everholm
2312520.about_the_game:
Lilly is searching for her lost sister, Melanie. During her search, she happens upon a magical portal that lures her into Everholm: a cute, cozy little island where everyone seems to recognize her. Gathering her wits, she sets out to uncover the mysteries of this little slice of heaven, with the help of a local witch...

Everholm is an open-ended role playing game, focusing less on punching your way through the island's wildlife, and more on interpersonal relationships. Meet the residents of Everholm, gain their trust, and figure out why they're stuck with her on this enigmatic island.

Everholm isn't just about talking to the locals - it's about living together, learning new skills, and making the most of this cute little island. Lilly will have to learn how to farm crops, forage for supplies, do some fishing, raise livestock, and more. Turn a little run-down homestead into a cozy and well-kept place to truly call home.

However, Everholm isn't all sunshine and flowers - the island has many secrets which need to be pried open by force or finesse accordingly. Delve into procedurally generated dungeons to fight monsters that lurk underground, requiring powerful weapons and spells to survive. Delve deep enough into the dangerous caverns, and Lilly might just be rewarded with rare materials to bring topside…

There is always more to Everholm than meets the eye. As Lilly bonds with others, discover each of their hidden secrets. But before that, they need to trust Lilly, which may be more difficult for some over others. Help others or choose to ignore them and enjoy the cozy atmosphere and non-linear story as you prefer! Unlock new pieces to the puzzle of where Lilly’s sister is and how to bring her home.

- QQ official group: 875458679

2312560.name: Dragons Heart
2312560.about_the_game:
Dragons Heart is a visual novel RPG hybrid. It’s primarily focused on telling its story and uses varied gameplay to reinforce its themes. There is a calendar system where you have a set amount of actions you can perform each day. As you do activities like fishing, decorating the town, and befriending new people time will progress, which means the story will pull you along for the ride!


In Arcadia, there exists a strong hatred between two species. Humans and Dragons. At the highest point of tension between the two one-man, knight, and a father named Ronin tries to protect the Dragons from a one-sided setup that will lead to mass extinction. To stop Ronin his friend and fellow knight betrays and kills him. Ronin is branded a traitor to the public, and the truth of his death remains a secret. Ronin’s family, a wife, baby son, and kid daughter, leave their home to escape the daily harassment.

14 years later, that same baby son, Zale, now a teenager has stumbled upon one of the last Dragons left. She entrusts Zale with her power. It allows Zale to peer into other people’s hearts and live, feel, and understand their trauma. Zale and his sister decide they should use this power to help people who are in trouble, misunderstood, and even the same types of people who called their father a traitor. To them, the only way to do that is to do what their father did and become knights. Unknowing to them following under the very man who killed their father. Will Zale and his sister be able to change society for the better, or will they end up like their father? 


You’ll play as Zale as he tries to connect with people. You’ll do this by helping them with favors like planting flowers, hide & seek, delivering love letters, and much more! There will be times when you’ll need to be a good listener and empathize and other times need to be honest with the person. The most optimistic people tell uncomfortable truths because they believe people can change. So don’t conflate being blunt with pessimism. Just be gentle and empathetic with others and try to tell them what they need to hear. 

 Along with helping the townsfolk, Zale will attend the Knight Academy, where he will learn how to use a sword and use elemental magic. He’s told that monsters are the greatest threat to humanity, but is that really the whole truth? Monsters, just like the humans in the game have problems of their own so when you engage in combat, you’ll have to save the monsters or give in to the knights and do what you’re told. Just remember that your actions have consequences and that bad actions can lead to a day when you’ll wake up and not recognize the person you’ve become.


-A village hub world to meet new people and participate in activities that build your ties to the town.
-20 distinct favors. Favors are opportunities to help people sort out their trauma by helping them by star gazing with them, helping cook for their restaurant, or helping them sell the inventions they make.
-A point-based time system. Meaning time doesn't progress until you decide how you want to spend it!
-A battle system where you can either help your opponent or fight them. The battle system is turn-based with elemental-based attacks. The battle system also incorporates timing, button mashing, and pressing the correct keys at the right moment.
-A story that was written first and was over 300,000 words that have now been adapted into game form with very appealing illustrations of the character faces and scenes.
-Your actions are all tracked and everything matters.

2312580.name: Cyber Souls
2312580.about_the_game:
-Turn-based tactical game, will require you to combine a lot of game moments - an attack card, the position of the hero on the playing field, the morality of the hero - everything matters.
-Immerse yourself in the world of dark and brutal sci-fi.
-Death is not the end. Try again to achieve perfection.
-Unlock new heroes, cards, skills and more.
-Upgrade cards to build what you think is the best deck to destroy the dark emperor.
-An important role is played not only by the deck, but by the place where the card is used - each position gives its own bonus.
-At any time, you can resort to blood sacrifice, but be careful - the bonus from it can bring very painful consequences.
-The morale system will allow you to more successfully use your deck or, on the contrary, will greatly complicate its use.
2312580.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese

2312620.name: The Devil lives down here
2312620.about_the_game:
What is it about?

A linear visual novel about cold-blooded demons showing an apathetic girl how people can be interesting.
Vicky is just a self-centered girl who was spending a few days at her boring grandmother's house when she ended up in the wrong place at the wrong time, talking to the wrong person... Or at least that's what she thinks. But for now, she has to prevent the Devil from being released.

Gameplay

In "The Devil Lives Down Here," you must interact with demons and solve small puzzles on each floor by moving pieces and interacting with their figures. You won't be able to tell what Vicky or the demons are thinking, but you can guess based on their expressions and iconography above their heads to try to figure out what plan Vicky is trying to execute to get out of this situation.

Features

  • Monochromatic dark atmosphere
  • 13 different demons
  • Optional auto mode for continuing dialogues

Add to your wishlist!

2312730.name: Ballistic - The story of Marble and the Energy core
2312730.about_the_game:
TEST A PREVIEW OF 30 FIRST LEVELS OF BALLISTIC ON ANDROID AND IPHONE!

and support the development of more levels & more robots!

2312830.name: SoundTown
2312830.about_the_game:
An accessible one-button music game for children with complex needs.

Born out of my PhD research at the Glasgow School of Art, SoundTown is a game designed for - and with - children and young people with complex physical and cognitive needs.

The initial brief for SoundTown was developed through consultations with several appropriate organisations, including schools and charities with knowledge of accessible play. Built in the Unity game engine and powered by the Wwise audio engine, SoundTown consists of six minigames that are accessed directly through the Main Menu.

Players interact with SoundTown using a maximum of two buttons or switches. One button navigates the menus, whilst the other is used to select a minigame or play. Thus, SoundTown is explicitly accessible to players only capable of interaction with a single input device such as a switch, foot pedal, or the Xbox Adaptive Controller.

SoundTown is completely free to play and always will be. A huge thank you to:
- Menphys
- Birkett House School
- Kinnaird Primary School
- Hazelwood School

Created by Alexander Horowitz, with artwork by Carol Studzinski, and voiceover by Susannah Horowitz.

2313160.name: Hodgepodge Hunch
2313160.about_the_game:
Hodgepodge Hunch features a new kind of gameplay in which you'll cook up ingredients you've collected all while conversing with other characters to find out just who the traitor is. Up to four players can join in at a time, but if you're short on players, never fret—you'll be joined by trusty (or not-so-trusty) CPUs. No need to worry about how many players you've assembled, unlike board games. You're sure to enjoy this who-done-it game either way.

Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry... Find out who it is while making the dish of your dreams!

Game Rules:
Players are divided into one of two groups: the Staff and the Spies. Each group works to fulfill certain conditions to win. The Staff’s goal is to cook a delicious hotpot, venturing into dungeons to collect ingredients and charms that, when combined, have the potential to generate high scores. Staff can also “ban” other players to protect the final product, reducing the number of ingredients they can put into the pot. The Spy’s job is to thwart the Staff’s efforts. Certain ingredients are forbidden from the pot, or else the dish will transform into a dreaded Hodgepodge. The Spy’s goal is to sneak these forbidden ingredients into the pot without raising suspicion from the Staff. The Spy can also spread false rumors to make the Staff suspicious of each other.

CPUs and Solo Mode:
Hodgepodge Hunch features CPUs that can join in the game, so no need to worry about having enough players—an all-too-common issue with who-done-it games. CPUs even appear in the Tutorials and Solo Mode, allowing those new to the genre to practice by themselves at their own pace.

Plot:
After an unexpected turn of events, former hero Cocotte changes occupations and finds himself working at a hotpot shop, vying for victory in the Hotpot Contest—a festival where participants flaunt their hotpot-preparation prowess. However, when honing his cooking skills alongside his fellow staff, Cocotte discovers that their precious hotpot has been transformed into a dreaded Hodgepodge.

Could there be a traitor among them…?

The Staff members grow suspicious of one another, but their shop is simultaneously invaded by demons, stalkers, and all sorts of assassins.

Is there truly a Spy? If so, then who? And more importantly—can they still win the Hotpot Contest?!

2313210.name: SpiderAttack
2313210.about_the_game: SpiderAttack, vous êtes une araignée qui doit capturer des insectes pour se nourrir, le but du jeu avec votre toile que vous tissez et de rapprocher au maximum les insectes de leur toile colorée respective afin qu'elle soit capturée, jeux 2D, 23 niveaux avec différents environnements.

2313220.name: Never Forgotten
2313220.about_the_game:
You are a lone soul who awakes in an abandoned world enveloped in flesh. As you explore, you will discover forgotten structures, abominable creatures, and fragments of your past, all twisted by the darkness now consuming the land. Your journey will be wrought with conflict, strife, and pain; you must keep going, in spite of it all.

Explore large atmospheric levels, avert enemies, cling to your resources, and solve puzzles to make your way through this world.



Fight your enemies when you can no longer run. Time your attacks to maximise damage output, and dodge enemy attacks to cling to your ever wavering vitality.



This world will wear you down the longer you persist in it; you must keep going, in spite of it all. You know there’s another way – there has to be.

-Please be aware that Never Forgotten contains several brief instances of flashing lights-
