2313260.name: The Fog
2313260.about_the_game:
Out of the fog, zombies, aliens, ghosts, monsters and many other creatures are trying to eat you. Shoot them with your pistols! Power up after every wave! Don't die! Made with the Godot Engine.

How to survive:

• Defend yourself from zombies,
• Power ups your weapons after every wave,
• Defend yourself from ghosts,
• Use the in game power ups to trigger bombs, collect health, push enemies back and more,
• Defend yourself from trolls,
• Collect as many Fog Points as possible,
• Defend yourself from monsters.

2313270.name: Blightlands Blacksmith
2313270.about_the_game:
Features

  • Follow a fantasy smithing process from mining to rune-crafting, with every step affecting the appearance, quality, damage, and value of your weapons.
  • Explore a vast abandoned mine loaded with materials, enemies, and lore.
  • Drive the progress of the cohort (and game) by supplying weapons for scouting and battle.
  • Sell weapons to adventurers by matching your weapons to discovered locations and adventurer class.
  • Navigate the world in first person.

Forge the weapons you need

Enjoy the process of crafting mighty weapons with your own two hands. Smelting, forging, assembling, grinding, and rune-carving will all determine who will buy them, what they're worth, and what they're capable of slaying.

Use your weapons, don't just sell them

Fight your way through excavations overrun by enemies, and battle the evil that turned a mining province into the Blightlands. Strafe, combo, block, always remembering you need the right weapon for the job.

Design weapons from daggers to war-hammers

Choose from 8 classes of weapon, with thousands of possible variations of shape alone. Different materials alter durability and damage, and alloys can be made from any mined metal. Craft smaller scouting weapons to allow the legion to discover new locations, or larger weapons to enable the cohort to progress through the Blightlands.

Explore and gather

Seek out and find the materials you need in a vast abandoned mine. Use your trusty cart to store your ore, tools, weapons, and light as you navigate through the twisting tunnels.

Live life in the legion camp

Interact with the cohort, your fellow shop-keepers, and adventurers as you conduct your business in the civilian area of the camp. Trade with the cutler and quartermaster, gather rumors or seek healing at the tavern, and track your progress at the Banner Office.

2313330.name: TerraTech Worlds
2313330.about_the_game:
TerraTech Worlds is an open-world, build-craft exploration adventure game, set on an uncharted alien world. Playing solo or with friends, you’ll explore your surroundings, craft unique vehicles, construct automated bases, and battle your way through natural hazards and challenging enemies to harness the power of your environment.

CRAFT & AUTOMATE

Expand your base with complex, automated production lines to refine minerals, scrap spare parts and keep you stocked with ammunition. Design intricate conduit networks to manage production, and scale up your power infrastructure to keep pace as the factory grows.

CREATE & CUSTOMISE

Create different Techs to meet different needs. From mining to combat, you can build the perfect vehicle for the mission! Visually customise your Techs and bases until everything is just to your liking, then optimise your Tech by taking advantage of powerful stat modifiers.

MINE & TERRAFORM

Expand and consolidate your planetary infrastructure by extracting exotic resources from the world around you. Resculpt the landscape to suit your needs with free-form terraforming tools - from flattening out a racetrack to creating peaks and valleys for base defence!

EXPLORE & DISCOVER

Explore a 300km² planet with no loading, no streaming and no limits, populated by rich and diverse environment biomes, with a day/night cycle, dynamic weather, dangerous plant life, hostile enemy factions and bases, and more. Venture deep into strange Woodlands, traverse the acidic Swamps, dodge lightning storms and enter the snowy Arctic.

COMBAT & DEFENSE

Encounter and overcome a diverse range of enemy Techs as you expand your territory, scavenging and researching new blocks to upgrade your combat capability. Face down dangerous opponents, experiment with ever-more powerful and specialised combat builds, and team up with your fellow Prospectors to raid enemy bases and push back the frontier.
2313330.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Russian

2313380.name: Vicious Red
2313380.about_the_game:
Vicious Red unfolds on a sprawling space station in a near alternative past. After losing the moon race, the Soviet Union makes a fateful decision to focus on developing space shuttle technology. Thanks to engineering breakthroughs, they manage to build ships capable of delivering humans to another planet.

However, a disaster of unknown origin has struck an alien space station, transforming nearly all of its inhabitants into hostile mutants. You step into the role of an engineer, arriving during a new wave of colonization. To survive, you must uncover the truth behind the outbreak and deal with its terrifying aftermath.

The game will feature Soviet brutalism, constructivism, and Soviet space futurism as its primary styles and aesthetics. Puzzles are based on pseudo-scientific realistic engineering, mechanical, chemical, or electrical tasks, designed to feel like real challenges on a space station.

Vicious Red is a third-person survival horror game that stays true to the genre's best traditions. Enemies will haunt your every step, and survival here depends on you... Looking for a realistic horror experience? Welcome to Vicious Red!

2313420.name: Jewel Match Aquascapes Collector's Edition
2313420.about_the_game:
Dive into a wondrous Match-3 undersea world and let the cares of life drift away! Make matches across sprawling coral reef levels, and collect sparkling treasures to restore magnificent maritime mansions to their erstwhile splendor.

Plunge into a spellbinding deep-sea world. Solve mind-bending puzzle challenges with spot the difference scenes and jigsaw puzzles to gather resources. Visit the shop and equip yourself with helpful power-ups as you delve into the fascinating ocean.

Discover tons of new game play elements like submarines, walls, conveyor belts, octopuses, and more! Savor a delightful, relaxing soundtrack while you explore the vast match-3 levels! Your undersea adventure awaits in Jewel Match Aquascapes!

Features
- Explore 220 huge levels!
- 72 additional bonus levels with new game features!
- 3 different play modes: timed, relaxed, and limited moves!
- 3 difficulty settings: normal, advanced and insane.
- Buy dozens of upgrades and power-ups from the shop.
- Replayable mini-games, including jigsaw puzzles and spot the difference scenes.
- Stunning wallpapers.
- Ethereal soundtrack.

2313440.name: Demonslayer AKA Me
2313440.about_the_game:
Demonslayer AKA Me offers a fresh take on the cultivation journey, seamlessly blending the sprawling adventures of a mystical immortal world with the fast-paced action of a classic scrolling shooter. Engage in thrilling aerial combat as you command your squads, switching members in real-time to adapt to every challenge that lies ahead.

A Living World of Cultivation

Discover a richly woven cultivation realm, featuring twelve illustrious sects, three grand capitals, twenty-five vibrant towns, and ten mysterious islands. Every location is brimming with untold stories and formidable challenges, awaiting those who dare to explore.

Forge Your Own Path

Craft a cultivator like no other with 32 distinct Spirit Bodies, 10 foundational Spirit Roots, and countless combinations of innate traits and heavenly Destinies. Master the ten elemental arts—Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Lightning, Wind, Ice, Light, and Shadow—as you explore over 500 Heart Sutras and Mystical Techniques. Arm yourself with more than 300 legendary Artifacts and Treasures, steadily ascending toward the heights of immortality.

Classic Aerial Combat

Relive the thrill of classic side-scrolling and vertical shooter battles. Whether defending your abode against intruders or engaging in high-stakes duels, each mode challenges your skill, strategy, and reflexes.

The Cultivator's Way of Life

Immerse yourself in a world of boundless cultivation possibilities. Refine elixirs, forge treasures, weave arrange formations, and inscribe powerful talismans. Tend spiritual fields, gather rare resources, and trade your spoils at auctions, in black markets, or in games of chance. Design your personal Immortal Abode, complete with spirit springs, celestial fields, meditation chambers, and alchemy halls—a sanctuary to further your path toward enlightenment.

2313490.name: Whisper
2313490.about_the_game:
Step into the Shadows


Enter the haunting halls of Whisper Manor, where the boundaries between past and present blur in a tale of unspeakable horror and hidden secrets. As a seasoned investigator, you are drawn to this cursed mansion by its dark reputation, but what lies within its walls is far beyond anything you could ever imagine.

Explore the eerie rooms, uncover long-buried truths, and follow the whispers of the lost as you unravel a chilling story of tragedy and terror. Every corner of this mansion hides a secret, every shadow conceals a lurking threat. But be warned—the deeper you delve, the closer you come to awakening the malevolence that festers within.

Can you survive the whispers that echo through the night?

An Immersive Horror Experience


With intense gameplay and a gripping narrative, Whisper offers a horror experience that will keep you on edge from start to finish. Solve intricate puzzles, confront terrifying entities, and brave the unknown in this atmospheric first-person horror game.

Are you ready to unveil the dark secrets that Whisper Manor has kept hidden for so long?

2313530.name: Poly Jigsaw: Cats
2313530.about_the_game:
Poly Jigsaw: Cats is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game, with a cute kitty.

Featuring 50 hand drawn images in a polygonal style, with each puzzle piece uniquely shaped in a way no physical puzzle could be.
The player's goal - puzzle pieces together to get a beautiful picture.

In Poly Jigsaw: Cats:

- 50 levels
- Polygonal art
- Simple controls (mouse)
- Achievements
- Relax music

2313560.name: ArrowMongers
2313560.about_the_game:
ArrowMongers is a top-down, pixel art, 2D shooter roguelite!... Or actually more than that!?

The Combat

Fast-paced, ammoless, arrow-spamming action! With dozens of arrow types available to choose from. Analyze the situation, and choose the best-suited arrow against the enemy you're facing.

Roguelite

Become the best archer in the village by fighting your way through a procedually generated dungeon filled with enemies and bosses, while using and mastering tons of different arrows you acquire through your journey

Colosseum

But that's not all! Conquer the 100-floors village's colosseum and put on a show to get the crowd fired up!

But What Is Arrowmongers

Nestled in the heart of the forest, there lies a village called ArrowMongers, where the residents are passionate about bows and arrows!
Exploring the dungeon has become everyone's favorite hobby, and colosseum fights are the national sport!

2313570.name: Rhya's Crusade: The Aradia's Reavers
2313570.about_the_game:
Rhya's Crusade: The Aradia's Reavers, is an action-packed game with the soul of a Run & Gun classic featuring NES/Famicom palette and resolution with modern physics simulation and dynamic lightning making a frenetic mix made for players who love retro classics with a naughty side.

This game is for adult audiences who enjoy Hentai and challenging gameplay, throughout the levels, Rhya's clothes tear apart as she takes damage, being exposed to lewd enemy glares. Stopping the plans of the sex-crazed Reavers could be a dangerous task.

You will play as Rhya, a military-trained archaeologist who seeks to stop the Demon Princess Aradia's ambition to control the galaxy . Equipped with the most advanced technology and the most powerful weapons, you will face the ruthless army of the little demon.

Find the hidden beacons and destroy it to obtain hidden tapes containing Hentai CG's featuring various characters and story in the Rhya's Crusade universe.

  • 6 levels, 7 bosses with a animated H-Scene each.

  • 28+ collectible static H-Scenes hidden in the levels.

  • 8 Different Weapon Modules to ease Rhya's mission.

  • Chiptune music and sounds to match the retro feeling of the game.

  • A piece of lore in every scenes and dialogue if you want to know more about Rhya's universe.

  • COMING SOON: Score and Time challenges to unlock more collectibles, scenes, etc.

2313590.name: Broken Blade: Airgetlam
2313590.about_the_game:
Broken Blade: Airgetlam(아르게틀람)은 판타지풍의 시뮬레이션 롤플레잉 게임입니다. 당신은 세계의 운명을 지켜보는 '관찰자'가 되어, 제국의 황녀였던 카모밀레와 그 동료들의 앞을 막아서는 시련을 헤쳐나가기 위해 함께 노력해야 합니다.

인간과 마물이 공존하고 있는 '미드젤'.

대륙의 서쪽으로는, 세계수가 자리잡고 있는 인간들을 위한 나라 '크바지르 제국'. 그 반대편에는 여러 종족의 마물이 연합해, 크바지르에 대항하기 위해 세워진 '에이레 왕국'이 존속해 왔다.

하지만, 크바지르 제국의 황제이자 인간과 마물 사이의 불신을 해결하고자 한 황제, '시그몬드'가 시해당한 뒤, 미드젤과 한 소녀의 운명은 크게 뒤바뀌게 된다.

  • 화려한 일러스트와 복고풍 픽셀아트
    다양한 캐릭터 일러스트와 화려한 전투 애니메이션과 함께 Broken Blade: Airgetlam을 즐겨보세요.

  • 기본적인 재미에 충실한 시스템
    SRPG의 기본 요소인 전략과 육성에 중점을 두어, 각 캐릭터마다 준비된 다양한 기술을 스킬트리 시스템을 이용해 플레이어 입맛대로 고를 수 있습니다. 동료와의 대화를 통해 파티원들과의 유대를 쌓아 나갈 수도 있습니다.

  • 캐주얼 롤플레잉 게임 지향
    Broken Blade는 캐주얼 롤플레잉 게임을 지향합니다. 다른 SRPG에 비해 난이도가 낮은 편이기에, SRPG 장르를 처음 접하시는 분들에게 추천드립니다. 물론, 코어 유저분들을 위한 숙련자(HARD) 모드도 준비되어 있습니다!

2313600.name: Shot Supreme
2313600.about_the_game:
Shot Supreme is an arcade basketball game inspired by incremental games. Like a clicker, but you have to score baskets.

Score Points

Sink baskets to score points

Complete Missions

Earn upgrade points by completing goals

Buy Upgrades

Use your points to upgrade your abilities

Unlock Special Balls

Unlock special balls to earn even more points

Rinse and Repeat

Complete every goal and max out all your abilities to earn a huge score!

2313630.name: MITTIN
2313630.about_the_game:
The Michigan Transition To Independence (MITTIN) is a virtual life skills library of dynamic modules that foster the development of independent living skills in the home and community. Designed to support special education transition-related instruction, these virtual resources are free and available to parents, schools, educators, and students in Michigan. MITTIN is a partnership of the Michigan Association of Administrators of Special Education (MAASE), Michigan Council for Exceptional Children (MCEC), Great Lakes Reality Labs (GLRL), and Public Policy Associates (PPA).

The topics covered in this game include:

Safety and Independence in the Home
  • Change a Light Bulb
  • Clean the Bedroom
  • Put Away Groceries
  • Use a Microwave
  • Use an Oven
  • Use a Stove

Safety and Independence in the Community
  • Cross the Street
  • Shop for Groceries
  • Use Self-Checkout
  • Walk Through a Parking Lot

2313660.name: Milo no Senki 3
2313660.about_the_game:
On the continent of Athermyl, stricken by war and disease, Lord Milo embarks on an adventure to Hell to bring back his departed friend, Prince Nelson, who lost his life during the conflicts. In his quest, he will face the mightiest empires who have ruled on the surface, will have to overcome his fate, find a so-called Scepter of Thug, and play neither-yes-nor-no. A comedical tale carried by a bunch of misfits, obstinate to brave the highest of dangers!



Milo no Senki 3 is a simplified turn-based tactical-RPG, where you attack in one click! Position your companions to counter the adversary army and lead Milo to victory throught the numerous battles that stands between you and your friend.





  • Take advantage of the different unit types and their role on the battlefield to turn the odds in your favour, but be cautious as your ennemies will use those same tools!
  • Navigate Hell, and surprise your opponent or discover new allies!
  • Do not fear losing! Down here, falling in battle and coming back to life with your past experience is as common as breathing.





Dive down in the Great Athermylian Civil War in the Free Expansion! The remake of the original Milo no Senki will let you experience the events that propulsed Milo into the fray of a continent in disarray.

Do I need to play the previous games in the serie before starting Milo no Senki 3?

Absolutely not, Milo no Senki 3 was designed with new players in mind, who don't necessarily have previous experience with its world.

2313670.name: Drake's Dungeon
2313670.about_the_game:
Drake's Dungeon is an adult, roguelite survival game. Your job is to eliminate hordes of monsters by shooting them down or destroying them with spells. Pick your class, then create unique builds with different items and spells on every run. Buy class upgrades to unlock new story and adult artwork.

Game features
  • 3 Dungeons
  • Upgradeable Characters Classes
  • Various Spells and Items
  • Rich Story 130k+ Words
  • 25+ Adult scenes
  • Optional Voiceover DLC

The Story

The story transpires in the notorious dungeon, Labyrinthe. Part tavern, part brothel, Labyrinthe is a venue for the seedy demon world to come together and revel in their own debauchery.

Owned and empowered by the nefarious imp, Luro, the dungeon itself is partly alive. Labyrinthe hears your thoughts and desires… Its walls shift and its rooms reform to suit your needs. Needless to say, the cocky, dick-dragging Drake has spent many a night plundering its depths.

But now, a strange, malevolent power has begun to seep through its stony walls. The black poison is infecting the dungeon's demonic patrons, wiping their minds and amplifying their savage natures, turning them away from debauchery to brutality.

Luro is all for a little chaos, but chaos he can control... Unable to contend with these violent mutations, he enlists Drake as his personal bodyguard to see him safely into the depths of the dungeon to find the source of the infectious evil.

Of course, Luro has his own designs for his muscular companion... He may be trying to stop a murderous, demonic outbreak, but why not have a little fun along the way? He will ensure his handsome bodyguard gets worked to the fullest extent of his ability.

Drake's Dungeon features guest appearances by Deimos (Class Comics) and Derek (Crown’s Reverie) alongside new and familiar faces. Each hunk will find themselves getting entangled in Luro’s schemes. Between the imp’s lusty manipulations and the dungeon’s potent danger, how will any of these brave hunks ever make it out on top?

2313680.name: A Quest to Be The Best
2313680.about_the_game: "A Quest to Be the Best" is an auto battler where players create their own characters to compete against others all around the world. In this strategy-focused game, you'll select your character's stats, and gear. Battles are automated, relying on your strategic planning rather than real-time control. As you win fights, your character gains boons, allowing for skill and stat upgrades. The game features a competitive leaderboard and a loot system, rewarding you with powerful items for your victories. The ultimate aim is to climb the ranks, continually enhancing your character, striving to become the most formidable competitor in the game's universe. Each playthrough is unique, offering endless possibilities and high replay value. See if you can be the best.

2313700.name: Constance
2313700.about_the_game:
Become Paint

Utilize paint-based mechanics to experience a constant state of flow—dive into the ground and walls, slice through the air and enemies!

Wield Your Brush

Become stronger by unlocking new techniques with your brush that aid you in defeating threatening foes, overcoming platform challenges, solving complex puzzles, and advancing your progress.

Discover Yourself

Explore Constance's non-linear interconnected world and discover countless secrets, abilities, upgrades, characters, side quests, and inspiring moments.

Strive for Balance

Using your brush techniques will corrupt your Paint. If you become fully corrupted, negative effects await you, so be wary!

Get Inspired

Use inspirations that you find on your travels to sketch in your journal. Your sketches enhance and customize Constance's capabilities. By gathering materials, you can upgrade your sketches into even stronger artworks.

Department of Works: Upgrade the promotion efforts, expand the prize pool capacity, and increase physical benefits.

2314330.name: A Bard's Last Song
2314330.about_the_game:
In "The Bard's Last Song", players take on the roles of three unlikely heroes - Maggie the Mage, Kelly the Knight, and Anwir the Rogue - as they embark on a journey to unite their shattered land. The game begins with Maggie and her father figure, the Bard, on a fateful hike up a mountain. The Bard's sudden death leads to the scattering of his pages across the land, and the trio must recover them in order to restore balance to their world. Each character faces their own unique challenges and enemies as they make their way through twisting forests, dark dungeons, and ruined castles.

Along the way, players will engage in epic battles, solve puzzles, and explore a richly-detailed, hand-drawn world filled with bizarre creatures and hidden secrets. With fast-paced combat, challenging platforming, and a deep, emotionally resonant story, "The Bard's Last Song" is an unforgettable adventure that will keep players hooked until the very end.

2314350.name: Xurb
2314350.about_the_game:
XURB throws you into headfirst into an abandoned American suburbia. Society has collapsed, leaving those who remain to fight over what's left. Become a hardened survivor, navigate the desolate remains of once-familiar streets and kill or be killed by those who remain there with you.

Raid

You find yourself stranded in a deserted suburban neighborhood: doors are haphazardly thrown open and burning cars block the streets. Any few remaining civilians are thrown into a panic, with the more fortunate survivors quickly converging into hostile factions. You have little time, and with the permadeath format of this game the stakes are high.

Find whatever you can to defend yourself. If you are fortunate, you may find a handgun left behind by a more-prepared citizen. Be prepared for a shoot out with whoever you encounter, if you manage to survive their loot is yours.

This may work for a while, but with factions gaining strength, you will need heavier artillery to defend yourself and any of your companions. You heard that there is military bunker nearby, but this area would certainly be very heavily defended…

Loot

Find the supplies you need in the otherwise vacant houses. At first survival is your main concern: food, clothing, bandages and medication. Next you'll need protection, find a weapon and body armor defend to yourself, or at least stay alive a little longer.

Getting around on foot is holding you back, but finding a vehicle in working condition won't be easy. Instead, find the tools and parts to repair a car that won't start, it will have to do for now.

Extract

It's getting dark now, you need to rest but it isn't safe here. You know of a quiet spot in the forest, right outside of town. Nobody should be able to find you here. You can rest for a bit, as long as you have the resources to stay alive. Bring your food, weapons, and other resources to your camp; you will need them in the coming days.

While you’re in camp you rest, restore your energy with some food, and bandage your wounds. Keep items you aren’t using in the raid safe in storage, while you outfit yourself with only the things you need for another venture into the dangerous areas near town.

Recruit

As your stash grows, you know that what you need to survive may no longer be more weapons, but more hands to use them. Some survivors have managed to go unnoticed by the factions, but they will need your help to keep it that way. Find people you can trust, and bring them back to the safety of your camp.

Your new companions count on you for shelter, food, and protection, but they are willing to help! Some can take care of camp chores, while others are skilled with a weapon. Finally, people to have your back: the factions won’t be able to have all the control much longer.

Rebuild

The initial shock of the falling-out has passed, and it is becoming clear that you will need a long-term survival plan. You have room to grow your camp: establish food plots for growing vegetables, build additional shelters to house survivors, and use resources salvaged in raids to fabricate materials and equipment that you need to keep your camp alive.

You're in charge. As the group leader, you delegate tasks to members of your camp and organize resources to keep your new society running as long as possible.

2314380.name: Billie Eternal and the Jetcats in... Escape from the Black Hole!
2314380.about_the_game:
​Billie Eternal and the Jetcats in... Escape from the Black Hole! is a video game/album from Sydney surf rock band Billie Eternal. It's a remix of the classics from the 80s and 90s, from Commander Keen and Raptor: Call of the Shadows to California Surf and Donkey Kong.

When black hole monsters come to suck the light out of the Earth's kids, little Billie Blazer knows what he has to do! Blow those mothermonsters up with the only way he knows how - blast off into space on a wild adventure to find himself a shit hot rock 'n' roll band.

Relentlessly fun with a bumping soundtrack to boot, come save the world with Billie and jam along to some hot new rock 'n' roll bangers from Down Under.



Contains 6 levels based on classic games from the 80s, 90s and now!
- Collect music gear and blast monsters with a laser gun in a platformer, climb ladders, slide under enemies and explore secret rooms.
- Fly a spaceship through a classical shoot 'em up, blasting enemy ships with your laser guns and avoiding attacks.
- A OG DK style platformer, jump over kegs, shoot those same monsters, climb up ladders and collect gear to steal back your amplifier from Deadbeat Darryl!
- Fly your spaceship through a blackhole, dodging the edges of the tunnel and the mines and enemy ships within.
- Relaxingly float through the center of the blackhole, filled with mines to avoid
- Surf a cosmic wave, avoiding enemies and giant fish, and even go skateboarding for good measure, jumping over and avoiding obstacles

It's a nice, simple game - all you need is four directional keys and a spacebar to go on amazing rock 'n' roll journey into outer space and back. It's groovy and relaxing, if you're into fast-paced action and explosions.

You play as Arthur, a dim-witted drivers-ed teacher with a heroic sweet tooth. His friend and honey-dealer has gone missing and it is up to him to find out what happened.

Arthur must delve into this seedy underworld to find his missing friend...and maybe score a jar or two of honey for his troubles.

2314460.about_the_game:
CultureHouse is a adventure game inspired by biological cultivation experiments, 20th-century modernist architecture, and the dépayssement of surrealism.

You will live for 7 days in a residential research facility called CultureHouse, where a missing biochemist once resided, nurturing a mysterious lifeform known as Geneo.

As you progress in cultivating Geneo, you'll engage in conversations with visiting characters related to CultureHouse and observe strange occurrences happening in the surroundings. Gradually, the serene life transforms into something peculiar.

The story, which once concluded with your death (or the world's catastrophe), restarts from the morning of the first day when you visits CultureHouse, and the growth of Geneo takes on different forms based on the your choices.

Experiencing several catastrophic endings, you delve into the enigmatic connection between the tragic past events at CultureHouse, the world heading towards doom, and Geneo, using clues from the notes left by the biochemist and conversations with visiting characters.

2314580.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Fever
2314580.about_the_game:
Jigsaw Puzzle Fever is a single player game that is fun for all the family. Pick one of the ten starting puzzles to get on your way.

Each puzzle can be played in one of four difficulty levels:
- 48 pieces
- 48 pieces with rotated pieces
- 108 pieces
- 108 pieces with rotated pieces

The pieces are laid out on the screen - the player simply scrolls through the available pieces
and selects a piece.

Puzzles offer one or more additional features for the player to use:
GRID - Show the grid of the puzzle pieces.
EDGES - Filter the pieces to show only the edge pieces.
HELP – Automatically place one piece in the correct position.
PEEK - Show the full picture.

Some of the puzzles have forced difficulty settings (e.g. no hints, timer, no peeking).

Levels
Puzzles are grouped into levels. Once all of the initial 10 puzzles have been completed, the
next level unlocks. There are 75 puzzles in total.

Trophies
The game will feature trophies which the user can collect by completing various challenges.

Leaderboards
The game will include leaderboards to allow players to post scores with their friends and the rest of the world.

2314820.name: Hira Hira Hihiru
2314820.about_the_game:
【INTRODUCTION】


"Hira Hira Hihiru" is a visual novel set in a fictional Taishō Era.

【STORY】


They're all perfectly normal human beings.
￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣￣

The world you are about to enter is one in which the dead come back to life.

It is a phenomena which has occurred since time immemorial. But these unlucky individuals do not return as the person they once were. They rise from the grave with depleted cognition, memory, and awareness. Their bodies, stripped of all regenerative abilities, slowly rot away.

In Japan, those with this affliction are known as "hihiru." Though once revered as holy beings, over time they have come to be shunned and reviled by society. Eventually, however, their condition was recognized as a medical issue, and given the name Aerodema.

Now, at the dawn of the Taishō Era, Dr. Shūhei Katori is conducting field studies in an effort to improve living conditions and support systems for Aerodema patients. Given how slowly they have developed in Japan compared to other nations, it is an uphill battle he fights.

It is through the eyes of two men that this story will unfold: Masamitsu Chigusa, a young doctor assisting with these studies, and Takeo Tenma, a student to whom Aerodema has only been a distant problem until now. Watch how these men grapple with Aerodema as it twists itself into their lives...

2314850.name: The Legend of Skye
2314850.about_the_game:
In The Legend of Skye we will put ourselves in the shoes of a young druid who is summoned by her tribe elders to undertake an mission of the utmost importance. After some events in her village, she will have to leave the safety of the forest behind and venture into a world full of dangers. The young druid must now infiltrate the city and thwart the plans of the wicked King Finn. The fate of the grove rests now in her sole hands.

The Legend of Skye is the first professional graphic adventure from Point & Pixel Adventures. It features classic Point & Click gameplay, inventory items, and the usual nine verbs from legendary 90s adventures. You will need to pay attention to dialogues with characters and keep a keen eye on your surroundings to solve the clever puzzles and challenges that this adventure has in store for you.



Key Features of The Legend of Skye:
  • Classic Point & Click graphic adventure.
  • A system of 9 verbs and an inventory to interact with the environment.
  • Resolution of 320×180 pixels.
  • Over 40 scenes reminiscent of early 90s adventures.
  • Over 90 inventory items.
  • An adventure focused on solving puzzles and challenges with very clever solutions.
  • No dead ends. It will never be necessary to load a previous save.
  • The story takes place in a fantastical medieval world.
  • Many hours of enjoyable dialogues with over 30 characters to interact with.
  • Approximately 10 to 15 hours of gameplay.
  • Available in English, German, French and Spanish.
  • Original soundtrack by Michael Lückgen.



    Who are you going to meet in the first hours of the adventure?

    Skye
    Our heroine still has much to learn from the wisest druids in her grove. Even so, with only her blue cloak and a bag that can hold all the inventory items in the world, she must fight those who threaten her forest.

    Woodland Spirit
    Skye will never be alone on her mission. This spirit, who had also once been a druid, will guide the girl through the most difficult moments with his wise advice.

    Tribal chief
    As the leader of the druid village, he is tough and unyielding. He's always known how to run people from him, but now he'll need Skye's help.

    Peddler Druid
    This dirty looking and hungry druid will try to sell you some of his items on the outskirts of town. Don't trust him.
2314850.reviews:
“The Legend of Skye is an entertaining point-and-click adventure that revisits classic tropes. It features often-humorous scenarios, enticing pixel-art visuals, and an enchanting soundtrack. I recommend this great game to all adventurers, particularly those who yearn for brain-teasing challenges.”
4/5 – Adventure Gamers

“The Legend of Skye is a point-and-click game that does the genre proud. It offers us a characterful protagonist, an engaging storyline, challenging puzzles and a good dose of humour. We highly recommend it to all genre fans.”
90/100 – 1upNerd

“The Legend of Skye is a very good adventure and a love letter to LucasArts classics, with a puzzle design as ambitious as satisfying, surely the best so far this year. More demanding than we are used to nowadays but that knows how to find a good balance during most of the course of the adventure.”
8.5/10 – ErrekGamer

2314930.name: Far Tale
2314930.about_the_game:
Narrative role-playing game in the world of Slavic dark fantasy.
You have to take on the role of a father who must guide his daughter to distant lands. A cruel world, terrible monsters, witchcraft, and even time itself will stand in your way.

Game features

A large global map, where along the way you will have many points of interest, random events and story arcs.
When traveling, you need to remember the time and replenish supplies in time.
A non-linear story with choices that have consequences. Some chapters may be completely different, depending on your choice. Decisions and their consequences should be considered. The hero's companions may not live to see the finale
Turn-based combat system for fans of tactical battles. Many types of opponents with their own characteristics. Pumping characters through equipment and various points of interest.

World

The game world is set in a Slavic dark fantasy setting.
Many realms lie in ruins, consumed many years ago by the curse of a blood plague that turns people into terrible monsters called ghouls or bloodspawn.
In addition, the Long Night is coming - a time when the sun does not illuminate the earth for a long time, and therefore, evil creatures raise their heads and besiege entire settlements. Even the Gods are not able to resist them, because monsters are able to resist magical effects, and therefore, in such difficult days, you have to rely only on yourself and your loved ones.
In the course of the journey, you will have to go along the tract - a long road stretching almost across the entire continent. And on the way you will meet various settlements, forests, fields, mountains, swamps, rivers, and much more.

Game features and mechanics

  • The player travels around the global map choosing destinations or points of interest.
  • In the course of movement, plot or random events, monster attacks can occur.
  • The ability to complete some tasks depends on the time of day.
  • The choice in the dialogues can lead to different consequences, both good and bad.
  • In the game, you can meet 5 characters available for invitation to the squad. The characters have their own quest chains, conflict points and dialogues. They will comment on your actions and may die as a result of your decisions or lay down their lives in battle.
  • The player must keep an eye on supplies and fatigue, otherwise the squad will not be able to effectively fight, restore health and use abilities.
  • The player is limited by the time frame - the daughter is terminally ill. Delays along the way lead to negative effects, including bad endings.
  • The player can upgrade the hero's abilities, change them as a result of story or side quests, as well as upgrade his weapons and armor.

2314940.name: Land of Ramchin: Between Dimensions
2314940.about_the_game:
Overview
In this expansive open-world action role-playing game, you will play as the valiant protagonist, Vico, as you embark on a series of adventures across the sprawling land of Ramchin. Engage in the seamless transitions between multiple dimensions. Through the journey, you will enhance your power and skills through battles and trials and forge your own remarkable tale in this vividly imagined world.

Story
In antiquity, a great flood swept away the dwellings of our ancestors. A giant goat bore the survivors upon its back as they drifted across the endless sea. They journeyed until the ceaseless rain subsided, revealing the once-hidden sky. However, the goat himself transformed into a vast land, with its sinews sculpting towering mountains and its arteries giving life to winding rivers. People call this place the land of Ramchin.

Millenniums later, one day, Vico got lost in a desert and stumbled upon a tram. As he prepared to board, an old man stopped him, warning him that the vehicle was a ghost tram. Subsequently, Vico found himself in a shadowy realm where two infernal messengers sought to capture him. Jolted awake by profound fear, he pondered the unsettling notion that the ghostly tram in his nightmare should appear in the real world!

This marks merely the commencement. We refrain from any more spoilers here, for the allure of this enigmatic fantasy tale is destined to captivate your imagination!

Gameplay

Beyond the abilities to run and swim, players can indulge in paragliding, self-propelled flight, and even mount a dragon to soar across the skies.

A diverse array of of items can be collected, each serving various purposes, facilitating wealth accumulation, investments, and the potential for unexpected robbing encounters. And, engaging in malicious activities in the Land of Ramchin may lead to your incarceration.

The game boasts a sophisticated system encompassing time, weather, banking, public transport, teleportation, quests, achievements, and equipment upgrades. Throughout your journey, a multitude of features ensures a continuous source of enjoyment and exploration.

Fight

In action battle mode, Vico can employ a sword for attacks, wield a shield for defence, and harness skills for additional power. Your equipment can undergo upgrades as you progress through your adventure. Make sure to pay a visit to a Landlord Shrine when you come across one!

Design
Each location is bestowed with a name derived from its origin. For instance, Juhe, which means river in the Manchu language, or Talnotog, translating to plateau in Mongolian. Every unique place holds cultural references to real-world locations.

The protagonist is meticulously crafted to embody the appearance of a seasoned adventurer, with his golden hair colour and iconic red shirt carrying significant meaning within the narrative.

Controls
It is strongly recommended that you use a game controller (Xbox controller, PS controller, joysticks) to play.

2314960.name: Trans Agent X
2314960.about_the_game:
A top-down bullet-hell dodger.

In a galaxy far far away... Oh, wait, no. We're still in our solar system.
Anyways. After the gender war, transgendered people fled to a new planet and made it their own. Earth being completely devoid of trans people could not survive because of it and annihilated themselves.

You, should you choose to accept this mission, will revisit this post-apocalyptic earth, evade horrible hurtful memories, and retrieve the lost dignity of the, now ghostly, cisgendered people for closure.



Trans Agent X is a top-down bullet-hell dodger - a game that explores topics of growth, healing, and trauma.
Every enemy in the game depicts a narrative fragment of the "treatment" transgender people in norway suffered from rikshospitalet. These fragments were collected from the norwegian transgendered community, norwegian media, and personal experience.

A full list of the enemy statements can be found on the game's open source wiki page.


Developed over two months, this solo project is one of many controversial games the developer has made. Being able to artistically express yourself is a proven way to heal trauma and possibly also move on. This game hopes to achieve, for players who need it, through gameplay, to stir up hidden and muddied emotions, needs and thoughts.
Please take care of yourself and your loved ones.

  • Voice acted intro
  • Real-life examples of horrible things health practitioners tell trans people

2315050.name: We Were Here Tomorrow

Each assignment brings new asymmetrical puzzles that can only be solved through cooperation and trust. You will often find yourselves separated, relying solely on your walkie-talkies to communicate. It’s up to you to describe what you see, share what you know, and piece together the truth as one.

With every puzzle you solve, you’ll come closer to understanding why you and your partner are here and what your role is in the facility. Only together you can decide what Tomorrow will hold.

2315100.name: The Great Smog
2315100.about_the_game:
You and up to 3 of your friends are Commissioned Officers of the United Africa Company, now colloquially known as Smog Runners. Where once your commission might have taken you to exotic locations across the globe, now your mission is very simple - carry all the salvage you're able to from the mutant-infested streets, and don't die in the process.

Use all your cunning and willpower, and run like hell, and you might be able to profit from the treasure troves nestled deep in the heart of the mutant-ridden streets of London. Until then, make sure your airship is fueled, your rusty pipe is in good nick, your gas mask is fitted properly, and you haven't miffed off any of the factions vying for control over what's left of the Empire.

Explore various iconic landmarks of London, such as St Paul's Cathedral and the Tower of London, and the ruins of an Empire on the cusp of revolution, both technologically and politically. Uncover the secrets behind the mysterious Great Smog and the world it ravaged. 

Take part in the battle for the Empire's uncertain future, aligning yourself with the various factions that survived the catastrophe. Will you recover the Crown Jewels to help the Aristocracy crown a new king, or scrap them for the metal to craft explosives for the revolutionary Trade Union Congress? Or just hang them on your mantelpiece?  

Horrifying mutants, twisted by the Smog, prowl the streets below. In order to survive, you must keep your airship stocked with fuel recovered from the surface. In order to thrive, you must gather and break down everything that isn't nailed down to make new weapons and traps, or take contracts to recover lost trinkets and old world relics for profit. 

Whether scavenging to survive or to get the resources to craft that one perfect decoration for above your fireplace, you will run into danger. And with random loot locations and mutants in every run, you will never know quite what to expect.

Take on the streets of London however you like, through stealth, utilizing the environment, or perfectly placed traps. Hide, run or fight - the choice is yours. Just make sure you're well stocked if you choose the latter.

A wide array of cosmetic choices ensure that your Smog Runner is truly yours. And should you manage to keep it fueled, your airship, your mobile base in the sky, is fully customizable with decorations, furniture and storage.

When you begin your journey in the Great Smog, you will be woefully unprepared. Death is almost certain, whether by a monster stalking you through London's alleys, your oxygen running out too far from your bathysphere, or your airship's fuel tank being empty. But with ingenuity and perseverance, you and your friends will overcome these challenges and eventually be able to go toe to toe with foes that once seem insurmountable.

The Terran Empire is in shambles and you barely escaped the onslaught. Your only mission is to reach a set of coordinates, a journey that will take several centuries. To reach your destination you´ll explore unknown sectors, gather resources, find new crew members, take important decisions to guide your people, discover new technologies, assist your allies, and defeat your enemies.

If you love exploring and battling through unknown quadrants of space with a fully customizable warship… Voidship: Redux is for you!

  • Build your own ship – Combine weapons and special modules to build a ship suited to your style of play.
  • Space travel takes time – Your travel in space takes hundreds of years, your crew will age and die. Society onboard your ship will develop according to choices you make.
  • Uniquely skilled crew members – Each person has their own strengths and weaknesses, affecting the special abilities of your ship.
  • Traditions system – Decide which principles define the surviving Terran people.
  • Complex strategic gameplay – Tactical overlay reveals your enemies weaknesses, exploit them with your special abilities.
  • Play Voidship as an RTS or a top-down shooter – At any point, you can switch between RTS or shooter control modes. RTS control mode lets you control your ship, it's modules, and any other units like an old-school real-time strategy game. Top-down shooter mode gives you more direct control in piloting your ship.
  • Real-time 2D space combat – Battle against a huge variety of unique enemy spaceships.
  • Randomly generated maps and rogue-lite gameplay – Each playthrough a new world to explore.
  • Moddable – All game scripting data is easily accessible.

SHIPBUILDING

A wide selection of modules gives you near countless ways to design your ship. Large armored and shielded dreadnaught class ships may be powerful, but become very slow and especially vulnerable in ion nebulas. A smaller speedy spaceship can kite the enemy and evade most weapons, but will have less firepower. Choose between kinetic weapons, missiles, beams, launching satellites and fighters, or less conventional means of battle like trapping enemies with tractor beams and ion weapons.

STRATEGY

The enemies in your path are quite challenging. You can pause the game and identify the weakest points of each enemy. Concentrate your weapons on a specific module to take out the engines, weapons, or repair stations to weaken your enemy. Learn from your mistakes and add countermeasures to your ship to have a better outcome in the next battle.

EXPLORATION AND THE PASSAGE OF TIME

Different factions inhabit different star systems. Based on the design of your ship you can choose to avoid the enemies you aren´t prepared for. Space travel takes time and traveling from one star system to another may take decades. Over this time your crew and your society will age and mature according to choices you make as the captain.

CHANGES BETWEEN VOIDSHIP: REDUX AND THE ORIGINAL GAME


  • 40% more content overall – Fully new game mechanics like scanning for resources and anomalies, and fully fleshed out visiting of locations on friendly space stations. New enemy ships. New events and interactions. New traditions to guide your people with. Overall just a sizeable upgrade to the amount of content in every way making for a varied replayable game.
  • Updated graphics and engine – Higher definition backgrounds and scenery. Lighting engine. 60 FPS update.
  • Bug fixes and quality of life improvements – The engine was rebuilt from the ground up and features countless small additions and fixes compared to the base game.

2315430.name: The Executive - Movie Industry Tycoon
2315430.about_the_game:
The Executive is a sandbox business simulation game that lets you rewrite the history of Hollywood from the 1970s to today. As the founder of a scrappy production company, you’ll produce the movies you’ve always dreamed of, manage ambitious franchises, and build a studio that rivals the industry’s greatest. Navigate the challenges of the movie business, outmaneuver your competition, and decide whether to chase critical acclaim or box office domination.

PRODUCE YOUR DREAM MOVIES

Bring your cinematic visions to life. Choose themes, genres, and target ratings to shape your creations. Dive deep into screenplay development, cast the hottest stars (or discover hidden talent), and allocate your budget wisely to make each film shine. Every decision impacts your movie’s critical acclaim and box office potential, so craft your masterpieces with care.

BUILD AND MANAGE FRANCHISES

Turn your biggest hits into long-lasting franchises! Create sequels, prequels, reboots, and even spinoffs to capitalize on audience demand. But beware: too many installments can lead to franchise fatigue. Strike the perfect balance to keep your fans invested without burning them out.

MASTER THE ART OF DISTRIBUTION

Your movie’s journey doesn’t end at the final cut. Decide how to distribute your creation: self-publish, partner with a distributor. Each route comes with unique risks and rewards. Timing is everything—analyze the market, outmaneuver the competition, and secure the perfect release date for your blockbuster.

MONETIZE YOUR BACK CATALOG

Don’t let your past successes collect dust. Manage your studio’s library and maximize ancillary revenue with strategic home entertainment deals. Partner with distributors who are the best fit for your catalog, and invest in add-ons to boost sales. Your back catalog is a goldmine—make it work for you.

TACKLE MOVIE PRODUCTION INCIDENTS

Making movies isn’t all glamour and glory. Sometimes, production doesn’t go as planned, and you’ll have to face the unexpected. From budget overruns to on-set accidents, adapt to unforeseen challenges and turn setbacks into opportunities.

BUILD YOUR EMPIRE

Turn your small studio into a Hollywood powerhouse. Use your profits to upgrade your offices, hire and train top-tier talent, and research cutting-edge technologies to stay ahead of the curve. Attract A-list actors, expand your capabilities, and solidify your reputation as a major player in the industry.

FOLLOW YOUR OWN PATH

In The Executive, the road to success is yours to decide. Will you become a champion of the art world, winning critical acclaim and prestigious awards? Or will you build a blockbuster machine, raking in billions at the box office? The choice is yours in this ultimate Hollywood simulation.

2315680.about_the_game:
Story
Ethan and his stepsister Samira are both starting their first year at the same university, but they have very little money. To afford it they decide to live together in an campus apartment to split the cost of accommodation.

Ethan is 20 years old and is highly focused on his studies and wants nothing more than to excel in university. He is a straight-A student who spends all of his time studying and participating in extracurricular activities.

On the other hand, Samira, who is 21 years old, is wild and likes to have fun and party. She is reckless and disorganized, and often stays out late drinking with friends.

Despite their differences, they are both determined to make their living arrangement work. Ethan wants to stay at the university no matter what to get the best education possible, while Samira wants to stay to enjoy the endless frat parties and campus social scene.

How will they live together? Are they going to became closer? What will happen once he discovers her naughty secret?

- Can be played with one hand.
- Realistic and beautiful renders
- 22 levels to play with various difficulty
- 27 reward renders to unlock

This game is a combination of a visual novel and a match 3 puzzle. You will play as Ethan and in each level you will have to deal with Samira and the problems arising from your co-living. You will get to know her better and eventually, you will see what is hidden underneath her tight pants.

After a short story, you need to win a match 3 level in order to progress in the game. The puzzle is challenging yet not difficult, it will require you to think!

You'll need to match 3 or more of the same gems in a row. Each gem has a different meaning and some may harm you. You have to match the right tokens to perform the specific actions, like seducing Samira or restoring your health! You win the level after you seduce her.

The game contains also a gallery with unlockable CGs of Samira and later also your naughty adventures together.

You arrive at Fred Karlsen's isolated cabin. The physicist has vanished, leaving behind scattered tapes and one fragmented message. His voice crackles through static, unravelling and afraid.

The message is a warning. Something is out there.

  • Play back tapes on a dusty cassette recorder.

  • Search the cabin for clues.

  • Manipulate audio frequencies to reveal hidden messages.

  • Each discovery points you toward the next tape.

Each recording is a piece of the puzzle. Cold War research logs. An old news broadcast. Medical journals. Experimental music. Static noise. And amidst everything - an unfinished letter to an old friend.

Tape by tape, the truth emerges. You uncover Fred's growing fear and obsession with something he found in the recordings - something that listened back. You follow the same trail, rewinding through the fragments of his life.

What happened to Fred? Why was he alone out here? And what is waiting in the static?

2316290.name: Cerulean Days
2316290.about_the_game:
Cerulean Days is the third original visual novel by developer LeafCascade. It had a successful campaign on Kickstarter and is now here on Steam!






2016.
Inre Island.
A seemingly idyllic, modern island in the middle of the Atlantic Ocean. A constant tranquil breeze along a mild climate, and a well-off society embracing a harmonious way of life. Its citizens often refer to the island as their very own miracle, counting themselves lucky to have been born on it. Tourism is hampered despite Inre being a highly desired travel destination, and for good reason. Not only is it a trip only the rich can afford, a rigorous regime means a special visa is required for entry.



2018.
Over the course of six months, a lethal biological attack claims a significant amount of lives. While tragedy occupies people's minds to the brim, a controlling governmental plan is constructed and put into motion. All to prevent such attacks from ever occurring again. In the following years, Inre Island's citizens face unexpected change from their usual ways. On a somber day—damp, dark, and horrifying—the internet is shut down, leaving the island disconnected from the world around it.



2020 - present.
After a long internet-less spring tinged with uncertainty, a new system to replace it with is introduced. A new "internet" along digital setbacks result in major changes to everyday life. Unable to adapt, many find themselves spiritually stuck in a world that no longer exists.
Suddenly, the island appears shrouded in mysteries. The closed hearts are many. A select few want a way out. But most want to reset and forget.
People who never would've met, meet.
People who never would've loved, love.
An island that had never known sadness, knows it now.
Cerulean Days is set in 2020 and follows two outliers of society—mellow Michael and competent Séverine—as they discover the true effects of 2018. Amidst tragedy of lost friends and family, bonds are grown, solace is found, feelings blossom, truth is discovered, and conspiracies are seemingly unraveled.
Hearts in need of mending await you. Welcome to Inre Island.

2316420.name: Track Day: From Street to Circuit
2316420.about_the_game:
Do you have a feeling that there is less and less creativity in the racing games genre? We think so too. Being players first and foremost, we were tired of this stagnancy and decided to create a game we want to play ourselves. A game centered around a robust, creative career mode, inspired by the best ideas from classic titles and enhanced with our own experience with real-life racing in Central Europe.

A RACING CAREER OF MERE MORTALS

In Track Day, we invite you to enter the world of racing just like you’d do it in the real world (in case you don’t have rich parents or influential sponsors, that is). You’ve saved some money to spend it on a regular used car - one of older, nostalgic models manufactured 20-30 years ago. A youngtimer.

For starters, you’re going to compete with amateurs on local race tracks in Poland. Driving fast is not enough to climb higher. In the real world everything has a price: repairing damage, changing worn tires, even entry fee for races. Driving slowly and wisely can take you further than being a speed demon who goes broke in his first race after crashing his car over a barrier.

LICENSES FOR THE AMBITIOUS, TUNING FOR THE WISE

If you survive the beginning of your career and earn some money, you’ll have a chance to progress. Pay for license courses that will let you participate in professional asphalt racing, rallycross, or drift - first on a national level, then European.

You’ll also need a car prepared properly. You’re going to transform not only the engine, chassis, or body, but also the interior. Adding wings or splitters is just as important as removing unnecessary kilograms from the cockpit to place a rollcage and other equipment for motorsports in its place.

Each event has specific requirements and class restrictions so you need to upgrade your ride carefully, managing ever-small funds and time needed for work on the car. A roaring engine with big power won’t do you any good if you exceed the noise limit during the pre-race scrutineering. If you’re installing a rollcage in your car, you need to take into account additional costs of transporting it with a car hauler, since the law in Poland forbids you from driving a car with such equipment on public roads.

AN OPEN CAREER ON OPEN TRACKS

However, your life in Track Day doesn’t go just from race to race. You’ll find various events with diverse activities in the calendar.

You can visit your favourite track and explore its open map via freeroam, take VIPs on show rides to earn extra money (unless you’ve removed the passenger seat from your race car to save weight…), or go to the parts fair to acquire some special upgrades unavailable via the webshop.

And when you decide it’s time to get some rest… who knows, maybe you’ll drive one of those legendary machines, unattainable for ordinary people like you, in your dreams?

RPG MECHANICS TO SERVE BEGINNERS

Do you think the automotive realm is too complex? Worry not, your mentor is here to guide you through the nuances of racecraft and explain anything that’s unclear. You can imagine him as an NPC talking to you like in an RPG game.

You can also turn on some assists and customize your experience to your liking so that you don’t go broke after your very first race. However, even if you go… you can always earn some cash by participating in events as a marshal who watches races to keep them safe and penalize dirty drivers.

There are many paths to success in the world of Track Day. And whichever you choose, the most important thing is for you to simply have fun.

KEY FEATURES OF TRACK DAY

  • Robust career mode (offline, obviously). You buy used cars to modify them extensively and get licenses for various disciplines (asphalt racing, rallycross, drift) to compete on a national and then European level.

  • Wide selection of well-known "ordinary" cars, as well as proper race machines.

  • Race tracks in Poland and Europe created as open maps where you can have fun and explore freely, looking for side activities.

  • Online multiplayer allows you to show your uniquely modified cars to other players and compete with their vehicles in races.

  • Outside of career, you can drive and race freely in the singleplayer arcade mode.

  • Mod support allows you to add your favourite cars and tracks to the game, and customize the gameplay to your liking.

  • Unreal Engine 5 makes Track Day look like a modern game (unlike too many contemporary sims).

2316700.name: Cursed Halls
2316700.about_the_game:
Cursed Halls is an unforgiving stealth horror game that takes you to dark, cursed locations where survival is your only goal. Explore an abandoned school, a desolate hospital, and a haunted prison, each with unique demons stalking your every move. Essential items needed to unlock exits and escape are randomized in each playthrough, ensuring no two runs are the same. But be warned: death is permanent, and every mistake brings you closer to a grisly fate.

With its tense atmosphere, randomized object placement, and permadeath mechanics, Cursed Halls will test your wit and courage. Can you survive the horrors and uncover the secrets of these cursed halls?

The gameplay of Cursed Halls blends stealth with heart-pounding escapes, creating a constant tension that keeps you on edge.

To evade the demons hunting you, you’ll need to strategically use throwable objects to create distractions and safely navigate the cursed environments.

You can take refuge in ventilation ducts that connect rooms, lockers, or hide under tables and inside cabinets to stay out of sight. If all else fails, your only option is to break their line of sight and lose them in the labyrinthine layouts.

Each level includes maps that reveal the layout and mark the locations of essential items, such as the flashlight, to aid your survival.

To heighten the stakes, traps scattered throughout the levels demand constant vigilance and quick reactions, making every step a dangerous gamble.

In Cursed Halls, you’ll explore three chilling locations, each with its own unique horrors and a demon lurking within. Navigate the eerie corridors of an abandoned school, where echoes of a dark past fill the air; the desolate wards of a ruined hospital, steeped in unspeakable secrets; and the oppressive cells of a haunted prison, where the despair of the condemned still lingers.

Each environment is meticulously crafted to immerse you in dread, with decaying walls, ominous shadows, and the faint echoes of unseen terrors drawing you deeper into the cursed world. These settings are not mere backdrops—they are integral to the fear, tension, and survival that define every moment of your journey.

The AI in Cursed Halls is relentless, always lurking near the player to maintain a constant atmosphere of tension and dread.

No two playthroughs are the same, as every key item is randomly placed in different locations, ensuring that you can never rely on past strategies.

Adding to the challenge, your inventory is limited to just 8 items, forcing you to make critical decisions about what to keep and what to discard.

Every choice matters, especially as you plan your escape route—each exit requires different items to unlock, making inventory management a key element of survival. Stay sharp, adapt quickly, and be ready for anything.

2316710.name: Rootman: Bodycam Horror Footage
2316710.about_the_game:
Find out what happened
On October 26, 2005, a strange call came to the police at night. In the application, the owner of the house said that some dark figure was watching him from the forest, and strange sounds were constantly heard in the house, as if someone or something was crawling along the walls. Police officer Harry Whippet went to this challenge. Nobody saw him again. Only a week later, footage from a police officer's body camera was found.

Learn about Rutman.
This is a monster that lives in the dense dark forests of a small town. Rootman tortures and kills everyone who wanders into his domain. The legend speaks of murders, cursed artifacts, and the supernatural behavior of trees. It is said that its roots go deep into the earth, and Rutman's body consists of twisted gnarled branches and roots. No one knows how old he is and where he came from, but the townspeople are still afraid of him. He has the ability to manipulate surrounding trees and plants, using them to trap his victims. It is said that, once in its grasp, the roots tightly wrap around the body, squeezing the life out of the victim. The town lives in fear of Rootman, never going too far into the forest for fear of encountering the monster. It is said that on quiet, moonless nights, Rootman's whisper can be heard through the trees, reminding the city of his omnipresent presence and of the danger lurking in the forest.

Play with the body camera effect.
Experience realistic camera shake, sound and visual effects. Feel the incredible effect of immersion and presence in the center of events.

Feel the horror.
In the game you will find a tense atmosphere and suspense. And sometimes you have to jump up and down in your chair.

Try demo and add to wishlist!
For now, you can play a short demo, or rather a prototype, that was created by me and my wife at Global Game Jam 2023. If you like the demo, we will make a full game out of it.

2316750.name: Finger Football: Goal in One
2316750.about_the_game:
Finger Football: Goal In One is a minimalist finger football puzzle game.

  • 70 levels designed to challenge you;
  • Levels with increased button strength;
  • 2 types of "enemy buttons";
  • 6 custom fields for you to choose what you prefer;
  • 2 different goal sizes;

Will you be able to find the right strength and angle for each of the 70 levels?

2316770.name: FUZZ
2316770.about_the_game:
The last seed of a decayed forest journeys to breathe life into the stolen paradise. In FUZZ you'll fly through a land of whimsical nature and lost technology, engage in fluid aerial combat, and use the world around you to unlock new areas and conquer challenges.
* Gather the forces of nature, technology, and spirit by flying through the environment and pulling items and elements into your Gale.
* Use the Tether to tie objects together or pull things apart.
* Travel to 5 unique environments, each full of new challenges, new weapons and tools, new ecosystems, and old mysteries.

2316800.name: Kids Land
2316800.about_the_game:
Diversified, easy-to-play and short-lived mini-games, suitable for children who are new to computers or for parents who accompany their children to play together. If you are a veteran player who has been playing games for many years, you are welcome to play it. It may remind you of the happy times when you first came into contact with games.

The game level time is all 60 seconds, making it easier for you to manage the time you play with your children.
The current game levels are:

1. Balloon Shooting
2. Catch the treasure

2316820.name: Rudra: A Tale of Time
2316820.about_the_game:
A game made by students at the University of Utah.
Narrative
  • Live the story of Rudra. As a hero determined to protect humanity, you travel through the different Yugas(Eras) of the world to find the source of malignant corruption.
  • As you travel through the beautiful landscapes of each Yuga, cleanse the orbs of corruption blocking Ma Ganga’s flow. From the divine Satya Yuga to the darkest Kali Yuga, you will experience the full Chatur Yuga cycle.
  • As you progress, immerse yourself into the world of Hindu culture. Explore the inner workings of Chakras, stories from Hindu scripture, and much more.

Combat
  • You’ve faced enemies from the Nordic and Greek regions. Now it is time to face the evil from Hindu scriptures. Take on Pishachas, Rakshasas, Bhishani, and even Asuras!
  • Unleash the power of Varunastra, a gift from the gods. Use this legendary weapon to perform a variety of epic combos.
  • Use powerful incantations known as Mantras to aid you on the battlefield and morph Varunastra into several weapons from ancient India.

Features
  • Richly detailed world inspired by Hindu scriptures.
  • Epic storyline that takes you through the four Yugas of the universe.
  • Dynamic combat system that allows you to use Mantras and Varunastra to defeat your enemies.
  • Challenging boss battles against legendary creatures from Hindu scriptures.
  • Exploration of the inner workings of Chakras and stories from Hindu scripture.
  • Immersive soundscapes that transport you to a mystical realm.
  • Stunning graphics that bring the world to life.

2316840.name: CardShark
2316840.about_the_game:
CardShark is a roguelike card-battler game in which you take the role of a young daring shark, seeking adventure. Battle your way through each floor of a dangerous dungeon in an endeavour to reach the bottom...

Gameplay & Features

  • Turn-Based Combat requiring strategy and wit to outplay your opponents
  • Many different enemies and bosses to fight your way past to further your conquest
  • Randomly generated dungeons, for a different experience every playthrough
  • A vast array of different abilities to forge various interesting combinations with

CardShark takes the idea of drawing from an ordinary deck of playing cards, and depending on the card suit/number value, they can be used to activate various different abilities. These abilities you will find more and more of along the way while battling your way through the dungeon floors, allowing you to experiment with different combinations and builds in an attempt to yield better results while venturing through the depths, wiping out anything that may stand in your way.

2316860.name: Doomsday Derby
2316860.about_the_game:
Play this pixelated style indie derby game!

destroy the cars that want to destroy you with you powerful gun and missiles in a battle arena.

In this arcade style mini game you must survive and beat the record of seconds alive.
Face the aliens that put the giant worm in the land and get the diamons to get more strong cars ....
keep destroying them into pieces! feels good!

Avoid the chickens and loot the destroyed cars with Health Armor and Ammo!

Be carefull with the aliens! they drop a big worm on the arena, destroy it and get the green gems to unlock new cars!

FEATURES
  • High quality graphics with pixelated style made in Unreal Engine less than 2 gb
  • Shoot missiles and use your mini gun to destroy others cars
  • Cool sounds and music with an arcade style
  • Aliens will drop a big worm on the arena, destroy them and get the green gems to get other cars
  • Be carefull with the chicken-mine that will take your green gems
  • Nitro, Reset Car, Drifting, great explosions and more!
  • OBJETIVE: JUST STAY ALIVE!!!

Enjoy this release from our studio LFR Games

2316870.name: The END of Sanity
2316870.about_the_game:
Dive into a dark, supernatural world in this survival Dystopian RPG, where the city is under the grip of dark entities controlling AI machines. Harness solar power and the environment to fuel your equipment, engage in intense combat, and build defenses. Reclaim the city from the shadows.

Key Features


  • Discovery Gameplay

Embark on a journey through an urban labyrinth in a game that offers open-ended exploration. You have the freedom to immerse yourself in the lore or simply focus on survival in a world that changes every playthrough. Cultivate your survival skills by farming, trading with NPCs and factions in real time, recruiting allies, and scavenging for items. Guide Seven and Sanity, your protagonists, as they navigate a dystopian city riddled with abandoned towers and dynamically generated events.

  • Player vs Environment
Engage in strategic combat or opt for stealth to evade threats in a hostile Real Time environment. Scourge the city for limited resources to stand your ground against machines, hostile human factions, and supernatural entities.

  • Real-Time Solar Gameplay
Experience a game that unfolds in real-time, allowing you to harness environmental elements like sunlight. Survive the daylight hours by maximizing solar power storage.

  • A.I. Companion Management
Sanity is a powerful A.I. Companion that can Fabricate Weapons and equipment given the right materials and energy. Travel with your A.I. Companion Sanity and maintain his energy levels to ensure his assistance throughout your journey.

  • Equipment and Weapon Development
Leverage your scavenged items to Development weapons and equipment with the assistance of your A.I. companion, Sanity. Utilize solar power to charge your gear and gain an edge against the myriad challenges of the environment. Materialize weapons into reality using you A.I. companion.

  • Inventory Management
Utilize Sanity's storage capabilities for your synthetic equipment and items. For organic materials, you'll need to rely on traditional storage methods, such as a backpack.

  • Skills and Combat Abilities
Enhance the combat effectiveness of Seven and Sanity by improving their skills. Elevating your skillset is crucial to boosting your survival odds.

  • Seed System
Embrace agriculture by growing food in solar pods. Cultivate herbal medicines and fruits for trade with NPCs or to Consume them.

2316880.name: Fabulous Field Trip
2316880.about_the_game:
Fabulous Field Trip is an island excursion game full of learning and fun suitable for children aged 9-12 and adults of all ages.

Upon your arrival on the island, you visit the clothing store, where you can change your appearance and choose your outfit from a selection of 100’s of beautiful and unique combinations. You can return as often as you like and even save up to 9 of your favorite outfits on an intuitive wardrobe ring enabling you to switch instantaneously. When you leave the clothing store, your next destination is a visit to the exciting museum of history and art. Marvel at the beauty of 88 fantastic paintings you will appreciate and learn to recognize; pass through the dinosaur room to see the fossils of 13 amazing dinosaurs and enjoy the more than 40 fantasy artifacts in the animal artifact room. Next comes a visit to the museum café for some refreshments and extra energy with a free coffee or cappuccino. And while you’re there, enjoy the challenging puzzles and games at each table!

At your leisure, you may visit the aquarium filled with over 69 different types of fish and marine life wonderfully animated in glorious detail before you visit the adjoining insectarium with 50 various insects you can learn to identify. Then, enjoy an afternoon in the blissful botanical gardens filled with 64 different types of beautiful flowers. And no excursion would be complete without a visit to the disco with its fun arcade games, delicious ice cream cones, and fantastic board game room.

The island is filled with 42 fun games, challenging puzzles, and extra activities that will keep you coming back for more:

  • There are 3 different word games to help expand your English vocabulary: Word Search Cube, Flower Power, and Morse Code Master. The latter also teaches how to send and receive Morse code.
  • There are 8 different memory games, such as Touch Tones, Disco Dance Battle, Match'Em Up Flowers, Match'Em Up Dinosaurs, Match'Em Up Marine Life, Match'Em Up Insects, Match'Em Up Paintings I, and Match'Em Up Paintings II. These games are ideal for helping improve short-term memory, visual attention, spatial memory skills, and naming skills.
  • There are 3 different math games, Kakuro, Mathdoku, and Mahjong Math. These games help development using clues, problem-solving, reasoning, and mathematical intelligence.
  • There are 5 different types of logic puzzles to solve, including Nonograms, Japanese Number Game, Tic-Tac-NO, Islands in the Sea, and Stempelspel. These games help you think critically, develop logical reasoning and analytical skills, quick-thinking skills, and improve concentration. In addition, they offer a great way to make problem-solving development fun.
  • There are 9 different puzzle games, including Jigsaw Puzzles, Marble Solitaire, Warehouse Worker, Knights Tour, Circuit Schematics, Chemical Compounds, Connect the Dots, Magic Color Cube, and Where’s My What. These types of games help improve reasoning, planning, and visualization skills.
  • You may also challenge Skyla Skunk to any of the 6 board games in the board game room, including 4 In A Row, Checkers, Chess, Backgammon, Gomoku, and Moor of Venice. Each game has self-adjusting artificial intelligence as you win or lose, and all can be played locally with a friend. These games help develop abstract reasoning and strategic thinking skills by encouraging you to recognize patterns on the gameboard and develop strategies based on those patterns.
  • There are also 4 casual just-for-fun activities like Painting for Fun, Groovy 8 Ball, Bubble Wrap Popper, and Chattering Teeth. Having better imagination skills and using the imagination effectively and deliberately can be the key to having a successful and happy life.
  • Are you seeking a little more thrill and action? Try out the collection of 4 arcade games, including HOPPER, Block Blowout, Falling Tetrominoes, and MOP: Operation Cleanup. These games help improve visual attention, sustained attention, reaction times, and focusing skills.

You are never too old for a field trip. Besides being great for children, the dozens of games in Fabulous Field Trip and the different difficulty levels for each game make them suitable for players of all ages. They can readily be enjoyed by senior adults who wish to challenge their minds. Playing mental games and exercises may not stop Dementia or Alzheimer’s when diagnosed: still, studies have shown that brain exercise throughout life can help to build a healthy reserve of brain cells and connections. This can minimize the risk of Dementia, and they are also the key to slowing down the negative impact of Alzheimer’s. Mental puzzles can also help to calm the mind and keep stress and anxiety at bay.

We hope you enjoy your Fabulous Field Trip!

2316900.name: Metavaxx
2316900.about_the_game:
Develop the ultimate vaccine in Metavaxx, the world's first minesweeper shooter!

Your mission is to train your new vaccine in a selection of various body samples. In each one, you'll have to identify infected cells using your minesweeper detective skills, and either shoot down those cells and the agents hidden inside them, or clear the way around them, only removing the healthy cells. You win when there are either only healthy cells remaining, or only infected cells remaining. The more cells remain, the more points you'll get to level-up your vaccine with unique upgrades!

Carefully choose the order of your body samples, select your upgrades wisely, and try to make the most efficient and accessible vaccine to save as many people as you can around the world.

Ask your doctor if Metavaxx is right for you!
2316900.reviews:
“Metavaxx is a great game, serving as both a decent mishmash between minesweeper and shooter games, and a great introduction to PUNKCAKE Délicieux’s quirky yet bite-sized takes on games”
Indie Hive

Big Boss Battle
