Rock Paper Shotgun

2316930.name: Beat the Humans
2316930.about_the_game:
Beat the Humans is the turn-based tactical role-playing game. Here you lead a squad of aliens against invaders from the human race. Your choices as well as the tactical and combat skills of your soldiers will determine whether the free races of the galaxy will be able to resist the superior force of the human army.

On the space map the squad under your command will have to thwart enemy attacks. The help of allies is also important! Capture and defend planets, rescue civilians or destroy monsters on abandoned asteroids. By engaging in combat, you take control of your squad directly. Use abilities, explosives, melee and ranged weapons and the destructive power of combat robots in turn-based combat to destroy the enemy.

  • Assemble and upgrade your squad from a customized set of generated heroes.

  • Fight in complex turn-based battles, combining skills and using the battlefield situation to your advantage.

  • Control the galactic system, taking advantage of enemy vulnerabilities in time.

  • Collect artifacts that give you an advantage in battle.

2316950.name: Monster Battle
2316950.about_the_game:
"Monster Battle" is a fun and charming roguelike deckbuilder game featuring a colorful cast of cute monsters. Players will journey through a randomly generated world, using their deckbuilding skills to collect and train an army of monsters to defeat dangerous foes and reach their ultimate goal. With fast-paced, turn-based battles and a constantly changing world, "Monster Battle" offers a fun and challenging experience for players of all skill levels. The cute and playful art style, combined with the deep and engaging gameplay, make this game a joy to play for fans of roguelike deckbuilding games.
  • Resource Management: Manage your resources carefully to acquire new cards and abilities, and improve your chances of survival against the enemies of the night.
  • Customizable Decks: Build your own custom deck of cards by selecting from a range of powerful abilities, equipment, and allies, and tailor it to your preferred playstyle.
  • Unique Enemies: Battle against a variety of enemies that pose different threats, including undead creatures, hunters, and other supernatural beings.
  • Evolving Gameplay: Over time, new cards and abilities become available, making the gameplay richer and more complex as you progress through the game.
  • Multiple Paths to Victory: Discover different strategies to defeat your enemies and emerge victorious, whether through combat, diplomacy, or stealth.
  • Beautiful Artwork: Enjoy stunning artwork that captures the dark and brooding atmosphere of the vampire world, from haunting landscapes to terrifying creatures.
  • Replayability: With a wide range of cards, enemies, and game modes, the game offers high replayability, providing hours of entertainment for both casual and hardcore players.
  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: The game is easy to learn, but hard to master, making it accessible to players of all skill levels, while still providing a satisfying challenge for experienced players.

2316960.name: Moorhuhn 'Traps and Treasures'
2316960.about_the_game:
The Quest for the WHATSIT
An amulet lost 1000 years ago, the WHATSIT, has always been the Holy Grail of treasure hunters. Well, actually the Holy Grail is the treasure hunters' Holy Grail, but the WHATSIT comes right after it. And even Moorhuhn, the greatest adventurer among treasure hunters, cannot resist a hint as to the whereabouts of this relic. And so, he unceremoniously drops himself above the dense jungle and plunges headlong into the adventure.

In the depths of the dense jungle, the Moorhuhn follows the legend of an ancient, lost temple complex. Legendary treasures are said to lie hidden there, but above all a priceless treasure: the sacred amulet of WHATSIT!

Hidden traps, bad-tempered gorillas, aggressive crocodiles, strange shamans, forest spirits, temple guards, bats, warriors of the dead and stranded aliens require all the courage and skill of a real treasure hunter.

As you would expect from a proper jump and run platformer, you need to use all your physical strength, courage, and skill. Jumping and swinging, kicking, boxing and sometimes even shooting, Moorhuhn races through the depths of the jungle to find the treasure of treasures: The Amulet of WHATSIT.

But before that, there are all kinds of hostile opponents to defeat, obstacles to overcome and traps to avoid. And then there are some valuables to be found and collected.
You can replay unlocked levels at any time to improve your final score.

But that is not all! 6 new bonus levels not included in the original game bring further fun and the opportunity to collect additional points.

And when there is nothing left to collect and all the opponents have been defeated, you can still try to achieve a new best time.

FEATURES:
  • 21 jam-packed Jump and Run levels
  • 6 bonus levels
  • Jungle soundtrack
  • Animal animations
  • Cool bonus treasures
  • Rankings — Beat your own top scores over and over again and compete against friends and players around the world for the top position in the online leaderboard.
  • Online/Offline — Play whenever and wherever you like. No internet connection is needed to play. However, you will need an internet connection to upload your top score to the global leaderboard and see other players’ scores.
  • Community — With more than 15 million games sold, Moorhuhn is one of the best-known and most successful game characters. Join the large Moorhuhn community now!

Moorhuhn speaks English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish and Russian.

Enough talk. Get the game now and jump into the adventure!

Welcome to the foot of the Shlimalaya!

Well-hidden among the snowy crags of the mountain massif lies the monastery of SingSong. Since the beginning of time, the monks have watched over a fabulous relic - the HEART OF GOLD.

2317010.name: Periculum
2317010.about_the_game:
Periculum is a casual (turn-based or real-time) strategy game in which you conquer hexagonal tiles and build your empire on them. Gather resources (such as Gold, Wood, Stone, and Fish), construct buildings, and erect walls to strengthen your empire. Choose from different game modes and engage in epic battles against up to 7 bots or challenge your friends to see who comes out on top. With an extensive range of options (similar to a sandbox), the possibilities are endless. Take your strategy to the next level by creating your own unique maps inside the in-game level editor. The game is easy to learn, but with customizable settings, it can also offer a challenging experience. Playable with a mouse & keyboard on one screen or with motion controllers through virtual reality. Choose between different play styles such as turn-based (a player takes his turn, and the rest waits) or real-time (where everyone takes a turn at the same time).

8 Players (multiplayer)

You can play with up to 7 other online (or local) players or bots.

Choose one of 8 colors and maybe even team up with some friends or bots.

You and your friends can also play on your own custom levels/maps.

More than 7 Game Modes to choose from:

  • Default: Whoever is the last player who owns a hexagonal tile wins the game.

  • Capture the Flag: Capture enemy flags but don't lose your own flag or you will lose the game.

  • King of the Hill: Hold the hexagonal tile in the middle the longest to win.

  • Economy: Be the first player to collect a chosen amount of resources (decide between Gold, Wood, Stone, or Fish).

  • Conquer: The first player to conquer a defined amount of hexagonal tiles wins.

  • Regicide: Every player starts with a king, which he can move around but if the king is lost, the game will be lost too. The last player with a king left will win.

  • Battle Royale: With or without loot scattered around the map which can be collected by a player. The map shrinks over time until only 1 hexagonal tile remains. Whoever owns the last hexagonal tile wins the game.

Customization and Level-Editor

Build your own custom levels/maps with the Level Editor and share them with your friends.

Customize your gameplay with numerous options available to suit your preferences. Adjust resource lifespan, troop limits, map visibility (whether the entire map is visible or must be discovered first), and much more to tailor the game to your liking.

Buildings

  • University: unlock exciting upgrades for your army such as more damage or armor.

  • Marketplace: trade your collected resources with other players.

  • House: accommodates 5 residents, allowing you to train 5 more troops.

  • Wooden walls: can be used to defend one of your hexagonal tiles.

  • Stone walls: twice as strong as a wooden wall.

Soldier types:

  • Infantry: Standard

  • Cavalry: double price, double damage, double health, and can reach 2 hexagonal tiles.

  • Archer: can attack from 1 hexagonal tile away, deals standard damage but has double health. Only reaches 1 hexagonal tile per turn but can be upgraded to Cavalry Archer through University.

  • Cannon: does a lot of damage to buildings or other troops. Can hit a target 2 hexagonal tiles away. Can reach 1 hexagon per turn.

  • (Ships planned In the future)

2317070.name: MASKA
2317070.about_the_game:
What to do in the virtual world MASKA?

Getting bored from all the fun? Start a business, earn game currency and become successful. What’s your ideal world like? Explore Maska! Bonuses, promos, gifts, and, of course, positive emotions!

Your persona

Male or female, brunette or blond. Express your taste and creativity! Come up with your unique look and personality with the help of our advanced editor. Simple but powerful, it allows a quick-and-easy creation or detailed, elaborate appearance, that can impress even experienced lovers or life sims.

Time to party!

You don’t need an excuse to show your skills on the dance floor! Hot parties, cool music and a great mood are waiting for you every day. Learn new moves and impress the crowd!

Relationships

Find a special someone. What will your first date be like? In a club, out for a walk, or maybe at work? How will your story develop? Everything depends on you! Fall in love or even create a family.

Transportation

The virtual word has transportation to support your virtual freedom. Regular cars? Boring! Show your style: gather a full collection from a spacecraft to a magical unicorn!

Interactive objects

Get immersed the help of interactive objects. Unique effects and animations are waiting at the store and around countless virtual environments. Discover them all and have fun on a new level!

Adventures

Every day - new things to do. Finish quests and earn game currency. More adventures - more money earned to check out all the awesome things at the store.

Express emotions

Are you angry, happy or maybe amused? MASKA is a world where everyone can freely express their feelings. With the use of actions and avatar’s facial expressions, of course :) A full spectrum of human emotions is available to choose from.

Real estate

Set up your dream home, whether it’s an apartment or a house. Our intuitive editor has everything you need for building and decor. Unleash your creativity and invite friends to check it out!

Work

Shopping

2317080.name: Asura's Trial
2317080.about_the_game:
Learn new skills based on simple key combinations in this easy to learn, hard to master adventure RPG. Chain over 100 different skills from 5 diverse classes to create an unbeatable combination and reclaim your body by finishing Asura's Trial.

You were once a noble adventurer until your body was taken over by a demon. You wake inside the mind of the demon Asura, trapped together with all the other
souls the demon has consumed over the ages. It's your goal to recover your body, slaying the lost souls within the demon's mind, gaining the skills they had in life and finally slaying the demon Asura.

Features:
  • Unlock over a hundred skills made from simple key combination which you can chain for devastating effects
  • Develop a unique character each run by raising your stats and drafting a unique skillset
  • Cute 2d graphics
  • Unique enemies within each encounter

Asura's Trial comes with:

  • 3 levels each with their unique encounters and atmosphere
  • 100+ unlockable skills
  • 3 different starting characters

P.S I developed this game as a solo developer, to bring to life something which I believe would be cute and cool.

2317110.name: Shapeless
2317110.about_the_game: In this short action game, you start off as a prisoner locked up in a jail cell. The game features various obstacles and challenges that players must overcome to progress. As you escape the prison, you encounter guards and other enemies that are determined to stop you from escaping. The game incorporates combat elements, allowing you to fight and defeat these enemies. You must be strategic and tactical in your approach, as you face stronger enemies as you progress through the level. The game also features a puzzle that you would have to solve to unlock the good ending. As you progress through the game, you encounter NPCs who may offer advice and guidance, and also provide clues to help you solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. The game is not easy and may require several attempts to beat. Overall, the game is a short action-packed adventure that tests players' combat, puzzle-solving, and strategic skills.

2317120.name: In Ukrainian Soil
2317120.about_the_game:
In memory of those, whose lives were taken by the Russian invaders, erasing peaceful Ukrainian cities from the face of the earth and committing other acts of genocide and crimes against humanity.

Today in Ukraine, we are all in a close relationship with death. So we decided to look behind her and share this journey with you.

An innocent soul is trapped in the depths of the ruins of a home shattered by a rocket.

She turns into a small seed from which a flower grows and reaches out with its roots to other bodies trapped among the rubble to help restless souls find their way to heaven...

Soar through the transcendental realm and guide lost souls to heaven's gates in this rhythm-fueled psychodelic racing game.

Game features

  • Otherwordly visuals
  • Dark psytrance soundtracks from well-known producers
  • Dynamic transcendental flight gameplay
  • Infinite procedurally generated environments
  • The narrative twists and turns around the odyssey of the ethereal essence, beyond the veil of mortality

2317140.name: PINO THE ELEMENTAL
2317140.about_the_game:
This game has several levels and stages.
where each level requires a different strategy to advance.
use equipment or accessories to advance, collect pets to help in battles.
each pet has a specific spell combo.
each boss has a different difficulty according to the play style.

This game recalls the molds of the old titles, with fast movement and action.
The artwork in this game is unlike anything you've ever imagined.

2317170.name: I REMEMBER
2317170.about_the_game:
With a focus on psychological horror, 'I REMEMBER' will leave you on edge as you experience the gut-wrenching tension and horrifying story. Expect to see distorted environments, eerie sound design, and MIND, bending puzzles that will test your psychological stability. The game's FOCUS. on implicit horror means that the fear is not solely based on jump scares, but on a deep-seated dread that will STAY WITH you long after you've finished playing.



Step into the shoes of a Father and Son as they navigate the challenges of taking care of one another. Things take a turn for the worse when moving your fathers belonging from his old apartment to your own. Immerse yourself in a first-person experience filled with subtle, implicit terror and elements of survival horror. Traverse through a decaying environment, as you fight and hide from the terror that consumes us all.

As you play, pay close attention to the details within the dialogue and environments, as they will help you piece the story together.

Do you have what it takes to confront the fears that lurk in the shadows and uncover the truth behind 'I REMEMBER'? Find out in this gripping interpretation of an already popular concept.



ME. Laud - the coolest guy of all time.

Huge thanks to Unrested / Inksmith for creating the Art of 'Mother' used in this game. You can check him out on YouTube @Unrested or at @Inksmith or DON'T

Huge thanks to Monk for making awesome music as well as taking my terrible MIDI music and producing it into something useful and awesome.

Huge thanks to MXXN for taking commissions on super short notice and creating awesome music for me to use!

Can't FORGET. DaveFace, the genius behind Unreal Retro Shader.

2317180.name: Cube Crusaders
2317180.about_the_game:
Adoros is dying.

A catastrophic Void Anomaly threatens to tear open Adoros' surface, warping reality and unleashing forces no one fully understands. You are a Cube Crusader, sent to deal with this threat for the continued success of the Crusades.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CRUSADER

Enjoy a full customization system inspired by a classic arena shooter that rhymes with Kalo. Mix and match your favourite pieces, apply particle effects, and visor colours to get the perfect look.

CAMPAIGN

Take on Adoros' various metroidvania style underground as you seek to crush the Void Anomaly and the horrors it produces alone, or with a local couch co-op buddy. 

The means by which you achieve this is up to you. You can further challenge yourself with Curse Modifiers to make the game more challenging, or to heavily alter the experience.

PVE HORDE MODE - LOCAL OR ONLINE:

Something underground has inflicted great suffering on the Cube Crusaders on the surface of Adoros, and turned them into Cube-Eating zombies! Fight for survival as the horde becomes more numerous and powerful with each new wave, with up to 24 players online (2 locally) against this endless onslaught...

2317190.name: retro life
2317190.about_the_game:
create the life of your dreams, in this classic real time life simulation/rpg game.

will you become the success story to make your parents proud? or a hopeless loser? the choice is yours!

features
  • climb the corporate ladder in 8 different career tracks (including a criminal career track).
  • become an entrepreneur and start 1 of 3 different businesses.
  • earn 1 of 4 different degrees at the retro university college.
  • improve 6 different stats.
  • move out of your parents place and move up in the world.
  • pay rent and manage finances.
  • risk your life savings in the stock market, or at the casino. Or play it safe and earn interest in a savings account.
  • get married, and start a family. with 5 bachelorettes to woo. each with there own unique story.
  • befriend the 4 other bachelorettes male counterparts to progress a new unique story between them.

2317220.name: Project Break//Down
2317220.about_the_game:
Overview

Project: Break//Down is a experimental 3D action-adventure brawler with a unique limb-based combat system. In this game you explore the EZON complex a mass production and distribution facility secretly gone rogue in the shoes of 2 fools.

Smash, Bash, and Mash your enemies

Project: Break//Down utilises a unique physics based limb system where you can disable, dismantle and destroy your enemies, the limb system allows for dynamic flinch and ragdoll to allow for the satisfying feeling of weight and impact to every hit.

Anything you can grab it a weapon

Grab anything in the environment you can get your hands on to dynamically change how you fight your enemies form; bottles, paint cans, an old pole, a plank of wood or even your foes limbs.

Abuse the physics system

Use physics and magnetic abilities to cause havoc and chaos for your foes in combat

Explore the rogue EZON facility

Explore the facility after a secret robot revolution and discover the madness and shenanigans of the facility formed from laziness and incompetency.

2317250.name: Neko House
2317250.about_the_game:
Play as Mikan, a cat running a small shelter for strays. 

Care for each cat, build trust over time, and help them find a home. Every day is limited, and every decision matters. You won't be able to do everything, so choosing what to prioritize becomes part of the experience. 

Not every adoption will go as planned. 

 Each day has limited actions, forcing you to prioritize

 Balance cat care, exploration, and shelter responsibilities 

 Feed, groom, and play with each cat once per day

 Build bonding/trust over time through consistent care

 Different items affect how quickly cats bond with you

 Find Stray cats throughout the town and bring them to your shelter 

 Poor performance over time can impact your finances and reputation

 Choose when a cat is ready, knowing each adoption carries risk

 Visit locations like the cemetery, Meowket, and town hall

 Find items, encounter stray cats, and uncover small stories

 Interact with townspeople who may return as adopters

Neko House is a quiet management game about care, routine, and small decisions. There's no rush, but you won't be able to do everything in a day.

English*, French*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

2317290.name: EvoCreo 2
2317290.about_the_game:
Step into the world of Shoru, a land inhabited by powerful creatures known as Creo. These monsters have existed for millennia—yet their origins remain shrouded in mystery. Will you be the one to uncover the truth?

Begin your journey as a new cadet in the Shoru Police Academy. Mysterious disappearances of Creo are sweeping the land—but this is just the beginning. As you investigate, you’ll uncover hidden plots and ancient secrets. Explore the continent of Shoru along the way with over 50 missions that expand the world and its lore.

With over 300 unique Creo to discover and capture, the possibilities are endless. Assemble powerful teams, experiment with synergies, and find your favorite combinations. Each Creo comes in multiple color variations—hunt them down and make your collection truly one of a kind. Whether you prefer brute strength, tactical control, or status effects, there’s a Creo to match every strategy.

Discover a beautifully crafted pixel-art world with over 30 hours of offline gameplay. From hidden caves to bustling cities, Shoru is filled with secrets, rare Creo, and unique encounters.

Customize your Creo with over 100 traits, equippable items, and 200+ unique moves that can be swapped at any time. Whether you're preparing for a boss fight or PvP battle, tailor your strategy to suit every challenge.

Compete against players in Online Ranked Battles [Coming Soon], or challenge your friends to casual matches. Prefer to play solo? You can experience the full adventure completely offline.

Face down powerful Evokers across Shoru and rise through the ranks to conquer the Coliseum. Only the best will earn the title of Evoking Master.

• 30+ hours of offline story-driven gameplay
• Over 300 Creo to capture, train, and evolve
• No level caps on your monsters
• Deep battle mechanics with hundreds of moves and traits
• Competitive online battles and ranked matchmaking [Coming Soon]
• Fully offline-capable — no internet required
• Multiple color variants for every Creo

2317300.name: Access Denied: Escape
2317300.about_the_game:
In the future, people no longer trust computer networks and prefer to use physical devices to store important information. You are a professional hacker of such Data Vaults. However, your latest job didn't go according to plan, and you're now locked in a scientist's laboratory. In order to escape, you need to not only complete the work, but also uncover the secret of this place.

Access Denied: Escape is a 3D device-hacking puzzle game. Unlock the Data Vault, examine the devices around you, and use the notes to learn about events that took place here. Use your wits and powers of observation to discover the secret hidden within the walls of this laboratory. After all, it's the only way you can get out of here alive!


  • Explore the lab in first-person view;
  • 30 Data Vaults that you must hack;
  • Various devices and mechanisms that you can interact with;
  • Explore the surroundings and the notes left behind to uncover the mystery of this place.

2317310.name: Hentai　HOTLADY
2317310.about_the_game:
This is another story of Kozue Nada, a popular character in 'HOT FIT!'
It contains many intense, sexy, and abnormal scenes with the main character of the original story.
There is also a part from Kozue's point of view, which adds depth to the story.

Kozue, who has become the temporary manager of a fitness gym, teases me as usual.
This escalates into a relationship where they have sex.
As I plays with her, I becomes immersed in intense, abnormal sex.
But I wonders if that's all I wants to do with her.

Different choices lead to different scenes and endings.
And from CONFIG, you can adjust the volume and change the clothes of the standing picture.
Enjoy the sensual play that takes place in the sports gym!

■Costume
14 patterns can be changed

■Change Language(Supports Language)
Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
Window menu「System setting(S)」→「System(C)」→「Text tab」の「Language」
Chinese fonts are easy to see with Simsun easy to read.

2317320.name: Orb Devils
2317320.about_the_game:
Deck Building Roguelike with a twist!

A silly little Deckbuilding card battler! Attack enemies, Gain Block, Get Cards/Relics, Remove Cards, and kill enemies! However, you can use your cards on more then yourself and enemies:

Use Cards on Status effects!

Damage your Bleed to remove it or at least soften the blow! Heal your own Might to deal even more damage! Heal enemy Bleed to make them die faster!

Use Cards on Enemy intentions!

Destroy enemies attacks, Offense is the best Defense!

Use Cards on Relics!

A relic that lets you use 1 card on all enemies? Great for a deck around building up one super strike! A relic that lets you save a card for next turn? Could help with all sorts of combos. Find all sorts of "Active" relics!

But most importantly...

Combine Card Orbs via Keywords!

Use Cards on Cards! Cards will have all sorts of keywords that change how they work.

Potent cards will increase all Healing and status effects on a card! Useful for stacking all sorts of effects!

Cheap cards will cost less then they would otherwise!

Any more!

These effects are great on their own, but even more powerful when put on another card! Plan your deck around powerful combinations.

Original Card

After some Combining!

Real Talk

This game is made by 1 solo developer who just really likes card games who truly hopes you have a bit of fun playing this silly little game!

*languages with full audio support

2317330.name: Trance, Trauma
2317330.about_the_game:
Who Are You?

A woman who killed herself.

Where Are You?

In 3 surreal hexagon rooms.

What Are In These Rooms?

Secret messages to decode, hidden clues to jot down, Morse code to translate, equations to solve ... and around 2 - 3 hours of unique, hand-crafted puzzles that will put your problem-solving skills to the test.

Why Are You Here?

To uncover a tragic incident and the events that led to my death.

What Else?

  • A parrot to feed
  • A piano to play
  • A plantable seed
  • A picture to take
  • An ear to listen
  • A heart to give
  • A chair on the floor
  • And many more
  • (No cats)

2317340.name: Rabbi-T
2317340.about_the_game:
You are Rabbi-T, the latest Rabbit Robot developed by Wilson Company, the leading toy company of the time.
Your mission is to subdue the giant robot 'ACTO' that is going on a rampage in an underground incinerator.
Get to the top of his head in a blink of an eye using your specialty, running. And hit his weakness, the red button.

Incinerator will be full of obstacles, and ACTO will create a number of creative disruptions.
Fortunately, you have a powerful punch that can blow them up.
Keep an eye on the obstacles as they approach and punch them out.
Destruction of the obstacle will give you higher speed.
The faster you run, the faster ACTO falls.
The number of electronic carrots you will receive will increase as well.

2317390.name: ToyLand
2317390.about_the_game:
Help Hana, who has fallen into the world of abandoned toys, 'Toyland', return to the real world!!

If you defend at the right timing of the enemy's attack, you can parry, and you can create a command attack by combining weak and heavy mouse attacks.

Combine the attacks to defeat the toys and the boss King Crown that attack one, and listen to the story behind them!!

Toyland is a 3D back view hack and slash game where you advance while defeating the waves of enemies. Feel the cool action feeling in Toy Land!

Do you remember playing with your eldest son when you were little?
If you remember playing with toys, where are the older boys now?

Here is Toyland, a world of toys forgotten and abandoned by their owners!

- This game supports operation through a gamepad.

2317420.name: Aether Fly
2317420.about_the_game:
Go on a journey through countless dimensions shaped by bullets and sound.

Take Control of an Aether Fly
Control an "Aether Fly", an inter-dimensional space insect, as you make your way through the aether stream.
Dodge and survive the hazards of your current environment as you generate a portal that will allow you to slip into the next world.

The Sound of the World
An Aether Fly can sense the sound of the world, giving it (and you) an indication of the dangers that linger in the environment,
meaning everything around you will be in sync to the music of the world.

The Shape of the World
Each world you visit has it's own set of wonders (and dangers).
Dodge bullets that come from the environment, as well as other inter-dimensional creatures that inhabit the world.

The Flow of the World
Ever changing and ever moving forward, each world will present a different experience.

Metamorphosis
As time passes, much like the aether fly, you may find this game take on many different forms. Transforming not only how you play Aether Fly, but also your understanding of what an "Aether Fly" is.

As "Indie" as Indie Gets
Aether Fly is crafted and published by a single person without
AI assistance or any funding from external sources outside the Aether Fly community,
ensuring that the authenticity and freedom of the games growth will be lead solely by the vision of it's creator
and the feedback of it's community.

This is just the beginning, stay tuned.

2317440.name: Beasts Vs Legends
2317440.about_the_game:
In the magical realm of "Beasts vs Legends," you'll step into the shoes of the King, the respected ruler of a land filled with mythical Legends. Everything takes a sudden turn when merciless beasts invade, driven by the desire to rule and destroy the peaceful home of the Legends. As the courageous King, your mission is clear – to save the Legends, unite them under your leadership, and stand against the invading forces threatening the harmony of your realm. It's a journey of bravery, where you'll gather the Legends to stand together against the looming threat.

Embark on a Vast Open World Adventure

Dive into a mesmerizing open world, brimming with wonders and perils. Explore lush landscapes, mysterious ruins, and encounter fantastical creatures as you navigate through the sprawling terrain. The open world of "Beasts vs Legends" invites you to unravel the secrets of this magical realm and forge your path in the face of adversity.

Unlock Magical Weapons and Unleash Your Power

As the King, your journey is marked by progression and discovery. Unlock a vast array of magical weapons, spells, and abilities as you advance through the game. Each step brings you closer to becoming a formidable force against the invading beasts. Customize your arsenal, master magical powers, and unveil the true potential of your character.

Command Your Army of Legends

In the heart of the conflict, you are not alone. Command a diverse army of Legends, each with unique abilities and strengths. Strategically choose your companions, forming a powerful alliance to face the relentless beasts. Your decisions as a leader will shape the outcome of the battles and the fate of the Legends who follow your banner.

Experience the Epic War and Unravel the Story

Immerse yourself in the epic tale of "Beasts vs Legends." Engage in intense battles, witness the clash of mythical forces, and experience the highs and lows of a war for survival. Unravel the intricacies of the narrative, confront powerful adversaries, and discover the obscured truths that lie beneath the surface of this legendary conflict.

As the King, your destiny awaits in "Beasts vs Legends." Lead your Legends, explore the open world, wield magical weapons, and write the story of a realm teetering on the brink of chaos. Are you ready to answer the call and become the savior your Legends need?

2317540.name: Ocean Man
2317540.about_the_game:
This is a role-playing turn-based game. In the game, you will play a captain and lead your team to explore the ocean and find the treasure! You need to sail in the ocean, explore different islands, sometimes encounter sea monsters. You will find new partners, expand your team and adventure with them.

Feature:

  • Beautiful Ocean

The real and fantasy sea, your ship sails on the sea,
Different weather and day and night systems make you immersive.




  • Ocean Adventure

There are many different marine life in the sea,
Including dolphins, turtles, sharks and more than 20 kinds of creatures,
Some sea creatures will frighten and run away when they see you,
There are also some sea creatures that will actively attack you,
You can even capture them as partners,
Make sea adventure more exciting and fun.




  • Many Game Modes

A variety of different game modes, such as island exploration,
ocean battle, sea monster challenges, and more.




  • Pet Systems

The pet system is very special, each pet has different characteristics,
Some are born geniuses, some are late bloomers, with Superman cards,
It can be said that there are many ways to play, and there are many different genres.




  • Global PVP

Players can duel with players from all over the world,
Further deepen the interaction between players.

2317550.name: Stellar Insurgency
2317550.about_the_game:
Stellar Insurgency is a single-player, 3D, Open World, space game with rts and rpg elements. Explore a galaxy of 300 systems as you control your fleet in a top-down 3D style, navigating through Star-lanes, Warp gates, and Black holes. Customize and upgrade your fleet, complete missions, trade, hire your crew, wage war and determine the fate of the galaxy in this grand sim saga.



Major Features

  • Explore a galaxy of 300 systems controlling your fleet in a 3D top-down style.
  • Three playable Factions plus three additional.
  • Cross the galaxy through Star-lanes, Warp gates and Black holes.
  • Customize and upgrade your fleet consisting from Fighters to Carriers and Battleships.



  • Acquire techs via researching a well-structured tech tree.
  • Complete missions that impact your relations with galaxy’s factions.
  • Forge alliances, wage war and determine the fate of the galaxy.
  • Hire crew to improve the stats of your fleet.
  • Be a pirate (if you want to).
  • Make profit through trade.

Minor Features

  • Explore stellar objects through exploration probes.
  • Three levels of defense Stealth, Shields and Armor prior to component and hull damage.
  • Use warp drive to jump locally and through solar systems.
  • Board Enemy vessels through boarding probes or transporters.
  • Several classes of weapons that include, laser-turrets, beams, missiles, flak (anti-fighter).
  • Place or avoid mine fields.

2317560.name: 3 Days War
2317560.about_the_game:
Background:


In 2069, humanity discovered a high-energy density mineral, the Black Stone. Countries vied for control of this resource, leading to conflicts that culminated in a global war in 2085, known as the First Black Stone War. Five years after the war began, humanity developed the Core-Gear, a giant war machine powered by Black Stone. Its immense combat capabilities had an immediate impact on the war, and within a year, the world briefly returned to peace. The world split into three major factions: the Black Eagle Union representing democracy and freedom, the White Bear Front representing the people, and the neutral Suzaku Covenant in the East. However, true peace never arrived, and the crisis of war continues...

Features:


Innovative Real-time 4X Game
A creative fusion of RTS and 4X core experience, with real-time battles and minimalistic operation, allowing players to focus more on development, strategy, and social interaction.



Grid-based strategic rules
Expansion, construction, development, and battles occur in real-time and intuitively in the "grid". A large battlefield composed of over 10,000 grids supports dozens of players to cooperate and compete.



RougeLike elements in strategy building
In the process of developing an empire, players will continuously have the opportunity to choose "pondering cards". After dozens of random three-choice selections, you will eventually build your own strategic card combination.



Heroic mechas that determine the outcome of battles
Dozens of distinct heroes drive Core-Gear to gallop across the battlefield. With the reasonable use of heroes' "active strategic skills", one can dominate the war.

Game modes:


Adventure mode
Follow the plot to become familiar with the basic game rules, and gradually deepen your understanding of the game's world view.



Evacuation mode
16 players participate in a 3-day grand strategic confrontation. Find a teammate, become the commander and lead everyone to victory!



Alliance mode
18 players are divided into three factions for a 5-day grand strategic confrontation. Instead of simply eliminating opponents, become a true strategist through cooperation and alliances!

Camp Introduction


White Bear Front Arms
The design mainly highlights the characteristics of heavy industry and heavy machinery and uses heavy bomb weapons and electromagnetic weapons. For example, the K-47 Aviation Fortress: the only weapon in the game that can provide a powerful ground strike in the air, and it is very difficult to sink



Black Hawk Combined Arms
The design mainly highlights the characteristics of modern high-tech combat troops, and a large number of optical weapons are used.For example, Rhino Heavy Tank: is the toughest tank in the game, has an energy shield, and can withstand high damage in frontline combat



Vermilion Phoenix Alliance Force.
The design mainly emphasizes the combination of classical and technological elements, and the tech tree features an Eastern mystical style. Currently, still in the design and production stage...

2317570.name: Crazy Designer
2317570.about_the_game:
A strategy and simulation game about interior design.


There are hundreds different kinds of family which has different request.

2317610.name: Demon Tormentor
2317610.about_the_game: A girl in a desperate situation summons a demon to save her father, but the ritual goes terribly wrong. Now she seeks help from an experienced occult investigator. Perform magic rituals, avoid hidden dangers, look for secrets, and gather artifacts as you shoot demons and monsters in this dark and immersive underground VR action-adventure shooter.

2317640.name: JUMP KING QUEST
2317640.about_the_game:
JUMP KING QUEST is your new favourite platforming-climbing-adventure from HELL!

Packed with irresponsibly ambitious features! Combat, Upgrading, Fast-Travel*, Bosses?! In a Climbing Game!? Only in Jump King Quest!

Guess what!?

Welcome to The Heights - a sprawling melting pot of Mudmen and other despicable undesirables. All you know is that Up Is Right, and Right is also Might!

But remember… In this world, it’s Never Game Over! Instead, you must pick yourself back up every time!

 

 

Do you even FEEL that you are in the ONLINE ADVENTURE of your LIFETIME?!

Team up with friends or explore alone! Nexile’s novel online-system lets you encounter others dynamically on your journey to The Top! But in a world where the only law is gravity, who can you trust?

(Jump King Quest is also playable in offline mode!)

 

Master the JUMP, unique WEAPONS and PARRYING in a harmony of hilarious violence!

With its roots in fighting-games, this deceptively simple yet high-skill-ceiling’d combat-system is the perfect blend of “Souls-Like” and bing bing WAHOO!

Cower in fear, then learn to dominate with your choice among an arsenal of 60+ tools of war and gain Mastery.

 

Classic old-school HARDCORE gaming with GROUNDBREAKING bold NEW design choices!

Did you ever want to get kicked while you’re down? These bastards won’t hold back!!

Combat mighty foes, annoying friends, innocent strangers and perhaps thousands that want to stop YOU from reaching the TOP!

 

Live out your deep dark RPG fantasies in a system that both giveth and taketh…

Four dualities will make up your own unique persona, and grow all throughout your journey in accordance with your philosophy...

Feeling weak?! Explore the meticulously designed interconnected world of The Heights to unlock new paths, complete quests, and find the upgrades you need!

 

The End Times are upon The Heights, but from the darkness you rise to the call of The Smoking Hot Babe at The Top… From among the Mudmen known as “Redfins”, THE CHOSEN ONE will rise…

Will you stop Evil Lord Krulk from stealing the Babe Powers and ruining Equilibrium? There can be only ONE TRUE JUMP KING!

(Smoking Hot Babe to be added in Act Three!)

2317680.name: Koloni
2317680.about_the_game:
Koloni is a city-building strategy game that puts you in charge of a group of pioneers who have discovered a new land to colonize. However, you're not alone in your quest to settle on this uncharted territory, as other groups have their sights set on the same land.

Koloni is the brainchild of a single developer who is deeply invested in the project. If you have any thoughts, suggestions, or critiques, please don't hesitate to contact me. Your feedback will be carefully considered and appreciated.

2317690.name: Untold Love Stories
2317690.about_the_game:
Dive into a multiverse where everything is possible: romance, new meetings, adventures and even mystery. Choose the story you like or go through all, living many lives.

Untold Love Stories is a collection of short visual novels in different genres and art styles. You have to play for the main characters and make choices that will determine their destiny.

Unexpected Meeting (episode 1) is a spicy visual novel in 3D. Lucy works as a waitress at a roadside cafe. She once dreamed of becoming a famous actress, but one day she faced a cruel reality. Can one meeting change her life for the better? This is exactly what you will have to find out!

Jane's Mystery Story (episode 1) is a 2D detective visual novel. Jane lives the life of an ordinary high school student until strange things start to happen to her. Can Jane solve all the secrets, find love and herself? Everything depends only on you!

The Survivor (episode 1) is a story in a post-apocalyptic setting with pixel art style. In the near future, the world has been attacked by an unknown virus and natural disasters. You are one of the few who survived. But are you ready for the twists and turns of fate and new meetings that lie ahead of you?

2317700.name: SPRYDITE
2317700.about_the_game:
Sprydite is an action-adventure, survival with immersive RPG elements in a large open world. Science fiction set in a post-apocalyptic and cyberpunk backwoods setting with a small touch of surrealism.

The player will be able to immerse himself in the exploration of the world with a non-linear narrative, the ability to make choices and influence the environment, to play one or another role depending on his preferences and views.

World Story

In the game world, in 2029, a catastrophic event occurred when there was a malfunction of experimental quantum engines on the private space stations "Robinson" and "Rascvet-2". "Robinson" fell from orbit and crashed on the territory of the fictional country of Bieknur. The collision caused a brief space-time distortion due to the activated quantum engine, resulting in a sudden change in the local relief in the area of the crash, which was subsequently named the "Wandering Horizon." The government closed the anomalous zone and contracted with the private corporation NTechS to protect the area. The corporation began to build a wall and the Megallun system that would later isolate the Wandering Horizon from the outside world.

Over the past nine years, the anomalous zone has undergone significant changes: the anomalies have begun to spontaneously expand, despite all efforts to contain them. Researchers record the appearance of new types of mutants and parasites, as well as strange distortions called “super transformations”. The Corporation's researchers sign non-disclosure agreements to keep the results of their research confidential.

As a result of the Corporation's experiments with glumtra-radiation, a second incident occurred, causing the Megallun Towers to malfunction and subsequently fail. This event caused the zone to expand dramatically and triggered an apocalypse-like global crisis.

The global crisis of the SPRYDITE world

When the anomalous zone expanded significantly, the surrounding regions were critically threatened. The powerful anomalous electromagnetic radiation and the appearance of mutated creatures forced the government to conduct emergency evacuations of the population of these areas, leaving towns and villages empty. Many of these communities became abandoned ruins where nature and the anomalies took over.

After the second incident, anomalous radiation from the epicenter continued to affect electronics even in neighboring countries. However, ways were found to circumvent these problems through the use of gravity stones and super-glumtra-radiation-based technologies. Gravity stones have become a rare and valuable resource mined on the fringes of the epicenter.

Amidst the global crisis, seekers, gangs and powerful organizations rush to the dangerous fringes of the zone in pursuit of profit. Despite the deadly threat from anomalous magnetic radiation and parasites that turn humans into monsters, people continue to take risks to mine valuable gravity stones and GL-biomaterials.

On the fringes of the epicenter, social and governmental structures have all but collapsed. Economic collapse and electronics problems have led to chaos and instability. Traditional forms of power and control have lost their effectiveness, creating ideal conditions for the dictate of corporate interests, as well as for the activity of bandits and looters.

Protagonist of the main narrative:

Bulat is the protagonist, seeking to enter the dangerous zone of the epicenter called “Wandering Horizon” to find information about a missing loved one. However, his mission is much more complicated than it seems. Before starting his search, Bulat has to find his way to the areas of the epicenter, which becomes the starting point of an exciting adventure full of unexpected twists and turns and dangerous challenges. The hero's path will lead him to new acquaintances, unexpected alliances and meetings with insidious enemies. Although Bulat is ready to overcome any obstacles for the sake of his goal, the outcome of events will depend on the choice the player will make.

Features:

  • Open world.

  • Basic plot and various quests.

  • Interesting moments and random events.

  • Caves and underwater exploration.

  • 4 different biomes, forests, abandoned villages and towns.

  • Change of day and night, with changing weather conditions.

  • A system of quests and dialogues.

  • Ability upgrade tree, including rare superpower implants.

  • An extensive selection of weapons, equipment, resources and various items for survival.

  • Character needs for food, water, etc.

  • Friendly factions and marauders.

  • Ability to have robots or human companions.

  • Relationships with Characters

  • Battles with various enemies such as monsters, bandits, and robot guards.

  • Transportation.

  • Inventory system.

  • Crafting and repairing items.

  • Building a base and home.

  • Fishing.

  • Farming and poultry farming.

  • Farming, growing vegetables and plants.

  • Making tinctures from Gl plants, vegetables, and mushrooms.

  • Cooking, preparation of various dishes.

  • Building machines or entire factories to process ore, wood, and produce various items.

  • Digging, searching for treasure and mutated worms.

  • An extensive system of trade and entrepreneurship in the game.

Multiplayer:

2317790.name: Titan: The Ascension
2317790.about_the_game:
Titan: The Ascension is a colony management and survival strategy game set on Saturn’s moon Titan.

You take control of a corporation tasked with establishing humanity’s first large-scale off-world colony while Earth is collapsing due to extreme water shortages caused by climate change and global conflict. Your mission is not only survival on Titan, but also supporting Earth’s remaining population through resource extraction and interplanetary trade.

Earth–Titan Resource Network

On Titan, you will explore the frozen northern regions of the moon to locate and extract valuable ice deposits hidden beneath the surface. These resources are mined, processed, and converted into usable water, forming the core of a critical supply chain that connects Titan to Earth. The extracted water is transported across space to support Earth’s collapsing infrastructure and remaining population, where resource scarcity has reached extreme levels. In exchange, Earth provides financial credits, raw materials, and advanced technological components that are essential for expanding, upgrading, and maintaining your growing colony on Titan. This interplanetary exchange system becomes the foundation of your progression, driving both survival and expansion as you balance extraction efficiency with colony development needs.

Colony Infrastructure and Industrial Expansion

You will design and expand a large industrial network across the frozen surface of Titan, building the systems needed to support a growing off-world operation. This includes managing production chains, establishing efficient logistics routes, and connecting multiple facilities into a functioning economy. Before permanent human habitation is possible, you must construct essential resource processing systems, stabilize supply lines, and prepare the groundwork for future dome-based colonist housing. Every structure you build plays a role in transforming a hostile environment into a sustainable colony capable of long-term survival and expansion.

Ancient Threats and Colony Defense

As your presence on Titan grows, you will uncover remnants of an ancient automated system buried beneath the surface. These dormant machines are not passive. Their core directive is to eliminate all technological activity on Titan. As your colony advances, these systems begin to awaken and actively target your infrastructure.

You must defend your expanding colony using tactical defense systems, including orbital support, automated weapons, and strategic planning to survive escalating threats.

Core Features

  • Colony building and industrial expansion on Titan

  • Resource extraction of ice and water conversion systems

  • Interplanetary trade between Earth and Titan

  • Logistics and supply chain management

  • Progressive base development from outpost to full colony

  • Defensive gameplay against hostile ancient automated systems

  • Strategic survival under environmental and technological threats

Titan: The Ascension combines large-scale colony planning with survival pressure, resource economy, and defensive strategy in a hostile off-world environment. You must carefully balance expansion, production efficiency, and resource distribution while adapting to an unforgiving alien landscape. Every decision impacts the stability of your colony, from industrial growth and supply chains to defense readiness and long-term sustainability. As your operation expands, new threats emerge and systems become more complex, requiring strategic planning and constant adaptation to ensure survival and continued progress on Titan.

2317810.name: Elevatrix
2317810.about_the_game: "Descend into a chilling adventure with this first-person indie horror shooter. In this game, you take control of a protagonist who must navigate a haunted building, using an elevator to move between floors. Each floor presents unique and challenging puzzles that you must solve to proceed to the next level. But the building is not empty—undead enemies lurk in the shadows, ready to attack at any moment. To survive, you must manage your resources, solve puzzles quickly, and keep an eye on the timer. If the timer reaches zero, your fate is sealed. Experience the tension and terror as you uncover the secrets hidden within each floor."

2317870.name: WorldWide Warfare League of Cities
2317870.about_the_game:
Join the fray and take part of the final battle.

Play the game as a singleplayer with bots or play it in multiplayer mode with your friends.

Create a server and invite your friends in a private world or create an open world and play with other players online.

Choose between three maps unique maps, Harmagadon, Alaqsa(Dome of the Rock) and Aalborg(Vesterbro).

Two of the maps are inspired from real world locations both from the fare ancient to the modern world as we know it today.

Add friends to your list. Create a clan and invite others to your team.

Customize weapons to your needs by choosing different camo skins or by adding or removing attachments.

Customize your profile with emblems and callingcards with real world flags and symbols.

Achieve higher levels and unlock more wapons, emplems and callingcards.

2317880.name: Bullet Bunny
2317880.about_the_game:
Fight and fend off waves of enemies in this twin stick shooter game with rogue-like elements!

Features

  • Twin-stick shooter

  • Rogue-like: As you play, you will unlock new characters, guns, and backgear!

  • Level up and choose from over 75 powerups!

  • Characters are unique with there own supers and passives!

  • Different modes like Endless Mode & Dark Mode!

Variety of Guns

Tons of guns to choose from, ranging from your basic pistol to intense toxic blasters. Unlock and master them all!

Hero's with unique Supers

Characters are unique with their own supers and passives. From magnet throwing bunnies to blood bursting spells, each character offers a different experience. More characters planned post-launch.

  

Powerups & Masteries

Every time you level up choose from over 75 powerups. Find what powerups suit you best and build the most overpowered set up!

Intense Bosses

Defeat intense bosses every run!

2317890.name: Hat'venture
2317890.about_the_game:
Would you throw yourself into a well if asked? No, of course not. Unless someone stole your hair. Travel through the underground world dodging obstacles and eliminating monsters that block your way. But beware, you're not the only one chasing your hair.

Travel deeper and deeper
You will travel through a randomly generated world in this roguelike shoot 'em up. Avoid all obstacles to go faster and faster through the depths. But be careful, depth means danger.

Hats
Retrieve hats during your trip. Now that you are bald, they will give you power. You want more ? Upgrade each hats while you have money !

Simple but challenging
You can jump, dodge or shoot. Simple ? Don't be fooled, it's not as easy as it looks.

2317950.name: Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 4 - Collector's Edition
2317950.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the enchanting depths of the mystical underwater realm of Atlantis Solitaire! Delve into numerous intricate underwater levels and build stunning aquatic landscapes.

Tackle the latest Supersize, Challenge, and Match-2 levels as you unlock a multitude of new solitaire variations. Discover exclusive fish to bring the seascapes alive and enhance their splendor. Navigate through numerous quests to gather emeralds, employing game-altering power-ups across four different game modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed, and Timed.

Regardless of your preferred play style, prepare to be enthralled by a soothing soundtrack, mesmerizing visuals, and captivating gameplay. Explore the extraordinary underwater world of Jewel Match Atlantis Solitaire 4!

- More than 1000 levels!
- 6 classical Solitaire games such as Klondike, Spider or Freecell.
- 18 additional Solitaire variants such as Pacifico and Centuria.
- 120 replayable bonus Mahjong levels!
- 10 magnificent undersea palaces to build.
- Play 4 different game modes: Normal, Hard, Relaxed and Timed.
- Play supersize, challenge, sliding and match-2 bonus level.
- Solve quests.
- Choose between multiple card decks.
- Unlock gorgeous wallpapers for your desktop.
- Enjoy an ethereal soundtrack.

2317960.name: Samurai Survivors
2317960.about_the_game:
Samurai Survivors is a rogue-like, hack-and-slash, Vampire Survivors-like game. Slay evil spirits as you age and learn techniques to become the most powerful samurai.

You've betrayed your clan and been cursed to battle evil spirits as long as you breathe. You will continue to age until you pay your price while improving your swordsmanship more and more

Features

  • Hours of intense slicing & slashing survival!

  • 26 unique attacks with incredible synergies!

  • Interesting enemies with unique mechanics. They don't just increase in health!

  • Different maps with map-specific enemies and mechanics!

  • Unlockable weapons & attack techniques!

  • Continue playing the game after you beat the time with increasing Ascension Levels!

  • Custom-made Japanese medieval musics!

  • Lots and lots of juicy gameplay!

Samurai Illustration by Toriotto

2318020.name: Yondu's Journey
2318020.about_the_game:
Welcome to Yondu's Journey, an interactive movie where every decision you make can lead to life or death. Take on the role of Yondu The Fearless and face the challenges that await you in this exciting game.

As you play through the game, you will be presented with a series of difficult decisions that will test your courage and quick thinking. Do you want to fight or flee? The choice is yours, but be prepared to act fast - you only have a few seconds to make each decision.

Each decision you make will impact the outcome of the game, so choose wisely. Will you be the hero that saves the day, or will you succumb to the dangers that await you? The fate of Yondu The Fearless is in your hands.

With stunning graphics and intense action, Yondu's Journey is a game that you won't want to miss. So gather your courage and get ready for an adventure that will test your skills and leave you on the edge of your seat. Are you ready to face the challenges of Yondu's Journey? The choice is yours.

2318070.name: Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest
2318070.about_the_game:
Step into Twinsun's fantastical world in this action-adventure remake! Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest brings brand new visuals, new music by the original composer, and smoother gameplay to the iconic classic released back in 1994.

Embark on a Timeless Adventure, Reimagined
Twinsen is back in this remake featuring a new stylish makeover and modernized gameplay. Faithful to the original game, Little Big Adventure – Twinsen’s Quest takes you on an epic journey on a small planet harboring both magic and technology.

A Tale of Destiny and Heroism
On a planetoid with two suns, four species lived in perfect harmony... But that all changed when the brilliant scientist Dr. FunFrock invented cloning and teleportation, bringing the inhabitants under his total control. End the clone occupation while playing as Twinsen, a model citizen turned fugitive. Armed with your mysterious Magic Ball, explore beautiful landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and face formidable foes!

Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the series, Little Big Adventure - Twinsen's Quest offers an adventure like no other. Are you ready to become the hero Twinsun needs?

FEATURES

  • Discover a compelling story with deep themes.
  • Navigate through Twinsun with a revamped level layout and redesigned controls.
  • Defeat foes with an enhanced Magic Ball.
  • Enjoy a brand new artistic direction.
  • Immerse yourself with a new soundtrack by the original composer.

2318090.name: Sole Salvation
2318090.about_the_game:
Uncover the secrets of an ancient organization and explore the corrupted lands shaped by Valeriano’s memories, a young man pulled into a fate far greater than himself. Master cosmic artifacts and defeat the relentless creatures that hunt you.

In this action roguelite, you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously, mixing combos, elements, and abilities to create devastating attack chains and annihilate any threat.

Push through each zone, recover your memories, and grow stronger with every attempt… If you die, you lose only the faintest fragments of who you were.

Sole Salvation is the first game by METEORA, an independent studio created by a solo developer.

MASTER YOUR WEAPONS AND DISINTEGRATE YOUR ENEMIES

In this Action Roguelite, the key to survival is mastering the rhythm and moves of your ranged and melee weapons.

In every run, you carry two weapon types, melee and ranged: use both at any moment according to your strategy, without ever having to equip or manually swap them.

Each weapon has its own combat style, traits, and combos, which are amplified by the wide range of abilities and powers you gain during the run.

Combine attacks, upgrade your arsenal, and forge your own path to survival.

POWER UP WITH EVERY ATTEMPT

Collect echo fragments with every attempt and use them to permanently restore Valeriano's memories. Upgrade Valeriano’s weapons, abilities, and stats to become stronger and disintegrate the creatures that stand in your way.

Connect with Evanescences, faint memories that vanish upon death. Collect hundreds of different evanescences, each influenced by the weapons you choose, and craft your build, making every run unique and unrepeatable.

Die, adapt your strategy, and deepen your awareness.

A WORLD SHATTERED BY COSMIC LAWS

A hidden organization has triggered the event known as the “Sole Salvation.”
In an instant, humanity is overwhelmed: people's heads detach from their bodies and float motionless in mid-air, staring at a massive beam of light tearing through the sky. The world twists under the impact of incomprehensible cosmic forces: fractured landscapes, distorted architecture, and fragments of reality contaminated by an unknown presence.

You play as Valeriano, a survivor of the event, pulled into a fate far greater than himself.
Lost in a dreamlike and unstable reality, you must fight your way through corrupted memories and distorted visions to uncover the intentions of the organization behind the Sole Salvation, save your loved ones, and confront the redemption of a past that resurfaces.

2318100.name: Tales of the Magic Ball: The Lost Sorcerer
2318100.about_the_game:
You, the magic ball, have lost your sorcerer and in order not to perish you must find him again. For this reason, you start your journey. Initially, you'll find yourself in a magical, dreamy world that matches the ball. During your journey, however, your real adventure begins.

Tales of the Magic Ball is a puzzle platformer where you'll experience a fantastic story during your adventure in a magical world. Use your magic to solve puzzles. Use magic to defeat your enemies. Interact with the inhabitants and get help. Face the challenges and try to survive. Let the world enchant you.

-Play with a physically simulated ball and solve difficult bouncing passages.


-Let the puzzles challenge you.


-Use your magic to defeat your enemies and solve puzzles.


-Fight your opponent and adjust your tactics.


-Enjoy the story.

-Explore hand-built levels.


Wildmonkeygames is a small 1-man-team with a few freelancers who, besides their regular work, have dedicated themselves to game development with a lot of love and passion. Originally "Tales of the Magic Ball" was planned as a fast skill game/roller ball, but in the course of development more and more a more modern kind of roller ball crystallized out, meanwhile it became an adventure platformer, in which you can experience a story. The whole thing is spiced with puzzle game elements and packed in a beautiful fantasy world.
I hope you will enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed developing it.

2318120.name: Juruna Game
2318120.about_the_game:
"Juruna is a hack and slash fighting game with third person gameplay.
You control a rabbit on a quest for revenge, facing his enemies on his way.

The rabbit game is based on sword and magic combat.
On your journey, seek to evolve and defeat your enemies.


Goal and explore the forest and free the trapped rabbits

In a forest the rabbits were being enslaved by the fox
who had acquired magical powers.
She used these powers to subjugate, enslave the weaker animals and conquer the whole forest and bring chaos.

The rabbit, as the weakest species, was infected and attacked everyone in its path.
One day Juruna's daughter was taken along with the other rabbits.
Even though Juruna is the weakest of the species, he decides to go on a mission to face his enemy and try to recover his daughter and the others.

2318180.name: Knight Cats: Leaves on the Road Collector's Edition
2318180.about_the_game:
Elephant Games brings you a brand new epic adventure unlike anything you've experienced before in Knight Cats: Leaves on the Road!

The capable and devoted guards of Catstown provide safety and security to the thankful inhabitants, but when a recent string of missing townspeople culminates with the disappearance of the governor's niece, the whole town is scared and on edge. Join town guard Shavan as he braves the dangers of the world outside the gates on his mission to find the missing residents and track down whoever is responsible. It won't be easy, and it will be perilous, but the reward for conquering this Hidden-Object Adventure is peace for the kitties of Catstown and a nice big ball of yarn!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version.

The Collector's Edition includes:

• Prevent foxes from destroying the cat kingdom in the bonus game!
• Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, and more!
• Tons of puzzle pieces and collectible weaponry to find!
• Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games, earn achievements, and unlock the Secret Room!
• Never get lost with the comprehensive strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
2318180.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2318180/Knight Cats: Leaves on the Road Collector's Edition/

2318230.name: Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery VR
2318230.about_the_game:
Behind the Frame is a vivid, interactive fiction about an aspiring artist on the cusp of finishing the final piece of her gallery submission. Now available in VR, you'll be able to paint brushstrokes in a fully realized 3D space!



A relaxing, eloquent experience that can be played at any pace. Become immersed in a panoramic world filled with resplendent colors, beautiful hand-animated visuals, and a smooth, easy-listening soundtrack.



As a passionate artist, seek the missing colors that will bring your paintings to life - all while remembering to take the occasional coffee and breakfast breaks that keep you going. There is more than what meets the eye, for every painting has a story to tell.

4gamer

2318250.name: Everybody's Stranger
2318250.about_the_game:
The characters you meet and interact with differ based on how you decorate your inn:
  • Turn your inn into a veritable garden, and you'll attract plant-loving druids.
  • Fill your tavern with music, and the realm’s finest bards will soon be clamoring to perform on your stage.
Each oddball you meet has their own, unique storyline that weaves into the ever-changing plot. All NPCs are fully voice-acted by "professionals" with a focus on humor and tales that will make even the stoutest of folks tear up. Your decisions matter and will dramatically affect the outcome of their stories. Plus, you'll be able to date and develop a relationship with almost every character in the game.


  • Plant all sorts of vegetables and turn them into a bevy of seasonal dishes for the guests in your inn.
  • Decorate your inn to attract different types of heroes (or villains) and learn their food likes and dislikes.
  • Smith weapons, armor, jewelry; tailor clothing; build furniture and upgrade your inn.


Strap on your monocle (once you get it) and explore the world from the flip side. Encounter lost souls, relics to attract new NPCs to the inn, and a whole mess of secrets to help you uncover where you're from and how you ended up running an inn in a desolate swamp with a bunch of wackos stopping in at every hour of the day.

Key Features:

  • Rich stories for remarkable NPCs driven by your unique interactions with them
  • Extensive system for tracking what your inn's guests value, to repel or attract precisely the right clientele depending on your preference for good or evil (or somewhere in between)
  • Hundreds of accurate (though simplified) recipes to cook and serve to the various guests that come to your inn
  • A sweeping story rooted in the mystery of finding out who you are, where you’re from, and how you fit into the strange new world you’ve found yourself
  • Fishing system where you catch fish to the beats of metal, pop, bluegrass, and other genres of music in a rhythm-based mini-game
  • Completely original score composed by Joel Steudler, with unique tracks for each area, different times of day, and themes for many of the characters you’ll meet
  • Robust quest system with far too many side quests, different ways to complete them, and multiple endings depending on which paths you choose
  • Chopping, mining, planting, growing, harvesting, tailoring, blacksmithing, silversmithing, and more, all to suit your crafting temptations

Bonus Features:

  • Chickens equipped with advanced evasion capacity
  • Virtual swamp eel stew, with accurately simulated gastrointestinal response
  • Naked mole rat awareness outreach indoctrination
  • Gnomes
  • Farming sim that requires no application for government subsidies
  • Gargoyle mental health awareness
  • Relaxingly inaccurate depiction of economic exchange in a capitalist economy

2318260.name: HeliVR Simulator
2318260.about_the_game:
Welcome to HeliVR Simulator, an immersive virtual reality helicopter flying simulation experience designed for both novice and experienced players.

• VR Cockpit with extreme realism and attention to detail
• All cockpit instruments function exactly as they would in real life.
• Experience realistic simulated aircraft behavior across various scenarios.
• Four carefully crafted worlds to explore, from small to large

HeliVR Simulator is developed by aviation enthusiasts who accepted the challenge of bringing the best VR experience to life for all kinds of players!

2318280.name: Beyond a Coral Sea
2318280.about_the_game:
Explore your way through mystical islands while learning about your characters past. In this short adventure game you play as the protagonist of a memoire, telling a story from the pacific in the late 1800 century.

The game requires room scale interactions and a play area of at least 2x2 m.

Finishing the game takes around 30 minutes to 2 hours depending on how you play.

We recommend taking your time, playing the game without stress in a calm environment.

We hope you like it!

Features include:

English voice acted story, Immersive environment, Beautiful soundtrack by film score composer

2318290.name: Neon Skylines
2318290.about_the_game:
Experience an electrifying journey through an immersive 80s sci-fi world with Neon Skylines

Take control of your spacecraft as you soar through procedurally generated neon environments at breakneck speeds. Keep your reflexes sharp as you deftly maneuver to avoid obstacles and reach new heights in this thrilling 3D procedural arcade game.

With the power to slow down time at your fingertips, you'll need quick thinking and lightning-fast reactions to achieve the highest scores and soar above the competition.

2318300.name: DI: Debt is Inevitable
2318300.about_the_game:
-= DEATH IS INEVITABLE =-


Each wave will feature larger quantities of enemies, where you must keep a high combo and grab as many coins as you can in order to maximize your profits each round. Memorization of the level's waves and learning each weapon are also key to delaying the inevitable. Reaching the "final" wave will just start it back from the beginning, but even more hectic than before. You cannot escape your demise.

-= DEBT IS INEVITABLE =-


The shop contains everything you need to help you survive, at prices you cannot afford. Here, you can find health, weapons, armor, consumables, powerups, and passive upgrades. Each purchase from the shop increases that item's future prices, so if you're not careful, you may soon find yourself with empty pockets, and a mountain full of debt.

-= THE FUN NEVER STOPS =-

Your deaths and failures in DI will not be in vain, as each run will help you unlock new levels, characters, items, and mechanics that will be available in future runs. Each unlock that you acquire can change the way you play the game dramatically. There's no shortage of things to discover in DI.

2318310.name: Class of '09: The Re-Up
2318310.about_the_game:
It's not a sequel, it's not a remaster, it's The Re-Up! A new serving of story stems parallel to the first critically acclaimed Class of '09, the interactive sitcom you never knew you needed.
Just like the first game: all based on real events, encounters, and personalities experienced by the lead developer.

All of the original cast featuring Elsie Lovelock, Kayli Mills, Kira Buckland, and many more, return to combine for the greatest voiceover performance in gaming to date (yes I dare you to find something better, you won't). From double entendre to the darkest of humor, all 5,000+ lines of dialogue were carefully tailored to present premiere comedic performance and cultural accuracy.


Nicole makes her triumphant return as the most socially realistic female protagonist to ever graze video games. Delve into even more of her toxic realities sewn together by the darkest of humor as you navigate through 7 different endings, each more poignant than the last.

All wrapped in a late 2000's aesthetic that's not just a phase, it's a movement.

Plus bonus content upon 100% completion of the game!

2318350.name: Inside SCP-167
2318350.about_the_game:
Inside SCP-167 is a first-person psychological horror game that combines elements of investigation and puzzle-solving, aiming to resolve the strange occurrences related to SCP-167.

About SCP-167

After years of research and experimentation, the SCP Foundation finally classified SCP-167, a cube containing an infinite labyrinth of cubic rooms, as "safe" — provided it is adequately mapped and marked by specialized teams. Shortly after its reclassification, the intricate rooms of SCP-167 began to be used as expansive storage by the Foundation, but things are not exactly what they seem...

A Spreading Threat

Recently, a series of disturbing events triggered a deeper investigation into the enigmatic SCP-167. Despite multiple investigations yielding no conclusive results, Alex, the most experienced agent of the SCP Foundation, was assigned to explore the site alone and collect crucial information to eradicate the growing threat that seems to somehow be taking over the place.

About the Game

As a player, you have a single mission: to enter SCP-167, unravel the origin of the disturbances, and root out the evil. Alex, the main character, is one of the most competent and reliable agents of the SCP Foundation. Even though she is used to handling tasks that range from the simplest to the most complex, she could not imagine the horrors and challenges awaiting her in the Foundation's infinite storage.

What's Inside SCP-167?

From stacks of boxes filled with the Foundation's obsolete equipment to secret labs dedicated to horrendous and disturbing research, SCP-167 is literally a cube of mysteries. When the SCP Foundation turned the place into a storage facility, a large amount of items was stored in its countless cubic rooms. This includes everything from materials and tools considered useless to lower-risk SCPs that can be stored with some degree of safety. Over time, this structure not only served its purpose as a storage facility but also transformed into a crucial research center for the Foundation. Which seems to be slowly falling apart.

2318430.name: Forbidden Dojo
2318430.about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling and seductive adventure in Forbidden Dojo, an immersive adult visual novel that will captivate your senses and immerse you in a world of ancient beauty and sensual mystery. Step into the shoes of the protagonist as you navigate a world of magic, martial arts, and forbidden desires.



When a mysterious stranger knocks on your door, little do you know that your life is about to take an unexpected turn. With immense potential lying dormant within you, she transports you through a mystical portal to an enchanting world, where you find yourself in the tranquil courtyard of a martial arts dojo. Here, you encounter Akiko, the owner of a mesmerizing dojo, who welcomes you to stay and trains you in the ways of martial arts.



However, the tranquil atmosphere is disrupted when Sayuri, another enigmatic woman, appears with unwholesome intentions. As tensions rise between the two women, you find yourself entangled in their conflict. Amidst the chaos, a magical revelation ignites within you, leading you on a path to harness your newfound powers. As you journey through this extraordinary world, you'll face choices that shape your destiny. Will you pursue a deep bond with Akiko, exploring the depths of passion and love? Or will you yield to the allure of Sayuri's magical teachings, and embrace desires beyond imagination?



Navigate a world filled with dangerous encounters, intense martial arts battles, and steamy rendezvous. Your decisions shape the story and determine its outcome. The Russian Psychiatric Pastoral - despondency, cruelty, lawlessness, and mental disorders. What else do you need to describe our reality? Take on the role of a professional psychiatrist, confront various psychiatric diagnoses, and investigate missing people.

You find yourself in a small provincial town, which is famous for housing one of the largest psychiatric hospitals in the whole country: it holds the most dangerous criminals.
