You can unlock new skills and abilities in the Tech Tree with the resources collected in the levels. As the battle progresses, the eggs will grow stronger.

The game adopts a minimalist art style. Although it’s easy to play, The Territory of Egg will challenge your power of observation, strategic thinking and techniques.

Prism

A manifestation of light, Prism is a personification of electromagnetic radiation that can be perceived by the human eye.

Luna

Spark

2318830.name: Digital Diamond Baseball V11
2318830.about_the_game:
Digital Diamond Baseball is a statistically accurate baseball simulator and tabletop board game companion. The built-in game engine allows users to play games, series, tournaments, and entire seasons using players from any baseball season from 1927-2022. The board game companion feature allows users to bypass the game engine and manually play games using their favorite tabletop baseball game (digital Statis Pro baseball cards are included for all seasons). Tabletop results can quickly be entered and integrated with the stats generated by the built-in game engine.

The included seasons contain as-played lineups, real-life schedules and transactions, left/right splits (1954-2022), custom player ratings (1954-2022), and ballparks (with park factors and over 40 ballpark images). In addition, you can utilize the easy to use player library tools to customize your libraries by adding player pictures, logos, sounds, and custom play-by-play calls. You can also quickly and easily build your own custom seasons from scratch using team/players from any year in history.

Want to learn more? Check out our comprehensive User Guide that contains detailed video tutorials on how to get the most out of Digital Diamond Baseball!

2318860.name: Architecture Zeitgeist
2318860.about_the_game:
Architecture Zeitgeist is a game created with great care by me, Matheus Rudo, a student at the University of Brasília, with the goal of popularizing the teaching of architecture and making the study of architectural references more immersive. The game has educational purposes and currently features two game modes:

  • Story Mode: In this mode, the player studies the biography of a selected architect. They can walk through projects and search for notes, which tell the story of both the visited project and the architect responsible for it. Once the player collects all the notes about a project, they can move on to the architect’s next project and deepen their studies.

  • Free Mode: In this mode, the player can freely explore the project.

Currently, the game includes the following projects in each mode:

  • Story Mode: Barcelona Pavilion (Ludwig Mies van der Rohe), Azuma House (Tadao Ando), Villa Savoye (Le Corbusier), and Canoas House.

  • Free Mode: Barcelona Pavilion (Ludwig Mies van der Rohe), Azuma House (Tadao Ando), Villa Savoye (Le Corbusier), Fallingwater (Frank Lloyd Wright – still in beta), and Canoas House (Oscar Niemeyer).

Development Roadmap:

  • Addition of Fallingwater by architect Frank Lloyd Wright in both Story Mode and Free Mode.

  • Addition of 4 new maps featuring architect Tadao Ando, in both modes. Preliminary list of projects:
    Church of the Light
    Koshino House
    4x4 House
    Oval House

  • Addition of 4 new maps featuring architect Mies van der Rohe, in both modes. Preliminary list:
    Farnsworth House
    Crown Hall
    Villa Tugendhat
    Seagram Building

  • Addition of 4 new maps featuring architect Le Corbusier, in both modes. Preliminary list:
    Ronchamp Chapel
    Unité d’Habitation
    La Tourette Monastery
    National Museum of Western Art

  • Addition of 4 new maps featuring architect Frank Lloyd Wright, in both modes. Preliminary list:
    Robie House
    Guggenheim Museum New York
    Taliesin West
    Johnson Wax Headquarters

  • Addition of 4 new maps featuring architect Oscar Niemeyer, in both modes. Preliminary list:
    Niterói Contemporary Art Museum
    Pampulha Church
    Itamaraty Palace
    New York Pavilion

  • Game release and end of Early Access.

After that, it is difficult to say. The expectation is that the game will occupy less than 50 GB of disk space. If it reaches 50 GB or more, no new projects will be added, and a new game will need to be released. If there is still room for expansion, we may consider adding new architects. There are countless architects and projects that could be included — we may even open community voting for future additions. These could come as free updates or paid DLC.

The full content of the game will be quite extensive, with around 25 hours of gameplay and 25 maps. There is also interest in investing more in projects focused on Japanese architecture — perhaps a future release like “AZ: Japan”? We’ll see.

Architecture Zeitgeist is an independent, educational, and non-profit project. Purchasing the game is entirely optional, since the content available in the demo corresponds to the full version of the game. Therefore, buying the paid version mainly serves as a way to support the project. All revenue generated from the game’s sales is reinvested directly into its development, contributing to the creation of new maps, technical improvements, optimizations, bug fixes, and the expansion of its educational content. The project is also part of Matheus Rudo’s master’s research at the University of Brasília, Brazil.

2319390.name: Kvark
2319390.about_the_game:
Congratulations, valued future employee, on your decision to interview for a position of [REDACTED] at Kvark! We commend you on your impeccable decision-making skills, which will reflect positively on your overall assessment. While you wait for your complimentary lunch of dill cream sauce, dumplings, and exactly 110 grams of what is most assuredly a beef sirloin steak, we have prepared a short presentation for you on what you can expect from working at our facility… apart from the sense of pride and accomplishment that you are helping to secure the nation and advance the humankind!


Here at Kvark, we take security very seriously. Our mining, production, and research facilities are guarded 24/7 by highly trained security personnel with access to a wide array of weapons tools to help them deal with any unexpected situations, ranging from riots incited by imperialist infiltrators to [REDACTED]. Rest assured that we take every precaution possible to make sure that these dangerous, double-barreled and even explosive weapons tools do not end up in your wrong hands.


Workplace safety is our utmost priority and we are proud to inform you that it has been [REDACTED] number of days since the last incident of a workplace injury at our facilities. We do our best to contain all dangerous elements we use in our research, including radioactive isotopes. Do your part in helping us keep your place of work safe and report any suspicious substances you find to your overseer. Do NOT attempt to handle them yourself as contact with such substances can have unforeseen consequences for your body.


Be prepared to deal with unexpected situations in your place of work. You may be ordered asked on a short notice to take over a job position for a currently unavailable colleague, which might not, due to possible personnel shortages, exactly fit your qualifications. Should such occasion arise, keep calm and ask yourself: What would comrade overseer do? Just remember to always stay in your designated work area. Employees found exploring wandering outside of their work area will be [REDACTED] under the suspicion of espionage.


We care for the well-being of our employees! Interiors of our facilities were designed to provide necessary sensory stimuli and every work area has been outfitted with machines where you may receive purchase refreshments. Employees are allotted [REDACTED] minutes of break time per day, which they may spend as they see fit. While smoking is not prohibited within our facility, we kindly ask you do so in smoking-designated areas. Keep in mind that smoke breaks will be deducted from your allotted break time.


Afraid of the radiation? You do not have to be! Our large underground facility has been constructed with great care to provide as much shielding and protection as possible, while also keeping the construction costs risks of any radiation leaks and containment breaches to the absolute minimum. You will be pleased to hear that the probability of one such breach event happening is less than [REDACTED] percent at any given time!

Addendum:
IncaseofanemployeedeathKvarkdoesn’tbearanyresponsibilitytowardstherelatives.

That will be all for the presentation, thank you for your attention and patience. Please do enjoy your complimentary lunch, we will see you very soon at the interview!

Kvark - For the secure nation, for the bright future!

2319400.name: Rootown
2319400.about_the_game:
From little seeds grow big forrests! Plant trees, spread your roots and explore the underground in this cute and relaxing small-town sim. Use the forest to improve the life of your neighbours, find hidden treasures underground and collect tons of trees and animals from around the world!

GROW


Find a good patch of soil and sprout! Select the right tree for the job and explore the underground, collecting water, minerals and fossils along the way.
You could even clean up the soil from nasty pollutants while you're down there!

HARVEST

Cut your trees to get wood, or let them grow and wait for fruits! Use the ecosystem to your advantage and improve your harvests day after day!

IMPROVE


Use your forrest to better the lives of your animal neighbours! Grow your town, unlock new building and activities, talk to your fellow townsfolk and try to help them!

TRAVEL

Travel to different biomes with unique challenges (arid desert, frozen mountain, polluted city...) and discover unique new trees and animals!

A TAVERN FOR TEA is a fantasy tea-brewing simulator and visual novel. Play as the owner of a fantasy tavern and brew the tea that your customers didn't know they needed.

2319490.name: The Bean Trials
2319490.about_the_game:
The Bean Trials is a unique multiplayer mini game versus where you take on the role of a “bean” and compete against other beans to see who is the best! Compete in over 20 unique mini games and customize yourself with over 2,000,000 possible combinations! Using coins earned from doing challenges or winning games you can purchase new looks and items to make your bean just like what you dreamed of! Want to play with friends? Hop into a private match and get up to 15 other beans to compete against!

Think you’re the greatest? Try to top the Leaderboards to show true superiority!

2319540.name: The Very Brief and Meaningless Adventure of Hero Man
2319540.about_the_game:
Hero Man, Hero Man, only doing what a Hero Man can. Whether he can actually save the world and bring home the glory is another question entirely.

And so we enter this retro-inspired RPG world where YOU determine the outcome! Your choices will determine the fate of Hero Man and the world at large. Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from the sinister Lord Doldrum ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please! Will you help bring peace to the world or break the story line in some horrible way? The answer is up to you!

In this satirical take on an old-school JRPG, you'll guide Hero Man on a journey that is very brief and meaningless indeed, and find up to 18 fun, heroic, and grisly endings that take 2-20 minutes each! Unlock different endings depending on your moral actions, party composition, character levels, and more.



Look forward to the following new features, as well!

  • Original Graphics and Music Assets.
  • 18 Endings that can be found in almost any order, depending on your actions.
  • Keep track of every ending you've found on one save file. What will happen when you find them all?
  • Enlist the aid of Marionette characters to help Hero Man on his adventure! Recruit helpers such as the Solider, Mage, Cleric and... that's it.
  • Quality of Life features that gradually unlock as you find more endings, such as the ability to turn off random encounters or restart your current run.

2319550.name: Spectrum Forces
2319550.about_the_game:

Select the right pilots for the right jobs, use everyone, bring them all back alive, and enable challenges to get the highest scores you can!

Playthroughs usually take 15 to 20 minutes to complete successfully.

2319560.name: Road To Place
2319560.about_the_game:
Road To Place Is a dice rolling roguelike. That you move based on the number you roll with the dice. Dice rolling can also determine outcomes bad or good, whether you defeat the raiders or get hurt in the process. There are 4 resources bullets, medicine, food, and money. Run out of food you will get hurt or starve. Run out of bullets you will have a tough time to defend against the raiders. Run out of medicine and you won't be able to heal your player. If you run out of a resource, you can either search the woods to find it, fight raiders to get resources, or simply buy it using money at the shops.(money is acquired the same way as the other resources). Perks will help you along the way to acquire perks you need to find mushrooms along the way, and you guessed it, roll for the perk. If you manage to get to "the place" There are 3 different endings, luckily you can have up to 3 adventurers to help get you there.
Features-
-Multiple Items
-a shop where you can buy and sell resources
-multiple endings
-recruit other travelers along the way

-find resources in the forest
-gain perks to help you along the way
-3 difficulties

2319580.name: Super Cakeboy
2319580.about_the_game:
Once again take the role of Cakeboy in this sequel to Khimera: Destroy all Monster Girls' "game-within-a-game". Run, jump, punch and use the variety of pastry-themed weapons at your disposal to blast through 9 action-packed stages. Face off against Cakeboy's eternal rival, the enigmatic Dark Cake and send him packing!

Items no chef should leave at home:

Pick up far-away items with the Croissant Boomerang, set traps with the exploding Cupcake Bomb, perform trick-shots with the bouncing Super Donut, or just punch them in the face! The choice is yours!

Short and Sweet:

This snack-sized game's nine levels can be completed in about 20 minutes but hidden collectable ingredients, achievements and other secrets give you extra goals for subsequent play-throughs.

2319620.name: Kore VR
2319620.about_the_game:
Available with Meta Quest

Kore VR offers a unique experience that transports you to the heart of a traditional Korean Hanok village. From there, you can explore a futuristic and interactive orb that teaches you the sounds of each Korean alphabet, as well as a shooting arena where you'll use a laser blaster to shoot letters and gather ingredients for delicious Korean dishes in just three minutes. But beware - if you don't get the letters right, you'll be "roasted" in Korean!

With Kore VR, you can immerse yourself in the Korean language and culture in a fun and engaging way. The serene landscape of the Hanok village creates the perfect backdrop for learning the characters and pronunciation of Hangeul. And as you explore the village and its surroundings, you'll gain a deeper understanding and appreciation for Korean culture.

Whether you're a beginner or an experienced learner, Kore VR is an innovative and effective way to build a strong foundation in the Korean language. Through its combination of language learning and cultural immersion, Kore VR can enhance your overall language skills and provide you with a truly unforgettable experience.

2319640.name: Rise of Gun
2319640.about_the_game:
Rise of Gun A simulator of a weapons store in a world overrun by zombies after a global epidemic. The entire world is enveloped in darkness, but humans have not given up and are fighting to the end. After losing his family, the main character sets out in search of survivors in despair. The journey was difficult, but he was able to find a wonderful settlement with few people but all of them determined to rebuild the world. As the only master who can create weapons, the main character is very valuable in this town. The mayor of the town has allocated a shop with a workshop so that we can create and sell the weapons that we make.

Features
Weapon CraftingYou will be able to create weapons without any restrictions, even from incompatible parts. Unleash your imagination and create the most creative weapons.
The weapon crafting system is as convenient and enjoyable as possible, so you can enjoy the result rather than get tired of the countless actions.


Many componentsThere are over 200 different weapon parts that allow players to create over a million different weapon combinations. The parts are divided into several types and differ in rarity. The main part to which all subsequent parts are attached includes the barrel, scope, stock, grip, magazine, silencer, and bayonet. With these parts, players can create an incredibly unique weapon.


Weapon SalesIn the store, players can display and sell their weapons. There are many different shelves for displaying weapons. Once a resident of the town finds a suitable weapon, they will buy it.


Shop UpgradesPlayers can upgrade their shop with various buildings, from decorative elements to workbenches and generators. Each building adds something new to the gameplay, such as attracting more customers, making the store more cozy, opening up more space for selling weapons, speeding up the creation of weapons, adding new functions, such as disassembling parts for materials, and more.


AtmosphereThis small town is very cozy. The mayor of the town makes an effort to ensure the safety of all residents and create a pleasant atmosphere. You will also experience day and night cycles, weather changes, and cheerful residents.

Each turn, your actions are dealt randomly to the Brain board. Place your block shapes strategically to activate powerful combinations. Adapt as you discover the limitations of your host... and how to overcome them.

Push the bounds of what your host can be. Together we survive.

2319790.name: Captain Wayne - Vacation Desperation

After losing his arm in a terrible encounter with the legendary Vampire Whale, Wayne replaced it with his trusty shotgun, The Captain's Ol' Reliable, and sailed with it across the seven-and-a-half seas in his vessel, the S.S. Salty.

When an unexpected run-in with a group of evil mercenaries leaves him marooned on Orca Isle with his ship stolen, Wayne starts doing what he does best: annihilating everyone responsible.

Equipped with a double barreled shotgun for an arm, countless explosives, and a bad attitude, you’ll have to go toe-to-toe with The Killer Whales, the most ruthless mercenaries in all the seven-and-a-half seas.


DO YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES TO EMBODY THE CAPTAIN?  Let’s find out.

Mow down enemies with your double-barreled arm, rip enemies apart with devious chain-gun fingers, toss a bottle of the explosive Boom Brew, unleash the force of thunder from your palms, or PUNCH THEM ‘TIL THEY’RE PASTE!

Those Killer Whales bastards aren’t gonna slaughter themselves! It’s time to rob the rich to feed the badass.

2319800.name: The Land Past Redemption

The Land Past Redemption is a medieval rogue-lite with turn-based combat. Take on bounties, explore procedurally generated dungeons, outfit and level up heroes, and earn enough money to escape the Land Past Redemption.

Key Features

  • Rogue-lite
    Heroes can permanently die but even if a battle is lost, three new heroes are generated and the game mostly continues where it left off.

  • Customize heroes
    Armor and weapons can be equipped to suit play style and hero class. At certain levels, a new skill can be selected and there are two skills to choose between. Even if there are two heroes with the same class, they can be built to have different skills.

  • Procedurally generated loot
    Buy gear at the store to make heroes stronger, or use loot from enemy drops. The store's items refresh every time the heroes rest so there's always something new and better to find.

  • Positioning plays an important role in battle
    Heroes in the back row will be safer, but will be unable to melee attack without the added reach of a spear. A hero in the front row with heavy armor and a shield can tank enemy attacks.

  • No two dungeons are alike
    The layout of the dungeon and the events are all procedurally generated.

  • From reconnaissance missions to front patrolling, strategic bombing and balloon hunting, it is up to you to use your resources wisely and stand up to the enemy.

Arm yourself with 66 unique items, every single one rolling its own distinct traits from a pool of 60 powerful modifiers, ensuring every build feels truly personal.

Face the depths alone or team up online with up to 4 players, combining wildly different builds to conquer the dungeon together… or die trying.

No meta. No mercy. Just misfits in a dungeon that never ends.
2320070.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Danish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian

2320080.name: Russian Psychiatric Pastoral
2320080.about_the_game:
The Russian Psychiatric Pastoral - despondency, cruelty, lawlessness, and mental disorders. What else do you need to describe our reality? Immerse yourself in a multi-genre interactive movie, combining a psychiatrist simulator, a noir detective and unique fighting sequences built from a variety of video fragments. Take on the role of a professional psychiatrist, confront various psychiatric diagnoses, and investigate missing people.



At the center of the plot is you, a protégé of the authorities from Moscow. You find yourself in a small provincial town, which is famous for housing one of the largest psychiatric hospitals in the whole country: it holds the most dangerous criminals. In the depressing atmosphere of the Russian countryside you will meet a variety of crippled-by-fate locals, each of them adapted their own way to survive in this merciless reality. As you interact with them, you will find more and more details about the disappearance of people whose fate nobody cares about anymore. You will also analyze their mental disorders, from schizophrenia to bipolar disorder.



Key features:
- Varied dialogues, where you need to skillfully select proper words for every patient. As a reward, you learn more about their diagnoses;
- Collecting and matching information about missing people piece by piece;
- Explore a variety of mental diagnoses using educational charts and speadsheets;
- Exciting interactive fights, where your survival depends on your reaction;
- Unique aesthetics and atmosphere of the Russian countryside.
2320080.supported_languages:
Russian*, English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Portuguese - Brazil, Hungarian, Greek, Danish, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Japanese, Dutch, Finnish, Czech, Swedish

2320130.name: Farm Empire
2320130.about_the_game:
Farm Empire is an idle / clicker game where you will be making crazy amounts of money from farming. You start the game with just one chicken, but soon you can expand into tomatoes, tractors, factories and many other assets. Hire managers to do the clicking, upgrade your assets and reach your milestones. You can also expand your empire to other countries like Australia, Madagascar, Denmark and even Antarctica.

Farm Empire was originally released in 2016, but has been in active development ever since. Content updates are out every other month, ensuring there will always be ways to expand your empire.

  • Thousands of milestones to play towards.
  • Seven empires to unlock and complete: USA, China, Australia, Denmark, Norway, Madagascar and Antarctica (yes, you can farm there!)
  • Each empire has 36 cool, interesting or funny assets to unlock and upgrade: How about an Australian banjo frog, an arctic sea pig or a Chinese dragon?
  • Discover the best combination of assets for each empire to optimize your earnings - the path you take is important, but you can always restart to try another.
  • Speed up your earnings with the help of friendly workers gained from restarting your empire - restart often, to keep your worker force growing.
  • 15 golden eggs for free each day, and even more if you create your own golden egg farms.
  • Your game data is stored on the mighty Farm Empire server - log on from any device, and your empire will be at where your last left it.

highlighted.name: One chicken short of being crazy!

2320150.name: Chronicles of Taldun: The Longing
2320150.about_the_game:
Most people spend their whole lives never touching magick, and some are gripped by it before they ever open their eyes. Is there a place in this world for a child cursed with the hunger of the Moons? For a child with a song that wants to be sung? Will they devour one another or find salvation in each other’s embrace?

The world of Taldun is shaped by mysterious forces of the Seas, a power that gives and takes life. Touching its waters brings death to most people, but in rare cases some survive it and become magi. Evin and Near come from very different circumstances, one grew up in a tiny village and stumbled upon magick by accident, and the other was born with it and spent their life locked away in a temple. Despite this, as if pulled together by the currents of the Sea, their paths cross, and now a storm is brewing.

The story deals with emotionally heavy themes.

2320170.name: Medieval Coin Hunt
2320170.about_the_game: 'Medieval Coin Hunt' is a medieval horror game that throws you right into medieval times. You must conceal yourself in the shadows and find the coins without making enemies aware of your presence. During this scary horror game, you will be forced to endure horrific torture and pain in order to complete the game. Embark on this journey at your own risk

2320220.name: Royal Romances: Forbidden Magic Collector's Edition
2320220.about_the_game:
Spectacular continuation to the acclaimed Royal Romances game series! What can a human do in a desperate situation or for the chance for unfathomable power and love? The murky air becomes heavier and harder to breathe, monsters roam the forest, and dark magic taint smothers everything within its reach. Ida and Illeon are about to strike, fulfilling their devious plan. Face battles with your people, find love and endure loss as you get ready to defend the lands from mortal threat! Can a simple bard defeat a monstrous werewolf? Can a villain change its nature? Answers to these questions in this pulse-pounded new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure!

This Collector's Edition includes:

💋 Unexpected plot twists!
Explore a fabulous fantasy world full of unexpected heroes and spectacular sceneries! Can you catch and defeat your enemy and still remain human? Is there any chance of a happy ending for the evil witch? To answer these questions you need to embark on an unforgettable journey with the heroes of the fantasy story!

💋 Difficult decisions!
You have the opportunity to influence the plot of the point and click adventure. Make a fateful decision, on which the development of the romance story depends. Can you help the characters and save the day like a true hero before it’s too late? Better think twice!

💋 A variety of achievements!
Unique riddles, intricate puzzles and relaxing mini-games are waiting for you! Solve brain teasers and find hidden objects to earn numerous achievements and highlight your success!

💋 Collectible items!
Immerse yourself in the magical atmosphere of this adventure! Multiple picturesque locations with mysteries for you to solve and secrets to find. Keep an eye out for many different collectibles to make the game even more exciting to play!

2320230.name: Cavimilation
2320230.about_the_game:
Cavimilation is a 2D shooter/platformer throwback to classic high score chasing games with the addition of modern roguelike elements. Explore an endless procedurally generated cave filled with treasure and monsters, where every mistake takes its toll and where every bullet counts.

  • Fair randomness – Every level in a run is randomly generated. Systemic rules will assure that your success won't be in the hands of RNG.
  • Clean visuals – No visual clutter. Cavimilation features readable programmer/naïve art audiovisuals.
  • Collect and spend treasure – Caves are filled with treasure. Collect it to increase your score and use it as currency in shops for weapon upgrades and power-ups.
  • Outsmart your enemies – Enemies in Cavimilation may hit hard but they are not undefeatable. Learn their weaknesses, master your positioning, and give 'em hell.
  • Shape the environment – Use grenades you've found or your handy pickaxe to destroy the environment to your advantage.
  • Achievements and leaderboards – Compare scores with your friends through Steam leaderboards.

2320250.name: Zefyr: Prologue
2320250.about_the_game:
1st chapter of "Zefyr: A Thief's Melody". In a colorful archipelago, play as a young thief studying at the Guild. Investigate kidnappings, steer clear of roaming pirates or fight them. Sail the ocean on a cute turtle and climb on every island. Cure sick animals and reveal the truth.

"Zefyr: Prologue" contains the first chapter of "Zefyr: a Thief's Melody". It's a tribute to old adventure games like "Beyond Good & Evil" and "Zelda Windwaker"; it features exploration, dialogs, fights, puzzles, collectibles and huge Boss battles, all wrapped in a colorful world with a contemplative and feel-good atmosphere.

Run, jump, and climb wherever you want, travel between islands on a turtle, and discover a colorful open world!

Be it pirates, guards, robots or other thieves, you'll face many challenges during your missions. You are free to play sneakily or go straight to confrontation. But choose carefully!

During your journey, you'll find ancient Guardians. Some will block your path, others will be well hidden. Will you be able to bring back peace to these giant creatures?

Look for sick animals and cure them with fruits! Collect flowers, discover lost paintings... Many side quests await you in this feel-good world. Will you find them all?

  • Freely explore a colorful open world.

  • Learn various skills: climbing, stealth, fighting, bow, bombs, grapple and much more!

  • Confront or avoid pirates, guards and robots.

  • Cure sick animals all over the world.

  • Collect gemstones, paintings and flowers.

  • Defy giant Guardians during epic battles.

  • Discover cute and funny characters.

  • Save the world! Er no, I mean "be a true hero!" Er no, I mean "help your sister." Well, you have to start somewhere, kid...

  • Oh, yeah! And ride a cute turtle! But I guess you already got that from the picture.

Hi there! I'm Mathias and I've been creating video games since I was a child. I love coding, playing music and drawing. So what's better than creating a video game to do all of this at the same time? I do everything alone because I love every part of it and I'm a curious guy who likes to know how it works! I hope you'll like it :)

If you want to support me or learn more, don't hesitate to check out my website, where you can find all the links to social media, my dev blog and other stuff. Thank you so much!
2320250.supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil

2320260.name: Piratopia: Raiders of Pirate Bay
2320260.about_the_game:
Embark on an epic action-adventure RPG in this open-world sandbox pirate game for 1-128 players. Explore a procedurally-generated world inspired by One Piece, as you customize your ship, crew, and cove to battle mythical monsters and conquer the seven seas!

  • Explore unique biomes in a procedurally-generated world
  • Start your own sandbox server instance and cooperate (or battle)
  • Play cross-server in Pirate clans, raids, auctions, and PvP arenas
  • Select your ship class and playstyle
  • Collect and craft powerful gear and weaponry
  • Take down mythical sea creatures in dungeons or the open sea
  • Ally (or war) with different world Factions and uncover humorous quest lines
  • Recruit crew with unique buffs and skills



Based on the cult Steam game with over 200,000 downloads, you won’t be sailing alone in Piratopia: Raiders of Pirate Bay. Come on board and feel the breeze in your beards* as we sail into a new chapter together!
*for the unbearded, hook-ons are available for a modest fee.

The Ships



All hands on deck to hit the stretch goals and unlock more classes!
In Piratopia: Raiders of Pirate Bay, you can collect a fleet but you may only captain 1 ship at a time. Each has different traits and can be further customized with Gear and Weapons (see later sections).

Stretch Goals:

Frigate - High Capacity (cargo), every merchant's favorite
Galley - Supply Ship, every fleet needs a good support
Corvette - A balanced multi-tasker; Jack's favorite ship

Master their unique playstyles and skills, and make the seas your…old salty dog.

Crew


You’ll encounter a plethora of "recruitable" and powerful NPCs as you explore the world! Convince these legendary sea rogues to accept you as their captain and join your motley crew to conquer the oceans together.



Equip up to 3 NPCs on your ship and level them to unlock or upgrade active skills and passive buffs (or debuffs). Design your own lethal combination of crew + ship for custom encounters!

Enemies


Go up against different enemies, all intent on rooting out piracy - aka YOU.

  • Dungeon and raid mobs and bosses in each biome
  • Naval fleets that patrol the open seas
  • Naval elites that hunt you down as your notoriety goes up
  • Pesky sea creatures that disrupt your adventures
  • Mythical open-world sea horrors that you have to take down together

You can score rare and important relics and materials when you take down more dangerous enemies!


Size of open-world bosses vs Dreadnought

Procedurally-Generated Worlds

In the grand tradition of some of our favorite games like Valheim, V Rising, Project Zomboid, and more, you can start your own game instances in Piratopia: Raiders of Pirate Bay:
  • Open/Public: open it up to 128 players and see who comes to cooperate (or battle)
  • Private: invite only your mates or simply play solo in your own private world
  • Bring your ships and the inventory onboard to any other server

Factions


No matter what the map seed is, the Imperial Navy and other world factions in Piratopia will offer friendly parties different trade options and access to unique materials, quests, and crew (check out the next section).
Go against them and they will hunt you down whenever you are sighted. It's up to you to be a friend or foe with them!

Player Modding

Help us hit our stretch goals to unlock player-modded dungeons!
We'll give you the tools to be your own game designers and dungeon masters in Piratopia. Create and share your own brilliant and insane encounters, and make it as fun - or brutal - as you like!

The Lore


Before his death, "Bloodhound" Addicus left pages of his journal scattered across the Seven Seas of Astillia, detailing several ancient monuments lost beneath the waves. Legend has it that anyone who manages to retrieve these monuments will be granted untold riches and mastery of the oceans.

Gears & Weapons


From extra armor plating to hyper propellers, it's up to you to farm and equip parts so you can have the right build for the right encounters. Each ship class can be leveled to unlock:
Up to 5 Gear slots - Choose between moving faster, being more durable, or having more firepower.


Up to 3 Weapon slots - Choose your flavor of destruction:

  • Basic cannonballs - always a classic...
  • Long cannons - a bit more fun than the basic kind.
  • Missiles - yes, you heard right.
  • Flamethrowers - crude and short-range, but effective.
  • Thunderbolt (AoE) - aim, drop, watch it zap!
  • Chainsaws - cos we like melee action.
  • Lasers - bet you'd like to see THAT.
  • Naval mines (AoE) - sneaky and deadly.
  • And more!


(Welcome to Piratopia, cake or death?)

Crafting

A crafty boy (or girl), eh? Through gear crafting, you tweak and balance your stats to:

  • Strengthen gear and weapons
  • Craft new gear and weapons from scratch
  • Break down unwanted items for resources
  • Unlock set bonuses (3, 5, and 8-piece sets)

Enchantment System (Stretch Goal)

Loot pretty sparkly gems from exploration, quests, and boss drops., then socket them into your gear to diversify builds by:
  • Socketing unique skills
  • Applying stat multipliers

Clans

Rally your mates to trade, raid and battle together as the mightiest flotilla ever seen on Astillia. In Piratopia: Raiders of Pirate Bay, you will be able to create your own Pirate Clans and enjoy perks such as:

  • Cross-server clan banks
  • Clan buffs
  • Clan quests and rewards

Auction House

Wheel and deal with other enterprising players in a cross-server auction house, where you have the chance to score rare loot or become the mightiest trader of them all.

Player Vs Player



Ready to show off your mastery? Bloodthirsty pirates can enjoy:

  • 1v1 to 4v4 arenas
  • Free-for-all battle royale
  • Server leader boards
  • Cross-server leader boards
By battling in PVP activities, you will unlock new skins and titles exclusive to only those most skilled in naval skirmishes.
Will yours be the name that strikes fear in the hearts of a generation of seamen?

Biomes


With a vast array of biomes for open exploration, each zone brings its own unique climate and denizens to the world of Astillia.
Biome-specific enemies

  • Whirlpools pull you to another plane to take on special challenges and bosses
  • Encounter Environmental hazards (Cold climate, Sirens, Storms, Whirlpools, and more)
  • Hidden secret quests that tie into the game's story and lore
  • Treasures scattered around the world

Piratopia's Creator



The brainchild of Adi Zhavo, Game Director at Popcore and creator of cult PvP arena brawler Gladio & Glory, Piratopia began its life as a one-man project developed during off-work hours while Adi juggled full-time work as a Game Producer.

Now, in collaboration with Project 99, Piratopia is getting a major upgrade from an addictive IO-style sea brawler to a brand new multiplayer game with a graphic overhaul, a bigger world, and tons of new features!

Join the Community

2320280.name: Nova Strike
2320280.about_the_game:
Nova Strike is a retro shoot 'em up that transports you to a distant galaxy where you face waves of increasingly powerful enemies. Because it is easy to pick up and play, has addictive gameplay, and generates different levels with each new game, you can enjoy hours of challenging fun. Every time you take off is a chance to unlock new upgrades and improve your ship. Try to beat your high score!

FIGHT FORMIDABLE FOES


Destroy as many enemy ships as possible while skilfully dodging their attacking fire. After defeating mighty armadas, a formidable boss stands in your way. You need to watch, learn and anticipate the attacks of each boss to stand a chance of defeating them. Push yourself to your limits to complete the perfect run and beat the high score.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR WEAPON LOADOUT


Your ship has nine secondary weapons to unlock and equip as well as some 40 defensive and attacking skills. From missiles to grenades to electric forcefields, every upgrade creates a different game experience. Build a ship to suit your style and refine it between each level during your stops at the spaceport. Every customization radically changes the tactics you need for annihilating enemy squadrons. Choose carefully and find the best configurations to suit your play style.

EACH GAME IS DIFFERENT


Play and play again: every Game Over is the start of a new adventure. Using the persistent points you earn with each run, unlock new weapons and skills, then start a new game to explore a fresh procedurally generated map. Come back stronger and stronger until you can confront the final boss and save the galaxy!

2320300.name: Endless Warrior 无尽勇者
2320300.about_the_game:
Heroes, welcome to this mysterious and challenging continent! Here, you will embark on an exciting adventure similar to the vampire rouge game, where you will grow your abilities, collect weapons, and defeat powerful enemies. By constantly honing your skills and amassing a diverse array of weapons, you will gradually transform into the mightiest warrior, overcoming all obstacles and writing your own legendary chapter! Forge ahead courageously and become the undefeated overlord of this continent!

Rich weapons and props


On this continent filled with unknowns and adventures, dozens of unique weapons, items, and skills await heroes to explore and discover. Whether it's the king's sword, excellent at one-on-one battles, or the magic scroll, proficient in mass killings, their individual abilities will add infinite possibilities to your adventure. Even more amazing is the combination of these weapons, items, and skills, which produces astonishing effects like a chemical reaction. When you cleverly fuse them together, you can unleash combat power beyond imagination, becoming an unmatched hero on this continent!

An endless stream of monsters


An endless stream of monsters pours in like a surging tide, wave after wave, violent and powerful. Some are fierce like beasts, others cold as demons, with hideous faces and menacing auras. In this relentless onslaught of monsters, the hero must skillfully navigate through them, dodging attacks and launching counterattacks with supernatural wisdom and courage. Each encounter tests the hero's willpower and abilities. Only by constantly honing and elevating oneself can one gain a foothold on this perilous continent.

Rich Growth Elements


In this game, growth is not limited to in-game combat experiences. Outside the game, we also provide a rich array of upgrade and enhancement mechanisms that allow heroes to comprehensively boost their strength. Every weapon, whether it's a sharp sword or a mysterious staff, possesses unique growth potential. Through continuous forging and upgrading, they will unleash even greater power. Each item also holds latent energy waiting to be discovered, which may provide additional defense or grant heroes special skills.
Most importantly, heroes themselves possess boundless growth potential. Through constant training and battles, heroes can enhance their skill levels, unlock new abilities, and even change their fighting styles, evolving into more comprehensive and powerful warriors. This combined internal and external growth system fills every adventure with anticipation and surprises, allowing heroes to write their own glorious chapters on this continent.

2320340.name: Adrenaline Dungeon
2320340.about_the_game:
Adrenaline Dungeon is a thrilling top-down dungeon crawler game, inspired by classic games of the past. Where you take on the role of an unknown man who is trapped in a time-looped dungeon, filled with dangerous enemies and deadly traps. But soon you discover that a new order is trying to rewrite history and alter the course of time.

In this epic journey, you must navigate through the dungeon's multiple levels, fighting off the order, avoiding traps, and uncover the anomalies that lie within the dungeon itself. As you explore the dungeon, you'll uncover clues and learn more about the order and their plans to alter history.

Armed with your weapons and skills, you must confront the new order's minions and defeat their powerful leaders in engaging boss battles. But beware, as you progress deeper into the dungeon, the enemies become stronger and more cunning, making it increasingly difficult to succeed.

You'll need to master different styles of combat, such as swordsmanship, archery and magic, to overcome the dungeon's challenges and defeat the new order. Only by doing so you can break the time loop and prevent history from being rewritten.



Do you have what it takes to defeat the new order and escape the time looped dungeon? Are you ready for an epic journey filled with danged and adventure? Then grab your weapons and embark on this exciting quest today!

Features

  • Old school level design.
  • 9 Mini-bosses and 1 Major Boss to master, each with their own challenges tailored to the player's progression.
  • Challenging enemies that encourages a more tactical approach to combat.
  • Random encounters that brings fun and engaging combat scenarios that will test your resolve and skills.
  • Multiple ending scenarios based on decisions made in game.
  • Unique enemy types that have been crafted to complement each other.
  • Unique abilities tied to each school of combat, where you can be an Expert Warrior that crushes everything in its path, a Deadly Archer that never fails to hit its target, or a Powerful Wizard that slows down time around him and blasts his enemies with powerful magics, or why not a combination of all schools, its up to you on how you would like to build your character.
  • And more left for you to uncover.

2320400.name: Darkzan Arena
2320400.about_the_game:
🔥 Face Legends, Defeat Creatures, Dominate the Coliseum! 🔥

Get ready for an epic challenge like no other! Test your courage against the greatest legends and creatures of the multiverse in this mind-blowing coliseum. Collect rare treasures, upgrade your gear, and carve your path to becoming the number 1 of all time!

🎮 Endless Action: An arcade game that will push your limits with endless waves of unique enemies, each with unpredictable behaviors and exclusive rewards!

⚔️ Advanced Combat System: Strategy and skill are essential to victory! Experience, damage, and resilience blend into engaging gameplay that evolves with you.

🏆 Addictive and Fun Progression: With every victory, you grow stronger. A seamless system ensures every playthrough is a step closer to the top.

🌌 Don't wait any longer! Prove you have what it takes to dominate the coliseum and etch your name in multiverse history!

💥 The Challenge is On. Are You Ready to Be the Best? 💥

⚔️ Simple to Learn, Incredible to Master! ⚔️

While the concept starts simple, the game offers deep and challenging mechanics for those seeking complete mastery.

🎯 Customizable Combat Styles: Experiment with unique combinations of attacks and abilities that completely transform your battle strategy. Be agile and explosive or methodical and devastating—the style is yours, and the power is absolute!

💡 Countless Possibilities, Unlimited Fun: Combat variations allow each player to create their own path to victory, testing different approaches and ways to overcome challenges.

Jump into the game and discover the wealth of possibilities awaiting you! 🌟

⚔️ Darkzan Arena: Here, There Are No Rules—Only Victory! ⚔️

Prepare to fight without limits! In Darkzan Arena, what you equip defines your destiny. Choose your weapons: staffs, bows, swords, or anything else you can hold. If you can carry it, you can use it!

🔥 Unmatched Powers: Summons, necromancy, enchanted weapons, forbidden tomes—everything you conquer can be used to crush your enemies! Become a legend by mastering abilities beyond imagination.

💎 Hundreds of Exclusive Items: Choose from a vast variety of gear, each with its own identity, style, and devastating potential. Create combinations that suit your fighting style and write your story in the arena!

🏆 In the Darkzan Arena, the only limit is your ambition. Are you ready to rise above all and become invincible? 🩸

⚔️ Attention, Challenger: The Arenas Do Not Forgive! ⚔️

In the Darkzan arenas, you won’t face just anyone. Here emerge the best of the best, ready to prove they’re worthy of eternal glory.

🔥 Powerful Mages: Arcane masters with spells capable of devastating everything around them.

🏴‍☠️ Legendary Pirates: Swift strikes, ruthless strategies, and the glint of an unattainable treasure.

🛡️ Warriors from Another Era: Veterans carrying the fury and wisdom of ancient battles, thirsty for a new challenge.

👁️ Peak Adversaries: Every encounter will be against enemies at the height of their abilities, as determined as you to conquer the top.

Face-to-face, do you have what it takes to overcome these relentless opponents? Or will you be just another among the defeated? 🌟

💥 The Challenge Awaits. Prove Your Strength! 💥
2320400.supported_languages: English, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America

2320410.name: Scavenger of Dunomini
2320410.about_the_game:
Congratulations, you have been bound to a trash pit! Your task will be to recycle the trash into useful resources as it keeps coming down, and build automated deadly defences. Why defenses? Well other drones are not so lucky as you, and they will come to steal your precious garbage... But of course we trust you to kick them out before any makes it out with your trash! But do take caution that your garbage doesn't pile up too high either...

This is a unique and nervous take on the match-3 genre, inspired by the likes of Wario's woods, with a tower defense twist. Play solo or in local coop to defend your trash pile, or battle it out with a friend in versus mode!

2320460.name: Build and Drive Racing
2320460.about_the_game:
Get ready for a new experience on Windows desktop and VR,
where you get to build your ultimate racing machine, tailored to your driving style and optimized for performance, or race to the finish line with a monster what makes you smile.




Take on thrilling challenges to unlock a wide range of tracks, cars, addons and wheels.
And here's the best part: this is just the beginning! As the very first early access version, you can expect regular updates featuring fresh challenges, exciting tracks, and cool cars.




Don't miss out on the special early access price as the game continues to grow and evolve!

With stylised graphics and arcade-like physics, every turn, straightway and ramp will put your skills to the test.
Feel the thrill of the race like never before in VR, as you immerse yourself counting the seconds on the home stretch.



So what are you waiting for? Get behind the wheel and start building your car today.
The race is on!

The game features:
- Challenge unlock system: complete challenges to unlock cars, wheels, levels
- Game modes: race against your ghost and beat your best lap or race against AI opponents
- Garage: customize your car

Coming soon:
- UX improvements
- New level and challenges
- New cars and addons
- New game modes

2320480.name: Unsevered
2320480.about_the_game:
Enter Windgate and become its newest Relic User — the host of a rare magical power passed down through generations. A power cursed by their holders and coveted by everyone else.



With a brand-new target painted on your back and several bullets with your name on it, survival is no longer a mundane 21st-century activity, but a commodity sold to the highest bidder. After tearing apart every scrap of safety and normality in your life, this power will leave you but one thing to hold on to — your humanity. How will you face off against an entire city that wants you dead? What will you do when a second shot at true love scares you more than the red dot outside your window? Is blissful ignorance a fool's consort or veiled wisdom? One thing is for sure, the price for your survival will be paid in blood. In the end, the only true question is how much you're willing to pay.



This visual novel features an ample cast of characters, each with their own roots, conflicts, and biases, all clashing in an ever-evolving plot that unravels around The Protagonist and his struggle for control in the depths of a world he understands nothing about. Honoring its format, Unsevered does not recoil from meticulously exploring its narrative-rich world and the different perspectives of the people living in it. What truly sets this game apart is that even what seems most predictable can and will inevitably catch you off-guard. Unsevered seeks to fully utilize its themes and complex elements to offer a unique and genre-defying experience.



As it currently stands, Unsevered offers:

  • 7 chapters averaging 5-8 hours of total playtime for the entire game.
  • Around 5,100 renders.
  • Obsessively thought-out artwork.
  • Erotica made out of the hottest thing ever: human connection.
  • Lots of animations to go with it.
  • An enthralling story about passion, survival, and carving peace of mind out of chaos and misery.
  • One unlockable bonus chapter for one of the six main love interests.
  • A completely original, plot-driven magic system with its own language, sets of rules, and interactions with real-world physics.
  • Handpicked and diverse soundtrack and SFX (including for sex scenes).
  • The product of four years of labor, love, and the support and feedback of its player base.

2320500.name: Chloé’s Requiem -encore-
2320500.about_the_game:
Chloé’s Requiem is a Japanese 2D adventure game, filled with mysteries and surprises. The young creator, in her teens, created the original game, inspired by free game titles such as The Witch’s House and Ao Oni.

From the original release in 2013, the graphics and sounds have all been completely revamped, allowing all players, new and returning, to have a fresh experience with the game.






Interactions between Michél the violinist and Chloé the pianist can be enjoyed with beautiful character illustrations.



To break the multiple "curses" in the mansion, the player may need to hold items in both hands. There may be "curses" that require musical knowledge, making music one of the central themes of the game.



The world is set in 19th century Europe, with aesthetics and interiors reflecting the era.



We are all looking forward to your arrival.

2320530.name: KILAGER
2320530.about_the_game: "KILAGER" is a survival game with rich storyline, high degree of freedom, open world view and abundant gameplay mechanics.

2320550.name: The Respawn Banter
2320550.about_the_game:
The game over screen has always been a mystery: what hides behind it?
It might surprise you that behind it lies the goddess of life, who, by making just an exception, brings the hero back to life to enable him to resume his arduous path to victory.

But- what if the hero of the story and the goddess of life don't get along well?



The Respawn Banter is a unique adventure and visual novel hybrid where you are bound to die during your exploration. In the afterlife, the goddess of life’s role extends beyond mere revival: she seizes every opportunity to humor the hero’s demise, making each encounter a one-of-a-kind witty exchange.



Game Features:
  • Dying is never the punchline: it’s the start of the joke! Experience countless dynamic discussions based on how you reach a game over! "Am I dreaming?" "Was the prophet a fraud?" "Can slimes really get drunk?": with all the heated discussions that will ensue, you'll forget that you’re actually dead!
  • Lots of carefully crafted dialogues!
  • Play as the hero of the prophecy, or at least, fail to identify with him since he’s not the classic silent protagonist. Actually, he's a dummy who never shuts up when he should and quite frankly sucks at not dying.
  • Explore and avoid unfairly funny traps. Be ready to die, but always with a smile on your face!
  • Get to know the cast of characters you will meet over the course of your multiple lives!
  • Multiple secondary endings, depending on which areas you want the poor hero to meet his demise.

2320560.name: The Last Wish
2320560.about_the_game:
The Last Wish, a third-person exploration game diving you through the story of 5 different animals who was on the journey to complete their wishes. Players take control of different animals and discover their past and help them to reach their destiny. However, the main goal is not to just watch the stories but to learn the different perspective of life and how we are not alone with misfortunes in this world. In easy words this game will teach us that we are just a small scene in a very big picture, and we should value the things we have.

Key Features:

*Interactive Visual Novel, not moving 2d pictures but interactive so player can feel the environment.

*Not an "animal simulator," but an emotional, intimate story with an ending you won't soon forget.

*Focused on storytelling and exploration in linear world.

2320570.name: Tamagoneko
2320570.about_the_game:
Mischievous kitten eggs have escaped from the home nest!
As a small white Cat, it's up to you to find and return all of them back to safety, because the world is not friendly out there! Spikes, saws and bottomless pits are just a small part of what the Cat has to face on the journey to save the kitten eggs.





  • A huge world to go through:
    The kitten eggs have scattered all around the world! You will jump and climb through 160+ unique hand-crafted levels in 7 worlds in order to rescue them. Wild plains, thorny deserts, crystal caverns: each world comes with different design, distinctive levels and new gameplay mechanics.
  • Complex level design:
    Created with inspiration from Super Meat Boy, Celeste and Kaizo Mario, these fast-paced levels challenge your understanding of the Cat's movement and game mechanics. Some of them also require good execution, so it won't be easy, but won't be boring either!
  • Dozen of interactive elements:
    Balloons can bounce you up, platforms fall down (usually), stompers will squish you and coins always show the right way. Learn how to make them all helpful!
  • Refined character movement:
    Jumping is not the only thing cats are good at! Crawl through narrow passages, climb on steep walls and even double jump your way to new heights. Utilize these moves in combination with different level elements to overcome even the toughest obstacles!
  • Achievements and Cat customization:
    Spend your hard-earned coins and complete achievements to get colorful upgrades for the Cat! You can unlock more than 50 various skins, trails and effects and combine them to create your own stylish character.
  • Friendly for speedrunners:
    Tamagoneko tracks individual level times and total time spent completing the game. Can you beat it faster than anyone in the world?
  • Secret stuff:
    Each level contains a secret fruit for additional challenge. You get something cool after collecting enough of them, but don't dig too deep...
2320570.supported_languages: English, Russian, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Belarusian, Tatar

2320620.name: The Guard
2320620.about_the_game:
You are on the night shift at the mall. While you were taking over, your partner went missing. You hear noises all the time. You need to find out what they are and find your partner. As you pass, you will need to find the keys and open locked rooms. First person game with horror elements. Explore the mall and its rooms, collect batteries for your flashlight. Darkness can conceal a variety of mysteries.

F - flashlight, Tab - inventory
Control in the game WASD - move, left mouse button - pick up the item. Right mouse button - examine the item.

Features:
- pleasant graphics;
- simple controls;
- interesting gameplay;

2320630.name: Make Them Stop
2320630.about_the_game:
In a glorious past, the kingdom of Meritons shone with wisdom and prosperity. But after centuries, the whole dynasty's been falling apart. The governance of the kingdom has crumbled, injustices have multiplied, and many citizens have been forced to leave a system that has become unfair and outdated.

You joined a small group in a camp near the city.

To survive, we’ll have to help each other and stick to the camp rules. Food, water, electricity, cleaning, resource management and rat hunting. Everything counts!

The camp’s really basic, we’ll need to upgrade it if we want to survive the winters. You’ll help explore and discover new tools and techniques to craft improvements. From shelter insulation to vegetable gardening to electrical systems, there's plenty to do!

Outcasts, but not alone! You’ll have plenty of missions to gain experience. Team up with your campmates for the riskiest tasks. High risk, high reward.

Resources are running low, and the competition outside the camp is brutal. Don’t let anyone push you around. You're going to have to fight!
2320630.supported_languages:
English*, French
*languages with full audio support

2320660.name: 1000 Man General
2320660.about_the_game:
To battle! An enormous battle awaits you on the way to glory.

Tasked with leading 1000 troops, you must devise a battle plan that will ensure your army emerges victorious. Purchase troops, assign locations, and give them orders on the battle map to create devastating maneuvers to annihilate the opposing army.



Lead your troops into battle. Give the order to charge, and join them in the assault. Hack and slash your way through hundreds of enemy troops seeking to destroy your army.



Replay any level you have already beaten with the ability to customize the weather, enemy difficulty, or even scale up the number of troops to an insane level.

2320710.name: Mauled
2320710.about_the_game:
Trapped in a paranormal-infested shopping centre in the middle of nowhere, your goal is to survive! With a lurking horrific late-night shopper searching the empty corridors, you must evade dying and stop the cycle.



You must be versatile. Run and use hiding spaces to your advantage to escape the monster patrolling the shopping centre. Or use the variety of items left behind by other trapped mortals to get through the multiple levels of the shopping centre.



Every time you die, the cycle restarts. It is permadeath. With every cycle, the horror evolves. Your goal is to escape in as few cycles as possible….if you enjoy your sanity.



New cycle, new mortal. From a scientist to lost children, every time a new cycle begins a new mortal is challenged with escaping the shopping centre. Equipped with unique items or unique gameplay features each mortal brings something to a cycle.



Venture through multiple levels of the shopping centre in search of a means of escape or to end this nightmare...



Don’t die for nothing. Unlock secret passageways and broken doors that remain open in every cycle. Mortals will then be able to move around the map more efficiently…but so will the monster.



What could be worse than a monster? Paranormal entities playing tricks on your mind. Nothing in this shopping centre can be trusted, the environment will be constantly changing and devious events are throughout.

2320720.name: AgrChamp
2320720.about_the_game:
AgrChamp is a game where your goal is to jump to the top, where irresistible reward awaits you - a dream of every high school student. But it won’t be that easy, as it seems. There are a lot of ways how to make the jump, and that’s why you have to consider your every jump. One mistake and everything you have achieved is gone.





To make our form more enjoyable we’ve divided the map into 6 parts. Each part will have its own special qualities and a different subtext. After you complete the given part there will be a guard waiting on you, he is going to give you your last task that will open the door for the next part. But beware, that’s not all. In between two parts there is so-called intermediate level, that works like a connection. This is where it gets really dangerous… And why? See for yourself.



What’s there to look forward to?

  • 6 Big parts (entertainment is taken care of)
  • Retro graphics
  • Real and funny moments from the life of Agraelus
  • Funny texts
  • Special qualities for each part

2320730.name: Neon Death Drop
2320730.about_the_game:
Explore a futuristic sky-city teeming with glitchy robots in NEON DEATH DROP, an action game about a gay go-go boy who must use his fierce dance moves to save the world.

THE GROUND IS YOUR PLAYGROUND

Manipulate floor tiles by making them move, grow, or even disappear

SLAY THE BOTS DOWN

Defeat enemies by knocking them into pits and watch them drop dead

COMBO YOUR CHOREO

Combine dynamic dance moves to perform spectacular takedowns and see your TIP$ go through the roof!

  • Dodge waves of projectiles in bullet hell mayhem

  • Defeat big bad bosses by countering their attacks

  • Explore sprawling cityscapes and enjoy neon-tastic vistas

  • Discover hidden treasures to beef up your abilities

  • Enjoy hours of sassy voiceover as you unfold the story

  • Restore order to the city and become the fabulous hero you were born to be

2320740.name: Exodus of Descent
2320740.about_the_game:
Exodus of Descent is a dynamic third person online dungeon-looter RPG inspired by games such as Runescape, Dark and Darker, and Monster Hunter. Party up with your friends to run through intense PvE dungeons. Each dungeon contains challenging enemies, bosses, secrets to find, puzzles needed to solve, and 150+ lootable items including weapons, armor pieces, amulets, and crafting materials. Risk it all to Escape your Descent. Will you make it out alive?

PvE Dungeon Looter

Your team will be faced with cross-road decisions each run requiring you to solve each dungeon's mystery to successfully escape your descent. Or... do you all choose to travel deeper into battle for better loot and rewards? Face down final boss battles with your partners where only the strongest will survive! Along the way collect loot, level up and unlock new perks and abilities!

Create Your Class

Build out your play-style with a classic RPG leveling system, where each skill point spent after leveling up adjusts your player's strengths and weaknesses. Create the build you desire with over 150+ weapons, armor pieces, and items with different rolls and rarities. Be careful though, dying in the dungeon with looses all weapons and armor pieces not soulbound... so look out!

Craft Your Way to Victory

Can't get the drop you were looking for? No worries, stock up on crafting items to forge the items you want at the crafting table. Rarer crafting items have special effects, so be sure to search every chest and enemy drop!

Shop After You Drop

Did you just die and lose all your valuables? Need a helping hand? Are you just a looking for a quick setup? Whatever the case, spend your hard-earned gold pieces at vendors within the Hub World before each raid. Vendors are routinely stocked with a rotating inventory, with special vendors within dungeons selling the best-of-the-best.

NOTE! This title is in ongoing development at Yooper Game Studios and all images are subject to change. Join our discord for the latest news and updates regarding upcoming playtests and information surrounding the game and its release!

2320770.name: Pinewood Valley
2320770.about_the_game:
Pinewood Valley thrusts you into a spine-tingling, single-player horror experience. It is 2006, and you return to your hometown as a young man, only to find it shrouded in secrets and haunted by a sinister presence. Every shadow hides a new danger, and survival means outsmarting, escaping, and confronting a ruthless group of killers to save the town you once called home.

Open World: Step into a richly detailed open world where nearly every building invites exploration. Lose yourself for hours as you roam the Town, uncovering secrets and confronting both new and familiar dangers.

Encounter Survivors: You are not the only one trying to survive in the Town, meet and interact with survivors along the way who are trying to survive the night and make it out alive.

Killer Line-up: Face a chilling array of killers, each with their own twisted style, yet all united by a relentless urge to hunt you and the entire Town.

Run, hide, or fight: The choice is yours. Sprinting offers the safest escape from relentless killers, while hiding gives you a lifeline in cramped spaces. In Pinewood Valley, you are never without options. Some enemies are fierce and hard to defeat, but every threat can be overcome.

Weapons: Arm yourself with an array of powerful firearms to stand your ground against relentless killers.

2320800.name: Finesse
2320800.about_the_game:
Finesse has a simple premise: avoid the lasers. They will zap you. If you get zapped, you lose health. If you lose enough health, it's game over.

How you go about avoiding the lasers is the fun part. You play as a world-class athlete who can jump like a pole vaulter, contort like a gymnast, and dress in fun costumes. You also have the ability to bend time--that part especially comes in handy.

With just one button you can halve the speed of any given animation. While the lasers continue to move at the same pace, you can hang in the air for several seconds or, if necessary, keep your belly on the ground. It also looks really cool.

2320860.name: We Will Get revenge
2320860.about_the_game:
Don't buy it, for the love of god.

This is a test game, my first project, and it's meant for research purposes.

It's poorly optimized, and while it's playable, there are no plans to finish it. I'd just like to keep testing it.

We Will Get Revenge is a challenging Roguelite-Shoot'Em Up game with interesting mechanics and physics in which you will have to take revenge on those who destroyed the earth.

Key Features

  • Replayability with unique and unrepeatable runs

  • Cooperative Multiplayer

  • Master Upgrade System

  • Critical Decisions

  • True Enemy Protocol

  • Twitch Implementation

No playthrough is the same

  • Various Ships with unique weapons to choose from

  • Pilots with bonuses to combine

  • Powerful Bases to select from

  • Dozens of Weapons to find and unlock

  • Hundreds of Power-ups to upgrade

  • Dozens of Challenges, decisions and missions

  • Dozens of new Enemies and Bosses to face

  • Procedural maps

  • Mutators to modify each run

  • A hateful Rival with True Enemy Protocol

  • Everything this and much more succulently distributed throughout 30 levels of difficulty that you must unlock

Gameplay

The main premise is very simple. Defend your base at all times and completely destroy any enemy that stands in front of you but... With a gratifying number of missions, challenges and mini-games we can forget about those repetitive experiences:

ENEMY ATTACK

Simple missions where you have to defend your base and destroy all enemies.

STATION CAPTURE

Mission in which you must retake control of neutral stations before the enemy destroys them.

ESCAPE

Mission in which you must dodge obstacles, destroy barriers and enemies, evade turret attacks and more, all while being chased by a powerful explosion.

MINIBOSS AND BOSS ATTACK

The name is more than enough, but it is important to mention that each of these rivals has unique mechanics, random patterns and others not so random, weak points and strategies that require great skill.

COMBAT EVENTS

If you like risky decisions this is for you, random missions where you will have 4 choices with possible positive, neutral or catastrophic outcomes and that will commonly trigger battles or combat challenges.

OPPORTUNITY EVENTS

Similar to combat events but here the choices can take you from huge credit rewards or unique boosts to automatic damage to your base or the loss of all your upgrades.

ASSAULT TO STATIONS

Massive combats against enemy stations with the support of allied ships in unique conditions.

ISOLATED LOOTS

Magnificent rewards in which you must decide whether to take the easy path and get a safe but simple reward or choose the path of the samurai and put your skills to the test with unique mini-games, battles or challenges to get powerful rewards.

REFUELING STATIONS

What better way to describe this than space shops and markets, buy upgrades or weapons, repair your base or recharge shields.

True Enemy Protocol

Your worst nightmare comes true: a rival that will evolve along with your game. You can choose between two versions:

Simple:Let's avoid spoilers, so I'll just mention that it has the ability to annoy you at almost any time, plan ambushes, interfere in a battle, sabotage your base and even make you lose some rewards.

Complete:If you really want to suffer, welcome to hell. Just like simple mode but on steroids: it will have almost human capabilities, it will be able to make you suffer in unique ways like a real rival, it will strategize at the level of a genius and will make you feel afraid of his mere presence - of course without being an invincible or super powerful enemy.

Upgrading System

When you start each run you will start the same way, with your basic ship and preset weapons, but there are ways to improve it so you can progress through each game and each difficulty level.

Unlockables:At the end of each game you will get temporary fragments that you can use to unlock new weapons, ships, pilots, bases, stations, missions, improvements and much more.

Master Level System:Everything in this adventure can level up as you use it, weapons, ships, pilots and main bases will improve minimally with each fight permanently.

Basic Power-ups:Powerful upgrades to choose from for every win or reward, choose wisely.

Elite power-ups:Even more powerful than the Basic ones, they significantly change the way your weapons work and open the way to new strategies.

Implementation for Twitch

Link your account and allow your audience to participate in your destiny.

They will vote to decide your fate: good, bad, terrible, what could go wrong?
2320860.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

2320880.name: Terror of the Seven Seas
2320880.about_the_game:
Terror of the Seven Seas is the pirate game you have always dreamed of, combining ship combat, boarding and sailing with a massive living open world full of exploration and conquest.

BE THE CAPTAIN YOU ALWAYS WANTED TO BE

  • Become a Legendary Pirate! Live a life of freedom and plunder a mountain of gold.

  • Become a Naval Officer! Serve your king, raise a mighty fleet, and conquer the world for the glory of your nation.

  • Become a Wealthy Trader! Run your own treasure fleets, carry unimaginable wealth to all corners of the world, and battle the pirates trying to plunder it from you.

  • Become a World Renowned Explorer! Find lost temples and artifacts, hunt whales and sea monsters. Maybe you will even find the dream of every conquistador: El Dorado!

Become a real cutthroat and sweep the enemy's deck of crew by slashing and shooting through it!
Master a sword and parry yourself to victory.
Shoot with masterful precision and dome your enemies from stern to bow.
Wield the deck sweeping hand cannon and make your enemies fear its roar.
All this in the massive 30 vs 30 melee battles.

Enjoy and explore a massive hand built version of Earth. Sail the Seven Seas and all that it provides, from the warmth of the Caribbean to the cold winds of the Arctic.

See the bustle and industry of Europe and sail the trade winds to Asia and the Americas.

Visit, trade with, and conquer over 120 ports. From London to Istanbul to the pirate haven known as Tortuga.

A fully uninterrupted open world; follow the sail winds of Magellan and circumnavigate the globe!

NAVAL COMBAT BAR NONE

  • Sink your enemies with a wide array of weapons. From cannonballs and mortars to explosive barrels and fire ships!

  • Use skills such as anchor turns and explosive cannonballs to aid you in combat.

  • Weaken your enemies and board them for extra rewards.

  • Manoeuvre your ships with the wind and devastate your enemies with raking shots.

  • Command a fleet of up to seven ships to aid you in battle.


Over 30 detailed period correct ships, all the way from 6 gun sloops to massive 160 gun Man'O'Wars!
Recruit up to 6 other captains to your fleet!

A LIVING BREATHING WORLD

  • Trade galleons carry vast wealth across the seas while pirates hunt them in search of gold.

  • Fierce pirate hunters await their chance at vengeance and justice.

  • Navies dynamically war on the shores and open seas for control of territory.

  • Sea monsters lurk below the surface, eagerly awaiting the next unsuspecting ship to become their prey.

  • Nations create alliances and start wars in their quest for dominance over land and sea.

  • Witness, cause and join massive naval battles.

Move freely and command your ship either from the deck or from the third person view.

RANK UP AND TRAIN YOUR SKILLS

Gain experience and rank! Use your status to gather mighty crewmen, loyal allies, and special skills to offer you advantages inside and outside of combat.

From fiery volcanoes to sunken treasure and ancient temples. Veer into the mysteries of the occult and more!

Find treasure, allies, and legendary equipment hidden inside.

ROARING SEAS

Dynamic weather and time of day offer an ever changing environment. From calm, clear sunrises to fierce ship sized waves, howling winds, and pouring rains. Witness mighty thunder storms and battle fierce tornadoes!

CHOOSE YOU ALLIANCES

Choose from 14 different factions to enlist with, from all over the world! Affect their destinies and rewrite their history to your liking.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIPS

Gather upgrades from enemies, find them from hidden treasure, or plunder them from merchants. Use them to enhance your ship and crew in a variety of ways:

  • Use copper plated hulls to improve your ship's speed

  • Equip bronze cannons to increase accuracy and damage of your cannonballs.

  • Customize sails that will forever symbolize the might of your fleet.

And dozens of more ways to turn your ship into one that you have always dreamed of!

So what are you waiting for? Buy now and set sail in the Seven Seas!

2320890.name: Midnight at the Disco
2320890.about_the_game:
Midnight at the Disco is a fast-paced, top-down roguelike twin-stick shooter where you must survive a dance floor overrun by grotesque alien eyeball monsters.

Annihilate massive hordes of the interdimensional invaders. Collect vinyl records to level up an insanely deep skill tree, unlocking game-changing perks and abilities. Break open chests for powerful items and gear up for each frantic, bite-sized run.

Over 20 unique enemy types, each with distinctive attack patterns, will relentlessly pursue you. Thankfully, you can create wildly different builds by mixing and matching a huge array of upgrades, power-ups, and random modifiers - ensuring no two runs play out the same.

Oh, and watch your step...there's poop.

Features:

  • Huge build variety for limitless replayability

  • Short roguelike runs perfect for pick-up-and-play

  • Online leaderboards

  • Intense and fast paced gameplay

  • Massive enemy hordes with unique, challenging behaviors
