2320900.name: XC Cross Country Racing
2320900.about_the_game:
A strategy based racing game where you must manage your stamina as you determine whether you should follow behind the other racers or push the pace.
Customize your character and get ready to take on the competition as you try to win the race and compete for a top spot on the leaderboards. Maneuver the course and avoid obstacles as you tap to keep the rhythm of the race. There are three difficulties to choose from, but be forewarned this game demands as much toughness and patience as the sport (and kart racers) that inspired it. No Ads…Ever....Just good, old-fashioned Cross Country Racing.

2320910.name: AMID EVIL VR
2320910.about_the_game:
A retro FPS for the ages! Completely rebuilt from the ground up for VR! Once branded a HERETIC. Now YOU have been chosen as our champion! Reclaim our sacred weapons. Take back our ancient lands. If you can stand... AMID EVIL.

  • SEVEN distinct episodes each featuring unique settings and enemies in each.
  • An EIGHT HOUR CAMPAIGN with TWENTY ONE levels and SEVEN INTENSE BOSS FIGHTS!
  • LUDICROUS magical weaponry that can be overcharged with the souls of the dead and used in either hand.
  • Hack ‘n slash demons to pieces, or blow them to bits with an arsenal of weapons including a PLANET LAUNCHER.
  • BRUTAL and adaptive enemy AI that will hunt you down on land, sea and air
  • SPRAWLING non-linear levels filled with secrets and ancient lore
  • MULTITUDES of comfort options and *cheats* for a truly「 Golden Experience 」
  • EPIC original & dynamic soundtrack composed by Andrew Hulshult
  • BUILT in Unreal Engine 4 for cutting edge visuals (even if they are a bit retro)

This is not some half-baked version of AMID EVIL ported to VR, this is the REAL DEAL.
2320910.reviews:
“It just feels incredible.”
UploadVR

“A fantastic addition to the world of VR gaming.”
Gamertag VR

“A must-have for owners of VR headsets”
WayTooManyGames

2320980.name: Loftia
2320980.about_the_game:
Loftia is a cozy multiplayer game about building a life in the sky. Set across floating islands, you’ll farm, craft, decorate, and explore alongside friends in a shared world that grows over time. Whether you’re hanging out after a long day or teaming up for a bigger adventure, Loftia is a place to slow down, connect, and create something meaningful together.

In the world of Loftia, you can:

Explore the world of Loftia, meet and befriend NPCs, tackle quests to help the community, and gather and craft with resources and tools to help you on your journey!

Master sustainable farming techniques like hydroponics, aquaponics, and trellis farming. Craft your own tools using renewable energy generated from the sun, wind and rain!

Create a character that feels fully like you, and design your home in the style you love. There's a super wide variety of different options and aesthetics for you to choose from!

Create your own floating island and link up with others to form neighborhoods. Decorate, farm, craft, and spend time together in shared spaces that feel lived-in and personal.

Rescue and adopt animals to join you on your journey, from capybaras and turtles to other unique species. Bring them along, dress them up, and let them keep you company as you explore the world.

Venture beyond the city to scavenge in abandoned factories, solve puzzles, and take on group quests across different biomes. Team up when you want, or explore at your own pace.

Work together on community projects that help the world grow. By contributing to shared builds, you’ll unlock new resources, uncover hidden stories, and open up new islands to explore.
2320980.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil

2320990.name: Hentai Puzzles: The Origin
2320990.about_the_game:
Meet Melissa, the bubbly and outgoing university schoolgirl who loves spending her free time at the beach. With her bright smile and infectious laughter, she's the life of the party and the center of attention wherever she goes. Melissa spends most of her days soaking up the sun, surfing the waves, and building sandcastles with friends. With her love for adventure and passion for life, spending time with Melissa is sure to be an unforgettable experience.



Introducing Amanda, the strict and efficient librarian who has a heart of gold. As a tsundere, Amanda may come across as cold and unapproachable, but deep down she has a soft spot for those who show an interest in literature. Whether it's finding the perfect book or recommending a hidden gem, Amanda is the ultimate tsundere librarian who will go to great lengths to help you discover the joy of reading. Are you ready to uncover the treasures within the library's walls with Amanda?

Features
  • High Quality Puzzles
  • Casual One Handed Gameplay ;)
  • Steam Achievements
2320990.supported_languages: English, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, French, German

2321000.name: Beacon's Bluff
2321000.about_the_game:
Check out our latest game -- SEEING THINGS

Beacon's Bluff is a 2D pressure puzzler with horror elements.

You've taken the job as a lighthouse keeper at a mysterious, isolated lighthouse.

Keep the beacon's light alive and survive your shift by solving intriguing puzzles. Become engrossed in this discerning horror puzzler.

Your watch starts now

  • The graveyard shift awaits

  • Complete dynamic lighthouse tasks to keep the light alive

  • Whatever you do, do not let the light extinguish. Ships could crash. Or worse...

  • You are responsible for the lighthouse from 12am to 6am

  • Survive your shift to win

highlighted.name: Keep it Secret, Keep it Safe

2321040.name: Mercenaries Lament: Requiem of the Silver Wolf
2321040.about_the_game:
A prayer for the fallen to rise from the depths of despair—

[Game Overview]
Mercenaries Lament is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world.
Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, where character positioning in the front, back, and side of enemy units may very well determine each battle’s outcome.
Support effects depend on where allied characters in your party are positioned, allowing players to enjoy highly strategic maneuvers. Players have a high degree of freedom in character development, such as acquiring and strengthening skills and changing classes by using skill points earned in battle.
The characters are beautifully drawn with rich facial expressions by the illustrator Sakura Mochi!

・Advent Soul
When Amalie, the heroine is in your party, you can fill a gauge on the top right of the screen which will allow you to stock 1 BP when full.
（Up to 9 BP can be stocked up.）
By using BP characters can enter a state called "Advent Soul" which fortifies the character for a certain period of time.
The character can then use "Advent attacks" with other party members and "Soul Exceed" skills, which are special moves.


・Advent attacks
When a character in “Advent mode” is positioned to sandwich an enemy with another ally, a coordinated attack can be unleashed by performing a normal attack or attack skill.
The Advent attacks are unique skills for each character and provide a chance to inflict heavy damage.


・Soul Exceed skills
Units in Advent mode can use Soul Exceed skills at any time.
This special move is unique to each character, and effects vary from inflicting immense damage to the enemy to recovering HP and abnormalities of all allies.
(Once Soul Exceed is used, the character's Advent mode will be lifted.)
Utilizing Soul Exceed skills are the key to victory!


・Orbs with hidden power
There are mysterious "Orbs" that can be obtained from story progression, specific locations, and certain enemies.
There are 13 Orbs in total scattered throughout the game.
You can check the status of your collection on a dedicated screen and equip your character with them as accessories.
What will happen when all the Orbs are collected?


[Story]
Several years have passed since a mysterious disease with no cure quickly spread across the continent.
Those infected would suffer a horrible fate of turning into zombies after their death, mindlessly attacking the living. It has become the norm for hired mercenaries to spend countless days clearing the lands of the undead.
Such a mercenary is Johann, captain of the Silver Wolf Mercenary Company. He is paid a visit by the Grim Reaper, and narrowly escapes its blade of death, but the Reaper leaves him with an eerie prophecy: "In the next 100 days, your luck shall run out. That shall be the day of your fate.”
After awaking from a delirious slumber, he is met by a young woman with miraculous powers that can heal people from the disease.
Was his encounter with the Grim Reaper but a nightmare....?
Regardless, Johann offers to protect the miracle worker on her travels to save as many people as she can. They set out on a journey to travel the kingdom, curing the infected.
Soon, however, Johann must confront his mortality…

2321450.name: QR Escape
2321450.about_the_game:
Welcome to QR Escape, a game designed by QR Mosaics.

QR Escape is essentially a fun escape-room puzzle-solving game, with a unique twist. You play the game on your PC/laptop device while interacting with a QR reader app on your mobile device. You are playing one of the first games in a new interactive gameplay genre.

To progress in the game, you will need to solve puzzles, and once complete they will reveal/construct a QR code. When scanned with a reader, those QR codes will provide a 6-digit password. That code is then plugged into various keypads in the game to open doors and make progress. The codes change each time the game is played, so each game execution is a unique experience.

QR Codes


There are many QR codes to scan in the game. Some are required to progress the game, some provide clues/hints, some are for fun and others are simply gallery QR artwork to look at and enjoy!

Because scanning QR codes is a very important aspect of the game, please feel free to test your ability to scan using the picture below before you purchase the game. If you can scan this picture on your screen and see the words "puzzle time!" on your QR reader, you can play the game! Scan from a distance!



If it doesn't scan right away move your phone AWAY from the screen so it appears small, or zoom-out. QR readers are best at reading screen QR's from a few feet away.

Where Do I Get A QR Reader?


if you have a mobile phone, you certainly will be able to scan the QR codes.

1) Modern iPhone or Android devices will scan from the built-in camera. Just start up the camera app and point the camera at the QR code on the screen and the camera will detect it. You may have to enable QR Scanning from your phone settings if it is currently disabled.
2) Download a custom QR reader. There are literally hundreds to choose from, most work fine, but a few are not so good. The free QR reader app I used personally to test the game (on an iPhone) is called "Qrafter: QR Code reader". I found it an excellent reader, but it will show adverts. I have no personal connection to the reader and do not profit from it.

The Story


You have been asked by the curator of a unique art gallery to investigate strange goings-on in the basement of the gallery. The basement is used as a store room and to provide heat. However, the curator has been locked out of the basement and strange noises are coming from downstairs. As you enter the gallery, the door locks behind you and you realize you must escape. Delve into the underbelly of the gallery to discover the source of the mystery and escape!

Achievements


If you like achievements, this is the game for you. There are currently 25 fun Steam achievements. More will be added in due course.

All to sort out your private life and chase your ultimate dream!

The free version of Dynopunk: Welcome to Synth-City offers a chance to live a full 7-day week as a resident of a futuristic cyber city, but there is a catch — you will now have to deal with having much shorter arms!

Imagine that a meteor had never struck the Earth, so the dinosaurs did not go extinct but continued to evolve. Now, millions of years later, they inhabit high-tech megalopolises. One such dino is Chris, a repair shop owner who dreams of building a Time Machine to travel to the past and find true love, because he is the last remaining T-Rex on the planet!

Meet Cyberpunk Dinosaurs
Enjoy pixel art that pays homage to 1990s retro games. Meet a cast of memorable characters from an alternative future where predatory, carnivorous dinosaurs have come to rule the world. Relax to the sound of a Lo-fi soundtrack as you progress through the story and make plot-altering decisions.


Fix Gadgets
Elicit relevant information from your clients to find the source of the problem and fix their gadgets. Perform your work neatly and carefully — your income depends on it.


Chat up the Customers
Strike up heart-to-heart conversations with customers and offer them a beverage to their liking. A glass of cool fizz or a cup of hot coffee increases your chances of getting tips.


Follow the Dream
You play as the last surviving T-Rex on Earth, trying to build a Time Machine and travel to the past to find true love. Will this dream ever come true?


Features:
  • Seven in-game days of running your own workshop and repairing equipment to learn the tricks of the trade. Disassemble and replace parts by carving out the required chips. You can even play a prank on your customers if you wish... or have an ulterior motive. Just be ready to face the consequences!
  • Great opportunity to exchange pleasantries with a quirky assistant — a talking printer that enjoys teasing Chris about his little arms and likes to give questionable business advice.
  • Drink-serving simulator, which affects not only the customers' mood but also the size of your tip.
  • Original, 1980s-inspired Lo-fi soundtrack! Pour yourself a cup of hot tea, then sit back, relax, and get immersed in the story.
  • A variety of interesting characters that will pay a visit to your repair shop. Each of them comes with unique traits, dreams, and a personal story that can be influenced by player choice.
  • Dialogues full of irony, jokes, references, and Easter eggs to cheer you up!
  • Pixelated graphics inspired by 1990s retro gaming.

2321470.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
2321470.about_the_game:
Welcome, Survivor!

DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: SURVIVOR is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades to survive, as you wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

REVERSE BULLET HELL, WITH MINING

Kill bugs, upgrade your gear, and delve ever deeper into the lethal caves of Hoxxes. Collect and assemble a devastating array of guns, unleash hell upon wave after wave of alien monsters in fast and frenetic combat, and tunnel your way to collect precious riches from deep within the cave walls. With the auto-shooter gameplay, you don’t worry about aiming and firing – just run and mine for your life, as you automatically blast away.

Each mission is entirely unique with its own procedural cave generation and enemy waves, just as you've come to know from Deep Rock Galactic.

COMPLETE MISSION OBJECTIVES TO BECOME STRONGER

Dig deep, Miner! Once the Drop Pod releases you into the oppressive darkness, you’re on your own. Complete the mission objectives set forth by the Company, and make it back to the Drop Pod in time to try your luck at even more deadly and lucrative encounters. Progress deeper and deeper into the planet while you grow ever stronger, survive all the way to the very end of your assignment, and finally get extracted alongside your hefty sack of loot.

DEEP ROCK, FROM A WHOLE NEW PERSPECTIVE

Now you can explore the Deep Rock Galactic universe in a whole new single-player-focused experience! Play each mission from a top-down perspective, navigating the caves of Hoxxes as you've never seen them before, soaking it up through nonstop auto-shooter action. Greybeard Deep Rock veterans will recognize much from Deep Rock Galactic, and if you are a recently joined Greenbeard: Welcome all the same! We are thrilled to have you on board. You will like it here. Management requires it.

ROCK AND STONE!

2321520.name: Aussie Bogan Hero
2321520.about_the_game:
Welcome to Dusty Springs—a sleepy outback town where the mullets are long, the stubbies are cold, and the local bogans are louder than a magpie in mating season.

All is as it should be in Dusty Springs, until life takes a wild turn and the nearby opal mine digs up more than just shiny rocks. These ain’t your average gems—they’re packed with spooky spirits and weird powers, warping the land and turning the local wildlife into beefed-up bush terrors.

Enter Drill and Thrill—a dodgy megacorp with more money than morals. They move in faster than a seagull on hot chips, snatching up the mine and milking it dry. As things get weirder, they do what any greedy company would: blame the local bogans. Next thing you know, Dusty Springs is in full lockdown—no footy, no servo runs, and worst of all, no pub.

Meet Davo—proud bogan who loves a good pint. When his beloved watering hole shuts down, he’s had enough. With his thongs on and a heart full of sausage rolls, Davo sets out to save his town, expose Drill and Thrill, and maybe even punch a few drongos along the way.

Explore Straya

Strap in for a wild ride across the weird and wonderful Aussie outback. From the blistering heat of the red centre to the Opera House itself, the land down under is packed with secrets around every corner. 

Dive deep into cursed opal mines that twist reality itself, unearth ancient bush legends, and maybe even ride a rogue emu or two.

Throw Down

Menacing magpies. Bulbous bin chickens. Ravenous redbacks. The outback’s crawling with trouble, and Davo’s not afraid to throw down. Arm yourself with whatever’s lying around—cricket bats, pub darts, or even your trusty ligher. 

With plenty of toe-to-toe knuckle sandwich showdowns, combat in Aussie Bogan Hero is a glorious mess of backyard brawling and improvised mayhem. It’s not about finesse—it’s about fightin' dirty and lookin' good in a singlet.

Bonza Upgrades

As Davo makes his way through the treacherous Aussie outback, he’ll come across some fair dinkum upgrades to help him on his journey. These ripper tools let him crack tricky puzzles, take on tougher enemies, and reach places he couldn’t before.

From a dodgy old lighter that doubles as a flamethrower to a used goon bag perfect for gliding through the air, Davo’s keen to make the most of whatever he can scrounge up to survive the wilds of the outback.

True Blue Laughs

From snarky one-liners to pub-worthy banter, Aussie Bogan Hero is dripping in true-blue Aussie humour. Satirical, shameless, and proudly Strayan—it’s the kind of comedy that’d make your nan gasp.

So grab your thongs, crack open a cold one, and join Davo on the bogan-est adventure out of Australia. 'Cause sometimes, it takes a legend in a singlet to save the day.

2321630.name: Animal Jigsaw VR
2321630.about_the_game:
Animal Jigsaw VR is a relaxing puzzle game that not only improves your mood, but also increases your knowledge with interesting content about a variety of animals and their habitats.

Take a deep breath and immerse yourself in nature.
Enter the beautiful, sunny savannah to socialize with cheetahs, or listen to the sounds of the trees in a peaceful meadow among deer. "Animal Jigsaw VR" pleasantly surprises with its graphics and faithful representation of animals.



An adventure you'll return to time and time again.
With over a dozen levels of varying difficulty, each with 3D puzzles of varying complexity and quantity, it's the perfect way to beat boredom any time of the year or day. Completing each level allows you to explore a new region and expand your animal collection.

More than just a game
"Animal Jigsaw VR" is not just great fun, it's also educational. Players can learn many new things about different animal species and their environments.



For young and old alike
Whether you're buying the game for yourself or your child, "Animal Jigsaw VR" is a game for anyone who loves animals, logic puzzles, and wants to explore the world.

2321650.name: Old Forest Ranch
2321650.about_the_game:
Welcome to Old Forest Ranch

A place where the lush green forest meets the rolling hills of the countryside. As a young farmer, you've decided to build your dream ranch here, but there's just one problem – the forest is being invaded by evil scarecrows! Your mission is to protect your land, your crops, and fellow farmers from these wicked enemies while creating a thriving ranch!

Grow crops till you drop!

Plant your crops, fulfill orders, and complete jobs to grow your farm, all while defending it against waves of scarecrows. Use a variety of weapons, traps, and upgrades to keep them at bay and protect your land. Earn money by selling your harvest and use it to upgrade your farm and weapons to face even greater challenges.

In Old Forest Ranch, you can:

  • Plant and harvest a variety of crops and sell your harvest for profit
  • Fight off waves of evil scarecrows with an arsenal of weapons and traps
  • Buy new weapons and unlock farm jobs to improve your ranch and fend off even stronger enemies
  • Explore the rich and vibrant forest, uncovering secrets and meeting new characters

Get out there and explore!

With immersive gameplay, charming characters, and a colorful world to explore, Old Forest Ranch is the ultimate farming/forest adventure. Protect your ranch and defeat the evil scarecrows to save the forest and become the ultimate farmer hero. Play now and embark on a wild adventure!

2321690.name: The Voyager
2321690.about_the_game:
In The Voyager you play a solitary inventor who has dedicated his life to breaking the laws of physics. You built the Device, but you never imagined what lay on the other side.

Dimensions

Immerse yourself in the mind of the protagonist in his daily routine, work on the device and play the video game, go to sleep and see what the subconscious tells you from your dreams.

Travel to parallel worlds

You don't know the destination and you don't know the duration of the journey but it's the same land, the same year and the same day, something different has happened in evolution.. Cross desolate dimensions, mysterious islands inhabited by prehistoric creatures and military bases.

Each world is a piece of the puzzle to understand the Krag threat.

Gameplay

is a linear narrative experience where you advance the story by overcoming small environmental challenges, with some horror, FPS, stealth and simple puzzle sections. Between trips, return to the safety of your home, drink coffee, train, upgrade your device and note your discoveries in the journal.

The Horror of the Unknown

Your dreams reflect the trauma of your travels. Confront psychological manifestations of your guilt and terror in dream sequences that change as the story unfolds.

A Terrible Threat

A race is crossing dimensions… and you're in the middle. Discover the truth about the Krags, they are not aliens but they are not human either... but they will stop at nothing to conquer all the parallel worlds.

2321700.name: Escalar: The Tower of Treasures
2321700.about_the_game:
Make your way towards the tower, but beware of dangerous traps and enemies hidden behind any corner! As you progress through the game, don't forget to collect gems to purchase upgrades from Burlar's Bazaar!

Key Features

  • Climb!

Climb up the tower and discover more of the treasures that lie within it!

  • Charge Jump!

Use your Charge Jump to jump long distances, however once you release the jump key you'll be left with no air control!

  • Grapple!

Equip your grapple hook to reach higher locations!

  • Grenades!

You can use your grenades to break through wooden doors, perhaps you will find hidden areas!

  • Shovel Donk!

Use your trusty shovel to destroy boxes or defend yourself against enemies!

  • Hazards!

Beware of hazards and traps that try to stop you from traversing the tower!

2321740.name: Hank Loves The Beach
2321740.about_the_game:
It's time for a pawsome beach adventure!



You play as Hank, a drooling stray cat, who loves the beach. And cheeseburgers (or any other food really). Life would be perfect if he finally found his one true love. After setting paw on Stabby Island to go on an eating frenzy, our little chonky boy disrupts the established order of the beach. Can he stuff his belly without consequences? Will he be alone forever?

Features
  • 2D side-scrolling adventure with a wholesome, but kinda dumb story.
  • 18 accessible levels full with platforming puzzles.
  • Over 1000 food items to inhale. Some are well hidden!
  • Shoot garbage at seagulls, crabs and other enemies.
  • Six mean bosses who are waiting for you to miss that jump.
  • Full controller support.
  • Cats!

2321770.name: The Druid
2321770.about_the_game:
STORY

Long ago, the Celts and their culture ruled much of the land. But various natural disasters and invasions by other peoples decimated their population and brought their culture to the brink of extinction. Before this, the Celtic gods were devastated but accepted the fate that had been imposed on them. All except the evil Morrigan, who decided to corrupt the much-revered land of the Celts to prevent that fate.

The Druid is a roguelike 2D platform game where we play as a druid, created from Dagda, whose mission is to stop Morrigan and free the land of its corruption.

KEY FEATURES

  • A modular generation system to offer a great experience in different levels of the game.
  • Up to 54 available upgrades to combine with our character and obtain new abilities.
  • The game will feature three playable areas that will be full of enemies, from the simplest to bosses that will make a difference in combat.
  • The Celtic god Dagda asks for help to defeat the evil Morrigan and stop the corruption she is spreading through the world.

Project made for the B.A. in Interactive Product Design of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.

2321780.name: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!
2321780.about_the_game:
The United Citizen Federation is calling on YOU to join the fight for humanity.

You’ll witness humanity’s noble efforts to safeguard the galaxy first hand. Wield the diverse and unique Mobile Infantry arsenal to burn, dismember and cripple the Arachnid threat in first-person, high-action warfare through the eyes of Sammy.

The Arachnid menace has spread far from their home planet of Klendathu, invading human territory across the galaxy. Once inspiring colonies of human beauty, ingenuity and collaboration, now lie torn apart by the merciless and unprovoked Bug threat.

Sign up today and protect not just our world, but the future of the human race.

A Faithful Training Simulation

Recruits like you are vital to the Federation. We expect the best, and we give the best! Our Games and Theory department have been working hard to develop an in-depth training course. Troopers on the path to Citizenship will find a unique experience within Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!

Authentic retro FPS experience

lead your squads through epic battlefields in a solo campaign packed with missions, secrets and (of course) BUGS!

Devastating anti-Bug arsenal

wield over 30 iconic weapons and items, from the classic Morita rifle to mechanical bipeds, tactical nukes and more

Sharply loyal story

experience a unique and original story honoring the Federation’s commitment to save humanity from the Bugs

Video and audio starring General Johnny Rico himself

witness the legend return in full, high-quality FMV and meet new Federation hero, Major Samantha Dietz

Remote Control is a JOI (jerk-off instruction) game focused on Femdom / BDSM.

You regain consciousness to find yourself in a Discipline Enhancement Center. The Fembot Discipline Facilitator assigned to you is programmed to help you improve your capacity for discipline by any means necessary. She will give you commands to follow in what you think of as the real world. Obey, and your sessions will turn out to be much more enjoyable.

Features:

  • Massive replayability is possible via multiple individual tasks, each animated and voiced, which are combined into procedurally generated sessions.

  • Your performance is tracked across sessions, allowing your past performance to affect future tasks.

  • Animation and Voiceover - Tasks are fully animated and voiced.

  • Enable/Disable categories of tasks based on your personal preferences.

  • Block tasks that you never want to see again.

2321820.name: Restart
2321820.about_the_game:
A scientist with great knowledge about humanity ends up back in the Stone Age and has to build a civilization and develop it into the modern age.

Found a civilization, build cities, develop technological progress, fight bosses and let all this lead you to end up in the space age. Discover abandoned worlds, explore cities, research science and find out the story behind humanity's decline.

2321860.name: 8th Heaven
2321860.about_the_game:
8th Heaven is a Scenario Simulation: a mix between a point & click adventure game and a life simulator. There is sandbox gameplay featuring stats and inventory items, but also a narrative throughline with goals and progression.

You died! Things aren't so bad though, as you find yourself reborn in an island paradise filled with fantastical monster-people. You now have a second chance at life, filled with adventure, relaxation, and romance!

  • SLICE OF LIFE: an explorable world packed with characters!

  • ADVENTURE: an RPG-inspired combat system that directly incorporates sex!

  • BARTENDING: become a barista and make drinks for the islanders!

  • ROMANCE: nurture intimate relationships with the diverse cast of characters!

2321870.name: Lawnmower Game: Zombies
2321870.about_the_game:
Story:


This new Lawnmower zombie game is driving simulation game, where player need cut grass, drive as much as can to unlock new mowers. Also player need avoid deathly zombies. When zombie hit player it will decrease player health, but also zombie will be killed. Lawnmower has fuel consumption and player can play for 4 different mowers. New mowers can be unlocked when player have driven enough. Also game contains weather and day/night cycle and of course lot of grass to cut. Game contains also hidden objects which gives player steam achievements

Features:

- 4 different mowers which can be unlocked when enough driven
- unlocked mowers
- weather system
- Deathly following zombie enemies, which can kill player.
- day/night system
- lot of grass

2321880.name: Spire Horizon
2321880.about_the_game:
Discover a thrilling world of adventure in Aetheria, that takes you on a journey through diverse races and unique residences. Navigate challenging obstacles as you fight for survival in a world teeming with danger. And embark on quests to piece together the fragments of your forgotten identity.



Embark on a relentless pursuit to defeat a wide array of formidable monsters, pushing yourself to the limits in order to ascend to the pinnacle of power and prowess. Through intense battles , continuously develop your skills and experience, forging a path that leads you to unparalleled greatness.



In Aetheria, a multitude of diverse monsters inhabit the various regions, each area harboring its own unique and formidable creatures.



Unite with friends to confront mighty bosses, combining your strengths and skills in an epic battle. Together, you'll face overwhelming challenges and stand strong against the formidable forces that await. Victory lies within the bonds of friendship and the power of teamwork.



Master rare weapons and dominate in PvP battles, outshining your friends. Develop your skills to reign supreme, seeking exclusive treasures. Rise to the challenge, leaving rivals in awe.



Within the realm of Aetheria, acquiring the necessary materials for armor is an indispensable endeavor, as it holds the key to augmenting one's power and advancing development amidst its vast expanse.



Escape fatigue, delve into Aetheria's realm, embrace comfort, let tranquility overwhelm. Roam, explore, gather experience from foes, hunt rare weapons, where adventure truly flows.

2321890.name: Swordeye
2321890.about_the_game:
Dive into brutal, skill‑based combat in this hardcore MMO where your skill with your blade is the only thing standing between you and a quick death. Compete to climb an expansive, interconnected, and persistent tower overflowing with monsters, traps, and treasure. Swordeye combines a hardcore 6-directional combat system including ripostes, feints, kicks, and combos with persistent massive multiplayer dungeons, loot, abilities, and a skill tree.

As you progress you will unlock skills and abilities, craft potions, upgrade gear and customize your combat style as you strive to gain power and reach the top of the tower. Each floor of the tower is a unique hand-crafted dungeon crawl with a variety of different enemies, trials, and traps, as well as the ever-present threat of other players.

Group up with friends or engage as a lone warrior to face off against the dangers of the tower.  Compete to traverse massive interconnected dungeons filled with monsters, bosses, traps, and loot. Can you make it to the top?

Swordeye's "easy to learn, difficult to master" directional combat system provides a fluid yet brutal combat experience that will keep you coming back day after to day to hone your skills.

Slay bosses, find chests, or kill other players within the tower, then find an exit portal to escape with your loot.

Use your loot to upgrade your sword and craft new gear. Level up, and unlock powerful new skills and abilities to use against your foes.

2321900.name: Archons: Arena
2321900.about_the_game:
Strategic Deckbuilding
Create a unique deck that suits your playstyle and strategy. There's no randomness in the building of your deck. Your strategy and choices determine your path to victory.

RPG Elements
Define your character's identity by unlocking skills, attributes, and specializations (100+). Play as a cunning rogue, an armored knight, a powerful sorcerer, or anything in between. The choice is yours.

Friendly Shopkeepers
A selection of fully-voiced shopkeepers to comment on your choices and progress (1500+ lines in total).

Dynamic Equipment System
Spend your hard-earned gold on new gear from a selection of over 70 items, but remember - equipment degrades over time, so choose wisely and manage your resources carefully.

Challenging Opponents
Face off against 30 unique opponents that will force you to change your strategy.

High Stakes Combat
With a small health pool, every fight matters. Pay close attention to each round, as a single mistake could be your downfall.

Customizable Difficulty
Whether you're a deckbuilding novice or a seasoned veteran, Archons: Arena has you covered. Adjust the difficulty to keep the game challenging, fun, and accessible.

In-Game Editor
Edit and extend the game to your liking, and test your changes within the same session.

2321940.name: Sorrowful Night
2321940.about_the_game:
A bit of history

For generations, a small village has been protecting a sacred book capable of defeating the witches who threaten the survival of humanity.
However, one night, a blood red moon appeared in the sky, it did not bode well...
Within an hour, the village was decimated by a witch in search of the sacred book.

Unfortunately, the guardians who knew where the book was hidden took the secret to their graves.
You and three of your neighbors are the only survivors capable of stopping this disaster by finding the sacred book.

You must be quick because the witch is also searching for it and if she manages to destroy it, humanity will be doomed to chaos...
But escaping is also an option, right?

Escape or Banish? You will have a choice


Sorrowful Night is an asymmetrical multiplayer game in 4 against 1, allowing you to take turns playing as a witch or one of the 4 villagers.
As a villager, you will have a choice:

- Try to banish the threat forever to return to your peaceful life
- Flee, because your survival is at stake, and you do not wish to risk your life any longer.

Keep in mind that if the witch survives, she will inevitably attack other villages. And imagine if she manages to destroy the sacred book?
She would become invincible!
Know that if you succeed in banishing the witch, you will be rewarded for your bravery.

The Future of the Game

2321950.name: Fantasy Boy
2321950.about_the_game:
In a faraway kingdom, a brave young knight-in-training named Boy prepares for his most incredible adventure yet.

Boy is determined to defeat the evil that looms over the realm and rescue the beautiful princess who is being held captive.

Will Boy, with his boldness and heroic spirit, be able to overcome the pitfalls of the path and restore peace to the kingdom?

Fantasy Boy is a 2D platformer where you explore a fantasy world, battle numerous enemies, and most importantly, have FUN!

...and don't forget you can play in co-op with your friends!

2321960.name: Spirit Crossing
2321960.about_the_game:
Welcome, Wanderers.
Settle in the storm-swept Crosslands, a realm between the human and spirit worlds. Make your home in a vast, ever-changing shared landscape that empowers and fosters friendship, kindness, and community.

Perhaps you’ll harvest rare flowers, join a fishing tournament, or play songs to passersby from a rooftop at sunset. Every day brings endless possibilities for kind, creative interactions with new friends.

Join a Waystation – a customizable village that grows with a community of players. Together, you’ll build, decorate, fortify and sustain your home. Visit other Waystations to play with new friends and explore new sights.

Curate your social experience with a unique friendship system. By leveling up your friendships, you can unlock proximity chat, two-player emotes, teleportation, gift giving, and much more.

Regular storms tear apart structures and draw in lonely spirits. By performing acts of kindness and leaving offerings that restore Waystation Beacons, you can hold the storms at bay.

As you explore, you’ll meet people and spirits who need help. With patience and kindness, they’ll begin to reveal more about themselves, gifting items and stories. Over time, you’ll understand the curious ways spirits communicate.


Unleash your unique creative vision. Manage, upgrade, decorate, and use your own house as you see fit.
It may even come with a tiny roommate. 🐻

  

⟢ Befriend villagers, little bears, and other players

⟢ Unique friendship levelling system with fun perks

⟢ Solo and Co-op activities, building, puzzles, and timed events

⟢ Aid mysterious spirits, learn their ways

⟢ Glide, climb, and explore a vast, ever-changing wilderness

⟢ Expressive character and home customisation

⟢ Sensational seasonal soundtracks


Please note that game progress does not transfer between the Steam and mobile versions of Spirit Crossing.

2321970.name: Not Anyone's Business But My Own
2321970.about_the_game:
Navigate a local princess through the pages of a hand-crafted fairy tale and help her solve the mystery of a golden ring in this narrative-driven point-and-click adventure game with multiple endings.



Yup, it’s a short game. It will only take you about 15 minutes to complete it. Well, maybe 30 minutes if you are a real achievement hunter.



Every action (and inaction) has its consequences. Every decision can lead to catastrophic results. Like whether you decide to dig up a skeleton in a peaceful forest clearing or let it rest. Or cross a rickety bridge over a deep ravine. Or… well, you’ll discover the rest yourself.



This game has five endings. Sad, epic, controversial… Some are happier than others. Will you dare to unlock all of them?



Like any self-respecting fairy tale, this story has a charismatic narrator, an adventurous hero, and a couple of mysterious strangers. All of them have voices - literally and metaphorically.



This game is crafted in full 2D. Like back in the day, when the grass was greener and the third dimension was a subject of legends and myths.



Just come on in and play. There is no microtransactions, NFTs, paywalls, or other greedy creatures.

Enjoy the journey!

2322010.name: God of War Ragnarök
2322010.about_the_game:
THE NORSE SAGA CONTINUES

From Santa Monica Studio and brought to PC in partnership with Jetpack Interactive comes God of War Ragnarök, an epic and heartfelt journey that follows Kratos and Atreus as they struggle with holding on and letting go.

The sequel to the critically acclaimed God of War (2018), God of War Ragnarök picks up with Fimbulwinter well underway. Kratos and Atreus must journey to each of the Nine Realms in search of answers as Odin’s forces in Asgard prepare for a prophesied battle that will end the world.

Along the way, they will explore stunning, mythical landscapes, and face fearsome enemies in the form of Norse gods and monsters. As the threat of Ragnarök grows ever closer, Kratos and Atreus must choose between the safety of their family and the safety of the realms.

A FUTURE, UNWRITTEN

Atreus seeks knowledge to help him understand the prophecy of “Loki” and establish his role in Ragnarök. Kratos must decide whether he will be chained by the fear of repeating his mistakes or break free of his past to be the father Atreus needs.

FLUID, EXPRESSIVE COMBAT

The Leviathan Axe, Blades of Chaos, and Guardian Shield return alongside a host of new abilities for both Kratos and Atreus. Kratos’ deadly Spartan skills will be tested like never before as he battles gods and monsters across Nine Realms to protect his family.

EXPLORE VAST REALMS

Journey through dangerous and stunning landscapes as Kratos and Atreus search for answers.

MASTER THYSELF IN GOD OF WAR RAGNARÖK: VALHALLA

2322020.name: SeaFeud
2322020.about_the_game:
SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game made by students at SMU Guildhall. Players race on fish and dynamically change their “vehicle” stats by colliding and swapping with other fish on the course. While in typical racing games, players select their vehicle or customize their vehicle prior to starting the game, SeaFeud switches things up by defaulting everyone to a basic fish at the beginning of the race. Throughout the race, the player can swap to other fish, giving them a statistical edge. While on these fish, their stamina will run down before swapping back, encouraging the player to try different playstyles.

Four Funky Fish Types

There are four types of fish in the game, each with unique abilities and access to unique items. The default fish (Mahi Mahi) has basic turning, speed, and acceleration stats and access to the entire item pool. The Electric Eel has better speed than the default fish, better turning, and the ability to boost forward while leaving a wall of electricity behind. As a defensive fish, the eel can pick up and shoot forward bombs to impede those in front of them. The Swordfish, though having the worst acceleration, has one of the highest speeds. Riding this fish will give the players the passive ability to attack players that are within range and boost quickly ahead. As an offensive fish, swordfish can pick up and drop a whirlpool item that lingers on the course and slows anyone who runs into it. The Pufferfish gives the players a defensive ability by expanding and pushing any opposition away. It also is immune to any attacks while using this ability. Pufferfish pick up a boost item and use it to launch ahead of their enemies.

Three Sunken Courses

Navigate through three beautiful underwater courses: Express-wave, Sea-nic Drive, and Night Fishtrict. These courses display a post-apocalyptic city that has been engulfed by rising sea levels. They feature decayed skyscrapers covered with algae and are populated with colorful sea life sprawling the seafloor.

Eight Zany Characters

There are 8 different characters that the player can choose from, all distinct with their own unique features and names, from Bruno the scuba shark to Kat the feline diver.

Made by Students at SMU Guildhall

This game was made by a team of graduate student developers at SMU Guildhall over a 12-week production as part of their TGP2 course. Given the short development time, the team's emphasis is on quality over quantity.

About SMU Guildhall

Recognized as one of the best graduate schools for game design, SMU Guildhall trains the next generation of game developers. With a faculty of industry veterans and specializations in all four cornerstones of game development, we have been commended for our multi-disciplinary Team Game Production curriculum, which yields award-winning student games.

Hank is an astronaut who has been assigned with a mission to build rocket launch pads on the moon. 2322420.name: Stack Island - Survival card game
2322420.about_the_game:
After waking on a seemingly deserted Island, you’ll need to piece together the clues to survive and remember what happened. Exploring the island will unlock new recipes and cards, which can be used to craft tools.
Dismantle obstacles and make your escape from the island. Survival is merely a means to acquire the necessary tools for escape.

Escape

On an island where drifting garbage has accumulated, there is no obvious place to escape. You must create the necessary items for escape using things left behind by previous inhabitants or various items found on the island, and find a place where you can make your escape.

Survive The Elements

The most important thing on Stack Island is to survive until you can escape. The island can be a very punishing place. From blistering hot days to dangerous creature-lurking nights, you’ll always need to be one step ahead of the island.


You'll need to manage four main survival elements: health, stamina, condition, and contamination level. Eating off the land, growing your own crops, drinking clean water, and avoiding wildlife are all luxuries on Stack Island.

Survival Card Crafting

Stack Island is full of natural ingredients, materials, and wildlife that can help you survive. Exploring new locations will unlock new recipes for you to craft. From stone knives for cutting and hunting to make-shift hideouts to survive the night.


However, not all items or interactions in Stack Island have a recipe. You’ll need to put on your Bear Grill hat and think outside the box to create some of the tools you’ll need to uncover all the secrets of Stack Island.

Features

-Over 600 cards to discover and combine to help you survive
-Survive the elements by managing your resources, hunting the wildlife, and discovering new recipes
-Explore the Island to uncover new areas and find hidden blueprints
-Uncover the secrets of Stack Island. First of all, are you even alone on the island?

2322560.name: Love Is All Around
2322560.about_the_game:
"Love Is All Around" is a simulating love story real-life full-motion interactive video . You will not only meet but also fall in love with six beauties with completely different personalities and styles, eventually embark on an immersive and sweet journey one after another.
Under their charisma, how would you deal with the six beauties while you are busy at paying off debts? Would you ignore your feelings and focus on making money? Or would you choose love over money? Among these beauties, who would you choose to be your partner for the rest of your life?

Is it the extremely charming ingenue girl?

Is it the mature girl with intellectual tenderness and gentleness?

Is it the innocent, lovely gamine girl?

If the above isn’t what’s in your mind, then there’s…
Unruly and willful, but slightly masochistic girl who born with a silver spoon!

Sexy, hot, and delicate goddess!

Noble and glamorous, a domineering female CEO who loves you solely!

There is always one that will make you fall in love with it! The right to choose a love one is now in your hands!

Product Features

·Full first-person perspective during the whole story, immersive experience of love -"Love Is All Around" is first-person perspective throughout, completely immersed in scene interaction and real-life simulation. It provides the immersive simulation experience, allows you to try more, and have an immersive love experience with the girl you like.


·Multiple branches, multiple endings, multiple hidden story lines and bonus scenes - the interactive video has designed more than a hundred story branches, twelve endings, multiple hidden story lines and bonus scenes for you, additionally, you can find achievement system, mining and multiple experiences in product. In the product, make the choice that goes with your heart, rather than the correct choice.

·Acting by real actors , shooting in real-life scenes - numerous wonderful behind-the-scenes stories are waiting to be discovered, revealing the actor's understandings of the character's inner world, and unravel the secrets of flirting through girl’s perspective.

·Various ways to play, finding the faint clues - the game life is not limited to choices, the key clues of the follow-up plot can be hidden in the scene, faint clues can closely related to the ending. Maybe everything is predestined, but sometimes being brave will change your fate. Come and play out your story.

·Six girls with very different personalities can be introduced—either charming, or tender, or innocent, or capricious, or sexy, or glamorous, there is always a kind of girl that make you exclaim: " Damn it! I am surrounded by beauties! "

About Us

We are "intiny", we are all "split personality" nerds who want to have date every day, but will never step out of the house to the real world. Thereford, we would like use interactive video as tool to create one fantasy dream after another, to create dreams for players, and to make our dreams to come true for ourselves.

Written at the end

At the beginning, we said we were going to make a interactive video, and then there were a lot of topics. As for why we finally chose love, it may be because the pictures posted in the intro slides are eye-catching . We, nerds in the team, had suddenly become impatient. Then we immediately decided, "I want to fall in love , I want to date girls!" After we’ve decided the topic, we started to collect "secrets" from our friends.

The nerdy guy, named B, his first love was on the night of the graduation party of high school. He saw the female classmate who shared a table with him, drinking and singing with others, and only then did he realize that this girl was so interesting and adorable. But after that night, he never saw her again ;
L (he paints a lot and do it for a living, but he does not allow us to call him a painter) once fell for a girl who is five years older than him. The girl repeated the final year of high school 4 times, but still didn’t get herself enrolled in the professional Fine Arts school, and finally let go of the obsession and became a substitute teacher in an art institution. That is the reason why L studied Fine Arts;
A College student ,C, fell in love with his fellow student, but this girl had a childhood sweetheart;
W,born with a silver spoon, is a little luckier than C, but not much. He did have a childhood sweetheart, but when they grew up, this girl got married with another guy;
G,a wage slave, once met a single mother in a blind date event. He have made up his mind to go further with this lady. Unexpectedly, she has already met another one.
…

All these emotional and heart-breaking experiences are full of regrets and make people feel sad. We originally wanted to use this as the keynote to write a love story full of regrets but unforgettable, but our friends said that life is already not satisfactory, why not sprinkle some sweetness in the game? So here we goes, we have "Damn! I am surrounded by beauties" now. It's a satisfying love story. Hope my friends will be healed by this story. If you happen to have such a girl in your memory, it would be an honer to our the production team.
By the way, there is actually another friend of us, X, my college roommate. He is still studying in university, doing experiments and writing papers day and night, and he is relationship virgin. He said he wanted to find a sugar mommy, because he wanted to have hair transplanted.

Follow us

Follow us for latest information on "Love is All Around".

Tournament sessions

Change of day and night
The game world exists in the same time zone. Day will change into night, and night into day. Determine which of your characters will stay awake during the day and which at night. Plan your attacks during daylight or darkness.

Manage the diet
Develop agriculture, cattle raising or fishing. Determine dietary diversity of the characters so that they are happy with your leadership. Surplus can be sold in some game scenarios.

2323140.name: Ringash

The destruction of the “The Ring” has blurred the boundary between reality and the Abyss.

As one of the few who can resist the corruption — an Ash — you must uncover the truth behind the disaster and stop the Abyss from consuming all that remains.

Fluid, Stylish, and Expressive Combat

The combat system in Ringash is built for both impact and depth.
Each fight isn’t just about choosing the right weapon or skill — it’s a stage for your personal style.
From the ground to the air, combos flow freely, and your battle approach is yours to define.

Exploration Is More Than a Side Path — It’s Your Route

Every stage is filled with shortcuts, hidden treasures, secret lore, and optional challenges.
Exploration doesn’t just deepen your understanding of the world — it reshapes the rhythm of your journey and unlocks alternate outcomes.

Your Adventure Is a Story of Fate Rewritten

In a world torn between fantasy and despair, your choices shape the outcome.
With multiple endings and narrative branches, each run tells a different story.
Only through repeated decisions and battles can you uncover the truth hidden within the Abyss.

2323200.name: Uberich: Advent Sinners
2323200.about_the_game:
Uberich: Advent Sinners is set in a diverse, extensive, and enigmatic fictional world with countless scenes spanning from the main character's bedroom to imperial palaces, from bustling streets to unforgiving battlefields, from the god-forsaken ocean floor to the vastness of outer space, and many more!

The complete story of Uberich: Advent Sinners includes:

· 7 Books;
· 5,500+ Illustrations;
· 80-song Soundtrack;
· 40+ Main Characters;
· A 2,000,000 Words Storyline.

◼ STORY




In mid-September, a wave of excitement swept over the Horiverti Residence in the suburban hills when the Hartson sisters rescued Joe and his ex-girlfriend, Raina, from a dark alley. Joe could only recall being attacked by an elusive shadow while Raina begged him to flee to safety.



Chaos erupted when a mysterious woman in a black dress burst into the home, firing bursts of energy, only for another mysterious woman, named Annie, to come to their rescue. She led the group to the Enja Defense Science Institute to uncover the truth. Joe, initially disinterested, stepped up after discovering a tracking device on his person, proving that there was no escaping the situation.



The group discovered a horrifying secret in the Institute’s basement lab that connected various mysterious elements, including a shadowy attacker, a space blockade, and a high-orbit space station. These discoveries hinted at a complex web of intrigue involving religious wars, powerful words, and a secretive organization spoken of only by Annie. As the seemingly unrelated pieces came together, they pointed toward a future that could drastically change the world, with the once-deserted Horiverti Residence now buzzing with powerful energy and activity.

◼ GAME FEATURES


· An unrivalled wide stage: Hundreds of scenes present a credible world that challenges your imagination.



· Friends, Foes, or both?: Every character thinks independently and together they decide the development of the story.



· Screenplays and narrations that leave no stone unturned: A relatable fantasy world with words without leaving room for gratuitous clues and narratives.

· Masterful Soundtrack: Features a unique soundtrack crafted by ZIZZ STUDIO, famous for their musical masterpieces in hit visual novels such as Saya no Uta and Full Metal Daemon Muramasa. The main theme song is performed by Kanako Ito, the renowned singer of the Steins;Gate theme!

· Unique Personality Analysis: AI will integrate your in-game choices and generate a concise report about your unique personality.

· Full-scale Battles: Impactful experience comparable to the hottest blockbusters.



◼ INITIAL CHARACTERS




· Joe Castleton: Ophelia's new tenant. Oddly, he can't remember anything from two years ago. He used to have a good relationship with Raina at the same university but seems to have recently broken up, about which Joe is rather anxious.

· Raina Summers: Raina is an ordinary girl, a sophomore in Chemistry. She had nearly a year-long relationship with Joe but it faded over the summer. After an accidental street encounter on Sep 15, her life became increasingly unfortunate.

· Naomi Hartson: Lives with Ophelia, at an age suitable for upper elementary school but she doesn't attend school at all. She spends days leisurely, always coming up with fun ideas. Harassing Joe is her daily vices. And she consistently beats Joe in games.

· Ophelia Hartson: Lives in a suburban villa. Apart from Naomi, there is no other family member, making the enormous villa seem empty. She works as a luxury goods designer at a recently famous company, receiving enviable treatment despite young age.

· Annie Alois Schultz: Known for her intelligence and rare beauty, she radiates charm. However, her strong aura of mysticism often leaves others at a loss, and she enjoys it. She appeared suddenly in the battle against Chava, saving everyone.

· Chava Fon: The stranger who broke into Ophelia's house. Dressed and behaved oddly, with eyes full of resentment. She frequently checks the watch, often muttering to the timepiece with a Big Dipper pattern on its dial.

· Ember Chester: The girl frequently appearing before Joe, seemingly close to him. She is always smiling, gentle, and unobtrusive. Occasionally she shows up in Joe's bedroom in her underwear, leading to a suspicious relationship.

2323220.name: AA Soldiers
2323220.about_the_game:
This game is a simple 3D missile shooter.

About game
Read about the mission on the menu screen and select the level to start the game.
Player becomes an anti-aircraft soldier, lock on the enemy aircraft and shoot missiles.
At the level of the anti-aircraft, the player can not move.
The enemy aircrafts are mainly old propeller aircrafts, with multiple appearances.
The allies include multiple multi-role jet fighters, self-propelled anti-aircraft guns, and the missile destroyer.
Each mission has its own set of conditions for completing levels.
There is also a level to operate the aircraft.
At that level, you operate aircraft and destroy enemies with guided rockets.

Common Matters
Press the ESC key on the menu screen to display the options screen.
The commander tells the player in a radio conversation dialog which target to destroy.
The difficulty level of this game is lower. It may feel unsatisfying to avid game players.
The game's progress is automatically saved.
In order to play the next level, you must complete the previous level.

How to operate an anti-aircraft soldier
Mouse: moving viewpoint
ESC: Pause screen
Lock-on when you focus on the enemy.
Lunch a missile with a left mouse click.

How to operate an aircraft
Mouse up: Aircraft descends
Mouse down: Aircraft ascends
Move mouse sideways: Aircraft rolls
Lateral movement: A and D keys on the keyboard (important)
Lunch the guided rockets with a left mouse click.
ESC: Pause screen
These operations can not be changed from options.

2323260.name: Odyssée numérique
2323260.about_the_game:
From digital to real

Odyssée numérique is an educational game that will allow you to mobilize and develop skills associated with digital competence. To progress in the game, you will have to research, evaluate the reliability or credibility of information and publish it in the vast digital world, which will certainly be useful in your student and professional life!

Exploring a new world

Your application to the university department has been accepted; your interstellar science internship takes place on Sollertia, a newly discovered planet. This is a world where plants and minerals do not react as they do on Earth. The environments, or biomes, are mesmerizingly beautiful, but don't let that distract you, or at least not for too long, from your research goals. The department has granted you the help of the droid Copernick in order to help you in the realization of the missions.

Multiple missions to realize

The missions in the biomes are varied since the environment as well as the properties of the plants and rocks are constantly changing. The scientific missions included in your internship have two main objectives. The first objective is to find scientific information that could help regenerate the Earth's ecosystems. The second objective is to improve your knowledge and skills related to digital literacy.

Why a serious game?

Play to learn! Far from being a distraction, this educational game is an active form of learning that aims to motivate you. Odyssée numérique offers an environment in which your actions receive feedback to guide you in completing missions. No real danger! Mistakes are opportunities to learn. Don't forget that repetition allows for greater retention.

What you can expect

  • A soothing ambiance and music while exploring the environments
  • Discovering natural species with form and properties you've never seen before
  • Computer-generated environments containing multiple puzzles to solve
  • Learning critical thinking and other digital skills while doing the intranet research
  • A charming game about spatial exploration and saving the planet Earth

2323280.name: Project Dark
2323280.about_the_game:
Close your eyes, and see.


Project Dark is a narrative driven, immersive audio game that draws on the classic “choose your own adventure” genre to create a unique and compelling interactive experience. The game’s impactful choices and realistic binaural audio allow players to become so immersed in the experience that they can play with their eyes closed. Simple mechanics make this a game that can be played by anyone, and we look forward to seeing where this exploration of darkness takes you!

In this first anthology, players will enjoy several episodes set in rich and vibrant worlds that examine the breadth and depth of darkness. Each episode offers a unique and captivating experience that will leave you wanting more. The branching narrative of the game is dependent on your in-game choices, resulting in different storylines and endings depending on your decisions. This results in high replayability, as players can play episodes over again to get different outcomes.

Episodic Content


A Date in the Dark - You’re on a first date in a restaurant that’s in total darkness. As you navigate this unusual experience, you must also navigate the complexities of a first date with a woman named Lisa. Will this be a good first date, or will you strike out in the dark?

Submersive - After recovering ancient treasure, a small scavenger team on an ocean expedition must work together to survive. As the captain of the team, every choice you make could mean the difference between life and death. Will your leadership skills be enough to get your team to safety?

Game of Three - Your morality is put to the test as you find yourself with the power to decide who lives and who dies. Forced to eliminate one of three strangers in each round, you must weigh the value of each life and make the difficult choice of who deserves to survive. As the game progresses, you'll discover shocking truths about your competitors that will challenge your beliefs and force you to question your own value system for life. Will you prioritize your own survival, or will you make decisions based on your moral compass? The choice is yours in this thought-provoking and suspenseful episode of Project Dark.

Cave of Spirits - Adventure across a medieval fantasy landscape as Oswin, a blind cabbage farmer, in his quest to rescue the princess and become a knight in King Aldrich’s court. You will travel with the court jester, making this episode very funny and more of an action comedy. Will Oswin be able to overcome the challenges and emerge as a true hero?

Home Invasion - Mina and her younger brother Samir must defend themselves from an intruder who has broken into their home. As you play, you must stay hidden and avoid detection until you can escape with your lives. Will you be able to outsmart the intruder and get out alive?

Bliss - You’re a coma patient reliving your traumatic past in order to fix your future. With the help of Calm, a mysterious guide, you must confront your demons and find a way to move on. Will you be able to find the path to bliss, or will you be trapped reliving your past forever?


Experience the power of audio storytelling and immerse yourself in the dark and captivating worlds of Project Dark. With each episode offering a unique and engaging experience, this anthology is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Play the game with your eyes closed, and let the story take you away.

2323360.name: Defective Sectors

2323370.name: You Are Sick

WARNING

- Expect 20-60 minutes of gameplay.

Gameplay


You will parkour in a huge abandoned city with wobbly controls to try to escape it.
Players must navigate their way around using parkour techniques. The city is filled with obstacles and challenges, and the player's mission is to explore every corner of it, uncovering hidden secrets and treasures along the way.

The camera controls in the game are intentionally wobbly, adding to the immersive experience of being an urban explorer in a city that has long been forgotten. Players will feel as if they are right there in the game, with the camera swaying and tilting as they leap over gaps, climb up walls, and run along narrow ledges.

Story

You will find yourself...

2323380.name: Void Bound
2323380.about_the_game:
In Void Bound, a fast-paced multiplayer game, you and your team of elite demon hunters face never-ending waves of demonic creatures from other dimensions. The goal is to survive each round using unique weapons and abilities from a roster of three characters. Work together with your friends to fend off powerful and terrifying creatures and progress through intense, wave-based rounds. How long can you survive the onslaught?

Features
  • Fluid and fast-paced movement
  • Choose between 3 unique characters and play styles
  • Survive with friends against demonic hordes
  • Intense wave-based survival gameplay
  • Unique weapons and abilities to master
  • Challenging rounds that increase in difficulty
  • Non-stop heart-pounding action

2323400.name: Pitch Black
2323400.about_the_game:
Traverse a cave, factory, and other strange places within Pitch Black. Meet many horrific, monstrous, or simply strange creatures, some of which may help you along the way. Discover odd puzzles and mysteries yet to be solved. Can you find a way out and maybe help some new friends along the way?

Story Introduction

In a large, dark, damp cave, a child plays with his own echo, previously playing with his friends left behind outside. But, without any light to guide him, he trips on a small rock and falls to his side into a deep, dark pit. If he could see below himself, he would have noticed rocks below that would surely impale him–but they don’t. Instead, it stops and he ends up in a room with jagged stone walls wreaking a metallic smell. After a moment he finds a nearby chamberstick, a matchbox, and two locked cells nearby… what must he do now?

Run from the watchful eye, stay clear of the crawling corpse, and keep a lookout for any other creature you may run into in the first area. There is certainly something wrong with this place, and you must be the one to figure it out…

2323440.name: Mimi and Lisa - Adventure for Children
2323440.about_the_game:
Mimi and Lisa is a simple 2D adventure game set in the environment of the TV series of the same name, where the player takes on the roles of two characters (Mimi and Lisa). Both characters experience adventurous stories full of joy and fantasy. They solve a variety of simple puzzles and explore different locations that children know from the TV series or from books.

Mimi is a magical little girl with her eyes closed. She looks at the world with her sensitive palms, ears and nose. Although Mimi is blind, she is not sad or lonely. She has her carefully tidy room where she feels safe, a kind daddy, and a friend, Lisa, who brings joy and excitement into her orderly world.

Who the game is for:
For children between the ages of 4 and 9 and for all parents who want their children to learn in a non-traditional video game way.

The game was supported by Slovak Arts Council. More info: https://www.fpu.sk/sk/

2323500.name: Shattered Souls
2323500.about_the_game:
Shattered Souls is a dark, fantasy otome that is currently in development by Eternal Love Studios. Become lost in a realm where nothing is as it seems. A realm of broken, beautiful, and resilient people. Experience enchanting, passionate love stories with twists and turns in every direction. Fight for your soul, never giving up, and always trying again until the day you are healed.

Shattered Souls is the third commercial project released by Eternal Love Studios, a game studio dedicated to bringing you worlds you can escape into and romances you will never forget.



Celeste finds herself fighting for her life after enduring a betrayal that no one should experience. As she nears her final breath, she is whisked away to a different world: Remoire. Things are not as they seem, though. She’s not a mortal. Her past is as vast as the ocean. Her soul is fractured and barely holding together from the traumas she’s faced and forgotten. She must heal herself or even the tiniest tragedy could shatter her. But she’s not the only one who is broken. Join Celeste as she fights not only to save her own life, but to change the lives of those around her.

Will you traverse worlds, realms, and even time itself? Will you test your fate? Will you try again?



Lose yourself in a thrilling adventure filled with gods, demons, betrayals, and twists and turns in every direction. It’s a battle for justice. It’s a battle for your soul. It’s a battle for existence itself. Are you willing to do what it takes? Will you try again?

- Complex Branching Storylines -

Your decisions shape the way that your adventure unravels. No two routes are the same. Each route features new, uncharted locations, unique characters, links to the puzzle that is your existence, and sometimes, more questions than answers.

Your quest may be revenge, but the journeys you take to get there will be as diverse as the universe itself. Even the beginning of your story is subject to change, depending on the choices that you make.


- Seven Unlockable Routes -

Shattered Souls features seven available love interests, two of which are unlocked by exploring different choices. You will find that these men are just as shattered as you are. Will you have the strength to face the demons, literal and metaphorical?

-Personalized Choice Options -

While Shattered Souls still follows the traditional flow of choice options, you will also be given the opportunity to express your personality, likes and dislikes through the personalized choice option prompts. These choices will not affect the affection, but will allow you to answer freely in the moment.

-Detailed Lip Animations -

Shattered Souls boasts a complex and detailed coding style that matches the audio with the mouth animation. This intricate animation style creates a more dynamic playing experience.

- Content Control -

Take control over potentially uncomfortable scenarios with our ‘Content Control’ feature. This feature, when enabled, will allow you to be informed of potentially unwanted experiences and situations. It will give you the option to opt for a summary and skip to the next section of the scene.

- Multiple Endings -

Shattered Souls contains a minimum of 16 different endings. Your choices may unlock a few secrets and surprises along the way.

2323520.name: Dark Life Excalibur
2323520.about_the_game:
Dark Life: Excalibur is a fantasy action adventure that tells the story of Aron, a human linked to the most famous and legendary sword of all time: Excalibur. Aron must find peace through his family's vengeance and to do so he must discover why York, the lord of the giants, destroyed everything he fought for. To confront the beings that pursue him, he must forge a sword capable of killing gods, without knowing that it would become the most legendary sword of all time, but also the one that has shed the most blood.



Forge the darkest and most violent legend of Excalibur with this title, a tribute made by and for Souls saga lovers.



In the world of Dark Life: Excalibur, bestiality is a power that accumulates in the hearts of the beings that inhabit it. By killing enemies, you can accumulate bestiality in the form of fragments, which can be used to buy upgrades, level up and improve parts of your Excalibur sword to build its own structure.



The game is divided into zones that you must overcome by exploring to improve Aron and Excalibur's stats.

Each zone will have a final boss and mini bosses that are part of the story. Finishing them is a necessary challenge to accomplish your goal. You will encounter puzzles as well as frantic combat and sometimes you will be overwhelmed by the difficulty of certain enemies.

2323540.name: Mirrored Souls
2323540.about_the_game:
In this 2D “single-player-coop” puzzle platformer, players have to reunite Ravi and Daru, two celestial beings separated in a mirrored world.

Control both characters at the same time in a mirrored screen while jumping and pushing your way through a bevy of beautifully illustrated scenarios to solve challenging, mind-bending Braid-like puzzles.

Discover a variety of pretty locations that bring up the duality of both characters while developing your cognitive skills and spatial vision as you cross portals to bring them together in a thoughtful, sensitive story-driven experience.

Features


Control both characters at the same time and test your skills to get through each level.



Hand-drawn scenarios with different challenges and elements that complement the narrative



Explore the possibilities of a unique mirrored mechanic to the maximum



A thoughtful story about the complexities of love and how it can change our lives

2323550.name: UDO
2323550.about_the_game:
Dig through a mysterious planet in an arcade down-scroller roguelike that basically challenges you to dig deeper and deeper into a creepy hole with an oversized drill!

Go further to find mysterious technologies, improve your drill and suit, and make each run unique while being surrounded by creatures that definitely don’t want you in any of the 4 biomes in this weird planet you crashed into.

Features


Master your oversized drill's mechanics to blast your way down into the creepy hole in a rare down-scroller game format. You'll be amazed by the amount of different stuff you can do with it.



Enjoy super tight and rewarding gameplay as you unlock perks and extra powers for your character and drill.



UDO brings a familiar pixel art roguelike style with a unique easy to learn, hard to master gameplay mechanic.



Make each run unique by choosing between different suits and upgrades to shape your playstyle.

2323560.name: HOW
2323560.about_the_game:
HOW or Human Operations Worldwide is a punishing and terrifying experience from massive death machines to fast and ugly creatures chasing you through the halls. You must use your skills of strategy and survival to live long enough to escape.

In this game there is not a set path for your story and you must explore and scavenge what you can without being torn apart. There are many rooms to explore in the building and not only do you have to find them but there are keys spread out across the levels for you to find and use. There are seven levels accessed by elevator each with new challenges and plenty of monsters to hunt you down. While running and hiding in the many halls and rooms of the compound you can also collect batteries to supply your flashlight needed for seeing in the dark maze in which you travel.

This is my first video game created and I hope you enjoy it as much as I have.

2323570.name: Origin Unknown
2323570.about_the_game:
Investigate the recently condemned High Rock Hotel in this mystery horror expedition. As Lin Wei, a woman who can turn just about anything into a weapon, you will uncover the disappearance of your father.

It has been a week since Lin has last heard from her father, the only thing she has left of his is a letter postmarked from his last known location - The High Rock Hotel - and his walkie-talkie. With her, she brings her transformed camera which she has turned into an electrical killer beam of deadly destruction.

The High Rock Hotel should be desolate, the halls ringing with silence, but something strange is lurking within its depths. At every turn, terrifying monsters will stalk your every step.

Lin will need to evade threats, use careful foresight when her weapon - the Polaris - needs to recharge, and piece together the mystery her father left her in his journal. From there, Lin will go on an adventure discovering cassette tapes and begin unravelling the mystery of the disappearances at the High Rock Hotel.

2323580.name: Before The Green Moon
2323580.about_the_game:
BEFORE THE GREEN MOON
A science-fiction farming simulation game set in a small community at the base of a space elevator during the days and seasons leading up to your departure for the moon.

Features...

  • Relaxing farming simulation gameplay. An aesthetic and mechanical throw-back to early farm-sim games.
  • Create your own character. Be you. Be with your thoughts.
  • Explore the community and its surrounding areas. Quiet vistas and secret alcoves.
  • 24 hour day/night cycle with dynamic weather. Adapt to the region's Rainy and Dry seasons. Rainy days, sunny days, stormy days, dusty days.
  • Get to know your neighbors. A helpful administrator, a handsome chef, a plant designer.

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Before the Green Moon was developed by Turnfollow

Programming and Writing by Ian Endsley
Art and Sound by Carter Lodwick
Music by Scott Archer, Marissa Deitz, and Carter Lodwick

2323630.name: Ninja Otedama R　～忍者お手玉R～
2323630.about_the_game:
A funny party game in which you launch ninjas like a cue ball and carry them so that they don't drop.

-Normal Stage-
Carry the ninja to the goal without dropping him.

2323650.name: Clash: Blue Mirage
