Clash received a direct call from a scared little girl. She barely had time to scream for help before the line was cut. Her call was traced back to Fallen Plantation, a haunted mansion attraction controlled by an AI calling itself Blue Mirage. The AI is strong enough to hack Clash, even when he is disconnected from any networks! How will Clash solve this mystery? Will Clash solve this mystery?

2323660.name: Headlong Hunt
2323660.about_the_game:
Headlong Hunt is a puzzle game about guiding a skittish animal. Capture it by using simple interactions in surprisingly deep and satisfying ways - be two steps ahead as you choose to hide from sight or send the creature bolting. Think forwards and backwards to set up the perfect path to victory.

Features:

  • Elegant mechanics which elaborate on the central theme and interact in surprising ways

  • A seamless overworld map, with two main paths and optional islands

  • Unique painterly art style and atmospheric original soundtrack

2323670.name: Jigsaw Puzzle Delicious Foods
2323670.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Delicious Puzzles, the puzzle game that will challenge your puzzle-solving skills while making your mouth water with images of delicious dishes from around the world. With over 50 beautiful images and 5 difficulty levels (64, 144, 289, 484, and 784 pieces), this game is a visual feast for foodies and puzzle enthusiasts alike.

2323710.name: Damsels of Vice 2: Project Mesmer
2323710.about_the_game:
The bustling metropolis, Infinity City, is in grave danger once again as rumors of a dangerous, unknown plot called "Project Mesmer" start to circulate. It's up to two of Infinity City's quirkiest superheroines to step in and save the day... but there's just one problem: their enemies can turn them into giggly, jiggly, sex-crazed BIMBOS! Will they be able to fight against their basest of instincts to conquer evil, or will they give in to become it?

Take control of Sister Fister, the super fighting nun, and Copy Kat, the sarcastic cynic, to discover the secret of Project Mesmer before the entire city fall under the control of the evil Dr. Vice! The dysfunctional duo will fight against numerous foes that will attempt to use things like rope or tape to bind them in dangerously kinky states known as Perils, or even seduce them into becoming bimbos!

Becoming a bimbo, even in the middle of battle, is not the end! Being a bimbo is tough, but it provides each superheroine with some sexy new and altered skills to get the advantage over their enemies. People and events will change depending on whether or not the superheroines are bimbos, so be careful what form you're in while exploring these unique and dangerous levels!

For fans of the first game, both the "Power Up!" customization systems and the fast paces Action Sequences are back and better than ever! With more options of character customization and enhanced feedback for Action Sequences, battles have never before been so thrilling to play and so satisfying to master.

  • To be or not to be... a BIMBO! - Enemies and traps will transform our heroines into slutty bimbos that affect how they react to certain events/people and how certain events/people react to them.
  • Damsels in Distress! - Heroines will be subjected to kinky Perils like being tied up with rope or having their costume morphed into a rubberized, restrictive, and humiliating version of itself. Struggle and fight to break free and overcome such nefariousness!
  • Power Up! - Beat up enemies to gain Lewda, then use that Lewda to upgrade stats and learn a plethora of powerful new skills! How you wish to level up is completely up to you!
  • Action Sequences like never before!!! - The fast paced, adrenaline pumping Action Sequences are back and completely revamped! With improved feedback and all new attacks, enemies will show no mercy in their attempt to take down our haughty heroines.
  • Speed for everyone. - Too easy? Too hard? You can adjust the difficulty at any time during the game. Enjoy it at your own pace.


Controls:

Enter or Z or Left Mouse Click - Confirm
Esc or X or Right Mouse Click - Cancel or Menu (Outside of Battle)
Shift Key (Hold) - Sprint/Move Fast
Tab Key (Hold) - Skip Dialogue


Even bimbos know that kink is the ultimate superpower~

I hope you are comfortable enough, so that you may derive enjoyment from it!

2323750.name: Lattice Dancer
2323750.about_the_game:
Basically, avoid lasers by moving and use jumps and special moves only when they are really dangerous.
The camera is intentionally fixed in its movement.
Special moves have an invincibility time of 0.5 seconds.


Get lost in the rhythm and feel the beat as you become fully immersed in the action. Don't be fooled by its compact design - this game is sure to leave you wanting more!

To begin, the player must choose one of the two dancers available. The objective of the game is to avoid the lattice lasers. The dance ends when you touch the laser three times. The controls are straightforward and consist of three actions: "Move," "Jump," and "Special".

The dancers dance on their own, so the player only needs to focus on using the controls to dodge the lasers. The "Special" move makes it easier to avoid the lasers by lowering the dancer's posture and providing a brief period of invincibility. However, after this period, the dancer becomes vulnerable again, and if hit during this time, it counts as two hits, making it a high-risk move.

At the end of each playthrough, the player is awarded a score and one of eleven levels of titles based on their performance. Taking risks, such as staying in the lattice or upstage, increases the score, but it's important to enjoy dodging the lasers rather than maximizing points.

The game tests spatial awareness and concentration, so why not try improving these skills? Even if you don't understand the language, you only need to know "play" and "restart" to get started.

2323780.name: Elodya
2323780.about_the_game:
Explore the New Continent of Elodya!

Arriving in a boat from the western continent, you and your crew have been tasked with exploring and learning about the habitants, wildlife, materials and secrets of the undiscovered continent of Elodya!

Gather Materials and Craft Gear!


Gather materials to craft gear and complete quests! Upgrade your camp to unlock more crafting recipes, equip more things and much more!

Fight Diverse Creatures and Bosses!


Fight tough souls-like enemies by using diverse weapons! Craft and equip armors and accessories to defeat bosses and progress through the game!

Meet Interesting Characters!


Build relationships with the inhabitants of Elodya! Upgrade your village with new houses to attract more villagers!

2323810.name: DEFENDUN : Hero Defense
2323810.about_the_game:
Defenden is a strategy merge defense game!

There were two very powerful beings in the world, Bael and Deus, who were very close brothers, but for some reason their relationship deteriorated and they began to fight. Their fight had unacceptable negative consequences, and the dark energy that spread during the fight awakened long forgotten dungeon guardians and monsters, demons in volcanoes, and yetis in snowy regions. The angels and demons who came as reinforcements to stop the monsters from invading the villages and kingdoms of the uninhabited, gave the heroes the ability to merge with the monsters and use this ability to help them stop the onslaught of monsters. Help the heroes, Guardians!




Combine units according to a recipe.
Mix and match your favorite units to a set recipe. Build your own team by combining over 100 different units, each with unique traits and skills. Sometimes units are stronger uncombined, but higher tiers are usually better.

15 classes to differentiate units.
Build efficient teams with units that are categorized into 15 different classes. If you have a lot of units of the same class, you can use class enhancement cards effectively. (Individual characters do not have classes.)

Defeat over 200 themed monsters.
To clear the stages, you need to know the characteristics of each monster. Whether it's physical or magical damage reduction, multiple births, or the ability to summon monsters, know the characteristics of each monster to clear the wave.

Understand and utilize your unit's skills.
Understanding the skills of your units will help you organize your team. Try to balance physical and magical attack units, think about the ratio of damage over time, instant damage, and area of effect attacks, and combine units that stun, bind, and slow monsters.

Earn different passives each game to create different combinations.
Fill up the monster kill gauge or defeat boss monsters to earn the chests in the bottom right corner and spend them to upgrade individual units and earn class upgrade gold.



Clear the stage by understanding the boss's abilities.
Defeat bosses by recognizing their abilities to freeze or stun units, reposition units, or restore health.

Understand the structures that embody the concept of the stage.
Understand the features of maps that match the stage's concept, such as lava on the ground to give debuffs and water at the bottom to match the sea concept, and place your units correctly.

Use the diamonds you're rewarded for playing to become stronger.
Diamonds are rewarded for play and can be used to take units to the next game or to permanently strengthen a player's Passive. They're awarded after you play, so play a lot to customize your look by purchasing custom skins from the Shopkeeper and in-game event skins.

2323840.name: Red Titans
2323840.about_the_game:
You are the best pilot, survivor, this is your last mission and everything will be finished. But in the middle of the mission, strange ships appear, a greater threat has arrived and the conflict seems to change course, now you are no longer fighting for a nation, it is the beginning of something much bigger and now you are the first defense barrier without even know.

FEATURES:

! 6 frantic stages
! 5 Epic bosses at the end of the stage
! Beautiful hand drawn pixel art environment
! A retro 3:4 resolution (vertical shoot em up)
! A challenging path without contines

RED TITANS is a single player vertical shoot em up, you will have to end the threat by creating a strategy with the available resources, you will have to be very skillful since there are no continues, but you will be able to recover lives at certain times.

2323860.name: Lambda Spellcrafting Academy - Learn to Program!
2323860.about_the_game:
Welcome to Lambda Spellcrafting Academy!


Follow along with Professor Whiskers as you learn to combine your magic cards to create your own spells(programs).

Each card features a unique ability, or represents some real world object. Arrange your cards to construct elaborate spells to solve magic themed puzzles. Shrink objects, make them float, open locks, and more!

Learn real programming

The system used in this game focuses on core programming concepts. After playing through the game, you will be ready to apply your new problem solving ability to nearly any programming language you wish to use outside of the game.

Programming should be fun

See the results of your spells immediately, with a checklist that updates as you change your spell. Want to take a closer look? Cast your spells and watch the magic rules play out, so you can detect issues and also develop a better understanding of how things work.

Nothing to memorize

Some programming tools require you to memorize a bunch of syntax rules as well as a long list of special words. At Lambda Spellcrafting Academy, you build your spells/programs by arranging your hand of magic cards. Everything you need is in front of you, you just need to figure out how to put them together.

Lessons and Puzzles included

New concepts are taught through small lessons and a little puzzle to help you apply your learning. By participating actively in your learning, you will better understand and learn more quickly.

Multiple solutions to each puzzle: Unleash your creativity

Unlike some puzzle games, there are many solutions to each puzzle. You are free to solve the puzzle in any way that works. Unleash your creativity as you develop various different approaches.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Q. I've never programmed before. Will this be too hard for me?
  • A. You don't need to know anything before getting started :) The levels start from the complete basics, and slowly work up to new ideas. If you're already familiar with programming, the game gives you an opportunity to work with a functional / LISP inspired language and have fun while doing it.
  • Q. Does this cover every programming language?
  • A. The programming system used in the game focuses on general problem solving techniques, rather than a specific programming language. After playing through the game you should be able to easily apply your new abilities to most programming languages, including Javascript / Python / Ruby and more.
  • Q. I like puzzles but I dont want to program. Will I enjoy this game?
  • A. If I didn't tell you it was a programming game, you might not even notice ;) Programming is really just problem solving, and I think I've made the experience pretty fun. Feel free to try the demo and see what you think.

2323900.name: Obelisk
2323900.about_the_game:
Obelisk is a turn-based tower defence game in which players take on the role of Allen, an astronaut from an alien planet who has accidentally landed on Beta. In order to repair his damaged ship, Allen finds the Obelisk, a power source that can provide energy on the planet. But many monsters are also drawn to the planet, and on his journey of discovery, Allen discovers the planet's unexpected secrets...

In Obelisk, players can experience.
Tense and exciting battles!
You'll need to gather resources while fending off monsters that are constantly coming in from all directions, trying to destroy the source of energy - the Energy Obelisk. You must stop them and protect the Obelisk.

Get progressively more powerful equipment!
You can acquire advanced weapons and turrets through exploration and battle. These weapons with destructive power can destroy and block enemies. Each time you pass a level, you get a new blueprint.

Intriguing storyline!
As the key to the square tablet is unlocked, Allen learns the secrets of the planet.

2323920.name: Missile City AeroLeague
2323920.about_the_game:
Enter Missile City limits and compete in the newest Ponglike, inspired by the head-to-head competition of the arcade era!

Join the AeroLeague and choose from a rogue's gallery of athletes, each with their own unique kit of special moves, and start climbing the ranks in pursuit of Championship Belts!

- Win by getting your disc into the opponent's goal OR by knocking them out!
- Diverse cast of firejammers, street gang leaders, child prodigies, and telekenetic amazons!
- Customize and counterpick by choosing your special moves before each match!
- Local and online multiplayer!

2323980.name: Dungeons & Jewels
2323980.about_the_game:
Dungeons & Jewels is a tile-matching roguelike inspired by classic PC puzzle games, such as Puzzle Quest and Bejeweled - in the style of modern roguelikes such as Slay the Spire.

Delve deeper into the dungeon. Become stronger - unlock powerful spells and gamechanging relics, with every run offering a variety of build options and synergy potential. Fight monsters and use your abilities by matching tiles, chaining combos, and solving puzzles.


  • 12 Dungeon Branches, 90+ Enemies: Featuring a wide variety of puzzles and challenges.
  • 80+ Spells and Relics to find/unlock: Customize your loadout, and become stronger.

  • 4 Playable Characters: Offering different gameplay, unlocks, and difficulty options.

  • Short 20-30 min runs, High Replayability: Every run contains new treasures, and different colors of enemies and spells!
  • Endless Mode: if you're looking for a long one, Endless Mode offers infinite escalating and combined challenges.
  • Online Leaderboards: Show off your runs, and compete for the best scores online.
  • Practice Mode: Choose your favorite branch or encounter to replay, to optimize your strategies or just for fun.
  • Steam Achievements, Cloud Saves: Strive for completion, to earn the title of Greater Player.

2324060.name: The Catapult VR
2324060.about_the_game:
Help the stickman defend his castle from the siege weapons of the enemy.

Use the slingshot, ballista or cannon to throw stones at the opponents and break their military mechanisms and siege towers.

The game has a simple intuitive control. Pull and throw a projectile at the enemy to charge the slingshot and select the tension force. Release to launch the projectile into the enemy.

For each struck enemy you will earn coins which help you to upgrades a weapon, turret or your equipment.

Have a good game!

2324070.name: 文字遊戯 第零章(日本語版)
2324070.about_the_game:
Word game is literally a game of words.

Words are not only composing narratives and interfaces, but also representing objects, characters and scenes.





Player controls "I" to challenge puzzles composed of words.

When "I" appears a secret room, in-game narrative clearly tells "I" that "there is no door”. However, in the world of word game, “I" can walk through the "door” because there is a “door”.

“I" should find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words.







May the best "I” win!

2324150.name: Neuroshima Hex
2324150.about_the_game:
Neuroshima Hex is a tactical turn-based strategy game based on a bestselling board game set in a unique universe that has gained recognition among players worldwide. Now, for the first time, it's available on PC in a full digital edition – featuring single-player, local multiplayer, and online PvP modes.

Take command of one of the factions and face off against rival armies – including the legendary Moloch, a network of automated machines that have rebelled against humanity. Every match is a fast-paced, intense battle of tactics, planning, and anticipating your opponent's moves.


Step into the role of a faction leader and lead your units to victory. The reason for the fight? The classics: water, fuel, weapons, survival – everything that’s precious in a world engulfed by rust, dust, and toxins.

The game’s mechanics revolve around strategically placing unit and module tiles on a hexagonal board. Choose, combine, deploy, and activate – every decision matters. It’s a fast-paced yet mentally demanding turn-based game where good planning is key.


At launch, you’ll have access to 10 diverse armies, each with its own playstyle, strengths, weaknesses, and unique mechanics. Every faction offers a different tactical approach – from brute force to precision counters and mechanical traps.

Base game armies include: Moloch, Hegemony, Borgo, Outpost, Steel Police, Smart, Vegas, New York, Beasts, and Mississippi.

Additionally, we’ve added 3 more armies as DLC: Neojungle, Sharrash, Uranopolis.

Over time, we plan to add more expansions known from the board game version.


Whether you're playing for relaxation or in competitive mode – there's something here for everyone.

The game includes:

  • Advanced solo mode with AI

  • Story-driven campaign

  • Local multiplayer on one computer

  • Online PvP battles

That makes Neuroshima Hex perfect for both casual home play and intense online combat.


The game is available in 17 languages, including Polish, English, German, French, Japanese, Korean, and Chinese – making it accessible to players around the world.

A must-have title for:

  • fans of board games and turn-based strategies

  • players who value deep tactics and asymmetric factions

  • fans of the Neuroshima universe – now also on PC!

2324180.name: Tranquil Isle
2324180.about_the_game:
While away the hours on the sunkissed shores of your own tiny paradise! Tranquil isle is a minimalist townbuilder, set on idyllic, randomly generated islands. The sun will rise and set as you work to grow your town to keep everything humming along nicely.

There’s no combat, no trading - just focus on making your little islands the best they can be.

The game has 2 main modes: Classic Mode, where players must strategically place buildings to build up your high score and unlock new buildings and islands, and sandbox mode for those looking to chill out and build purely for aesthetics and vibes. There's also a Daily challenge, where all players will play for a high score on the same fixed map.

  • A unique mix of townbuilder, roguelite and strategy mechanics. Each island is procedurally generated, offering a fresh challenge each time!

  • Relaxing gameplay that drops features like combat and trading in favour of a more chill, focused experience

  • Islands come with day/night cycles and different visual themes: grasslands, winter, desert, and more

2324190.about_the_game:
Prepare for a journey unlike any other with "Inu: Loas'Fate," a strategy game deeply rooted in the Haitian vaudou folklore and the mystique of the Bayou. Here, the boundaries of reality blur, and the powerful traditions of vaudou shape your adventure. Step into the role of Inu, a Loa of transformation, tasked with harnessing the powers of other Loas to defend Vilokan, your spiritual home.



Prepare to dive into the bayou, summon waves of mystical creatures, cast strategic spells, and march your forces through enemy defenses. Defeat the Potomitan on each archipelago to earn rewards and upgrade your deck. Every decision impacts your path to victory in this fast-paced, strategic experience.



  • Revolutionary Reverse Tower Defense: In "Inu: Loas'Fate," you don’t just defend, you attack. Create waves of mystical creatures and send them to overcome enemy towers in this genre-defining twist on tower defense.
  • Transformation: As Inu, you possess the unique ability to transform the creatures of other Loas. Mix and combine different ingredients to unlock new abilities and forge powerful new monsters.
                              
  • Deckbuilding: Customize your strategy by building a deck filled with powerful summons and magical spells. Each run brings new challenges, with a roguelite system that ensures no two journeys through the archipelagos are the same.
  • Immersive Vaudoo Setting: Explore a vibrant and rich vaudou-inspired world, interacting with legendary Loas such as Papa Legba and Marinette. Traverse the Bayou, where every choice has consequences.
  • Strategic and Tactical Gameplay: Plan each move carefully, manage your mana, and unleash devastating attacks. Upgrade your creatures and spells in the Great Cuisine to enhance your forces and ensure victory.
  • Procedural Archipelagos: Every trial takes place on a unique set of islands, reminiscent of games like Slay the Spire. Face different archipelago types, including boss battles, merchants, and specific challenges, all shaped by semi-procedural generation.

2324260.name: Dungeon Legends 2 : Tale of Light and Shadow
2324260.about_the_game:
Dungeon Legends 2: Tale of Light and Shadow

Dungeon Legends 2: Tale of Light and Shadow is a dungeon crawler RPG that draws inspiration from classic games, seamlessly blending the nostalgia of yesteryear with modern graphics and sound. As your city faces the onslaught of an army of chaos, your only recourse lies in exploring the mysterious dungeons of the long-abandoned Drakensberg Castle in search of the ancient artifact—the Dragonblood Crystal.

Embark on a Perilous Journey

The forgotten tunnels, seemingly endless and empty, exude a sinister energy from within. Whatever lurks in the depths is far from pleased at being disturbed. Dungeon Legends 2 immerses you in a game of exploration and real-time combat against hordes of monsters dwelling in the subterranean world. Success hinges on character development, a relentless search for superior items and potions to survive, and mastery of the magic permeating your surroundings.

Descend through the Depths

Grid-based movement, riddles, puzzles, and NPC quests shape the journey, fostering an atmosphere of mystery and danger at every turn. Engage in melee combat, enhance your warrior skills through magic items, and wield powerful spells as you descend through 12 extensive levels. Confront the ultimate challenge at the journey's end—the Dragonblood Crystal, guarded by the king of dragons in a majestic lava cave.

Unprecedented Interaction

Dungeon Legends 2 introduces an innovative AI-supported dialogue system, utilizing advanced natural language processing to craft dynamic and personalized conversations between you and NPCs. Your choices and interactions dynamically influence the storyline, unlocking new quests and opportunities. The NPCs, powered by the dialogue system, remember your preferences, fostering continuity and consistency throughout your adventure.

Key Features:

  • Explore vast abandoned dungeons filled with dust, haze, and magic, uncovering secrets in the ruined castle's enigmatic chambers.
  • Discover spellbooks, cast powerful spells, use potions, and vanquish deadly monsters with an array of weaponry.
  • Develop your character with four main traits—Strength, Agility, Endurance, and Magic—each influencing critical parameters like weapon damage, hit probability, avoidance chance, attack rate, health, spell casting rate, magic attack, mana, and armor.
  • Immerse yourself in the game's story with an AI-supported dialogue system, offering dynamic and personalized conversations that adapt to your choices and behavior.
  • Experience a classic dungeon crawler RPG with a dark, foreboding atmosphere, spanning 12 extensive levels, an immersive gameplay journey, hundreds of randomly distributed items, and plenty of types of randomly generated enemies.
  • Immerse in moody visuals and music that enhance the atmosphere of mystery, abandonment, and imminent danger.

A World of Fun

Run, chomp, butt-bounce, and more to meet PAC-LAND's challenge and charm! From B-Doing Tree Tops to ice skating in Snowy Mountain, and taking aim from the PAC-Marine deep in the Ocean. Rev roll in Paradise Meadows, Flutter jump over lava in the Volcano, and PAC-Dot attack through Ghost Island! PAC-MAN is ready for action!

Remade for all PAC Players!

With modern graphics, expanded levels and PAC-Village, quality of life improvements, and voice acting - it's the fan favorite remade from scratch with the original recipe. But Re-PAC means more: new actions for PAC-MAN, updated boss battles, characters, collectables, customizations, even a 2-player mode!


In PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC, Adventure is back on the menu!

2324390.name: Knights of the Road
2324390.about_the_game:
Once upon a time, there was a kingdom of Rockwall, strong and prosperous, and ruled by a king loved and respected by all. But soon a plight befell the kingdom: a curse struck the queen and put her in a deep and dreamless slumber. All the kingdom's healers and sorcerers tried their trade, but no one could wake her from her eternal sleep. Distraught and desperate, the king himself turned to dark sorcery to find a cure for his beloved. But the dark occult is subtle and trecherous. It blackened king's heart more with each passing day and soon the dark forces possessed him whole. The kingdom of Rockwall began to fade into darkness..


You play as Fred, an outlaw and a brigand. Together with his faithful compainion, a beautiful fairy Aiwa, they roam the country roads, robbing the rich and ignoring the poor.



Like all fairies, Aiwa is magical and thus can transform into a magical shield imbued with magic, which Fred can protect himself with or throw at enemies. Thanks to Aiwa's magic, the magical shield returns to Fred like a boomerang. Because magic!

Those two are constantly on the road in search of another booty, but unbeknownst to them a grand and perilous adventure lies ahead...



Use your shield to attack annoying enemies and deflect their shots.



Slide down on the shield to gain momentum and perform a long jump.



You can also use your shield to push off of an enemy or a projectile to reach certain places. Some obstacles need even more creative approach. Poor Aiwa!



But there's more to the game than mashing buttons. There's also a captivating story, unfolded through in-game dialogues and cut scenes.



You will also collect gold coins, gold bars and pouches, which you'll spend at shops on armor and on sorcerers who will bring you back from the dead at safe points.



The soundtrack is done in 8-bit style with tunes inspired by Irish folk music.

2324410.name: Summerhill
2324410.about_the_game:
Summerhill is a story-driven puzzle adventure game in which you play as a young shepherd and their dog. Rescue your sheep, bond with your faithful dog, and delve into the mysterious, long-forgotten world that lies beyond the borders of home.

From the BAFTA-nominated development team behind the critically acclaimed Alto’s Adventure series, Summerhill brings together gentle puzzles, striking pastoral landscapes and tranquil music to tell a timeless coming-of-age folktale.

Features:

  • Play as a young shepherd and their dog as you venture into the unknown to recover your lost flock.
  • Herd, split and corral your sheep through ancient contraptions to open hidden pathways and continue on your journey.
  • Forge a bond and work together with your dog to solve increasingly more complex puzzles.
  • Journey across an ancient, pastoral landscape and unearth the mysteries of its long-forgotten past.
  • Experience a timeless, wordless narrative interwoven with themes of duty, companionship, and morality.
  • Become immersed in a folk-inspired soundtrack by Todd Baker (Monument Valley, Dreams) that richly blends traditional influences from around the world into an ancient, transcendent soundscape.

About Land & Sea

Land & Sea is a small, independent games studio founded with the goal of creating artful, hand-crafted experiences that resonate with a wide audience. The studio is formed of the same BAFTA-nominated development team behind the critically acclaimed Alto’s Adventure & Alto’s Odyssey.

2324460.name: Copter Strike VR
2324460.about_the_game:
CopterStrike is a thrilling virtual reality game that immerses players in intense multiplayer helicopter battles in colorful, low poly and highly performant environments. With realistic controls and a complex HUD, players can pilot their choppers with precision as they engage in fast-paced dogfights. The low-poly environment provides a visually stunning backdrop for the action, with the added challenge of avoiding crashes and obstacles.

In CopterStrike, players have the ability to take out their enemies with a combination of turret control and rocket fire. The intense gameplay is made even more immersive with voice chat, allowing players to coordinate with their team and strategize in real-time.

The game features a variety of multiplayer game modes, including Football, Racing, Blast On (this game mode is a direct 1v1 or 1v1v1 round based match on a small map with boundaries) , deathmatch, team deathmatch, 3-team deathmatch, domination (capture the flag), 3-team domination and 2 Co-Op game modes: Zombie Outbreak and Desert Strike. The Co-Op game modes can be played solo as well!

The game also features 30 single player challenges with leaderboards! After the player completes those challenges with 3 stars each they will unlock a special bobble head item!

Whether playing solo or with friends, CopterStrike is a must-play for fans of fun, action-packed virtual reality games.

The game is also available on Meta Horizon for all Quest standalone platforms! Get it here

Crossplay between standalone and PCVR is possible.

2324470.name: Time Ocean
2324470.about_the_game:
In the vast 'Sea of Time', control the time to twist the logic and find the answer.

Time Ocean is a puzzle game that you use time manipulation to overcome obstacles and reach a goal. Help the water drop that fell alone in the vast sea of time to solve the difficult puzzles and reach the last point of the sea.

However, you should always be careful about the Time Paradox.

2324500.name: Tank Online: War Shooting Simulator
2324500.about_the_game:
Tank games are indispensable war games for both adults and children. The fact that the tank game is online doubled this excitement. Because you can have great tank battles with users connected from different parts of the world, this tank game allows you to show who is more robust. There are three other war tanks in this game, which is a candidate to be one of the best simulation games. Each tank has its characteristics. It will be good to choose tanks according to the tank battle simulator mode you will play. For example, if you're playing the capture the flag mode, a faster tank will lead you to victory faster.

The multiplayer tank game has been getting a lot of attention lately. The reason for this is that the simulation quality is increasing day by day. It is easy for users to feel themselves as a soldier on the battlefield while playing the 3d tank game. All the details are specially included in this tank soldier game to make you experience it better. You are only expected to choose the game mode and enjoy the excellent simulator game.

There are both offline and online options in the tank simulator game. Two game modes will meet you when you want to play an offline tank game. The first tank game mode is a team death match. In this mode, what you need to do is to destroy as many enemy tanks as possible. This will be challenging because there are four different online tank teams, including your team. You are expected to defeat three rival teams in the tank simulator game. To win the game in a team deathmatch, you need to destroy more tanks than the opposing teams. Once you achieve this, you will win the team death match.

The other game mode is specially designed for those who like to play war games. The name of this mod captures the flag. In this mode, the number of teams is two in total. In this mode, it is possible to do tank battles with six players, including the opposing team. The mod's primary purpose is to bring the flag in the opponent's region to your region by carrying it with the tank. Each time you successfully get the flag to your area, you earn one point, and the person with the highest score at the end of the game is deemed the winner in the online tank game. Team skills are critical in an online tank game. Because if the whole team tries to capture the opposing team's flag simultaneously, your team's flag will be defenseless. That's why it's often necessary to leave behind someone who drives a good tank. This will be enough to prevent the enemy team from capturing your flag. Users who have played simulator games can have much fun in this tank game mode.

The same modes also meet those who want to fight online in the tank war game. The only difference from the offline mode is that you have the chance to compete with other users around the world. You do not need to wait for any number of users to start the tank simulator game. To start the game, it is enough to choose a mode. If tank wars have started in online way, a direct connection to the existing room is established. If the rooms on the system are complete, a new room is automatically created and includes you. This process makes it possible to fight in the tank wars game without waiting.

The tank simulation game has three tanks: Bronze, Silver, and Gold. These tanks can be used in every mode of the battlefield. Of course, it would be better to choose according to the mods. Because in some methods, speed is required, while in some modes, significant tank damage will lead you to victory. If you are confident in yourself, join the battles and be the winner of the game.

Tank game is an online desert game. You have to defeat the rival enemies with tank war vehicles. When you start the game, four different objects appear in the environment. These are additional features you can get in the tank game. These features are; health, shield, bouncing bullet, and high-damage bullet. When you take life objects in the tank game, the life of your tank increases. Taking the shielding object reduces the damage even if the firepower opened by the opposing team players is high. The bouncing bullet has a blue color. With this bullet, you can damage the enemy tank by bouncing the shot from the surrounding objects. Most of the time, it is recommended to use this bullet in tight spaces. You should think carefully before using it because bullets reach opponent tanks in a shorter time in tight spaces. The shot with significant damage has a red color in the tank game. Users who play tank games have always wanted to increase the damage power of bullets. Therefore, this item cannot be acquired as a tank upgrade but only by collecting it from the environment. When you get this item, your damage will be significant. Objects appear again after a while. Therefore, it may be a good strategy to win the game to hide in the places where the objects come out.
2324500.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

2324520.name: Kanji Industry
2324520.about_the_game:
About the game

Many Kanji characters can be created by combining other Kanji characters.
Watch as the Kanji assembly factory automatically moves through the game!

Game Flow

There are two modes in this game: "Stage Mode" and "World Mode

Introduction of Stage Mode

The game progresses in stages.
When you start the game from the beginning, the stages are automatically generated. You can play over and over again!
When you complete a stage, you can choose from three different machines to get the one you want. Predict the machines you will need in the next stage and strategically collect the machines you have!

Introduction to World Mode

The player becomes the manager of a Kanji factory.
The objective is to purchase a factory site and grow the factory.
All machines are leased, so you must pay rental fees at regular intervals.
To make money, you need to sell more complex Kanji characters.
Make more complicated Kanji characters by increasing the number of machines that can be rented by delivering the specified Kanji characters!

How to create a factory

1. place the generating machine. This machine will generate the specified Kanji characters at regular intervals.


2. place the assembling machine. This machine takes two adjacent Kanji characters and assembles them into one Kanji character.


3. place the delivery and redemption machines. You can clear the stage and earn money by using these machines to deliver the Kanji characters specified for each stage.
2324520.supported_languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

2324530.name: Grow Your Team
2324530.about_the_game:
Strange forces have transformed peaceful animals into haunting monsters.

Grow Your Team is an immersive, action-packed adventure that merges exploration, combat, and character evolution. Traverse vivid landscapes, confront eerie adversaries, and cultivate a team of hybrid characters from the seeds left behind by defeated monsters. With every step, unearth the secrets of this unusual world and challenge the unknown, as you piece together the ultimate truth behind the transformative chaos.

FIGHT MONSTERS and COLLECT SEEDS


Engage in thrilling combat against peculiar creatures, gathering seeds dropped upon their defeat. These seeds hold the key to unlocking unique body parts essential for character customization.

GROW BODY PARTS


Plant collected seeds to cultivate a variety of body parts, each blending human and animal traits. Pig heads, dog legs, and much much more.

BUILD HYBRID CHARACTERS


Mix and match cultivated body parts to assemble a crew of distinct hybrid characters. Experiment with various combinations to craft a team with varied skills and appearances to aid you in battle. Make them not only powerful but also as unique as your imagination.

EXPLORE NEW AREAS and CHALLENGES


Embark on an immersive journey across diverse landscapes, each harboring new enemies and body part possibilities. Explore hidden secrets, confront unique adversaries, and expand your roster of hybrid characters.
2324530.supported_languages:
English*, Polish
*languages with full audio support

2324550.name: Robo Frenzy
2324550.about_the_game:
Robo Frenzy is a sandbox boss-battling game where you slay bosses and create them. Defeat massive robos, customize them, and unleash the ultimate boss for the world to fight!

INFINITE BOSSES, INFINITE STRATEGIES

 

Start slicing away at a laser shooting, flying desktop computer with a sword and then in mid-battle craft a chicken grenade launcher to change your strategy. Robo Frenzy’s dynamic multi-weapon system gives players an arsenal at their fingertips to face the game’s army of bosses. Quickly construct machines like cannons you can load with any weapon and springy bumpers in the heat of battle to fend off foes. Your arsenal is your imagination!

 

CREATE A UNIVERSE OF BOSS FIGHTS

You can crush bosses or capture them and bring them back to your lab. Equip your robos with parts from fallen foes. Hats, accessories, and stickers give robos style and new abilities. You can even reprogram how robo attacks by changing a simple shield bash into a teleporting shield strike or a combo attack that summons a tsunami before striking. Unleash your inner mad scientist to design the boss battle of your dreams… and everyone else’s nightmares.

 

SHARE AND CHALLENGE THE WORLD

Every boss you build can be easily shared with a cross-platform password system. Post a code on Discord, drop it in a Twitch chat, or send it to a friend. Your custom boss is instantly ready for the world to fight. The only rule is you have to beat your creation first.

 

TEAM UP IN CO-OP

Play the entire campaign in local co-op! Join forces with a friend to beatdown bosses and scavenge parts to make an unstoppable boss together.

 

JOIN THE BATTLE BUILDERS

Be part of our growing community! Share your creations, fight other players’ bosses, and help shape the future of Robo Frenzy. Join our Discord today.

2324570.name: Maid's Melancholy
2324570.about_the_game:
Maid's Melancholy is a puzzle game where you become a maid and perform various tasks. 'Clara', an apprentice maid, has to perform various tasks at the Belmond House in order to become a full-time maid recognized by the state. Can Clara safely pass the exam and become a full-time maid?

Features

  • Various minigames
    You can play about 10 mini-games such as serving, hunting, cleaning, and more! Aim for the highest score in each minigame!

  • Various Achievements
    There are more than 30 different achievement elements in Maid's Melancholy. Achieve numerous achievements in the game!

2324610.name: Xanthiom Zero
2324610.about_the_game:
Take control of Captain Grisham as you investigate the uncharted Planet 4-514. Collect items to help you progress deeper into the planet's depths, and power up your weapons to fight off powerful enemies and bosses! Explore multiple biomes, each with its own hazards to navigate, and uncover the mysteries that lie underneath the surface!

Features:

  • Over 70 items to discover
  • Each item has its own unique uses



  • Customize your weapons and find powerful combinations
  • Over 5000 weapons combinations


  • Battle against challenging bosses
  • Each one of the 10+ bosses presents a unique challenge


Earn Achievements to unlock modifiers which can be applied to new games, such as:
  • Limiting your maximum health
  • Making the entire world dark
  • An item randomizer
  • And much more!



  • Original Soundtrack.
  • Original Art.
  • Made entirely by 2 people.

2324650.name: The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog
2324650.about_the_game:
It's Amy Rose's birthday, and she's hosting a murder mystery party on the Mirage Express! When Sonic the Hedgehog becomes the game's victim, everyone is off to get to the bottom of things. However, something feels a bit off - is this really an innocent game or is something more sinister afoot?

Join the colorful cast of the Sonic the Hedgehog series in an exciting new adventure!

New & familiar faces
Interrogate some of your favorite characters as you figure out what happened to Sonic. Play as a new character who is starting their first day working on the Mirage Express, and meet the kind Conductor who is finally retiring from his long run with the train!

All aboard!
Immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of the Mirage Express, featuring fully hand-drawn landscapes and characters.

Canon or Headcanon?
You know what they say: everything is canon*.

*This is not a Sonic Team title, but we strongly believe in the power of headcanon!

2324660.name: Cart Life
2324660.about_the_game:
Part life sim, part adventure game, Cart Life is about three everyday people trying to make it as street vendors:

  • Andrus, a Ukrainian immigrant recently arrived in the US

  • Melanie, a divorced mother trying to maintain custody of her daughter

  • Vinny, a dreamer who never quite manages to make ends meet

Features

  • Guide three characters through the early days of their new ventures selling newspapers, coffee, and bagels. Play their intertwined stories in any order.

  • Acquire a cart, secure the necessary permits, and set up shop. Stock, maintain, and upgrade your cart to increase revenue.

  • Manage your budget for supplies, rent, and your own personal needs. Can you make enough money to survive?

  • Freely explore the city and get to know the locals. But don't be late to work, or your relationships with customers will suffer!

Note: Cart Life was first available on Steam in 2013. Although it won three Independent Game Festival awards and was named one of the best video games ever made by publications including Polygon and Slant Magazine, the game was never completely finished.
2324660.reviews:
“Cart Life is an astounding achievement.”
5/5 – DigitalSpy

“This is a fascinating game that deserves attention.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“Cart Life is a reminder of the humanity the medium is capable of.”
#93 of the best video games of all time – Slant Magazine

2324670.name: Police Heroes
2324670.about_the_game:
In Police Heroes, the world has been taken over by zombies and it's up to you and your police heroes to survive the horde of the undead. The game is a hybrid of action and strategy, with Roguelite, RPG and RTS elements.

Unique police officers!


Each playable character in Police Heroes has their own unique choices and abilities, offering different playstyles and strategies. Some characters are better at close combat, while others specialize in explosions. In addition, each character has their own special abilities, which can be used at critical moments to change the course of a battle.

Damage = Money!


The game has an interesting money system. Each time a player deals damage to a zombie, he earns money in the same amount. This money can be used to buy upgrades to improve your stats. These upgrades help players face stronger and tougher zombies as they progress through the game.

Call for backup!


Here your hero doesn't have to play alone. Call in a variety of extra cops to aid you in combat!

Challenge yourself!


The main objective of the game is to survive different stages that have an average duration of between 10 and 30 minutes. As you progress, the zombies become stronger and faster, and new types of zombies emerge, each with specific abilities and weaknesses. This makes every gameplay unique!

Police Heroes features graphics in pixel art with great attention to detail. Controls are responsive and easy to learn, allowing players to focus on surviving.
With its challenging difficulty level and many choices, Police Heroes becomes an exciting and addictive game for those who like a challenge.
2324670.supported_languages:
Portuguese - Brazil, English*
*languages with full audio support

2324680.name: Rugby Sevens 23
2324680.about_the_game:
Get ready to experience the intensity and excitement of rugby 7s like never before with our new game! In this retro-inspired 2D action game, you'll take on the role of a rugby player and lead your team to victory in a full career mode, complete with team building, trading of players, and more.

With real physics and a range of challenging gameplay features, including stamina, CPU AI off the ball running, cross kick, chip kick, skip pass, and auto cut back runs from your team mates, you'll need to use all your skills and tactical nous to outmaneuver the competition and come out on top.

But it's not just about your own performance - you'll also need to master the art of team management and make strategic decisions both on and off the field. Choose the right players for each match, develop your squad's strengths and weaknesses, and trade for the best players in the league to ensure you have the edge when it comes to match day.

With 22 CPU teams to compete against, including some of the best rugby teams in the world, you'll need to be at your best to win. Use your side step move to evade the opposition's defense, or perform a perfectly timed cross kick to set up your team for a try.

And if you just want to jump straight into the action, our exhibition mode lets you pick your favorite team and get straight into the game. So what are you waiting for? Get ready to experience the ultimate rugby 7s game and take your team to the top of the league!

2324700.name: Whitestone
2324700.about_the_game:
Note: A controller is highly recommended to play this game.

Welcome aboard the 'Sunchaser' at the dawn of the 20th century with Jack and crew!

Backed by his good friend, Jack lands his first major career move as an apprentice in the Archaeology department aboard the colossal airship. On its capstone voyage to the Arctic, it's smooth sailing until Jack's quarters are broken into and his friend goes missing.

A madness spread across the ship. The crew looks at Jack with paranoia, and Jack looks back with the same. Unsure who to trust, Jack is forced to fight nightmares both mental and physical as he becomes the prime suspect for a terrible deed, eventually discovering the truth with the assistance of his crewmates.

Whitestone starts as an investigation and then goes far beyond. Whitestone blends RPG, horror, action, comedy and romance. Want a happy JRPG ending? Study, help out your crewmates and see the voyage completed! Want a survival horror ending? Make the... err not so right choices.

Survival is not guaranteed, not for Jack or his friends. Your choices matter. Go to the banquet with friends? Stay in the spooky infirmary alone at night? Or do neither! Torture? Or a dinner party? Multiple routes lead to not only different endings, but different storylines, protagonists and enemies.

Inspired by titles such as Corpse Party, Higurashi: When They Cry, Dead Space, Dark Souls and the Persona franchise.

Features:
- 10+ hour story over 30 in-game days.
- 6 different routes to with different characters, combat levels and story focus.
- NewGame+ with increased difficulty while keeping your items, stats and money.
- 20 crewmates with their own side-quests.
- Dozens of weapons and elemental powers to fight foes.
- 8 combat levels with medieval fantasy, sci-fi and steampunk themes.

2324730.name: Necogram
2324730.about_the_game:
Nonogram / Picross is a logic puzzle where the goal is to fill in the squares correctly using the given clues. In Necogram you are rewarded with the pictures of Neco-women for completing this task.

Game features:
  • 8 unique reward-pictures
  • a gallery to enjoy said pictures
  • levels of varying difficulty
  • relaxing music

2324750.name: Planeta 55
2324750.about_the_game:
Planeta 55 is a horror-themed fast action sci-fi FPS.



Dalgis finds himself trapped in a prison, somewhere in the vast space of stars, planets, dangers and horrors. He only wants one thing. To fight.
Luckily, Aura finds him chained up and sets him free. Aura is from Planeta 55 and she needs help.

"Is that your wish?"



The road towards Planeta 55 begins. Hordes of monsters. New weaponry. Guns. Blood. Fight.



The fast action and story driven game features brutal first person gameplay, offering the player multiple weapons, big variety of enemies, bosses, a story of the sci-fi realm, challenge after challenge, characters, and lots of satisfying FPS bloody gun-play.





Play as Dalgis, follow your liberator Aura, explore multiple planets where you find new guns that allow you to combat anyone in your way in a variety of ways, challenge the bosses that stand against you, and save Aura with Planeta 55.

2324760.name: Florida Interstate '86
2324760.about_the_game:
Welcome to FLORIDA INTERSTATE '86, a light-weight driving game where the goal is to cruise into the sunset for as long as possible while earning points by collecting cassette tapes and driving dangerously.

A dynamic noon-sunset lighting system, a selection of colorful retro-styled sports cars and a synthwave/chillwave soundtrack ensure that every single one of your trips into this '80s fantasy Sunshine State is a unique one.

2324780.name: Arcade Asylum
2324780.about_the_game:
The Pirate Gamer has trapped you inside the Arcade Asylum with other gamers in this multiplayer arcade world. Play through a variety of reimagined classic minigames from diverse genres with varied graphics and unique twists. The catch? You have to be the best across all genres of games to beat out all the other inmates and escape the Asylum.



Love co-op parties? Are you also competitive? You have a choice of Single Player or PvP modes. This game is perfect for those who crave a blend of chaotic fun and strategic gameplay. Can you prove your skills and smarts to be the first to escape the Arcade Asylum, or will you become another mad denizen of this bizarre world? The Pirate Gamer awaits your attempt to escape!



Play mini games within the asylum, earn game tokens. Use said game tokens at the portal to escape…. Simple, really! 



With 3 player ability classes and a plethora of customization, you can play your way. Customization features include:

  • Character and brand icon personalization

  • Unlockable aesthetics, gear and weapons

  • Casual, Pro and Streamer classes with a range of different abilities




We’re building something. Please help us create the best community by YOU being in it… You might find your new best mate here to help you escape the asylum!

Join the Discord, Wishlist our games, share the love… and the chaos! 

- Gamokratic

2324790.name: Three Potions
2324790.about_the_game:
"In an abandoned kingdom scarred by darkness, a broken knight must fight to protect his world."

Three Potions is a 2D action-platformer adventure with aggressive fast-paced combat and an engaging storyline.

In Three Potions, a knight named Kal awakens to protect the empty kingdom of Heartfall. Evil has been lurking, and Kal must travel far to the east, facing harrowing dangers, and a regretful past.

Battle against fearsome warriors, mages, and forces of binding darkness. Uncover the sorrowful history of Heartfall. Discover if it's truly possible to change.

  • Beautiful Environments and Visual Effects

  • Intense mission-based gameplay

  • Challenging Boss Battles
2324790.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil

2324870.name: War Shore
2324870.about_the_game:
Build powerful towers, face gigantic bosses, and conquer a series of epic maps through enemy-infested waters.

Explore dozens of unique stages while defending the ocean from endless threats. Use the gold you earn to upgrade your abilities, unlock new powers, and become unstoppable.

Battle against pirate warships, the mighty great white shark, and many other dangerous enemies on your journey to protect the waters.

2324900.name: SUPERVOID
2324900.about_the_game:
DISCLAIMER: This game might not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.

SUPERVOID is a fast-paced arcade runner with colourful minimalist visuals and a synthwave soundtrack.

Features

  • 9 levels
  • Leaderboards
  • Unlockable colour themes
  • Stats for each level
  • Music by DOS-88
  • Simple 2-button play - Play with keyboard or controller

2324930.name: 50 Rounds
2324930.about_the_game:
Do you think you have what it takes to fight through 50 rounds of zombies and bosses..? I doubt it.
Features
5 Unique bosses
6 Different weapons ( more coming soon! )
Zombies get stronger each wave
Killing zombies will give you EXP and Coins to spend on either new weapons, ammo or tomes for stat points.
- Marksmanship will increase the damage you do, Toughness your Max HP & HP Regen, and Agility will improve your move speed, You will also increase some stats each time you level up

2324940.name: AESIR Online
2324940.about_the_game:
AESIR Online


AESIR Online is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) developed in GODOT Engine by a group of friends from Argentina. It was inspired by a game created in 1999 called Argentum Online.

The adventure takes place mainly in the initial world called Midgard, an open world of medieval fantasy. Players can perform all kinds of actions, such as exploring the world, collecting raw materials, crafting their own equipment, trading with other players, fighting creatures, etc.

Through the different actions mentioned above, our character will gain experience and level up, unlocking new worlds to explore, skills, and items.

There is a wide variety of combat types, and players can choose from 6 races (appearance, attributes, strengths, and weaknesses of the character) and 9 classes (combat style of the character) combinations.

The game will never be P2W (pay-to-win).

Don't Wait Any Longer, Start Your Adventure Now!
2324940.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support

2324960.name: Sex Simulator - Pool Party
2324960.about_the_game:
An interactive sex simulation game with visual novel elements, featuring realistic high definition graphics and characters.
You play the role a guy spending the day at the pool with gorgeous ladies.

About the game
Enter the world of Sex Simulator - Pool Party, set by a swimming pool on a warm summer day.
Choose between 3 girls and try and make them cum in this sex simulation game.
Get to know the girls, by going through a brief visual novel like prelude.

Control the sex motion in order make the girl cum before you run out of stamina.
Choose between several types of sex (oral, normal and anal) to satisfy her. All sex scenes have different camera angles.

2325030.name: Project Horror Tales
2325030.about_the_game:
Project Horror Tale is a story driven first-person horror action maze game. When Travel plans go awry, the only way out is to face the darkness and find a way to survive to make it home alive.

This is the First Installment of Project Horror Tale. With something Lurking in the Dark. You are not alone. There something in there and they are looking for you. You will Have to Face the Darkness to Survive. The question is - Can you Survive?

Features:

  • Fast-paced Horror: No hiding in lockers here. Run for your life and run fast. The enemy can be tricked but not for long.
  • High Quality: AAA-quality graphics and creative designs give players a variety of unique and terrifying to survive.
  • Hazardous Environments: Enemy is not the only danger. The House seems like it is alive and it is full of traps, hazards, and other dangers to watch out for.
  • Unique Enemies: Roaming Enemy that will chase you down. A house that will trap you with in it.

2325040.name: DETUNED
2325040.about_the_game:
The festival is here. The music is everywhere, and it only gets louder as the main event approaches.

Too bad it hurts you.

You are tired of this. You have decided to seek a way out. However, it won’t be easy...

Playable misophonia

DETUNED is a bizarre game based on personal experiences with sensitivity to noise. It turns classic rhythm gameplay on its head: rather than hitting the notes of a song according to its beat, you need to avoid a randomly generated series of notes.

However, running around trying to avoid pain is not a socially accepted way of life in this town. You have a job as a pearl collector. Every time you arrive in an area, a pearl might be hiding in the scenery. Attention and constant movement will be the keys to your survival.

Twisted remixes

Every session of DETUNED is different. The songs will be remixed with gameplay changes every once in a while. Sometimes you’ll get to choose how to suffer, other times it will be up to a dice roll. You might be able to obtain items to increase your chances of survival… but only if you have collected enough pearls. Even if you make to the festival’s main event, there are 8 different endings depending on which special items you managed to get.

Audiovisual insanity

DETUNED’s graphics combine photographed doodles with pre-rendered lighting to create dreamlike images to look at while you succumb to stress. The songs haunting you are not the kind of music you know, but rather distorted recordings of random everyday noises.

Cacophonic controls

DETUNED can either be played with the mouse, the keypad or the keyboard numbers. Pick the option that makes your fingers hurt less… because your ears are going to suffer in both cases..

Bonus beats

Tired of the procedural generation? Reach at least 6 endings to unlock the song editor and produce your own creations of pure acoustic torture.

Want more items in the store? Having the save files of previous entries on the "ApeHardware’s Playable Freakshow" bundle will unlock a bonus item for each game.

2325060.name: Alpacalypse
2325060.about_the_game:
Story

Pancake The Llama is a humble pig farmer who lives with his wife, The Mrs The Llama. One day The Llama's lives are turned upside down when The Mrs is stolen by a nasty corporate alpaca gang. Now, Pancake must go on a journey to rescue his wife from the evil clutches of the alpacas.

Game Features

  • Play as Pancake The Llama on a quest to save The Mrs.
  • Kick, spit, and jump through 10 hand crafted levels.
  • An open level concept lets you take on each level in whatever order you choose.
  • Face off against a horde of alpacas, featuring 2 unique boss fights.

About Development

Alpaclypse was designed, developed, and released by a team of five students at Neumont College of Computer Science during a 10 week project course.

The Team

  • Gus McGuire
  • Mark Nusser
  • Logan Bailey
  • Hailey White
  • Alan Buechner

2325070.name: Bitsy
2325070.about_the_game:
Story

A stealth puzzle game where you play as a mechanized spider. Climb walls, leap and web sling around tough obstacles, and above all: avoid detection.

Game Features

  • Control the mechanical spider, Bitsy, as you take on contracts.
  • Hack, disable, and stealth your way through 3 levels with multiple objective choices.
  • With levels having multiple routes through them, the player can choose their own path to accomplish their mission.
  • Avoid detection by robots, lasers, and security cameras.

About Development

Bitsy was designed, developed, and released by a team of five students at Neumont College of Computer Science during a 10 week project course.

The Team

  • Will Little
  • David Southern
  • Matthew Cone
  • Alayna Garry
  • Gage Somerville

2325090.name: American Eristics
2325090.about_the_game:
Andrea and Mandy return to their hometown after 4 years away at college. Reuniting with old friends and fellow survivors of a tragic party night in Lakefield. A night that created and killed the Lakefield Slasher known to the press as Zombie. Now tormented by a stranger who knows what only the original Zombie could, Andrea and her friends have to come to terms that the killer might still be alive.

Reconnecting with old friends is scary. They know so much and so little about you at the same time. Are they going to like the person you’ve become now? Can they afford to hold years of not communicating against each other while a killer is on the loose?

The world labeled him Zombie, but some of Andrea's friends remembered him as Trip Walinski. It started how they always do. A romance gone wrong, a party at an abandoned farm, and a one way ticket for a bad trip. Partying at moon rock farm was a recipe for disaster.


Explore key locations in Lakefield. Get chased by the slasher, Zombie. Fight back using pallets, slamming doors, blinding with your flashlight, and out maneuver the killer with slides and vaults. The game transitions between key locations and character perspectives with pixelated comic styled cutscenes.

2325150.name: Luxaren Allure
2325150.about_the_game:
Karuna and Aurelie were friends. Then Aurelie went off and found the infernal armor of Ellicide and became the Evil Overlord Darkloft. Karuna is the only one who can stop her. But Karuna loves Aurelie, even now.

She won't be alone on her adventure. Chisa, her trusty baby-faced, axe-wielding squire; Merel, the ruins-loving (and human-loving) naga mage; and Lynette, the prickly holy warrior from the mainland will all join her on the quest to defeat Darkloft.

Luxaren Allure is a medium-sized RPG (12-20 hours) that follows Karuna and her allies as they explore the isles of Luxaren and confront a former friend who now wants nothing but destruction. This is a wlw (women who love women, lesbian romance, yuri, etc) game with an all female playable cast.



  • Battles are turn-based but fast-paced! Enjoy animated heroes and enemies in classic side-view style reminiscent of classic RPGs!
  • Gorgeous illustrated character art by by M-3-1!
  • Explore the Isles of Luxaren and experience tales of lost love, new relationships, and a romantic twist on the hero's quest to defeat the dark lord!
  • Oops! All Lesbians! Your party is all WLW, all the time.
  • Alchemize items to boost your play along the way! There are dozens of unique items, equipment and accessories available from the alchemy pots.
  • Trouble navigating complicated dungeons? New optional Dungeon Navigation Mode activates ethereal arrows to show you the way through- or the way to avoid, if you're searching for hidden treasures!
  • Adjust the difficulty on the fly with four levels to choose from! Glide through battles to get to the next scene quicker, or torture yourself and test your skills- it's up to you to decide how you feel like playing.

2325170.name: HAG
2325170.about_the_game:
Welcome to Hag, a first-person horror escape room puzzler that will leave you terrified and questioning your every move. In this game, you play as an unsuspecting victim who finds themselves trapped in the home of a sadistic hag and her morbid son.

As you explore the dark and ominous house, you'll encounter an array of intricate puzzles and obstacles that will test your wits and challenge your ability to survive. With each passing moment, the tension and fear will mount as you uncover the true horrors that lie within this cursed dwelling.

The hag and her son, both notorious for their malevolent tendencies, have long been rumored to dabble in dark magic and unspeakable acts of cruelty. As you delve deeper into their twisted world, you'll uncover an unknown mystery that will keep you guessing until the very end.

Your goal is simple: escape the clutches of the hag and her morbid son before it's too late. But be warned - this won't be an easy task. You'll need to use all of your cunning and strategy to outsmart your captors and uncover the secrets of the house before it's too late.

Are you brave enough to face the horrors that await you in Hag? With its spine-tingling atmosphere, puzzling gameplay, and unknown mystery to solve, this game is not for the faint of heart. Enter if you dare.

2325180.name: Mirage 7
2325180.about_the_game:
Mirage 7 is a dark fairytale, a third-person adventure with a unique blend of fantasy and sci-fi elements.

Deep in an arid desert, a reconnaissance drone crashes from the sky. The explosion rocks a secret underground military base, and a mysterious “hybrid” is awoken within.

In another time or another world, the young Nadira and her pet lizard Jiji begin their journey through desert sands to find the mysterious oasis of Jala. According to the legend, this is where they will find Taishma, the Lost Princess, hidden in the Moon Palace - only she can fulfill Nadira's deepest wish, and bring her little sister back to life.

Follow Nadira’s tale, as she journeys to reveal a secret that goes beyond her comprehension.

  • Experience a rich, mythic story with a focus on enthralling narration
  • Survive and overcome the hazards of the desert with environmental puzzle solving
  • Craft rudimentary tools from collectible items to tackle unique challenges
  • Battle monstrous enemies with rewarding melee and ranged combat

2325190.name: Cat Jigsaw Puzzle Games
2325190.about_the_game:
Embark on a feline-filled adventure with these captivating cat jigsaw puzzle games. Celebrate the beauty, playfulness, and charm of our favorite furry friends as you piece together delightful cat-themed puzzles.

Immerse yourself in the world of cats as you assemble puzzles featuring adorable kittens, majestic big cats, and a variety of cat breeds. From cuddly tabbies and fluffy Persians to sleek Siamese and regal Maine Coons, each puzzle showcases the unique characteristics and personalities of these beloved companions.

Enjoy the therapeutic and rewarding experience of solving puzzles as you carefully arrange the interlocking pieces to reveal heartwarming cat images. With different difficulty levels, you can choose puzzles that suit your expertise, making it enjoyable for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.

As you progress through the game, unlock new puzzles with even more enchanting cat images. Explore a range of captivating scenes, such as cozy living rooms, sunny gardens, or picturesque outdoor settings, all adorned with the delightful presence of cats.

Whether you're a cat lover or simply appreciate the grace and charm of these fascinating creatures, these jigsaw puzzle games offer a perfect escape into the world of cats. Immerse yourself in their world, unravel their images piece by piece, and revel in the joy of completing each puzzle.

With stunning artwork, intuitive controls, and relaxing background music, these cat jigsaw puzzle games provide a delightful and immersive experience. Get ready to embark on a feline-themed puzzle-solving adventure that celebrates the beauty and charm of our beloved cats.

Do puzzles in a new puzzle way! Advanced puzzle layout and involving gameplay will help you to relax after a hard-working day. The player can choose to play with 20, 30, or 42 pieces.

- 3 difficulty settings: Up to 42 pieces!
- 16 puzzles
- Every puzzle is unique: Different piece shapes every time!
- 1080p HD Graphics.
- Traditional jigsaw puzzle that you can easily play
- More puzzles will increase with DLC

2325200.name: Legends of Castile
2325200.about_the_game:
Legends of Castile is a new comic fantasy point-and-click adventure with full HD hand-drawn graphics, and a twist: The protagonist's biggest dream is to become a nun, and she must investigate the region’s folk legends to fulfill it.

Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.

The main character of this adventure is María, a young and fearless, though clumsy, Castilian girl. The story begins when, just after a long night with her friends, María has a vision of the Virgin Mary, after which she decides to become a nun. María asks to be ordained at a convent in Burgos, where her future mother superior assigns her a very important mission: To fulfill her dream, María must investigate the mythological creatures that have been appearing around the territory of Castile, and collect an item from each to prove their existence. Only once she has done this will the bishop take action against the creatures, to end their threat to the population of Castile... and Christianity.

  • Lateral logic puzzles, with a smooth difficulty curve

  • No dead-ends or deaths, just fun!

  • Female main character

  • Classic frame-by-frame animation, with lip syncing

  • An original story full of fantasy, humor and plenty of Spanish folk legends and myths to discover

  • Occasional references to the adventure game classics, without going overboard!

  • Inspired by classic adventures like Monkey Island and Broken Sword

  • More than 30 characters and mythological creatures to interact with

  • Around 50 picturesque scenes, each hand-drawn with pencil and paper, and digitally colored in full HD resolution

  • Hundreds of objects to inspect, combine and use

  • No slider/jigsaw/mechanical puzzles (guaranteed!)

  • One-button interface with 3 contextual verbs, providing more room for experimentation and fun

  • Original soundtrack, plus traditional pieces of Castilian folk music

2325290.name: Sky: Children of the Light
2325290.about_the_game:
Restore light to a world overcome by darkness, uncovering memories that shine light on a fallen kingdom.

Free trapped spirits across seven realms, return them to the constellations, and bring life back to Sky.

Take flight across beautiful, mystical landscapes, discovering hidden secrets, trapped spirits, and Winged Light to strengthen your flight.

Dive and glide for an enchanting flight experience with easy maneuverability that brings a sense of engagement, wonder, and curiosity. Explore on your own or journey with friends who guide the way.

Sky invites creativity and interactivity with other players. Create your own personal Nest, a cozy space to call home and decorate with an assortment of collectible furniture and placeables that reflect your style.

Visit friends’ Nests for inspiration, or craft shared spaces out in the open world where other players can gather and enjoy your creation. 

Along your journey, discover messages left behind by fellow travelers to guide and encourage you. We invite you to write and place your own messages for others to discover.

Sky is an online multiplayer experience, where friendships can form naturally, if you choose. Offer your light to fellow travelers, and interact through emotes, chat, hand-holding, and more. 

Sky is designed as a safe, welcoming place for everyone. While the world beyond your Nest is shared, chat is only visible with friends or in designated areas – like benches – for open interaction.

With millions of players across the world to connect with, built-in translation lets you communicate with anyone. As you explore Sky’s vast realms, your friends will be a guiding light, and you can call for help along your journey.

Self-expression and customization are at the heart of Sky. Collect hundreds of unique cosmetic items. From capes that let you soar through the skies, to glasses, masks, hairstyles, boots, and more, you can mix and match to create millions of outfit combinations that express your Sky Kid.

With a new Season every three months, and shorter events throughout the year, there’s always fresh content to discover, explore with friends, and collect items from. Whether you’re celebrating the holidays, getting spooky in October, or enjoying vibrant seasonal sets, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

The world of Sky is ever-changing and dynamic. Beyond our regular Seasons and events, you can participate in special, limited-time live experiences every year, such as our world-record breaking concert with AURORA, where thousands of players come together in real time.

These events celebrate community, offering interactive elements, fun surprises, and shared moments that make the world feel alive. You’ll never feel alone, experiencing awe, wonder, and emotional depth that redefine what a game can be.

Sky has the most wholesome and welcoming community in gaming.  Strangers become friendly guides, playing an instrument can lead to a band, and puzzles blocking your journey are solved with teamwork. Friends can hold your hand and lead you through the realms – no journey or mystery has to be faced alone.

The community is also incredibly active on our official Discord, social media channels, and on the Steam forums, bringing players together around shared adventures and creativity. Sky and its community go hand-in-hand. We appreciate our community, and we’re confident you'll enjoy becoming a part of it. 

Download Sky and join this incredible community in a beautiful, open-world adventure. See you in the skies!

2325310.name: Gensokyo：Presumption of Guilt~Pansies Before Dawn
2325310.about_the_game:
