2326210.name: Innkeeper's Basement
2326210.about_the_game:
What is this game about?

Explore the cursed dungeon of Innkeeper's Basement in this minesweeper-inspired roguelite: Use cards from your deck to destroy enemies, interact with special objects and journey deeper on the increasingly difficult levels!

Inspired by

Slay the Spire, Runestone Keeper, Desktop Dungeons & Minesweeper, among others.

How to play?

First, create your Character...

Try over 5100 character combinations, each one with a different starting deck, stats, buffs and / or debuffs!

Next, select the Dungeon...

Choose one of the 12 unique Dungeons, each one with different goals!

...and start your Adventure! :)

With minesweeper-inspired exploration! :)

Controls

Mouse is all you need to play the game. Use "WSAD" for easier navigation and hotkeys below the cards (1,2,3,4...) for faster gameplay!

Build up your deck as you play!

Every run will give you new cards and items to modify your deck and stats / buffs during gameplay!

Oh, the game also has *Tons* of unlocks...

  • 13+ Dungeons
  • 16+ Character Races
  • 24+ Character Classes
  • 10+ Constellations
  • many Cards, Enemies and other in-game elements


Enjoy! :)

Join our Discord server!

Interesting fact

All art in game was AI-generated (not counting placeholders).

2326220.name: Furry Sniper
2326220.about_the_game:
Take on the role of an elite sniper on a crucial mission: track down and eliminate rogue furries causing chaos in a vast forest. From your lookout tower, you need to find and neutralize all 30 targets. Use bullet-time cameras to see every precise shot up close. Some targets are skilled at hiding, so you’ll need sharp eyes and keen instincts.

Practice your shooting in the Aim Trainer mode, where you’ll find various tools to refine your skills. Compete for top scores with randomly generated targets, ensuring that every session is a new challenge.

In game leaderboards as well as frequent updates, Horde mode was just added and more game modes will come in the future as well! Join the discord and let me know what you want to see added.

2326240.name: MimiK
2326240.about_the_game:
Mimik is a local multiplayer game in which players hide, seek and tag each other. In the standard game mode, one player is assigned the role of the "it" player, the rest are "not it". During matches, every puck is visible, forcing "not it" players to hide by 'mimicking' the behavior of the NPCs around them. There is nowhere to hide except in plain sight.
Mimik comes with a hand-full of preset game modes to enjoy. It also gives players access to the match settings used to make the rules for each of these unique game modes. Thus making every game mode a customizable experience, as well as allowing players to come up with their own game modes.

2326260.name: Island Hopper
2326260.about_the_game:
Island Hopper is a relaxing game in which you venture to randomly generated islands.
Collect as much resources from different places to rebuild your home and unlock further possibilities!


Resource Collection

Collect materials from different island types.
Use your collected resources to sell them to stack up on gold or upgrade your equipment and skills!

Island Biomes

Island Hopper provides four unique island types which hold their own hazards and resources.
Embark on journeys to all biomes to get the resources you need.

Upgrades

Upgrade your collection device and character skills to improve your gathering speed and efficiency!
Can you upgrade all your gear?

Combat

On your journeys to all the islands there will be a lot of dangerous enemies.
Make sure you're prepared accordingly to defeat them!

2326290.name: RedSpaceOps
2326290.about_the_game:
RedSpace Ops is a 3D adventure learning game designed to teach players the fundamentals of space operations. In this immersive experience, players join teams to execute realistic space missions, controlling various spacecraft capabilities, communicating via specialized signal sets, and utilizing advanced terrestrial technologies. RedSpace Ops enables players to “Chair-Fly” space missions, helping them grasp the complexities of the local space environment.

Set within the local cis-lunar arena, the game will soon feature a timeline extending back to 1877, allowing players to explore the space domain and understand the intricacies of Research, Experimentation, and Demonstration (RED) Space capabilities. Players will interact with RedSpace controllers, who employ a variety of sensors to detect and track small objects in the vast darkness of space. These controllers will identify objects without breaching warning zones, report on their behavior, and, when necessary, execute dynamic space control measures to mitigate threats to the domain.

Players will engage with RedSpace Ops at three levels of play:

- Tactical Level: Players directly control their spacecraft and its sensors, following precise C2 instructions to avoid threats and gather data on the space environment. This is a “driver’s” perspective, exemplified by the Space Cowboy ADR module, which serves as a minimum viable product.

- Operational Level: Players manage their assigned spacecraft constellation, allocating resources, and overseeing logistics, including the launch of alert and spare spacecraft. This level focuses on operational movement and asset management, emphasizing team collaboration.

- Strategic Level: Players plan their research, funding, and time investments, developing new mission areas to prepare for future challenges. They will track R&D progress and make strategic decisions based on intelligence gathered from missions.

The first RedSpace Ops module, Space Cowboy, challenges players to capture and remove space debris, reducing operational risks and preserving the orbital environment. The goal is to collect and either dispose of or repurpose debris to earn the funding needed for tanker refueling. Future versions of Space Cowboy will explore advanced techniques like sorting and powderizing debris for 3D printing in orbit.

ChairFly represents the operational level of RedSpace Ops. In this module, players take tactical control of a space asset while simultaneously acting as the mission commander for a space campaign. This allows players to “ROCdrill” the execution of a fiscal year campaign or OP ORDER timeline, helping to identify capability gaps and inform acquisition requirements for decades to come.

The strategic component is captured by Ascendant Space Strategic Sim (AS3). AS3 is a real-time strategy game where players guide their nation’s efforts to develop the solar system and become the ultimate superpower. Players manage personnel, research, production, and operations in a simulation modeled on current events and the geopolitical competition among Russia, China, and the United States. AS3 offers valuable insights into the future possibilities of a thriving space economy and highlights the consequences for nations that neglect space domain development and protection.

The vision of RedSpace Ops is to provide an immersive educational experience that teaches players the foundational concepts of space maneuver warfare. The ultimate goal is to foster an understanding of the speeds, distances, power requirements, and lethality of the local space environment and the manmade systems within it. As players progress, they will gain a deeper appreciation of the complex systems and technologies necessary for successful space missions. Upon completing this gaming series, a new generation of warfighters will be inspired and motivated to pursue careers in the Space Force or the commercial space industry.

Future Space & Building Games Features:

- Explore the cis-lunar environment and experience the unique environmental effects of local space.
- Upgrade your sensors to enhance space situational awareness and communication speed.
- Compete against other teams to test and hone your space skills.

2326300.name: Paranormal Files: Silent Willow Collector's Edition
2326300.about_the_game:
Elephant Games invites you on the latest chilling investigation in the Paranormal Files series!

Solving the mystery of your missing colleague and the magical shop he disappeared from finally seems within your grasp, but key evidence to crack this case remains to be found. Your only hope lies at the Silent Willow Mental Hospital, where an old ally needs your help. But you quickly find more than you bargained for when a dark shadow entity appears to keep both you and your case buried for good! Can you uncover their sinister origins and unravel their plans, or will this case prove too much for even the renowned Paranormal Files Agency to take on? Find out in this riveting Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version!

The Collector’s Edition includes:

•Hone your paranormal detective skills as you chase down ghostly spirits in the bonus game!
•Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games and earn achievements!
•Tons of collectible figurines and hidden eyes to find!
•Enjoy exclusive concept art, soundtrack, videos, wallpapers, and more!
•Never get lost with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

2326350.name: Grey Area
2326350.about_the_game:
Hailey is just a typical little kid, on a typical kid's adventure: she's walking to the store by herself for the very first time! But there's a different adventure in store for her, an adventure most kids probably don't go on...

Follow her on her very peculiar journey through this strange "world between all worlds" as she tries to find her way back home... what will she find? Who will help her? What is this place?

Explore, search for secrets, and unravel the tale of... Grey Area!


  • Tight platforming
  • Strange places and even stranger creatures
  • 21 levels to explore
  • Hidden challenging locations to find
  • Some things you shouldn't find
  • Two different endings
  • Five hidden abilities to unlock
  • Hardcore and relaxed difficulty options
  • You can pet the snurk

2326380.name: King Datchi
2326380.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Datchi, a world where every moment is survival of the fittest! In the land of Phonea the time has come once again for the King Datchi Tournament. A competition ruthless as it is prestigious. A landscape where decimation of your opponent is the only goal. It is now your time to compete and become the King Datchi!





King Datchi brings consequences to the creature collecting genre.
*Datchi lost in battle are lost forever, any move could be your Datchi's last.
*Use ringtones to steal other trainers Datchi but beware the same can be done to you.




The world of Datchi is not infinite.
*Datchi species can go extinct from over hunting, but rarer Datchi become more valuable.
*Destroying habitats also effects populations




There is no game over
Losing your Datchi does not mean losing the game. There are plenty of ways to try again.
*Get money working at a part time job to buy a new Datchi and enter the tournament again.
*Earn the corpses of rival trainers and sell them on a fluctuating market.
*Or catch and sell live Datchi to earn money.



A Tournament of the Best
*Challenge gyms and other trainers along the way.
*Losing and winning affect your rank, only a rank below can challenge a rank above.


Will you be able to rise to the top and become the King Datchi? Or will you only leave a wake of tombstones behind you?

Also, play snake!

2326410.name: One Flag: A 2D Puzzle-Platformer
2326410.about_the_game:
Help a little blue pill liberate their homeland one flag at a time, in this puzzle-platformer that is all about turning the elements of the level in your favor.

FEATURING


  • 20 levels of increasing difficulty that will test both your puzzle-solving and platforming skills
  • Discover new tools as you progress, and learn how to use them to reach your goals
  • Simple and accessible controls; it's all about using what's available in each unique challenge
  • Test your mastery with Time-Attack mode; beat every level under a strict time limit for a rare achievement

2326420.name: Halfway Down
2326420.about_the_game:
A Cruel Foddian Platformer.

Inspired by games such as Jump King and Getting Over It, this game forces you to complete highly precise gameplay under pressure of losing progress. There are no permanent checkpoints so be prepared to replay a lot of sections.

This game is ridiculously difficult and extremely frustrating.

While it is possible, do not actually try to beat this nightmare. For the few that actually play my game, good luck.

To anyone that actually completes this game...

Your name's will appear at the bottom ranked by time to complete. However, it could take 40+ hours of practice to even have a shot at the final jump.

2326430.name: NANOVOID
2326430.about_the_game:
In NANOVOID it's not just about the shooting - it's about outsmarting your enemies. Customize and command your modular ship where each piece adds a unique function and can be the difference between victory and defeat. But beware, your enemies aren't just a health bar. Their ships also use the same modular system, meaning you'll need to strategically target their ship's components to disable them effectively.



Engage in intense battles where the laws of physics reign supreme. Every movement, every shot fired, every explosion generates forces that can be used to your advantage - or lead to your downfall if mismanaged.

Features:

  • Modular Ships: Build your own spaceship from various modules, each with its own function and characteristics.
  • Realistic Physics: All actions have consequences, and the realistic physics engine brings a new level of depth to space combat.
  • Tactical Combat: Outmaneuver your enemies, target their weak points, and use the environment to your advantage.
  • Epic Encounters: Face off against a variety of enemies, each with their own unique behaviors, attack patterns, and weaknesses.
  • Stunning Visuals: Experience the beauty and chaos of space with visually stunning graphics and special effects.

In this 2D tactical space shooter, you'll engage in fast-paced battles against deadly enemies and bosses, using strategy and planning to outmaneuver and outgun your opponents. Utilize your skills and reflexes to take down powerful bosses, and immerse yourself in a beautifully designed universe with stunning visuals and special effects.

Fly and fight using intuitive WSAD controls and mouse aim. The open space offers strategic possibilities, allowing you to retreat and recover your shields before re-engaging.

2326450.name: Ball Drop
2326450.about_the_game:
Ball Drop is a single-player puzzle platformer game. Made up of fast-pased action. The ball rolls down using gravity and you must use the mouse to move platforms to guide the ball to the goal line. Can you use the platforms and broken cogs to get the ball to it's destination? I certainly hope so! The objects in the game rotate following the mouse and you can use them to solve puzzles and navigate around hazzards. On the menu screen is the list of levels which are not level-locked, so players can navigate to whatever level they're interested in. The game is relatively short, 8 levels, taking about an hour to beat. The game is set with a minimalist gear and cog asthetic. There are no items or levling-ups, just simple puzzle solving.


This game is a practice project for myself to learn Steam and game design. I hope you enjoy and would appreciate feedback.

2326460.name: The Magical Land of Canada
2326460.about_the_game:
You've heard the stories, you know the legends but Canada is actually real.

In the second chapter of Alter Historia we follow Georgia (George Washington) and Teddy (Theodore Roosevelt) as they make their way to the Summit. On the way they will face several challenges, one of which includes their friend Bonny (Napoleon Bonaparte).

They'll also meet new and exciting villains and allies like Leo Spatula (Cleopatra), Hairheart (Amelia Earhart) and the Elder Moose.

Will they be able to make the Summit in time? Find out now in Alter Historia: The Magical Land of Canada - a powerful and true story of the indomitable spirit.

It's important that Canada and it's people were portrayed accurately in this game so a real Canadian was asked to make sure everything is fact checked. (Yes you read that right, an actual Canadian). So any naysay will not be tolerated.

This is a sequel to What if George Washington was a Girl? Be sure to play that first or you'll have no idea what's going on.

2326480.name: To Aerthen
2326480.about_the_game:
Scroll to the bottom to view instructions regarding the game's control scheme!




















It's Zephyr's duty to destroy the dreaded Voidlord, and it's your job to guide him!

Lead a unique cast of colourful individuals across Aerthen in an attempt to thwart XORMOTH's machinations. You'll engage in countless battles and uncover innumerable secrets resulting in our hapless heroes hauling around more loot than they could ever possibly pawn off to any unsuspecting merchant!





Tired of the moody and brooding stories out there that are chock-full of drama and a little TOO serious? Need a palate cleanser that ticks all the right boxes a classic RPG should but doesn't leave you with a heavy brain and on the cusp of tears?

This is the perfect pit-stop!

Inspired by Lunar 2 and Final Fantasy 3, To Aerthen features a light-hearted story that will feel like a giant helping of delectable comfort food... but with a twist! This adventure will set you up for the next heavy-hitter down the road while still upholding and honouring the foundation that fans of classic RPGs the world over have grown used to and expect.





  • -Take control of 8 distinct characters to tackle mighty foes in classic turn-based action. Each hero feels perfectly distinct and unique so that players will always be enticed to constantly switch their 4-person battle party around to better tackle the various obstacles they'll face.
  • -Save anywhere and EVERYWHRE! No more running around in a desperate attempt to locate the next/last save point.
  • -Monsters wearing your party down a little TOO much? You're guaranteed to escape every time from any battle that isn't a boss!
  • -Over 25 HOURS of looting and exploring while you thrust the heroes into each and every dungeon, crypt, and ancient castle dotting the world to prepare them to completely dominate the Voidlord and show him who TRULY rules Aerthen!





KEYBOARD CONTROL SCHEME AND INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO ACTIVATE WINDOWED/FULLSCREEN MODE:
"Spacebar" = Confirm/Talk.
"X" Key = Open/Exit Menu.
"Arrow/Directional" Keys = Move character.
""Q and W" Keys while Equipment Screen is open = Switch between Characters.



CONTROLLER CONTROL SCHEME AND INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO ACTIVATE WINDOWED/FULLSCREEN MODE:
Triangle or Y Button = Open Menu.
Circle or B Button = Cancel/exit.
X or A Button =Confirm/talk.
Square or X Button =Run/Dash.


You can activate Windowed Mode/Fullscreen Mode by pressing the Function (Fn) key and then F4. Doing so again will put you back into /WindowedFull-Screen Mode.

highlighted.localized_name: We're off to save the world...?
highlighted.name: We're off to save the world...?

2326500.name: March of the Drunken Sailors
2326500.about_the_game:
THAT’S IT! WE’VE HAD ENOUGH! NO MORE FISHING! THE SEA IS CLOSED!

Defend the sea from the menace of these sailors, who wish for nothing more than to embark on another fishing trip. Unite the denizens of the sea to stop the coming menace before they can reach their vessel.

There are no health bars or damage numbers here, only mass. Instead of defeating an enemy through traditional means, you’ll need to push and pull your foes off the dock and into the sea to stop them from setting off to fish the sea once again.



Features:
  • A new way of playing a tower defense with no health bars, only mass
  • Unique challenges across 15+ levels
  • 8 wacky different towers to stop the sailors
  • In game jukebox to play your favorite tracks over and over...
  • An original soundtrack by Matthew Martino Music

2326510.name: Ettrian - The Elf Prince
2326510.about_the_game:
Witness the Betrayal

Ettrian - The Elf Prince is a turn-based RPG set in the magical world of Yumhia. Step into the shoes of Ettrian, a 14-year-old elf prince grappling with betrayal from his own human siblings, even though they are part of the royal family of Atlantus, ruled by King Tularic.

Ettrian's journey is fraught with danger and mystery. He must navigate the treacherous aftermath of an ambush and unravel the enigma surrounding the Dark Temple.

To survive and thrive, Ettrian must pass a series of rigorous trials and tap into his latent powers.

The game features the Ethereum Nexus, a grid-based skill tree that reflects the unique abilities encoded in Ettrian's DNA. This system allows players to unlock incredible skills with the bow and arrow, infusing them with arcane magic and enhancing their stats to face the challenges ahead.

Engage in classic turn-based battles. Use straightforward commands to defeat enemies, perfect for easing into the game’s combat system. As the game progresses, combat becomes more intricate. Employ strategic thinking to master advanced commands and ensure your survival.

With its engaging turn-based combat, Ettrian - The Elf Prince offers a deep and strategic gameplay experience. Players must master the intricacies of battle, utilizing a variety of magical abilities and tactical maneuvers to defeat formidable foes.

Explore the immersive world of Yumhia, filled with diverse environments, hidden secrets, and compelling characters.

Dive deep into a rich storyline filled with intrigue, danger, and self-discovery. Every decision you make will shape Ettrian's destiny and influence the fate of the kingdom of Atlantus.

"The veils of fate grow thinner as unworthy trespassers disturb the sacred balance. A shadow rises, yet the light of the chosen one cannot be extinguished. The true heir shall answer the call, for this temple's destiny is bound not to the living, but to the blood of ancient promise."
2326510.reviews:
“Recomendado. 7/10”
7/10 – JuegosGratisUnlimited

“JRPG+Adventure+Fantasy. The royal family decided to get rid of the illegitimate elven prince. They throw the boy into the river, but the prince survives and returns to take revenge...”
Обзоры онлайн

2326540.name: The Archives
2326540.about_the_game:
In The Archives, you'll explore a post-apocalyptic world that's been ravaged by war and natural disasters. Set in the aftermath of a global economic collapse and escalating tensions between NATO and BRICS, the game takes place several years after a devastating event that has left the world in ruins.

The game opens with the revelation that the government has secretly created a program to rebuild society, but it's been shrouded in secrecy and controversy. As a player, you'll navigate through the harsh realities of this new world, encountering mutated creatures, fierce factions, and remnants of the old world as you strive to survive and uncover the truth behind the government's actions.

You'll start the game by creating your own character and choosing a faction to align with. Each faction has its own strengths, weaknesses, and goals, and the choices you make will have a significant impact on the game's storyline and ending. You'll explore the world by navigating through various environments, including desolate cities, abandoned military bases, and underground bunkers. Along the way, you'll scavenge for supplies, weapons, and equipment, and you'll encounter other survivors who may be friend or foe.

As you progress through the game, you'll unravel the mysteries of the government's program, uncovering secrets hidden deep within "The Archives" - a vast database of information stored on an offline server. Your choices and actions will determine your fate and the fate of the world, as you fight to survive and potentially change the course of history.

With its immersive post-apocalyptic world, deep storyline, and a vast array of choices and outcomes, The Archives offers a thrilling and unforgettable gaming experience. Are you ready to take on the challenge and become a survivor in this dangerous new world?

2326550.name: The Doorway Effect
2326550.about_the_game:
The Doorway Effect is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror roguelike. Venture into the subconscious minds of test subjects, investigating the recesses of their psyche to dissect a lifetime of fears and traumas.

While you can still play and enjoy the game solo, we know there's no better feeling than getting scared half to death alongside other people. The Doorway Effect will primarily be a multiplayer experience.

This game is atmospheric, frightening, and filled with secrets. There's no telling what may be waiting beyond each door. Collect keys, solve puzzles, outsmart the entities, and brace yourself for the worst...

Push forward through 100s of doors in a shapeshifting environment, scrambling to escape the horrors within, and to reach the final Doorway. Run after run, make it a little further each time, and attempt to unravel the larger mysteries at hand as you do.

Inspired by the cooperative horror of Phasmophobia and Lethal Company, the randomized gameplay of Doors, and the existentialism of The Stanley Parable.

2326590.name: Kakuriyo Village ~Moratorium of Adolescence~
2326590.about_the_game:
As they mature, will they be together forever?

Summer
Emerald, green plants growing everywhere.
Sparkling white dirt shimmered on the gravel road from sunlight.
The storm clouds resemble the intimidating gates of a grand castle.
Most importantly, is the strange and endless blue sky.

Summer
The landscape filled with primitive colors looked so blindingly bright.
The climate ravages the flesh and revives memories of the past.
The shifting mirage reflects the fullness of being homesick.

Summer
The most special season for children.
The most ordinary season for adults.

Summer
The past that can't be revived.

6 months later a couple of childhood friends Ao & Hinori met again during the New Year.
Escaping from a boring family party, their friendship sways between maturity and youthfulness...
Unexpectedly, on the way home, they accidentally broke into a village called "Kakuriyo Village".

They didn't realize that it was a sexist village where men and women had unequal statuses.
Because of Hinori's boyish appearance, the villagers mistaken her as a boy.
So, until they find a way to escape from the village, they must figure out how to hide that Hinori is a girl...

There's only one rule in this village that can not be broken, and that is " You can not disguise your physical gender".
Rumor has it, whoever breaks this rule will be punished horribly…

Can they successfully escape from the village?
It's all left to the players to decide.




They experienced young love that sways between youthfulness and maturity.

"Even if you're destined to love--And even if the gods wish you to love each other--
but you can't be together because of fate,
to fight against this fate,
the god summoned his people here. To give happiness to the world--"

Hinori & Ao asked for help from the Shrine Maiden to escape but learned a shocking truth instead.

"If they return to their world, their paths will never cross again──"



The two of them will spend a year here.
They love each other forever in this constantly cyclical world that does not age or die,
or they find the courage to overcome their separation and look towards the future.
Their fate is all decide by "You" the player.



Explore the open village!

From morning to night, there are countless events in the village that are waiting for you to explore.
Let's explore & discover all 4 seasons of this beautiful village with Ao and Hinori!









More than 20 fully-voiced supporting characters!
Enjoy interacting with all the residents!

  • Basic CG 80 pics (color)
  • Total of 200 scenes
  • All scenes are voiced
  • Expected playing time over 20 hours

2326600.name: 【異常奇象】動く遺体 / Moving Corpse
2326600.about_the_game:
"Take them down, using even the damage as vengeance."
This is a first-person survival horror.

■Parasitic Progress System
The "parasitic progress " is increased by taking damage from enemies or performing special actions.
The maximum HP value will decrease, but depending on the percentage of progress, special bonuses will be triggered.
It is up to you to decide whether you want to play a steady strategy with less damage or take damage and use special bonuses to push your way through!

■Weakness Transmission System
A moving corpse will attack you without regard to your attacks.
If you can shoot through their weak points, you can silence their onslaught.
However, they do not easily expose their weak points.
Use "Weakness Penetration" to find their weak points and put a bullet through them!
2326600.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326600/【異常奇象】動く遺体 / Moving Corpse/

2326610.name: Games to Learn Programming
2326610.about_the_game: This is a software for players to learn programming while making games. Players could learn programming from scratch by making some classic games, such as Life Game, Retro Snake, etc. Then players need to make a little bit more complex game called Two Snakes, which requires players to play with two hands, or making an AI for another snake. Code templates for these games are built in. Players have to follow the tips to learn programming and change the code.

2326630.name: One Step To Paradise
2326630.about_the_game:
At the turn of the century, the United States of America is shaken by the march of progress – airplanes, telegraph, telephone lines, automobiles, photography, so, all of this electrifies minds and changes destinies. Henry Morgan, who worked as a pilot instructor in a flying school, conceived the impossible – to build an airplane capable of flying from Washington to Mexico without breaks. But what awaits Henry on this journey? Fame, immeasurable wealth, or love, which cannot be destroyed by time or distance?

As a result of intrigues and a chain of coincidences, the first intercontinental flight in the history of mankind, which began as a heroic adventure, turns into an epic of romantic events, seductions, and revelations that Henry Morgan must experience just one step away from paradise. But will Henry take the most important step of his life and soar to the shining peaks of bliss? And if he does, with whom?

The game is filled with bright and stylish locations in the colors of the era, an engaging storyline with unpredictable twists, distinctive characters, and captivating animations. As you immerse yourself in the game, it's not hard to find yourself one step away from paradise.

Main characters:

  • Henry Morgan
The main character of the visual novel "One Step From Paradise". At the beginning of the story, Henry works as a flight instructor at a flight school, understands well the construction of airplanes, and dreams not only of building a machine capable of flying from Washington to Mexico, but also of making this flight without stops or refueling.


  • Elizabeth Miller

The fiancée of Henry Morgan, a sweet and intelligent girl whose family is in a difficult situation: her father's business assets are in danger due to the machinations of a local rich man. To save her family's money, Elizabeth is forced to sacrifice her honor and marry Henry Morgan, a poor man who is not loved by her. As a result of this arranged marriage, the Miller family hopes to save their assets, while the Morgan family hopes to improve their financial situation.


  • Mister Ralph

Mister Ralph is a real business shark, the richest man in the state, known for his tightfistedness and disdain for people who are not able to multiply their wealth. He invests in enterprises only when he is one hundred percent sure of profits, tries to foresee all the details, and leaves nothing to chance.


The latest computer game in the genre of virtual anime visual novel about love, adventure, intrigue, and human progress!
2326630.supported_languages: Russian, English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese

2326640.name: Timeless Tesseract
2326640.about_the_game:
Introducing Timeless Tesseract - The First 3D Parkour Platformer That Lets You Control Time.

Are You Ready To Experience The Thrill Of Manipulating Time In A Way Never Before Seen In A Video Game? Don't Miss Out On The Chance To Be Part Of History.
Play Timeless Tesseract Today And Immerse Yourself In The Ultimate Time-Bending Adventure!

With The Power Of Time Cubes, You Can Manipulate Time Like Never Before And Reach Your Objective - The Almighty Cube. But That's Not All! Timeless Tesseract Offers Five Unique Levels, Each With Its Own Theme, Colour, And Difficulty Level. And With The Ability To Control And Rewind Time, You Can Overcome Obstacles, Solve Puzzles, And Make Your Way To The Finish Line Like A True Time Traveller.

Game By Captain Tesseract
Music By Deb V.C. | @debv.c
Trailer Music By Siddharth | @vilkristproductions

2326650.name: Antkeep
2326650.about_the_game:
Game Mechanism

There are many different elements in the game, all aimed at enhancing the ants and giving them the ability to fight back.
  • Upgrade ant abilities by collecting honey
  • Breed ant colonies in test tubes
  • Launch defensive ants to form a protective barrier
  • Use kamikaze-style attacks against the opponent's ant colony
  • Deploy ants to collect honey
  • Use buckets to temporarily slow down the opponent's attack


Game Story

As an environmental conservationist, you are sent to explore the ecology of Antilles islands and investigate the local ant population.
You discover that the island has been invaded by invasive red fire ants, and the native ants are on the brink of collapse.
You must quickly supply the native ants with the resources they need to fight back against the fierce red fire ants.

Game Features

  • Breeding “Towers”: Once the ant nest is upgraded, its offspring will also become stronger.
  • Different Strategies: Different strategies can be used to face enemy attacks, whether it's adventurous, conservative, fast-paced, or steady.
  • Different Ant Species: Ants can be converted into spreading nests, patrolling and intercepting, or suicidal attacks to match different strategies.
  • Ant Simulation: A gamified simulation of ant growth.
  • Islands: Different islands have not only different missions, but also different species of ants and ecologies.


About the Team

I'm Michael Pan, a student from Taiwan’s Tatung University, and the sole member of the team XD.

I have participated in many game productions before, but this is the only time where I'm responsible for the entire process from start to finish, including planning, designing, programming, art, and marketing.

There is still much room for improvement and learning.

Idea Origin

This game started as a school project, it was a "serious" game that teach player invasive ant.

After the semester ended, I felt that the game had unique qualities.
So I planned some future directions for its development.
With the help of my internship unit 'Team9', I continued to develop the game mechanics and planning, constantly refining the game.

Today, we're excited to bring our unique game concept to Steam!

All About That Ant

The most well-known invasive ant is the red fire ant, they have strong live, grow rapidly, disrupting the ecological chain.
There are many ways to control invasive ants, such as liquid nitrogen, hot water, poison, etc.
Each with its advantages and disadvantages.
This game focuses mainly on "biological resistance."

Biological resistance is achieved through strong native species to resist invasive species.
When it's time to mate, ants will take to the air and mate outside of the nest, building a new nest in a new location.
The nesting process is the most vulnerable time for ants, as the ant population is low.
If there are already strong native ants competing for food nearby at this time, it will reduce the likelihood of invasive ants spreading.

2326740.name: Galactic Empire
2326740.about_the_game:
Galactic Empire

Build your own galactic empire and lead it to domination among the stars.

In Galactic Empire, every turn matters. You will expand your infrastructure, research new technologies, build and upgrade your fleet, manage diplomacy and trade, defend your worlds, and conquer new systems. Every decision shapes the future of your empire.

Choose your path

At the beginning of the game you choose:

Planet type

Each starting planet has unique traits such as resource richness, food abundance, temperature, buildable space, population size, and sometimes unique structures. Your starting world directly influences your strategy.

Character class

  • Architect – cheaper and faster construction

  • Scientist – stronger research and technological development

  • General – superior military power and fleet efficiency

Each class changes your playstyle and provides unique bonuses. Additional specializations can be unlocked later in the game.

Define your victory

Choose one or more victory conditions:

  • technological supremacy

  • maximum reputation among factions

  • conquest of all planets

  • reaching a target score

Develop your empire

Build structures, conduct research, and construct fleets. Unlock new technologies and blueprints that expand your strategic options and change how you play.

Population management

Your empire consists of four social classes:

  • unemployed

  • workers

  • engineers

  • administrators

Assign them wisely to ensure efficient growth, production, and stability.

Ships and customization

Every ship contains upgrade slots for parts. These components allow you to fully customize your fleet, creating units specialized for economy, defense, or full-scale warfare.

A living galaxy

Explore a massive procedural universe:

  • multiple galaxies and star systems

  • planets, black holes, nebulae

  • cantinas, asteroid fields, pirate hideouts

Send probes, scout locations, and decide how to use what you discover.

Diplomacy and factions

Your actions affect your reputation with other factions. Some will become allies and trade partners, while others will declare war and try to destroy your empire.

Warfare and defense

Build defensive systems and manage them during enemy attacks. Engage in turn-based battles and fight for control over the galaxy.

Additional systems

  • original card game available in cantinas, with deck progression

  • laws that periodically change gameplay conditions

  • achievement system and global rankings

  • tutorials and beginner-friendly missions

  • four difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, Hard, Extreme

  • over 40 minutes of original soundtrack

2326910.name: Scroll Scramble
2326910.about_the_game:
Please Note: The game is still being developed, and there may be some inconsistencies in the screenshots/videos due to them being from older builds. Particularly in the artwork, which is the main thing being worked on right now. New screenshots will go up closer to release.

Scroll Scramble is a maze puzzle game about a hapless student wizard who just can't get the spells to stay in his head. In a last-ditch effort to learn the magic, our inept hero must travel into the magical scrolls and seek the knowledge in a... more hands-on fashion. You take control of Ian as he navigates the magical scrolls. Each spell is made up of a series of runes, and you must find them all before you can progress to the next spell. It's not just a matter of looking, however. Magic can be dangerous, and those dangers are manifest down here in the scrolls.



  • 24 spells to find, each with a different maze to navigate and different puzzles to unravel
  • An original chiptune soundtrack
  • Collectables provide a little extra challenge for those who want it
  • Controller support
  • 2.5D art style; control 2D sprites in a 3D world
  • Steam achievements



All game entities--including the player--are confined to a grid-based movement system, with wrinkles in the scroll parchment being impassible to all. The scrolls are full of a purple mist that represents the player's ignorance. The mist can hold other entities in place, but the player can remove it simply by walking through it. Once the mist has been removed, any entities it might have been confining can get out, so be careful what you set free!

You will experience several days before and after the battle during the game, and your tasks will be to prepare the army for the fight, gather intelligence, earn the support of locals, and more.

The game consists of 30+ missions that start with a short historical anecdote that CAN BE SKIPPED. Each mini-game is simple with a unique challenge, such as collecting coins on the map, racing around the prehistoric racing circuit of Gustav Havel, or fighting enemy knights. Experience history from the front seat and help Jan Žižka win the civil war!

You can play the game alone but also with your family or in a group of up to 4 friends on the keyboard/controllers. The game is well suited for kids, casual players, and playing with a girlfriend/boyfriend. You work together as a team, so it is OK if some of the players are beginners.

I am a Ph.D. student indie developer. I have been developing the free2play franchise "Engine Evolution" for 6 years, and I have decided that I would like to try a different challenge. When the 600-year anniversary of this battle, which happened in my hometown, approached, I decided to capture this event in my next game.

2327130.name: Xenon-Runner
2327130.about_the_game:
Utilize movement abilities to increase speed

Race your friends

Advanced Grappling Mechanics

Controls

  • Shift - Power Slide
  • Right Mouse - Grapple
  • B - rewind to checkpoint
  • L - rewind to start

How to Exit the game?

There is a transport portal outside the claw that says exit!

Why no 2D Menus and UI?

Less time creating boring menus = more time making fun game!

2327140.name: Daemonium
2327140.about_the_game:
Daemonium is a 1-4 player online co-op psychological horror game. Demonic possessions are running rampant. Grab your equipment, join your team, and locate the source of the demonic presence. Enter the portal to the demon realm to stop the possession once and for all. Perform an exorcism and banish the entity to hell before it claims your soul.

- "One of the best rituals in any ghost hunting game"

Players can play in a wide variety of locations as well as a selection of demon realms which are chosen randomly each game

Play together with up to 4 player teams

Use a wide range of equipment to find evidence of paranormal activity and reveal the possessed item

Remove possessed items from the locations

Enter the demon realm at your peril

Perform an exorcism ritual in the demon realm and banish the demon back to hell

2327160.name: I commissioned some dogs
2327160.about_the_game:
A hidden object game where you must find all the dogs and bones to complete each level.

Key features:

🖼️ 15 Unique artworks
❓ 1500+ Hidden objects total
🐕 750+ Dogs
🦴 750+ Bones
💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck
♻️ Restore a small number of hidden objects to a painting so you can find them again!
🎵 Music and ambiance for each artwork
⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel
💾 3x save slots
🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again
🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level

Context:

The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many dogs and bones as they could inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.

Controls:

Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.

Difficulty:

A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck.

Get immersed:

Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for everything.

Replayable

You can restore a small number of hidden objects back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

2327220.name: Survive The Backrooms
2327220.about_the_game:
Unique Maps
Each map has several puzzles that the players have to solve to get to the next maps. Per map there are about 3 or more puzzles, so pay attention and do not get confused otherwise the monsters will come and get you.

User interface
The game offers a clear and good looking interface which is very easy to use

Sounds
The game has ambient sounds that adapt to the maps. In addition, the player will hear his own footsteps that adapt to the ground, as well as the steps of monsters. There are also sounds for opening boxes, doors and much more, so that the user has a good sound experience.

2327250.name: Metal Ape
2327250.about_the_game:
Embark on a haunting journey through a shadowy world in this atmospheric 2D platformer, drawing inspiration from classics like Oddworld, as well as modern games such as Limbo.



Features

• Experience a captivating 1-2 hour dark tale, perfect for an immersive playthrough on a rainy night.

• Immerse yourself in a classic-style 2D platformer with prerendered 3D graphics, reminiscent of games like Oddworld.

• Navigate haunting landscapes and encounter mysterious creatures as you search for a lost soul in the shadows.

2327260.name: Earth's Greatest Defender
2327260.about_the_game:
Earth's Greatest Defender is a passion project that started in December 2021. It takes everything that we love about boomer shooters: fast paced action, loud weapons, tons of explosions, and a lot of obliterated aliens, all with the rhythm of a metal soundtrack.
It is a game about shooting enemies in the most badass way possible.

The game features a familiar set of weapons: machine gun, shotgun, rocket launcher, sniper rifle, and freeze gun. While basic, the real power of those weapons comes from switching between them to adapt to every situation, and combining them with the grappling hook.



Shooting aliens is fun, but doing it while flying around using the grappling hook is 1000% more badass. It is the real star of Earth's Greatest Defender. Grappling can be done on any part of the levels. You can use it to get the high ground, but you can also use it to move super fast and become an unstoppable alien-killing machine.

Built-in level editor


If shooting aliens isn't your thing (really, it should be), Earth's Greatest Defender also features challenge levels, where the goal will be to use the grappling hook and other movement techniques to reach the final teleporter.

If those levels still aren't enough, Earth's Greatest Defender features a map editor which allows you to create fun arenas in just a few clicks. Create the structure, add a few enemies, test it.
Once your level is cool enough, share it and it might just be featured in the game!

2327270.name: Grid-M
2327270.about_the_game:
Grid – Music - Rhythm

To the Grid-M

Click, Hold, Slide and Swipe to the Rhythm in this unique grid bound rhythmic experience.

High variety music

A wide songs both original and licensed from indies, and upcoming artists to more established rhythm game composers. Play hand crafted levels and boss battles with music from hip hop to electronic music passing by trance. There's something for everyone!

For all skill levels

For beginners the easy difficulty is as accessible as it gets. 9 Squares, click the note with right timing. Slow songs, simple patterns, everything to get a grasp of the basics. And if its still too hard, there are modifiers to lessen the difficulty.

Experts at rhythm games know no bounds and neither does Grid-M. Take on up to 25 squares, on a moving and rotating grid with high BPM songs and complex patterns. And if it’s not enough, there are Modifiers to further increase the difficulty or just go wild.

The fair progression

Get compared to people of your skill level and feel your progression. Grid-M Abstracts away positions until they are pertinent (top 10). Instead you progress through the score distribution rank tiers. There’s always a small goal within reach!

Keep your scorecards

The score is everything in Rhythm game and now it is also a card. Have your highscores turn into cards that you can save and share!

2327330.name: Andromeda
2327330.about_the_game: Andromeda is a 2D side-scrolling space shooter game that offers a unique and thought-provoking experience. In this casual adventure, you assume the role of the last remaining human in existence, embarking on a final journey to the galaxy of Andromeda before uploading your consciousness to the mega computer with the rest of humanity. Encounter formidable enemies, collect power-ups, and navigate your way through five challenging levels to discover what lies at the end of your journey.

2327340.name: Sleigh Strikers
2327340.about_the_game:
In Sleigh Strikers Santa's elves have engineered the ultimate gift-giving gadget: the Present Launcher 1225. With the reindeer missing, it's up to you to deliver the goods in a blitz of festive fury. Race through 10 increasingly challenging levels, each faster and more frantic than the last, and bring back the missing reindeer to save Christmas. Ready, aim, unwrap!
Challenge the rest of the world at your present delivering skills and deliver your way to the top of the Global Leaderboards.


Ready to Sleigh? the frosty fun ramps up with each level. Your mission: zip presents or coal down chimneys, scoring points for precision. But beware, a merry mix-up between the naughty and nice lists will cost you! Aim like an elf on expresso to snag those high scores and stars. While it's all jingle bells and joy to start, mastering the leaderboard is a craft only the most dedicated Santa's helpers will perfect.

2327350.name: FURY
2327350.about_the_game:
FURY GAME


Online first- and third-person shooter in which players fight in different parts of the world against military forces and armies of different countries. Fast, bright and large-scale battles in PvP and PvE modes, customization and upgrading of fighters and weapons.
Killing opponents will earn in-game tokens which can buy weapons, equipment and more in our in-game marketplace.
Fans of PvP battles can discover 10 different modes, combining time-tested classics and intriguing innovations.



Combat vehicles will be involved in the game, depending on the game mode. The larger the map, the more types of combat vehicles you can use. Combat vehicles are available for a single player as well as for a team.




Player Customization is a gameplay feature that allows the player to customize their character's appearance with cosmetic changes and additions.
individual pieces are earned through progression and challenges, supply drops and other micro-transactions, promotions and as rewards.




Discover one of the most detailed weapon modification systems available. You can visually modify a fighter's primary, secondary, and special weapons by installing various pieces of equipment on them. In addition to appearance, these modules change the combat characteristics of weapons. Increasing the accuracy of fire, reducing the speed of changing weapons or reloading - and many more possibilities in a fair and balanced way.

2327360.name: Webcott Dungeon
2327360.about_the_game:
Platform stealthfully through Webcott and gain the advantage in turn-based combat by finding ways to separate your foes! Time your attacks and defend your friends as you fight your way into this subterranean, under-siege village!



Navigate Webcott with companion abilities, such as Absko's web swinging and wall climbing!


Battling lots of enemies all at once isn't great for your companions, especially since you'll have limited chances to heal. However, using the environment and your companion's abilities, you can separate enemies to gain an advantage in fights before they even begin!



Beat up your foes through turn-based combat and master the timing of action commands throughout combat to enhance both your offense and defense!



Defend weakened companions during enemy attacks with other companions to help them last longer in fights!


Exploring, talking to inhabitants, and winning fights gives companions ideas on new abilities and moves called inspirations, which can be equipped with points gained from leveling up!

2327370.name: Insurgence - Chains of Renegade Remastered
2327370.about_the_game:
Join Rissa and Diana in a quest to prevent a civil war from breaking out in Aereon, the brink of an empire in turmoil in Insurgence - Chains of Renegade. This engaging 2D RPG mixed with Visual Novel elements will keep you on the edge of your seat with its classic front view Turn Based combat, HD 2D Graphics, and over 10 hours of gameplay.

Take control of Rissa, a knight assigned by her father, the Empire's prime minister, to capture one of the opposition leaders to stop the impending war. But as Rissa delves deeper into her mission, she uncovers an unsettling truth that the Empire has been hiding. Will she fight for what is right, or will she choose to remain loyal to the Empire? The choice is yours in Insurgence - Chains of Renegade.



Experience a vast amount of usable skills, with each character boasting over 40+ Skills & Specials, 25+ Weapons, 25+ Armors, and 60+ Accessories that can be equipped to gain additional skills. With 4 choices of difficulty settings and a unique Skill Equip System, players can tailor their gameplay experience to their liking.

Engross yourself in the world of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade with its Visual Novel-styled dialogue, over 20 original CGs, and 20+ Collectible Artworks by Various Artists. Don't miss out on the opportunity to embark on an unforgettable adventure and discover the truth that lies within the empire.

2327380.name: Insurgence - Second Assault Remastered
2327380.about_the_game:
Insurgence - Second Assault Remaster is the remastered follow-up sequel to the acclaimed Chains of Renegade, and takes players on an unforgettable journey through the civil war that ravaged the kingdom of Aereon. With a brand-new graphics rendering engine and support for four languages, this remaster truly brings the game to life in a whole new way.



In Second Assault, players experience the war from two different sides. On one side, players follow the story of Alissya as she searches for her sister with the help of Rea. On the other side, players step into the shoes of Tressa Lauretilion, a knight of noble descent, and her friend Sara as they lead the fight against the Imralia Rebellion and try to prove Tressa's worth as a Lauretilion.

The stories from both sides are intricately woven together, creating a unique narrative experience that is sure to captivate players. As players progress through the game, they'll encounter a vast cast of characters, each with their own motivations and beliefs, and make choices that will have a lasting impact on the outcome of the war.



In addition to its gripping story, Second Assault also features deep customization options and engaging battles. Players can choose from a wide variety of skills, weapons, armor, and accessories to build their perfect party, and engage in classic turn-based battles that require careful strategy and planning to emerge victorious.

Insurgence - Second Assault is a must-play for fans of turn-based RPGs and immersive storytelling, offering a rich and engaging gaming experience that is sure to keep players hooked from start to finish. With its stunning graphics, deep customization options, and compelling story, this remastered version of the game is an experience that no player should miss.

2327430.name: Four-Knight
2327430.about_the_game:
Four-Knight is a simple and strategic four-in-a-row.

Rules

Four-Knight is a simple four-in-a-row.
The first player to get 4 knights in a row wins.
However, Knights can be placed in a location moved from another knights.

Act strategically on the simple rules and aim for your victory.

2~4 Player Local Multiplayer

.2~4 player matches including the enemy are available.
Aim for your victory in local multiplayer.

Full Controller Support

.Mouse/keyboard and controller support.
It is also possible to play up to 4 players with a single mouse/keyboard or controller.

2327480.name: Backrooms: Realm of Shadows
2327480.about_the_game:
Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is a horror game that takes place in a seemingly endless maze of interconnected rooms and hallways, known as the Backrooms. The game is based on the popular internet creepypasta about a mysterious place that exists between the walls and floors of buildings, a place where people can become trapped and lost for days, weeks, or even years.

In the game, you play as a person who has become trapped in the Backrooms, and your goal is to find a way out before the endless maze drives you insane. The Backrooms are a surreal and unsettling place, filled with strange noises, flickering lights, and mysterious creatures that seem to be watching you from the shadows.

As you explore the Backrooms, you'll need to find keys, solve puzzles, and avoid dangerous traps and obstacles. You'll also encounter other lost souls who are trying to escape, but not all of them can be trusted. The deeper you go, the more unsettling the Backrooms become, and the harder it is to tell what's real and what's just a figment of your imagination.

Backrooms: Realm of Shadows is designed to be a tense and atmospheric horror experience, with a focus on exploration, puzzle-solving, and survival. It's a game that will keep you on edge from start to finish, as you try to find your way out of this terrifying and otherworldly place.

UNIQUE LEVELS


In The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows, there are different levels or layers of the Backrooms, each with its own unique characteristics and challenges.

THE ENTITIES


In The Backrooms: Realm of Shadows, there are several entities that the player can encounter throughout the various levels of the Backrooms. These entities are typically hostile and dangerous, and encountering them can be deadly.
Encountering any of these entities can be a terrifying and deadly experience, and players must exercise caution and use stealth to avoid them.

highlighted.localized_name: Getting the hang out of it
highlighted.name: Getting the hang out of it

2327490.name: Shape Theory
2327490.about_the_game:
Relax and immerse yourself in dozens of hand-crafted movement puzzles that will challenge your mind and soothe your senses.



Link your movement with different shapes. Unlock switches. Reveal the path.



Reach the checkpoint to complete the puzzle. Easy to learn, difficult to master.

2327510.name: Screws Loose
2327510.about_the_game:
Battle Your Friends
In Screws Loose you play the role of a robot and your only goal is to kill all other robots. Earn points by ending your foes but be careful because those points can be lost by dying.

Maps
Tired of fighting in the same place? Well I have good news for you! We have a handful of maps for you to pick from to spice up your game. Be mindful not to fall off the edge.

Announcers
Like any good shooter we have a disembodied announcer who watches and comments on the state of the match at any given time. Kill Streak! Robot Slayer! Rampage! Killing Frenzy! Untouchable! If you ever decide you might not like the current announcer's voice or maybe just want to change it up a bit then I have something for you. In your settings menu you'll find a dropdown list of voices you can pick from to replace the announcer.

The Guns
What is a shooter without some guns? Well here you'll have access to any gun you want at any time. Ammo is endless but you still might have to reload from time to time. You may ask "Is that a double barrel pump action shotgun?" and to that I simply say... yes. "Isn't that really dumb? It makes no sense." Yes and I love it because of how stupid it is!

2327560.name: Endless Railway
2327560.about_the_game:
If you're looking for a fun, simple yet challenging game, then Endless Railway is definitely a game worth trying. This game combines relaxing music, simple controls, and exciting gameplay to turn a boring train ride into a thrilling adventure.

The game is set in the Wild West, with alternating periods of dusk and mist creating an atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic world. As a guard, your role is to escort a train carrying supplies back and forth between shelters through the hordes of zombies and mist.

You must use your machine gun and pre-apocalyptic technology to constantly upgrade the train's ability and your weapon's capacity to eliminate the zombies blocking the train. The closer the zombies are to the disaster zone, the stronger they become, making your adventure challenging and fun.

In Endless Railway, you need to allocate your skills wisely to survive in the zombie and misty world. You must keep the train running smoothly and enable the shelters to exchange resources with each other.

So, if you want a simple shooting game or want to challenge yourself against increasingly difficult zombies, then come and try Endless Railway! Don't let the zombies stop the train from moving forward, venture deeper into the disaster zone and bring the necessary resources to each shelter. Purchase this game and experience a thrilling and challenging adventure!
2327560.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Russian, Bulgarian, Hungarian, Turkish, Greek, Norwegian, Czech, Polish, Thai, Ukrainian, Swedish, Romanian, Finnish, Dutch, Portuguese - Portugal, Vietnamese, Arabic

2327580.name: SimPoly Drive
2327580.about_the_game:
Get ready to hit the road and become the ultimate transportation tycoon in our latest game! In this low poly style car simulation game, you'll have the chance to build your own car collection, transport goods and people, and experience the thrill of a dynamic day-night cycle in an immersive open world map. With a variety of car types to choose from, including SUVs, mini trucks, and even heavy-duty trucks, there's never a dull moment as you navigate through different terrains and breakable meshes. As you level up, you'll unlock new cars and increase your income, making you a true master of the road. So, rev up your engines and get ready for the ride of a lifetime in our thrilling new game!

Hop into your newly bought car:

Bring out the Buy/Spawn Menu [Button T] to access all your cars and to add something new to your collection. Make sure to read the car details though and plan out your tradeoffs between expenditure and power. Choose between sedans and hatchbacks to carry your passengers whereas the rugged minivans and trucks are meant for rough use on the challenging terrains of SimPoly to carry the biggest of Cargos the world has to offer.


Just keep in mind that some cargos are only meant for the mightiest of the hauling machines!! You can find cargo missions in specific locations spreadout across the map. These places show up on the minimap as you get closer or zoom out.



The world doesn't just revolve around the idea of frantically shipping cargos but sometimes take a long breath, relax and enjoy the beauty of SimPoly. Just drive around in the vast world and merge yourself with the smoothly transitioning weather and day night system. Here you can see our player driving around sightsee...... Oh ok!! Never Mind!

The Most Interesting Assignment


Once you complete 5 missions to the post office construction site you will be appointed as their part time delivery driver. Go ahead and race through those narrow lanes while the clock is ticking. Isn't it always more fun when there is a real challenge and a real deadline!

2327590.name: CHI NINJA
2327590.about_the_game:
Welcome to Chi Ninja, the fast-paced game that will test your ninja skills and reflexes like never before!

In a world full of ninjas, our hero must fight his way to freedom using his sharp ninja moves, grappling hook, and ninja stars, as well as his trusty katana. With challenging levels that will put your skills to the test, you’ll have to dodge traps, avoid enemies, and use your ninja abilities to reach the end of each level.

But be warned, the ninja army is not to be underestimated! You’ll face waves of enemies that will test your combat skills, and you’ll need to use all of your ninja abilities to defeat them. You’ll need to be at the top of your game to survive.

But it’s not just about fighting - Chi Ninja also features a range of other challenges that will test your agility and reflexes. You’ll need to use your grappling hook
to reach places , wall jump your way to new heights, and slide under obstacles to make your way through the levels.

With its stylish visuals and fast-paced gameplay, Chi Ninja is the ultimate ninja experience. Do you have what it takes to fight your way to freedom? Play Chi Ninja on Steam today and find out!

2327600.name: On The Job
2327600.about_the_game:
"Get In, Get Out, Get Paid!"


That's The Agent's motto, and that is exactly what you do in this turn-based roguelite stealth game!
In On The Job, you control The Agent, and it is your mission to sneak your way through many dangerous levels to get all the documents from dastardly secret organizations. There are many obstacles and guards in your way so it won't be easy, but it's all about how much risk you can take before you leave with that big payday!

Features

  • Endless levels that constantly challenge you in various ways.
  • Fun upgrades to turn the tide in your favor.
  • Different guard types to change things up.
  • Various contracts which alter the game rules.
  • Cool achievements to unlock to show how cool you are.
  • Different agents to unlock and play as, each with different ways to sneak, stab, shoot, etc!

2327610.name: 纯白医院Whitedary
2327610.about_the_game:
◇游戏类型◇

- 视觉剧情向RPG
- 多角色互动+少量战斗要素
- 通过对话选择，治疗病人，改变故事的走向和结局

◇故事简介◇

　　“2202年7月13日，由市区开往城郊的都市第一列车，在行驶时遭遇不明事故，造成多节车厢脱轨，乘客大量死伤。目前，幸存者已被送往就近的医院——‘纯白医院’进行救治。”

　　“除去对逝者的痛惜，都市各方更是对事故起因议论纷纷：行车记录仪‘黑匣子’不翼而飞，给侦查工作带来巨大困难；有就近的目击者声称在现场看到巨大的黑影，破碎车厢上竟覆盖着层层雪花。而且，本次事故的13名幸存者，相貌都发生了非人的变化，精神问题也遭遇了极端放大——听到闹铃便满地打滚的社畜，不握着笔就无法入眠的考生……他们到底在列车中看到了什么，经历了什么？这依旧是都市持久的热门话题。”

　　《纯白医院》是一款基于传统像素RPG系统的视觉剧情向游戏。待完整版发行后，玩家可以免费获取游戏本体，享受风格独特的视听盛宴。
　　在游戏中，你将扮演一名初来乍到的实习咨询师，在偌大的精神专科医院“纯白医院”中进行探索与疗愈。你可以跟随导师，学习咨询的技巧；你可以与病人们闲聊，了解医院和他们的故事。不过，不要忘记了你所肩负的重要责任——帮助蓝月科技集团，调查列车事故的背后真相。

◇游戏操作◇

上下左右移动，Z确定，X取消

◇注意事项◇

1.该游戏可能不适合光敏性癫痫人群。
2.部分游戏表现取自于个人、同伴经历与影像资料，不能与专业诊疗等同；对某种精神现象好奇时，辛苦以严谨的态度另行查证。
3.如果您发现了bug，可以在评论或QQ游戏群126448933中和作者反馈，谢谢！

◇发行日期◇

- 等鸡吃完了米
- 等狗舔完了面
- 等火烧断了锁
- 制作从未停止

2327640.name: Deadlock Station
2327640.about_the_game:
Engage in Automated Battles

Positioning is key: the outcome of the battle is decided by your pre-battle setup, characters’ abilities, and your orders.

Use the Environment

Turn the battlefield to your advantage: construct spike walls, establish choke points in city ruins, bait enemies into traps, and push them on hazards or land mines. Who said that's not fair?

Assemble Your Squad

Command a diverse team of characters, learn how to use their abilities and battle stances, and enhance them with powerful implants and gear, such as Energy Shields and Time Weapons.

Learn Your Enemy

Defend against the deadly Ravagers, outsmart the Renegades, and hunt dangerous aliens for loot and glory. Various enemies, terrains, and battle objectives require you to adapt on the fly.

Develop Your Base

Unlock new items, characters, and factions to interact with - from the ruthless Order to the all-knowing PFS. The possibilities for experimentation and creating synergies are limitless: two expeditions won’t ever feel identical.

2327660.name: Pigeon Protocol
2327660.about_the_game:
Play with up to 10 of your friends in this frantic bird-based online game! Customize your pigeon, compete to build nests, own territory and keep hold of shiny things. But watch out, it’s a bird eat bird world out there!

Fun Gamemodes!

Pick from 5 game modes to play with your friends! Build nests, fight over shiny things and battle to keep hold of your territory!

Maps!

Pick from 4 different maps to play on!

Fun flying and gliding mechanics!

Fly and glide around to your heart’s content.

Customize your bird!

Personalize your bird by giving yourself a custom name, hats and custom colors to make you stand out from the flock.

Combat!

Use your claws and beak to defend yourself and keep your enemies at bay.

2327670.name: Pipe Dreams
2327670.about_the_game:
Pipe Dreams is a challenging and addictive 2D puzzle game that will put your logic and problem-solving skills to the test. As a master plumber, your goal is to connect pipes of different shapes and sizes to create a perfect destinations to help your Slime!

Features:
- Procedural Generation: With procedurally generated maps, the game offers a virtually unlimited number of unique puzzles to solve. No two games are ever the same, making each playthrough a new and exciting experience.
- Intuitive Controls: The game has simple and intuitive controls that make it easy for players of all ages to pick up and play. Players can simply click and change pipes angle to connect them, and move to gather treasures and rise the difficult.
- Beautiful Graphics and Sound: The game features beautiful hand-drawn pixel graphics and a relaxing soundtrack that create a charming and immersive gameplay experience. Players can enjoy a relaxing and engaging puzzle adventure that will keep them entertained for hours.
- Replayability: With over 50 levels of increasing difficulty, players can enjoy hours of challenging gameplay that will keep them coming back for more. The game also features lots of Steam achievements, giving players an extra incentive to replay levels and improve their scores.

Pipe Dreams is the perfect game to unwind after a long day or to challenge yourself with a new and exciting puzzle adventure. Are you ready to become the ultimate master plumber and conquer every level?
2327670.supported_languages: English, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Spain

2327690.name: The Orphan
2327690.about_the_game:
In "The Orphan," players are invited to step into the shoes of Eric, a former orphan who has grown up to become a journalist. Eric's childhood was marked by tragedy and horror, as he lost his family in a horrific accident and was forced to endure the paranormal events that plagued the orphanage where he lived.

Now, as an adult, Eric still finds himself haunted by the nightmares of his past. In the game, players must help Eric survive the horrors of the orphanage, which doubles as a school, by solving puzzles, hiding from danger, and finding a way to escape.

One of the standout features of "The Orphan" is its immersive and eerie atmosphere. As players explore the haunted halls of the orphanage, they will encounter unsettling sights and sounds that will keep them on the edge of their seat. The game's use of sound and lighting is particularly effective in creating a sense of dread and tension.

"The gameplay in 'The Orphan' is designed to challenge players and reward their problem-solving skills. From decoding complex puzzles to manipulating objects in the environment, players will need to think creatively and use their intuition to overcome the dangers that lurk in the shadows. The game's puzzles are both immersive and satisfying, offering players a sense of accomplishment as they progress through the game. Whether you're a fan of horror or puzzle-solving, 'The Orphan' is sure to test your wits and keep you engaged until the very end."

As for Eric, he is a complex and relatable character whose struggles will resonate with players. Despite his traumatic past, Eric is determined to survive and to uncover the truth behind the paranormal events that continue to haunt him. Through his journey, players will discover the strength and resilience that Eric possesses, and will be rooting for him to overcome the obstacles in his path.

Overall, "Fans of horror and puzzle-solving will find much to enjoy in 'The Orphan', an atmospheric indie game that delivers a haunting and immersive experience. From its spine-chilling sound effects to its challenging puzzles, the game offers players a thrilling journey through a world filled with danger and intrigue. Whether you're looking for a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat or one that will test your problem-solving skills, 'The Orphan' is an excellent choice that is sure to leave a lasting impression."

2327710.name: Escape the Unknown: Awaken the Realm
2327710.about_the_game:
About the Game

Escape the Unknown: Awaken the Realm is visual novel fantasy RPG, where you step into the shoes of a hero in the making as you explore dangerous dungeons to uncover the mystery behind your identity and save the realm!

Key Features
  • Six dungeons to explore, each with its own challenges to face.
  • A colorful cast of voice acted friends and foes.
  • Various puzzles that block your path through the dungeon to valuable loot!
  • Strategic combat against opponents each with their own weaknesses and resistances.
  • A plethora of weapons, armor, and magic to wield against opponents.
  • A world filled with rich lore waiting to be uncovered by the inquisitive adventurer.

As the mystery behind the world is uncovered, your journal will update to keep track of your progress.

Uncover the mystery, save the world, awaken the realm!

2327720.name: City Car Driving 2.0
2327720.about_the_game:
Choose your car – explore an entire region where every sign, traffic light, and road marking follows real traffic laws. Become the ultimate driver in the city.

• Become more confident on realistic roads: every traffic light, sign, and road marking is placed strictly according to traffic regulations, creating a believable environment for learning and honing your skills.

• Progress from novice to professional: from your first city turn to off-road driving — your actions impact the gameplay and carry realistic consequences.

• Prepare for the unexpected: unpredictable pedestrian behavior, dangerous lane changes, sudden hazards, and other dangers can occur at any moment – learn to make quick, correct decisions.

• Challenge yourself in various weather conditions: from morning fog to nighttime storms — the dynamic weather system will push your limits and create unique scenarios for every drive.

• AI vehicles obey traffic laws: strictly following regulations, traffic yields to pedestrians at crosswalks, respects speed limits, reacts to changing road conditions, and interacts with other vehicles.

• Every vehicle has unique behavior: each car in traffic acts differently, imitating various driving styles — from cautious beginners to aggressive drivers who stop at nothing.

• Traffic can make its own decisions: it can make mistakes, break rules, and handle situations on the fly — creating not only the atmosphere of a real road environment, but also unique gameplay!

2327730.name: Draft - In the woods
2327730.about_the_game:
Draft - In the woods is a casual puzzle game.

Your goal is to remove grid nodes using pencil drawn lines.

Featuring:

  • Grid movement in turns, you play with the pencil and need to cross a drawn line without colliding with enemy objects such as erasers, erasers or concealers.
  • Solve 30 progressive levels that challenge your ability to memorize patterns.
  • Enemies and power-ups with different mechanics that teach you how they work at each stage.
  • No distractions, put on your headphones and relax in a unique challenge.
  • Original soundtrack, specially composed to keep you focused.
  • No counters or scores, in draft you forget about the world around you and have fun.

Can you destroy all the nodes? Give it a try and prove that you are a real Drafter.

2327740.name: Bird Watch: Central Park
2327740.about_the_game: Bird Watch Central Park is an Ornithology Simulator where you traverse New York City’s central park in search of various bird species to fill your log. Take in the breathtaking scenery of a to-scale Central Park and keep your eyes peeled for various bird species as you fully immerse yourself in Bird Watching. Take out your camera and grab some cool pictures of the various birds walking around or casual walk in the simulated Central Park and enjoy the view while listening to our realistic bird sounds!

2327750.name: Moon is Not the Limit
2327750.about_the_game:
Moon is not the Limit is a narratively driven educational spaceflight simulation game designed to teach players about the science behind space travel.

Experience the journey as the newest astronaut to join the newly-formed Multi-national Aeronautics & Space Administration, MASA, as you answer space-related trivia to guide your rocket to a safe Moon landing!

Discover starfaring features:
  • A cast of voice acted characters to accompany you on your journey!
  • Compelling narrative-driven dialogue.
  • Trivia to test your astronomical knowledge.
  • Customize-able Quick-Time-Events so you can experience the perils of space at your own pace.

Afraid you don't have what it takes? Worry not! Your co-pilot and mission controller have your back with various dialogue comments about travel and life in space. Just sit back and remember to answer the questions posed correctly or your spaceflight may come to a sudden, and explosive, end.

2327930.name: 方案之困

Tired of number inflation, tired of leveling up just to switch maps.
