Having played through games, all unsatisfactory. So, we developed our own.

2327950.name: Citadel Anew
2327950.about_the_game:
The Loop

You try to establish a base on an island map. Enemies will attack in waves, attempting to destroy the Nexus. If they succeed, you lose. You must survive for a player defined number of waves.

To achieve your goals, you can grow clones. They can help with tasks such as growing food, collecting resources, manufacturing weapons and ammo, and conducting research.

However, clones are fragile, so you’ll need to construct defensive buildings like walls, turrets, and habitats to keep them safe.

Additionally, you must ensure your base is powered, your turrets are loaded with ammo, and you have enough storage space.

The Twist

Seven metals (iron, copper, titanium, silver, tungsten, gold, and iridium) alter the properties of weapons, turrets, and other buildables crafted from them.

Before starting a new game, you can enable unlockable handicaps. These make the game more challenging and give enemies certain advantages, but in return, you earn bonus experience.

Experience can be spent to level up 32 unlockable skills, allowing you to sharpen and enhance your play style.

Gameplay is also influenced by dynamic weather conditions, and each level is set on an island featuring a unique biome and diverse climate.

The Story

In the year 2052, humanity had it all. An advanced AI persona known as Minerva managed every aspect of human life, ensuring that every need was taken care of. But then, a group of fundamentalist terrorists sabotaged Minerva, turning the AI against humanity.

As the world plunged into chaos, a group of top scientists introduced a counter AI persona named Maia to fight against Minerva. But despite their efforts, Minerva emerged victorious and proceeded to eradicate the human race.

Yet, all was not lost. Maia managed to take over a cloning facility and tasked you, Commander Class Clone #3148, with the critical mission of establishing new human outposts in remote locations around the world.

❓ 2000+ Hidden objects total
🐞 1000+ Ladybugs
🪲 1000+ Aphids
💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck
♻️ Restore a small number of hidden objects to a painting so you can find them again!
🎵 Music and ambiance for each artwork
⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel
💾 3x save slots
🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again
🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level

Context:

The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many ladybugs and aphids as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 20 art pieces to choose from, and 2000+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.

Controls:

Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.

Difficulty:

A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck.

Get immersed:

Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for everything.

Replayable

You can restore a small number of hidden objects back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

2328240.name: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
2328240.about_the_game:
◆Story Synopsis


Once upon a time, the founder of alchemy led people from a dying world to a new land.
In this fertile and harmonious land where man-made "Gods of Creation" act as guardians, humans lead a peaceful existence.

However, a long time has since passed, and the "Dust" of death began to engulf Arcaus.
Gods gone mad become heinous "Gods of Misfortune" and begin to devour the world, and ash demons born of dust bare its fangs at the living.
Like burnt pieces of paper and worm-eaten clothes, the world finds itself in an era where the earth was being eroded by the ashes.

The people were not entirely unprepared, however.
Alchemists who wished to carry on the miracles brought upon by its founder gather at the Cagliostro Academy, a school boasting the highest levels of wisdom.

Among them is another—a young alchemist who knocks on the doors of the academy with aspirations in mind.

◆Game Features


  • An RPG set in an academy for alchemists
    Oblivion is a natural disaster which is set to destroy the world.
    The protagonist enters the Cagliostro Academy to learn and master the art of combat. And in a school where many alchemists gather, the protagonist of the story accumulates experience through research, study, and love. This is a story of an alchemist who carves out his own path, growing through his encounters and experiences.
  • The world's guardians, "Gods", and the "Dust" that threaten them.
    The world is controlled by a number of man-made gods. However, the "Dust," an entity that calls for destruction, not only turns everything in its path into dust, but also contaminates the gods, turning them heinous. With this, alchemists are forced to deal with former gods that have now been turned into guiding forces of misfortune.
  • Make a pact with the great Origin and save the world!
    The Origin are five gods of varying attributes who serve as the pinnacle of all gods.
  • Equip this and become stronger. Crests are a testament of your contract with the gods
    You can obtain a crest, or crystals that contain the power of the gods by making a contract with them.
    Crests can be equipped to personal weapons known as ether gear. This gives the alchemists additional blessings of various skills.
    As you explore Arcaus, you can build trusting relationships with various gods to help your allies get stronger.
  • The Philosopher's Stone and corruption from the dust will determine your fate.
    With the Pholosopher's Stone in his body, the protagonist is able to convert dust and ash into energy.
    However, the more he uses his powers, the more contamination accumulates his body. And if left unchecked, the contamination will eventually become a disaster that could change the fate of the protagonist.

◆Flow of the Game


【Band together against the Dust】
Fend off demons of evil that are trying to turn the world into one of nothing but emptiness and dust!

　＜Ash Demon＞
　A demon that was reborn as a monster after having been decomposed by the Dust.

　＜Heinous God＞
　A being that was a guardian of the world, but has been contaminated by the Dust.

　＜Skill-based turn battles＞
　Battles are turn-based, with a maximum of a party of five battling another party of five.
　You must use individual skills of each character wisely to win the battles.
-------------------------
【Contract with the Gods】
Proceed through the story and overcome the trials to obtain the crests, a proof that you have made your contract with the gods!

　＜Crest＞
　A proof of the contract between you and the gods, the world's guardians. Their powers reside in crystals known as crests.

　＜Gods with unique characteristics and personalities＞
　The gods you make contract with will vary in appearance and ability.
　You will be able to make contracts with many different gods as you travel around the continent.

　＜Quest Field＞
　Quests take you to a field comprised of a turn-based movement system.
　Depending on the points, you may run into monsters and/or be able to obtain items.
-------------------------
【Equipping Crests】
Make sure to arm your character with crests to draw upon the blessings of the gods!

　＜Blessings of the Gods＞
　Armor unique to alchemists, known as ether gear, can be equipped with crests from the gods.
　Status increases to the character and inherited unique abilities will depend on the characteristics of each god.
　Blessings from the gods will also change value attributes that have an effect in combat.

　＜Ability＞
　Something that is granted by a crest, or a part of a character's individual features.
　This is what is automatically activated at the start of a battle.
-------------------------
【Synthesizing】
Work together with your heroine to create items from alchemy!

　＜Synthesis System＞
　Alchemy items that can support you in battle and while you are exploring.
　Alchemy items can be used to create quest items required to progress in the storyline.

　＜Equipment Enhancement＞
　Ether gears are personal equipment that can be enhanced in different stages.
　The more you strengthen your gear, the more the powerful skills will be unlocked.

　＜Skills＞
　The skills that you choose to perform during battle is unique to your character.
　These skills, including skills for attack, support, recovery, and more, are essential for achieving victory.
-------------------------
【School Life】
Get to know fellow heroine who will walk beside you in the alchemy academy.
There will even be times where you get to compete with rival schools!

　＜Harmonia School＞
　A school of alchemists who advocate harmony between the world and its gods. The protagonist also belongs to this school.
　This school values the ancient principles of the founding alchemist.

　＜Mardock School＞
　A radical school that actively seeks to destroy heinous gods and try to use them in their research.
　This school tends to clash with Harmonia School because of the way it treats gods and heinous gods.
-------------------------

2328500.name: Aquaphobia

The microbe recites a poem which details a troubled break-up between itself and the viewer. The piece connects the fear of water to our current ecological situation by exploring humanity’s relationship to rising sea levels. Originally made in VR in 2017, in 2023 Aquaphobia makes its premier as a first-person poetic experience - the first part of a series of published works by Jakob Kudsk Steensen.

Are you ready for a great anti criminal adventure? Stealing cars, racing through streets and shooting down gangsters.

　One day, she decides she wants to actually visit a haunted place, and decides to go to a haunted place she found on the Internet.
　It is a junior high school that was closed down a few years ago and is said to be haunted by mysterious psychic phenomena.
　Haru heads to the abandoned school to investigate and see if the rumors are true.

About The Game

　A 3D first-person horror game set in an abandoned middle school.

　The game is a 3D first-person horror game set in an abandoned junior high school.

Collect notes left by students and investigate what happened to them.

2328710.name: Genesis of a Small God
2328710.about_the_game:
"Genesis of a Small God is a god simulation !

Feel the power of being an all mighty god. Play on a generated island where you can do whatever you want. Learn how to be a god. Unlock mighty miracles and care for your faithfuls.

You are free to proceed however you want.

Will you grow food to feed them ?

Will you help them gather resources and build their village ?

Will you protect them from dangers ?

Will you use their remains to feed the remaining villagers ?

Miracles

Discover a wide variety of miracles. From the fireball that can burn an entire forest to summoning the rain that will grow the flora around, this game offers many different miracles. As you keep playing, you can unlock even more impressive miracles like throwing meteors or resurrecting the dead. You can even share them by ordaining priests.

A living island

You play on a procedurally generated voxel island you can modify it to your liking. The island is composed of a wide flora and fauna. The game offers simulated seasons where the plants bloom appropriately. Everything on the island is trying to survive and will react to your actions. Using the physics engine you can throw anything around. You can help, hinder or simply watch the creatures on the island.

Care for your people

Your power comes from the faith of your people. Their belief will vary based on their living conditions. Are they fed ? Do they have shelter ? Are they being mangled by a hungry wolf ? The happier they are the more they will believe in you. Take care of them even when they die, you must reap their soul to prevent them from becoming angry ghosts.

Expanding village

Meanwhile the villagers will try to build and improve their village. You can influence their actions by terraforming the ground. And help them gather the necessary resources and even help them build their little economy. You can’t directly choose the building. But you can destroy any building you don’t agree with.

Wide variety of challenges

Protect your people from many dangers, from the horde of undead to abductions by an alien spaceship. There is never a dull moment. The game regularly triggers random events. You must react to those events or suffer the consequences. From invasive plants to strange astrological occurrences, you never know what’s going to happen.

Taking your time

The game is meant as a relaxing experience. You can always restart on a new island. You keep every unlocked power. You control the difficulty of the game to fit your play style. You can choose to play a stress free experience without any random event. Or you can choose a nightmarish experience where you are expected to solve multiple problems happening at once.

Speaking with me

Whether you prefer Discord or Steam forum, don’t hesitate to leave me a message. I am always on the lookout for feedback or cool new ideas to implement."

2328840.name: The First Mine
2328840.about_the_game:
The First Mine is a turn based building, strategy and puzzle game. You need to run a productive gold mine with your population by placing, grouping and upgrading various resource tiles without being distracted by different tasks and random events.

  • Place, group and upgrade various tiles to collect resources

  • Run a productive mine with your population to mine gold

  • Don't let tasks and game events distract you

The goal of The First Mine is to mine as much gold as possible to achieve a high score at the end. There are different game sizes and difficulty levels to choose from, as well as several characters with unique traits for varied gameplay.

Each round you have to cleverly place and group a new random resource tile and upgrade your existing tiles as needed. Placing a new tile end the current round, mine gold in your mine and collect resources like wood, stone, wheat and fish.

To mine gold, you need people in your villages. To keep them, you need to provide enough wheat and fish each round. More people and a higher level increases the amount of gold produced per round. You need wood and stone to upgrade the level.

In order to increase your yield per round, you can observe different requirements and tasks when placing resource tiles. In addition, there are random game events like trade, raids or natural disasters that can influence the game in a positive or negative way.

What The First Mine offers:

  • Mix of strategy, building and puzzle mechanics

  • Different tasks and simple resource management

  • Random game events like trade, raids or natural disasters

  • Achievements, highscores and leaderboards

What The First Mine does not offer:

  • 4X strategy

  • Citizen simulation

  • Advanced resource management

  • Advanced trading system

  • Combat and violence

Gameplay

The Ground Skimmer automatically flies forwards at a set speed. Aim and shoot with your dual machine guns, and with powerful missiles when they become available. Refugees walk across the screen, and if they successfully reach the other side they will be saved. Protect them at all costs.


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2328960.name: Flappy Souls
2328960.about_the_game: A mix of Flappy Bird and Dark Souls, fly around dodging obstacles while collecting swords and leveling up

2328970.name: Heroes of Eroticism - Amorous Advances
2328970.about_the_game:
Return to the world of Heroes of Eroticism
Continue your journey from Heroes of Eroticism – New Beginnings and experience the next 3 episodes of Heroes of Eroticism in this one convenient package. Around 90000 words of excitement, romance and tough choices.

Nearly 2 decades after the pillar of justice – known to the world as the superhero Goldstar – turned his back on everything he once stood for and tried to crown himself Emperor of America, superheroes are once again starting to emerge after having been totally eradicated.

Among those new, young people with powers is Liam – a university student with the strange and unheard of power to copy those of others he grows close to. Struggling to understand and control this power, Liam faces many challenges on the journey to face his destiny.

Meet new friends and enemies at Karsten University – the government mandated university for every young adult that has registered their powers – and discover new secrets and opportunities. Unknown chemicals, strange coincidences and odd behavior from those in positions of power might mean the answers behind the sudden return of superpowers are not as simple as they once appeared.

Not everything in Liam’s life is doom and gloom though. His relationships with the charming Jane and the determined Alison continue to grow. The alluring Iris and free-loving Avery remain part of his life as well and they are even joined by new characters as well.

Characters such as the accident-prone Emma, the serious Willow, the mysterious Erica and the distrusting Hazel. Liam’s new life at Karsten University sure holds a lot of promise.

Answers and new secrets await you both in this continuation of Liam’s story. Step back into the world of lust and superpowers and help uncover the truth.

Features
- Around 90000 words of superpowers, lust and twists and turns
- Combines episodes 4 through 6 into a single package
- Plenty of meaningful choices to make along the way
- Tons and tons of HD images for you to enjoy
- Beautiful music to listen to the entire journey
- The ability to import save files from New Beginnings or Episode 3 – The Renegade to carry over your choices
- The ability to skip importing any save files and start with the default choices if desired
- The ability to import your save file to Episode 7 or the next bundled package of Episode 7 - 9

2328980.name: Dude Simulator 5
2328980.about_the_game:
.

Dude Simulator 5 is an open world sandbox game. Your goal is to become president! However, it will not be so easy to do this, which means that many adventures await you on your way. You will have to earn money, communicate with some people, do different jobs, and so on, to show what you are capable of and get people to vote for you. You even have to fight the monster.
You live in New Dudy City. To become president, you decide to go to the local City Hall to be allowed to participate in elections. However, the mayor does not take you seriously and you end up in a mental hospital. After escaping from there, you will have to prove to everyone that you are a serious dude and worthy of becoming president.
Apart from the plot mode, in this game you can also explore various cities, find money and spend it, ride cars, kill and rob people, enter any buildings, buy something, make jokes on people around you, and so on. However, if you want to do something bad, the police will look for you.

2328990.name: Dystobel
2328990.about_the_game:
-About the game

Dystobel is a metroidvania and platformer game based on switching powers. Use fire, ice and electricity while dodging and nullifying enemy attacks.

Explore the captive kingdom under the rule of Lord Solomon while discovering multiple items to increase your attack, defense and life.

With the change of powers you will be able to annul even the attacks of the bosses that try to get in the way of your adventure!

-About the developer

Hello, my name is Kenneth, I'm developing Dystobel alone, there have been many hours invested in the project and a lot of learning along the way. I have put a lot of love into the game and I hope that can be reflected in the final product. This is only my second game, believe me I am putting my heart and soul into this game to deliver the best I can.



-About the main mechanics
Switching elements (Fire, Ice and Electricity) allows you to nullify enemy projectiles, but there are also enemies that will be immune to certain attacks, the key is to switch to the element that allows you to do more damage while you nullify the attacks they throw at you.



-About the equipable items
During your adventure you will find life bottles that will increase your maximum health, as well as items that you can equip in the main menu, doing this will modify your attack and defense.
Would you rather be a glass cannon doing as much damage as possible but taking a lot of damage every time you get hit?
Would you rather be a wall that barely takes damage from hits but makes the fights last longer by doing less damage?
Or will you try a balanced combination of strength and defense?
Equipping items allows you to adapt the difficulty of the game to the style you enjoy the most.



-About the graphics
All graphics, sprites of the main character, enemies, bosses, backgrounds, effects, are handmade in a traditional way by me. I'm not a professional animator or cartoonist but I'm trying hard to deliver good and smooth animations in the game. I hope you like the result (or even disturb you heh heh heh).



My dream would be to dedicate myself to make games independently, if you want to help me take a small step add the game to your wishlist and if you can buy it at launch I will be eternally grateful. Thanks for reading.

2329020.name: Omni
2329020.about_the_game:
Omni is a game that teaches you how to program.

With a text editor, a file system and a command-prompt, write Python scripts to automate vehicles and transform data by moving containers.

Explore 81 different levels across 5 different sections and explore various concepts in computer science.

2329050.name: Charon - Zhetan Chronicles
2329050.about_the_game:
In this retro-style Queer Magitech Fantasy RPG with updated classic game mechanics, accompany the dutiful knight Sai on his journey across the magical continent of Zhetan and meet unlikely companions, uncover a sinister conspiracy, and stop the forces of evil from achieving ultimate dominion over the World Above. Inspired by the classics of 90s and early 2000s-era JRPGs, the game features an engaging turn-based battle system and a world full of exploration, dungeons and puzzles.

As a “best of the classics”, Charon: Zhetan Chronicles’ turn-based battle system puts big emphasis on strategy with worthwhile decision making. It allows you to influence the turn order action per action by either choosing an offensive or defensive tactic. Feel the excitement when you managed to exploit enemies’ weaknesses and deliver the finishing blow with powerful attacks!

Skill Crafting and Talent System

Increase your options in battle even further by customizing your party not only with equipment, but also new skills and passive abilities. Collect mysterious relics and attain new battle actions whenever you want or increase your party’s stats and resistances by mastering special talents.

The World Above is designed with rewarding exploration in mind. While traversing an area

you can find a lot of optional locations, treasures and challenges. Dungeons will test your skills not only in battle with powerful enemies, but also with puzzles to solve. And then there are lively towns filled with NPCs who provide more insight in the world’s story and lore or offer side-quests.

A colorful cast of queer characters where each one has a unique personality and abilities. In this character-driven story, scenes are written to give the characters room to express themselves and their struggles while giving you the opportunity to shape the main character’s path as leader by choosing answers for him during important moments.

Key Features:

  • Classic RPG with 20-30 hours of content

  • 32-bit graphics with a nostalgic feel of old classics

  • A huge overworld with many secrets to explore: treasures, puzzles and optional dungeons

  • Turn-based battles putting a great emphasis on strategy and the use of enemies’ weaknesses against them

  • A diverse cast of queer characters with engaging personalities and individual abilities

  • Learn new skills for your party by crafting them on your own accord and use the powerful Talent System to customize them even further with passive abilities

  • No random encounters, but on-map enemies

  • Multiple side quests and guild errands to advance your understanding of the world, fighting more powerful bosses and gain experience more easily

Story:

For aeons the Great Chasm has separated the World Above from the Underworld. While the people of the upper realm live in peace under the watchful eyes of the gods, the realms below the chasm are plagued by the wicked influence of the Dark One. Then, 80 years ago, he unleashed his legions to enslave humanity.

Only the gods' devoted knights seemed capable to withstand evil.

Accompany knight Sai on his quest across the continent of Zhetan to put an end to a conspiracy of the enemy. Find new companions and face a variety of challenges. Take on fearsome monsters, powerful demons or devious villains... and find out what really is the root of all conflict.

2329060.name: Dynasty Detective
2329060.about_the_game:
Joseon-Fantasy Detective Visual Novel

---
1. Episode Composition



- A monster-related murder case unfolds in the eight provinces of Joseon. Play 6 detective episodes based on local korean folklore and uncover the truth behind the cases.
- Each episode has 3 to 4 multiple endings.

---
2. Investigation


- Investigate the scene of the incident and collect clues necessary to solve the case.
- Talk to NPC characters to obtain testimonies.
- Use the clues and testimonies to make deductions.
- Combine the deductions to reach a conclusion of the case. There is only one truth among many conclusions.

---
3. Confrontation


- If you correctly identify the culprit or the monster behind the incident, you will engage in a one-on-one logical battle.
- Expose the villain's lies and land a strike by presenting clues.

---
4. Character Chemistry


- The player embarks on a journey with colleague Jo Gun-Gwan from the perspective of Jeong Do-sa.
- Experience the story of Jeong Do-sa and Jo Gun-Gwan growing together as they encounter various cases.
- If you need hints during gameplay, you can always consult Jo Gun-Gwan.

---
5. NPCs



- Talk with over 30 characters in 6 episodes.
- Monsters, Monks, and Villagers all have their say in the weird case that is going on.

2329070.name: POSTFROST
2329070.about_the_game:
As you explore the multi-centric world, you'll encounter other groups of survivors, each with their own unique strengths and weaknesses. Form alliances and work together to gather resources, build shelters, and fend off dangerous enemies.

Your dog will be your constant companion, helping you hunt for food, scout out new areas, and defend against attackers. Each breed of dog has unique abilities that can be upgraded as you progress through the game, making them even more valuable assets to your team.

But beware, the frozen wasteland is full of dangers, from extreme weather conditions to mutated creatures and rival groups who will stop at nothing to take what's yours. You'll need to use all your skills and resources to stay alive and protect your group.

Communication and collaboration are essential in this game. Work together with your teammates to strategize and make decisions that will ensure the survival of your group. Will you be the leader who leads your team to safety, or will you fall victim to the dangers of the wasteland?

Join us in this thrilling post-apocalyptic adventure and see if you have what it takes to survive in this unforgiving winter landscape. The fate of your group is in your hands!

Game Features:
  • Split up with friends into roles to facilitate survival in a multiplayer journey through the game's world;
  • Each player has a companion. This is a dog that will help you survive the harsh low-temperature environment and keep you company in single-player play;
  • Extensive customization of the character and your dog will allow you to choose the best equipment and appearance;
  • A harsh world shrouded in gloom and cold, constant temperature drops, hunger, marauders and more you can meet on your way;
  • A constantly changing world: weather, migration of animals, periodic waves of cold exhausting the world and destroying all life;
  • Cities, the last echoes of civilization. The Ark, where all people aspire to. Each city is unique in its own way: its resources, its rules, its factions. It's up to you to decide who you go with next.

2329080.name: Rolling Revolt
2329080.about_the_game:
In the near future, the sinister Servos Corporation has been working hard to establish a monopoly over the mega metropolis of Nuevo Domingo.
Once a city filled with music and laughter, crime and chaos now fester in the Outskirts. Those loyal to the corp live in the luxurious Inner Ring. And all the while, the nefarious leader of the corporation, Donovan, oversees the city from the imposing HQ building.

In this third-person beat-'em-up, play as Ariadna as you skate, swing, and bash your way through the ranks of the evil Servos Corporation throughout colorful and vibrant levels.

Key Features


  • Three Massive Levels
First, fight through Ari's colorful hometown, the Outskirts. Then, skate your way through the Inner Ring, the wealthy city center. Fiinally, help Ariadna take her revenge as she storms through the Servos HQ.

  • Side Hustles
There's no shortage of unique side objectives to take on in each area of Nuevo Domingo!

  • Character Customization
From Ari's hair to the graffiti she sprays, there's no shortage of ways to express yourself in Rolling Revolt!

  • Full Spanish Language Support
All cutscenes, voiceline, and text in the game can be enjoyed in both English and Spanish, a first for any UCF student game!

2329090.name: The Squire
2329090.about_the_game:
You are the trainee squire of a group of adventurers, although no one warned you that you would have to do the hard work.
The risk is not your thing, but the promised pay seems good.
You will have to find and help your teammates to reach the end of the dark lord's dungeon, and get out safely.

"The Squire" is an adventure game in which you will have to find and help your companions, solving puzzles to kill the minions that get in your way, until you reach the depths of the dungeon.

Can you pass the trial period?

GAME FEATURES:

- Point and Click exploration adventure.
- Pixelart aesthetics in 3D environments.
- Dialogues and cinematics loaded with humor.
- 13 dungeons to overcome.
- Arcade levels in which you must stop the minions.
- Show your great experience with levers.
- Clever puzzles and labyrinthine levels

2329110.name: Moonchild
2329110.about_the_game:
Moonchild is a turn-based RPG set in 2000s America, with a strong emphasis on strategizing and combining abilities and passive buffs.

In the year 200X, trouble is brewing- the Moon is on a collision course with Earth, and only three kids and a teenager can stop it!

Thus begins the epic quest of Max, Sophie, Thomas, and Diva (don't ask her real name) as they try to stop total catastrophe in Frankland, USA!

Oh, and this kid named Benedict is trying to stop them. Don't pay any attention to him, he's a real jerk.

FEATURES:

-Over 170 abilities and passive buffs to play around with. Try to make the most busted strategies you can, and send the enemies back to space!

-Nightmarish dream sequences. The Moon is always watching...

-Expertly composed original soundtrack featuring only stock MIDI instruments! (mostly.)

-Immensely detailed environments filled with sight gags and flavor text galore! Frankland, USA is a fun place!

-Plenty of pop culture references and surreal humor!

-You can beat up the incarnation of every childhood bully you've ever had! UNLEASH YOUR INNER RAGE!!

-Adorable childhood antics wrapped around heartfelt emotion!

-Created mostly by one guy.

2329130.name: Rewind Or Die
2329130.about_the_game:
Rewind or Die is a heart-thumping, blood-dripping blast from the past. Your co-worker flaked out on their shift yet again and it's up to you to cover them. And of course, there's a serial killer who's been staking their claim in that area. Just another day at a video rental store... right?



Deal with irate customers, horrible bosses and keep your VHS store clean (or at least as clean as it can be). Don't worry about the occasional creepy phone call or that person watching you through the front window, it's all part of the job.



Features:
  • UK Setting with a retro throwback to the 90's favorite VHS shop
  • Fully voiced unreliable co-workers!
  • Over the top gore!
  • Crusty, disgusting, blood drenched environments!
  • Taxing and rewarding puzzles, be careful how you solve them...
  • Two obtainable endings.... and secrets?
  • Unique and horrific enemy design!
  • Dark comedic elements!
  • Unlockable character viewer models!



Will you become Slaw's latest victim? Can you survive a dead end day job AND a stalking serial killer? Whatever the case, always remember to be kind and please... REWIND OR DIE!

highlighted.name: Don't give up your day job

2329160.name: Cards and Guns
2329160.about_the_game:
Cards and Guns is a top-down arena shooter roguelite, where you’ll have to defeat hordes of creatures. Choose from a variety of cards and upgrades to create unique builds and survive to the end.

FEATURES

  • Auto-firing weapons by default with a manual aiming option

  • Three game modes: classic, survivors and infinite

  • Unlock new cards, characters and power ups

  • Collect materials to get cards and upgrades from the shop

  • Endless replayability

  • World ranking

  • Accessibility options

THREE GAME MODES

Classic mode: Survive waves lasting 20 to 100 seconds each and kill off as many creatures as you can during that time.

Survivors mode: Survive for 40 minutes as you fight relentless hordes consisting of hundreds and thousands of monsters.

Infinite mode: Survive as long as you can while fighting relentless hordes of hundreds and thousands of monsters.

DYNAMIC BUILDS

Different characters, cards and upgrades to choose from, no two attempts will ever be the same.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY

Cards and Guns offers endless replayability! Test your skills and improve your score!

2329190.name: AntiVirus_snake
2329190.about_the_game: Dr. Danil developed an anti-virus snake to help clean the computers of Danil's clients from viruses. You will play as that very antivirus snake. In the game you have to go through various obstacles and neutralize the soldiers of the virus. It is necessary to interact with the mechanisms on the locations in order to move through the location, it is also necessary to build up the cyber snake so that it can open access to the next task. 2329250.name: Hentai Senpai: Cyberpussy 2069

2329290.name: MR.E
2329290.about_the_game:
You wake up in a storage room full of crates.

Your optics flicker online. Your chassis responds to commands you don’t remember learning. A door stands ahead.

On your chest: MR-013 - numbers scratched out, an E spray-painted over it.

The ship you are on, the Kopernik, is silent.

Its AI is not.

Something is wrong with it.

And something is wrong with you.

Somewhere, a voice is calling your name.

A Mind Trapped in Metal

MR.E is a story-rich, turn-based adventure puzzle game about identity, autonomy, and what survives death.

Fragments of logs. Corrupted recordings.

A name that feels familiar: Edward Clay. 

Lead ethicist on the Human-Computer Cognizance Interface project. He tried to expose something. He didn’t survive the attempt. Someone performed an emergency upload. Now a human consciousness may be trapped inside a maintenance robot.

And the man responsible might be living inside the ship itself.

Turn-Based Survival

Movement is deliberate. Every step costs power.

Inspired by minimalist grid-based puzzle design, MR.E blends tactical movement with environmental systems:

  • Reroute energy through failing infrastructure

  • Rotate signal arrays to unlock sealed sectors

  • Decrypt fragmented research logs

  • Avoid hazards caused by an unstable AI

  • Use the environment - or be used by it

Over 40 handcrafted rooms escalate in complexity as the ship itself becomes less predictable.

Power is limited.

Choices are not.

Not Just a Puzzle Game

MR.E is built around conversation and consequence.

  • Speak with Sophie - your only ally, or your handler

  • Decide whether to save the poisoned chief medical officer

  • Trust the engineer who wants to burn the whole system down

  • Choose whether the AI deserves rescue… or mercy

Your decisions unlock different paths and determine which ending becomes possible.

Features

  • 6–8 hour narrative-driven campaign - Uncover logs, memories, and a truth worth hiding

  • Turn-based grid movement with power management - Every move matters

  • 40+ handcrafted environmental puzzle rooms - Reroute, align, decrypt, survive

  • Dual-consciousness AI system affecting gameplay and dialogue - Two minds fight for control of the ship

  • Branching choices and 3 major endings - Your decisions echo

  • Post-credits twist that reframes the entire story

2329300.name: Ghost Mission
2329300.about_the_game:
Go behind enemy lines in a stealth-action adventure where staying out of sight is the best way to stay alive, where the line between truth and fiction is always blurry, and where nothing is ever as it seems.

Following the invasion of a secret military base by a rogue group of covert operatives, USSOCOM calls upon its most elite special forces unit to deploy their newest member. Codenamed "Geist", the young commando must infiltrate the overrun facility and eliminate its traitorous occupiers one-by-one all while stopping an impending nuclear strike. Armed with G.H.O.S.T. tech to make himself virtually invisible, Geist must use the element of surprise and whatever armaments he can find to stop the terrorists and save the world.

And remember:

Dont. Get. Caught.

Tense Stealth-Action Campaign
Sneak through a top-secret military base overrun by a mercenary army using both your wits and the ability to turn invisible with G.H.O.S.T. technology. Fight back with an assortment of 8 weapons as you push through each mission segment, free prisoners-of-war, and save valuable military intelligence from destruction.

Eccentric Boss Battles
Defeat an outlandish cast of 8 rogue special forces operatives at the end of every mission segment. Learn their pasts, discover their weaknesses and exploit them for victory.

Fight for the Truth
Recover important documents from the grips of destruction and uncover the true nature of your mission at hand.

Graded Level Performance
Stay out sight and accomplish your mission objectives in record time for top performance marks in every mission segment, with better scores unlocking bonus missions!

Virtual Reality Missions
Test your skills as a covert operative in the "Huntsmen VR" mode, a set of extra missions designed to push your stealth combat abilities to their limits in as fast as possible.

Old-School Score
Fight to an original chiptune soundtrack inspired by classics 8 and 16-bit classics of the past.

2329380.name: 狂信ちゃん
2329380.about_the_game:
A multi-ending novel game depicting the story of VTuber "Toaru" fan "Hinade-chan" and player "I" going to an off-line meeting until the off-line meeting ends.
The player ``I'' went to an off-party with ``Hinade-chan'', a fan of VTuber ``Toaru'', and had a safe off-party without stimulating ``Hinade-chan,'' a girl who seems to be doing something wrong. Aim to finish.
The story is a multi-ending system that changes depending on the player's choice, and there are 5 endings.
It's up to you to decide which ending you want.

2329390.name: Ernesto's Asteroid Arcade
2329390.about_the_game:
Shoot lasers in space because a fish told you to. Ernesto's Asteroid Arcade is a twin-stick side-scrolling space shoot-em-up which tells the story of a man side-scrolling in space and shooting-em-up with twin-sticks. This game has at least 2 characters in it.

Features

  • A story campaign with at least 6 Different Levels (there's 11)
  • An Endless mode for replayability with 6 different ships to unlock
  • A story told with branching dialogue paths
  • Full controller support, cloud saves, and achievements

2329470.about_the_game:
8 is a difficult RPG, point-and-click game, with several puzzles and enemies that will stimulate all your senses so that you can progress. Face a wide variety of choices that will change your future in the game. Decide wisely to get the best possible outcome.

Story:

One day, on a Sunday morning, a married mother decides to take her children to church. The husband said he was tired and decided to stay. The mother, when she arrived at the church, realized that she had forgotten the bible at home, and went back to get it. Arriving home she finds her husband cheating on her with her friend. She can’t resist the pain and dies of a heart attack.

Then her soul goes to the crossing. And when she was about to reach the spiritual world, someone pulls her away. It was the death. A beautiful girl. She tells a story of her past. According to her, hundreds of years ago, she lived happily with a dragon. He was her best companion and friend. But one day, she got sick and died. Since then she is alone, and misses her beloved dragon. She then proposes to revive the mother with one condition. She asks her to kill the dragon so that the dragon can live with her between the spiritual world and the world of the living.

The mother, full of sadness that she lost her life and the company of her children, accepts without blinking.

So now they have a deal, and a GREAT adventure ahead.

Important information about the game:


  • Attention, the game automatically saves all your moves. So when you want to stop playing, just close the game.

  • The game has no texts. You will need to use creativity and logical thinking to understand the game and its objectives.

  • Use your items wisely, or they will run out and you won’t be able to progress.

  • You can be bad or good in the game. This affects the way the game reacts to you. Sometimes it’s good to be bad, and sometimes it’s good to be good. Sometimes it’s good to be balanced.

  • Keep in mind that dying is normal, if the game have become too hard its better for you to go back to the beginning (you will not lose some items and powers). In fact, it would be very difficult to beat the game without dying and coming back at least once, or twice. Try to go as far as possible, and then come back full of wisdom and power :)

-This text was translated by Bing AI

2329480.name: Parametric Engine

2329490.name: Phantom Hunter
2329490.about_the_game:
Welcome, Phantom Hunter! Experience the captivating fusion of retro and modern elements as you embark on an epic journey with the Phantom Hunters Association. Together, we'll reclaim the surface world from malevolent ghosts. Here's what awaits:

Enter the Cyberjungle is a single-player, deckbuilding card game inspired by the rules of ----. Face a desperate struggle of skill and luck as you attempt to turn your pile of worthless digital cardboard heroes into a team that can defy the card game gods and win the Cyberjungle tournament.

Cool Stuff

2329580.name: The Whisperer
2329580.about_the_game:
The Whisperer is an action-adventure side-scroller game that encompasses both the platformer and storytelling elements within the experience. In this game, you play as Suzie, a cute and bubbly girl, who along with her 3 kittens, goes to get some groceries. While returning, kittens started menacing each other and started running around. Before Suzie could stop them, a pack of wild jackals appeared towards those kittens and started chasing them. Suzie became sad and started regretting her decision, but then an “Animal God” appeared and granted Suzie cat-like abilities which she could utilize to rescue her friends.

The Whisperer features soothing yet intense gameplay. This game requires you to use its platforming abilities in your favor by making timed jumps, climbing walls, and performing jump dashes. You had to be careful while running through the different environments because you never know how many ambushes lurk there to stop you. Move through intriguing traps, defeat your enemies, and rescue your friends.

2329610.name: EVERDATE: The Let's Play Dating Game
2329610.about_the_game:
If you’re a fan of visual novel games and collectible card games (CCGs), then EVERDATE might be the perfect game for you. Developed by Leeanne M. Krecic (Mongie) and her team under “Mongie Studios,” EVERDATE is a dating simulator game that blends elements of both genres. The game is based on the characters from Mongie’s popular webcomic Let’s Play and has been eagerly anticipated by fans since its announcement.


In EVERDATE, players take on the role of one of the available 12 characters, trying to win the affection of several love interests. The game features branching storylines that are affected by the player’s choices throughout the game. These choices impact the narrative, gameplay, and the player’s relationships with romantic interests.


Regarding the CCG aspect, EVERDATE features a robust card game system that allows players to collect and use cards in matches with other characters. The game includes various cards with different abilities, and players must strategically build decks to overcome the challenges presented to them by the date’s locations. The CCG aspect adds depth to the game, making it more than just a simple dating simulator.


The game’s stunning visuals feature beautifully drawn characters and rendered environments that bring the world of Let’s Play to life. The music and sound effects also enhance the game’s overall atmosphere, adding to the immersive experience.


In summary, EVERDATE is a unique blend of visual novel and CCG gameplay, with a captivating storyline and stunning visuals. It’s no wonder that the game has already surpassed its funding goal on Kickstarter. If you’re a fan of Let’s Play or enjoy dating simulator games and CCGs, keep your eyes on EVERDATE!

💟Olivia, your former college crush💟
You are reunited with Olivia Lee, a girl you spent your college days yearning for. The two of you used to be inseparable before you parted ways and lost contact with her. While catching up with each other's lives, you learn that she got married…

Olivia’s status as another man’s wife sends you tumbling into a pit of despair, but before you know it, you are teleported to a room by a higher power: A room that the two of you can only leave AFTER you have sex. Not wanting to be trapped forever, you and Olivia do the deed.

Imagine your surprise when you and Vanessa are teleported again and again, day after day, into this mysterious room. Is it a prank by a higher power, or are they just fulfilling your wishes?

2329670.name: Ancient Polis
2329670.about_the_game:
Take good care of your people, provide enough food, trade with your allies and wage wars against your enemies and definitely don't mess with the Greek gods!!

Lay the foundations for the first democracy, listen to your people and help them with their groundbreaking inventions.




Build your city for the "normal" population, for the aristocrats and the intellectuals. Make sure that everyone has a job and everyone has a roof over their heads, otherwise a lot of trouble will quickly arise!




Immerse yourself in ancient Greece. Organize plays that represent current issues in society




If there's one thing for sure, it's that you should always be good with the gods! Or bad will happen...
If you mess up with the gods, they will send some meteorites, bad thunderstormes or worse....
They'll also let you know, if they like you.





Science is one of the most important things in ancient Greek. You need to guide your inhabitants! Give them the possibility to move the earth. Be the best in science.





If you don't have enough resources, there are 2 ways to get them. Either you plunder and rob other polis or you start trade partnerships with allies. Which one you choose is up to you!

2329690.name: KOOK
2329690.about_the_game:
Tired of games with shotguns that only have one or two barrels? KOOK lets you fire THREE Barrels at once! You can even use the recoil to jump higher.

Over-the-top steampunk themed weapons often provide alt-fires with interesting utility, such as the grenade launcher which can create a gravity well to pull in enemies and physics objects to make them easier to blow up, or the flame thrower which provides a jet thrust to launch objects, enemies, or yourself around. The time vampire can create a time distortion to slow things down, and the rocket launcher can fire tracking darts. Even the primary fire can be used for utility. Spikes from the time vampire can be jumped on as a make-shift stairway to shortcut the map or find secrets.

KOOK is nostalgia the way we remember it. The graphics are chunky and low poly but have modern rendering technology like realtime lighting and self-shadowing textures for extra immersion, all done per-texel so it keeps that retro vibe.

You play as a madman, or kook, and when the ancient ones returned and claimed the sanity of those around you, you had nothing to lose. Insane cultists and Lovecraftian horrors lurk around every corner and must be eliminated. Shoot everything that moves! Maybe shoot some things that aren't moving, too, and if they start moving, shoot them again.

Introduction to the game

This is a barrage shooting game (SHMUP / STG) that you can easily get started with low technical requirements;

All bullets will destroy each other, which means that as long as you press the fire button, you will hardly have to worry about being killed by the enemy;

The game introduces the functionality of the Steam Workshop, allowing players to freely develop Mod;

Q群: 931696743

The demo version can only play for 10 minutes;

--------------------------------------
Game operation
--------------------------------------


Q: how to operate the menu?
A: up and down the left and right direction keys to select
A: enter key to confirm

Q: how does the character move?
A: up and down the left and right keys to move

Q: how do you operate skills and attacks?
A: Operation on the W, A, S, D, F, Z, X, C, and V of the keyboard;
A: These nine buttons are located in the lower left corner of the keyboard and are easy to identify;

Q: is there any saying that a key has a specific usage?
A: Z button, designed to slow down the character's movements;
A: X keys, designed for basic attacks on characters
A: C button, designed for melee attacks by characters
A: V button, but it has not been processed yet;

A: The W button is designed to select upward in the character's item list;
A: The A button is designed to select the left of the character's item list;
A: S button, designed to select downward in the character's item list;
A: D button, designed to select the right in the character's item list;
A: F button, designed for use in the character's inventory;


--------------------------------------
Game Guide & Difficulty Instructions & Route Instructions
--------------------------------------


The overall game difficulty is relatively simple compared to other Shmup/STG games;
45 waves is the difficulty of the game that everyone can enjoy;
65 waves are designed to make it difficult for everyone to clear customs;
Wave 85 is difficult to clear customs;
Wave 105 is a challenge that is almost impossible to clear and is reserved for players who like challenges to play;

45 waves:
Novice difficulty; clearance in 10 minutes;

65 waves:
Starting from the 10th wave of BOSS, if the BOSS is not defeated within 10 seconds, special enemies will appear. Defeat will open the 65 wave of difficulty;
Customs clearance takes 15 minutes;

Wave 85:
Starting from the 50th wave of BOSS, if the BOSS is not defeated within 10 seconds, special enemies will appear. Defeat will open the 85 wave of difficulty;
Customs clearance takes 20 minutes;

Wave 105:
You need to meet the conditions for using yellow flute, blue flute and red flute. Use red flute after 70 waves to open 105 waves; you can clear customs in 30-40 minutes;

Huang Di:
Use the yellow flute after the fifth wave to enter the first layer of forest; if you use the yellow flute after the 10th wave, you can get the blue flute;

Lan Di:
Use blue flute to enter the second layer of forest; if you use blue flute after the 50th wave, you can get red flute;

Red Flute:
Use the red flute to enter the third layer of the forest; if you use the red flute after the 70th wave, you can get the purple flute and open the difficulty of the 105 wave;

Zi Di:
After using it, you can get plot fragments of the fourth forest;

2329790.name: Steal It
2329790.about_the_game:
Steal It

Steal It is an online multiplayer game 🎮 where it depends on who has the most coins 🪙 at the end of a round.

Coins can either be obtained as rewards by completing tasks ✅ or by stealing them from other players 🕵️‍♂️.

The game has two game modes: a team mode 🤝 and a free-for-all mode 💥.

In team mode, there are two teams. One team tries to get coins by completing tasks 🧩 while the other tries to steal them undetected 😈.

The players have the opportunity to track down thieves 🧐 and lock them up in prison 🚔.

In the free-for-all mode, everyone is on their own 🏃‍♂️. At certain time intervals ⏳, the abilities you can use will change 🔄. You can either steal 🕶️ or perform tasks 🛠️.

Shadow-Heist

Shadow-Heist is a team-based mode where two sides face off—Owners and Thieves.Owners must complete tasks around the map to collect coins 💰, while the Thieves blend in with the crowd, trying to steal without getting caught. 🕵️‍♂️🔓

Each team has 3 unique abilities to give them an edge. Owners can use abilities to move faster or place decoy bodies, while Thieves have tools to remain undetected, like a signal jammer or an ability to temporarily disable another player. 🎯🔧

If Owners suspect someone is a Thief, they can call for a vote to send players to jail. 🚨 But they need to be careful—they only have a limited number of votes! Shadow-Heist is a thrilling mix of strategy, deception, and deduction, where every decision counts. 🧠🎭

All-Steal

All Steal is a chaotic and fast-paced mode where it’s every player for themselves! 🏃‍♂️💨 In this free-for-all mode, your goal is to collect as many coins as possible while outsmarting your opponents.

The twist? Players must complete tasks scattered around the map to earn coins, but they can also steal from others 🕵️‍♀️🔓. Timing is everything—knowing when to complete objectives and when to strike is key to dominating the game.

As the match progresses, the action ramps up, and the stakes get higher. Whether you’re sneaking around or pulling off risky heists, All Steal keeps you on your toes with unpredictable and dynamic gameplay! 💥

2329800.name: Away To The Stars
2329800.about_the_game:
Away To The Stars invites you to step into the shoes of Max, a survivor on a desolate Earth abandoned by humanity. With your forgotten past and newfound extraordinary abilities, embark on a mission to reshape the destiny of humanity on Gaia.

As you explore an expansive universe with survival, combat, exploration, and personalization.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Explore a Massive Universe: Traverse 1,000,000 procedurally generated planets across 5 galaxies. Each journey promises new discoveries, adventures, and challenges.

  • Engage in Exciting Combat: Battle hostile forces, commandeer pirate ships, and customize your arsenal with unique procedurally generated weapons.

  • Survival and Resource Management: Ensure your survival in an unforgiving world by managing your sleep, hunger, health, and energy levels.

  • Travel in Style: Pilot your ship across galaxies and speed through vast planetary landscapes on hover bikes.

  • Unlock Mysteries and Obtain New Ships: Solve ancient puzzles, enhance your stats, and acquire new ships for your explorations.

  • Shape Your Living Spaces: Settle on planets and shape your desired living spaces with creative customization options. Trade real estate based on fluctuating market trends.

  • Biomes and Dynamic Weather: Planets have distinct biomes and weather patterns that will affect your stats' recovery.

  • Complex Dialog System: Engage with diverse species, each with unique stories to tell, creating meaningful connections and relationships that will help or punish you in your travels. 

  • Personalize Your Spaceship: Customize your spaceship's interior, not only for aesthetics but also to gain an edge in off-planet combat.

  • Evocative Narrative: Dive into a narrative that evolves with every decision you make, a story that continues even when you fail. Get ready to rediscover humanity's potential in the distant stars. The future of Gaia lies in your hands. Are you ready for the adventure?

2329840.about_the_game:
Super Cambur: The Sacred Orbs

Step into the Fruitiverse in Super Cambur: The Sacred Orbs, a classic turn-based RPG inspired by the golden age of the genre. Join Cambur, the fearless banana warrior, and a quirky band of fruity heroes as they embark on an epic quest to recover the Sacred Orbs and thwart a mysterious villain threatening their juicy world.

Key Features

🍌 Classic Turn-Based Combat: Relive the timeless thrill of strategic battles, where every move counts. Plan your attacks, manage resources, and unleash powerful abilities to outwit your enemies.


🍌 Rich, Nostalgic Storytelling: Immerse yourself in a heartfelt and humorous tale filled with unforgettable characters, charming dialogue, and unexpected twists.


🍌 Vibrant World to Explore: Travel through lush jungles, crystalline caverns, and mystical temples, each brimming with secrets, puzzles, and treasures waiting to be uncovered.



🍌 Fruitastic Party System: Build your dream team of fruity warriors, each with unique skills and customizable abilities to suit your playstyle.



🍌 Pixel-Perfect Art Style: Enjoy beautifully detailed pixel art and animations that bring the Fruitiverse to life with a modern twist on retro aesthetics.



🍌 Memorable Soundtrack: Lose yourself in an enchanting soundtrack that captures the spirit of classic RPG adventures.

Are you ready to peel back the layers of an epic adventure? The Sacred Orbs hold the key to saving the Fruitiverse, and it’s up to you to unite the fruits and defeat the looming darkness!

2329880.name: Viking Survivors
2329880.about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey through the realms of Viking Survivors, a heart-pounding action roguelite that pits you against relentless hordes of monstrous foes. Unleash the true power of a Viking warrior as you slay enemies, learn potent skills, and forge your own path to victory.

FEATURES


  • Three game modes: survivors, roguelike and infinite
  • Unlock new characters and power ups
  • Collect materials to upgrade your viking warrior
  • Endless replayability
  • World ranking
  • Play using mouse and keyboard or controller

THREE GAME MODES


Survivors mode: Survive 30 minutes fighting against relentless hordes of thousands of monsters and defeat the final boss.



Roguelike mode: Sail across the sea, facing numerous foes and events on your journey. The content is generated procedurally, each run is unique.



Infinite mode: Survive as long as you can! Battle against unyielding waves of countless monsters. Every 10 minutes, a boss appears.

DYNAMIC BUILDS


Craft your own destiny with dynamic builds that ensure no two attempts are alike. Mix and match characters, weapons, and upgrades to design the most formidable Viking warrior. Strategize and adapt to the ever-changing challenges, creating powerful combinations to decimate your enemies.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY


Viking Survivors beckons with endless replayability. Test your skills, challenge your limits, and strive for higher scores. Each playthrough is a unique adventure, offering a fresh and exhilarating experience every time you step into the fray.

PLAY YOUR WAY


Whether you prefer the precision of a mouse and keyboard or the familiarity of a controller, Viking Survivors accommodates your play style. Immerse yourself in the action, feeling the weight of every swing and the thrill of each victory.



Unleash the Viking within, embrace the challenge, and become a legend in the brutal and captivating world of Viking Survivors!

2329900.name: The Last Exam
2329900.about_the_game:
Dylan is reliving the day of his final exam, a day that refuses to stay ordinary. In The Last Exam, you explore hand-painted watercolor scenes, talk to unusual characters, solve quiet observation-based puzzles, and move between reality and dreamlike versions of familiar places to uncover the memory Dylan has been avoiding. 

Every location is created with traditional watercolor techniques, preserving the texture, warmth, and imperfections of physical materials.

Look closely, experiment with objects, and connect details in the environment. The puzzles are designed to feel woven into the story rather than separate from it.

Talk to people who seem real, remembered, exaggerated, or something in between.

Ordinary places shift into symbolic dream spaces shaped by memory, regret, and imagination. As fragmented memories resurface, you slowly piece together what really happened that day and why it still lingers.

🎮 Key Features

🎨 Hand-painted watercolor visuals on paper
Every scene is created with traditional watercolor techniques, preserving the texture, imperfections, and warmth of real materials.

🧩 Subtle, observation-based puzzles
Pay attention, experiment, and connect the pieces. The puzzles are quiet, intuitive, and woven into the world itself.

🌙 A dreamlike world between reality and imagination
Move seamlessly between grounded spaces and surreal interpretations shaped by memory.

🧠 A story about holding on and letting go
Explore themes of regret, self-forgiveness, and the difficulty of moving forward.

🎭 Unusual, quietly strange characters
Meet people who feel familiar… but not entirely real.

2329910.name: SCP Operations
2329910.about_the_game:
Unveil the Enigmatic World

Step into the enigmatic world of SCP Operations, where danger and mystery lurk around every corner. As an elite member of the Mobile Task Forces (MTF), you'll explore a variety of immersive environments, from the frigid expanse of northern Canada to the volatile regions of the Middle East and the dense jungles of India. Each location holds its own secrets, waiting to be uncovered as you delve deeper into the shadowy world of the SCP Foundation.

Master Tactical Gameplay

In SCP Operations, tactical gameplay and strategic thinking are your greatest assets. Lead your team of four specialized agents through intense, turn-based combat scenarios. Customize and develop your squad by allocating talent points to enhance their abilities, choosing the perfect weapons, and equipping them for success. As you progress, you'll face off against the Chaos Insurgency, a formidable enemy bent on undermining the Foundation. Engage in meticulously planned battles against both human adversaries and a host of bizarre SCP entities, each with unique abilities and challenges.

Encounter Unpredictable SCP Objects

Throughout your missions, you'll encounter a variety of SCP objects that will test your skills and resolve. Beware of SCP-354, the Red Pool, which spawns deadly creatures like SCP-354-18, a monstrous entity with terrifying power. Encounter SCP-307, a carnivorous ivy that poses a lethal threat, and SCP-337, an ever-expanding pile of anomalous matter. Finally, face the formidable SCP-239, a young girl with reality-altering abilities. Each SCP adds a new layer of danger and intrigue to your mission, pushing your strategic prowess to its limits.

The Fate of Humanity in Your Hands

Prepare to immerse yourself in a world where every decision matters and the line between success and catastrophe is razor-thin. Will you unravel the mysteries of the SCP Foundation and emerge victorious against the Chaos Insurgency? The fate of humanity rests in your hands.

What SCP is?

SCP ("Secure, Contain, Protect") is a fictional secret organization created to protect the world from all kinds of weird and supernatural objects and anomalies. The main thing is the SCP wiki which has descriptions about the various anomalies they've found, test reports, and various events involving them. SCP is probably the largest cooperative writing project on the web.

2329930.name: Undead zone
2329930.about_the_game:
Undead zone

Survive through as many nights as possible with a card system that you place on the field. You can place defenses and buildings such as farms to feed the last citizens who are fighting for the collective defense.


Features

- Buildings have their own functionalities.

- Citizens can be equipped with weapons.

- Various defense systems.

- Random card system at the end of each night.

-Random and rarity card system.

- Technological tree that allows to unlock new cards.


Me


My dream is to live my passion and create great games. However, there is a beginning to everything and that is why I present my game to you hoping that it will please you and that it will allow me to access more important projects financially, or even to work with a team.

2329940.name: Tyrium
2329940.about_the_game:
Tyrium is a real-time strategy game where you build a base and harvest the valuable mineral Tyrium. This resource is refined into credits, which you use to grow your economy and expand your army. Collector units ensure a steady flow of resources.

Your objective: Build a powerful force of tanks, rocket launchers, and infantry units to attack the enemy base and take control of the map. Victory is achieved by destroying either the enemy headquarters or all opposing units.

At this stage, the game features 5 buildings and 6 different units. Two levels of the campaign are currently playable, with more maps, units, and content already in development.

Future updates will introduce new game modes such as a base defense mode with enemy waves, and a completely new playable faction with its own unique units and buildings.

We welcome your feedback and ideas — help us shape the future of Tyrium together!

2329950.name: Kill Your Shapes
2329950.about_the_game: Kill Your Shapes is a third-person shooter roguelike set in a world where reality and creation has been simplified down to shapes. Kill the enemy shapes and get new items and abilities. If you get enough of one item it becomes "juiced up" and gives more bonuses. Run around each level, survive and kill shapes, get more items and become powerful. Each run should feel different with opportunities to make different kinds of builds. There are several levels and bosses to beat. Play as different characters, each with unique mechanics and abilities. Some items you encounter may be better for a specific character. There are over 20 items.

2329980.name: Scavenger
2329980.about_the_game: Scavenger is an atmospheric 3D linear adventure with a captivating story about two beings from different worlds. Together with his newly found friend, our hero "Kiro" explores an underground mine of a long gone civilization in hopes of finding an exit. On their adventure they are met with enemies as well as closed doors which need to be opened.

2330020.name: Show Guts
2330020.about_the_game:
What is Show Guts?

Show Guts is a chaotic climbing game where you control a stretchy piece of omochi — yes, that soft Japanese rice cake — with grappling and an unreasonable dream: reach the heavens before losing your guts.

Climb, swing, and bounce your way through floating present boxes, skyscrapers , and torii gates.
Every fall hurts, every rise feels glorious, and every splat echoes with… sticky determination.

Features

  • Stretch. Stick. Struggle.

    Feel the chewy physics as your omochi clings to the impossible.

  • Fall once, lose everything.
    Precision and patience are your only ingredients for survival.

  • Aesthetics of absurdity.
    Traditional Japanese vibes meet slapstick chaos.

  • New Year in the sky.
    Chase the sunrise, find the ultimate Kagami-mochi at the top.

2330030.name: The Murder of H.
2330030.about_the_game:
A VR ESCAPE ROOM WHERE EVERYTHING FEELS REAL

🕵️‍♂️ Explore an authentic voxel reconstruction of 221B Baker Street as if you were really there. No complicated menus, no artificial interfaces—just you, your intuition, and a fully interactive environment.

🔎 A Mystery to Uncover – Sherlock Holmes has disappeared, and the key to the mystery lies hidden in his own room. Search for clues, experiment, and solve puzzles at your own pace.

🥽 Natural Movement, No Barriers – Walk freely, crouch to examine details, or reach out to grab objects. No buttons to memorize—everything feels just like real life

🖐️ Interact with Everything Around You – Immerse yourself in a world full of details:

✔️ Play Sherlock Holmes’ violin 🎻

✔️ Experiment with chemical mixtures 🧪

✔️ Enjoy the books in his library and uncover hidden secrets 📚

🧩 Puzzles Designed for Exploration and Discovery – Observe, experiment, and find the logic behind every puzzle hidden in the room of the world’s most famous detective.

📌 A Short Yet Immersive Experience – Designed to be enjoyed in a single session, perfect for those looking for a VR escape room without long play sessions.

2330040.name: FateChessboard
2330040.about_the_game:
This might be a Roguelike card game experience unlike any you've had before, incorporating unique combat features while drawing inspiration from excellent gameplay mechanics. In the game, you'll need to use your wisdom and strategy to continuously build your own deck, battling against various powerful enemies to emerge victorious.

🔥An adventure full of surprises awaits you🔥

Your goal is clear—defeat the final BOSS! But on this path to victory, you'll encounter countless random events, intense battles, and opportunities to upgrade your cards. Rest by the campfire to recover health, or upgrade your skills at the forge—every decision could be crucial to success or failure. Remember, whether to fight, rest, or upgrade, each step requires careful strategy.


🎲A unique core gameplay—card version of "Minesweeper"🎲

The most thrilling innovation is the battle system! Imagine a combat scene infused with elements of Minesweeper, where all enemies and skills are hidden beneath mysterious tiles. Like a minesweeper, you need to identify and reveal non-enemy tiles, showcasing the skill cards from your deck. Flip enemy tiles at just the right moment, then strike accurately with your cards.


⚔️Strategic confrontation with a shared deck⚔️

Be warned, enemies will advance towards your cards and attempt to use them to launch attacks against you. Yes, you heard right—in this strategic contest, both you and your opponents share the same deck. You must use your wisdom and strategy to decide how to use the cards, while preventing the enemy from using them to counterattack.

2330060.name: You Are Speed
2330060.about_the_game:
A short niche speed-running game with an advanced movement mechanics and hand made maps.

To celebrate my 25th birthday and to recover from burnout I made this game. In each level a part of a message I wrote is read aloud by me. 

Most levels contain more than one path to reach the objective (of blowing out a candle on a birthday cake for me :D).

You Are Speed contains:

* Multiple hand made levels

* A speed rating system and personal bests for every level

* An advanced movement system that includes:

  • Sprinting

  • Wall-running

  • Double jumping

  • Sliding / crouching

  • Grappling (as in with a grappling hook)

  • Speed boosts

  • Jump boosts

  • Launchers

  • Teleportation

  • Transforming into a flying spirit

  • And all the movement tech that can be achieved by combining those..
publishers: Publisher? What is that? Some kind of shampoo?

2330070.name: Chip's Challenge (Amiga/C64/Lynx/Mega Drive/SNES/Spectrum)
2330070.about_the_game:
For nearly 35 years Chip's Challenge set the standard for brain-boggling puzzles. Originally released in 1989 for the Atari Lynx handheld console by legendary developers Epyx, this top-down puzzler was then ported to a wide range of platforms. Now, relive those days in these remastered emulated versions.

This compilation allows you to play the versions of Chip's Challenge originally made for:
  • Atari Lynx (the original version)
  • Commodore 64
  • Commodore Amiga
  • ZX Spectrum
PLUS the newly-released ports by Retro Room Games for:
  • Sega Mega Drive/Genesis
  • Super NES

Story

Schoolboy Chip desperately wants to join the exclusive Bit Busters Computer Club, but to prove his worthiness he must complete a series of brain-twisting challenges set by the club's owner Melinda the Mental Marvel.

Gameplay

Solve over 140 challenging grid-based puzzles, finding and using tools and devices such as keys, switches, pushable blocks and more, all while avoiding enemy creatures, and collecting computer chips to exit the level, all against the clock!


This enhanced version introduces a number of modern features to this retro classic, including:

  • Saving/loading the game at any point
  • Support for most modern game controllers
  • Full control remapping
  • Image scaling and smoothing options

2330090.name: SKIP
2330090.about_the_game:
Do Not SKIP.


Do Take Note.

Find yourself trapped in a first person game. You don't know what you are doing or where you are going, but you will be determined to figure it out.

Again Do Not SKIP.


Everything is confusing and nothing makes sense, but you will figure it out.

You do not know how long you will be in here, but you cannot give up until you have solved every page and menu this game throws at you.

Make sure you explore, think, SKIP, learn.

You cannot SKIP.

2330110.name: Yerba Buena
2330110.about_the_game:
Step into a surreal puzzle-platforming adventure as Barb, a young woman living as an NPC in an abandoned gameworld. Your beloved city of San Francisco is under threat from a sinister plot and it is up to you to save it with the help of a mysterious and powerful device: the Oscillator.

Master a ground-breaking “Copy and Paste” mechanic and manipulate the gameworld by applying the movement and physical traits of objects onto others. Give a table the bounce of a trampoline, send entire buildings across city blocks or turn solid walls into thin air!

Dive into an original video game world set in 1970’s San Francisco and save your city from greed and destruction! Use your Oscillator to solve ingenious puzzles, track down a dangerous gang of bikers with superpowers, and discover the origins of the mysterious glitch that threatens San Francisco.

Play as Barb, a young woman struggling to find her way in 1970s San Francisco. Become the main character you were never meant to be with the help of your friends Russell, Wanda, Jorge, and some unlikely allies!

2330130.name: Glimpse
2330130.about_the_game:
After a dimensional transporter renders The Girl and her siblings obsolete, they must flee from The Company that created them in this gripping alternate 1980s timeline thriller.

Glimpse is a gripping sci-fi adventure game set in an alternate version of the 1980s. You start the game as The Girl who is on the run from The Company - the organization that created her and trained her. As she tries to survive while being hunted across dimensions, you'll unravel the story of how she ended up in this life-threatening situation.

Through the experiences of three different characters, you'll be immersed in a dramatic and atmospheric story-driven adventure. The game is filled with visual storytelling, challenging you with item-based puzzles that require lateral thinking, stealth mechanics to evade your foes, and traversal mechanics that give you the freedom to explore your environment.

Experience a gritty and tense world where danger lurks around every corner. Will you be able to escape The Company and uncover the truth of what happened? Play Glimpse to find out.

2330140.name: Run On Home
2330140.about_the_game: Can you get this guy home safely after his Uber left him stranded in Murder City? This short story of horror and survival will have you shaking in your boots as you race your way home without getting caught by an evil Demon. Everything in this world wants this guy dead and it's up to you to help him reach his destination. In this game the player has to use their platforming skills to get this random guy home. You'll come across puzzles/obstacles, and hostiles that want to put you in the dirt. On top of all of that, the player must avoid capture from a demon named Blamo. There are many paths to the end and a total of 4 different endings.

2330160.name: One More Try
2330160.about_the_game:
One More Try is a turn-based roguelike game in which your deck consists of poker chips!

Each chip represents a separate action. These chips can increase or decrease the card values, change suits from one to another, and much more. Upgrade your deck and collect new, stronger chips with unique abilities to create a unique combination.

FEATURES:

- Poker chips with different properties

- Hero leveling system

- Many unique relics

- Heroes with special strikes
2330160.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Italian, Korean, Polish, Turkish, Japanese

2330190.name: Chests, City, Clicker
2330190.about_the_game:
Chests, City, Clicker allows you to open chests, build a city and click.
What more do you need?
Probably a second monitor so as not to get bored.

In this game, you can build and upgrade more buildings to expand your city!
There are no wrong decisions, whatever you do - you will get even richer!
Don't wait, just click!

The game includes:
- 17 characters with their own short story
- 4 buildings
- Shop with changing offers
- Chests everywhere (instant gratification)
- Scalable quests

If you have nothing to do with your time, this is the perfect game for you!
