2330210.name: Labrys
2330210.about_the_game:
Labrys is a multiplayer (up to 5v1) horror game where one player becomes the minotaur against the human prisoners, trying to escape the randomly generated labyrinth.

Humans can equip perks and find various equipment to aid them escaping the labyrinth.

The minotaur has access to various abilities and augmentations to upgrade his abilities.




• Be The Beast
You have the opportunity to play as the mighty minotaur, a fearsome creature with great strength and cunning. Kill the humans as they try to escape the labyrinth, using your superior senses and abilities to hunt them one by one.

Smash through walls and use your abilities to corner your prey. You are the ultimate predator, embrace the power of the minotaur and let the hunt begin!



• The Ultimate Test Of Survival
As a human prisoner, your only goal is to escape the labyrinth before its sealed permanently. Use wits, equipments, agility and the environment to evade the minotaur's wrath. Team with other humans using the voice chat or be selfish to survive. Will you be able to outsmart the minotaur and escape the labyrinth?

• Face The Unknown
In Labrys the labyrinth is randomly generated meaning every game is a unique and an unpredictable experience, keeping you on the edge of your seat every time.



• Single player and Co-op mode
Play versus Minotaur AI alone or with your friends!

• Level Progression System and Character Customization
Unlock perks and augmentations and character customization options.
2330210.supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese

2330250.name: MemoryWonderland:Bond
2330250.about_the_game:
Story background:

The departed always leave behind their unfulfilled wishes, while the living always pray for their peace. Even when separated by two worlds, are they willing to cut off this bond?
Why not transform into a butterfly and enter the world of death, to see each other's memories of the heart and to see if the bond that you both think cannot be cut off is really as firm as you think in your heart?
Realm of Memories, a journey of death game. Are you... ready?
by Alice


Game Features:

Maze exploration:
In the game, players will enter various well-designed mazes, and must carefully observe, solve puzzles, crack mechanisms, and engage in strategic battles with monsters in order to gradually explore the secrets of the maze and find a way out.


Strategic puzzle solving:
In the game, players must make use of the costumes and skills they have collected, combined with the different maze puzzles or monster abilities, in order to solve problems successfully. This requires players to have strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, challenging themselves and improving their gaming level.


Rich collection elements:
Players can collect various elements, including cards, memory fragments, costumes, scene scrolls, and tree spirits, each of which will provide certain help to the protagonist in the maze exploration. Collecting all these elements not only helps players to better understand the game world, but also makes their gaming experience richer and more colorful.


Unique narrative approach:
The game's story is not only guided by the main storyline, but also includes memory fragments discovered in the maze. These fragments are presented to the player in the form of black and white animations, gradually revealing the story of the game. By collecting memory fragments, players will better understand the game background and characters, making the game more rich and interesting.

2330260.name: CORR
2330260.about_the_game:
CORR is a CHALLENGING Souls-lite Boss Rush Action RPG where you Run-n-Gun & Hack-n-Dash your way through formidable boss encounters. To endure the strange, dark, and bizarre world of CORR, level up and customize your warrior build with berserk powers, tonics, talismans, and more.

COMBAT:

  • I-frame dashes.
  • Stamina/energy management.
  • Visceral melee & gunplay combat.

BOSS FIGHTS:

  • Be prepared to face CORR's vast roster of challenging multi-phase boss encounters.
  • Non-linear progression. Stuck on a boss fight? Try another for a while.
  • Tired of not being able to replay a boss fight you enjoyed? In CORR, all boss fights can be replayed through memory shards.

CHARACTER PROGRESSION:

  • Acquire talismans to customize your character build with passive abilities.
  • Acquire unique berserk powers that can be activated during combat.
  • Collect ingredients and brew your own consumables.
  • Obtain hexes that increase the game's difficulty in unique ways in order to challenge yourself and obtain unique rewards.
  • Level up your character's stats.

STORY:

  • Piece together the events of the stagnant world by interpreting item descriptions, cryptic character dialogue, environmental storytelling, and more.
  • Includes branching NPC questlines.
2330260.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Ukrainian

2330270.name: Mission: Diamond Back
2330270.about_the_game:
Mission: Diamond Back is a first-person adventure game. A security breach have occurred in one of Diamond Back's Research Units, the soldiers that have been sent are either dead or disappeared. As a last resort, a special trooper shall find the source and dangers caused by the breach.

  • Find clues of what happened
  • Overcome the obstacles that might occur
  • Survive the hostile environment




The features of the game include :



Different enemy types :
The security breach has brought mutations to the environment. Be aware of the small (or big) dangers surrounding you!




Weapons: use different weapon types to advance further into the mission.

2330290.name: Socket Fighters
2330290.about_the_game:
We are looking for help and a community for our new project:


Prepare to compete in the ultimate battle of home appliances! Socket Fighters is a 2D fighting game in which you can play against a friend or a bot in a one-on-one match. You can select your preferred appliance from a list that includes a washing machine, television, toaster, blender, vacuum cleaner, and more!

You can utilize basic strikes like kicks and punches in Socket Fighters, as well as five unique special attacks for each appliance. The washing machine, for example, can spit forth a sock, the television can fire a rainbow, the toaster can spew toast, and so on.

The game takes place in a domestic setting, with battles taking place in a variety of areas such as the kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hallway, and basement. Each chamber has its own collection of active elements that you can use during a fight. You can, for example, destroy a cabinet to discover a concealed weapon or hurl a chair at your opponent to deal extra damage. Other ways to engage with the environment include throwing a knife into a fan to create a hazard.

In Socket Fighters, prepare to rule the domestic arena. Will you be crowned the ultimate household champion?

2330300.name: Ecstatic
2330300.about_the_game:
Control a disposable spider mech that shoots rockets out of its butt and decimate waves upon waves of drones synced to rave music, while also slowing down time whenever you stop moving. Pick up power-ups strategically and weave your way around enemies to make it to the end of the track!

Ecstatic is a unique experimental bullet-hell that promises tight action, fast choices, and sick tunes.

The game features 4 different difficulties, a slew of challenges, and includes a level editor that lets you use your own music tracks!
2330300.reviews:
“Unlike other retro shooting games, Ecstatic is a challenge where the long game matters. You need to carefully manage your ammo and work on developing your abilities if you are to go the distance.”
Family Gaming Database

2330310.name: Bent Oak Island
2330310.about_the_game:
Twins Archer and Sam just want to relax after getting shipped off to stay with their eccentric uncle for the summer. Too bad for them the world is ending, and only they can stop it! The genre is point and click adventure, similar to the PC classics from the 80s and 90s! Keep reading for more info about the game's features and content!

Bent Oak Island was once a bustling tourist hot spot, until a fire burned through the town square and turned everything to cinders. With the destruction of the town center, tourism dried up, and with it the main source of income for the island. Now 15 years later, the island has moved on, but is a shell of it's former self. The future of the island seems bleak, and to make matters worse, an air of dread has settled on the islanders. Ned at the diner is barely able to make ends meet after the paper factory shut its doors. The Captain swears the fish he catches are talking about him behind his back. A strange, hairy creature has been sighted stalking through the forests of the nature preserve. And Ted from the University on the mainland has measured the beginnings of disturbing tectonic activity- vibrations in the ground. The same activity that happened 15 years ago on the night of the fire.

Will Archer and Sam unravel the secrets of Bent Oak Island in time to save themselves from certain doom? Will Uncle finally be able to muster up the courage to ask out the head librarian? Will the pie shop ever actually have any pie in stock for people to eat? Find out the answers to these burning questions and much more by playing the game!

-Bent Oak Island follows the gameplay of classic point-and-click adventure games. In each scene there will be things to look at and interact with, items to collect, NPCs to talk to, and puzzles to solve.

-Gorgeous hand created pixel art, somewhere between NES and SNES graphics. (Game does NOT use AI!)

-Explore the island with main characters Archer and Sam, twins who get wrapped up in the island’s mysteries.

-A fully fleshed out world with deep lore that the player learns throughout the game. What starts out as a simple adventure turns into something much wilder and weirder!

-100+ different scenes with locations ranging from mountain peaks, to underground lakes, from abandoned factories, to townie bars!

-Two main endings, with a third secret ending that requires numerous optional puzzles to be completed.

TLDR:

Bent Oak Island is a point and click adventure game. It is a full, stand alone-game that tells the story of twins Archer and Sam on their summer vacation. It features puzzles, inventory items, fun characters and loads of dialogue.

2330320.name: Aqua Marbles - Ocean
2330320.about_the_game:
Deep in the abyss of the ocean lies an underwater kingdom full of color and joy. Dive into a submarine atmosphere complete with colorful graphics and exciting music, but keep an eye out! In the deepest darkest corners lie sunken ships and castles full of danger. Test your courage, complete tough but exciting levels and come back to the sunlight! Check out match-3 from a fresh perspective: increased difficulty and a new game element – petals.

Features:

* 135 challenging underwater levels
* Use a variety of strategies to win
* Colorful ocean worlds to explore
* Relaxing and atmospheric music
* Play with no time limits

2330360.name: Pixel Art Academy: Learn Mode
2330360.about_the_game:
Pixel Art Academy is an educational game for learning how to draw. In Learn Mode, you jump straight into the game's interactive tutorials for the fastest way of becoming a pixel artist. After you learn the rules behind pixel art lines, test your skills by drawing fan art and unleash your creativity with designing and illustrating your own pinball machine.



Please note that during Early Access the game does not cover all areas of art yet!

The game's content is organized around the 7 elements of art: line, shape, form, space, value, color, and texture. The current version only covers lines with about 2–3 hours of gameplay for a minimal playthrough (more if you complete all the challenges and put extra effort into game projects). The other 6 elements are planned to be developed during Early Access.

Features


  • An immersive user interface with a cozy, relaxing atmosphere.



  • Carefully designed interactive tutorials teach how to use drawing tools, followed by intermediate lessons covering pixel art fundamentals with a focus on line art and jaggies.



  • Put theory into practice with drawing challenges where you copy other indie game sprites or draw fan art from reference.



  • Design video game sprites as you customize the game Snake and create your very own pinball machine. Of course, you get to play the games as well!



  • Get in the groove with more than 6 hours of background music to accompany your drawing sessions.

Future development

Please keep in mind that the game is designed, drawn, and coded by a single person—me! I also have to run the business side of things, do marketing, and organize collaborations with other artists, all of which take time. Expect slow, but steady progress. I have been working on the bigger Pixel Art Academy universe for 9 years now and I don't intend to stop any time soon.

I also keep a completely transparent development process. Visit my YouTube channel for frequent devlogs or catch me anywhere on the internet to chat about current progress.
2330360.reviews:
“Pixel Art Academy is really something else. Originally created as an RPG-style experience that allows you to learn as you play, the upcoming Learn Mode strips it back to a beautifully crafted course in pixel art skills. Essential.”
Debug Magazine

“Learning anything, be it an art, a craft or a new language, can be overwhelming for anyone, but Pixel Art Academy: Learn Mode has managed to make that process very relaxing and satisfying.”
The Art of Gaming

“It is clear that the developer has thoroughly understood the theory and is a very good pixel artist, but it is also clear that he knows how to convey his knowledge very well, with concrete examples and detailed but not tedious explanations.”
ErreKGamer

2330380.name: Golf VS Zombies
2330380.about_the_game:
Play alone, play with friends!

Frenemies. We mean frenemies. There are no friends in the post-apocalyptic, living dead-infested wasteland. So you might want to take your club, hit those courses, collect bottlecaps (what other currency did you expect? rupees?), and drive your golf cart through crowds of zombies for fun and profit. OR! Or you can invite up to 3 more people to a hilarious hot-seat golfing duel, treuel, or even quadruel, where survival is optional, but fun is unavoidable.

Swing easy and carry a big club

There is only so far your collection of clubs and balls gonna get you. Luckily, or not so, that weird guy has also survived and he has been tinkering on all sorts of things. Exploding and homing balls, sniper clubs™, drones, movement detectors and other wacky stuff. Too bad the guy accepts only bottle-caps as legal tender, but you are bound to find some - this is a wasteland afterall.

Bring your A-game

Up till now you had to deal with sand traps, tall grass, pools of water and that bloody wind, but times have changed and repeating a shot may be the least of your worries. Keep your head in the game and the dead… well dead - there is a record to set. Even better if you manage to grab some loot along the course.

2330400.name: I Have No Nose and I Must Climb
2330400.about_the_game:
I Have No Nose and I Must Climb is a 2D Precision Platformer where you use the control sticks to operate a pair of hands to overcome various platforming challenges. Reach the top to of the world to help Wally retrieve their nose!

Sling from walls and ledges to maneuver around different obstacles, Throw out a Thumbs up to pass through special barriers or fly high into the air off a bouncy mushroom.

Inspired by titles like Getting over it with Bennet Foddy, Jump King, and Pogostuck.

2330410.name: Vom Drachentöten
2330410.about_the_game:
"Salutatio, Fremde!"
"Ihr habt erreicht uns're Oase."

Worum es geht


In der drückenden Wüstenhitze des Protektorats ziehen Drei aus, einen Drachen zu töten:
Nare Nivadh. Illum. Lambda des Morgens Rot. Ein jeder trägt eine eigene Motivation, eigene Erfahrungen, einen eigenen Konflikt in seinem Inneren. Und auch das Land selbst rumort unter der Tyrannei des Wurms ... Wissen, Waffen, Fertigkeiten: Nun gilt es, die Kraft zu finden, vor der sich selbst ein Drache beugt!

Wie es sich spielt


Ein textlastiges JRPG, reduziert auf seinen Kern.

  • Eine runde Geschichte. Etwa 4 Stunden, ganz ohne Sammelquests oder Grinding.
  • Erkundung mit Charakter. Eine lebendige Oase voller Geschichten. Ein ruiniertes Land uralter Geheimnisse, die es zu lüften gilt.
  • Fordernde Kämpfe. Jeder Charakter hat seine Rolle. Jede Aktion und jeder Erfahrungspunkt können entscheiden.
  • Taktik mit Effekt. Eine überschaubare Selektion an Fähigkeiten und Gegenständen, die es zu meistern gilt.
  • Konsequenzen. Jedes Risiko birgt Möglichkeiten ... und Gefahren!

Wie es entstanden ist


Dieses Erstlingswerk ist auch ein Experiment: Gelingt es, ein stilvolles, einnehmendes Rollenspiel nur mit den Ressourcen des RPG Maker MZ zu erschaffen? Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, versucht sich das Spiel an einer ungewöhnlichen Sprache, inspiriert von den Dramen der Weimarer Klassik.

This game is only available in German, for now.

2330430.name: Looney Tunes: Wacky World of Sports
2330430.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Wacky World of Sports

Play against your friends featuring 4 classic sports: Basketball, Soccer, Golf and Tennis. Avoid the wacky obstacles and gain power-ups to incite chaos against your friends and family as you control your favorite Looney Tunes character. Play your way in this 4-player local co-op sports arcade game and choose the character that best suits your play style.

Key Game Features:

• Compete in 4 iconic sports: 2v2 arcade basketball, 1v1 or 2v2 arcade Tennis, 4-player golf, and 4v4 arcade soccer

• Play as 9 iconic Looney Tunes Characters: including Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Elmer Fudd, Sylvester, Taz, Wile E. Coyote and the Road Runner

• Play Your Way: Speed by with Road Runner, Lola Bunny, or Sylvester; Overpower with brute force as Elmer Fudd, Porky Pig or Taz or outwit your opponents with Wile E. Coyote , Daffy or Bugs Bunny

• Play Against your Friends and Family: In 4-player Local Co-Op

• Experience the Looney Universe: playing across iconic levels such as Galactic Outpost Delta, Porky’s Barn, Foghorn’s Farm, Road Runner’s Canyon, Whispering Woods, Martian Command Center, Granny’s House, and many more!

• Unleash the full arsenal of ACME: and disrupt your opponents in the wackiest way possible, but watch out for falling anvils!

2330440.name: Heck City Delivery
2330440.about_the_game:
Overview:


Enter the world of Heck City, 20XX. As a delivery goblin, you'll dash through the city and surrounding wastelands, delivering food to the diverse inhabitants of the world. Blood powers technology and demons walk the earth, yet your hustle is eternal.

Surviving in Heck City will take quick wits and a strong work ethic. Will you rise to the top of the food chain, or will the city claim your soul too?

Key Features:


  • A fast-paced, high-octane experience inspired by classic arcade games like Crazy Taxi
  • A vibrant and diverse world to explore, filled with all sorts of colorful characters and wacky surprises
  • A cast of quirky and demanding customers, each with their own unique needs and preferences
  • A blood-powered car that lets you plow through obstacles and enemies alike, with bonus rewards for expert driving and zombie-smashing.
  • Groove to an upbeat, infectious soundtrack that will keep you engaged and energized.

2330490.name: FLIES FLIES FLIES
2330490.about_the_game:
An episodic, queer, sci-fi comedy visual novel

One day, before he can even graduate high school, Finn Flynn wakes up in the body of a housefly. Without the use of his voice, he'll have to enlist his prankster ex-boyfriend, and his dads, an insectophobic mad scientist and a punk rocker, to solve the mystery of his transformation, and maybe get his life back?

FLIES FLIES FLIES will contain 6 episodes of roughly 25 minutes' playtime each. 3 episodes are currently available, and the rest will be released as free updates as they are developed.

FLIES FLIES FLIES is a linear, scripted experience. There are no player choices, alternate endings, etc.

Features

  • Dark sci-fi comedy story full of twists and turns

  • A diverse cast of lovable oddballs

  • Eclectic collage art style

  • Fully voice-acted with subtitles

  • Sound captions

  • You'll laugh

  • You'll cry

  • You'll turn into a fly??

  • Just kidding

  • But only about that last one

2330500.name: BETON BRUTAL
2330500.about_the_game:
Climb the tower

BETON BRUTAL is a first person parkour game which tries to replicate and build upon the parkour mechanics seen in Minecraft.
Your goal is to climb a massive overgrown concrete tower which offers multiple stages of increasing difficulty.

Watch your step

Beware, a single misstep might cost you a lot of progress as there are no checkpoints whatsoever.
The course is however riddled with shortcuts which, when spotted, can save a lot of time and frustration.

Vertigo

If things get too stressful feel free to rest for a moment and take in your surroundings, just make sure to not peek over the edge too much.

2330520.name: Echoes of Somewhere: Series 1
2330520.about_the_game:
It is the year 2042, all of the human work has been replaced by AI powered robots. It is punishable by law for a human to perform ANY work.

The hard core criminal underworld is bustling with gangs and criminals selling illegal pastries, dressing hair in high security basement-salons and stealthy ninjas cleaning streets in the dark of the night.

Meanwhile, the upper echelon of people are imprisoned in their golden cages, unable to escape their lives of excess and absolute safety.

Echoes of Somewhere is a free, experimental 2.5D point and click adventure game developed by a group of game industry veterans on their free time.

The project relies heavily on AI generated content and as such is an experiment in itself. The development progress is documented on the game's website. For good or for worse.

2330550.name: Bridge to Another World: Cursed Clouds
2330550.about_the_game:
Welcome to Celestis, a breathtaking city of floating islands, friendly talking animals, tons of natural beauty, scenic vistas, and curious local characters. Unfortunately, your visit comes at a time when the local attractions also include a devastating curse, cluster earthquakes, and a massive, destructive serpent!
Your arrival, of course, was somewhat mysterious itself, and you may find that much about this world feels oddly familiar, but you’ll surely catch on quickly with the helpful fox as your guide! After all, it’s up to you to unravel a great mystery and save the city in the sky in this all-new Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

• Search tons of breathtaking hidden-object scenes!
• Beautiful original artwork!
• Explore a world of mystery and surprises!
• Gorgeous soundtrack!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

2330570.name: Camplandia
2330570.about_the_game:
Build a thriving summer camp.

Welcome to Camplandia! In this charming 2D build-em-up, you're tasked with creating and managing your very own summer camp. From designing cozy cabins to planning exciting activities, every decision you make shapes the success and reputation of your camp.

Keep your campers happy and healthy.

Start by constructing essential facilities. The campers are going to need beds to sleep in, showers to stay clean, and a cafeteria to keep their bellies full. But meeting their basic needs is just the beginning. Organize fun activities to keep your campers entertained like fishing, kayaking, and campfires. Hire staff to handle cooking, cleaning, and keep everything running smoothly.

Bring your dream summer camp to life.

Provide unforgettable experiences to earn glowing reviews and grow your camp. Whether you build by the beach, deep in the forest, or atop a snowy mountain, unlock new technologies and customize every detail to reflect your vision.

Will you build a summer camp paradise… or end up with a bug-infested disaster?

2330600.name: Veni, Vidi, Vici
2330600.about_the_game:
Enter the Land of Ardera

Play as Delphine as she tries to piece together her memories and figure out what happened to the Arderan people.

Borrow power from strange creatures and dance your way to victory

Engage Tenants in rhythm-based dance battles to rid them of corruption and gain their trust. Switch between unlocked tenants on the fly to develop your own mixture of dance styles.

2330640.name: Tiny Tied
2330640.about_the_game:
TINY TIED - A world where every action has consequences.


Have you ever wondered why in every RPG game...

  • You are always seen as the main character of the game, without anyone questioning it?
  • Everyone is so nice to you, the protagonist, even if you go on a killing streak or break into random peoples houses and steal their stuff?
  • You are treated as a hero, without doing anything heroic yet... or without doing anything at all?


In the world of Tiny Tied, these questions will be reflected.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

In this tiny adventure you'll play as a little fox girl called Mi.

A narrator will guide you through your journey and explain your surroundings and interactions. Don't worry, he won't judge your actions... at most he will only question it.

On your journey, you will encounter several creatures in a turn based, bullet hell like combat. But with the right interactions, you can increase their MOOD so that they eventually stop fighting you.

Here, the outcome of every combat encounter is up to you, whether you kill the enemy or befriend them through interactions... or just ignore them completely.

But whatever you do, remember...



every action has consequences.

2330660.name: Twin Stick Heroes 2
2330660.about_the_game:
Twin Stick Heroes 2 is a top down arena shooter.  Choose from a diverse cast of heroes, and engage in epic battles across a galaxy of exotic planets. This time with new gameplay options an array of new heroes to master, and balance improvements for fair and thrilling combat. Twin Stick Heroes 2 is the sequel you've been waiting for. Are you ready to prove your skills and conquer the cosmos?

             Join the fight today! 

                                        WELCOME TO TWIN STICK COMBAT

At its core Twin Stick Heroes 2 is a hilarious and intense 1-4 player party game. The "heroes" cater towards very different playstyles, learning which one suites you best is key. Combat can seem wild and unpredictable with everchanging items and stages, but mastering your hero will carry you through to the end.

CHOOSE YOUR HERO

  • A VIBRANT CAST OF 27 HEROS! Every hero in the game has specific strengths and weaknesses, learning to master their weapon and abilities
    is key to victory.

  • MASTERY SYSTEM! Play against your friends to unlock new stages and heroes', or go it alone against bosses to unlock their mastery skin and furnish your home

  • ITEMS ARE COMING OUT OF MY EARS! Make use of the weird items and wield abilities never before seen, such as the timeline changing
    save state, or the black hole which is so powerful it may eat everyone on stage!

  • WATCH THE SKIES! A new weather mode can be enabled to unleash even more havoc in the match! Don't let the wind blow you away, and make sure to keep your eyes to the sky and nab items with the item shower.

Say hello to a new and improved cast of "heroes". Take on your foes as the otherworldly Hunam, showcasing inhuman sniping skills. Defend your position like a pro with the dependable Camper, or dispense unrelenting justice as the battle-hardened Veteran. Or pull out all the stops with the evil mind manipulator himself Dr Brain and his sinister goons!

A TRUE PIXEL ART EXPERIENCE

Art was inspired from the likes of older snes games such as Earthbound and FZERO, mixed with a healthy dose of Saturday morning cartoons such as Beavis and Butthead and King of the Hill.

Fight on the labyrinthine surface of Gord City, whose asphalt paved roads and buildings make for a unique experience, or journey across the coliseum which is littered with the megalithic remains of a once mighty civilization.

SINGLE PLAYER!

  • Defeat evil bosses which vary from a fungal infection to a gangster mob

  • Hero masteries that unlock costumes which carry over into multiplayer

  • Unlock new furniture for your home in the single player mode

KEY FEATURES

  • local multiplayer, and online multiplayer with Steam remote play

  • A new and improved single player experience

  • 27 Heroes to choose from

  • Mastery system and tons of unlocks to discover

  • Items galore

  • Tons of handcrafted stages to fight on

  • Cartoony snes inspired pixel art

2330700.name: VICO 3: TALE OF THE SEVEN SEAS
2330700.about_the_game:
VICO 3: Tale of the Seven Seas is an ARCADE game that revolves around "Spherical Game-play". What makes "VICO" different from other Spherical games, is the ability to see through the WATER. This adds an extra level of depth to the game, making "VICO" a truly unique Game-play experience.

Each level gets harder and harder. In order to collect the most amount of points you need to save all three of VICO's children. Each child that is saved earns you a 1,000 points.

[FEATURES]

- Unique Gameplay

- 7 unique worlds

- Numerous enemies

- A fun and exciting Soundtrack

2330720.name: ChipWits
2330720.about_the_game:
Program a robot to solve logic puzzles in ChipWits, an open-ended programming game for beginners and experts alike! Inspired by the 1980s original, ChipWits combines the best of puzzle games, automation, and programming to introduce a new generation of players to a classic gaming experience.

Take control of a humble robot, ChipWit Model CW-03.24, and learn the ropes of automating its activities. Place chips to instruct your ChipWit’s movement across the factory floor, building on skills learned in previous areas to solve increasingly complex puzzles to help Professor Chip open his first factory. Order these chips to find a solution to each floor, then press play to watch your ChipWit accomplish its goal!

ChipWits is designed to mimic programming, with no prior experience required. Each puzzle has multiple solutions and can be resolved in unique and clever ways. Experiment with different chip combinations to achieve your goal, and see how your performance compares to the global leaderboard! 

Every solution can be optimized to:

• Maximize your score

• Minimize the number of chips used

• Minimize the number of cycles (steps) it takes for your program to run

ChipWits reimagines the original 1984 game of the same name. This reboot offers an accessible introduction to programming, featuring thorough tutorials, familiar automation controls, and a diverse range of puzzle solutions.

Join our Discord community (link in the sidebar) to learn how to become a beta tester, connect with fellow players, share tips, and stay updated on the latest game news and events.

2330740.name: Royal Razzle
2330740.about_the_game:
Royal Razzle

Embark on a sugary quest with Royal Razzle, the latest addition to the world of hyper-casual gaming brought to you by Radioactive Bullfrog Entertainment!

Join Princess Sammi-chan in the magical kingdom filled with colorful candies. Your goal is to match and collect as many sweets as you can, while helping the Princess on her journey home to the castle. With its endearing and cheerful graphics, Royal Razzle is guaranteed to put a smile on your face.

This tile-matching adventure features a hundred levels, each designed to challenge your matching skills and provide hours of entertainment. Whether you're a fan of casual games or just looking for a fun and easy way to pass the time, Royal Razzle is the perfect choice for you.

With its intuitive gameplay, charming character, and addictive puzzle mechanics, Royal Razzle is an experience that will keep you craving for more. So ready your sweet tooth and join the Royal Razzle community, where sweet victory and endless fun await!

2330750.name: Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead
2330750.about_the_game:
An apocalyptic cataclysm has happened… more precisely, all of them did, all at once. Within the last few years, riots and wars shook the Earth, devastating its population, and finally, the grid has completely collapsed. As if that weren't enough, there are zombies?! Evil mushrooms!? Giant hornets?! You'll need to make the best of things and figure out a way to survive. In this expansive survival RPG, you'll have to find or craft tools, kill monsters, gather allies, build your home base, grow crops, and survive a world that grows ever harsher around you. Find a working vehicle and use that to explore the wasteland of New England! Who was the mysterious "XEDRA" that left artifacts around the dying world, and how are they connected to the cataclysm?

Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead is the epitome of a modern roguelike: with turn-based play and a RPG-like skill progression system, it hearkens back to the classics of the genre while building on them in unexpected ways. The depth of this game will surprise you, with a cleverly-designed inventory system, the ability to drive vehicles on land or water, well-written NPCs with their individual stories, and more. The scope of Cataclysm is unparalleled in the genre, thanks to a dedicated community that works to create this game collaboratively, as we have for over ten years.



  • Complex and diverse enemies from ever-mutating legions of the undead, to giant insects, to existential horrors from between worlds.
  • Unparalleled vehicle building and customization system.
  • Immersive, exquisitely detailed crafting system covering everything from smithing and soldering to keeping your sourdough starter fed.
  • Build almost anything you can imagine, from a wattle-and-daub shelter in the woods to a tower of reinforced concrete and living alien resin.
  • Populate your base with NPC allies that help you craft and keep you company.
  • Explore one of the most detailed and immersive skill and proficiency systems in any RPG.
  • Ever expanding content, with new major updates released regularly.
  • Challenging, rewarding game balance that forces you to evaluate every step, or pay the price. You'll soon see why most of the world's population is dead!



  • …want to feel like you might actually be able to survive against an incredibly harsh and unforgiving apocalypse.
  • …have ever wandered through a hardware store thinking "This would be a great place to hole up when the zombies come."
  • …love survival RPGs but get frustrated when you can't hotwire one of the nearby broken-down cars, weld a makeshift ram to the front, and plow it through the gates of the next story-important area.
  • …enjoy detailed simulation-style games, but also want to mutate into a bizarre cat-girl slime mold creature with a cybernetic gun arm in one.



What do you get for purchasing the Steam Edition of CDDA?
  • Steam cloud support for save games.
  • Graphical achievements.
  • A chance to help the CleverRaven team in supporting one of our long-term developers, working on one of the best open-source games on the internet.
  • More planned… check back soon!

2330770.name: Flowball
2330770.about_the_game: Prepare for an unforgettable adventure of precision and memory. Flowball is an ultra-difficult platformer that tests your memory and precision with a ball. To succeed in the game, you must complete all 19 levels in a single session. Good luck and have fun!

2330780.name: Little Elf Tanks
2330780.about_the_game:
Embark on an exciting journey in this thrilling bug blasting adventure! Choose one of four playable characters and join the battle to free your fellow elves from the grasp of a wicked spider army. Each playable character comes with their own set of unique abilities and strengths, giving you the freedom to tackle obstacles in your own way. But beware, your foes won't make your mission easy. In addition to the hoards of gross creepy crawlies, several big boss fights lie in wait to test your skills!

Features:

2330810.name: Alien Frontier
2330810.about_the_game:
Alien Frontier is an open world, third-person shooter roguelite. Explore, search, and mine resources in the deadly alien wilderness... assuming you can survive combat with hordes of bloodthirsty aliens. Collect loot and upgrades to become the most dangerous (and wealthy) prospector in the galaxy!


Grapple, dash, glide, and hover your way through harrowing encounters with the deadly alien fauna. Fight your way through adrenaline-fueled, bullet hell inspired third-person combat that will keep you on the edge of your seat.


With over 100 unique items, upgrades, and abilities, each run is a chance to discover and combine loot in creative and unexpected ways, allowing you to unleash devastating power on even the most fearsome of aliens.


As an interstellar prospector, you don't just explore a vast open world, but you change it. From constructing tunnels deep into mountains to setting up massive mining rigs on the surface, every structure you build transforms the landscape and rewards you with valuable upgrades and equipment.


Use your jetpack, thrusters, and hoverboard to explore procedural open worlds where there are no minimaps to guide you. Read the landscape and explore every corner of the world to uncover the mystery of the strange alien planet.

Collect cards to craft the deck of your choice. Start from a few basic trap cards, and expand to a versatile deck that could stop a variety of enemies in different terrains. Find powerful synergies with over 100 traps and skills, and test your strategy on the field!





Choose your path and encounter curious events that can change the course of your run. Unfold the dark secrets behind the relentless assaults, and study what it takes to become THE Trap Master.

Players can choose the theme that suits them best, in addition to the atmospheric environment, and customize their game experience. The four different theme options within the game provide players with a different atmospheric feel each time they play, offering them a unique experience every time.

If you enjoy puzzle games such as "Hidden Folks" and "A Building Full of Cats," then Zippy Detective: Cats may be the perfect option for you. So come on, find the hidden cats in the city and send them all to space by bringing them to the area in front of the Eiffel Tower!

2331070.name: Vasilisa and Baba Yaga
2331070.about_the_game:
A spooky adventure where Vasilisa's journey and service to Baba Yaga consist of a series of mini-games with a variety of gameplay mechanics.

You will go on a journey with Vasilisa to the land of the dead to obtain the power of fire, which only Baba Yaga can give. Vasilisa already has a magical helper — a doll given by her mother. But this is not enough to deal with the evil stepmother. It is necessary to pass the tests of the mistress of the forbidden forest and prove to her that Vasilisa is worthy to receive the power not only from her mother, but the mother of all mothers — Baba Yaga.

On your way you will encounter:

Сombat missions:

• fight petty evil spirits

• defeat the lord of the river Vodyanoy, lord of the swamp Bolotnik and lord of the forest Leshy (defeat the lords of the river, swamp and forest: Vodyanoy, Bolotnik and Leshy)

• prevail against the cruel stepmother

Household chores

• wash a mountain of dishes

• do a pile of laundry

• tidy up Baba Yaga's hut

• prepare the dough and bake some pirogi

Tasks to test attentiveness

• escape the fog

• successfully leave the forest

• do not get lost in the algae

Tasks to test dexterity

• sneak past a sleeping Vodyanoy without being caught

• creep quietly past Bolotnik without being found

• escape detection by Leshy

• flee From Baba Yaga

• The game is based on unadapted versions of fairytales and folktales with elements of what is perceived in modern culture as horror.

• The narrator reads the tale in a South Russian dialect. The story is told in the same manner as in Russian villages.

• The soundtrack is an original piece based on folk songs from the central and southern parts of Russia.

2331080.name: Taoism

The Luo Nan Kingdom was founded near the Luo River, flourishing for over a hundred years.

One day, a strange plague broke out. The deceased turned into evil spirits, causing further losses. The TianYi Taoism arrived on the scene and started hunting evil spirits, saving people’s lives. In the next 10 years, the TianYi Taoism wielded the scepter and its temples were constructed everywhere in Luo Nan. Still, the competition among various forces, as well as the invasion of evil Taoists and ghosts, had made people's lives very difficult…

In this game, you’ll play as different roles to know their clinging and solve their issues. Meanwhile, you need to clear out the mist to find the secrets hidden under the capital of Luo Nan in the past 10 years.

The Unique Gameplay and Settings

  • The basis of the two core rules of this game is Hunyuan Compass, referring to the original Eight Trigrams circular card field made by China's Fengshui.
  • There will be collisions between Yin and Yang, fulfillment between two sides of Yang. Use this setting to strike a surprise move to score success.
  • The special combat system, Huayuan, can change Yin and Yang. This might give you a chance to snatch a victory out of defeat.
  • Expand and form your card decks as you explore this game. Various creative gameplay and stunning effects will come out of the strategic combos of your cards.

A World with Chinese Traditional Ink Painting Style and Mythical Tales

The game’s worldview is based on the Chinese mythical tales like Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, Stories of Immortals.

Substantial Contents and Game Plots

  • Various different enemies and puissant boss are waiting ahead. Fight against their strange decks of cards and spells, just blaze your trail through them!
  • There’s a mysterious store on your way up. Don’t forget to go in and exchange more types of cards and other powerful gears with the beautiful hostess.
  • Each card that comes with a token forms a part of the protagonist's story, and the mystery will gradually be solved.

The Places Awaiting to Be Explored Along with Adventure Full of Surprising Encounters

  • You’ll be in the Luo Nan Kingdom where is shrouded with mist. Just travel freely and move towards the truth in this dangerous and mysterious land.
  • You’ll face different choices on different roads. Every round of game will start a new exploring direction that fills your journey with surprises and unknown.
  • In certain areas, you might receive some special gears and encounter some fortuitous incidents.

Currently, the game is in its rapid development. We would love to hear your advices on our work!

No Crime is a suspense puzzle game. The story takes place in a Chinatown in a country in South East Asia. Start from a drug case, follow private detective Sui Feng to discover a mysterious complexion full of conspiracy, overcome his intermittent amnesia, and avenge for his love…Can you find out the real culprit through fragments of memories?

2331130.name: Just Another Night Shift
2331130.about_the_game:
Just Another Night Shift is a casual competitive 1v1 and 2v2 PvP multiplayer online game.

You get to play as a security guard and a thief. The Thief’s objective is to steal a specific item from the mansion, while the Guard tries to stop him. Join us for hours of fun gameplay with your friends!

Basics Of the Game

  • The winner of the game is whoever wins the set amount of rounds first.

  • Players switch sides at the middle of the game.

  • Both characters have strengths and weaknesses, and a special ability.

  • The Guard has additional tasks. If he fails to do the tasks on time, the Thief will win the round.

Sneak into the mansion and steal the valuable! Buy useful items from the black market, use the Thiefs agility and special hiding ability to avoid the Guard and win the game.

Guard the mansion and catch the Thief! Use the dog or the cameras to gain advantage over the Thief. Remember to do the tasks, light the shadows with the flashlight and buy helpful items from the security shop.


Try your skills at a more compact modern mansion or jump to an old castle like mansion with room to play! Find the best strategies and routes on both maps and see who will be victorious! 

Attention!

The game works using a peer-to-peer (P2P) system. Player 1 works as a server and the player 2 as a client. Over long distances between these two you may expect high latency and problems in the game.

2331150.name: Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey
2331150.about_the_game:
Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is a vast and intricate multiplayer game that takes players on an unforgettable journey through a captivating world filled with magic, mystery, and adventure.

At the start of the game, players create their own unique character, selecting from a range of classes including warrior, ranger, and mage. Each class offers a different play style and set of abilities, allowing players to tailor their character to their own preferences and play style.

Once players have created their character, they are free to explore the world of Legendary Realms, taking on quests and challenges as they go. Quests can range from simple tasks like delivering items or defeating low-level enemies, to more complex missions that require strategic thinking and teamwork.

As players progress through the game, they earn rewards and level up, improving their character's stats and unlocking new abilities. They can also purchase equipment from shops and vendors, including weapons, armor, and magical artifacts, which can be used to enhance their combat abilities and increase their chances of success.

One of the key features of Legendary Realms is its multiplayer component. Players can team up with others to take on quests and challenges together, combining their skills and abilities for greater success. Additionally, the game offers a robust social system that allows players to communicate with one another, make friends, and form guilds.

Beyond its engaging gameplay and multiplayer features, Legendary Realms boasts a rich and immersive world that is sure to captivate players. From towering mountains and dense forests to bustling cities and mysterious ruins, the game's world is filled with detail and nuance, making it feel alive and vibrant.

Overall, Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is an incredible adventure that offers endless possibilities for exploration, questing, and combat. Whether you're a fan of fantasy games, multiplayer games, or both, this game is sure to provide hours of entertainment and excitement.

2331160.name: Liber 2: Lost in time

1 Million Zombies is a thrilling and action-packed game that will keep players on the edge of their seats as they battle through waves of the undead. With its stunning graphics, intense gameplay, and challenging difficulty level, 1 Million Zombies is sure to be a hit with fans of the zombie genre.

2331660.name: 词影
2331660.about_the_game:
About this game
A Chinese idiom guessing game that combines pictograms with Wordle guessing.

Players have six chances to guess a four-character idiom (usually a common idiom). After each guess, mark the difference between the answer and the color of the stroke.

If the words and answers are exactly the same, they will be marked with a green background.

If the word is wrong, but the stroke is the same as that of the correct answer, the correct stroke will be displayed in green.

If the word is wrong, the stroke is not exactly the same as that of the correct answer, but it is very similar. This stroke will be displayed in black and gray - the darker the color, the more similar the answer.

Story
It was the third day of the third month of the ninth year of Yonghe, the beginning of spring.
Wang Xizhi, who was then the internal historian of Huiji, invited you and forty-one other literati to gather at the Lanting Pavilion in the shade of the Huiji Mountains to drink wine and make poems.

When the people were drunk on the aroma of wine and poetry, Xie Wan proposed a game to help them enjoy it!
Wang Xizhi clapped his hands and said, "I have an idea for a game called "Chinese Wordle"."

He turned his back on the crowd and wrote some words on the scroll. Then Wang Xizhi turned around and hid the scroll behind him, and he smiled at the crowd and said.
"Gentlemen, it is well known that the beauty of Chinese characters lies in their form. On this scroll, I have written a four-character idiom, you can guess what I have written. It doesn't matter if you get it wrong, I will tell you the resemblance, which is called "Chinese Wordle"."

You can also play this game in WeChay by scanning the QR code!👇👇👇

2331680.name: Mighty Math
2331680.about_the_game:
Choose Your Numbers Carefully



-Collecting as many numbers as possible will maximize your score. Analyze all numbers on the screen to determine the most efficient order to grab as many numbers as possible.

Fast forward to speed up the game or move unwanted numbers out of the way.



-Fast forwarding the game can help speed up the flow of early rounds in repeated runs or speed up your down time between rounds, if you are daring enough..

Use BOMBS to clear all numbers on screen to save yourself from certain death.



-If you are in danger of being hit by a number you don't need and there is nowhere save to move, you can destroy all numbers on the screen by using a bomb. Keep in mind you only have 3 of these. Conserve your ammo...

Think quickly, collect an incorrect number and it is instant game over.



-Remember you have to stay between 0 and 9. You can see your current value by looking at the addition signs filling up the squares on your character cube.

Want to learn even more?



Mighty Math is a mind bending fusion of arcade survival and brain training all in one. Anyone can pick it up and play. It starts with a simple premise, collect a required set of numbers before all numbers run out to survive each round. As you collect numbers you will change the player value. You must maintain a player value between 0 and 9. If you go over or under this value range you will be instantly destroyed.

Although the game starts off with a simple concept, it contains endless rounds and ramps up in difficulty immensely. Survive as long as you can to set high scores to share with your friends!

Enjoy wild randomized runs with varying sets of numbers and traps for a unique experience each run!

Train your brain as you survive the mathematical onslaught in Mighty Math!

Sky Survivors is an arena shooter roguelite. Choose from a variety of skills, unlock unique characters and weapons. Build «stairway to heaven» — a sky tower, each floor of which gives your character a unique bonus. Create your own overpowered build to survive against hordes of monsters!

Over 100 different skills will help you create a unique build every run. You can become an elemental mage, a weapon master, or summon magic books to destroy your enemies.


Each weapon has its own unique playstyle.


  • Bullet Hell — classic «roguelike». Increased speed of monsters and their projectiles. You and the monsters take more damage.
  • Deckbuilder — the number of monsters and the amount of experience gained are increased.
  • Standard Mode — perfect for the first time.


Build a «stairway to heaven» — floors that grants your character a unique permanent bonus or a powerful temporary buff.



  • Auto-aim mode for gamepads and PC.

  • Over 100 different skills to choose from.

  • «Stairway to Heaven» — each floor has its own unique bonuses.

  • Unique weapons that completely change your playstyle.

  • Diverse characters with unique abilities.

  • Multiple game modes allow you to choose the playstyle to your liking.

2331750.name: Neon Music Drums
2331750.about_the_game:
Neon Music Drums is a music rhythm game for virtual reality. Hit the light-up neon drum at the right moment in rhythm to the music. Play with over 50 built-in songs or with your own personal songs. Collect stars to unlock more songs and beat your personal high score. Thanks to different difficulty settings, Neon Music Drums is the perfect VR game for cozy drum sessions as well as for exciting workouts in a colorful space environment!

Game mechanics

The gameplay of Neon Music Drums is totally simple! Hold the red drumstick in your left hand and the blue drumstick in your right hand. Wait for a drum to light up with an indicator and hit it with the appropriate drumstick at the right moment to match the music. This is the moment when the inner colored circle touches the outer purple circle. The menu also consists of individual drums and can be operated with the drumsticks. No controller buttons are needed.

Over 50 songs included

The game already includes over 50 royalty-free songs. These come from a wide variety of music genres: dance, pop, rock, hip hop, country, house, soul, wave, 80s, dubstep, Christmas songs, drum solo and many more. There is something for everyone! Collect stars with each game to unlock more songs.

Play with your own songs

You can also play Neon Music Drums with your own songs. To do this, copy your own songs as mp3 files to the music folder on your computer (Windows only) and load the songs from the menu. Up to 128 songs can be loaded simultaneously.

Five different drum sets

The game contains five different drum sets. From a small six-piece drum set that can be played standing up, to a circular drum set that requires you to turn your head, to a large 15-piece drum set that requires constant movement.

High score and different levels of difficulty

Play the perfect game and beat your high score. The game contains three different difficulty levels ('easy', 'medium', 'hard'). In addition, you can also play in crazy 'wild' mode or without sound.

Share your performance

Share your performance videos using the hashtag #NeonMusicDrums. We look forward to your videos!


Photosensitive Warning

This game contains flashes of light that could trigger seizures for people with visual sensitivities!

Take a break if you feel uncomfortable or recognize any symptoms of motion sickness, simulator sickness or eye strain!

About the developers

We are zefwih, a small development studio from Germany. Even if we can't keep up with the big providers, we develop all our games with attention to detail and great care. If you have any suggestions, problems, praise or feedback, please contact us!

2331780.name: Push battle Royale
2331780.about_the_game:
Push battle Royal is a battle royale game that challenges players to survive and eliminate other players while navigating through shrinking zones on a hostile island. In this game, the primary goal is to stay alive and be the last person or team standing.


Players can use a wide range of weapons, gear, and tactics to outsmart and overpower their opponents.

2331810.name: Shattered: Wasteland Dominion
2331810.about_the_game:
In the year 2079, the United States crumbled under the weight of climate catastrophe, resource wars, and political collapse. Once a beacon of prosperity, it has now become a desolate wasteland where survival is the only law. The remnants of humanity form factions, each vying for dominance over what little remains—water, power, food, and fuel. Amidst this chaos, whispers speak of a hidden paradise, a land untouched by ruin known only as Elysium. Many believe it to be a myth, while others would kill for even the slightest clue to its location.

Survival Mechanics

  • Players must manage hunger, thirst, and stamina while scavenging for resources.

  • Build and upgrade shelters, craft weapons, and forge alliances or rivalries with other survivors.

Factions and Politics

  • Players can choose to ally with a faction for protection, trade, and resources—or remain independent, risking the wrath of all.

  • Dynamic relationships with factions based on player actions, such as sabotage, diplomacy, or infiltration.

Exploration and Combat

  • Explore abandoned cities, hidden bunkers, and underground facilities to uncover valuable loot and clues about Elysium.

  • Face off against raiders, mutated wildlife, and rival players (in multiplayer mode).

Clues to Elysium

  • Scattered across the wasteland are cryptic journals, maps, and old broadcasts hinting at the location of Elysium.

  • Players must decipher these clues while avoiding the attention of factions and others searching for the fabled paradise.

Dynamic Weather and Day/Night Cycle

  • Sandstorms, acid rain, and blizzards challenge players as they traverse the wasteland.

Faction Warfare

  • AI-controlled factions expand their territories, leading to skirmishes and large-scale battles that players can influence.

Base Building

  • Players can establish and fortify a personal base or align with faction strongholds to gain resources and protection.

Multiplayer Options

  • Cooperative or competitive multiplayer modes where players can band together or betray each other for control of resources.

✔️ Influence Wall Street, Main Street, and the working class

👥 Real-Time Multiplayer & Community:
✔️ Play alongside hundreds in a persistent online simulator.
✔️ Engage in alliances, political debates, and backroom deals.
✔️ Impact elections, the judiciary, and corporate power structures.

🔹 Make History or Break It. Will you uphold democracy—or dismantle it?

🌎 Wishlist Battle for the Hill on Steam today!
2331860.reviews:
“Battle for the hill is a great game to get immersed in, from the multi-party system to the bill creation, no matter where you are on the political spectrum you are on there is a party for you. From right wing maga loving gop to far left socialists, you pick a side and go for the throat. Each party has their own discord so you can make friends or enemies or even frenemies. The election system is nice, raising stats, entering primaries, seeing how far you can go to win an election, the outcome is always fascinating. You can run attack ads, campaign for your colleges, change your states positions if you are elected governor, they even have gerrymandering if that is your thing. If you want to experience an exciting yet sometimes frustrating political simulation game battle for the hill is one you should try out. Will you be next? This ad review is brought to you by Yuri, join the socialist today!”
Yuri Cleary

“Battle for the Hill is a video game which is everything BUT a video game. It's a crash course on the real world via the most relevant topic in our lives: Our Government. Much like our real governments, disagreement and depression are the two things that come to mind first. However BFTH manages to circumvent reality and produce a sense of community among "politicians," causing us to think critically about issues we normally would have a safe answer for. In Battle for the Hill, unlike most simulations, the reality of "consequences" heralds players to doom or success. Resource management in cash or having to actually manage a group of people...your actions can have severe repercussions on hundreds of people and they develop situations you have to respond to. In BFTH you can be a Senator, Governor, Congress person, Party political figure such as Chair, President, SCOTUS, Cabinet, and else. There's always room for opportunity and a broom for the inactive; to be replaced by you...potentially vibrant and ambitious enough to make it to the top. BFTH isn't fun because it's a video game. It's entertaining because it's a community; Since the game has negative and positive implications for your behavior, your actions, and your decisions... BFTH becomes a real simulation. There is no total failure, but no total victory either. Everything is a perspective, and if you enjoy the realism of a world which makes you contemplate and consider the consequentialism of a "world," You'll learn more about politics here than you would from an 80 year old socialist professor at Harvard.”
James Ernest

2331870.name: Hibernation Day
2331870.about_the_game:
Hibernation Day is about family and the problems we face trying to keep it afloat. Our small team combined life experiences to compose a new-year-esk story you can relate to and spiced it up with some humor, so you wouldn't fall asleep listening to a calming soundtrack. The game features no saves but can be finished in around 20 very satisfying minutes, it's also slightly non-linear – try again and choose differently if you want more of them crisp wintery dialogs.

Story

It is almost the end of Hibernation Day, a holiday of the last day before a long winter slumber. However, the celebration isn't going well and everybody's on edge. Your cool older sister isn't happy to be stuck at home, your silly younger brother is nowhere to be found, and the parents are fighting (as they often do). Help your family get along and find peace in the last day before winter hibernation.

Creators

Developer and game designer: Serezhka Korneevskii
Artist: Nastasia Viatkina
Writer: Aleksandr Korneevskii
You must be aware that this game is our love-child, and if you treat it poorly, you should expect us to visit your parents for the explanations.

2331890.name: Cozy Together ☕
2331890.about_the_game:
Do not purchase in early access if you want a complete experience

It will be rough for a while.

Inspired by Runescape, Brighter Shores, Eldevin and custom rulesets from OSRS youtubers

Cozy together is an social skilling game where even if no one is online, your never alone! Your Runescape Girlfriend will be alongside you, cheering you on as you go on your adventure across the world!

Your goal is to invest with the mayor of your local virtual town, which will unlock new services as you progress, like the ability to ride mounts, register pets and level up your skill tree!  Where once the town is fully upgraded, he will allow you to ride the space elevator to freedom!

But the spirit of this game is always trying to present you with meaningful choices for which grinds to pick and why, so you could for example level / gear up and defeat the champion instead to get awarded the ticket to ride the elevator immediately!

I like to think a lot of the depth of osrs where happy accidents from the bugs in the engine, so I've spent a lot of thought and time and effort trying to maintain the purity of that with stuff like safe spotting and prayer flicking and tick manipulation for combos!

Every area is listed as a chunk, and any adjacent chunk has to be bought before you can access it!  But the price increases for each chunk you buy! 

Each chunk will let you peak before you buy to see a glimpse of what it contains so the choice is not completely blind, but you can only see 1 contained resource for each chunk!

Each chunk has a bulletin board with a list of area quests to unlock (once the service is unlocked from your town) and upon completing a list of area quests, you unlock a relic you can use anywhere (for example the bomb relic will let you blow open cracked walls you find along your adventure)

2331980.name: Unrelaxing Quacks
2331980.about_the_game:
Survivors but fast. Unrelaxing Quacks is not a waiting simulator, it's a fast paced game where you're thrown into the action from the first few seconds. If you kill enemies fast they will spawn faster. Once you get past the tutorial and holy duck and play on real difficulty with corruption enabled, every levelup makes the game more difficult. Every weapon and upgrade you choose scales things further, allowing builds that level up fast to keep the game difficult.

Play as one of the 14 different characters, but beware, most of them only get one life, and once they die you will have to recover their body to play them again.




Multiple game modes allow you to further customize the experience, from faster mode that only lasts 2 minutes, a noob mode for those truly bad at the game, or a corruption mode that increases corruption levels at maximum from the first second of the game.



  • Dynamically increasing difficulty.
  • Corruption system for extra difficult gameplay in lategame.
  • Noob and holy mode for beginners and noobs.
  • 14 playable and unique characters
  • 16 enemy types
  • 33 weapons
  • 6 unique game modes which you can mix and match to alter the experience
  • Large map with different zones, landmarks, teleports and shops


Survive until the timer runs out and escape through the gate to win the game. Every enemy you kill drops experience, with more experience you level up and unlock new weapons and upgrades. During gameplay, you unlock new characters, game modes and achievements, which stays permanently unlocked. There is no other meta progression influencing the game itself, so you better learn the game and the map, and enjoy a true roguelike experience.

2332050.name: As Talk As Walk Wayfarer Team - Land of Music
2332050.about_the_game:
This is an adventure game, in addition to providing a scene of exploration, the game to do a lot of things rely on the roll of 20-sided dice, known as "Play Chess" in the game.
If the number of dice is greater than or equal to the number of dice on the other side, the game succeeds, otherwise the game fails.
If you fail to roll a 20-sided die, don't worry. If you roll the dice again, "Luck will favor the lucky one."
In the game, you can invite other characters to join the team. Of course, the "invitation" still depends on the result of rolling a 20-sided die.
In a game, the character who is first in line affects the outcome of the game. A game is more successful when a particular character is at the top of the line. However, we want to emphasize that everything is not absolute, there is always a certain possibility, but the success rate does vary.
As the story progresses, we often find some unusual places, waiting to be discovered in the distance.

2332120.name: One Card One Shot - Mafia
2332120.about_the_game:
CARDS ON THE TABLE. FINGER ON THE TRIGGER

A sharp fusion of tactical deckbuilding with first-person precision shooting. Flip cards, create synergies, and finish the contract with a single shot — every bullet counts.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT!

  • Tactical “decide and shoot” action — play your cards, read the field, and finish in FPS at the right moment.

  • Dynamic transitions between mechanics — start in a top-down shooter, switch to FPS, or vice versa.

  • Surprise in every mission — new enemies, patterns, and mechanics keep discovery constant.

  • Powerful mafia bosses — each territory has its own rules, traps, and dangerous enemies.

  • Roguelite map & progression — choose routes between Enemies, Mid-Boss, Events, Side Jobs, and Safehouse; push forward toward the Big Boss.

  • Limited ammo — managing bullets is part of the strategy (and the tension).

  • Secondary weapons — finish targets in different ways and save ammo.

  • Short, replayable runs — perfect for “just one more” (average 8–15 min).

EXPLORING THE GAME

You are a bounty hunter in the mafia underworld. With a lethal deck and a trusty rifle, every contract becomes a battle of nerves: chain effects, create openings, and pull the trigger when everything is in your favor.

Build your hunt deck before each mission. Cards are activated at the start and shape the battlefield: body armor, extra ammo, protection, and other perks that pave the way for the perfect shot.

MAFIA BOSSES
Bosses control their own territories. Read their patterns and pull off the final hit.

SECONDARY WEAPONS
Versatile, fast, economical, and decisive.

PROGRESSION & MAPS
Plot routes between Enemies, Mid-Boss, Events, Side Jobs, and Safehouse; each region culminates in a Boss — mastering territories leads to the Big Boss.

COMMUNITY

Overview

The original design of the never-before seen point and click adventure is being brought to life after 30+ years in the vault - Beyond Shadowgate! This new PC game has been created by the designers of the original 8-bit hit Shadowgate and a leading 8-bit adventure studio!

With a world that is over five times larger than Shadowgate, Beyond Shadowgate captures the same look and feel as the 8-bit console version while including modern design sensibilities. Since the memory and color palette limitations are removed, Beyond Shadowgate is a much longer and vibrant game, with both retro and modern gameplay mechanics that give you the feel of the original! 2332450.name: Loading Screen Simulator
2332450.about_the_game:
You've already been inundated with every type of simulator possible. Well, at least you thought that was the case. Like most everyone else, we think the simulator genre has gone too far (We're looking at you, KFC Dating Sim....). However, instead of rallying against the deluge of downright weird simulators, we've decided to add to the growing abyss of them. Loading Screen Simulator started out as a joke between family members about the madness of the current simulator genre. Now it's progressed to a functional alpha build with goals to have a full game released by the end of the year. Keep checking back, as it's going to keep getting better? How, you ask? More loading screens, of course! Yes, there will be easter eggs for those of you that get through the first few loading screens. Will there be jump scares? Maybe. You'll have to progress through the loading screens to find out. Will there be some cool trivia hidden somewhere in the midst of all the loading screen madness? Possibly, if we can figure out how to code that. What's our end goal? World domination through a large amount of non-functional loading screens, of course! (We may be joking here, or there may be a Chinese spy balloon in there somewhere...If you're the CIA or any government agency reading this, we're just kidding! There's no spyware here). We just hope that our end product is as absurd as it sounds!

Features:
o Loading Screen images rotate randomly
o Hundreds of loading screen images at launch, with more being added every day
o Interactive loading screens (maze challenges, puzzles, and more!) that can be turned on or off
o Real-life and fantasy scenery!
o Can be used as a safety screen in many situations.
o Music that can be turned on or off throughout the screens

2332560.name: pan·gaia
2332560.about_the_game:
pan·gaia is a relaxed sandbox game about the whole Earth, featuring abstract, nostalgic graphics, and a rich, open-ended model of the planetary dynamics that shape our world.

Sculpt the Winds and Steer the Currents

Suspended in space, driven by the vast energy of the Sun, your planet swirls with winds and currents of immense power. They are yours to guide, and shape your planet's climate - if you dare.

Can you bring the monsoon to the deserts? Or... will you end up melting the ice caps?

A Whole-Earth Garden

It's a trilobite-eat-trilobite world. From the simplest cyanobacteria to the tiger at your throat, everyone's out to win the game of Natural Selection. Strike a balance between plant and animal, predator and prey, and build your planet's ecology. But whatever you do... be good to the fungi.

There are dozens of predefined species at your disposal to fill, exploit, and dominate every ecological niche. And if there is no pleasing you, then evolve one of your own.

Step Into the Unknown

Your planet has its own, relaxed logic, measured in centuries and millennia. But life can't stay in the cradle forever. Will you take the leap and set one of your species on the path to sapience?

Are you prepared to guide them through the long, perilous journey from animal to Antiquity? And is your planet prepared for the power they will wield, and the dreams they'll have?

The Science

Inspired by Maxis' 1990 SimEarth, and its legendary capture of deep ecological theory in a "software toy", pan·gaia draws on methods and algorithms from established research circulation models, like UVic EMBM, MOM5, and DieCAST. It simulates the Earth system (or other planets, if you want) as a set of interconnected spheres:
  • The atmosphere, the envelope of air and moisture that stretches from the ground to space, that circulates from the Tropics to the Poles in jetstreams and hurricanes, that nourishes forests and scours away at mountains.
  • The hydrosphere, your planet's water - from the smallest stream to the vast ocean deep - turning over in cycles from days to millennia, and mediating all life on earth.
  • The cryosphere, your planet's icecaps and glaciers - locked in a delicate cycle with heat and the Sun, whose fate can tip the entire climate from greenhouse to ice age, and back again.
  • The geosphere, the rock, soil and mountains beneath everything, which give shape to the oceans, and create rainforests or rain-shadows.
  • The biosphere, the teeming masses all fighting for survival, bending and yielding with the flows of water and nutrients, making dams in your forests - and creating vast algal blooms that can even cool your planet down. Gaia help you if one of them learns how to make a spear...

Everything - the sea, the sky, the rock, the living things - pulls and pushes on everything else. Your world is not just a silent rock or a pale blue dot - it's alive!

2332600.name: Reverie
2332600.about_the_game:
Can emptiness be an object?

PUZZLES

Reverie is a narrative-driven puzzle platformer where you can grab and move empty space just like ordinary objects. Explore your own dreams, solving mind-bending puzzles that teach you how physics would work if emptiness was an object. All chapters have their own artistic theme, along with unique puzzle elements that will expand your understanding of the system.

STORY

Most events in this game take place in your dreams. In the dreams, you will encounter a variety of other dream characters, some human and some not. By accompanying them through their adventure and talking to them, find out the truth behind the weird nature of your dreams.

HINT SYSTEM

All puzzles in Reverie come with interactive hints. This means that when you get stuck, you can first ask for a small hint that doesn't tell the whole solution. If you still feel lost even after reading the hint, you can ask for a different, more detailed hint.

FEATURES

2333390.name: Cricket Captain 2023
2333390.about_the_game:
Cricket Captain 2023 puts you in control. Create your own legacy. A packed international schedule includes the oldest Test Match rivalry in cricket as Australia tour England, the test championship final and 2023 World Cup. Test Match cricket was shaken up by a new aggressive approach in 2022, nicknamed Bazball, creating some of the most thrilling matches in history. Our new aggression system, inspired by Bazball, uses batting ability and natural aggression based on the current batting tactic, rather than the type of match being played. A generation of cricketers brought up on 20 Over Cricket have naturally aggressive styles that mean many have higher one-day averages than first class. Batting aggressively to match their natural style can improve performance. Equally, knocking runs off at 12 an over is natural to players in the last overs of a 20 over (or even Test) match.

Cricket Captain 2023 also includes historical data for international player rankings and player recent form, including recent performances in Test, ODI and 20 Over Internationals. International team ranking has been remodelled using results of every match in the four-year window. New wicket keeper statistics are also included, with separate fielding stats for keepers and outfielders, as well as byes conceded records. Wicket keeper abilities are also now more accurate.

All domestic systems have been updated to include the latest developments in India, South Africa and around the world.

Key features for 2023 include:
  • Match Engine: new Bazball inspired player aggression and rating system.
  • Updated International Team Rankings: calculated from last 4 years results.
  • International Player Rankings: with historical data, all-rounders and improved system.
  • Asia Trophy: play in ODI and 20 Over International tournaments.
  • Player Form: includes historical data, opposition and an updated system.
  • Recent Internationals: recent international player form graphs.
  • Wicket Keeper Statistics: keeper and outfield catches, byes conceded.
  • Wicket Keeper Ability: greater accuracy for keeping ability.
  • Stadium Model Updates: including new Perth stadium.
  • New South African Franchise League: six new teams.
  • Indian Domestic System: major update to all competitions.
  • Domestic System Updates: all systems updated to latest rules and formats.
  • Improved Player Generation: rebalanced with focus on player aggression.
  • New Kits: including international and Australian 20 Over.
  • Test and ODI Championships: updated for the 2023 season.
  • Tournament Modes: play in stand-alone One Day or 20 Over World Cups. Create your own World XIs, All-Time Great and Custom Match Series.
  • Interface: improved screen layout and flow.
Complete Stats Update for the 2023 Season:
  • Updated player database with over 7,500 players.
  • Added historical keeper and outfield stats.
  • Updated versus, ground and team records with partnerships, bowling and batting records.
  • Updated domestic squads for all 146 playable domestic teams.
  • Updated recent series stats for all players.
