2333460.name: Volar
2333460.about_the_game:
“Volar” puts you in control of the titular raccoon on the run from their past, who’s other half commands an army of Nightmares. With gameplay that revolves around using a single button to jump, air dive, and use abilities, Volar is easy to learn but hard to put down.

Explore five unique worlds filled with danger and adventure, and don powerful masks that will grant you the power to ignite, freeze, and electrocute your enemies, among many more abilities! Each level presents a new challenge that will test your skills and keep you on your toes. With cartoony visuals, a simple storyline, and plenty of challenges, can you help Volar overcome their past and move on?

----------------------------------
FEATURES
----------------------------------
- Single-button gameplay
- Accessibility options for No Damage and Speed Up/Down Game Speed
- 40 levels in the main game + ???
- Powerful mask abilities
- 5 different worlds to explore
- Many player outfits to choose from

----------------------------------
DETAILED GAMEPLAY
----------------------------------
- When Volar is on the ground, an arrow will rotate around them, Hold down spacebar to pause the arrow rotation, then release to jump in that direction. While jumping the air, press spacebar again to air dive. This gives you precise control if you mistimed a jump or are too close to an enemy. If you air dive on top of physics blocks, you will crack/break them.

- While in the air, if Volar is near a ledge, they will automatically ledge hop onto the higher ground. This is useful when almost making a jump.

- Power ups give an extra ability and allow you to take one extra hit of enemy damage. Certain power ups, such as the Fire Mask, will automatically active when making contact with the ground after air diving. The Fire Mask will burn surround wood blocks and enemies. Other power ups, such as the Rocket, are activated when double-tapping while in the air. Power ups are reset once Volar touches the ground again.

- Hearts allow one extra hit from enemy damage.

- Coins are scattered throughout each level. Coins are used to purchase power ups that you've already found during gameplay. Coins can also be used to purchase Outfits which change the look of Volar but do not affect gameplay.

- There is a secret power up unlocked at the very end of the last level.

The realm of Teleria trembles beneath the shadow of the Dark Lord Siroth. You have been called upon by the Arbiter, the immortal guardian of Teleria, to stop him. Heed the call!

Dive into a deep turn-based RPG with 8 exciting game modes and extensive character customization. Enjoy a story-driven campaign, competitive PvP clashes with players from across the world, and constant new challenges with our stream of updates.

KEY GAME FEATURES

SUMMON 800+ CHAMPIONS

Collect hundreds of unique Champions from 16 playable factions and combine them into unstoppable teams to take down your enemies. Dark elves, Ogryn warlords, Lizardmen, and more can all join your ranks – if you earn their loyalty.

PROVE YOURSELF IN 3 PvP MODES

Enter the Arena and go head-to-head with other players to unlock special gear and climb up the leaderboards. Then, really put your skills to the test in real-time PvP battles with Live Arena.

EXPLORE ENGAGING PvE CONTENT

Tear your way through a visually stunning campaign accompanied by a rich, fully-voiced dark fantasy narrative. Conquer the forces of Darkness as well as 13 challenging Dungeon bosses, fast-paced Faction Wars, and the notorious Doom Tower to earn valuable loot.

TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS

Take control of a squad of Blade Princes, highly-trained warriors that combine their skills to create devastating combos, striking down their foes.

Pause, Strategise, Execute

Deal status afflictions that weaken enemies over time whilst dodging attacks & spells to keep up the fight. Push enemies into disadvantageous positions and use the environment against them - the possibilities are yours to create.

Discover the Blade Prince Academy

The Academy is where the Blade Princes learn new skills, rest up between battles, and hang out. Social relationships grow as you guide members of the team to become more comfortable with each other and new heroes come on board. Before you head out on another mission, gain intel about the on-goings of Abjectalia and prep your squads abilities for the next assault.

Build your Squad

Throughout your adventure, assemble a roster of different heroes, each with unique strengths, weaknesses, and backstories. Discover how each of them perform in combat and tailor your squad to suit your style of play, or to progress relationships between your favourites. Utilise every ability and combo at your disposal and form dark pacts to help each other survive the darkest underbellies of the city together.

Features

  • True real-time with pause: in combat, suspend time to plan your attacks and outsmart your enemies.
  • Combo system: Combine attacks and abilities to generate powerful combos.

2333590.name: Mystery Case Files: The Dalimar Legacy Collector's Edition

2333790.name: Dog's World
2333790.about_the_game:
A surreal, menu driven, pseudo-immersive sim without rhyme or reason.

Thoroughly pointless, obtuse and purposely unfriendly. Dog's World will not hold your hand, pat your head or pinch your cheeks. Dog's World is indifferent and uncaring.

Set in the small town of South Hope, our aging protagonist Dog is unemployed, listless and destitute. Perhaps you'll provide the positive direction he needs in his life? Perhaps not.

Dog's World is an exercise in frustration - What's the point? What am I supposed to be doing? There are ways to "win" the game - Things to do, obstacles in the way, endings to find - But you're not going to get a quest marker or a reminder of what you're supposed to be doing. There isn't any auto-pilot, map or checklists. You're just going to have to figure it out.


Dog's World features:

  • "Player Unfriendly" design philosophy
  • Obtuse game design
  • Multiple Endings
  • Fully kill-able NPCs
  • Faux Open World
  • Unpleasant atmosphere
  • Oppressive and stifling player freedom

2333840.name: Simple Arcade
2333840.about_the_game:
Simple Arcade is an arcade game inspired by the games of the 80s. Simple, amazing gameplay addictive for many hours, with each game you will feel how your skill grows and you score a record number of points, biting record after record. The game has extensive customization, which allows you to change even the color of the interface to make the game look the way you like.

2333860.name: Pack Man in Rio
2333860.about_the_game:
Trabalhe como assistente de vendedor ambulante até aprender o ofício! Depois, comece o seu próprio negócio, comprando produtos no mercado para revender. Cresça, pague as suas contas, e tire uma folga curtindo o que a praia tem a oferecer!

1) É Cultural!


Este é um jogo indie feito por um carioca (nascido no Rio). Logo, você encontrará referências reais à situações vivenciadas nas praias cariocas sempre que possível, como preços, esportes, eventos e sátiras do Rio! =]

2) É Realista!


Os preços dos produtos e despesas começam no mesmo nível dos preços reais encontrados em 2023 no Rio de Janeiro! Após cada dia virtual, produtos podem ficar em falta ou sofrer reajuste de preço, simulando assim uma economia real na medida do possível. Tente estocar os produtos de maior demanda, para não faltar depois! ;)

3) É Educativo!


Vender requer mais do que pressionar um simples botão! Tem que dar o troco certo!

Este jogo ensina noções básicas a crianças e adultos de como lidar com dinheiro, tanto na perspectiva de empreendedor como na perspectiva de operador de caixa. Tente acumular e racionar as suas notas e moedas da melhor maneira, para não faltar depois! 8]

4) É Radical!


Pratique surfe nas praias em que houver ondas fortes! Alugue uma prancha e sinta o fluxo das ondas para bater o recorde de maior tempo se equilibrando sem cair! =D

5) É Esportivo!


Divirta-se em partidas de Altinha, um esporte popular nascido nas praias do Rio que é inspirado no vôlei e futebol! É só chegar e pedir para jogar nas praias em que houver grupos jogando!

Esse esporte adaptou os fundamentos do futevôlei para a prática em roda, onde os jogadores devem manter a bola sempre no alto sem deixar cair - daí a origem do nome "Altinha". Uma das características mais interessantes do esporte é que não há uma competição entre os jogadores, mas um espírito cooperativo.

No Pack Man in Rio, você poderá escolher jogar tanto na modalidade oficial de campeonatos (que é cooperativo) ou uma modalidade inovadora, de eliminação competitiva! E aí? Aceita o desafio? >)

6) É Fotorealista!


Todas as praias e ondas do jogo são reais, com imagens feitas exclusivamente de vídeos de altíssima resolução! São nessas águas e areias naturais que o seu personagem Pack-Man (o Homem do Saco) irá caminhar! 8)

7) É Satírico!


Sinta a adrenalina carioca de ser um verdadeiro pac-man humano, onde você foge de bandidos em arrastão para não perder o seu dinheiro suado! Ou vire a mesa e corra atrás deles (quando conseguir achar a polícia, é claro)!

E se não tiver licença de vendedor, fuja também da polícia, para não ser multado e ter seus produtos apreendidos!

Bem-vindo ao Rio! Esta bela Cidade de Deus! Mantenha carteira e celular dentro do bolso o tempo todo, se conseguir... xD

2333930.name: Kitchen Sync: Aloha!
2333930.about_the_game:
Cozy cooking and relationship building meets RPG depth, story, and strategy.  Adventure across the lush Hawaiian island of Maikai and lead a team of chefs to meet the demands of your hungry customers.  Make new friends, build new relationships, and save this foodie paradise with the power of good eats!

Befriend and recruit a cast of colorful chefs, each with their unique personalities and specialties. Watch them grow alongside you and your restaurant and uncover their own personal stories.  As you and your chefs collaborate, bonds will deepen and friendships will form… some even result in romance.  That goes for you as well as your team - play matchmaker!

Familiar kitchen management with a strategic twist.  Cook by coordinating a crew of chefs and a timer that helpfully pauses whenever you need it.  Craft your menu and customize your recipes by adding your own Twists. Optimize your kitchen layout, upgrade your appliances, and level up your chefs' abilities to fully master every kitchen.  Whip up some mouthwatering Hawaiian dishes as you explore Maikai's various venues and overcome challenges!

Need a break from the kitchen? Strengthen your bond with your team and enjoy what the island has to offer. Go on a fishing trip or a nature hike. Each mini-game lets you grow your relationship with the chefs you befriend on your journey.

Play as either Kai or Kala, two siblings on their quest to bring their family’s restaurant back to life. Along the way, you’ll complete meaningful side quests, experiment with recipes, and craft dishes as unforgettable as the people you’ll meet. Start as the new eatery on the island and grow your restaurant into a local gem.

On Maikai, cooking is more than just preparing meals. It’s about growing relationships and embracing the spirit of community.

  • Cozy Cooking RPG - The narrative focus of visual novel meets strategic kitchen management. Level up characters, customize kitchen layouts, and build relationships to uncover stories.

  • Over 30 Different Kitchens - Cook at beaches, restaurants, malls, food trucks, resorts, and more, all set against the beauty of a lush Hawaiian island. 

  • Wholesome and Heartwarming Story - A journey of food, family, and discovering joy in the connections that bring people together.

  • No Stress Kitchen Management - Play at your own pace with a timer that pauses.

  • Grow Relationships - Build stronger bonds between party members or find love with different romantic endings!

  • Mini-games - Participate in island activities like fishing and hiking with fellow chefs.

  • 3 Different Difficulty Settings - Turn off all timers and relax with Cozy mode or test your skills with Hard Boiled mode.

2334030.name: Camera Anima
2334030.about_the_game:
Pursue the Artisan, save your sister, and uncover the past, but remember what the stories say…Meet his face, and never wake again.

Camera Anima is a point-and-click visual novel where you take on the role of Essie, a young woman trying to save her sister from the soul-stealing serial killer known as the Artisan.

On the Floating Isles of Awyr, citizens live in a society where their livelihoods and social status are defined by the masks or “Faces” they wear. Though attitudes are slowly changing towards the Face-system, there are rumors that those who wander the streets at night without a Face become prey to the Artisan, doomed to turn up as a stylistically arranged corpse.

His last known victim was found five years ago, but he’s never been caught. Only Essie truly knows what happened that night.

Explore through her memories to uncover the mystery of the Artisan.

KEY FEATURES

  • Adventure Visual Novel: Point-and-Click gameplay inspired by a combination of Western adventure games and visual novel storytelling. Find optional interactions, secrets, and bad endings.


  • Exploration Wheel: Use the exploration wheel, to interact with the world in multiple ways.

  • Interactive Environments: Explore and solve a number of levels, combining problem-solving with a rich narrative.

  • Timed Events: As events occurs, determine whether it is better to wait or act.



  • Original Art and Music: Original art and music created specifically for Camera Anima.

2334040.name: YinYang Street Ultimate Edition
2334040.about_the_game:
The story of YinYang Street takes place in a border town in the 1980s. Our protagonist Minglai Li is a soldier fighting to defend his country. He runs into a series of strange things and finds his beloved wife missing when he comes home. Where used to be warm and sweet is now full of mysteries, which lead to a place called YinYang Street. Is this a coincidence or a conspiracy? Minglai Li has no time to think about it. All he could do is rush to YinYang Street and explore the bottomless abyss...

  • The hand-painted art style originated from 1980s will lead you on a nostalgic journey.

  • The complex relationships and five connected chapters will show you a story with ups and downs.

  • Simple puzzles plus exciting escapes will ensure a deep immersion and trigger your fears.

Hello everyone, we’re an indie development team from Yunnan, China. YinYang Street is an indie horror game set in Yunnan. We hope all of you will enjoy this game when it’s out. We welcome any valuable advice that can help us become better. Best regards!

Each stage features a variety of monsters, and the game is cleared by defeating all of the bosses in each stage.

Rin and her friends decide one day to explore a house on the hill. Rumours have spread

about that place. Some say evil dwells there. Unfazed by this they enter and

  • Boss Fights

  • Multiple Endings

2334080.name: Last Dream Fishing Arcade
2334080.about_the_game:
Fish your way across lush Gaia in this retro 2D pixel-art fishing RPG. Enjoy a relaxing day or battle for your fishing life against monsters of the deep. With 12 selectable characters, varying difficulty, numerous equipment options, and surprises, you’ll be hooked on this buried treasure of a game!

Follow the characters from the upcoming epic RPG, Last Dream II, in their quest to become Master Fishers. Help them win the Gaia Championship!

Key Features:


  • 5 adjustable difficulties + an unlockable challenge mode!
  • 12 characters each with unique fishing attributes and overdrives
  • 100 unique fish from Guppies to Monsters of the Deep
  • 14 unlockable locations where rare fish lurk, each with unique music
  • Compete in Fishing Tournaments to prove your skill!
  • Upgrade your fishing equipment to catch bigger fish!
  • Trawl the seafloor to collect Treasures, Pearls, & Messages in Bottles
  • Buy new items and accessories from the Traveling Merchant
  • Unlock New Game+ with the chance to earn over 80 Fishing Arcade Achievements!
  • Crush your fishing foes in Reborn Mode!



Thoughtfully Crafted Mechanics: Last Dream Fishing Arcade embraces the concept “easy to learn, hard to master.” Anyone can enjoy an afternoon of fishing fun, yet only the utmost skill and persistence can challenge the God of Fishers himself, Glaucus! Catch fish through casting, reeling, unleashing powerful overdrives at the perfect moment, and securing your hook through directional multipliers. Enhance your fishing abilities through accessories and wisely-timed items. Multiple difficulty settings allow you to customize the game to suit your style – be it hardcore angler or laid-back trawler.



Unlockable Mysteries: The Last Dream Fishing Arcade includes 100 unique fish, all of which are a mystery when you commence your journey. Start with the Jack-of-all-Trades fisher, Lucius – the Gray Mage, and unlock new characters by catching strange new fish. Begin your fishing adventure on the sunny shores of Ceos and unlock new locations by collecting messages in bottles to discover the locations of rare fish!



Compelling Replayability from the Creators of Last Dream: With 5 adjustable difficulties, 12 unique characters, over 80 achievements, and an unlockable challenge mode, the Last Dream Fishing Arcade will keep you coming back! The game isn’t over once you win the Gaia Championship – continue your journey to become the new God of Fishers through New Game+ mode or start a new game with all of your fishing equipment, items, and accessories in Reborn mode to enjoy a more relaxing fishing experience. Just. One. More. Fish!

About Our Developers:


Our development team is comprised of people who deeply cherish the RPGs of our childhoods.

We began developing Last Dream to be the central element of our decades-running annual RPG Tournament among fellow physics graduates. We started with the sole desire to craft an enduring game that we would personally enjoy. We continue to develop Last Dream II to combine the best aspects of the classic and modern games that we love so much.

Fishing has always been a big part of the Last Dream RPG series, which is even more true for Last Dream 2 – each fish you catch will directly benefit your journey. The Last Dream Fishing Arcade uses many of the same mechanics and is centered entirely around exploring the oceans of Gaia as you master every tournament and tame every creature. The characters and mechanics in the Last Dream Fishing Arcade comprise a vibrant, exciting microcosm that is part of the upcoming Last Dream 2 universe yet also wholly capable of standing on its own two (sea) legs.

2334100.name: Fractured Fury

In Fractured Fury, players will battle their way through challenging levels, encountering a wide variety of enemies and obstacles along the way in this 1980s Apocalyptic world! 2334170.name: Metal Bringer
2334170.about_the_game:
In this roguelike action-adventure, control humanoid "Labor" and giant "Arms" to uncover the mysteries of the world.
A young girl named Suria wakes up in a laboratory and finds out that she has been put in cryosleep for 1000 years without her knowledge.
In order to search for the rest of humanity, she builds Labor with her trusty Buds, and sends them off to investigate...

Highly Customizable Player Characters and Arms


Build and control android soldiers called "Labor", or have them pilot giant machines called "Arms". Each and every Labor and Arms you build is highly customizable. You can change the color and appearance of their features, or swap out parts to change their fighting styles. Create and fight with the mech of your dreams!

Effortlessly Wipe Out Hordes of Enemies


Labor can be strengthened by installing different types of apps. App disks can be obtained by defeating enemies, but you lose all installed apps when you fall in battle.

However, by analyzing an app's data, you can use it when you customize your next Labor, allowing you to perform better each run until you can freely trample all over your opponents with ease.

Obtain Enemy Arms Parts on the Go

Even the most powerful Arms will eventually wear down, but when that happens, you can use Arms parts left behind by the enemy.

What's more, you can analyze the blueprints of powerful Arms parts over the course of the game, which unlocks various customization options. Find out what kind of gear suits you best to build the ideal mech.

Ray Tracing and Ever-Changing Music

This game uses the same retro art style as Samurai Bringer, but just like Samurai Bringer, it also implements a real time pixel art generating system, and will also feature the newest raytracing technology for beautifully lit environments.

The music too is made with the newest technology, as it is played in real time and changes according to the situation.

The Story

The sky is blue, infinitely high, and infinitely vast...
Whose words were these again...?
Ah, I remember... It was about a virtual reality Rudra told me about.
A fairy tale.
How many years has it been since humanity took refuge underground?
No one alive has ever seen a blue sky.
And now, I'm trapped in the depths, in a small, lifeless room.
Just how long have I been here...?

2334220.name: Home Sweet Home : Online
2334220.about_the_game:
The ultimate excitement with Home Sweet Home : Online, complete missions to escape from Niwarn for victory.

Join Our Communities :

Survive Mode
Asymmetrical mode that consists of 1 warden hunting 4 visitors in an arena. There are two core gameplays depended on the role players take.

Warden's mission

The warden is to strategically hunt 4 visitors letting no one escape, and not being killed by visitors. Each warden will have different stats and special abilities offering various ways of hunting visitors.

Visitor's mission

The visitors have to cooperate to complete the objective. Each character will have different stats and unique abilities supporting each role of play - decoy, damage, or perform the rituals. Things will drastically change after the objective is completed. The game will test personal dilemma choosing either teaming up to eliminate the warden or saving own self by leaving the arena. escaping the Hindrance, or be the warden and hunt and collect souls.

Battle Mode
Win through collecting souls in a 4vs4 style battle where the Visitor that holds the Warden Soul will turn into a Warden to hunt down the visitor on the other team. The other Visitors has to do their best to stay alive to limit their loss. There can only be one winner in the war between sides.


(1) The 4 visitors must work together to complete the awakening ritual to summon the "Warden's Soul". After completion, they will receive 1 "Warden Soul".
(2) The Visitor that holds the "Warden Soul" can spawn and play as a Warden to hunt down the other team's Visitors.
(3) Over time the power of the Warden Soul decreases causing the Warden to slowly lose HP. The Visitors have to keep performing the ritual to restore their Warden's powers or store it to summon a new Warden that replaces the old one.
(4) The team that collects the most Warden Souls within the time limit wins the match. If the results end in a tie, The first team that can take down an enemy Visitor wins.


Wardens that revert back to being a Visitor will receive a "Karma Points" based on how many Visitors they eliminated. If the other team's Warden eliminates the reverted Visitor, they will receive the Karma points as bonus points for the team.



Niwarn is the dimension between the human and spirit world. The reason souls end up being trapped in Niwarn can come from a person being in a limbo between life and death or cursed with dark magic . People with strong arcanic powers often use their powers to control the Warden to hunt down the Visitors that end up wandering into Niwarn. They hunt for their souls to complete an unexplained ritual.

2334320.name: Cthulhu Keeper
2334320.about_the_game:
Welcome to Cthulhu Keeper, a real-time tactics and dungeon-building game set in the eerie 1920s, where you assume the role of a cult leader weaving a web of dark influence. Build, defend, and expand your lair, summon terrifying creatures, and orchestrate sinister missions. 

Plan and execute missions in the outside world, from stealing artifacts to converting new followers. Each mission presents unique objectives, like capturing valuable targets or escaping undetected. Customize your cult leader and monsters for each mission, equipping them with helpful items and powers.

Begin by carving your lair from solid rock. Lay out halls and chambers, create dedicated rooms for rituals, and strategically place defenses to fend off intruders. Customize the layout, giving your cultists tasks like research, monster care, and trap setting.

Use the power of ancient tomes and artifacts to summon creatures from Lovecraft’s mythos. Each monster brings unique abilities and needs a fitting habitat, such as shadowed caves or occult gardens. Choose carefully: a stealthy Shambler can move unnoticed, while a powerful Mi-Go dominates the skies.

As your lair grows, word spreads, drawing attention from rival cults, detectives, and the police. Set traps and strategically place spells to defend your cult against these intrusions. If an invasion breaks through, your compound will suffer damage, and resources will be stolen.

Dig, Dagger, Dagon.

Key Features:

  • Dungeon Building Meets Tactics: Carve out a sprawling lair, defend it against rival cults and investigators, and manage resources to expand your domain of terror.

  • Summon and Control Lovecraftian Monsters: Unlock and command creatures from Lovecraft's mythos, each with unique skills and abilities. Develop them through research trees, specializing them to fit your dark strategy.

  • Loot & Research: Expand your knowledge by collecting manuscripts and artifacts. Unlock powerful upgrades, new monsters, and specialized skills. For each creature, you can choose different evolutionary paths, adapting your horrors to fit your playstyle.

  • Challenging Missions with Unique Rules: Undertake a variety of missions with different goals—raid asylums, conduct grim rituals, and battle rival cultists, police, and even mythos monsters.

  • Lovecraftian Storylines: Experience handcrafted story arcs inspired by the Cthulhu mythos, including tense encounters with cults, gruesome rituals, and eldritch prophecies.

Can you harness the ancient powers without losing your sanity?

2334410.name: Heist Haven
2334410.about_the_game:
Heist Haven is a 1 to 4-player co-op online shooter set in the open-world criminal paradise of Haven. Assemble your crew, select your gear and customise your character: the next big score is waiting!

  • FPS Heists & Missions: Team up with friends or go solo to plan and execute high-stakes heists—complete Jobs and Missions for your criminal contacts to work your way up on the criminal ladder.

  • Co-op Gameplay: Play Solo or Team up with a crew of up to 4 Robbers online.

  • Vast Open World: Heists take place in locations inside the open world, which is explorable at your leisure and filled with secrets and surprises. Heists are only finished when the loot is delivered to a drop-off point and you have returned to your hideout.

  • Level up your Character & Crew: Create, customise and level up your Character. Progress through the world and unlock new equipment and vehicles by levelling up your Crew.

  • Customizable Weapons: Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons, gadgets, and vehicles tailored to your playstyle. Upgrade your gear and develop unique strategies to outsmart your foes.

  • Defeat Varied Enemies: From your average cop to tactical SWAT teams, experienced army units and even Helicopters and Jet Fighters, Heist Haven is filled with plenty of adversaries to test your capabilities.

Varied Vehicles

Lots of Weapons

2334450.name: GhostCatcher
2334450.about_the_game:
Ghost Catcher is a cooperative horror game that can be played by at least 1 and up to 8 players together. You need to continuously delve into the haunted house, unlock new areas, uncover the truth behind the case; conduct mysterious rituals, confront spiritual entities, identify their types, and ultimately capture them.

 

 

                                              

In the game, players can transform into adorable kittens, not only to evade the hunting of spiritual entities but also to discover hidden items through special vision. They can even interact with other players, enjoying the fun of lazing around.

 

                                                 

Search for clues in the map to increase exploration, learn more about the stories hidden in the shadows, unlock broader activity areas, add advanced gameplay, until the entire map is explored and the spiritual entities nesting there are completely subdued, to gain achievements and special rewards.

 

                                              

Each entry will confront different spiritual entities, completely random cursed items and relics, as well as a variety of map events that need to be resolved, ensuring that each game session is a unique experience, with endless challenges.

   

                                               

If you're tired of playing house in the same old apartments and crave a more thrilling adventure, a series of diverse and distinct dungeons, including farms and the upcoming amusement park, are waiting for your conquest

 

                                             

Here you can see enchanting demons flaunting themselves, holy nuns standing guard in assistance, and even beautiful pharaohs accompanying you. However, to attract more attention, perhaps using a mix-and-match style to showcase yourself is also a good option, it's up to your preference

 

                                               

Meticulously crafted using Unreal Engine 5 for better visual expressiveness, dedicated to providing players with a stronger sense of immersion, and experiencing the most immersive exorcism journey.

2334480.name: Where is My Cat?
2334480.about_the_game:
The cat always has a place to hide! It can be anywhere! Think carefully and find your lovely cat. It may be somewhere you’ve never thought about before, but please remember to avoid traps that will make you fail to get your cat!

Are you ready for a thrilling adventure with a furry feline friend? Join our adventurous cat on a quest to escape from various challenging and fun-filled environments in this exciting casual escape game.

Help find our furry hero through each level by solving puzzles, finding hidden objects, and outwitting cunning traps. You'll need to search for clues, and use your quick thinking and problem-solving skills to escape from each location.

As you explore each level, you'll be presented with a list of objects to find. You'll need to solve puzzles, search for clues, and use your quick thinking and problem-solving skills to find the cat from each location. And, you'll also need to use your keen eye and sharp observation skills to spot each item, but don't worry - there are plenty of hints available if you get stuck!

With dozens of levels to explore and new challenges to face in each one, this game offers hours of addictive fun for players of all ages. Whether you're a cat lover or just enjoy a good escape game, you'll find plenty to enjoy in this thrilling and entertaining adventure.

So what are you waiting for? Let's help our adventurous cat escape from all these challenging locations and enjoy the thrilling journey along the way! Download the game today and start playing!

2334500.name: Wizard Shrimp
2334500.about_the_game:
Wizard Shrimp™ is a bullet-hell, roguelite game where you play as a Shrimp who is inexplicably also a Wizard?!

Battle your way out of a slimy swamp, escape amethyst caves, before climbing the Mushroom Wizard's Tower to defeat the final boss.

Collect upgrades and power ups along your quest to become the most powerful Shrimp this world has ever seen!

Gain Krill points to power up your Shrimp and take on the game at harder difficulties in the Cauldron!

Pixel art graphics are accompanied by a modern soundtrack that mixes digital and analogue sounds, embracing naturalistic samples.

Choose your own path out of each area with a unique randomly generated tile system. Leverage your tiles to your tactical advantage by putting a campfire after an enemy encounter. Or say "f*** it" and put down only enemy tiles up until the boss, gaining the most amount of power possible but with a higher risk of death!

2334520.name: SKY
2334520.about_the_game:
SKY is a new way of looking at urban planning strategies. Change voxel landscapes at your discretion, develop technologies, build environmentally friendly cities of the future, and withstand any blows from the elements. After all, you are on the last piece of land in the heavens of this world.

  • You can start with a small piece of land or a ready-made continent of your choice. European, desert, snowy - whatever you want.


  • Explore new types of buildings, such as power plants, laboratories, residential buildings, factories, and more.


  • Change the landscapes, you can build a city in a cave or a ten-story mountain for laboratories, or anything else you want.


  • Keep an eye on the weather that will affect your island, you are in the sky and anything can happen.


In the normal mode, you will have to watch the city's indicators and come up with various strategies to speed up its development. But the game is mostly meditative, so just enjoy it. You can also try the "Creative" mode without restrictions. There you can quickly build anything, create pixel art in a new way.

2334550.name: Super Cat Simulator
2334550.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Super Cat Simulator, a fun and whimsical game where you can immerse yourself in the life of a feline adventurer. Explore a vibrant and interactive virtual world as you play as a customizable cat, using your magical abilities to complete quests, discover hidden treasures, and interact with other animals.

In Super Cat Simulator, you can roam freely around Cat Island, discovering new areas and interacting with other animals. Experience the full charm of Super Cat Simulator with its beautifully crafted world, stunning graphics, and a delightful lo-fi soundtrack that perfectly complements the game's whimsical atmosphere.

But Super Cat Simulator is not just about relaxation. Take a break from exploring the vast world of Super Cat Simulator and try your paw at a variety of fun mini-games and challenging activities that are sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. From fishing to treasure hunting, there's always something new to discover on Cat Island.

Unleash your creativity with the ability to dress up your cat with a wide range of outfits and accessories! Let your feline friend reflect your unique style with the ability to customize their outfit and accessories in Super Cat Simulator. From a sophisticated bow tie to a swashbuckling pirate hat, the possibilities are endless!

And that's not all! Super Cat Simulator also includes magical abilities that players can unlock as they progress through the game. From the power of flight to the ability to speak to other animals, there's no shortage of fun and exciting features to explore.

Features:

  • Customizable cats: Choose from a variety of outfits and accessories to create your own unique furry friend.

  • Magical abilities: Unlock new powers as you progress through the game, such as the ability to fly or speak to other animals.

  • Mini-games and challenges: Take a break from your adventures with various mini-games and challenges scattered throughout the world.

  • Lovable characters: Meet other animals along your journey, each with their own personalities and stories to share.

  • Charming lo-fi music: The perfect soundtrack to accompany your whimsical adventures.

Super Cat Simulator is the perfect game for cat lovers and adventure seekers alike. So why wait? Add Super Cat Simulator to your Steam wishlist today and be the first to know when it's available for purchase. Join our community of cat lovers and let's make this game a reality together!

2334560.name: AlcoFox
2334560.about_the_game:
Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure! In this captivating fantasy world, you'll take on the role of a courageous squirrel-fox who's fed up with living a mundane existence and is ready to take fate into their own paws.

Journey through dark forests, treacherous mines, eerie underground cities, towering mountains, and murky swamps as you make your way to the city of Dementia, where a ship awaits to take you to a brighter future. But beware, the world is fraught with danger, and you'll need to fight off hostile creatures and solve challenging puzzles to progress.

As you navigate this hostile world, you'll encounter pesky enemies that won't be easily defeated. But with your heroism and unwavering perseverance, you'll emerge victorious, no matter the cost.



Do you have what it takes to face the adversity head-on and emerge triumphant? Join AlcoFox on this epic adventure and discover the power within yourself to change your destiny!

2334570.name: Nuclear Winter
2334570.about_the_game:
Nuclear Winter is a post-apocalyptic survival game set in the ruins of a modern American city after a devastating nuclear war. In this first-person, survival experience, players must scavenge for resources, build shelter, and fend off threats while exploring a desolate and dangerous world.

Starting with only a few basic supplies, players must navigate the ruins of the city in search of food, water, and other necessary resources. The city is filled with dangers, including radioactive zones, mutated creatures, and other survivors who may not have the player's best interests at heart.

As players progress, they will be able to craft more advanced tools and weapons, build shelter, and eventually even establish a new settlement in the city. But the dangers will only grow as the player becomes more powerful.

With challenging gameplay and immersive graphics, Nuclear Winter offers a unique experience by combining a post-apocalyptic setting with survival mechanics.

Scavenging
The player must scavenge for resources to survive, including food, water, weapons, and other supplies. They will explore the abandoned streets of the city to find valuable loot.

Crafting
With the resources they collect, the player can craft tools, weapons, and shelter to survive in the harsh environment. The crafting system is extensive, allowing the player to create items ranging from basic tools to advanced weapons and even establish a new settlement.

Combat
The player will encounter various hostile creatures and other survivors in the ruins of the city. They must use their weapons and tactical skills to fight off these enemies and defend their shelter and resources.

Do you have what it takes to survive in the aftermath of a nuclear war?

2334590.name: Zong
2334590.about_the_game:
Overview


English Intro
Zong is a first-person VR novel that takes you on a journey through ancient Eastern history and culture. As an interstellar traveler, you find yourself in the world of Zong, which is currently in a dire situation under the grips of the Five Clans of Corruption. You will be completing missions to save ancient civilization from the corruptive forces and transmit important learnings to earth, while being guided by Zong's spiritual leaders, the four Supreme Commanders. As you progress through the game, you will encounter various challenges that require strategy, skill, and wit. Get ready to cast spells, summon magical creatures, solve puzzles, collect rare items, and more!

中文简介
在浩大的宇宙里，存在着一个时空维度——宗界，宗界是高级文明的始祖，生生不息，维护着无数星河的星际安全，更有着监测人类一族的使命与维护人间地球运转的责任。在过去的时间长河里，宗界与人间地球一直保持着距离，与人类一族各自为生，却没料想随着人类技术的发展与生产力的解放，人类试图逾越自宇宙初开以来与宗界之间的界限，不断地通过各式各样的方式想要抵达宗界，甚至窥探宗界中的动向，扰乱宗界生灵们的生产与生活。宗界生灵们经过商讨，为了预防人类的好奇心破坏宗界与人类一族的界限，决定挑选合适的人类，给他们在宗界中行动与信息交流的权限，如果他们能够经受住宗界的考验并与宗界生灵们和平相处，便给予他们周秭信函，让该选定的人把信函发送到人间地球，作为传递宗界与人间地球之间信息的人类使者。密函里面内容不一，但无一不关乎人类的生命与生活的七大主题：生死、名利、善施、至亲、爱人、博学、友忠。

Synopsis


LV1 - The Centiwell
  • As the player, you will enter Zong as your true self on human earth, and meet one of the four Supreme Commanders in the Cave of Centiwell. Sol sees your appearance and senses the human aura from you, he then quickly stamps Zong's Imprint on your finger. Zong's Imprint connects humans and Zong for information exchange. Only with Zong's Imprint can Zong's beings hear the voices of humans, and only with the Imprint can humans move freely in the world of Zong. Sol tells you that the current time and space is Era of Anima Gravis...
LV2 - Cliffside Tiger
  • When Sol and you walk out of the secret passageway of Centiwell, a dangerous cliff appears in front of you. Sol tells you that this place is called "Boreas Gorge". Standing on the edge of the cliff, Sol notices that there is an Osteospectral Tiger nearby. He tells you to pay attention to your own safety, because the Osteospectral Tiger would attack humans from the earth...
LV3 - The Captives
  • Sol snaps his fingers and recites the Mantra Karida, an old wooden bridge connecting the cliffs on both sides appearing in front of you. Sol tells you that this bridge is called "Bridge of Atomos". Those who have committed wrongs in the dimension of Zong—commonly referred to as the Captives of Zong—are hung by their ankles underneath the bridge, facing into the abyss below, as a stern reprimand of their egregious offenses. Even though living beings native to Zong can traverse the bridge with ease, a foreign being such as yourself will weigh it down significantly, alerting the Captives of Zong of your presence. They will flock to attack you once they become aware of you...
LV4 - Papaver Rhoeas
  • After defeating Captives under the bridge, you arrive at the Dent Area. Surprisingly, thousands of flowers fall from the sky in an instant. The information shows that the flower in the sky is called Papaver Rhoeas. Soon, Ves appears in the glowing light of Papver Rhoeas. Ves is one of the four Supreme Commanders in Zong during the arcane era of Anima Gravis, who is in a Spiritual Conjunction with Sol. Ves is often lachrymose and frequently recounts tales of past sufferings, bygone longings, and ancestral accomplishments. Her wistful tales are memorialized in melodies abundant with emotions and commendable virtues. She has lost her memory and the ability to memorize in the Era of Anima Gravis. As she senses your human identity, she decides to pave a flower ledge for you...
LV5 - Jade Burial Suit
  • After you break the Flower Ledge, you start taking a flower raft with Ves and Sol to traverse in the river. Suddenly, a huge crucible slowly appears in the center of Boreas Gorge. Sol looks a little surprised. He tells you that this crucible was used to make Jade Burial Suits. A Jade Burial Suit is created by stringing precious jade stones from Lake Li’er with the Golden Strings from Zong's Canaries, which are then fused together with the flames of burning Papaver Rhoeas. Creating and offering Jade Suits in sacrifices is one of the highest forms of memorial ceremonies in Zong. Jade Suits can be used to honor Commanders who have perished. Depending on the circumstances of a Commander’s passing, such as location or cause of death, a Jade Suit can be burned, worn, submerged, or catapulted during their memorial ceremony...
LV6 - Mount of Simian
  • After you collect Jade Burial Suit in LV5, you approach ahead with Sol and Ves together on the flower raft. The gloomy wind in Boreas Gorge is fierce, and an ape statue appears in front of you. Simian was a Zong Commander whose true form was an ape. Known for his exceptional valor and benevolence, Simian would come to any living being or Commander’s rescue if they’re at risk of being harmed by vicious forces. Simian’s offsprings have formed a close bond with each other; they live in harmony and leave their mortal coil in pairs. After Simian passed away, each of his offsprings retrieved a mouthful of white soil at the peak of Mount Almitas. They sculpted the soil after Simian’s image on top of the mountain where Simian last appeared. The mountain was therefore named Mount Simian...

Key Features (Unique to that level)


LV1 - The Centiwell
  • Take the Imprint from Sol and start to have inquiry access to communicate with Zong's commanders/NPCs.
  • Pick up dead wood branch to write your name on the stone wall.
  • Take the Spiritual Eye from Sol that was given by the descendents of Retinentia.
  • Take the rock and scrape it against the stone wall to generate a fireball.
  • Tap the fireball to get teleported out of the secret passageway of Centiwell.
LV2 - Cliffside Tiger
  • Optional choice to interact with commander/NPC - high five and communicate with Sol.
  • Take the Friery Whip from Sol after Sol summoning the Mantra Kardia.
  • Use the Friery Whip to combat against the Osteospectral Tiger.
  • Take the syringe to draw Osteospectral Tiger's Bone Marrow and save it to Imprint for future use.
  • Gain the Mantra Kardia to summon Osteospectral Tiger for one chance for future use.
  • Learn to use Pitasarah Tree and Imprint System to look up more information that is unique to the world building of Zong.
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Fiery Whip
LV3 - The Captives
  • Take the Hammers of Zither from Sol.
  • Practice freely and get familiar with how to use Hammers of Zither.
  • Get teleported onto the Bridge of Atomos and the Dent Area through catching the Weave Bamboo delivered by Sol.
  • Knock down the attacking Captives swinging upwards from under the bridge using the Hammers of Zither.
  • Prepare for three different attacking frequencies from the Captives at each segmented spot on the bridge
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Bridge of Atomos
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Hammers of Zither
LV4 - Papaver Rhoeas
  • Take WellSpring Needles from the Custodian of Papaver Rhoeas.
  • Use WellSpring Needles to pierce Papaver Rhoeas falling from the sky level, both the silver ones and the golden ones.
  • Take the Espousal Staff from Sol and break the flower ledge using the Espousal Staff.
  • More access to inquiries and communicate with the Commander regarding unlocked questions.
  • Magic Appearance of Flower Ledge.
  • Immersive falling from Dent Area to the river across Boreas Gorge.
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Papaver Rhoeas
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Espousal Staff
  • Mantra Kardia to break off the Flower Ledge
LV5 - Jade Burial Suit
  • Drop flowerball to light up the crucible.
  • Take the Dionysian Slingshot from Sol.
  • Use the Dionysian Slingshot to shoot Zong's canaries.
  • Distance grab Golden Strings from Zong's canaries.
  • Give Golden Strings to Sol and prepare for producing Jade Burial Suit.
  • Pick up Li'er Jade Stone from Sol and place it on the raft.
  • Push and pull bellows to produce constant fires to produce Jade Burial Suit.
  • Take Shield of Frost from Sol.
  • Use Shield of Frost to pick up Jade Burial Suit from the crucible.
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Zong's canaries
  • Mantra Kardia to cut off Li'er Jade Stone
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Jade Burial Suit
LV6 - Mount of Simian
  • Grab the spawned Jade Burial Suit by clicking into the Imprint System.
  • Distance grab Simian statue while holding Jade Burial Suit and put the suit on Simian's body.
  • Summon Simian's heavenly spirit and being pushed away by its wakeup power.
  • Distance grab seven water droplets representing seven sub-dimensions of Zong and save them to Imprint System for future use.
  • Distance grab Discernment Eye and save it to Imprint System.
  • Distance grab White Soil and save it to Imprint System.
  • Distance grab Umbrella Pugna and save it to Imprint System.
  • Practice using Umbrella Pugna and learn to shoot piperis.
  • Interact with Simian's tail and immerse in glorious lights.
  • Mantra Kardia to summon Simian's heavenly spirit.

Common Features(Across levels)


Pitasarah System
  • Accumulative scores calculation using the Pitasarah Fragment, Pitasarah Segment, Pitasarah Fruit, and the Pitasarah Tree.
Arcane Rank
  • All living beings in Zong have an Arcane Rank. From low to high, they are: Grana - Cyma - Virga - Thalla - Virgulta - Catoma - Palma - Amicula - Umbra - Silva - Auxiliary Commander - Ancillary Commander - Primary Commander - Supreme Commander.
  • Player's Arcane Rank will be shown based on the growth of Pitasarah System.
Level Selection
  • Levels need to be started from The Centiwell. Once six levels are complete, free selection is available on the Main Menu to enter into one certain level.
UI System
  • UI system is presented through the usage of the Imprint granted by Sol in the Centiwell.
  • All information saved can be found through searching tabs in Imprint.
  • UI canvas can be dragged in VR to your best sight.
Mantra Kardia
  • Mantra Kardia is the source power to summon creatures and weapons in the world of Zong. Currently, Mantra Kardias are summoned by commanders/NPCs only.
Immersive Effects
  • Immerse in the striking beauty of Papaver Rhoeas and the Mount of Simian.
Game Items
  • Interact with game items in general

Note


To keep the proceeding storylines confidential, key features and common features will be updated as we update to a new level.

2334600.name: Family Land - Farmer Simulator
2334600.about_the_game:
Many people dream of running away from the city to the countryside. When you get a chance to buy a farm in Tennessee, you don't hesitate for a moment.
Located in a picturesque spot, surrounded by forested hills, it is truly awe-inspiring.
But there’s a lot of work ahead of you. The buildings are falling apart, so is the equipment. The animals wander around as they please, and the fields are slowly turning into a forest. Even Old Bill who sold us the farm is still living in the shed, the thought of moving out never even crossing his mind.

Time to roll up your sleeves and get to work. The farm needs a serious renovation to become an ecological agricultural enterprise. A humorous story about the struggles of a townie who decided to become a farmer. This simulator will provide you with hours and hours of unconstrained entertainment.

Renovate!

All the buildings need to be renovated. The old boards and tiles have to be removed. Some elements have to be torn down. You need to clean the stables, get rid of rats and mice. You can choose whatever you need from the range of available tools and options to rebuild the farm just the way you like it. You are free to decide what you want to do first.

Build!

If your aim is to have an ecological farm, you need to plan its development. You can construct new buildings or expand the existing ones. Change the interiors and room layouts. Your budget is the only limit.

Cultivate the land and breed animals!

The fields have been lying fallow for a long time. You will need to grub up the trees, remove the weeds and sow corn. Ecological farm has its own rules. There is a lot of manual work to do. Grow tomatoes, green beans, cotton, soya, corn, wheat and sorghum.
As you renew the stable and the barn, you can build new corrals for the animals. You can breed horses, cows, sheep, goats, chickens, rabbits and bees.

Sell your products!

Open a store and sell goods from your farm. Invite people from the city to your fields and your orchard, and let them harvest your crops for a fee. Organize family events. Sell your goods in bulk to supermarkets.


Hire people!

As the farm grows, you’ll no longer be able to do everything by yourself. Hire people. Choose the actions they can perform using the UI. Monitor their work, fire them and hire new employees if there is a need.

Be careful!

Old Bill, who lives in the shed by the forest, won’t be very favorable towards your proceedings. Try to win him over. Maybe what he does in the shed can be included in your offer of goods. It's Tennessee, after all!
Set a weather station to protect yourself from dangerous weather events.
Foxes, martens and bears will be a pain in the neck. Build live-capture traps and protect your farm.

Surprises!

The neighborhood has its history. Taking a long walk might pay off. If you look around carefully enough, you may find some interesting objects, or even gold and silver! All of that can be sold, which will surely help you develop your farm.

2334640.name: Block & Balls
2334640.about_the_game:
Dive into the fast-paced world of Block & Balls, a captivating physics-driven, logic-packed 2D arcade experience. Take on a range of levels, from easy and enjoyable to intense and heart-pounding, each offering its own unique challenges. Discover endless creative mechanics that keep surprising you, with more levels and features being added frequently. Unleash your creativity using the intuitive level editor to craft your own custom stages and share them with friends. Compete against players worldwide on the competitive leaderboards, vying for the top spot. Get ready for an addictive gameplay experience that combines creativity, logic, action, blocks, and balls.

Welcome to Block & Balls, the home of a growing and creative community is listened to whose ideas are incorporated! Join this thriving community that values your input, as we work together to shape an extraordinary gaming experience. Wobbegong is committed to incorporating your feedback, ensuring Block & Balls becomes a game from and for the players, with your contributions and ideas at the forefront. Interact with our developers, share your thoughts, or show your own work and ideas on the official Discord or in the Community page. Celebrate your creativity by sharing custom levels, mechanics, and ideas with fellow gamers. Block & Balls offers endless fun for players of all ages!

Now the balls are in your hands, here you can see all the obstacles, enemies, fields, blocks, and other features you can encounter in the game:

Star: Every level contains a star that you must collect to achieve completion, like you.

Ball: Can be shot, caught, deflected, and destroyed. And it can activate, kill, deactivate, power, clear, and collect. You hold the balls. (I lied when I called you a star)

Shield: Deflect incoming balls and bullets with the shield. (You’re not a star)

AmmoBlock: Hit these to pick up ammo.

Smoke: Blocks your view.

Black Hole: Absorbs any loose object into void, including your balls.

Booster: Gives anything within it a speed boost.

Electrocution Field: Almost anything inside this field gets electrocuted and destroyed.

ForceField: When powered, nothing can penetrate it, not even your block or your balls. Cut the power to enter.

GravityField and Reverse GravityField: Encounter fields where gravity is applied normally or reversed. This will cause your balls to drop or fly up.

ElectricSource and CorruptSource: Interact with these fields to make a line of power or ‘non-power’.

BallControlField: You can manually move the balls that enter these fields.

Gravity + BallControl: Your balls act as a platformer.

Powercell: They activate and deactivate different game elements that can be powered.

Keylock: A powercell can be protected by a keylock, only if the right key is entered shall the powercell activate, and if the wrong key is entered it will NEVER activate.

Laser and FriendlyLasers: Handle lasers with care as they destroy most objects upon contact, but there are friendly versions that won't harm stars. (again you’re not a star)

LifeBlock: Face durable blocks that can withstand a certain number of hits before being destroyed.

MagnetBlock: Activates the magnetic field around your cursor, influencing object movement. (magnet, attractive)

MovingBlockLooper and MovingBlockOneTime: Blocks that move along a path, some that loop back and forth and others that move just once when enabled. (magnets are not attracted to me)

NegativeAmmoBlock: These blocks remove ammo. (It’s like AmmoBlock’s evil brother)

NoBallField: Field where you cannot enter with ammo or balls.

PortalBlocks: Discover teleportation mechanics, moving you when hit by a ball or colliding with you.

Triangle: Three edges, three vertices, all angles together add up to 180° (Just about didn’t make the title of the game)

Rotator: Rotates itself, and anything attached to it too.

SpedometerFast and SpedometerSlow: Only objects that move faster/slower than a certain speed can pass.

StickyWall: Anything that hits it, sticks, permanently.

ZeroGravBlock: This block functions just like a ball, but it’s not a ball… It can hold codes too (for the keylock maybe??? Ohhh)

Wall, TransparentWall, Firewall, and OneWayWall: Regular wall, wall that allows bullets and bombs to pass, wall that burns and destroys anything that touches it, Wall that can be passed through once.

Maze: It’s a maze (ing)

ENEMIES

Destroyer: Block that destroys anything that collides with it

LifeDestroyer: Like the Destroyer, but with a limited lifespan. Like a lifeblock.

Bullet: Swift and relentless, this enemy destroys the player on contact if not shielded.

Bomb: A deadly variant of the Bullet that can penetrate through shields. (Like bullet’s evil-er dog)

Senemy: Get ready for a chase as this enemy relentlessly pursues you. One well-aimed ball will bring it down.

Benemy: Watch out for this dangerous foe that shoots bullets from a distance. It will take multiple balls to the face before it stops.

Tenemy: Stay on guard as this stationary enemy launches bombs your way. Evade the explosives and find a strategic angle to neutralize this threat. (a turret)

Sawn: Similar to the Senemy, but with an eerie twist. Unaffected by obstructions, this ghost-like enemy moves through ANYTHING.

LEVELS

Different Level Variations:Small Box, Big Box, Horizontal Level, Vertical Level or a mix of them all: Encounter diverse level designs.

Note: Block & Balls is an ever-evolving game, with lots of community input, with updates regularly adding new features and levels to keep the adventure fresh and exciting.

LMB: Shoot

RMB: Shield

A or Left Arrow: Move left

D or Right Arrow: Move Right

D or Right Arrow: Move ball Right (while in BallControlZone)

W or Up arrow: Move ball up/Balljump (while in BallControlZone/GravityZone)

S or Down arrow: Move ball down (while in BallControlZone)

2334670.name: Battle Tea
2334670.about_the_game:
Battle Tea is a simple yet competitive word game where you fight against your friends until there's only one man standing. Play up to 8 players, or find people to play online. Are you tea master you may think your are?

How it works

By turns, each player must find a word that contains a certain 3-letter key quickly. Additionally, if the word meets certain criteria, you can attack the rest of players or heal yourself (or both at the same time). Each words is valued by their letters, rarer letters have bigger values than common ones, ranging from 1 to 10.

Available in various languages

The game uses a teapack system, those are the actual languages you can play with.
As of writting this, the game includes as vanilla the following languages:
English, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Russian.
We are currently planning to add more in the future!
Furthermore, you can create your own custom teapacks using a .json file

2334680.name: Novus
2334680.about_the_game: Novus aims to combine the Gorilla Tag type locomotion present in Gorilla Tag with the FPS genre of games mainly present on flat-screen games. There's an interactive type of movement in play which makes you have to use your hands to bounce of the ground to move where you want to, or you can use the dash. The goal is simply to shoot the other players and get as many kills as possible. There is also an in game proximity voice chat to help everyone communicate with each other and have fun! This way the game is more than 2x more immersing.

2334690.name: Detective Malinowski The Truth Will Be Revealed
2334690.about_the_game:
About the Game

Body found. Two missing. Detective Malinowski hears what others miss.

Atmospheric noir detective adventure (~2–3 hours of tense investigation you can complete in one sitting).

Step into the shoes of Detective Malinowski, a seasoned investigator drawn into a case that hits dangerously close to home. What begins as routine police work in a shadowy city quickly turns into a personal hunt for the truth.

Navigate atmospheric locations using your wits and your hearing. Footsteps in empty hallways, creaking doors and faint radio melodies all carry clues. Listen carefully to move from scene to scene and piece together what really happened.

Your graphic compass helps you move through each location, while hand‑drawn illustrations capture key moments in your personal sketchbook — a visual record of the entire case.

Full English and Polish voice acting brings Malinowski’s world to life through dialogue, inner monologues and environmental audio. Subtitles in both languages make the whole story fully accessible.

The story leads you toward one gripping conclusion. No branching paths — just focused exploration, careful listening and atmosphere that thickens with every scene.

Original music and ambient soundscapes build a tense noir mood, especially on headphones.

Perfect if you:

  • Like short, story‑driven detective games you can finish in a single evening.

  • Want story‑first experiences where sound and ambient audio guide your next step.

  • Prefer focused, linear stories with one strong conclusion.

  • Value games built around atmosphere, ambient sound, music and voice acting.

Truth waits for no one. Start now.

2334730.name: Death Must Die
2334730.about_the_game:

Yet this time, an unsung higher power had chosen to back our heroes in their quest. Toss a coin in my hat here traveler, if you wish to hear The Saga of Death's Demise."

Death Must Die is a roguelite RPG bullet heaven in which you play as the heroes trying to defeat Death.
A pantheon of gods guides the heroes in their quest, each granting different powerful blessings.
Learn why the gods have decided to stand against one of their own and uncover the personal stories behind each of the heroes as you explore the Underworld.

Features:

  • Face off and defeat the Guardians protecting each circle
  • Discover ancient shrines, mythical creatures and the other inhabitants of the Underworld
  • Choose from hundreds of god blessings to create synergetic and varied builds

2334760.name: The Elderseed
2334760.about_the_game:
The Elderseed is an action adventure platformer inspired by the classic 2D side scrolling adventure games of the 1980s. Battle your way through an assortment of unique creatures. Upgrade your equipment to increase your chances of survival. Interact with an array of characters in the world who will help you with your journey.


Explore the different set pieces from forests and caves to fields and dungeons. Interact with the world to solve puzzles and find hidden passages in order to continue your journey.



In this adventure you play a young man named Milo, who comes upon a nearby forest after his home is devastated by the Tares of Bedlam. Searching for personal aid, he discovers his destiny is intertwined with the fate of the realm. Set out and explore a wide world full of adventure while learning of the mystery of the Elderseed to forestall the coming chaos.

2334800.name: Harm Other
2334800.about_the_game:
Harm Other is a two-button narrative comedy game with art + music by Jay Tholen (Hypnospace Outlaw, Dropsy) consisting of five chapters with vastly different locations and themes:

  • Chapter I: KNEE DEEP IN THE READ
  • Chapter II: THY TEXT CONSUMED
  • Chapter III: WORD ME PLENTY
  • Chapter IV: BOOKMARKED FOR DEATH
  • Chapter V: ASHES TO ASHES, DUST TO DUST JACKET

The beginning of the game will occur at the start of Chapter I, the middle will be somewhere around Chapter III, and the end will probably be found in the last bit of Chapter V.



In the far flung future the response to every decision in life - no matter how enormous or insignificant - is a formal choice between Harm and Other.

As a DropCo Intergalactic Independent Contractor you are uniquely trained to make such decisions in an official capacity by pressing a pair of brightly colored buttons. Often with very little information. Always with no idea what Harm or Other could possibly mean in the current context. In exchange for your extraordinary talents you earn nearly half of a living wage.

2334820.name: The Girl From The Snuff Video
2334820.about_the_game:
STORY

A visual novel about Nastya, a sales assistant in an electronics store. Her life is full of stress: a strict boss forcing her to sell unmarketable garbage, perpetually dissatisfied customers, an endless flow of goods and paperwork... All of this can cripple even the toughest person.

The protagonist has long refused psychotherapy and antidepressants. Instead, she found another way to maintain her mental health: after a hard day's work, she relieves stress by watching a snuff video, justifying it by the fact that everything happening on the screen isn’t real.

One night she stumbles upon a new video of the murder of a young woman. After watching it, the image of the stranger sits firmly in her mind and from that moment on she cannot think of anything else...

CHARACTERS


Diana is a manager from the store where Nastya works. Like all salespeople, she tries to sell something overpriced rather than match the customer with the right product.

But who knows, maybe behind the mask of a soulless sales machine hides a completely different person?


Katya. One day a mysterious girl from the snuff video comes into the store where the protagonist works. Nastya is very happy about this sudden coincidence, but she can't even imagine how this meeting will turn out for her.

Very soon the protagonist will realize that the world of snuff videos is much closer and more dangerous than she imagined.

FEATURES

  • Visual Novel, Psychological Thriller
  • Psychological disorders
  • Screen resolution 1440x1080 px (4:3 aspect ratio)
  • An anxious dark atmosphere, which will be conveyed to the player through unusual sounds and visual effects

Add to your wishlist now and don't miss the release!

2334850.name: SHIRIME: The Curse of Butt-Eye
2334850.about_the_game:
SHIRIME: The Curse of Butt-Eye | 尻目 is the story of a Yokai called Shirime.

This is the first chapter in a series of horror games - 7TaleZ - based on Japanese folklore.

As the protagonist John, your objective is to find your missing girlfriend Sharon in the creepy Shirime Forest. However, your journey is not without peril as you are stalked by the eerie and malevolent yokai, Shirime.

To survive, you'll need to hide and run to evade Shirime's pursuit, making sure to pay attention to your surroundings and use the environment to your advantage.

The gameplay focuses on exploration, survival horror, and evasion elements. Your primary objective is to collect pages scattered throughout the forest that will reveal the story behind Sharon's disappearance.

However, each page you collect increases the intensity of Shirime's pursuit, making it harder to progress. You'll need to use your wits to evade and outrun Shirime while exploring the forest and finding new pages.

Speaking of the Yokai Shirime, the kanji is written as 尻目. 尻 (shiri) means "buttocks" while 目 (me) means "eye." So, literally translated, Shirime means "butt eye."

THE CURSE OF BUTT-EYE is a challenging and engaging horror game that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Can you uncover the truth about Sharon's disappearance and escape the curse of Shirime?

2334910.name: The Chalice of Illusion
2334910.about_the_game:
The Chalice of Illusion is an immersive tinkering game. Puzzles, enemies, dialogue, visuals, sound and more are all alike governed by a single supernatural order of hexing form sigils. This world will be presented to you with no restrictions, context or introduction. You will be gently nudged out of your confusion by subtle, tasteful, unobtrusive design that pushes you into figuring out the rules of how everything works by yourself.
This is a game that emphasizes the memorable experiences found in poking around, guessing and testing out assumptions about the unfamiliar. Its priorities are in player autonomy and internally consistent mechanics that express novelty and surprise by overextending in unusual ways.

Features:

  • Freely explore Panissari Castle and its interconnected surrounding areas at your own pace.
  • Universal symbolic grid hexing that unifies disparate systems into a consistent ruleset.
  • Unhinged memorability always favored over balance – or even sanity in a general sense.
  • Intentionally exploitable unintuitive interactions that reward continuous experimentation.

2334930.name: DEEPEST FEAR™
2334930.about_the_game:
DEEPEST FEAR™ is a sci-fi horror FPS with a retro-future aesthetic. Deep beneath the ocean, a long dormant secret has been unearthed which throws mankind’s future into jeopardy.

ENTER THE DEEP

As Dr. Danni Carrol, fight your way to the heart of a secret project masterminded by your estranged father and uncover mysteries both deeply personal and terrifying in their implications.

FEAR THE WATER

Using real time fluid simulation, fight otherworldly entities which manifest spontaneously from any water source, all while the environment around you can flood and take in water at any moment, sweeping you away with unpredictable currents, plunging you into the suffocating depths.

IMMERSIVE SIM + METROIDVANIA

Deepest Fear combines Metroidvania level design in the context of a classic FPS immersive sim, where the game’s setting is a puzzle to unravel and where creativity and improvisation are your greatest assets.

RETRO-FUTURISTIC HORROR

Channeling the spirit of iconic and subversive 1980s horror action films such as The Abyss, The Thing, The Fly, and Total Recall, and more broadly the cinematic canons of James Cameron, John Carpenter, David Cronenberg, and Paul Verhoven, Deepest Fear aims to stay true to our inspirations’ blend of visceral horror, vivid characterisation, and confrontational storytelling. Meanwhile in the realm of interactivity, our thoughts are never far from titles such as Metroid Prime, Half-Life 2, System Shock 2, and Dead Space.

2334940.name: Cosmic Worm Food
2334940.about_the_game:
With Cosmic Worms threatening to devour planets, you must jump straight into the belly of the beast and destroy the creature from the inside, before it's too late!

Cosmic Worm Food is an action platformer roguelike. It is inspired by other pixel art classics such as Risk of Rain, Downwell, Vampire Survivors, and VVVVVV. It features constant adrenaline pumping action with a large variety of enemies, bosses, upgrades and parkour puzzles for the player to enjoy.


Gameplay
Cosmic Worms are threatening the galaxy, devouring planets that take their fancy, only our brave (disposable) heroes (fools) can stop them in their tracks. By jumping into the belly of the beast, they must locate the Cosmic Worm's heart and destroy it. You will explore through the ruined remains of planets, teleporting between spaceships, satellites, and colonies, all slowly being digested by the great beast.

All good platformers must feel great, they need to feel responsive and intuitive. The movement must feel deliberate, with full control being granted to the player. This is the core ethos of Cosmic Worm Food, and it achieves that with tight air control, wall jumping, wall sliding, and consistent, reliable physics.



On their journey, the player will encounter a variety of different monsters, all with unique mechanics and combinations to offer their own challenge for the player to take on. Always keep on the move, making use of both horizontal and vertical movement to avoid the parasites' attacks. As the player destroys the flora and fauna inhabiting the Cosmic Worm's stomach, they are rewarded with tokens to spend on upgrades in the various shops found about the level.



Each character comes with their own selection of four unique abilities. A primary and secondary ability for offensive purposes, a utility ability for defensive purposes, and an ultimate ability. Each ability is accompanied by their own diverging tree of upgrades, all available for purchase at one of the various shops found around the level. Some upgrades may be exclusive and can lock other upgrades from being chosen, so choose wisely! None of the upgrades take your fancy? No problem, just spend a couple of tokens to re-roll your options and create the build you want!

As you progress through the run, you'll explore the partially digested remains of many different planets and ruins (each with many alternative levels to add variety to each run). All these levels are created by hand to make each feel unique, fair, and with purpose. All of these levels will come with jumping puzzles, spike traps, turrets, environmental conditions and hazards, and more, with rewards for anyone daring enough to take up the challenge!



In order for the player to activate the teleporter and progress to the next level, they must first find and resolve a number of arenas scattered around the level. Each arena comes with it's own unique challenge, including timed survival, enemy killing, boss slaying, sample collecting, and hive infestation destroying.

Eventually, the player will find the Cosmic Worm's heart, be warned, destroying it will be no easy task! It'll take both skill and strength to defeat it and rid the galaxy of the beast... For now...


Key Features
  • Action platformer roguelike
  • Wall-jumping, dashing, jump-pads, and more
  • Hand-crafted levels with procedural generation intertwined
  • 3 completely different characters on release
  • 4 abilities per character, each of which can be upgraded in a multitude of ways
  • Each character comes with their own unique upgrades
  • Full controller support
  • 4-Player local coop
  • Online coop
  • Steam achievements

2334990.name: Green New Deal Simulator
2334990.about_the_game:
The Green New Deal Simulator is a tiny deck-building game about the biggest challenge of our time: climate change. Your goal is to transition the United States to a post-carbon economy while ensuring full employment.
Invest in renewable energy sources, end fossil fuel consumption, capture the CO2 in the atmosphere, update the energy grid, research new green technologies… But watch out: the clock is ticking, and it seems like the budget is never enough!

Features
The Green New Deal Simulator is the long-awaited sequel to the Democratic Socialism Simulator. It features a completely new gameplay while maintaining the same accessibility.
Drag and drop your action cards onto various regions of the USA, evaluate their impact, and expand your deck. A game lasts about 40 minutes.


- Intuitive board game-like mechanics
- 22 action cards based on real-world policies and solutions
- A cast of proud working class animals
- Original soundtrack by Jesse Stiles made with locally sourced analog synthesizers
- 100% free: no ads, no subscriptions, no in-game purchases

Join Kairi in her adventure and explore the city, meet new girls, and try to form a group overcoming all the odds while having a lot of girl-on-girl action!

2335060.name: Ra Ra BOOM
2335060.about_the_game:
Ra Ra BOOM is a 4-player local co-op brawler. Perfect to play solo on a weekend, but even better with friends (Remote Play Together supported). Choose your hero, bash some robots, and upgrade to increase the chaos.

Who needs perfect grades when rogue AI is trashing Earth? The planet’s in pieces, robots are running wild, and only four high schoolers from outer space have the moves to save it.

Choose to play as Aris, Saida, Ren, or Vee through nine colorful levels. Collect Scrap by beating baddies and then spend it to upgrade your stats or unlock abilities.

With casual pick-up-and-play, but just a touch of choice and customization, Ra Ra BOOM brings the spirit of retro arcades into a fast, modern co-op brawler.

2335200.name: Project Horror Anthology: Project Prequel
2335200.about_the_game:
Synopsis

"Evelynn, is a military woman who has just returned to her hometown, where she lives with her mother and brother.... Nonetheless, something in the town doesn't seem to be right. An accident occurs and the residents start attacking each other.... Join the survivors, make friends or enemies and fight creatures to escape this nightmare."

Mechanics


  • Real-time combat - Knowing how to survive is knowing how to fight, and here we won't have any turn-based combat.



  • Item management - Your items are limited, but you won't survive if you mismanage your resources.



  • Character relationship system - Your attitudes and choices will make a difference in how your character will be perceived by the group, and may even unlock new interactions and different endings.



  • Sanity control - People are not made of iron, and neither is the protagonist here. You will be able to face creatures on your way, but be careful, if you overdo it too much you will end up suffering the consequences.



  • Puzzles - It's not only the graphics that remind you of old games, but the puzzles too! Set aside a piece of paper to write them down and solve the mistery, your life may depend on solving it.

2335220.name: Dolls
2335220.about_the_game:
Escape from this dark dimension and return to reality!


On an ordinary day, a student is suddenly and mysteriously transported to a parallel reality: an abandoned place immersed in darkness. Surrounded by sinister dolls and with no sign of human life, her mission is clear: find a way out of this nightmare and return to the real world.

"Dolls" is a first-person horror game that immerses the player in a dark environment filled with dimly lit corridors and disturbing sounds. Discover the hidden secrets in this macabre setting and unravel the mysteries behind this terrifying experience.


Be careful in the dark, there may be beings who do not welcome your presence!

Amidst the shadows and wreckage of this abandoned place, it is essential to remain vigilant, as dangerous creatures roam the dark corridors, sensing your presence. Proceed with extreme caution and avoid looking back at all costs.


Try to escape as quickly as possible before going insane in the darkness.

Explore the darkness, solve puzzles, and run to find an exit, but this won't be an easy task, as the inhabitants of this dimension are keenly aware of your presence!


And uncover all the secrets of this shadowy place.

What is this place? Who are these dolls? How did I end up here? Embark on the exploration and unravel the mysteries of this dark reality while searching for an exit.

Game Features


  • See the game world through the eyes of the main character, providing an immersive first-person experience.
  • Enjoy a heavy and ominous atmosphere that keeps the tension at its peak, immersing you in horror.
  • Navigate detailed environments and explore eerie locations to uncover secrets and find essential items.
  • Immersive and unsettling sounds heighten the suspense and fear throughout the game.
  • Uncover a compelling story while unraveling the mysteries of the alternate reality.
