🏎️ Racing
Compete in a race where the fastest to complete the laps wins. Use skillful driving to navigate the track and beat your opponent.


🏸 Badminton
Basically tennis but with a shuttlecock instead of a ball. Get the shuttlecock to the opponent's side and win points.


🥌 Curling
Take turns sliding stones on the ice and try to get your stone the closest to the center.


⛳ Mini Golf
Get your golf ball through the obstacles and into the hole.


🏹 Archery
Shoot arrows at the target and try to hit as close to the center as you can.


Are you ready prove your skills? Dive into Mini Sports now and let the games begin!

2335300.name: Master Maker 3D Ultimate
2335300.about_the_game:
Clear retro 3D levels or build your own in this 3D action platformer for all ages!



Play as Master Maker, a young builder who possesses a special boomerang hammer capable of collecting items, destroying boxes and defeating enemies from a distance! In this 3D adventure inspired by classics of the ’90s, you can explore and build freely. Adventure mode features 50 colorful levels to inspire your constructions. Just move Master Maker from the starting point to the flag at the end of the stage by jumping across platforms, knocking out enemies and avoiding traps! Then Level Creator lets you build original stages however you like by adding blocks, coins, spikes, cannons, trees, decorations, ramps and much more!



Presented in high-definition 3D style, Master Maker 3D Ultimate is a low-poly action experience that’s fun for the whole family, and replay value is practically limitless since you can use your imagination to keep creating long after the main stages have been cleared. Plus, if you complete Adventure mode, you’ll unlock 350 new levels to enjoy at any time!



Features:

2335330.name: Uncle Kenny The Game

  • A varied and energetic OST: Made mostly by me, along with a few tracks by friends!

  • Swingshot: a tool utilized by Uncle Kenny to swing his way through several areas while fighting off enemies simultaneously

  • Fun Shoot 'em up Gameplay: Which evolves as Uncle Kenny furthers his collection of weapons!

2335340.name: Asteroids: Multiplayer
2335340.about_the_game:
Asteroids: Multiplayer is a completely new interpretation of the classic Asteroids.

The game is focused on cooperative multiplayer. Thanks to the possibility of participation of an unlimited number of players, playing it with friends is especially fun! The gameplay allows you to share combat missions between participants. While some of them jointly manage a large ship, others provide support for it with fighters. A variety of ships and weapons will allow anyone to find a task to their liking.

A realistic physics engine will make each passage of the level unique. And responsive controls in open space will provide players with vivid emotions. High-quality visual and sound design, as well as great music written specifically for this game, will immerse you in the exciting atmosphere of space battles.

Shoot asteroids and fight as a team against various opponents in the new game - Asteroids: Multiplayer!


Game Features:
● Unlimited Players
● Realistic physics engine
● Management of large ships and stations in several players
● Quality soundtracks and sound
● Nice graphics and special effects
● Original enemies and boss on every 5th level
● Various ships and weapons
● Can be played with keyboard and gamepad

2335350.name: Linxy The Lynx
2335350.about_the_game:
Linxy is known for saving his home (Mangoberry Island) from the nefarious Prof.B.Ray on a weekly basis and this time it's not all that different, B.Ray is up to some scheme that revolves using his Nature Taker-er to power his Linxy Destroyer-er!

Overview
Play as Linxy and use his slick moves to get to Prof.B.Ray's fortress! Along the way you'll find bounce pads and aerial bounce pads that'll boost you vertically and horizontally respectively, you'll encounter grind rails that Linxy can ride at high speeds but it's not a smooth ride you'll need to be quick in order to jump bottomless pits, stalagmite pits and lava pits that split rails apart!

Collectables
Along your way you'll find little motherboard looking things called Remix Chips, these chips allow you to unlock new levels that are harder and introduce a couple of new mechanics you won't encounter on your normal journey.
Collect a ton of Coconuts for a final secret!

Moveset
Linxy has an easy to learn hard to master moveset so anyone at any skill level can pick up the game and play!
Linxy has your typical jump, a double jump, a slide and a slide jump!
The slide jump prioritizes distance over height so if you want to get up to higher ground you're best off normal jumping.
As for a slide it will give Linxy a temporary burst of speed and can be used to pop every enemy in the game!

2335370.name: Virvius
2335370.about_the_game:
A first person, Horror Boomer Shooter, inspired by Dark Fantasy FPS games from the 90's.
Scour through the fallen foundry, obscuring demonic-hanical enemies and creatures whilst plundering to your death or circumvent through harsh environments and traps.

Let the gun do the talking, so sit back, relax and blow things to pieces!

Bringing back the old school experience of boomer shooter games from the 90's,

Designed passionately with Enfenyx style.

-Different UI color themes to choose.

[Windows supported only.]

*** GAME TESTED IN 4K! ***

2335450.name: Cook'n'Slash
2335450.about_the_game:
Cook'n'Slash is a slasher game featuring multiple game modes: boss battles, territory clearing, arena battles and...cooking!

A large corporation has released a new kind of fertilizer that makes plants grow faster, literally by the hour. But things didn't go to plan: the plants didn't just grow, they came to life and started terrorizing the whole neighborhood! Only the chef at the small restaurant knows what to do: it's not the first time he has to deal with vegetables, and it's not the first time he toasted a steak!

It's up to you to rid the town of bloodthirsty vegetables and punish those responsible for this hilarious apocalypse!

Cook'n'Slash features:
  • Many various levels with different mechanics;
  • Bonuses and modifiers that allow you to do even more damage;
  • Several types of weapons, including ranged weapons;
  • Over a dozen of different enemies, from tomatoes and cucumbers to pomegranates, steaks and sausages!
  • Several powerful bosses that will test your mettle;
  • Colourful effects: juice splashes, explosions and more!

If you feel brave and hugry, try your hand at Cook'n'Slash! Who knew chopping vegetables could be so cool!

2335540.name: The Mystery Of The Moon
2335540.about_the_game:
Introduction:

This is an indie game developed by a single person. If you encounter any problems in the game, please leave a message or contact me.The Msytery Of The Moon uses Unreal® Engine. Unreal® is a trademark or registered trademark of Epic Games, Inc. in the United States of America and elsewhere. Unreal® Engine, Copyright 1998 – 2024, Epic Games, Inc. All rights reserved.


Story background:

With the recent technological advances, humans have achieved lunar colonization. Meanwhile, humans have established a joint scientific research institution on the moon to conduct scientific research. Through controlled nuclear fusion technology, humans have successfully obtained fuel from lunar rocks for nuclear fusion and realized wireless power supply and artificial gravitational atmosphere to ensure that the oxygen and pressure around the base are maintained at near-earth levels.

Due to anomalies in the moon's orbit, the human base on the moon is frequently attacked by unknown creatures. Currently, humans have evacuated the relevant personnel of the lunar base. Now, as a military scout, you are sent to the moon to investigate the anomalies and find solutions to the problems.

Stage 1: Survival

You wake up from the lunar base and the first thing you need to do is to maintain supplies and energy, and find ways to survive. Explore and collect raw materials, produce essential items.



Stage 2: Defense

There are often attacks from unknown creatures around the spacecraft docked in space. You need to strengthen the defense turret construction to ensure that the spacecraft is not destroyed so that you have hope of returning to Earth.



Stage 3: Exploration

By developing your own equipment and supplies and increasing endurance, you can go to surrounding buildings and mysterious places to explore treasures, discover anomalies and mysterious spaces, and solve crises. At the same time, you can establish branch base constructions, allowing yourself to have temporary shelter.



Stage 4: Solve anomalies

You will encounter different mysterious bosses, collect their drops, open hidden spaces, solve the final problem, and return to Earth or continue your leisure travel on the moon.

2335550.name: Delivery Impossible
2335550.about_the_game:
Delivery Impossible is a crazy delivery simulator that will suit both adult players and young racing fans. Add this game to your wishlist!

Dodge UFOs, fight military caterpillars, destroy everything you see. Above all, get your cargo to the destination point. At any cost!

10 Unique Vehicles

Unlock all 10 unique vehicles available in the game. Each of 10 main levels can be completed with any vehicle - even if it doesn't seem appropriate at first glance. All vehicles have unique design and characteristics - you will have to familiarize yourself with them thoroughly to succeed.

Destroyable Environment

Almost all game objects, except for buildings and some obstacles, can be destroyed! We took special care of how the physics work in Delivery Impossible, so that you get the most out of smashing the environment!

Unbelievable Cargo Loads

To complete the game, you'll need to perform more than 100 different deliveries. Buy cars to unlock new levels and revisit completed tracks with new vehicles. We tried to make every delivery memorable!

Unique Levels and Routes

Explore 10 highly detailed routes. The game features a variety of weather conditions and times of day, from sizzling desert heat to deep forest night.

Here's what we've got for you:
  • A mad tour through cozy city streets
  • Watermelon delivery in the countryside
  • Dinosaur skeleton transportation down a deserted railroad.
  • Jumping and flying on the skyscraper roofs
  • Escape from a UFO deep in the forest at night
  • Candy delivery in the "Sweet Kingdom".
  • Dangerous rappelling down a quarry with a truckload of dynamite
  • A crazy test drive of a giant monster truck.
...and even more!


The Future

At the end of the game you are in for a little surprise. The last and the craziest level will be revealed only after passing 9 main routes!

In the upcoming update we’ll add 5 more extra missions: Mommy's errands.

Achievements

There are more than 30 unique achievements in the game. To unlock them all, you'll have to try really hard!

Still Hesitating?

Try the Delivery Impossible demo! We guarantee - it won't leave you cold!

2335580.name: The Emperor Penguin Keita
2335580.about_the_game:
Keita, a brave emperor penguin, lost its way during the migration and would start an extraordinary adventure on the ice alone.
The blue sky, snow-white ground, enlargeable snowballs, interesting levels, unexpected endings and various level clearance methods will all get you immersed. Just control Keita to start your journey.
1. Tired of noisy and polluted environment, you will find long-lost freshness and tranquility in the game.
2. You will pass the level with an enlargeable snowball. The size of the snowball is adjustable, and so is the way to pass the level, which will get you a long-lost satisfaction.
3. The game level is designed full of mystery, and the following levels are difficult to pass in a single shot, so you need to keep trying.
4. After clearing the level, you will deeply feel the greatness in such an otherwise small game.
5. The game is educationally meaningful, and it’s also suitable for children.

2335610.name: ItemDay
2335610.about_the_game:
Welcome to the thrilling world of Item Day! Get ready to experience an intense 1 vs 4 multiplayer hide and seek game where every move could mean the difference between life and death.

Try our BETA version and give us your feedback about the game to help us improving it.



As a survivor, you must use all your wits and cunning to turn yourself into an item on the map and outsmart the relentless killer. With limited resources at your disposal, you'll need to remove corruption from the map to weaken your pursuer and give yourself the best chance of survival. Will you make it out alive, or will the killer claim another victim?

But beware, as the little corrupted one, your goal is to hunt down and eliminate the survivors before they can escape. You must use every tool at your disposal, including buying in-game items to gain an edge over your prey. Will you emerge victorious, or will the survivors evade your grasp?

Collect Gold Coin as you play and unlock new characters, profile icons, and other exciting rewards! And with a Quick Match system that lets you jump into the action in seconds, and a complete lobby creation/search system, you'll always find plenty of players to battle it out with.

So come on in and join the action soon! Whether you're playing alone or with friends, Item Day offers a chill and immersive gaming experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Don't wait, start playing today!

Discord




Don't forget to join our Discord community, where you can chat with other players, share strategies, and stay up to date on the latest news and updates.
You can give us your feedback about this BETA here.

WishList
And if you haven't added Item Day to your wishlist yet, be sure to do so to stay in the loop on all the latest developments and updates. With new content and features being added all the time, you won't want to miss a thing!

2335620.name: Delve Into Pawssion
2335620.about_the_game:
Set out on a role playing adventure in this NSFW Furry Turn based RPG with visual novel touches!

This game is heavily focused on rewarding the player with NSFW Art on a wide variety of furry (and not so furry) characters!

Accomplish this by progressing on Main Quests and Side-quests, interacting with specific places or buying a potion for youself to Gender-Swap back and forth!

Depending on the quests, you may receive Pictures or Animations which can be revisited at the Gallery menu. Some are very easy to unlock while others are quite a challenge!

And easy going Story with visual novel touches awaits you.

You find yourself visiting an Adult themed Amusement Park and a virtual role playing game catches your attention. Inside you will dive into a world based on the stories constructed by all the characters who joined while unaware of a mysterious entity that lurks in the shadows.

Your adventure is based on a virtual world where a lot of other people joined to have fun! Each character will share a story with you to enjoy.

The Main Quests has larger stories, while the Side-Quests are shorter.

Single Party Combat: You will travel alone for most of your adventure, with the occasional companion joining you temporarily. This allows the combat to be designed for you to take on any challenge on your own.

The combat is a traditional frontal Turn-based system with additional mechanics added, like Quick Cas, Cooldowns and Skill combo synergies. Use these and more to strategically conquer your enemies with all at your disposal.

Customizable builds: Your character has a variety of ways to get stronger! Leveling up through exp, purchasing stat boosts to match your playstyle, secure Badges, Skills and Items from the Shop, and even collecting monsters can all increase your strength.

Each class has it's own unique way of strengthening itself, like the Assimilative Feline, that gains new skills and strength based on the personality you develop through the responses you give to other characters.

Monster Backyard: Find friendly monsters along your journey! These collectible monsters don't fight and will stay in the backyard at town. They will even grant you permanent bonuses and other traits!

Costumes: As you play through the game, you'll be able to change your appearance. These changes don't affect the NSFW content.

Gender_Swap: Drink a potion to swap to a Female body, which will unlock some new interactions and Art! (Gender Swap only affects a portion of the Art dedicated to the Female form).

A variety of locations, secrets and more!

2335640.name: Kay's Destiny
2335640.about_the_game:
Epic and emotional epic quest: Experience a story that explores themes of self-discovery and inner strength, wacky/humorous scenes with selectable choices and tributes to movies or other videogames.



Play like it's 1994!: Enjoy a nostalgic experience with classic CRT-style graphics, a selectable filter that turns your monitor to a cathode ray tube TV, bringing the look and feel of Golden era of JRPGs and games of '80s-'90s.

Intense Battles: Battle against fearsome monsters and powerful enemies using a range of weapons and spells, with fast-paced, turn-based combat that will put your skills to the test.



Piano-Driven Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the emotional journey with a beautiful and evocative soundtrack, featuring emotional piano melodies, composed by the developer, that perfectly complement the game's themes that will stay with you long after the credits roll.

Character Development: Customize and develop your characters over time, choosing from a range of equipments and abilities that will shape your journey and determine your ultimate fate.



Tons of content: With multiple endings, side quests with unique rewards, minigames, extra dungeons, challenges, optional characters and hidden secrets, you'll have plenty of reasons to revisit the world of "Kay’s Destiny" again and again.



Discover and dominate hidden powers that will help you in your way opening new paths or making you discover useful special items.





Find and ride ships, steampunk machines, airships and so on!



Completionists will be rewarded by something special that goes beyond the game itself!

2335670.name: Bark & Blade
2335670.about_the_game:
Your person never came home. Now it's time to find them.

Time to be a very good boy.

Bark & Blade is a third-person adventure where you play as a loyal dog on a journey to find their missing owner. Explore ancient forests, crystal caves, scorching deserts, and volcanic depths. Something is wrong with the world, and only you can sniff out the truth.

They would never leave you. You will never stop looking.

BE THE DOG

Bark to alert allies, startle creatures, activate portals, and more.

Dig to uncover buried treasures and hidden paths.

Sniff to reveal color-coded scent trails: weapons, gear, allies, enemies, and secrets each carry their own scent.

Zoomies to dash at wild, unstoppable speed without costing Stamina. Discover more charges as you explore.

Swim through rivers, lakes, and the desert oasis.

Sneak past enemies or get the drop on them.

Double jump to reach higher ledges and hidden paths.

Fight with melee combos, ranged magic, and new abilities you gain along the way.

Idle for a few moments and your dog will lie down to rest, which regenerates Stamina faster. Stay longer and they'll fall asleep. Eat food to recover health. Every animation is a little reward for just... being a dog.

EXPLORE YOUR WAY

Each area is handcrafted and packed with things to find. Track your progress across bones collected, secrets discovered, dig spots uncovered, and animals helped.

Progress to the next region by collecting all bones, finding all secrets, or completing other goals. There's more than one way forward.

Rest at wells to save. Watch for environmental hazards! You'll get a warning when danger is close, and some areas require the right gear to survive. Face enemies that guard each region and or sneak past them.

Play to the final area to find out what happens to the best boy and his human.

DOG VISION

A whimsical take on how the world might look through canine eyes. Colors shift toward a blue-yellow spectrum. Nights come alive with enhanced bloom and brightness to reflect a dog's superior low-light vision. A soft vignette frames your view, shifting from warm daylight tones to cool blues after dark.

Fun first, grounded second. Adjust bloom, vignette, and other visual effects to your preference.

DOG NOSE

A dog's nose is its superpower (or one of them). Activate Scent Vision and the world fills with drifting puffs of color, each one representing a different category of scent. Weapons, helms, upgrades, allies, enemies, and hidden secrets all carry their own hue. It's a playful way to imagine what a dog might actually experience ... hundreds of invisible layers of information, translated into something you can see and follow.

FEATURES

  • Third-person action-adventure built entirely around being a dog

  • Bark, dig, sniff, swim, sneak, dash, double jump, and fight

  • Dog Vision: adjustable visual effects inspired by real canine biology

  • Scent Vision: color-coded trails that visualize what your nose already knows

  • Melee and ranged combat with unlock-able abilities and equitable gear

  • Encounter various enemies guarding each region 

  • Environmental hazards with proximity warnings and damage-over-time zones

  • Stamina system: run, jump, rest, and sleep to manage your energy

  • Health and mana bars with on-screen indicators

  • Up to 4 save profiles with detailed per-area progress tracking

  • Multiple progression paths: bones, secrets, or other goals unlock new portals

  • A complete in-game guide with hints and detailed info

FROM THE DEVELOPER

Hi, I'm a solo developer with a background in computer engineering. By day I work in software development and embedded systems. The rest of the time, I build games.

Bark & Blade started in 2022 because I wanted to make a laid-back adventure game where you play as a goofy dog who goes looking for their human. Light challenges, lots of exploring, and plenty of barking along the way.

This game is a labor of love, and I'm committed to improving and expanding it based on player feedback. Every report, suggestion, and review matters. I read all of it. Release day isn't the finish line: patches, updates, and new content will keep coming for as long as players are along for the ride.

Thanks!

- Matt

GIVING BACK

Dogs inspired this game; real dogs and animals should benefit from it, too!

Semi-annually a portion of Bark & Blade's net sales revenue (after US taxes and Steam's platform fees) will be donated to Best Friends Animal Society, a leading organization working to end the killing of dogs and cats in America's shelters. If Best Friends is unavailable, funds will go to a comparable animal welfare organization.

Donation receipts will be made public. When you support Bark & Blade, you're not just playing a game about a very good dog - you're helping real ones!

2335690.name: The House of E.
2335690.about_the_game:
The House of E. is a story-driven puzzle game with horror elements and a creepy atmosphere.

As you explore the darkest corners of the spooky mansion, you will collect items and solve riddles. Notes and newspaper pages will shed light on past events, and all combined will put you one step closer to discovering the truth. And in the end, you will have to decide not only about Emma’s fate.

Although David and Emma Adams are siblings, they grew apart in time. But when the news of Emma's disappearance reaches David, he decides to do whatever is in his power to find her. Seeing the hopelessness of the local PD, he decides to take the matter into his own hands.

The trail leads him to the old mansion owned by a mystery horror novelist, who, as it turns out, also vanished without a trace. Believing those disappearances are not a coincidence, David goes to the manor.

2335720.name: 69 Balls

A Third-Person shooting game but you are not a person. You are a BALL!

Imagine a pool ball, a shotgun and football mechanics mashed together! You said you can't? Neither do I! Just shoot everything you see and pray if the black ball goes in!

2335740.name: Jeff: The Hungry Fish
2335740.about_the_game:
Jeff: The Hungry Fish is a single-player mode aquatic themed arcade-style game where you eat and devour to rise above the food chain.

Play as Jeff, a small fish hungry to take on the entire sea. Swim through areas and prey on fish smaller than you. Get bigger the more you devour and move on to the next area, in search of more prey. Become the apex predator of the ocean.

But it’s not that easy. You start as a mere prey and as you grow, there will still be bigger and more dangerous fish out there. Maneuver and evade them until you’re big enough to eat them instead. And remember, there’s always a bigger fish.

Eat-and-Grow to Advance

Gradually Increasing Difficulty

Test Your Knowledge on Marine Life!

You are dead, but it is Your lucky death: sometimes to those who dies is given the possibility to FIGHT FOR RESURRECTION!!! in the after death realm devils and demons are bored, they want enjoy some fight to the death(again) ... and Your death is one of that lucky one in which You can choose a new body, fight 10 matches, and if You survive then You can keep Your new body and resurrect ... are You willing to accept the challenge?

2335800.name: Temporal Shore
2335800.about_the_game:
A unique blend of roguelike deckbuilding and survival strategy, where you control your characters only with your cards. You not only play your actions, but also decide who to perform them. Can you break the time loop and lead your team to safety, or will you die trying?

Build your team

Explore the island and search for other survivors. Unite your team from a diverse cast of characters, each with their unique abilities, bonuses, and Disaster cards!

Your team is more than just a list of names - their synergies with your actions, buildings, and perks can heavily influence the directions you'll take with your deck. All characters have different strengths and weaknesses, so picking the right members to perform the right tasks is crucial.

Exploit chain reactions

Build chain reactions consisting of perks, buildings, characters, and more! Maximize the impact of each action, and pull off exciting combos to fight back all the threats that are out there to get you!

Discover new technologies

Research new technologies to improve your deck and increase your chances of survival. Each new card can also unlock new challenges and subsequent upgrades, so always keep an eye on what other cards are added to your decks when deciding what to research!

Explore unique locations

Many locations are waiting to be discovered. Send your team to expeditions and find exciting gear, or learn new technologies that can fundamentally change the rules of the game. But beware, explorations also pose a high risk to your characters, so be mindful of who you send!

Journey through the time loop

Confront the boss of each time loop and defeat them to unlock unique perks that can leverage the power of your deck! Perks can fundamentally change how you approach deckbuilding, so taking full advantage of them is important!

Each run is different

Pick your win condition from a wide range of scenarios, that heavily influence what cards will be available in each run. Combos that were present previously might not be available here, so it's a constant battle of improvisation and adaptation.

Wishlist now

Add to your wishlist now, to get notified of updates and an upcoming demo!

2335810.name: Beach Club Simulator
2335810.about_the_game:
"Beach Club Simulator" is an exciting open-world simulation game where players manage a beach club. In the game, you construct, operate, and develop a beach club located next to a beautiful beach. However, the game is not limited to just the beach club; it also offers the opportunity to explore and complete missions in other areas of the island.

The game begins with a character named Kevin Mathews coming to Nevermind Island to find a job. Kevin initially settles in a campsite and seeks solutions to meet his basic needs.

In addition to building your beach club, you can interact with other important buildings on the island. You'll encounter different tasks such as driver training at the driving school and assisting with municipal services at the town hall. There are also a hotel, hospital, and other commercial establishments on the island.

Completing missions adds richness and diversity to the game. By interacting with people, you can elevate your career, and career points can later be used for improvements. You can also hire staff for your beach club. Efforts are made to meet guests' needs, organize the beach area, and host fun events.

Beach Club is also a life simulation game. Among your goals is to buy better homes and vehicles. If you're not using your old car, you can even rent it as a taxi, and similarly, you can rent out your homes.

One notable detail in Beach Club Simulator is the emotions the game evokes. We worked hard to create a refreshing, relaxing, and enjoyable gaming experience. For example, you'll see people dancing wildly as the sun sets; sometimes, you might forget you're playing a game and just enjoy the atmosphere.

"Toilet Management Simulator" is our previous game, and Beach Club is, in fact, a sequel to it. All the characters you encounter at the camp are reimagined versions of characters who went on vacation at the end of Toilet Management Simulator.

The goal of the game is to expand and improve your beach club, turning it into a profitable business. Beach Club Simulator offers an enjoyable experience with impressive graphics, detailed management options, and a rich game content. Exploring the broader world of the game, including other buildings and missions on the island, allows you to enjoy unforgettable experiences in your adventure with Kevin on the island.

But beware, the skies are also filled with explosive mosquitoes that will test your reflexes and strategic thinking.

As the sun rises and sets, you'll spin through different rounds of the day, each with a unique set of challenges and rewards. But don't worry, with your trusty tongue-turned-fist, you'll be able to chomp through entire swarms of bugs, racking up massive combos and earning your spot on the global leaderboards. Just be careful not to hurt your fellow frog friends along the way! So what are you waiting for? 2336060.name: World Class

2336120.name: Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse)
2336120.about_the_game:
The demo for our latest project THE MILGRAM EXPERIMENT is live! Play on Steam now!

A loving tribute to classic first person narrative games and obscure Source engine mods.

Are you tired of playing games that actually make sense? Are you craving something that's equal parts walking, existential crisis, and jokes about the very fact that you paid money to experience an existential crisis? Well, do I have something for you!

Presenting DO NOT PRESS THE BUTTON: a walking simulator where the walking is optional, the simulation is questionable, and the comedy is 100% guaranteed to make you chuckle awkwardly while questioning all your life choices.

Is there a deep, philosophical meaning to this game?

Who knows! Probably not! But it will definitely pretend there is, and you’ll go along with it, because you’re curious like that.

Revolutionary mechanics?

Let’s just say, if you’ve ever wanted to press buttons with absolutely no clue what they do, THIS is your game.

Inspired by classic narrative-driven games, Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse) challenges the conventions of storytelling and player agency, inviting players into a universe where every action leads to unexpected (and often humorous) consequences.

This is Theseus Games' third title, and by now, we've specialized in the advanced field of wacky game mechanics. After all, our previous releases include Pizza Synthwave and Be a Rock. For a more complete and in-depth understanding of what Do Not Press The Button is, check out the free demo.

In this game you will have the choice of how to play and what to do, it’s about you and your misdirected shenanigans against The Developer.

We are looking for the person that can set the record for not pressing the button the longest. Don't forget to annoy The Developer along the way! Estimated gameplay time: up to 1 billion years (or however long human civilization lasts).

Features
- Fun activities such as:

> The Room With All The People That Want To Hang Out With You;
> The Introspective Therapy room; > The Boxtopia room;

> The Dark Humor room;

> The Meaning Of Human Existence room;
> Interact with random physical objects inside the facility;

> Secret areas with secret content that developer don't want you to find;

- Comedic narration and fun story telling;
- Secret Do Not Press The Button (tm) lore (tm);
- Hundreds of voiced lines;
- Annoying The Developer;
- Wacky Multiverses;
- Accessibility: we value accessibility and strive to ensure that everyone can enjoy our game, regardless of any hearing impairments they may have. That's why we've made sure that every voice line in the game features subtitles, so that all players can fully immerse themselves in the experience.

Look, we're not asking you to solve complex equations here. You just have to not press a button. It's an average job for an average person. You've trained all your life for this moment. Go in there and shine my little mediocre moth!

P.S. "I have no idea what I'm doing with my life anymore!" - The Dev

“It is a game and I am in it. Now please don't bother me with this nonsense anymore.”
It's OK. – The Humorless Toaster
2336120.game_link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336120/Do Not Press The Button (Or You'll Delete The Multiverse)/

2336160.name: bugTDX
2336160.about_the_game:
GAMEPLAY


Purchase towers to defend against increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Level them up and grow your defenses, finding synergies both between towers and status effects.

WIDE VARIETY OF TOWERS


Lots of towers means lots of synergies! Find the best build and overcome the waves of enemies with ease!

DIFFERENT ENEMY TYPES


Flying and ground enemies can provide a fun additional layer of difficulty. Perhaps you could use the weight tower to ground all flying enemies for a brief period of time, or the LMG, incredibly strong against flying enemies but not good at much else...

REPLAYABILITY


The base game isn't easy, and it'll certainly take you more than one try to beat it. Once beaten, you'll unlock up to 5 levels of difficulty, each with new random modifiers, harder enemies, and even secret towers! A low difficulty playstyle may be far less viable on a higher difficulty; thus, encouraging experimentation with new strategies to take advantage of the otherwise detrimental modifiers!

AWESOME SOUNDTRACK


Created by @creeper4207 on twitter, this pixel style soundtrack perfectly gels with the simple pixel art to create a chill and relaxing atmosphere.

*languages with full audio support

2336170.name: PC Futbol 8
2336170.about_the_game:
The wait is over! The legendary Spanish football management video game, PC Fútbol, is back after many years with new dynamics and the classic spirit!
In this new version of the game, in addition to having the options from 2001, you can also interact with the city to improve the team's performance. Even the referees, credits, suppliers, and employees have been enhanced to offer a more fun and authentic experience!

With the same simplicity that made us enjoy it for years and the new options, PC Fútbol offers a unique and exciting experience that you can't miss.
Don't miss this unique opportunity to be part of the resurgence of one of the most iconic games in the history of football management video games. Reserve your copy of PC Fútbol today and get ready for a completely new and exciting gaming experience!

- Match simulator, to play the matches yourself.
- Simulator visionado, you will be the coach watching how the computer plays, for you.
- The most complete manager, with more than 50 screens and features, such as Alignment, signing, establishing alliances with other clubs, changing headquarters, requesting a change of referee to the federation, you can see your trophies in the showcase, and also grow your youth to take them to the first team.
- Interactive city, you can have full control of where to build your stadium and your other buildings. You will also be able to speculate with the land and build a new stadium and then sell the new one.
2336170.supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain*, Portuguese - Portugal, Catalan*, Basque*, Galician*, Spanish - Latin America*, French, Italian
*languages with full audio support

2336180.name: Midnight Witch
2336180.about_the_game:
The Midnight Witch cannot wait to meet you…


It was supposed to be just another day in college – you would hang out with your girl, joke with your friends, fall asleep with lectures… just like any average student.

But when a stunningly beautiful new professor shows up, your average day takes an unexpected dark turn. As it turns out, her angelic face is just a facade for her true identity – she is a witch. But not the nice kind. This one is out for blood.

You and the other students are now all trapped in this classroom, waiting for death to pick you off one by one.

Can you find a way out? Foil the Witch’s cruel game? Save the girl you love?

… can you even make it alive?

Features

  • Fast-paced narration filled with mystery and magic
  • Multiple endings based on in-game choices
  • Original art in 1080p
  • Main Theme music composed by In Uchronia, the acclaimed composers for StarCraft II competitions Iron Squid & Nation Wars

This game contains material that some may find disturbing. Viewer discretion is advised.

2336200.name: Choo Choo Survivor
2336200.about_the_game:
Command your train to safety in this post apocalyptic zombie wasteland. Upgrade your firepower and demolish ever growing hordes of deadly zombies!



  • This is a fresh take on the Bullet Heaven / Horde Survival genre where you define your weapon layout and upgrade the attributes of your weapons.
  • 12 locomotives to unlock and 8 different weapons
  • Plenty of fun meta progression and over 180 Steam achievements to unlock.
  • Awesome abilities such as the EXP magnet, critical strike, air strike, and orbital strike are all earned by accomplishing achievements.
  • Cool relics that you can obtain, and with a lucky combination will make your train incredibly over powered.
  • Lots of different zombies and zombie bosses to shoot down or crush underneath your locomotive.
2336200.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, German

2336210.name: Monochrome Heights
2336210.about_the_game:
A world devastated by past wars is threatened once again. When a former comrade asks for help, Happy the Robot reluctantly agrees to face Layla — once a friend, now a dangerous enemy they thought they had destroyed. The mission: ascend Layla’s tower and destroy the last copy of her consciousness before she can be downloaded into a new body and enact her devious plan.

Monochrome Heights is a tough-as-nails 2D platformer featuring classic run, jump, and slide mechanics — but most importantly, a distinctive color-swapping mechanic that involves phasing between black and white platforms to climb the tower. With crisp pixel art and a modern retro-style experience, the game is inspired by early Super Mario Bros. and Mega Man titles.


Features:

  • Traditional tough-as-nails platforming meets a novel phase mechanic where players must swap between black and white to avoid hazards and land on platforms.

  • Tight, simple controls that allow players to blaze forward with speed and momentum, or take it slow and patiently progress.

  • A narrative-focused, single-player story mode chock full of brain-breaking platforming.

  • Hand-drawn character portraits during dialogue that compliment the crisp pixel art.

  • An original music score by Bent Neatly that drives players forward during intense gameplay and provides a relaxing backdrop for story moments.

  • Robots. Lots of robots.

2336220.name: Feed the Cups
2336220.about_the_game:
"Feed the Cups" is a Roguelite multiplayer online cooperative game. Run a Drink Shop, stocking up, preparing ingredients, taking orders, crafting drinks, cleaning up, and checking equipment. Join your friends together! Be careful, as too many mistakes can cause the "pressure" to skyrocket!



You can immerse yourself in the real-life experience of managing a Drink Shop. Work in different shops, fulfill customer needs, handle inventory and supply management, avoid debt, and control "stress" levels. The game currently supports local 2-player or remote multiplayer mode, as well as a 2-4 player online cooperative mode with friends!




Have you ever thought of running a drinks shop? Iced lemonade, sweet milk tea, mellow coffee, all made by yourself!
 
 


Have your hands full alone? Make drinks with your friends! Is someone slacking off?


 


Random challenge choices will bring different buffs to your day. Of course, all power comes at a cost!


 


You can buy furniture and upgrade your house with the cash you earn in the game. The owner won't let you work for nothing at this fun-filled drink shop!

2336230.name: Super Sonday
2336230.about_the_game:
This is a 2D action platformer where you star as Sonday, a young girl who can transform into a powerful tanooki to save the world.

The Story

Sonday is a young girl who's family heirloom, the Sonday Stone, was stolen by 8 evil bosses. It is up to you to rescue the pieces, combine it back together, and prevent it from being used for evil purposes.

Gameplay

Super Sonday is an 8-bit style action platformer. You'll collect weapons, health, and powerups to defeat your enemies. But as the levels go on, things only get more difficult!

Support

Control Sonday using either a keyboard or gamepad controller.

Included

The game includes 8 levels and a password save system, just like 8-bit systems of old, so you can start where you left off or replay your favorite levels!

2336240.name: Airscrew Racing
2336240.about_the_game:
Airscrew Racing heavy focuses on weapons and combat. Weapons and items are crafted automatically and upgrade over time. The tiered weapon system rewards those who take the lead and helps those that are lagging! It provides simpler, auto pitch controls for younger gamers and exciting weapons for the more experienced ones. Up to four players can join locally in this wacky competitive racing game.

Control Weapons

Aim, steer, shoot, fly and detonate weapons while your plane races in autopilot.

Item Crafting

Airscrew Racing brings the choice to the player in deciding what weapons to select. Items level up with time. But watch out! You will loose any progress if your shot down.

Features

  • Unique item crafting system
  • Over 15 unique items
  • 5 pilot-able weapons
  • Race in Cities, lava caves, artic landscapes, senic terrain and much more
  • Customizable airplanes
  • Auto-pitch controls availible
  • Gamemodes: Racing, TBA

Credits

Haakon Davidson: Music

Collin Creekmore: Quil
Jasmin Bartlett: Iris
Keventendo: Blaze
Liza Jacob: Jade
Reeko Brooks: Sprock
Walter Mack: Crank

2336250.name: Stop the Crawl
2336250.about_the_game:
DEFEND AGAINST THE HEROES

An army of valiant heroes is invading. Assemble a team of monsters and tactically position them to defend against the onslaught. Battle against increasingly difficult waves of enemies across 8 handcrafted stages with over 40 monsters to choose from.

ASSEMBLE YOUR TEAM

Fine-tune your team in the Hollow Road, a safe-haven between stages. Here you can add or remove monsters from your deck and purchase powerful artifacts. Use these tools to streamline your strategy and unlock powerful synergies.

UNLOCK BOOSTER PACKS

Unlock 13+ booster packs. Booster packs offer a new way to start your runs, adding different monsters to the starting deck, keeping things fresh and enabling you to try different strategies.
2336250.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain

2336260.name: Recital of the Heart
2336260.about_the_game:
The knight Gregory Bellatoni arrives at a mansion party, intent on meeting Princess Eliza. 

In order to reach her, Gregory must adventure through a labyrinthine world that exists as a mirror to his own. Inside the world of the Weave, he encounters characters from art and fiction, phantoms of artists, and beings from seemingly nowhere at all. Gregory quickly finds out, however, that some inhabitants are friendlier than others...

Gregory, with the help of Kand, a strange denizen of the mirror world, must overcome obstacles, tame beasts, and make peace with his inner desires to escape this world and reach Princess Eliza.

Swap Abilities on the Fly

An artist needs the right tool to paint their symphony. Along your journey you'll find an array of different types of abilities, called Mementos. A new Brush is a melee attack, an Instrument a ranged attack, and a  Tempo a mobility action. Craft a build that suits your playstyle, and switch it up as you go to take advantage of your environment and opponents' weaknesses.

Evolve Your Gameplay

Tune your instrument to your preference. Flourishes are additional Mementos that modify how your Brush, Instrument, and partner Kand operate. Test combinations to find new builds.

See A New View Around Every Corner

The Weave manifests beings from all over the collective consciousness. With art that changes to fit each encounter, you may be wandering through a renaissance painting one moment and battling a rubberhose dragon the next. The places you walk, the puzzles you solve, and the creatures you fight change the world around you.

Spot Familiar Faces

Wait a second, what's he doing here? Sometimes you may encounter someone you've seen before and wonder what they are doing in this world. Some of these are characters, but others are the phantoms of real artists who have left their mark on the Weave.

Have Your Lightbulb Moment

New boons await you all over. If a spot seems out of place, there just might be something hiding in a secret nook. Perhaps you need to keep exploring and come back later, but this world rewards careful investigation.

The story is simple and familiar. Save the princess atop the tower distant. But the 'dragons' you will face along the way may surprise you. Some may terrify, some may humble, some may pull on thy heartstrings. But each will bestow upon you a lesson. The story may be simple, and it may seem familiar, but the true heart of a story...

...is all in how you tell it...

2336290.name: Well...
2336290.about_the_game:
Welcome to "Well...", a very difficult first-person precision platformer with engaging lore and storyline! In this game, you'll find yourself in a mysterious magic well with a few strange rats. To climb your way out of this unfamiliar terrain, you must strafe platform to platform while relying on your intuition for navigation. Along the way, you'll discover and collect hidden journals; these will enlighten you on the well's history. Four levels must be beat in order to save this perplexing world. The levels progress in difficulty, making your journey continually more rewarding and rage-inducing.

With its intuitive controls and fun gameplay, "Well..." is the perfect game for anyone who loves a good platformer with a twist. So why not join us on this adventure and see what lies waiting at the bottom of the well?

2336310.name: KingMini
2336310.about_the_game:
King Mini?



Today is nerd developer Zile's first day at the game company. As he runs the beta test of the game, he gets covered in a mysterious light...

Explore the vast company with a smaller body, and go forward to a new space through the portal!

Features


  • Pass through various obstacles set in the office!
  • Clear maps filled with mildly infuriating music and various traps!
  • Our game has no save points!
  • Show your extreme control ability!
  • In the process of repeating death, you'll see your skills improving.
  • Achieve clear time records and death count records!
  • Why don't you recommend this game to your friends who live a boring life?

2336330.name: Tower Song
2336330.about_the_game:
Tower Song is a compelling RPG melding the classic JRPG and CRPG genres of the 1990’s into a unique mixture of deliberate turn-based combat and colorful, pixel-art worlds.

Every encounter in Tower Song is unique and never repeated or respawned, but foes are that much more lethal. Malevolent towerborne and cunning echobeasts execute deadly stratagems while always revealing their intent to the player. With good preparation and clever choices, players can carry the day. (The campaign also offers multiple difficulty modes!)

Players access new skills, skill modifications, and crafting recipes as they progress the main quest. Loadouts can be easily changed between encounter attempts, and players can re-craft their equipment at campfires to suit their playstyle. Of course, curious players will find even more unique and empowering equipment hidden amongst the nooks and crannies of the Towers.

Players choose from multiple heroes to complete Tower Song's engaging 10-hour campaign. Each hero is equipped with unique battle mechanics, can explore otherwise unreachable areas of the world, and has a unique perspective on the main quest storyline. To succeed, players will also have to recruit deadly sniper Solace, magical swordsman Kiran and master of the elements Akeno. These Mana Knights will join forces to delve into the harrowing depths of the eldritch Towers and fight across the overgrown forests of Guhar and the desert expanse of Kidonia to liberate their allies from a terrible naga invasion.

Two Towers haunt the landscapes of Tower Song, and players must unravel their mysteries to save Solace's sister and the desert metropolis of Qadam. Along the way, players will traverse across forests, rivers, deserts and more. After a hard day’s work, they can also pause to get to know their party better at camp. With one central plot but four unique perspectives, players will always have something new to discover on subsequent playthroughs.

Tali is a mistress of dark magic, pulling Tarot cards from her Dark Deck to access spells and inflict devious curses on her enemies. Jiji, Tali's cat familiar, is his own party member in combat, tearing into opponents with his claws and protecting the party with his nekomata's barrier.

Porphry is a battle-hardened warrior wielding a very large, very dangerous axe. Her abilities send her into a Battle Trance, allowing her to access game-changing moves before pushing her over the edge into an uncontrollable berserker rage!

Ezoan is a crafty engineer and spellcaster. He summons scorching fire and soothing auras to support his team before hopping into his exosuit to punish foes with overwhelming force.

Neat is the ultimate tempo-fighter. Quick to strike and even quicker on his feet, Neat strings together combos to unlock an ever-changing skillset as combat progresses, before turning the tide with powerful finishing moves.
2336330.reviews:
“Tower Song has combat that veteran developers should be jealous of.”
God is a Geek

2336340.name: Smash Runner
2336340.about_the_game:
🔹 Smash & Run in Open Space for the Win! 🔹

Step left/right and jump in real life to play the game!

Jump and shoot the asteroids, but watch out for the rocks!

Do you like Subway Surfers?
What about Smash Hit?

If yes, then you will love this game!

Smash Runner new idea is just here!
The new VR gameplay is definitely here to shake things up!

This game requires focus, concentration and timing, not only to travel through space as much as you can, but also to earn rewards for every asteroid hit.

Beware of rocks - move left, right, jump or crouch to avoid the Clash!

🔹 Challenge Yourself & Have Fun! 🔹

Play, relax and train while traveling in space and running in the desert (coming soon).

2336360.name: Sethtek Sandbox
2336360.about_the_game:
Sethtek Sandbox is an open-world, physics-based, multiplayer sandbox experience. It's a blank slate for you to express your creativity!
The game is built entirely around player freedom and customizability.
Here are some of the features:

Full Modding Support
Unleash your creativity with almost limitless possibilities with Sethtek Sandbox's modding support.

Multiplayer/Steam Matchmaking
Connecting with your friends is super easy with Steam Matchmaking integration. Create any type of scenario and share the experience with a friend, or 32! :)
Dedicated server support is also a possibility in the future!

Steam Workshop
Share your creations with the world, or download and play with other players' creations for a truly unique experience.

What you do in this game really is up to you!

2336370.name: Space Wing Cadet
2336370.about_the_game:
Abstract:
Enter the cockpit of your combat ready gunship to join your fighter squad and reinforce your fleet against big enemy warships and enemy gunship squads. Fight off the enemy fighters in a classic dogfight-style combat. Join the Federation faction in 24 mission assignments against the Cartel and the Pirate faction. Protect Federation transporters and Federation facilities from incoming attacks.





Overview:
This game converts an old school 'arcade' gameplay into a modern 3d- gameplay world with extensive building structures. The gameplay focuses on an action-based gaming atmosphere consisting of numerous space-ship dogfights. The player can test his flight skills chasing down enemy ships, when flying above extensive space platforms and big war ships, like cruisers and carriers.










Gameplay:
The player fleet has to be managed between the flights, because every mission consumes resources, like munition and fuel. Used ships have to be re-equipped and repaired, new ships can be purchased. While playing different missions the player pilot gathers experience points and credits. Mission results and pilot career are saved to the players local hard drive. Every ship has an arsenal of weapons, like guns, lasers, ion-guns against shields, rockets and torpedos against bigger war ships. Bigger ships and stations are equipped with different types of gun turrets, controller units, bridge, freight and resources like containers, fuel tanks and other stuff.

User Interface:
The space ship can easily by flown with pc-keyboard in different fly modes. A joystick can also be used with an individual configuration. The keyboard configuration is fixed with one layout, which worked best when developing and testing the game.

2336390.name: Into the depths below
2336390.about_the_game:
The mines beneath Trianis tempt adventurerers with the promise of danger, exitement and wealth. Though many already lost their lives you yet heed the call.
Create a party of up to five characters and explore the depths below!

Features:
- Create your party
Choose from 11 different classes, each wih dozens of unique skill trees and different mechanics. You can later add skill trees from other classes, allowing for
sheer endless viable party compositions.

- 12 long levels in four different biomes
The mines are of course only the beginning. Each new level brings new dangers and treasure, new random events and monsters to defeat.

- Gameplay focus
Less emphasis on story allows you to focus on dungeon delving. Experiment, find your favourite class combinations and press on.
However prepare to die a lot. The depths below are unforgiving and cruel.

2336420.name: School Days
2336420.about_the_game:
The toughest school sim in the yard finally makes its PC debut, ahead of its bigger brother following later this year! For the 1st time ever, the original touch-screen concept has been adapted for a controller and a higher resolution display.

The prison from Hard Time has closed down and re-opened as a school, but the challenge to survive and thrive remains the same! Live every hour of every day in real-time - from getting out of bed in the morning to attending a timetable full of classes, as you explore a city filled with interactive props. Picking up knowledge from each class helps you answer real questions in each subject, as you work towards the grades you need to graduate. But with over 100 fellow students walking the halls, an equally important popularity contest decides whether your days are filled with fun or fear.

Fully unlocked as standard, you can start with a character of your own creation and save your changes to every other to make the world your own.

  • Manage your health to survive every hour of every day in real-time!
  • Gather the clues you need to answer real questions in each subject!
  • Develop unique relationships with hundreds of other characters!
  • Fend off bullies with a combat system inspired by wrestling!
  • Explore a city beyond the school gates on your way home!
  • Use hundreds of interactive props to get through each day!
  • Manage your finances to pay your way in a real economy!
  • Watch every other student grow up each year alongside yourself!
  • Save your changes to each character to make the world your own!

2336430.name: PoligonVR
2336430.about_the_game:
Imagine a virtual world where you can create or be anything you ever wanted.
PoligonVR is a powerful community driven sandbox where we give you the necessary tools to turn your dreams into virtual reality.

Our goal is to provide a safe, fun & exciting experience for everyone. You can explore the user generated content, have a chat with your friends or watch a movie together! The choice is yours at any time.
We provide a way to seamlessly switch between VR & Desktop mode quickly without having to restart the game. This allows you to test something in VR or need to take a quick VR break without having to shut everything down.

We want to shape this platform based on your feedback so we can deliver the best experience for you.



With our Unity based Content Creation Kit (CCK) you can easily upload and manage your content.
We designed the CCK to be both powerful and easy to use for anyone.
For custom content, PoligonVR utilizes "Single-pass instanced rendering" which provides VR performance benefits compared to the traditional "Multi-pass rendering".



We provide a safe, high performant scripting solution we call "P#".
With P#, you can create complex worlds where you are in control of the world logic. Within our CCK we provide examples of common world logics such as buttons, video players and much more. Because they are powered by P#, you can modify & tweak the provided examples to your needs at any given time.



Experience super immersive audio with Steam Audio.
We allow world creators to integrate Steam Audio directly into their worlds & the voice chat to provide a realistic and immersive experience.



You can upload your own custom avatars, or try out public avatars created by others or ask a friend to share their avatar with you!



Sparked your interest? Join our Discord server for more information on how to join the closed-beta and future updates!

2336440.name: Once Alive
2336440.about_the_game:
Part I: THE LAST SURVIVOR

Sixteen years have passed since humanity's extinction due to a global virus outbreak. You play as James, who, along with his brother, believes they are the last survivors. However, this changes when he discovers an invitation to a survivors' base, HaustVille.

Part II: WHATEVER IT TAKES

Determined to find others, the brothers leave everything behind. After a few days, they reach HaustVille, but something feels wrong about this village.

Part III: THEY ARE GONE

"Where is everyone? What happened here?" The player must explore HaustVille to uncover the mystery behind the villagers' disappearance and learn more about the virus.

KEY FEATURES

  • Developed using Unreal Engine 5, utilizing cutting-edge technology for a fully immersive experience.

  • The entire village is waiting to be explored. And every place has a story to tell.

  • Discover the past through environmental storytelling, speech echoes, and objects left behind by other survivors.

  • A hostile world awaits, where the virus has not only decimated the population but made animals more aggressive. Caution is essential in the wilderness.

  • Experience cinematic cutscenes that intensify the narrative.
2336440.supported_languages:
English*, Turkish*, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

highlighted.localized_name: Meet Us in the Fields at Dawn
highlighted.name: Meet Us in the Fields at Dawn

2336450.name: Mechanical Siege
2336450.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

At the peak of human technology, a super artificial intelligence gained self-awareness after being upgraded. It triggered a global robot uprising, the instant collapse of human society, and the extinction of most of the population. Now, the surviving humans struggle to survive amidst the ruins, and every day is a battle for survival.

Features

  • Post-Apocalyptic Atmosphere: Immerse in the atmosphere of a post-apocalyptic world!
  • Multiple Weapons: Equip up 4 to 12 auto-fire weapons for a tactical advantage!
  • Strategic Combat: Engage in room-by-room combat, making strategic decisions about your path forward!
  • Various Characters: Choose from 10+ unique characters and confront 20+ different enemies!
  • Fast-Paced Gameplay: Dive into fast-paced games, around 20 minutes each, with an endless mode coming soon!
  • Diversity Combat: Over 100 diverse weapons and items to craft your own combat style!
  • Meta-Progression System: Enhance your game with the meta-progression system - unlock characters, acquire rare weapons and items, and power up attributes!
2336450.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Traditional Chinese

2336520.name: Hope
2336520.about_the_game:
About this game


Welcome to the Utopian world of dreams 1+1<2
Class is rigid here, but there are few risk-takers
There is no freedom here, because there is only obedience
Everything here is in order
If you don't want to be someone else's tool, it's worth the risk

Is it bad to dream all the time?
Beautiful dream, but someone broke in
You're running away from here, or you're not
Someone you love in the dream, staying here all the time

Can't understand what I'm saying?

The game is a story game without words, no matter what country you are the player can easily pick up this game.
The game is a classic horizontal puzzle game, but you can turn into Superman at certain moments in the game, and solve puzzles with pause time and instant time backwards
There are certain levels in the game where you need to solve puzzles together with characters of certain abilities
The game is very humane, there are a lot of save points, explore the scene to find decorations and jump keys to add interest
2336520.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Bulgarian, Hungarian, Turkish, Greek, Norwegian, Czech, Japanese, Polish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, Romanian, Finnish, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Korean

2336540.name: Don't Beg for Help
2336540.about_the_game:
A horror visual novel set in a world where wizards have replaced psychologists.

"Don't beg for Help" is a creepy visual novel about a love triangle between Jill, Jack, and Paul. In an attempt to solve her problems, Jill turns to the wizard Keino for help, but his intervention leads to unexpected and terrible consequences for all three.

The plot is reminiscent of "Tales from the Crypt" and contains 10 different endings, each of which is unique and contains insane twists. If you're a horror fan, "Don't beg for Help" is an excellent choice with a rich plot, a gloomy atmosphere, and a successful mix of magic and reality.

Key features:
  • 10 unique endings
  • Mix of horror, humor and love triangle
  • Story in style of "Tales from the Crypt"

2336550.name: Chinese Chess Party (Xiangqi)
2336550.about_the_game:
Xiangqi, also known as Chinese chess or elephant chess, is a strategy board game for two players. The game represents a battle between two armies, with the primary objective to checkmate the enemy's king.

Besides all the traditional features, this game provides more experiences:

* Support up to 4 players in a game.
* Support iconic piece(instead of conventional Chinese characters) for easy recognition.
* Online ranked game and leaderboards.
* Non-ranked lobby game with friends or other casual players.
* 5 AI levels ranging from easy to master.
* Post-match analysis by powerful AI.
* Real-time analysis by powerful AI when you play offline games.

Note: AI level depends on the computer hardware configuration
2336550.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Vietnamese*, German*
*languages with full audio support

2336580.name: Mareld
2336580.about_the_game:
In this card-driven game, you can place Character Cards upon Scenario Cards for automatic exploration, or combine Character Cards with Item Cards to create new items.




Of course, there's more than one character in the game. You will encounter dozens of recruitable characters throughout your journey, forming a team to explore the world together.




Dangers always lie in exploration, as you'll encounter various enemies. It's up to you to strategically build your characters to wisely conquer the various adversaries along the way.




Defeating enemies or exploring the world grants you rewards, which you can combine to create various items and dishes to strengthen your characters for future adventures.




As your adventure deepens, you'll meet various people and events, and your choices will lead you to find your way back home.
2336580.supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

2336590.name: White Night Dream
2336590.about_the_game:
The game uses a simple gameplay of flipping cards to simulate the exploration of the streets at night.





Each location on the street has a different number of cards, and players must click on them in a reasonable order to pass through.





Different cards have different effects including attacking (mental damage), healing, damage-immunity and so on. Clicking on them in a reasonable order is the key to success.

2336690.name: Magica Planta Botanica
2336690.about_the_game:
Welcome to Magica Planta Botanica, a deck-building strategy game where you can experience the excitement of growing your own seed into a fruit-bearing tree. Use a set of utility cards to grow, cut certain parts, or even manipulate your surroundings to your advantage. But be prepared for the unexpected – with changing weather and pesky pests, every day presents new challenges to overcome.

Imagine a game simulation of growing a tree from a seed. You can grow the roots to search for water or other sources of nutrients, or cut them loose if they're decaying or the tree doesn't have enough food to maintain its size. You can also grow and cut other parts of the tree, such as the stems, leaves, flowers, or fruits. Moreover, you can even manipulate the surroundings to your tree's advantage. Now, all of these actions are limited to only using cards.

In combat deck-building games, you use cards to inflict damage, shield yourself, or perform other actions. In Magica Planta Botanica, cards are used to grow your tree. You can plant a root or stem toward a specific direction, grow leaves for photosynthesis, or a flower with the hope that it will bloom into a fruit. Well, even if it fails and begins to wither instead, don't fret – cut it loose! There are no more soils or water that can provide any nutrients or water for photosynthesis? Say no more, add more soils! With cards, of course. And if you have enough Miracle to use too, of course.

Not having enough food is not your only obstacle that stops you from prospering. Caterpillars, crows, and other pests can damage your precious tree. No need to worry though – when they arrive, you can repel them by the help of The Insects! The Insects are the special units you can deploy on many parts of your tree. Strategize their placements and banish all of those pests!

After growing your tree and feeling satisfied, a part of you may yearn for more growing. That's where challenges come in! You can select different seeds and choose different terrains, each with its own gimmicks and challenges.

Can You Nurture Your Seed into a Beautiful, Fruit-Bearing Tree?

  • Turn-based gameplay adds strategy and planning to the experience.

  • Explore numerous cards to develop your plant, starting with a simple starter deck and unlocking more cards as you progress.

  • Choose how your plant grows by selecting where to extend your stem, roots, and leaves. Optimize for resources, plan ahead with branching, or even shape your plant to your liking.

  • Defend your plant against invading pests! Place your units on your tree. Use the best unit and station them on the best part of your tree to deal more damage and protect your plant from harm.

  • Face off against changing weather conditions, which can both hinder and help your plant's growth.

  • Finish all of the quests from the Spirits to gain wonderful rewards! The more quests you finish, the closer you are to the spirits.

  • Play as different seeds, each with their own unique plant shape and starter deck, and strive to reach specific goals.

  • Explore various areas with different challenges and rewards to uncover.

  • Take a snapshot of your beautiful creation and share it with the world, or simply add it to your collection of personal favorites.

2336760.name: Immortal Hunters
2336760.about_the_game:
For centuries, the Church has ruled humanity in the name of defense from the thousand-eyed snake living within the bowels of the world. As its Immortal Hunters held the line against the nightmarish Khemrids, servants of the snake god, humanity was rallied in service of the Holy War. All the Cardinals asked for in return was obedience.

As the War raged, heretics and blasphemers were sent to the dungeons, ancient scriptures at odds with Church dogma were burnt to cinders, while the most faithful were also burned. As they were martyred by the Church, their bodies fueled the Holy Fire, the only thing the Khemrids feared, apart from the Church's holy warriors.

All they managed was delaying the inevitable. As the Khemrids launch their final invasion, the Apocalypse unfolds. Among the ruins of the capital city, you take control of one of four surviving Hunters, using their unique abilities to fight your way across the burning urban landscape, experiencing a story full of unpredictable turns of events that may yet see the world saved!

As the Church and the Khemrid invasion collide, the Hunters are stuck in between with unlikely heroes, brazen heretics, lying Cardinals, and everyone else stuck in the city. As it burns, experience the End Times from four different perspectives. The clash of the titans sets in motion a hundred other battles: Ambition and lust for power tear the Church apart, a brave heretic stands up to the corruption, and the truth struggles to be heard after centuries of oppression.

Ultimately, it will be you, as one of the Immortal Hunters, who will define the fate of the world. Battle the Khemrid hordes, make difficult choices, unearth long forgotten lore, discover ancient secrets suppressed by the Cardinals, and maybe you'll have a chance of averting the Apocalypse. Are you up to the challenge?

It typically takes 2-2.5 hours to complete (according to Waku Waku Games research). There are two different endings, and you will likely know when the story diverges. Be sure to save your progress before you make your fateful decision.

Features of the Steam version
・Ported to a Different Engine
This game has been ported from Godot to Unity, meaning it's been completely remade. Along with the shift to the new engine, you can now use a game controller in addition to a computer mouse. Enjoy the game in full-screen mode too.

・Conversations Added
New chit-chats with the other Moon Palace customers have been added.

・New Game Completion Perks Added
Complete the game with a certain ending and you'll be treated to a Sound Gallery and an Illustration Gallery. Why not revisit the drama that unfolded during your time at the Moon Palace?

In the Illustration Gallery, you'll find character descriptions not found in the main game courtesy of creator Gekkan Shicchitai (Oississui)***. Plus, you'll find the sounds used in the game sold separately as a downloadable soundtrack. Be sure to check it out if you liked what you heard.

・Steam Achievement Compatibility
Achievements have been added to Moon Palace. Try out all those drinks at the drink fountain!


About Gameplay Streaming:
Enjoy the Diner is an adventure game. There is only one rule we request that streamers adhere to:

Please do not include any spoilers about the ending of the game in your thumbnail. And, do not include gallery mode in your streaming or video.

So long as you follow the above rule, you are welcome to stream however you like!

The intent of this rule is to make sure that those who have yet to play the game but intend to do so do not have their own gameplay experience spoiled. For those who do not intend to play the game and simply wish to view videos or gameplay streams of it, we do not mind if you see any spoilers.

2337250.name: The Nine’s Showdown
2337250.about_the_game:
Inspired by the board game "Coup" and incorporating elements of poker card games and Mahjong, "The Nine's Showdown" is a unique blend of strategy and bluffing. With "Classic Mode", as well as the added excitement of "Fraud Mode" and "Madness Mode", this game promises an unforgettable gaming experience.

Basic Game Rules (Classic Mode)

At the beginning of each round, players draw 4 cards and receive 5 hearts and 2 coins. The first player then begins their turn, and each player in turn draws a card and chooses one of the common actions listed below.


Common Actions:
  • Gain 2 coins
  • Gain 3 coins (Might be Intercepted)
  • Strike: Spend 5 coins and let a player lose 1 heart
  • HOOLA
  • Use a card ability (Claim having the card)

Card Abilities:
  • Draw 1 card, gain 1 coin, regain 1 heart.
  • Snatch: Take away 2 coins from a target player.
  • Attack: Spend 3 coins and make a player lose 1 heart.
  • Reverse: Flip the turn direction.
  • Pick: Let the target player be the next to play.
  • Roll 6: Roll a 6-sided die. If the point is 6, gain 6 coins.
  • Roll 8: Roll a 8-sided die. Gain as many coins as the result.
  • Let all players' coin return to 0 and draw 1 card.

Players have to discard cards to keep exactly 4 cards in hand.
Players have up to 7 hearts and 9 coins.
Whenever players are challenged, their hand is checked. If they don't have the card, they lose 1 heart.
Players are out when they lose all of their heart.

2337270.name: Aboriginal
2337270.about_the_game:
**About this Game**

Inspired by the isolation of Sentinel Island in the Indian Ocean, "Aboriginal" is an immersive, story-driven adventure that takes players on a captivating journey through the mesmerizing dual world of the Indian mainland and the elusive yet fictional Tiroti Islands. Players step into the shoes of Ajay and Arjun, two brothers on a profound quest to unravel ancestral roots, grapple with identity, and unveil the secrets held by history.

Engage in an emotionally charged narrative, where discovery, love, and redemption intertwine against a backdrop of mystery and adversity. Harness your character's inherited superhuman abilities to combat the malevolent forces at play, and solve the enigma surrounding an untimely demise of your mother.

Set in the sprawling group of islands in the Indian Ocean known as Tirot, civilization thrives in isolation, oblivious to the outside world. As both an outsider and native, you'll confront the growing chaos that threatens your homeland. "Aboriginal" blends narrative-driven gameplay, first-person shooter action, and a compelling storyline into an unforgettable adventure.

**Design**

"Aboriginal" marries the thrilling dynamics of a first-person shooter with the rich narrative and world-building of an adventure game. Navigate through contrasting landscapes, from the bustling, culturally rich Indian mainland to the tranquil and biodiverse Tiroti Islands. The gameplay is meticulously designed to incorporate combat mechanics and heart pounding standalone moments into the narrative, requiring strategic utilization of the superhuman abilities inherited by your the two brothers.

Experience a dynamic day-night cycle, an intricate weather system, and a responsive environment that together create a living, breathing world.

**Key Features**
1. Immersive FPS: Engage in fast-paced, first-person shooting action.
2. Dual-World Adventure: Venture through the Indian mainland and the isolated Tirot Islands.
3. Enthralling Narrative: Delve into a story of discovery, love, and redemption.
4. Superhuman Abilities: Harness your unique powers to challenge malevolent forces.
5. Vivid Environments: Explore meticulously crafted landscapes teeming with life.

**Localization**

"Aboriginal" is localized for English and Hindi-speaking players, ensuring a rich and accessible gaming experience for our diverse player base. To select your preferred language, use the drop-down box in the game settings.

Embark on this enthralling journey of discovery, action, and redemption in "Aboriginal" - a game that captivates with its potent narrative, thrilling FPS action, and engaging gameplay.
