2337310.name: A Viking's Quest, the Lost Continent
2337310.about_the_game:
WHAT IS THE GAME ABOUT?
Inspired by the breath and depth of classic RPG and farming games,"A Viking's Quest, the Lost Continent" is an engaging, and dynamic role playing game where you experience a beautifully hand crafted world of fantasy and adventure. You will interact with the world and its inhabitants in the quest to learn more about its life, the plants and creatures of this lost continent; and to finally uncover your very destiny in this fantasy world!

- You can learn more about the game from our web site: or from our you tube channel:


"A Viking's Quest" is designed as a 2D top-down game with RPG and exploration elements with a tint of survival features. Inspired by popular games like "StarDew valley", "Don't Starve" and the likes, it will contain some elements of survival mechanics and farming. However, our game primarily focuses on exploration and action with co-operative game-play and progression.

On top of these, there is a side scrolling ocean diving game mechanic where you may explore the beautiful hand-crafted ocean biomes of this lost fantasy continent.


CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION

In your adventure in this lost continent, you can customize your character the way you want it and like it.


RESOURCE GATHERING
Resource gathering in the lost continent will include foraging from wild plants, gathering seeds, farming, hunting, cooking and mining for mineral ores. When you dive into the world of "A Viking's Quest", with a child-like curiosity, you can expect to find a good diversity of plant and animal life, and experience the excitement of finding rare plants or creatures, and even pets.





COMBAT
Combat is exciting and fun in the wold of "A Viking's Quest"! The melee and projectile combat is both fluid and quick. You can jump or move and attack at the same time which makes combat feels impactful and fun! You will have the opportunity to meet creatures large and small in your combat encounters. For those who are not so combat inclined, you can concentrate on the story part of the fantasy and meet up strange creatures of the dark forests! Who knows you might just befriend a faerie.


MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY
You can enjoy a fun CO-OP gameplay in "A Viking's Quest" either online or on the LAN and have a blast with your friends exploring the lost continent!


WEATHER SYSTEMS
The weather system is designed to work in tandem with the gameplay mechanics. There is a day and night cycle which controls the weather and how it affect the creatures of the land. There are different weather climate which applies to different region of land masses in the lost continent. Those regions are: (1) Rain Forest and swarms (2) Highlands, (3) Mountainous areas, (4) Deserts, and (5) Icy mountains.

In this tragic, dark fantasy visual novel, you play as Tasuku, a young warrior training with the other warriors who have sworn their lives to defending all humanity against the horrific monsters that will one day rise again to exterminate the populace. When the return of the Dark Reign comes early, you must take up arms and fulfill your oath. Tasuku and his fellow warriors face the "hollows" — horrendous monsters whose very touch can corrupt foes and quickly render them to ash.

Tasuku and his fellow warriors have mastered the art of using magic to stave off corruption, enhance their prowess, and heal from battle — but the strength of said magic relies on the bonds cultivated between partners.

Penned by Kurashiki Tatsuya, writer for Maggot Baits and DEAD DAYS, the tale of L.k.y.t is full of deeply emotional moments and realistic struggles as it delves into the heart of what it means to regularly risk one's life for the sake of others.

As the main mechanic of the game, you will have to manage, build, and expand your gym. You can buy new equipment, upgrade existing ones and sell supplements. You can also expand your gym by demolishing walls, buying new decorations, and opening facilities like a sauna, massage salon, solarium, and locker room. Meanwhile, you must protect your gym from potential danger, keep the gym clean and manage your members.



Outside of managing your gym, you can engage in various activities in town, including flirting with girls, sabotaging the competition gym, partying, buying cheaper equipment in a second-hand store, doing illegal business with a shady guy in the backstreet and lockpicking and stealing from the town while avoiding the police.

Key Features


  • Build and manage your own gym: Design your gym to your liking by choosing the equipment, decoration, and facilities you want. Expand your gym by demolishing walls and opening new facilities like a sauna, massage salon, solarium, and locker room.
  • Manage your members: Keep your members happy by providing them with high-quality equipment, facilities, and a clean environment. Bargain with members about subscription money by measuring their fat and prescribing them a diet in mini-games. Maintain your equipment, keep the gym clean, and deal with people who stir up trouble.
  • Sabotage the competition: Take revenge on the gym owner who fired you by making their gym bankrupt. Sabotage their gym to increase your customers and profits.
  • Popularity management: The popularity of your gym depends on various factors such as the cleanliness of your gym, equipment quality, ratings, music quality, and the ratio of girls to boys.
  • Town exploration: Explore the town and buy a new house, cheaper equipment in a second-hand store, and do illegal business with the shady guy in the backstreet. You can lockpick and steal from the town while avoiding the police.

SAN值

Serious injuries in battle, certain choices in the exploration, every decision in the mapping domain may make the mental state of the team members worse. 2337560.name: Spanky "Bat-a-Swing"
2337560.about_the_game:
THE RHYTHM IN YOUR BLOOD

Jump in, feel the rhythm, challenge the music!

Spanky “Bat-a-Swing” is a platformer where music isn’t just part of the experience: it is the world.

Set in a city where everything moves to the beat of a dynamic electro-swing soundtrack, the game

blends a visual style inspired by classic 1930s animation with gameplay that draws from the great

classics of the genre. The result is a vibrant, one-of-a-kind world that pulls you in with thumping

basslines, off-beat grooves, and sharp snare hits.

Everything around you moves in sync, like a living orchestra: enemies, platforms, traps, the city’s

mechanisms… everything is music! It is up to you to decide whether to ride this driving rhythm and

flow through levels like a perfectly choreographed performance… or resist it and carve your way

through chaos on your own terms.

WELCOME TO METRONOPOLIS

Metronopolis is a big, lively city: loud, relentless, always on beat. But it wasn’t always like this. It

used to be a great place to live… at least until the new mayor, Metrognome, took power.

Now, rhythm is law. Every citizen, every street, every system must follow the tempo imposed by his

endless soundtrack. Many have given in and accepted this drastic change.

But not Spanky!

A short-tempered bat with a knack for invention, Spanky has turned his oversized ears into

powerful speakers and decided to rebel against this musical madness. If the city runs on rhythm,

then he will use that rhythm as a weapon. His mission? Fight the mayor’s goons, climb the ranks of

Metronopolis, and give Metrognome a well-deserved lesson to put an end to the noise once and for

all.

And yes… press that big, shiny “OFF” button once and for all!

ENEMIES, PLATFORMS, AND LOTS, LOTS OF MUSIC

Step into Spanky’s shoes (and ears!) and explore the districts of Metronopolis, each defined by its

own unique visual and musical identity.

Make your way through hand-crafted levels packed with personality and style, in platforming

sections built around the rhythm of the music. Face enemies and traps that follow musical patterns,

meet a cast of quirky characters, and unlock new abilities to push your skills even further.

Between moving platforms, acrobatic routes, and timing-based challenges, every level will test

your precision, sense of rhythm, and ability to adapt. And when it’s time to face the bosses… get

ready to turn every encounter into a full-blown performance!

Stay focused, stay on beat, and don’t give up: Metronopolis needs someone to break the rhythm…

and finally bring peace back to the city!

FEATURES

  • 3D platformer built around rhythm and music

  • Visual style inspired by classic 1930s cartoons

  • 4 distinct areas with unique visual and musical identities

  • 13 personality-packed levels

  • Over 20 quirky, hand-animated characters

  • 3 main bosses plus one epic final showdown

  • 25+ original music tracks

  • Global online leaderboards

  • Hidden collectibles and secrets to uncover

  • Built-in music player to enjoy unlocked track

Kill the zombies and take on challenges by helping the last survivors in the city. The Last Survivors is action roguelike game. You can never stand still, always collecting XP and boosters to get stronger with your weapons. Beat the game by completing all the challenges in town.

You will play the charismatic Ava, one of the last survivors born in the apocalypse.

The Last Survivors is a casual apocalyptic survival game with Roguelite elements.

Kill All the Zombies

Eliminate as many zombies as possible to survive.

Never stop

Collect as much XP and boosters as possible to get stronger.

Challenges

To win the game, complete the challenges by helping the last survivors who are still alive.

2337760.name: Sky division
2337760.about_the_game:
Sky division is a visual novel, where the player plays the role of a human pilot fighting a war against an alien race to conquer their planet.
During a reconnaissance mission the protagonist is shot down on a desert island and finds a wounded enemy pilot. The story focuses on the relationship between the two and the mutual understanding between two races that are in conflict.

Sky division is a visual novel set in a dystopian future in which humanity abandoned Terra for unknown reasons. After traveling 600 years through the inhospitable darkness of space in huge spaceships called "arks", governed with an iron fist by "the federation", a conglomerate of countries that united with the purpose of avoiding the extinction of the entire race.
After 6 generations away from home, mankind forgot the languages they used in terra, the religions and even the feelings, to the point that love and sentimental relationships were left in the past. A few books were preserved but are considered forbidden to the general population.

The planet to which they were traveling was considered a paradise for the proliferation of the race, with no intelligent life and abundant resources.
But when they arrived they saw how wrong they were, there was intelligent life on the planet and the planet was immersed in a territorial war and for the survival of the different races that inhabited it.

(8.0)
-New scenarios were added, such as the forest at night and the place where the dax fighter fell.
-New songs and sounds to improve the atmosphere.
-A voice actor to play some of Dax's words and moans.
-Fixed some bugs that prevented you from continuing if you collected fruits instead of hunting animals.

2337770.name: Tsetseg's Adventure
2337770.about_the_game:
Tsetseg, a litlte witch, lives with her friends. One day, the Mad Wizard suddenly appeares. He converts her friends into bad guys via evil magic. The friends becomes the guard of Wizard's castle. They also take Tsetseg's magic power. Tsetseg bravely entered castle, rescues her friends, regains lost power, and finally defeats mad wizard!

Inspired by 16-bit classic platformers, the games provides a jump-and-squash centered game experience. Besides, the special power received offers ability to solve puzzles in levels and explore new area. The areas may lead to either different paths or hidden golds. With gold, we purchase items to enhance ouselves, and helps defeating the Mad Wizard.

2337820.name: The Crush House
2337820.about_the_game:
Jae has scored the gig of her dreams as the producer on 1999’s hottest reality TV show, The Crush House! The demands are high and the stakes higher as she must cast, film, and produce each season. Play as Jae as you capture the budding romances and explosive drama of each unique season in the iconic Malibu mansion. And no matter what, remember to satiate the demands of your rabid audience or risk cancellation.



Each season is unique based on your chosen cast and the ever-changing audience demands. The longer you manage to keep your show on air, the more questions start to arise. What's up with the cast's dependence on Crush Juice? Where does the Success Slide even go? Clandestine conversations and some good old-fashioned snooping will help you uncover the truth.. providing the Network doesn't get in your way.

Cast For Each Season's Run

Choose between twelve eccentric personalities and find your four-person cast for each season's run. Mix and match conflicting or complementary attractions and watch as tensions run and sparks fly.

Quench Your Audiences' Thirst

Everyone with a television watches The Crush House! From Foodies and Divorced Dads to Butt Guys and... Pharologists...? With dozens of micro-audiences to entertain, you'll have to be strategic to capture them all.

Commercial Breaks Make Cents

Entertainment as good as this isn't free, so set down the camera and pull up some tasteful TV ads now and then to bring the cash. Spend that delicious ad revenue each night on new furnishings for the house to mix things up for the audiences and the cast.

Uncover The Mystery

Explore the house at night while the show's off-air. Break the rules and engage in forbidden conversation with the cast to figure out the dark secrets of The Crush House!

2337840.name: Trials of Imorah
2337840.about_the_game:
Explore the Underground Hell of Imorah

The expansive realm of Imorah holds long imprisoned monsters and artifacts. Challengers journey from far and wide, but few reach the end to claim the treasure of immortality.

Trials of Imorah is a 2D action-adventure focused heavily on exploration. There are many paths to find and just as many secrets behind each twisted corner. Battle ferocious demons, solve dastardly puzzles, and meet other valiant champions trying to survive the depths forged by the gods.

Features

  • Classic 2D action with dozens of weapons and magical spells to fit your style.

  • Expansive platforming gameplay with a variety of movement options.

  • Explore a massive, underground world containing 10 unique, handcrafted levels.

  • Dozens of enemies with distinct behavior and weaknesses to exploit.

  • Collect Stray Souls! Gather enough and the remnants of failed challengers will power up your own capabilities with simple RPG mechanics!

  • Equip Runes! These arcane tools will modify your basic weapons with all sorts of effects.

  • Elemental systems to make the world your weapon. Burn foliage, freeze water, and electrocute metal to slay foes.

  • Side Quests with a Diverse Cast of Survivors, Fellow Challengers, and Lunatics.

  • Vast, original soundtrack to aid the atmospheric adventure for hours.

  • Challenge yourself with extra gameplay settings to amplify difficulty.

2337850.name: Furry Furries
2337850.about_the_game:
Furry Furries is a casual lewd match 3 game where you have to make matches of at least three same-colored gems to score points. The goal is to got 100 points , however you can also lose points and you have only limited turns to play. Matching different colors gives different results but don't worry, the rules are simple and clearly explained in the tutorial level!

The game has 33 levels, featuring 8 different opponent species - all of them furries. You start with easy levels until you reach more difficult ones. There are no time limits and no stress - only fun! It's a simple but challenging game that will keep you entertained and wanting for more lewd furriness! You can play in whatever order you wish - start with hyena and end with wolf perhaps?




Features:
* Casual gameplay, no story
* Easy controls, can be played with one hand
* Funny furry characters
* No Ads or In-App Purchases, no patches needed
* Adult content right away, no boring intro levels!
* Juicy reward after each match - 42 images of 8 different species!
* Fun gameplay, 33 levels to play

Gameplay
This game is a match 3 puzzle. You need to win a match 3 level in order to progress in the game. There are 8 different furry species to choose from and you can play in any order you like. Each has 4 levels and 5 reward renders to unlock (one for losing). The puzzle is challenging yet not difficult! After winning a match 3 level, you unlock a reward render (nude) which can be also accessed from the gallery.

2337860.name: Nubs! Arena
2337860.about_the_game:
Nubs are tiny, unpredictable warriors locked in a relentless arena battle striving to be the last one standing. Online 4 to 20 players (and in local couch co-op up to 4 players) can engage in fast-paced top-down PvP combat where quick reflexes and roguelite buffs determine the victor.

Stand out in the mayhem with a vast selection of outlandish outfits and eye-searing colors. With so many combinations, you’ll either look fearsome, funny, on-trend or completely ridiculous.

Start with basic weapons, then scavenge the battlefield for upgrades. Crack open chests for better firepower, or claim weapons from defeated foes, after all, they won’t be needing them anymore.

Battle through dynamic arenas filled with deadly hazards. Spikes, lava, and other dangers ensure that your opponents are not the only thing you should be afraid of...

Even death isn’t the end. Once eliminated, you become a floating star containing all your hopes, dreams, and regrets. Survive long enough in this form, and you’ll get another shot at victory.

Each match consists of five frantic rounds. After each round, select a passive ability that either boosts your chances of survival or amplifies the absurdity of battle. Choose strategically, or pick the one with the silliest name, the choice is yours.

Win, lose, or perish in spectacular fashion. Konzumos is only interested in a good show.

Key Features:

  • Extensive Character Customization – Craft a Nub that stands out in the chaos.

  • Multiple Game Modes – Battle solo or in teams with up to 20 people. 

  • Fast-Paced, Action-Packed Battles with Roguelite Progression – One more match quickly turns into ten.

  • A Variety of Weapons & Power-Ups – Some are powerful, some are absurd, and some are just… fish.

What’s NOT Included:

  • Friends to Play With – Bring your own, try and find some through matchmaking, or embrace the void.

Prepare for absolute mayhem—because only one Nub can claim the crown.

2337880.name: Tower Tales
2337880.about_the_game:
Tower Tales is a tower defense game where you must protect your kingdom using different types of towers. Strategically use and upgrade your towers to become an unstoppable force against any threat.

Features

  • Build and upgrade four types of towers: Archer Tower, Barracks Tower, Arcane Tower, and Laser Tower.
  • Enhance the range, attack speed, damage, and effects of your towers.
  • Use physical and magical damage towers to defeat your enemies.
  • Discover the stories behind each tower as you upgrade them.

BUILD AND UPGRADE YOUR TOWERS

Create and upgrade your towers to fend off waves of enemies. Each tower can be improved to increase its range, attack speed, and damage, allowing you to develop complex and effective strategies.

DEFEND AGAINST ENEMIES

Utilize physical damage towers like the Archer Tower and Barracks Tower, and magical damage towers like the Arcane Tower and Laser Tower to face waves of enemies threatening your kingdom. Upgrade your towers to make them more powerful and uncover the stories behind each one as you progress through the game.

2337910.name: Asuji: The Legend of You
2337910.about_the_game:

Play as You the sperm, no one believe in You, everyone doubts You, You’s friends makes fun of him because his tail size is very below average. Prove them wrong in your training arc to increase your tail size and journey towards becoming a human baby!

2337920.name: Amazo'
2337920.about_the_game:
AmazoMysterious Trail

Embark on this incredible adventure through the forests of Latin America, where the warrior must find a rare plant in the mountainous areas of the Amazon to cure his wife. Accompanied by his daughter and his little monkey, he faces dangers and teaches his daughter how to protect herself.

Setting :

- Explore the mysterious Amazon rainforest, filled with enigmatic symbols, ancient monuments, and natural dangers.

Enemies :

- Encounter hostile creatures, from agile predators in the treetops to ambushes hidden in the vegetation.

Collectibles :

- Collect golden fruits to earn points, green fruits to restore health, and purple fruits to recover the girl's energy.

Movements :

- Master a variety of agile maneuvers, including walking, running, double jumping, punching, and kicking. Use mid-air control to cross chasms and overcome obstacles.

Game Features :

- Immersive 3D Graphics: Experience the vibrant and dangerous Amazon in stunning detail.

- Dynamic Combat: Use the girl's special attacks to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

- Puzzles: Solve intriguing puzzles to advance the story.

2337940.name: War of Wheels
2337940.about_the_game:
A MEDIEVAL JOURNEY WITH A V8 ROAR

Ride your iron steed across vast battlefields and deadly arenas filled with traps and obstacles. Choose your class, build your war machine, and prove your mastery on the field.

Immerse yourself in a rich medieval-punk world where fantasy meets roaring engines and the arcane magic of the Aether.

ARENAS OF CHIVALRIC CARNAGE

In War of Wheels, the carnage unfolds in two thrilling modes:

Gladiatorial Arena: Enter a colosseum filled with traps and engage in fearsome one-on-one duels, where unpredictable magic and environmental hazards make every encounter unique.

Field Battle: Roam the world, ambush enemy factions, and take part in epic team skirmishes. Available during early access.

FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE WAR MACHINES

Five Classes. Infinite Honor. Choose your path to glory from five distinct car classes, each blending RPG archetypes with vehicular destruction:

  • The Knight: Heavily armored and unstoppable, built to tank damage and ram enemies into oblivion.

  • The Ranger: Agile and deadly at range, picking off foes with precision before they get close.

  • The Assassin: A master of stealth and speed, striking from the shadows when least expected.

  • The Barbarian: Pure, unadulterated aggression. High damage, high risk.

  • The Artificer: A master of technology and magic, controlling the battlefield with gadgets and Aether.

Unlock armor plates, spiked bumpers, and ether-infused upgrades to create a steed that is yours alone.

COUCH CO-OP CHAOS

Revive the glory days of split-screen gaming. Team up or settle grudges with friends in local multiplayer battles, compatible with Steam Remote Play.

KEY FEATURES

  • RPG CLASSES ON WHEELS: Don't just drive, play a role. The Knight tanks damage, the Assassin strikes from the shadows, and the Artificer controls the battlefield with Aether tech.

  • A VAST CONTINENT TO CONQUER: Drive your war machine through 4 unique biomes, from treacherous frozen tundras to ancient, fortified cities.

  • CHAOS CONTROL: Wreak havoc in dynamic colosseums where every structure can be destroyed, creating new traps and sightlines mid-battle.

JOIN THE RANKS! War of Wheels is in Early Access, meaning your battles and feedback shape the future of our medievalpunk world. Get immediate access to all 5 car classes and help us forge the Story Mode.

2337970.name: March of Tulpas:Xanadu
2337970.about_the_game:
Lies, delusions, become the light that shines on the truth too.

■About This Game
This game is a remake of the traditional turn-based RPG 『March of Tulpas』 that I made in 2021.
This game has added new dungeons and items, and the art and performances have been refreshed and remade.


■Game System
The game stage is an infinite looping world that will end on the third day.
If you fight with the enemy, time will be consumed, and you will return to level 1 at the end of the third day.
However, the skills learned and the powerful equipment collected will not disappear.
The materials collected in various places in the game can permanently increase the character attributes.


■Battle System
The main means of recovery in this game is to "bite" the enemy.
After letting the enemy enter the special debuff "dignity break", you can bite the enemy and restore HP.
Other means of healing is almost nonexistent, so how to effectively use the bite to renew is the main point of this game's strategy.

Teammates who join the team have different unique abilities.
Like "low probability of action twice", "easy to become a target", "magic immunity", etc.
You need to change your teammates according to the characteristics of various mazes to reduce the consumption in order to successfully clear the dungeon.


■Story
The main character is a boy named "King of Paradise".
Without any antecedents, he awakens on an unknown throne.

Walking out of the room, he met a creature named "Path Case".
She said that the King of Paradise had an important mission,that he needs to go everywhere to gather his teammates and partners.

The King of Paradise is a "Tulpamancer".
He can generate and summon imaginary friends "Tulpa" to help him.
The first half of the story is mainly about collecting "Tulpas" as teammates.
When the teammates are all there, the story will take a huge turn.


Why is this world in an infinite loop?
What is the mission of the Paradise King?
What is the secret of the Tulpamancer?


The source of power is love.
You will know what this means at the end of the story.

2338010.name: Parabellum: Artifacts Of War
2338010.about_the_game: Parabellum: Artifacts of War is a Single-Player First Person Shooter/Melee Combat game where you play as Dean Edwards, a museum curator who researches and explores historic battlefields. When you encounter an artifact, you will find yourself transported into the battle. There you will fight as a soldier who would have used the artifact and, in time, that artifact will be added to your museum's exhibits. 2338020.name: Mistified
2338020.about_the_game:

  • And much more!

Join our Community to stay up to date with news and puzzles!

2338040.name: Cards Survivors
2338040.about_the_game:
Cards Survivors is a unique mix of card games, action games and roguelikes. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and survive as long as you can!

FEATURES


  • Two game modes
  • Dynamic deck building
  • Unlock new cards, characters and relics
  • Endless replayability
  • World ranking
  • Accessibility options

TWO GAME MODES


Roguelike mode: Climb the tower, ascending its floors through three acts, encountering many enemies, bosses, and events along the way. The paths through each act all lead to a final floor where a challenging boss encounter awaits. The content of each floor and the available paths through each act are procedurally-generated, so each run will be a different experience.



Survivors mode: Fight relentless hordes consisting of hundreds of monsters, defeat the bosses and get into the world ranking. How many hordes will you survive?

DYNAMIC DECK BUILDING


Choose your cards wisely! Discover dozens of cards to add to your deck. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the top.

POWERFUL RELICS


Powerful items known as relics can be found while in battle. The effects of these relics can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions.

ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY


Cards Survivors offers endless replayability! Test your skills and improve your score!

2338070.name: Airborne
2338070.about_the_game:
Airborne is a combination of 2D Platformers, Rage Games, Parkour, while also being packed with Action. You need to get to the end of the level by dodging Spikes, Bullets, Turrets, Lasers and more!



This game is not easy, as you will need quick reflexes and platforming skills, while also being able to be played casually. You will need to escape precise levels that are designed to test the limits of your abilities. Your goal is to make it to the end of each level by dodging obstacles such as spikes, bullets, turrets, and lasers. You'll also need to use launch pads strategically to make death-defying jumps and reach seemingly impossible places.



But the fun (and rage) doesn't stop there! There is also a vast library of community-made levels, created by players just like you using the integrated level editor. With new levels being added all the time, there's practically infinite content being made by players all around the world.



Airborne has an advanced level editor with almost all features from the base game with the ability to publish your levels to the world using Steam Workshop! You can make pretty much anything your heart desires and share it with your friends - It is guaranteed to make them rage.


If you're a fan of precision platformers and adrenaline-fueled gameplay, then this is the game for you. With its intense rage platforming, interesting level design, and community-made content, you'll never run out of levels to beat!.

2338120.name: Outlive
2338120.about_the_game:
Summary:


Outlive is a first-person survival horror game, set in a post-apocalyptic world after a virus infected most of the population. You are determined to prove that the virus was not an accident, but rather planned and released by the government. You will go out on a journey to find the lab's and collect evidence. The only chance of survival is to use your speed and agility to outsmart your enemies, solve puzzles and make your way to safety after collecting all the evidence.

Developers:


Outlive is more than just a game - it's a labor of great passion created by an indie studio founded by only a father and his son. The father was responsible for the coding and the son was responsible for the level design and gameplay. Join us and support our indie studio's dream. The game was developed since 2019.

Story:


It all started when biohazard safety issues at the state facility prompted the government to shut it down for months, a spokesman told TV News. The statement said the problems date back to several months ago, when a storm destroyed the steam autoclave sterilization plant that processed the waste. There was no biological threat to public health, it was unlikely to spread widely.

But that was not true. The threat spread across the country. Disease and mutation spread among the population. Most channels carried the government's announcement but started studio debates, videos and live broadcasts from the country.

You will play as Peter, who embarks on a journey to prove that the disease and mutations that spread among the population, were not an accident as the news suggested. Peter made his research and though he might know where the government's labs and bases that made the virus were. While traveling on his journey, Peter gets into an accident and has to search in the woods for help, but there was something unexpected waiting to be discovered. In a world where weapons are nonexistent, survive the harsh environment using your observational skill, intelligence, and patience. Will it be enough? That's up to you.

Key Features:


  • Terrifying Enemies: Mutants have no mercy. They can feel your fear and hear your every footstep, you must be fast and agile, use the environment to your advantage and solve any obstacle that comes up during this adventure.
  • You cannot fight: You are left only with your camera and the things you find along the way. Can you outsmart, outrun, hide and escape the Mutants while collecting all the evidence? We will see.
  • Survive and Explore: As you explore the depths of this abandoned ground and underground, you'll come across bone-chilling scenes that will leave you questioning your sanity. Do you have what it takes to face the horrors that lie ahead?
  • Solve the puzzles: Use your skills and the environment to solve and escape deadly traps that may be lurking in the darkness. Just make sure to not become one of them!

Outlive contains violence, gore and blood. Hope you enjoy.

2338200.name: Medieval Delivery
2338200.about_the_game:
We all know that delivery is a fundamental part of modern times. But why not imagine what it would have been like to carry out this activity in a medieval era?

The World

Medieval Delivery is a simulation and adventure game. Embark on an exciting journey through a medieval world steeped in mystery and intrigue. Set in the bustling town of Thornridge, players assume the role of Alistair, a humble courier with a hidden past. As Alistair navigates picturesque landscapes and interacts with the town's diverse inhabitants, he uncovers a web of secrets that threaten Thornridge's tranquility.

Thorough Exploration

The expansive town of Thornridge and its surroundings hide secrets, treasures, and alternative routes that players can discover in multiple playthroughs. Delving into side character stories and parallel missions enriches the experience, encouraging players to delve deeper into the game world. Do you need more speed? Your horse will be your best friend in this adventure as it will allow you to move quickly across the entire map.

Variety of Missions

In Medieval Delivery, you can choose the type of missions you want to undertake. You have the option to build an honorable reputation by taking on tasks befitting a hero. On the other hand, you can delve into the world of acquiring things through less honest means, or, why not, do both.

Home

In your home, you can engage in various activities. First, you can decorate it according to your preferences. You can also sleep to advance time, cook dishes that will restore your health and hunger, and change your clothes. Is your house very small? You can acquire one of the properties for sale in the village or in the city.

2338210.name: Land of Tales

2338220.name: Irradiant
2338220.about_the_game:
Irradiant is a minimal 2D, score-attack action game where you're faced with destroying mischievous spirits bewitching a shrine as fast as possible. You'll need to thread the needle on precision movement, button mashing and careful use of soul charges - your resource for unleashing devastation screen-wide slashes. Do you play safely at the cost of score? Or push your skills to the limit to shave off precious seconds? Your achievements can be viewed by all, with the online leaderboard. Replay your best run or watch others to see what techniques they use.

Will you live long enough to face Kaizen and bring silence to the shrine?




  • Highly responsive controls, it's up to you to master your abilities to obtain the best score you can.
  • Time ticks away, hesitation will only hurt you.




  • Light attacks are as quick as your fingers and give you air time.
  • Heavy attacks have a cooldown but deal extra damage and fling you upwards.
  • Collect soul charges to unleash a powerful slash attack, but beware: enemies you kill with it won't reward you with more soul charges.
  • Use the environment to your advantage with wall jumps and dashes to speed towards enemies as they appear.




  • Compete for the top of the leaderboard, where every second counts.
  • Watch replays of leaderboard scores to discover new techniques.
  • Custom engine with minimal hardware requirements.



Playing with a controller is highly recommended. Music by Peritune. Voice effects by Voicevox.

2338300.name: Operation Crustacean

Ride a hotdog-selling shrimp through a surreal and perilous island in this punishing 3D platformer with a twisted sense of humor.

Wake up, soldier!
You play as the lone survivor of Operation Crustacean, who got stranded in a secret world. Explore a dark and gloomy island filled with danger and unravel its mysteries to find a way back home.

Alternate between 2 control schemes on the fly with the press of a button: "Precision" for accurate controls and direct, vertical movement; "Gallop" to go fast and far - but at a price: The increased momentum requires planning ahead.
Avoid deadly traps, encounter ridiculous enemies and face off against epic bosses that will push you to your limits.
Experience a surreal and twisted sense of humor that will make you laugh and shiver at the same time.
Uncover rare permanent power-ups that will give you the decisive edge when it comes to life and death.

Do you have what it takes to survive and escape this bizarre island? Giddy up!

HIGHLIGHTS


  • As Indie as it gets - designed and created by a solo developer
  • Dark and atmospheric world with a twisted sense of humor.
  • Hardcore 3D platformer with unique, physics-based controls
  • Permadeath feature with few checkpoints for a challenging experience
  • Rare and precious permanent power-ups to
  • Ridiculous enemies to encounter and defeat

2338470.name: Galactic Ruler Enlightenment
2338470.about_the_game:
Galactic Ruler Enlightenment provides 2 different campaigns, each with an option for an aggressive or peaceful path to victory. Built on the same systems and features from the original Galactic Ruler, but designed around 2 new playable races.


Players begin with a single homeworld and limited military, and must explore a unique galaxy with each playthrough, expand their territory and military forces, exploit resources from various planets in different star systems, and possibly exterminate the competition.


In the campaigns, players will interact with all the different races. Each other race has their own goals and agenda. Players will need to decide which factions would make good allies and which factions are simply a stepping stone to greater glory.


To be competitive in the galaxy, players will leverage new technologies and ship designs. Initially players only have access to their home system, but research will unlock improvements such as FTL travel, beam weapons and shields which can be equipped on new ship designs. Build up your space fleet to keep your people safe.


What the Galactic Ruler series offers that is unique from other games, is that not only does the action take place at space level, but most planets have surfaces that are accessible for colonization or exploitation. This also creates a new battlefield. Players will engage in combat on the planet below and the space above simultaneously.


Galactic Ruler Enlightenment offers real-time strategy game play at both the planetary level and in space! Campaign play expands the series with story driven elements. Lead your faction in diplomacy or conquest across a unique galactic map where any system might hold hostile enemies or resource riches. Harness needed resources and develop advanced technology to rule the galaxy in the latest offering from BattleGoat Studios.

Game Features
  • Two new factions to play, each with their own story driven campaigns
  • New Unit Management functions to enhance control of your forces.
  • Revised energy commodity balance for better economy gameplay
  • Procedurally generated galaxies, systems and planets for a new and unique experience with each new game
  • Customizable galaxy size and density, supporting games featuring dozens of systems and hundreds of planets that can be explored and exploited
  • Develop your planets to gain the resources needed to grow your empire
  • Research improvements to your military, social and economic capabilities
  • Negotiate treaties and form alliances with alien factions
  • Trade with other factions to acquire the goods and weapons needed for your empire
  • Sophisticated Real-Time Strategic and Tactical control of your forces
  • Engage in large-scale planetary battles and epic space conflicts
  • Venture from your home planet to forge an empire of colonies all under your direct control
  • Choose your level of control - Make all decisions or use your AI to assist
  • Multiplayer support for up to 15 players

Come and join our community to discuss the progress of the game development and stay up to date on all the latest news and information!

2338500.name: Utter Takedown
2338500.about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Utter Takedown is a gripping top-down tactical hard-core stealth game set in the 2000s. You play as a former hitman who has left the local mafia, only to have his family threatened as retaliation. Now, it's up to you to take down the mafia and save your loved ones. With a variety of interactive tools and weapons at your disposal - from knifes and tasers to cameras and toggles - you'll need to use all of your wits and strategic thinking to succeed.

The game features a diverse range of maps, each with its own unique challenges and obstacles to overcome. As you progress, you'll encounter different types of AI with varying levels of difficulty, adding an extra layer of complexity to the gameplay. Along the way, you'll need to solve puzzles, gather intel, and outsmart your enemies to stay one step ahead.

Utter Takedown offers a thrilling and immersive gaming experience. With its combination of action, strategy, and puzzle-solving, it's the perfect game for anyone who loves a challenge. So gear up, get ready, and prepare to make an utter mafia takedown.

2338820.name: DataJack 2020
2338820.about_the_game:

Your clients are the global megacorporations and crime syndicates that wage covert wars for territory and the control of information, following the collapse of nation-states and world order. You are contracted to conduct sabotage, assassinations, infiltration and espionage.


Completing contracts unlocks more in a nonlinear branching structure that allows you to control your progression. Strike a careful balance between the factions vying for world domination or destruction.


Gameplay is powered by a systems-based simulation that emphasizes player choice.
  • Fully destructible environments add a layer of tactical possibilities. Plant explosives to create a backup exfiltration route– or to create a distraction to cover your escape. Open new routes and move between floors.
  • Pick locks, open panels, cut wires, and hotwire electronics with an array of detailed and realistic covert-entry burglar tools.
  • Detailed NPC AI tracks you by sight and sound, radios for backup, and notices evidence of the player's handiwork. Guards might be relaxed and distracted, or on high alert.
  • Talk your way out of confrontations by leveraging information, using your social engineering skills, or with items like fake IDs.
  • Hack through security systems, discover traps and sensors, remotely open door locks, disable alarms, steal data, and cover your tracks.
  • Use the planning phase to plan your infiltration and exfiltration points and scout a route through the target building. Insert onto rooftops from your helicopter, or sneak in through the sewers- it's up to you.


Grow your character from a low-level street punk to an expensive and highly-sought corporate assassin for hire. Outfit yourself with new cybernetic limbs, hardware and software, and weaponry. Deploy an assortment of tools and gadgets to defeat security systems, disable robots, and level the playing field against heavily-armed opponents.

Craft powerful builds! You’ll learn a ton of attacks, but you can only bring 4 of them into each fight. Can you find the right combination to beat an opponent who heals to full health every turn? What about someone who reflects all the damage you deal right back at you? Every battle is a puzzle and an opportunity for you to find a new way to break the game.



  • 4 zones to battle your way through.
  • A fully voice-acted cast of characters.
  • "One-Punch Mode" if the battles get too tough.
  • A bite-sized experience! The game's only 1 or 2 hours long.

This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

2338890.name: Starship Colony
2338890.about_the_game:
Starship Colony is a deep spaceship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

Survival in Space is Hard

Resources are plentiful but you must journey across vast expanses of void to reach each oasis. This requires careful planning, efficient recycling, being self-sufficient, and a loyal crew. Beyond the human colonies there is nobody to call for help. Even the human colonies are full of dangers, with conflict and piracy rife in the outer regions. Desperate people do desperate things. And there are non-human radio signals that tell of dangers beyond.


You begin in command of a new starship with the very latest warp drive. You must assemble your ship and crew for the longest and greatest mission in human history. You start small, but pick up new crew members and expand your ship as you go.

  • Build your starship, hull design, equipment, crew quarters, and furnishings.
  • Manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive.
  • Closed-loop system in space. Recycle or die. Waste nothing.
  • Mine ice to make water. Split it into O2 and H2 for air and rocket fuel.
  • Mine ores and precious metals for trade or to expand your ship.
  • Build a factory inside your ship to manufacture parts.
  • Land on asteroids, moons and planets. Build outposts.
  • Dock with space stations.
  • Trade with human colonies and factions. Deal with (or engage in) theft and piracy.
  • Realistic communications with radio signals. Decode (alien?) signals and decipher messages. Build your own language translation matrix.
  • Pay your crew's wages and keep them fed to avoid them leaving or a full scale mutiny.
  • Grow you own food, and try not to resort to cannibalism. (Having a friend for dinner can take on a whole new meaning!)
  • Exploration of a vast galaxy with other factions and forces at work behind the scenes.
  • And more!

Quick Backstory

It's been 30 years since the alien radio signal gifted humanity with warp technology, and humanity has spread like wildfire throughout the stars. But there are also other powerful forces that see our rise as a potential threat to be curtailed. We were warned about that too. Now that our understanding of warp technology has matured, it's finally possible to journey to more distant regions and get answers. Find the source of the transmission, make contact and seek their help against the threat.

The Adventure Begins

Starship Colony is in development and hasn't been widely announced yet. However, the community is already building and we love getting feedback, so please wishlist and join our growing Discord server. It's a great opportunity to get involved and take part in alpha testing.

If you're looking for something like RimWorld in space, Oxygen Not Included, Dwarf Fortress, or Star Trek, we think you'll love this and would like to welcome you aboard. Please be patient though! Good things take time.. :)

Check out the website at BlackBeltSoftware dot com for dev log updates, join our Discord, and follow on Steam not to miss any important announcements, like play tests!

2338910.name: Behold Battle
2338910.about_the_game:
Guess which army will win, and watch them fight for your amusement. Behold Battle is a simple auto battler, where you see heroes and monsters fight to the death in randomly generated battles.

2338940.name: CyberRush
2338940.about_the_game:
Buckle up for an electrifying ride in CyberRush, where Subway Surfer meets the high-speed thrills of NFS! Immerse yourself in the breathtaking landscapes of a procedurally generated Cyberpunk city as you blaze through neon-lit streets in this fusion of infinite runner and racing genres.

🚗 Fast-Paced Action: Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled experience as you maneuver through dynamically generated levels. Speed is your ally, but can you outsmart the relentless police chases and navigate the procedural obstacle course?



🌋 Epic Boss Battles: Challenge your limits against titanic bosses in intense, adrenaline-fueled epic battles!



💥 Power Ups: Unleash chaos and speed as you transform into a variety of powerful vehicles with the ultimate power-up.



🚨 Hot Pursuit: It's not just about the race; it's about the chase! Feel the thrill of heart-pounding pursuits as the police relentlessly pursue you. Dodge obstacles, and use power-ups to leave them in the dust.



🌆 Surreal Cyberpunk Setting: Immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world of CyberRush, featuring stunning Cyberpunk aesthetics. Glide through neon-drenched skyscrapers and city streets as you push your reflexes to the limit.



🏆 Beat Your Highscore: Compete against yourself as you strive to beat your high score.

Get ready for a rush like never before in CyberRush, where the streets are your playground, and every run is a new adventure. Are you up for the challenge? The city awaits your neon-lit fury!

2339000.name: Portabellows
2339000.about_the_game:
Portabellows is an adventure of exploration and a collectathon. Find recipes and ingredients to bake pies, and help quirky castaway residents off the island. Discover the mystery of what's keeping them there. New abilities will help you access more and more whimsical areas!

Story time

You are Erma, retired, relaxing by the beach in your quiet island paradise when you see a plane falling out of the sky. There starts your adventure, following clues as to where the plane landed (certainly not in one piece) and help out!

Help new friends by collecting everything 

Collect jelly beans in the world to trade with a shopkeeper for seeds, useful items and upgrades. Complete collections that your new friends need or desire: missing plane pieces, relics and more, they'll reward you with mementos that'll help you get to know them. Go above and beyond in your collecting to get rewarded with cute outfits!

Classic Platforming Fun 

Explore every corner of the island: jump, sprint, swim, and more to traverse scenic landscapes full of all sorts of mushrooms (including giant portobello mushrooms!). Procure new abilities by exploring every path. Be victorious in challenge rooms, mysteriously in place to recover lost treasures: platforming challenges and puzzles.

Gather ingredients to bake pies fit for a hungry glutton

Find them in every nook and cranny of the island. Obtain eggs as a reward for reuniting lost chicklings with their mama. Fill in the pages of your journal and recipe book, discovering lost pages featuring location hints of ancient recipes and other secrets!

Pie Making

Combine your ingredients to bake delicious pies step by step. Delight in seeing each unique pie’s delicious result. Wonder who those pie orders are for?

About Us

We're a team of two, this is our passion project and we can't wait for you to enjoy your time in Portabellows! We hope to tickle your imagination!

2339040.name: Landnama
2339040.about_the_game:
In the 9th century, Vikings crossed the sea to establish the first settlements in Iceland, documented for the ages in the great book of Landnama. Select a clan and attempt to settle this unwelcoming land, but you’ll need to choose your strategy wisely to survive the ever increasingly harsh toll of winter and complete your saga.

The thrill of a dungeon crawler with the vibe of a city builder, Landnama is a survival strategy game that forces you to carefully decide your next step. Explore the land and discover hidden challenges and powerful landmarks. Build your settlement and brace for the punishing Winter’s Toll. Settle each region with differently skilled clans while facing ever increasing challenges and no second chances.

Only one resource exists in the game, Heart, but it must be invested wisely. Heart can be gained in many ways, whether you want to focus on exploring the land as a hunting clan or by building your settlement into a thriving production hub. Establish a completed settlement before winter takes your final heart, but how you get there is up to you.

This isn't your typical Viking game, there is no combat or raiding. These are farmers, explorers, and builders. But conflict isn’t missing, it comes in the form of a harsh winter that you’ll need every bit of your focus to survive.

Landnama is a taxing race against time with an ever present ticking clock pushing you always closer to winter, but it’s also a beautiful world where you can freeze time and enjoy the atmospheric music and art. Explore in detail the settlement you’ve built and the animated denizens that populate it.

We’re a small, passionate team of friends that are excited about bringing you a different kind of Viking game. We hope you enjoy it and appreciate your support!

2339110.name: Milita Aventuro
2339110.about_the_game:
在90年代的东欧国家，由于艾斯佩罗族和伊多诺族之间的矛盾，进而引发了双方的战争。玩家将扮演故事的主人公艾斯佩罗族的少女——弗洛拉，穿越战火过后的断壁残垣，结识抱持着不同想法理念的人们，在残酷的战争中竭尽全力生存下去，并揭开隐藏在战争背后的真相。

战争总是残酷


无情战火打破了东欧小镇的宁静，原本繁华的城镇转瞬间成为惨绝人寰的炼狱，面对敌军持续不断的袭击，幸存者们只能够勉力求生。在巨大的生存压力下，每个人的追求、理念甚至信仰都经受着严峻的考验。而主角的冒险故事正是在这样的背景之下展开。

性格丰富的角色


游戏中玩家将结识许多性格迥异的人物，在这混乱的战争时代，每个人都抱持着不同的立场、信仰及政治观点。与每个人深入交流，这场战争的前因后果，分辨每个人的行为动机，对他人的政治见解表态，影响他人对你的看法，并从中发掘出深藏在战争背后的真相。

穿越炮火艰难求生


探索小镇的每个角落，时刻警惕从天而降的炮弹。保护自己的家人朋友，为有需要的弱者伸出援手，面对强权也毫不畏惧。在时代、信仰、恩仇、人性的艰险抉择之中，你将时常置身两难境地，你将如何做出选择。

2339380.name: Eleanor's Handmaid
2339380.about_the_game:
Eleanor has just turned eighteen and her life is about to change in many ways. She has to learn about her family's businesses, get along with her fiancée, and get accepted into a prestigious university, just to name a few things. And then there's the curious and exciting but maybe a little bit scary activity called sex. What exactly is it that adults do in the bedroom (and sometimes in other places)? Luckily, Eleanor is surrounded by wonderful maids who are more than willing to help her find that out...

Eleanor's Handmaid is a light-hearted visual novel with branching storylines, multiple endings, and rich background lore. Join Eleanor and her handmaid Sofia on their journey to find out what being an adult is all about!

Features (ver. 1.3.1):

  • Multiple branching storylines & 7 endings
  • NEW: 7 seven epilogues, featuring 3 new characters, added in post-launch updates!
  • Total length: 111 000 words (5-8 hours)
  • 37 unique event CGs, 495 variants
  • 1080p resolution
  • Unlockable CG & scene gallery
  • 100% human-made (no AI-generated content)

Characters:


Eleanor "Ella" D'Faerwyn is the heir of the Faerwyn noble family. She's dutiful and somewhat shy but usually lively and playful at home. She's very fond of her maids and treats them as family members rather than servants.

Sofia Firlake has been the handmaid of Eleanor her entire life. She's cheerful and often mischievous but extremely devoted to her mistress. Now that they are both adults, Sofia is hoping to take her relationship with Eleanor to the next level...

Helen Firlake is the chief maid of the Faerwyn family and the mother of Sofia and Laura. She has a dark past that she rarely talks about, but she's happy with her life now. She considers Julie her hero and has strong feelings of affection for Eleanor as well.


Julie D'Faerwyn is the current head of the Faerwyn family and the mother of Eleanor. She's a retired special forces captain who has found more pleasant (and pleasurable) ways of living her life in the past decade and a half. She's proud and powerful but generally amiable toward everyone around her.

Laura Firlake is a housemaid and the gardener of the Faerwyn family and Sofia's older half-sister. She's perceptive and well-informed but not very talkative. She considers both Eleanor and Sofia her little sisters.

Nerisha is a young adult succubus who has recently moved to Earth from the Underground and entered Lady Julie's service. She's liberal-minded and, unlike most succubi, views humans as her equals. She's rumored to be very "nice and cute."

2339490.name: Pirate Patrol
2339490.about_the_game:
Pirate Patrol is a strategy -and tactics- driven science fiction space combat game with deep RPG elements, set in the lawless regions of space. Players take command of a powerful capital ship and fight to survive against enemy fleets, autonomous warships, and constantly evolving threats.

The game blends real-time space battles with procedurally generated missions, enemies, and systems, ensuring that every run presents new scenarios, risks, and opportunities. Players can discover and collect an endless variety of items, loot, and ship modules, allowing for highly personalized builds and playstyles.

Pirate Patrol’s RPG-based progression systems enable extensive customization of the capital ship, fighter squadrons, and defensive infrastructure. Turret systems, combat computers, specialized ship modules, and tactical configurations directly influence the outcome of every engagement. Resource management, planning, and smart equipment choices are key to survival.

Built around exploration, risk, and reward, Pirate Patrol constantly encourages players to experiment with new strategies. Its design delivers endless replayability, creating unique builds, new threats, and different survival stories with each playthrough.

With its deep systems, tactical decision-making, and strong atmospheric presentation, the game is aimed at players seeking a rich space-themed strategy and RPG experience.

⚓ Command a powerful capital ship and manage its economy Deploy fighters, pay your crew, repair damage, and make strategic decisions that shape your journey.

🚀 Issue tactical orders in real time Send your fighters to hunt down enemies, respond to distress calls, and control the flow of battle.

🗺️ Procedurally generated universe Every run offers new maps, encounters, and challenges — no two adventures are the same.

🧠 Advanced AI-driven combat Fighter pilots can operate independently and make their own tactical decisions — or follow your direct orders when you choose to take control. Enemies react, adapt, and exploit the battlefield.

🎯 2D tactical design with full battlefield control A clean 2D perspective gives you complete situational awareness and precise command.

💥 Destructible environments Asteroids, wrecks, abandoned stations, and space debris can be destroyed and used tactically.

🎒 Infinite items, loot, and deep inventory management Collect, manage, and optimize your loadout as you progress.

  • Rush to the aid of attacked ships

  • Rescue pilots and crews thrown into space from damaged vessels

  • Investigate anomalies that have caught the attention of scientists

  • Send your fighters to hunt down enemy ships

  • Scan the area and uncover lurking enemies

  • Rescue planets and sectors, and claim rewards

  • Take command of a powerful capital ship and manage its economy

  • Pay officer and pilot salaries, cover damage and repair costs, sell asteroid data, and collect bounties

  • Endless replayability

  • Destructible environmental elements: asteroids, shipwrecks, abandoned stations, and space debris

  • Advanced sound effects and an impressive soundtrack


What is Smart-Pause Gameplay (SPG)

To combine the tactical depth of turn-based strategy games with the dynamic flow of real-time combat, we developed a pause system for Pirate Patrol called Smart Pause Gameplay (SPG).

SPG is inspired by the Real-Time with Pause (RTwP) systems found in many real-time games, but it goes a step further by significantly enhancing the player’s sense of control in a real-time environment. With SPG, the game intelligently pauses based on the player’s input and intent, allowing for smooth, intuitive tactical decision-making.

This system enables players to plan ahead and issue commands without breaking immersion—eliminating the need to constantly press a pause button or deal with disruptive interruptions caused by scripted or repetitive events. The result is a more fluid and responsive tactical experience that stays fast-paced while remaining deeply strategic.

The more you produce, the more resources you'll unlock, allowing you to expand your production capabilities and create even more advanced products.

But it's not just about making things; you'll also need to manage your resources wisely, optimizing your factories for maximum efficiency and productivity. You'll need to balance your production rates with your energy consumption, ensuring that you're not wasting valuable resources on unnecessary processes. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter challenges and obstacles that will test your strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

But it's not all work and no play in Industrix. Along the way, you'll encounter other companies that are also vying for dominance in the market. You need to compete with them head-on, using your superior production skills to outmaneuver and outproduce them.

As you grow your production capabilities, you'll unlock new islands to explore, each with its own unique resources and challenges. You'll need to adapt your production strategies to each new environment, experimenting with new technologies and production methods to stay ahead of the competition.

Industrix is the ultimate factory building game, offering endless possibilities for creativity, strategy, and exploration. 2339530.name: Stone Tribes
2339530.about_the_game:
STONE TRIBES

An Automation-Driven Real-Time Strategy Game (RTS + Automation)

Context

The game takes place in Zyndoria. In this mystical place, tribes are fighting as automated agents that you design, using magical abilities, weapons and crafting to get decisive advantage on the battle.

Concept

Stone Tribes is a Real-Time Strategy (RTS) game with a strong RPG dimension, where the player does not directly micro-manage units, but instead designs their behaviour using an automation system that the user can design with UI. 

Rather than controlling every action, the player acts as a strategic architect, defining behaviors in advance and dynamically adapting strategies through Macros during battle.

You don’t control units.

Victory comes from preparation, coherent automation design, and the ability to adapt tactics in real time, not from high APM or constant micro-management.

GamePlay Phases

  • Team Design Phase

  • Game Phase

  • Game Design Phase ( Work in Progress ) 

-------------------

Core Pillars

1. Automation-Driven Gameplay

Each character operates using an Automation Flow:
a permanent, condition-based behavior that defines how the unit acts by default.

  • Automations represent the unit’s intrinsic intelligence

  • Autonomous, readable, and consistent behaviors

  • A combat fallback ensures units always remain functional

2. Tactical Macros (Player Command)

Macros are temporary tactical orders that override individual automations.

  • The player commands intent, not execution

  • Instant strategy switching

  • Simple predefined Macros or fully customizable ones

3. Group-Based Strategy  

The tribe can be divided into groups, each receiving different Macros simultaneously.

  • One army, multiple strategies

  • High-level coordination without micro-management

  • Clear battlefield intent and readability

4. RTS + RPG Hybrid

Each unit is a persistent character, not a disposable pawn:

  • Classes: Warrior, Hunter, Craftsman, Shaman, Druid, Necromancer

  • Levels, experience, equipment, and spells

  • Defined roles within the tribe

Core Systems Overview

Automation vs Macro

  • Automation
    → Permanent individual behavior

  • Macro
    → Temporary tactical order issued by the player

Team Design Phase

Before entering a match, the player prepares a team:

  • Composition of 30 characters - Each actor can receive a specific automation flow as "default flow"

  • Class distribution and balance - ( Work in Progress ) 

  • Equipment and spells

  • Individual automation flows

  • Custom Macro definitions

Players can either:

  • jump straight into battle using pre-built teams, or

  • dive deep into automation design to optimize their strategy

Game Modes (Beta Focus)

  • PvP Nexus vs Nexus
    Two teams compete to destroy the enemy’s core.

  • Solo vs AI
    Practice and strategy experimentation.

Additional modes (PvE, multi-objective scenarios) are planned for later development.

What Makes Stone Tribes Different

  • No frantic micro-management

  • No APM as the primary skill

  • Strategy based on design and anticipation, not mechanical execution

  • A system-driven RTS focused on emergent behavior

Target Audience

  • RTS players looking for something new

  • Fans of deep, systemic gameplay

  • Players who enjoy optimization, automation, and experimentation

  • Strategy players who prefer thinking over clicking

In the magical world of Battle Mages, becoming who you always wanted to be is easy, but staying that person becomes an ever-growing challenge as you venture deeper into a world that seeks to tempt you with an easy life of pleasure and shape your mind and body to its whims.

2339820.name: Manic Archers - Bullseye DEMO
2339820.about_the_game:
FREE BULLSEYE DEMO

This free Manic Archers Demo will be released to complement the official release of Manic Archers (changed from Early Access) on March, 20th 2023.
It features a limited game mode selection, limited map selection, limited powerups and will automatically quit after a few minutes (can be restarted though).
Other than that it behaves equivalent to the full version you can purchase on Steam as well:

ULTIMATE LOCAL MULTIPLAYER RETROGAMING ARCADE

Manic Archers is a game that I personally would have liked to play back then, but it was not possible in the 16bit era because of technical limitations. A game that overflows with gems inspired by the arcade 2D high-times - 1000s of sprites and interlocking effects cumulating into a sensory overload of 16bit hype - while keeping that absolute, direct and perfectly controllable arcade grip. It took 2 years to perfect this game as a solo-developer.

WHY YOU SHOULD GET THE FULL VERSION OF MANIC ARCHERS NOW

Manic Archers is the first topdown Zelda-type versus game ever!

  • On-the-point gameplay and simple yet deep mechanics
  • First rpg-style top-down versus fighting game with an arcade feel
  • Lovely, hand-animated pixelart, inspired by the golden age of 2d arcade games
  • Highly strategic matches vs. complete chaotic infernos
  • Interactive levels
  • Many common multiplayer modes
  • AI support and coop-mode to practice without your friends
  • Atmospheric music and hard hitting sound-effects
  • Easy to play, hard to master
  • Authentic classic RPG-scale sprites and environment expanded to HD resolution

Official release planned for Switch, Playstation and Xbox separately till mid 2023.

GAMEPLAY FIRST

MANIC ARCHERS is an atmospheric and extremely addictive local and online multiplayer arcade game in pixelart-style.
It features simplistic and on-the-point gameplay with amazing game mechanics and lovely pixelart-details.
It is playable with up to 4 players simultaneously on one single screen in several well known multiplayer variants.

THE MOST SIMPLE GAME OF ALL TIME

One screen and 3 buttons is all you need to know - jump, shoot and dash/block. The depth of good gameplay is found in simplicity accompanied by great mechanics.

THINK ZELDA AND DEATHMATCH

With the intention to make a multiplayer match top-down game, MANIC ARCHERS owes to and actually should remind of the heritage of all top-down games like the Zelda and Final Fantasy series. Imagine the same love for details put into a competitive multiplayer arcade game for 4 players simultaneously.

APPROVED MULTIPLAYER FUN

In versus-mode players each control an archer, shooting the opposing archers until only one archer is left - besides Free-For-All versus, Manic Archers is featuring several other well known multiplayer modes.
During the game a lot of combinable and game changing powerups and special arrows appear on the playing field, enabling players to turn the game around in an instant.

AI TO KEEP YOU GAMING

In case you need one more player to start a 2on2 teamplay match or if you are alone and want to train, Manic Archers got AI opponents to fill up the slots.

RETRO CAUSE WE DO NOT NEED 3D FOR THAT

The game takes place on a single screen with classic arcade wrap-around scrolling. The players make use of the top-down environment strategically such as water, higher grounds, obstacles and interactive map parts such as switches, explosives, burnable trees and more.

Key Features

Up to 4 players local and online

Play arcade style locally AND online with up to 4 Players (via Remote Play Together).

Versus

Simple Free-For-All match, fast paced, deep gameplay mechanics (also available for Teamplay).

King of the hill

Keep control of the center of the map to gain points and secure the round (also available for Teamplay).

Catch the fool with the chicken

All players match against the one who got the chicken - the one who keeps the chicken longest wins the round.

Conquer

Dominate parts of the map to gain points, the one who dominated most flags the longest wins.

Survival Coop

How long can you and your friends survive against hordes of enemies? Manic Archers features a small coop-campaign that is also playable alone. Though DO NOT buy Manic Archers just for the coop-campaign - Manic Archers is primarily meant as a versus game.

Deep gameplay mechanics

The gameplay is set up for competitive and fun matches through deep but easy to learn game mechanics.

AI Opponents

Fill up the remaining slots with AI opponents with adjustable skill or create matches alone to train.

Interactive and individual maps

Interactive maps allow strategic advances which are easy to understand and use. The interactive elements available vary in each map

SPECIAL MOVES

Though you will probably find out these yourself, as they're pretty simple...

  • SUPER DASH - Dash while on the way down of a jump, shortly before you hit the ground
  • STOMP JUMP - Hit the JUMP button again while in mid air
  • SHIELD - Hold down the dash button to shield yourself against attacks you are facing

2340190.name: Beyond Polaris Guardian
2340190.about_the_game:
Military schools serve as a crucial step for recent graduates of UNES (United Nation of the Earth System) universities. Referred to as TEOS by students, completion of the program is often viewed as the key to securing desirable positions in esteemed conglomerates like Nora Corp throughout the solar system. While students are exposed to an array of post-graduate career paths, emphasis is placed on instilling discipline, courage, and unity.

2340320.name: Kagami: An Odyssey in Japanese Language Learning
2340320.about_the_game:
Kagami: An Odyssey in Japanese Language Learning (phew, what a long name! That means it MUST be GOOD!)

*Ahem* Anyways...

The game is meant to help those who want to learn Japanese in a FUN way! It is a top down RPG-Lite centered around exploration, finding vocabulary words in the world by interacting with objects, playing minigames, and using the vocabulary you learned in each area to gain advantage when fighting enemies! You might unravel a mystery, learn more than you thought you would, and become emotionally attached to some of the characters along the way! Like, who's this cute lil guy runnin' around? YOU'LL FIND OUT!


Fight alongside your party members against monsters that are mostly based on Yokai from Japanese folklore in that classic turn-based RPG kind of way! Level up to become proficient in physical and magical combat to deal devastating damage to your foes!


If you are new to learning Japanese, no problem! The game starts by teaching you the basics of Hiragana, one of the alphabets of the Japanese language! You also learn Katakana as well!

You will have access to all the “charms” or vocabulary words you collect to study when outside of battle through your trusty Game-Buddy, who manages everything from inventory to vocab to saving your game file. Game-Buddy also has a Hiragana and Katakana reference guide that include visual representations of mnemonics to help you retain all this new information and a sound clip of the kana being pronounced!

Speaking of sound clips, they were made by professional voice over artist Ko Takehiro and cover the Kana, Vocabulary, and Phrases, so you'll hear them as pronounced by a native speaker!



The game is also playable on the Steamdeck!


We do not use romaji, so be warned, you will either learn to read Hiragana and Katakana or you will not have a good time. Though we give you the resources to learn, it will ultimately be up to you to retain the knowledge needed to succeed, and we think anyone who really wants to learn can and will succeed!

Do you think you have what it takes? We think you do!

2340500.name: Three Kingdoms: Innovatory
2340500.about_the_game:
A Message from the Developers

Hey, everyone! We are the Evolving Studio—a team mainly composed of five uncles. Initially, we were just a group of like-minded friends, passionate about the history of the Three Kingdoms, aiming to create a Three Kingdoms game understood from a Chinese perspective.

From conception to production, we have poured countless efforts and sweat into it, striving to bring the best gaming experience to players. But as a small team new to game development, we understand that our experience is limited and there are many aspects of the game that can be improved and perfected. This is why we decided to first test on EA, hoping to gather more feedback, helping us to continuously improve the game, and create a truly outstanding strategy game.

Although our team is small and lacks experience, we have never given up our passion for game development. We hope that through our hard work, we can make this game successful, allowing every player to experience the excitement of the Three Kingdoms history in the game.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Game Introduction

Game Features:

● Real-time strategic battle mode controlling hundreds of thousands of troops.
● Over 1400 historical figures from the Three Kingdoms period will appear in various scenarios.
● 400+ counties, cities, and passes to contest and develop.
● Recruit 40 different types of troops from the Three Kingdoms era.
● Use various strategies and diplomatic schemes to let the sovereign "win without fighting".
● Experience over 300 real historical events and stories.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Development Plan

For us, our game is more akin to a long-term project like the Great Wall, rather than a mere strategy game. Without several years of ongoing evolution, it would be meaningless. Based on this philosophy, we will continuously iterate and update our game, focusing primarily in a few directions:

Updating the scenario content. We will add more scenarios and historical events from the Three Kingdoms era, approximately one per month, and continue to update. More significant historical periods will be included once the Three Kingdoms scenarios are sufficiently refined.

Updating gameplay features. In core gameplay areas such as internal affairs, diplomacy, and warfare, there will be numerous functional updates. New technologies, character relationships, alliance relationships, duels, naval battles, construction, timing and geographical advantages, and other features will be gradually incorporated, making the game feel like a new experience after about half a year.

Workshop support. The editor and Workshop will be continuously strengthened, including support for the new content and features mentioned above. We hope players can create even better scenarios and content.

Enhancing effects. Approximately every two years, we will modernize the graphical part of the game, bringing it closer to the level of other high-quality strategy games of the same period.

2340520.name: Tales of Seikyu
2340520.about_the_game:
Seikyu is a quiet island sanctuary, hidden far from the noise of the human world. Here, yokai spirits live in harmony with nature and the turning seasons.

You and your sister begin your new lives in an old farmhouse - a place filled with memories, and room to begin anew. There's always something to tend, someone to chat with, or a quiet corner you haven't discovered yet.

Seikyu isn't a place you rush through. It's a place you can return to.

Your days follow a rhythm you create. Tend the farm, wander into town, or follow a path you haven't explored before. Some days you'll harvest. Some days you'll decorate. Some days you'll stumble across something you weren't expecting.

Expand your fields at your own pace, grow seasonal crops, and raise chickens, cows, sheep, and capybaras. Craft furniture and gradually create a space that feels like home.

The people of Seikyu have their own lives, routines, and quiet worries. Torleone, the thoughtful otter fisherman. Sasaki, the well-meaning carpenter who's always in the middle of a project. Nyotengu, the watchful guardian of the island skies.

Spend time with them and you'll start to notice the small changes - new dialogue, shared traditions, and story moments that unfold naturally over time. Their stories are interwoven, and yours will become part of that tapestry.

As a descendant of the Fox Clan, you carry the gift of shapeshifting. Transform to experience the island in new ways - charge through fields as a boar, soar on the wind as a tengu, or slip beneath the waves as a water spirit. Each form opens new corners of Seikyu: hidden ruins, distant hilltops, and sunken treasures.

Cherry blossoms give way to summer heat. Autumn leaves fall. Snow settles on the rooftops. Seikyu lives and breathes through every season, shaping the crops you grow, the festivals you attend, and the pace of life around you.

The application realistically depicts the economic cycle of the world's major cities and the surrounding industrial and rural areas.
