2340620.name: Battle for the Void
2340620.about_the_game:
"Battle for the Void" is a 2D online computer game set in the farthest corners of space, where only pure energy and matter remain. In this bleak world, players can engage in real-time battles against each other in various network modes.

DESTRUCTIBLE ENVIRONMENT


The terrain in "Battle for the Void" is more than just a backdrop; it's a key component of gameplay. When players engage in combat, the environment will be destroyed by various weapons and attacks, creating caves and craters that can provide strategic advantages or be used against players. The landscape will regenerate and change, offering players new opportunities for maneuvering and combat.

FLYING OPTIONS


In "Battle for the Void", players can choose from three different space fighters, each with its own unique set of abilities and more than 15 types of weapons in their arsenal. Each fighter has its own development tree, to progress through which you need to earn energy, matter, and other in-game currency in PvP and PvE battles. In addition to the fighters' abilities, there is an artifact system in the game that can significantly affect game mechanics, from damage to technology research time!

ENEMIES


Players are not alone in this world. Strange creatures inhabit this unpredictable environment, living clusters of energy or matter that move and react in unexpected ways. These creatures can be either a hindrance or a help, adding a new level of complexity to an already complex gameplay. Additionally, some maps have special features and modes, such as volcanic eruptions, global darkness, and others.

GAME MODES


PvE Assault
Several classic scroll-shooter maps that need to be completed either alone or in a group, with a final boss fight at the end.

PvE Defense
Over the course of a match, you need to defend your base from several waves of space creatures. The battle is considered lost as soon as any creature penetrates the base's perimeter. This challenge can be accepted alone or in a team of up to 10 players.

Capture the Flag
Two teams of 2 to 6 players participate in a match. The task of each is to capture and transfer to their base the maximum number of flags that appear at different locations during the match time.

Defense and Capture
The match involves 2 teams of 2 to 4 people. In powerful PvP battles, you need to defend your base and try to capture the opponent's base. Teams' bases are located at different ends of the map, and to reach the enemy's base, all watchtowers along the way must be destroyed. The team that can first hold in the enemy's zone for more than one minute in full strength wins.

Free-for-All
Here, every man is for himself. The game is in complete chaos, the environment is constantly changing. Players rank and receive rewards depending on the number of points scored during the match time. Up to 8 players can fight on the map at the same time.

Last Hero
The mode is similar to Free-for-All, but the game goes on an elimination basis until the last survivor. Up to 12 players can participate simultaneously.

During the game, you will need quick reactions and strategic thinking. With a destructible world, mysterious creatures, customizable fighters, and a range of game modes, "Battle for the Void" is a serious test of your space fighter skills. So, are you ready to take the challenge and fight for dominance in the void?

2340670.name: Brie Parmesan Mysteries

2340720.name: The Heroic Legend of America: Second Revolutionary War
2340720.about_the_game:
I am currently writing a full-length historical novel. For more details, you can follow my Bilibili account: 爱奥尼尤斯Aionius

March 11, 2026

I have always held a belief in my creative work: before putting pen to paper, I must be certain that the story I am about to write has the power to influence the world; otherwise, I would not write it. I have spent over a decade researching, reflecting, and writing, and I am convinced—indeed, I was convinced from the very beginning, and this conviction has only grown stronger through the process—that this story is indeed a great one that deserves to be told.

去年已经说过， 《美利坚英雄传说：第二次革命战争》 游戏开发没有资金继续。

我开发的游戏实际上是我的历史小说的一个简化的片段，“简化的片段”指的是故事时间跨度和文本量，而游戏本身需要的设计和大量素材绘制（全部是我一个人）更加耗费精力、金钱和健康，如前说述，就是这部分的开发成本令我难以承受。

这个小说暂定名为《美利坚大革命》，除非我想到更完美的名字。早年我在小说贴吧和网站发过一些，反响不错，毕竟作为“美国内战史第一人”，在国内，这个小说题材没有比我更早涉足的。但那是将近二十年前的事情，经过多年沉淀积累，今天我想讲的故事比过去的要更加沉重。为什么最近没再在线上发布过，原因很好猜，因为不过审。

顺便一提，为了筹集项目费用而注册的爱发电账号，不久前也毫不意外被封了，原因不需要再做解释。

这个故事令我深思熟虑了将近二十年，其中充满了激情、愤慨、怒火，废奴主义者和革命者崇高的英雄主义和人性光辉，还有美利坚奴隶主、欧罗巴专制君主等压迫者及其走狗龌龊的思想和卑劣的暴行，几千个历史人物， 以及两位为自由和平等的正义事业而斗争的美丽的年轻人——尼古拉斯·奥古斯汀和艾米莉·莫里斯（必不可少的主人公）。

如果日后这本长篇小说能出版，我会寄送给各位一直支持和鼓励的朋友一本，当然运费需要你来出，如果那时我还那么穷（大概率）。

只要还活着，人总是要有点希望和努力目标的。

美利坚大革命不只是美利坚大革命：这个小说的具体内容现在无法透露太多，可以肯定的是从来没有人这样写过，故事有着史无前例的以视角广度，从一种绝对追本溯源的史诗角度去描绘波澜壮阔的历史。

如果一个人不愿意为自己的权利和利益进行辩护，那么也不应该期望他能够有效地捍卫那些比个人利益更重要、更高尚的正义事业。

在亲身体验Steam的疯狂网暴、刷差评以及详细观察其参与者的背景之后，我得出一个结论，Steam的用户几乎没一个好东西。虽然严格意义上我也是Steam的用户，但不自认为是Steam的用户。虽然，我确实买了几个软件开发工具开发《美利坚英雄传说：第二次革命战争》，但我没有买过任何一款Steam游戏，与那些在Steam有几百个游戏满脑子秽物只知道打游戏（尤其是色情游戏）的用户在性质上完全不同。

当然，不是Steam的用户，乃至从不玩游戏的人，也未必是好东西。我是说，这个国家几乎就没一个好东西，很悲哀。我还有些理解共产党了，不论其理论有多谬误，行为有多错误，那帮子确实是流血的打天下了。其他没出过力的，也不抗争的，活该被奴役（不论之前还是之后），怨不了任何人。我们可不应该指望哪个势力都是坚持奉献、自由、平等、民主原则的美利坚废奴主义者，很少有人是像废奴主义者那样的救世主。所以，没出过力的，也不抗争的，活该被奴役。不过最可悲的永远都是奴隶帮着主子攻击良知，这在我国尤其不是一个罕见现象。

现在不是人们有没有勇气流血抗争的问题，而仅仅是有没有勇气维护敢于站出来的良知的问题，结果都极少有。良知本来就不多，这下更消灭了，可不就剩一堆蛆，自然是没一个好东西了。

然而即使是国家烂到这个地步，我们也不能放弃为正义和良知而斗争。每个人都有能力做出积极的改变，即使是微小的行动也能产生深远的影响。

我不知道何时能得到正义，不知道这个国家何时能有正义。

所有这一切都是紧密相关的，都指向一个问题，那就是正义！

正义会有的，只不过不知道能不能亲眼看到。

只能说，我已经尽力了。

If you are a foreigner and cannot understand the extent of the frenzy among the Chinese people, please take a look:

In China, it has reached a point where any insignificant clown can gain hundreds of thousands of views and tens of thousands of likes by claiming that Lincoln was a criminal and that slavery should not have been abolished

History has repeatedly shown that only slave owners or fascists inciting war would behave in such a manner, which deeply concerns me.

最近又疯狂出丑的留学生，再次证实了我的观察推断，原来那些粉蛆就是为了一点利益（跟真正权力者比）就毫无底线疯狂下作，充当喉舌打手走狗，迫害同胞。按理说留学生也算非富即贵，怎么沦丧到这些地步，有资本的阶级没有承担应尽的义务，而是为非作歹，这个国家难道不是无药可救吗？

当人们漠视敢于为正义而斗争的人，人们就是在葬送未来

当人们忽视或不支持那些为正义而斗争的人时，他们实际上是在削弱社会的道德基础和推动正义进程的力量。为正义而斗争的人是社会变革的先驱，他们的行动能够揭示社会不公，激发公众意识，推动法律和政策的改进。如果这些斗争者得不到支持，社会必将陷入停滞和倒退，并出现更多的不公和压迫。这种漠视会传递出一个信息，即为正义而奋斗是徒劳无功的，这样的信息会进一步削弱人们追求改变的意愿和勇气。因此，支持那些为正义而斗争的人不仅是对他们个人的认可，更是对整个社会未来健康发展的一种投资。

真正的英雄主义

真正的英雄主义难道有国家之分吗？任何反对奴役的英雄壮举都能激励后来人继续为人类普遍的正义事业而战。

这个游戏中的那些历史上的英雄和烈士们，时刻都在用他们崇高的精神和事迹，讽刺着当代那些披着精英的画皮的类人物种的卑劣思想和行径。这就不难理解为何那些类人物种对这个游戏如此仇恨，因为它们从历史的镜子里看到了自己丑恶的嘴脸，它们发现自己跟游戏中的那些恶棍和走狗一模一样，因此恼羞成怒，发了疯地贬低这个作品，煽动那些打手对作者进行人身攻击。

就像真正的英雄主义是没有国界之分的，卖国贼在任何国家和时代也有着相同的嘴脸。

什么是卖国贼，卖国贼是损害国家利益而求取私利的人。国家，国民的国家，国民就是国家。打压国民，迫害国民，奴役国民，让国民保持愚昧，就是卖国贼。

那些卖国贼将通过非法手段强取豪夺来的钱财转移到美国，却还煽动国人仇恨美国，没错，靠说谎煽动仇恨割流量韭菜就是其中一种获取钱财的非法手段。

这是历史上第一个被卖国贼所痛恨的游戏，作者除了饱受上述卖国贼们攻击之外，没有也不可能有什么收益，卖国贼却总是能通过对这个游戏的造谣诽谤割流量韭菜。即使是从历史的角度来看，揭露事物本质的人和作品在当时也往往得不到多数人的赞赏，反而会遭到恶棍的围攻。

那些卖国贼气急败坏的样子，最能说明这个游戏的价值，那些卖国贼的卑劣行径，更衬托出那些英雄的崇高。

我们的敌人不在外部，而在内部，我们的敌人不是美国，而是那些还在把钱转移到上述国家的卖国贼，是还在试图跑到上述国家的卖国贼。只要这样的恶棍在我们的国家继续兴风作浪，我们的国家便没有希望，我们国家的穷人便没有希望。

卖国贼不希望国民了解事实真相，了解什么是真正的人类的良知，什么是真正的英雄主义，因为这会让那些恶棍无法继续兴风作浪，继续奴役国民。

除了外部环境带来的困难，这个游戏的制作成本也一直困扰着我。我究竟该如何筹集开发资金？当然，较高的售价用处不大，可是众筹也无人问津。只有在被那些类人物种攻击的时候，这个项目才会成为被关注对象。不过我知道并不是所有人都像那些类人物种一样满脑子秽物，内心充满了各种阴暗的目的。这个社会还是存在一些希望的。

只要能展现什么是真正的人类良知，什么是真正的英雄主义，只要能继续揭示历史真相，能揭露类人物种的丑恶嘴脸，这个游戏就应该被更多人看到。你们的支持对这个项目接下来的开发至关重要。

2340810.name: Assassins of Darkness
2340810.about_the_game:
A long time ago, after the death of Emperor Nakatomi Shigeaki without an heir, the Eastern Empire disintegrated and fell into turbulent times. The political power of the empire was held by a series of military dictators and feudal lords known as the Shoguns and Daimyos. The Shoguns and Daimyos slaughtered each other, leaving the once prosperous land in the region covered in blood for hundreds of years.

At the most crucial moment of the war, Sakura, an elite assassin of the Nagasawa clan, betrayed her clan. She sought the power of darkness from the Darkness Titan Kilgranuth with the desire to end the civil war and unite all the clans into a new empire under her rule.

Now, with the Dark Energy flowing in Sakura's veins. She is ready to slay everything she sees from the smallest harmless animals to the most powerful monsters from Inferno. She has to go through the most difficult challenges facing the fiercest monsters of hell in her journey. With diverse gameplay along with an engaging storyline, the game will not let you down with its vast and challenging exploration. Combined with a unique and exciting skill set, the game's combat system will immerse you in exciting battles with the fiercest and most powerful bosses.



FEATURES:


  • Intriguing Storyline.
  • Female Protagonist.
  • In-depth Battle System.
  • Beautiful Graphics.
  • Attractive Gameplay.
  • High Difficulty.
  • Diverse and Attractive Skill System.

Sakura - Dark Assassin

Sakura is an elite assassin of the Nagasawa clan specially trained to assassinate the heads of other clans. Born into a family of assassins, from a young age, she trained to become one of the greatest assassins. From the darkness, she appeared and attacked the enemy with a speed faster than the wind, causing the enemy to die without knowing what had happened. At the most crucial moment of the war, she was assigned by Nagasawa Eire to assassinate the head of the Kanagi clan, Risako. However, on the way to the mission, she realizes that assassinating Risako will only create more chaos for her hometown. So she sought the power of darkness from the Darkness Titan Kilgranuth with the desire to end the civil war and unite all the clans into a new empire under her rule.

Ruby - Magic Archer

Ruby is the talented disciple of Darkness Titan Kilgranuth. Hiding in the darkness, aiming at her enemies with precision, she fired arrows sharper than knives at a speed faster than the wind that pierced the weak hearts of her enemies. In addition to her superb archery skills, Ruby is also known as a reliable companion, ready to help her teammates when necessary. Receiving orders from Darkness Titan Kilgranuth, she and Sakura began to go to Inferno to test the energy that Sakura has just been bestowed.

Aezlisa - Succubus

Aezlisa was once a voluptuous woman that any man coveted. All the bravest warriors are willing to die to win her heart. However, hiding behind her beautiful exterior is a wicked soul. The strongest warriors after conquering her all had to pay the price with death. Realizing the wickedness in Aezlisa's soul, the demons of Inferno kidnapped her to Inferno to become their slave. Over time, she became one of Inferno's most lustful demons. However, she was tired of serving violent demons. She wanted to be the one to win the hearts of others, not to be a slave to these demons. So she is willing to do anything to be free and out of this Inferno.

Lilira - Dark Warrior

Lilira is the champion of Inferno. Since childhood, she has always been ridiculed by other warriors because of her huge breasts. However, instead of being embarrassed, she responded to the ridicule with punches that bruised their eyes. With her unrivaled strength, she proved to other warriors that women can fight just as well as men. Steadfast and brave, Lilira wanted something more out of life and left her home in search of something greater. She went around and won tournament after tournament, bringing in huge amounts of wealth and fame. Realizing the rare talent of Lilira, Darkness Titan Kilgranuth took her to Inferno to fight the most powerful monsters. No difficulty could stop her, all the most powerful monsters were defeated by her and she was honored to become the champion of Inferno.

2340960.name: ReThink | Evolved 5
2340960.about_the_game:
ReThink | Evolved 5 is a Puzzle Game in a peaceful futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors to create challenging problems to solve.

Use proven and some new gameplay mechanics to puzzle your way through the game's beautiful world, which is now filled with even more puzzles than in previous games.


Lots of Content:

ReThink | Evolved 5 features more than 50 Puzzles that make use of newly introduced features and old ones alike, to keep the gears in your head turning.

New and improved gameplay elements:

The "Evolved" branch of the ReThink Series always had the most features, this game is no different.


It comes with almost every feature known from the previous 4 games, often improves them and then adds some new things on top.


Less linear progress:

Unlike previous games, in ReThink | Evolved 5 you are often more free to go where you want within an area, letting you decide which path you want to take, what puzzles to solve first.

Improved Levels:

ReThink | Evolved 5 comes with the largest Levels of any of the ReThink games, as was requested by Feedback in the past, therefore reducing level transitions to a minimum while conveying a sense of scale and place.


What you see, is what you get: If you see a Puzzle that you can not access yet, you will eventually get there, as is normal for the ReThink games.

Overall improved features:

While the game does not reinvent the wheel, it improves the gameplay and usability through a variety of changes and additions.


Many of these changes are aimed at giving players a greater tolerance when handling cubes and solving puzzles, improving the overall feeling of the game.

Improved Graphics:

Thanks to Unreal Engine 5, ReThink | Evolved 5 looks better than the previous games, while still running "as usual" on older systems when the new graphics are disabled.


Fully dynamic Global Illumination makes the simplistic style of the game shine, while not limiting player actions or Puzzles like previous lighting methods would have.

Additional Soundtrack:

Players wanted one, now they got one.

There is now a choice between the games original Soundtrack, and the new one introduced with ReThink 4.

2340970.name: Railborn
2340970.about_the_game:
Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.


Construct your train piece by piece, floor by floor, railcar by railcar.



Play alone or in co-op mode with your friends.


Navigate branching paths that carve through mountains and dive into the sea.



Beyond the train lies a hostile, dying world.


Manage power systems, direct resource flow, capture and distribute water.



Recreate biomes on your train.


Uncover the truth behind a planet consumed by endless tracks.


Pilot your train up the ultimate track rising into space.

2340980.name: Project Colored Mountains
2340980.about_the_game:
Project Colored Mountains is a cozy and colorful 3D platformer starring a bouncy little robot on a lighthearted journey through surreal and playful spaces.

Stretch yourself while launching yourself across buildings and bouncing off glowing blocks in a relaxing world that invites exploration over combat. It’s just you and a world full of strange, deserted places to discover.

At the heart of Project Colored Mountains is its movement system. You’ll unlock new abilities as you go, allowing your robot to:

  • Bounce in midair

  • Roll at high speeds 

  • Chain jumps and boosts to move with precision

Each move is designed to feel satisfying on its own and even better when combined. Whether you're hopping across a sunny field or bouncing through a flooded school hallway, the controls are smooth and intuitive, designed to reward creative play.

GIF of midair bounce combo goes here

The environments in Project Colored Mountains are quiet, surreal, and slightly magical. Every area is filled with hidden nooks, secret entrances, optional challenges, and playful environmental details. Some locations include:

  • A quiet, peaceful field, to explore at your own pace

  • A silent school, full of secrets

  • A children’s museum, with oversized exhibits and impossible rooms

  • And more!

 GIF of traversal

Each area introduces new types of blocks that change how you interact with the world. Uses of these odd cubes include:

  • Switching your gravity

  • Teleporting you across huge distances as well as tiny ones

  • Making your jumps huge!

  • Spawning something in

    And more

GIF of blocks: jump pads, teleporters, gravity shifts, etc.

While the game keeps things light and relaxing, there’s still a sense of progression and reward. You’ll:

  • Unlock new areas by completing levels

  • Collect light shards

  • Discover gems that temporarily enhance your movement

  • Revisit earlier locations with new abilities to find what you missed

Each level is self-contained, but they’re all part of a larger connected world - one that slowly reveals a mysterious event that changed everything.

GIF of unlocking a world

  • Smooth and satisfying platforming controls

  • A relaxed, story-light experience with no enemies

  • Bright, surreal levels that reward curiosity

  • Unlockable movement upgrades that expand your freedom

  • Dozens of secrets, power-ups, and hidden entrances

  • Ideal for both quick play sessions and deep exploration

Project Colored Mountains is perfect for people who love creative movement, hidden secrets, and gentle world building. Whether you want a challenge or just to roll around for fun, this is a world you can take at your own pace.

2340990.name: Jump Jump Cyberpunk
2340990.about_the_game:
Jump. Dodge. Repeat. Improve.

A fast, intense and challenging arcade platformer where every jump matters 🎮
Dive into a neon cyberpunk world full of lights, electronic music and impossible obstacles.

One mistake…
and you’re back to the start 💥 

Do you have the reflexes?

  • Short but extremely challenging levels

  • Simple gameplay, brutal difficulty

  • Vibrant Neon Cyberpunk visuals

  • Electronic music synced with the action

  • Perfect for speedrunners and hardcore players

  • Learn patterns. Improve times. Break your limits.

Easy to play. Hard to master.

Each level is a test of precision, memory and rhythm.
No luck.
Only skill.

Only the patient reach the end

If you enjoy fast-reflex games, progressive difficulty and real challenges…
Jump Jump Cyberpunk will test your nerves.

How far can you go without failing? 😨

2341030.name: Grim Tides - Old School RPG
2341030.about_the_game:
Grim Tides blends tabletop RPG adventure, dungeon crawling and roguelike mechanics, and a classic turn-based combat system into something that feels equally like a solo tabletop campaign or a choose-your-own-adventure book. Detailed worldbuilding, abundance of lore and hand-drawn artwork make every run feel like a story in its own right.


"What is the price of knowledge? What is the price of power that comes with it?"

Welcome to Farhaven, a lone port in an exotic tropical archipelago of the Southern Isles. Far removed from the orderly confines of civilization, the town is a den of crime, decadence and debauchery, standing on the precipice of the unknown. Enter a condemned prisoner who's been offered a chance at redemption in this strange new frontier...

As major factions and powers that be converge around you, you have a tough choice to make: will you be a simple puppet involved in a sinister plot beyond your understanding? Or will you take your fate into your own hands? Whatever your decision, it could have consequences far beyond your wildest imagination, because the hidden depths of the Isles' ancient jungles hide a secret so terrible, it could spell doom of the world itself. 


"How far are you willing to go to earn your freedom? What are you willing to sacrifice?"

*** FEATURES ***

  • immerse in a rich fantasy world with its own history and lore

  • defeat enemies and fight boss battles in a classic turn-based combat system

  • customize your character in a classless system with many skills, spells, and perks at your disposal

  • experience the game world through a large variety of interactive, text-based events

  • manage your own ship and crew as you explore an exotic tropical archipelago

  • complete quests, collect bounties and find scattered pieces of ancient lore

  • play your own way, with 4 difficulty levels, optional permadeath and other adjustable settings


"The Mua-Ta of old have a saying: when the Dark closes in, your own mind is your worst enemy"

* Grim Tides is a standalone prequel to Grim Quest. No prior experience with the series is needed; it's a complete adventure on its own.

2341070.name: The Banished Vault
2341070.about_the_game:
Survive a journey across space in the Auriga Vault, an interstellar gothic monastery crewed by the last remaining exiles of a terrible disaster. Explore hostile solar systems, construct outposts, and craft precious materials to keep your crew alive. During the long hibernation between suns, expand the knowledge and ability of your exiles, and delay the arrival of The Gloom.

The Banished Vault is a run-based strategy game of solar system exploration, resource and crew management, and outpost construction.

Procedurally generated solar systems are displayed as realistic energy maps, with various bodies presenting different challenges. Plan your movements carefully, as engines and fuel behave according to a simplified but punishing rocket equation.

Construct outposts in orbit and on planet surfaces, considering the space needed, hazards, and accessibility. Resources are not tracked globally, and must be harvested and transported by your star ships from various locations to be used.

Search for artifacts to bring back to the Vault to unlock abilities for your exiles and new buildings to construct. Dice challenges test your exiles’ faith enduring hazards in a hostile universe.

Complete your run by surviving long enough to write the story of your Vault and transmit it home. The voyage is challenging - your exiles might die or be left behind. If you are reduced to one exile, the journey fails. No one can survive alone.

FEATURES

  • Unique gameplay and solar system presentation using simplified but realistic math.

  • Challenging and permanent decisions reward planning and careful play.

  • Tense risk management and exploration involving dice challenges and unforeseen outcomes.

  • Gorgeous hand-drawn art and board game style aesthetic.

  • A stark and hostile original setting inspired by Alien and The Book of the New Sun.

  • An extensive and carefully written manual that combines tutorial, game explanation, and reference guide.
2341070.reviews:
“The Banished Vault is, if anything, a master class in the economy and cruelty of space survival where every movement matters. It is wholeheartedly uncompromising in bending the player to its will and vision, and it is right to do so.”
Recommends – Polygon

“It is a logistical, spiritual, and mathematical high-wire act.”
9.9 / 10 – Paste

“... an entirely singular game about the depths of space, the limits of your own mind, and the divine beauty of mathematics.”
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ – Eurogamer

2341080.name: Priscillas Dream
2341080.about_the_game:
In this Top-Down RPG game, players find themselves stranded in a vast and unforgiving desert, facing challenges and obstacles at every turn. The game begins with the player character waking up in the middle of the desert, surrounded by a small group of survivors who are also struggling to survive in the harsh environment.

As the leader of this group, the player must navigate the harsh desert terrain, scavenge for food and water, and fend off dangerous creatures that lurk in the sand dunes. The game offers a variety of RPG elements, including character customization, skill development, and equipment upgrades.

The gameplay mechanics are centered around exploration and survival, with the player and their group constantly searching for resources to keep themselves alive. The game offers an immersive open-world environment, with various locations to explore such as abandoned towns, oases, and ancient ruins.

As the player progresses through the game, they will encounter a range of characters, each with their own motivations and agendas. Some may be friendly and offer to help the player, while others may be hostile and try to harm them. Players will need to use their wits and skills to navigate these interactions and make the right choices to advance the story.

The game also features a crafting system, allowing players to create useful items such as weapons, tools, and shelter to help them survive. Additionally, the player can recruit new members to their group, each with their unique skills and abilities to aid them in their quest to escape the desert.

Overall, this Top-Down RPG offers an immersive and challenging survival experience set in a harsh desert environment, where players must use their skills and strategies to keep their group alive and eventually escape to safety.

2341090.name: Sisyphus.12.20.03
2341090.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Sisyphus, a 3D platformer that takes you on a journey through the eyes of a robot designed to help humanity: Sisyphus voiced by Kakos Xamos. The game explores the theme of existentialism and depression, delving into the mind of Sisyphus as it reminisces about humanity and its creator. As the player, you will accompany Sisyphus on its emotional journey, navigating through the different levels and obstacles in a world that has been left behind by humanity.

With stunning graphics and mesmerizing sound effects, Sisyphus immerses you in a post-apocalyptic world where the only surviving being is a robot questioning its own existence. The game's unique gameplay mechanics and challenging platformer puzzles will keep you hooked for hours on end, pushing your skills to the limit as you explore the different levels and environments.

But what sets Sisyphus apart from other platformers is its emotional depth and powerful storytelling. As you progress through the game, you will uncover the memories and thoughts of Sisyphus, experiencing the raw emotions of a robot left alone to ponder the meaning of its existence. The game is voiced by the YouTuber Kakos Xamos, whose haunting voice adds to the game's melancholic atmosphere.

Sisyphus is not just a game; it's an experience that will leave a lasting impact on you. Its themes of loneliness, depression, and the human condition will resonate with players of all ages and backgrounds. Sisyphus is not just another platformer; it's an art piece that will leave you breathless and emotional.

So, if you're looking for a game that challenges your skills while also exploring the depths of human emotion, look no further than Sisyphus. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through the mind of a robot and discover the true meaning of existence.

2341100.name: Lost in Cheese
2341100.about_the_game:
Lost in Cheese is a brand new puzzle game. Play as Mewton, a cube shaped cat who travels to Roll island. Embark on a cozy adventure filled with cheese. Lots of cheese. Your mission? Push, strategize, and clear the path to the big red button!

For each cheesy level completed you get one step further to solving the mystery of the cheese.

Immerse yourself in an adorable and cozy world filled with cheese.

Meet some old friends along the way giving you clues of the origin of the mystery cheese.

🏆 Award-Winning Puzzle Fun! 🏆

 🥇 Winner: Best Game Idea – The Great Winter Pitch 2023

 🥈 Runner-Up: The Great Summer Pitch 2023

Features:

- Explore beautiful islands filled with over 80 levels.

- Master each puzzles and unlock new worlds.

- Strategize your moves and aim for the least rolls possible to be rewarded.

- Enjoy atmospheric worlds with mind bending challenges.

- Collect coins and tokens.

- Cozy and relaxing atmosphere.

- Customize your looks in the barbershop.
2341100.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish

2341110.name: Narcalid
2341110.about_the_game:
Narcalid is a cooperative enlightenment journey emphasizing peaceful exploration that teaches real-life meditation skills as you decipher cryptic messages from the past. Immerse yourself in the beautiful and broken remains of once great civilizations, but stay aware… the Narcalid is a powerful threat that should not be underestimated!

From the ancient texts that move along the narrative to the multiple environmental hazards of an unknown territory, Narcalid challenges you to see the universe differently. The deep spiritual principles embedded in the gameplay offer intense focus and flow stats throughout your adventure into this new world.

You must reclaim lost abilities and decipher the sacred text of the ancients, which has remained secret for thousands of years. Heal the wounds of epic bosses, learn to coexist with exotic creatures, and use the power of meditation to purify the planet.

With Seemsless co-op, bring up to four friends to explore a beautiful and dangerous new world. Narcalid is built to offer a compelling solo-player experience and an adventure that can be enjoyed as a team. Each ambassador character in the game comes equipped with a unique multi-tool, from a wall-shattering projectile to a projectile-shunting shield.

Narcalid offers precise controls, challenging puzzles, tricky platforms, and epic bosses. Get ready to unlock all your chakras and conquer all the dangers and threats that Mother Narcalid holds for you. Tons of enemies and bosses are waiting for you in the depths of this unknown world.

  • 4 Unique Characters

  • Unique Skills and Powers

  • Seamless Co-op

  • Split-Screen

  • A Compelling Narrative that Embeds Deep Spiritual Principles

  • Out-of-this-world Creatures

  • Learn About the Powers of Chakra, Body, and Mind self-control

  • Multiple Unique Boss Fights

  • Platform and Puzzle-Solving Challenges

2341130.name: The Turgenev Study
2341130.about_the_game:
In this experimental arena game, capture enemies around you once every ten seconds, and avoid them the rest of the time. The harvested enemies' DNA will fill up a progress bar that, when full, lets you assimilate one enemy, which in turn will upgrade your agent. Weave your way around dangers, maximize captures, and choose wisely which enemies and associated upgrades you want to assimilate.

As you complete objectives and reach higher scores, you will unlock new enemies, new capacities, and new objectives. The research must go on.

For better accessibility the game features a set of different palettes apart from the original one shown in the screenshots and trailer.

2341140.name: Draw Rider Remake
2341140.about_the_game:
This is the highly anticipated remake of the legendary Draw Rider, rewritten from the ground up to be bigger, better and prettier in every way.

In the game you will find a huge number of different levels, the passage of which will open up various opportunities for character customization. In the beginning there will be nothing difficult, but once the training is over, there will be real hardcore! If you are tired of standard tracks, you can always create your own level in a special editor, as well as play on tracks created by other players.

Features:

• 350 hand-made levels
• Custom Levels, Level Editor & Global Level Sharing
• Leaderboard and online mode with over 200,000 levels
• Over 100 hidden secret customization items to discover
• 9 different crazy vehicles
• and more!

A sea of fun, incredible levels, cool electronic music, all this is Draw Rider Remake!

2341160.name: Harvest Uranus
2341160.about_the_game:
Harvest Uranus is a cross between action roguelite, farmsim and puzzle game. Embark on quests from opposing factions or choose a life of a freelancer, grow toxic plants, experiment with breeding, pesticides, flamethrowers, laser katanas, waterguns and other ridiculous tools; explore various planets and fight aliens while trying to earn money to travel to the next planetoid so you can get closer to your dream.

Why?

This is the question every person who happens to be born, living, or forced to end their life in the 22nd century is asking themselves.

While humanity fought over territory, property, and its own self-esteem, “domesticated” plants slowly domesticate humanity. Closely controlling humanity's development and political actions, they rapidly increased crops population. But the moment wheat, corn, and rice united in The Herbal Collective... they were being domesticated by cows.

Now the cow overlords have discovered their two-faced nature and in a matter of hours have turned the world into a vast Cow Benevolent Dynasty in which plants and mankind had a very minor role to play - being the hardworking hands and dainty food of their lords.

This game is about suffering. And about madness. It takes a madman to escape the quiet collective farms of Venus and go to Uranus to try your luck, putting your life on the line for a little ephemeral freedom. But it's already happened, so enjoy growing toxic plants that will blow your mind for a pile of garbage, credits, and a roll of toilet paper.

Key Features:
- Get assignments from Cow Benevolent Dynasty or The Herbal Collective to grow plants and defend your base on the colony
- Explore planets, find new gadgets and find a way to get the hell out of here
- A New Chance: failure is not the end. There are many like you on the orbiting ship: just wake up the new adventurer and start your journey from the beginning

2341200.name: Cube de Grace
2341200.about_the_game:
About This Game


It is a mix of a classic RPG and CCG. In the game, instead of cards with different abilities, you define the actions of the characters by rolling dice with various effects on its faces.

But don't worry, you're still in control of the battlefield! With your unique abilities and customizable items, you can manage the element of randomness and modify the final effects of the roll.

Collectible Dice Game


Cube de Grace is CDG. It’s like CCG but with dice instead of cards. This adds an extra layer of fun and excitement to the game. The random aspect can still be managed with the help of skills, items, and other mechanics.

Win battles and explore the galaxy to upgrade your collection. Add heroes and items to the mix and find your own way to control your fate.

RPG Elements


The tabletop role-playing game spirit, combat mechanics with dice and RPG elements, such as dialogues, non-combat encounters. All this is merged with the fun of CCG style.

The Best Combat Mechanics


◉ Plenty of heroes, idols for your character, with their own abilities and characteristics. You determine your set of heroes that best fit your style.

◉ Collecting dice with various effects on their sides and abilities that affect during the turn.

◉ A turn-based duel with in-battle progression and tons of dice rolls.

◉ Items that allow you to change the properties of dice right during the battle. Or sacrifice them (dice) for the sake of beneficial effects.

Customizable Settings


The consistency and predictable randomness of Dicey Dungeons, but with a more mature setting and non-combat encounters.

Diversified Gameplay


The game cycle with drastically different gameplay.

Gather the party of heroes with different characteristics. Bring the most valuable items with you. Roll dice to fight. Use abilities to change the result of the battle at will. Get a collection of dice, heroes, and items and go further and further on your way to change the destiny of your loved ones.

Unique Story


All armed conflicts are in the past since scientists discovered the way to determine people's fates. They have created the corporation responsible for distribution of dice, your elements of fate, for every newborn in the world. With the support of different races they quickly established a strong dictatorship over the galaxy and now they control the fates of one and all. Since then the only possible conflict resolution method is a match of Cube de Grace, the game of fates. The winner has full power over the fate of the loser.

What will you do if your family is lost in the sequence of strange events and you will be arrested for just one crime – ability to control the threads of destiny? Will you give up? Or you will try to change your fate no matter the cost?

2341210.name: STACK
2341210.about_the_game:
STACK is a VR multiplayer disc action game set in a wild post-apocalyptic world.

Engage in intense battles solo or with teammates. Dash through rusty environments, launching deadly discs and mastering the art of bouncing them off walls and surfaces.



INSTANT FUN

With intuitive basic mechanics, you will start enjoying the combat right away. Engage in skirmishes on 3 maps - in 1v1 or with up to 10 players in various game modes.

Invite your friends to play in private lobbies and find new teammates in the public social lobby.

FEEL THE PROGRESS

Not only you grow as a player, there's always a quest or a challenge for you to complete and unlock cosmetic items. Show them off on deadly arenas!

READY FOR ESPORTS LOVERS

Make it to the top, surpassing players from all parts of the world.

Private lobbies, spectator mode, league system - competitive players will feel right at home in STACK.

Team up and participate in developer- and community-hosted tournaments to become a STACK champion!

2341220.name: Abaddon
2341220.about_the_game:
Abaddon is a classic first person psychological horror game, featuring disturbing gameplay and a haunting, character driven narrative. 

STORYLINE

What would you do if your little brother disappeared without a trace… and the only path forward led to a place shaped by fear, not physics? Play as Jimmy, a 22 year old dragged into a collapsing reality, where memory, guilt, and grief twist the world around him. To find your brother Georgie you’ll have to confront the horrors of your past, and a world that was never meant to be seen. Will you uncover the truth, or be consumed by it?

Characters:

Everyone in the game has a story - twisted, broken, and all too human. The deeper you go, the more their secrets intertwine with yours. But beware, every step forward draws the eyes of something large, and hungry.

Gameplay:

Explore a twisted, surreal world full of puzzles, pain, torture and cosmic dread. Use your flashlight and your wits to survive. And remember, although you are on your own own, you are NEVER alone in the darkness.

Note from team:

We are an indie game studio called Nice to Meet Studios LTD. Having played horror games for over a decade, our love for the genre led us to create Abaddon. The game is a pure love letter to the classic horror titles that inspired us, such as Amnesia: The Dark Descent, P.T., Outlast, Visage, MADiSON, Detention, Resident Evil, and many others. Abaddon is designed to deliver a terrifying, classic horror experience.

Our goal is to make players suffer and terrify them in a deeply immersive horror experience that stays with you.

2341240.name: Shotgun Knight
2341240.about_the_game:
Shotgun Knight is an unforgiving platformer about propelling yourself upwards in search of the mysterious Double Barrel Banana. The only way to move up is by shooting a powerful shotgun with recoil that will send you up in the air but be careful as falling can set you back many hours of progress. Only those with the strongest willpower will reach the top.

Gameplay


-Master the art of the shotgun
The shotgun is deceptively simple but will take practice to master



-Up is the only way to go
With each jump, the stakes rise only to fall and lose all your progress for you to have to make that climb all over again



-The Double Barrel Banana await you
The climb may not be easy but those who push through will have a pleasant surprise awaiting you at the top



  • Climb high with nothing but yourself and a shotgun
  • Brutally difficult but addictive gameplay
  • Lose hours of progress in mere seconds
  • The Double Barrel Banana awaits those skillful enough to reach the top

2341300.name: Car Delivery Man
2341300.about_the_game:
Become a driver who delivers cars to different countries. Immerse yourself in the nostalgic open world of the late 90s. Discover the adventure by driving through various routes, testing your driving skills and delivering vehicle carefully.

Game Features:
- Delivery of various cars.
- Decide for yourself which route you will take.
- Ability to earn money to buy cars.
- Driving from the first and third person.
- Possibility to get out of the car.

2341330.name: Lost Alone Ultimate
2341330.about_the_game:
Lost Alone Ultimate is a first-person psychological horror game that aims to instill anxiety, anguish, and terror.


George is a man with a turbulent and mysterious past. Tormented by his demons, George emerges from the spiral of alcohol addiction by meeting Hanna. But his childhood traumas will resurface, pushing him into the abyss of despair.

In this dreamlike journey, George will meet several characters along his path. Each person, in some way, will have to do with his decline and rebirth. George's life has been marked by the presence and passing of 6 key women.

Good
Good players win if all evil players have been rooted out, and there are no remaining neutral players with an achievable win condition.
A number of good aligned players will receive a Hero role with varying extra abilities related to defense or information gathering.

Evil
Evil players win if all good players have been eliminated, and there are no remaining neutral players with an achievable win condition.
All evil players will receive a Villain role with insidious abilities.

Neutral
Neutral players will each have their own win conditions depending on their role.
All neutral players will receive a Neutral role with unique abilities suited to their respective goals.

2341800.name: Magic and Machines
2341800.about_the_game:
A retro fantasy RPG with turn-based battles, puzzles, and six unique characters.

Journey into the world of Magic and Machines with six unique party members on a quest to uncover the mystery behind a decaying world. Discover new areas, find the legendary items, solve puzzles to unlock secret buffs, and master the turn-based battle system with its Overload mechanic. Magic and Machines is perfect for players who grew up with turn-based RPGs and are looking for a new adventure while also being accessible for new players as it doesn’t take itself too seriously.

Inspired by games such as Chrono Trigger, Golden Sun, and Octopath Traveler, the game is a nod to those influences of the past and present. The game simplifies many RPG elements such as progression or equipment setups. There’s enough mechanics so players will strategize but not enough that they’ll need to reference a wiki to optimize. It’s also quite easy to pick up and put down and is perfect in short bursts or a longer sit down.

"I wanted to create a game that would appeal to fans of nostalgic turn-based RPGs that may have busy lives, but also could be picked up by someone who's new to the genre.”

Story
In a small quiet town a little accident leads to a dramatic chain of events. Years later, monsters run rampant, the world is slowly eroding, and the Sacred Stones are disappearing one by one. Initially, two childhood friends journey out of their small town to find a missing colony, but they uncover an even larger crisis as they cross paths with a colorful cast of characters. Form your party of three from six characters, explore and discover secrets, uncover hidden bosses and their legendary items, and use strategy to defeat your foes.

Gameplay
Turn-based battle system with an Overload mechanic. This mechanic lets you supercharge a move after you've used it twice. It can make attacks stronger, effects last a turn longer, and heals surpass your max health. Sometimes you may want to save it and sometimes you may want to use it right away.

In the Overworld, some characters can alter the terrain of the world with their elemental abilities. Use their powers to find new areas and solve puzzles. You never know what you'll find!

Characters
Blaer - Fire adept that's good all around.
Zmrzlina - Ice mage with strong magic.
Alda - Water mage with the best heals.
Toka - Earth adept that bolsters defenses.
Mphepo - Air adept that's the fastest.
Dian - Plasma mage that's an offensive powerhouse.

Players will take on the role of the cat protagonist, "Hoki" and explore the unfamiliar and mysterious southern island, "Isla Mosa ".
Due to a natural disaster in their hometown, Hoki and a group of villagers had to take a boat to seek refuge at sea. Unfortunately, they encountered a storm and drifted to an unknown small island.

One day, a sudden tsunami engulfed the entire island. To find a new place to live, the villagers had to take a boat and drift at sea. They were caught in a storm and ended up being washed ashore on the mysterious " Isla Mosa," arriving at a settlement called " The Southern Capital."

2341920.name: 三國立志傳2
2341920.about_the_game:
三國霸主！劉備？曹操？孫權？

在全新二代中，玩家不再是只能帶領蜀國，這次可以從劉備、曹操與孫權中選擇自己想要扮演的君主，挑戰不同的任務挑戰完成統一大業！魏國的張遼、典韋、夏侯惇、夏侯淵、司馬懿等；吳國的周瑜、魯肅、呂蒙、太史慈、陸遜等，也都可能是你的手下大將。也許這一次你能幫幫周瑜的忙，讓他不要每次都被諸葛亮欺負。

全新機關車、特殊計謀與天候 戰場更添策略性

作戰主要取勝方式有二：物理攻擊與計謀。在二代中新增機關車、特殊計謀、天候及風向來增加戰鬥的變化性。機關車可以在作戰時進行物理及計謀攻擊，還能幫忙將領抵禦，而計謀攻擊除了原有的火、水、巫、人四大系，二代增加了特殊計謀，包括放火、變天、變風、陷阱、滅火、查探、傀儡。將領可以在空地上放火、設陷阱來攻擊敵軍，配合天候及風向利用變天、變風、滅火來控制戰場上的火勢，多樣的戰略讓戰鬥更有趣！

神奇寶物裝備完美將領 成長中的將領還會自動換裝

除了全身的裝備和藥品，二代新增了坐騎系統，重要將領也會隨著時間自動換裝，如果趙雲長大了還一身布衣，代表主公可能沒有好好的培養，如果玩家能即時好好地鍛鍊趙雲，他可能就穿著鮮亮的鎧甲等候你的命令！

經營城池！鍛鍊將領！調派將領！組成常勝軍！

二代中的城池，不只代表勢力範圍，新增的滿意度可影響你的人口及稅收，任務的成功與失敗則會影響滿意度。
玩家可完成特定任務招募人才，或到客棧裡透過金錢收買或魅力攏絡，讓更多的人才加你的陣營。每個將領都有體力限制，該進行兵器訓練、學習計謀鍛鍊或是攻城掠地就有待玩家計劃籌謀！

百餘關卡，網狀劇情，寫自己的三國故事

《三國立志傳二》採開放式的的網狀關卡，玩家可以依據戰略思考或喜好來決定關卡進行的順序，也許你可以幫曹操把孫權、劉備都滅亡後，最後再與黃巾賊正面對決，每個玩家都可寫出不同的三國故事。

War Tanks offers a blend of realistic tank simulation and an engaging arcade-style shooter, giving players an immersive and exciting experience. Whether you prefer fast tank tactics or strategic planning, this game has something for everyone.

FEATURES:

Variety tanks: Choose from light, medium, and heavy tanks, each offering different speeds and strengths for dynamic tank physics.

Upgrades and customization: Modify your battle tanks with advanced weapons and equipment to gain the upper hand in combat.

Global tournaments and leaderboards: Compete in global PvP to top the tank battle leaderboards and show off your skills.

Destructible environments: Fight in real-time tank battles with destructible environments, adding a layer of strategy to your gameplay.

Modern tank tactics: Lead your team through strategic maneuvers in team-based multiplayer battles, dominating the battlefield.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER AND MAP VARIETY:

Take part in multiplayer tank battles across realistic maps and diverse terrains. Explore desert battlefields, mountain passes, winter plains, and more, with detailed environments designed for intense tank combat.

PERFORMANCE AND OPTIMIZATION:

The game is fully optimized for most modern gaming devices, ensuring high FPS and seamless gameplay. The tank destruction physics and stunning 3D graphics provide an unmatched immersive experience. 2342150.name: Folk Hero
2342150.about_the_game:
The stories about Leshy, Domovoy and Rusalka have always seemed like legends, but in the world of Folk Hero fairy tales have come to life. More and more mysterious events are happening all around: animals disappear in the forests, villagers see mythical creatures, and a mysterious Island has appeared on the horizon…

Become a brave hero, and go to the island of Buyan to discover the cause of the mysterious occurrences!

Game features

Souls-like style combat system. Use fast and powerful attacks, special moves, dash, block and parry to defeat your enemies. Responsive controls will allow you to instantly react to changes in battles.

Unique enemies and bosses. Each enemy requires a different approach. Study their behavior so you don’t miss a single hit. Develop your skills as the Bosses will become a real test of your strength!

Builds. Combine character classes, weapons, artifacts and elemental runes to achieve maximum effectiveness in battle. Combine the runes with each other to gain new features for your weapons!

Various in-game locations. Procedural level generation makes each of your Runs unique. Explore the Mysterious forest, Swamp, Wasteland and the Castle of Koschei. Each biome holds secrets, try to find them all.

Variability of endings. What path awaits your Hero? Experiment to unlock all available story options and discover the true reason behind the appearance of the mysterious island.

Friendly fire. Enemies can attack each other! Force them to fight among themselves to avoid wasting precious health points.

Permanent death. One chance to reach the end. If the Hero dies on the island, he will remain there forever. On the Island you can earn points that will not expire after death, but will be used to upgrade new Heroes and abilities.

Pixel art. Beautiful retro-graphics and funny character animations will impress the fans of this style.

Chudo-Yudo Games development team and publisher Targem Games were inspired by such “roguelikes” as Hades, Curse of the Dead Gods, Binding of Isaac, Dead Cells, and Risk of Rain. We took the best, added our own ideas and got a game that will appeal to beginners and experienced players of the Rogue-lite genre alike.

2342210.name: GENIE
2342210.about_the_game:
Explore fantastic environments as Lula, as she journeys to discover the meaning of the Genie and fulfill her destiny. First Collect the broken crystal shards then follow the unraveling poems of the story.

GENIE is a couple of hours of a relaxing experience. A rich story that's presented in a poetic form combined with immersive graphics, fantasy style, gorgeous natural environments that take place in varied eras, made with Unreal Engine 5, and a charming soundtrack to make it a journey you may not soon forget. Enjoy the environments!

In the first half of the levels, the player collects crystal shards scattered around the map. When they collect all the shards, the poem-spots start to appear one by one. When the player stands on them, they have to find a light source around them and focus on it. When that happens, the camera view changes and the narration begins. After that is done, the next poem-spot reveals, and so on until the next level begins.

GENIE is the re-creation of Drizzlepath: Genie which was released in 2016. The environments are made from scratch, the story is altered and transformed into poem form. A highly talented voice actor has recorded the full narration of the game. The music is revisited (with a single exception) with a selection of more atmospheric tracks.

The game is divided into 15 parts which take about 5-10 minutes each; the progress is saved at their beginnings.

PS: The core aspect of this game is the atmosphere. It offers almost zero interaction and is recommended for those who mostly seek to experience the mood.

2342250.name: Eastern Heroes
2342250.about_the_game:
"Eastern Heroes" is a work that restores the original intention of martial arts, abandoning all redundant and complicated content, and abandoning the flashy and unrealistic appearance. Everything is transformed into the most authentic experience of cultivating the flavor of martial arts through writing.
Note: This game has in store purchases, but the game will not force players to make in store purchases due to any gameplay barriers. The game has been adjusted and tested by us for a long time, adhering to the original intention of not forgetting the original intention. It is a game that can still be played smoothly without the need for internal purchases, and it will also provide quick experiences such as various one click functions. But all in-game items can be obtained in the game, and in-game purchases are a channel for very few bosses who support domestic independent developers with real money and silver. We hope everyone can understand and provide feedback on the game experience at any time. Our original intention is still to always work hard for martial arts fans and create their favorite large-scale multiplayer online text-based martial arts games.
In the game, players take on the role of a creator who leads the entire sect, possesses various divine skills, and recruits talented martial arts talents in the martial arts world. They cultivate their disciples and lead them through various levels in the martial arts world, guarding Xiangyang to resist foreign invasion; You can also invite martial arts heroes to form the Xiaren Alliance, besiege the old nest of the Demon Cult, punish evil and eliminate bandits and demons; You can also participate in various martial arts debates and ultimately stand at the top of the martial arts world, walking alone in the martial arts world!
There are over 200 martial artists available for recruitment in the game, each with their own unique talents, abilities, and fate. Upon successful recruitment, they become disciples of their sect. There is a distinction between disciples themselves and their souls. Disciples are various characters who can directly go to battle; Soul is the soul of a disciple, and collecting a certain amount can be used to recruit disciples.
Activities such as searching for heroes, martial arts, daily login rewards, opening treasure chests, disciples making wishes, and drawing disciples to send souls all have the opportunity to obtain disciple souls. Collecting a sufficient number of souls can recruit the disciple. Recruiting disciples of three qualities, A, B, and C, requires a certain number of souls. A few disciples can only obtain it by participating in activities.
Players can gain disciple experience by participating in martial arts discussions, observing the Double Ninth Festival relics, and upgrading through guidance and guidance. Transmission of skills can transfer the experience of one disciple to another disciple. When passing martial arts, it is necessary to use the Nine Transformations Scattering Pill, which can restore 100% of the disciple's experience and other resources.
If the disciple's own soul is collected more, they can be allowed to break through, which can increase their potential points and further cultivate and improve their attributes. Players can also use cultivation pills to cultivate their disciples and improve their attribute effects.
The combat effectiveness level of a disciple is influenced by various attributes. Players can enhance their disciple's attribute effects by raising their level, wearing equipment, and breaking through their disciples.
Weapons and equipment
Equipment can enhance the attack, defense, and health attributes of disciples, giving them stronger combat power. In the game, equipment is divided into three types: weapons, armor, and accessories. Each disciple can only equip one piece of equipment of the same type. The quality of equipment is the same as that of disciples, and it is also divided into A, B, and C, with colors of purple, blue, green, and white respectively. The higher the quality, the higher the basic attributes, and the improved attributes after strengthening should also be much higher.
Players have a certain chance to obtain equipment through the boss elite monsters in the martial arts world, and the quality of the equipment will also improve as the difficulty of the boss increases. Players also have a chance to obtain equipment by opening gold, silver, copper treasure boxes, and wooden boxes. Daily login rewards have the opportunity to obtain equipment, and visiting the Immortal Sister has the opportunity to obtain accessories. Participate in the Zhenlong Chess game to collect treasures and have the opportunity to obtain level B and level A equipment.
Equipment development
Players can open the equipment interface and click the "build" button to enter the build interface. Creating can elevate equipment levels, and the higher the level of equipment, the more silver it will cost.
Create critical strikes that can increase equipment by multiple levels at once. The specific range of critical strike increases can be discovered within the game. The maximum level of equipment that can be crafted is three times the level of the sect. If there is a critical strike during the last crafting, the level of the equipment that can be crafted can exceed three times the level of the sect. However, if the leader's level has not been improved, crafting cannot continue. Upgrading the sect level can elevate equipment to a higher level.
Equipment refining
After reaching level 18, players can activate the "Equipment Refinement" function. By refining and upgrading, their equipment can become more powerful. Only equipment above level B can be refined.
Players enter the equipment interface, select a piece of equipment, click the "Refining" button, open the Refining interface, click on Refining Materials. Different levels of materials will have different experience points. When the experience points are sufficient, the "Refining" button will light up, and click on Refining to upgrade the equipment.
Equipment can be refined up to level 9, and higher level equipment requires more and more refined materials. Refined equipment will have attribute improvements, and successful refinement can reveal changes in equipment attributes. Equipment that has been refined and upgraded will be more affected by the level of crafting.
Equipment melting
Master level 1 is activated, melting equipment can obtain recast materials. In the equipment interface, you can see the smelting and recasting buttons. Melt the refined equipment and return 80% of the refined materials, prioritizing the return of high-level materials and supplementing low-level materials. Melt the recast equipment and return 70% of the recast material. The smelting effect of different equipment varies. Smelting equipment can obtain silver, refining iron, forging intent steel, and golden stepping stones.
Equipment recasting
When the level of the leader reaches level 6, the recasting function is activated, and only A and B equipment can be recast. There are three types of recasting, which require the consumption of refined iron, forged steel, and quenched gold. recasting can randomly give equipment and add a certain percentage of the original attribute. The original attributes refer to the attributes of equipment that have been crafted and refined.
The final attribute of recasting is to multiply the recast attributes of each level. Equipment that has not been recast can only be refined before forging, and can only be refined after forging.
First click on the shape training button, then the button will change to recast, and the amount of materials consumed will be displayed below. Click on recast to complete one recast. The operation of forging and quenching is similar.
When the next level of recasting is not carried out, the same recasting method can be continued to be used for recasting, refreshing attributes; If you want to refresh the previous level's recast attributes, the current level and higher-level recast attributes will be cleared, and you need to operate with caution. For example, if you are not satisfied with the attributes of practicing shape, you can click on practicing shape again to recast the attributes, but the forging intent and quenching precision attributes will be cleared.

There are three types of currency in the game: ingots, gold leaves, and silver. Each currency has a different purpose and its acquisition method. Among them, ingots can be used to search for customers, purchase various items in the mall, reset the number of dungeons, etc. Players can obtain them through recharge methods, sign in rewards, daily tasks, achievement tasks, and other means. The function of Golden Leaf is basically equivalent to that of a ingot, and it is preferred to use Golden Leaf by default when making purchases (it is not supported to choose the currency type for consumption).
Players can consume silver to build equipment, search for customers, and obtain some silver rewards through exploring dragon veins, blood battles, adventure missions, and other means.
Other consumables
The consumables in the game include flower chicken, palm door stickers, silver keys, copper keys, etc. These consumables can be used to increase stamina, increase sword discussions, open treasure pots, etc. They can all be stacked in the backpack. When players consume these consumables, the stacking quantity will decrease. Players can obtain various consumables through various daily activities, tasks, and mall purchases.
The above only introduces a small part of the many gameplay in the game. As for the entire gameplay of the game, players need to enter the game and explore it......

2342260.name: Haunted: The Chronicles
2342260.about_the_game:
In Haunted: The Chronicles, you play as a group of influencers who are passionate about exploring abandoned locations and want to share their adventures on the "Glitch" platform.

Everything needs to be done from scratch, build your community by filming abandoned sites filled with creatures and other dangers that are more frightening than the next. Solve puzzles and discover the history of the places.

Cooperate to survive and escape safely from these haunted locations.

Whatever you do, don't stay alone for too long.
The threat remains lurking in the shadows...


Equipment:

In Haunted: The Chronicles, you will have access to various tools and gadgets to aid you in your exploration of abandoned places. From flashlights to cameras, your equipment will be essential for documenting your findings and surviving the dangers that await.


Exploration:

The world of Haunted: The Chronicles is full of mysterious and eerie places waiting to be explored. From decrepit old mansions to abandoned asylums, each location is rife with secrets and dangers. Will you have what it takes to uncover the truth and escape with your life?


Puzzle and mechanics:

As you explore each location, you will encounter a variety of puzzles and obstacles to overcome. From deciphering cryptic messages to navigating treacherous terrain, your problem-solving skills will be put to the test. You'll need to use your wits and your equipment to figure out the clues and unravel the mysteries.


Escalating Difficulty:

As you progress through the game, the challenges you face will become increasingly difficult. You'll need to stay on your toes and be prepared for anything. With each new location comes new dangers, puzzles, and creatures, so make sure you're ready for whatever the game throws your way.


Co-op:

Haunted: The Chronicles can be played solo or with up to three other players in co-op mode. You and your friends have to work together to solve puzzles, fend off creatures, and escape each location. Cooperation and communication are key to survival, so make sure you have each other's backs.

2342280.name: Ten Seconds Trillion
2342280.about_the_game:
Ten Seconds Trillion is a simple clicker game with easy goals but addictive gameplay.

Your main and only goal is to reach one trillion value. But you have to do it in ten seconds.
Click anywhere to get money, buy upgrades to increase your income and use prestige system to activate powerful boosts. It's slow and tough at the beginning but after dozens power ups you will be able to complete the goal.

Click upgrades are based on percentage system. High current value means higher upgrade bonus.

Benefits:
  • Simple but addictive clicker gameplay
  • Easy goals and no boring infinite playthrough
  • Cute minimalistic graphics
  • Prestige system and various upgrades
  • Nice ambient music
  • Achievements and leaderboard

I created Ten Seconds Trillion as a game that I wanted to play by myself. I hope you share this fun with me.

2342320.name: Insane Escape
2342320.about_the_game:
Live an experience where the roguelike meets the survival horror.

In Insane Escape, each playthrough is different, as almost anything you will experience is randomly generated at the start. Explore a realistic asylum in which layout, room design, puzzles, and item placement will change at the start of every new game.

Every run there will be more to explore, more stories to be told, and different strategies to reach the end.

You are no hero. You are no legend. You can't fight back.

Threats will try to kill you, but you can't fight back, only hide. Learn to identify which one is coming after you, find how to survive them, and use the resources available to help you.

The floors and the rooms, with their furniture, hiding spots, items, and puzzle locations, will all be randomly generated at the start of every new game.

Every playthrough will have a different story to tell, new information to find, and secrets to unlock.

The puzzles themselves and their solution will also be randomized, ensuring a different experience every time you start the game.

The goal is to escape the asylum.

Threatening your life: several out-of-control patients trying to kill you.

Every one of them will attempt to kill you in its unique way. Learn how to identify them, find their weakness, and find a way to survive each encounter, or use your cunning and your resources to plan a way to avoid the encounters altogether.

What happened to the asylum? Why did these patients decide to escape? What are their stories?

Answer your questions with helpful lore documents you can find scattered everywhere.

Discover one piece at a time the story that brought you to this insanity.

  • Escape from an asylum with 3 randomly generated floors.

  • Survive more than 5 different threats, each with unique strengths and weaknesses.

  • Use a pool of different items to help you escape.

  • Solve randomly generated puzzles to find your way out.

  • Uncover a rich narrative narrated through level design and lore documents.

  • Discover all the secrets the St. Christina Asylum hides within its walls.

  • Challenge yourself even more with the optional Tokens you get at the end of each run or by enabling the hard mode.

  • Play with two different characters with two different stories, goals, and rules.

2342330.name: Dungeon of Argion
2342330.about_the_game:
Dungeon of Argion is a auto-firing game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements.
Try to unluck new passiv and attack items by compleating achivements.

2342340.name: Save My Dreams
2342340.about_the_game:
Welcome to a charming retro-style 3D platformer inspired by classic PS1 collect-a-thons. In this game, you play as Mars, a brave tiger on a quest to restore the lost memories of Princess Mia by exploring her dream world.



The game offers colorful and delightful dreamscapes filled with endearing characters. Mars can run, jump, and dash through levels, unlocking new areas as you progress.

The game's low-poly models and retro video effects create a nostalgic atmosphere, transporting players back to a simpler time. Additionally, the game features an original, hand-crafted soundtrack that further enhances the immersive experience.

Overall, this game offers a fun and engaging gameplay experience for fans of classic platformers. Join Mars on his journey to restore Princess Mia's lost memories and explore a charming dream world filled with vibrant characters.

2342360.name: Dead Hook
2342360.about_the_game:
Dead Hook is an explosive mix of rogue-like and shooter genres with brutal combat and captivating storytelling. Explore the elder planet Resaract and take on the role of Adam Stone, a mercenary, smuggler, thief, and devoted husband.



CHOOSE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE
Find legendary weapons and customize your character with 100 buffs and permanent upgrades to make each run unique. Experiment with different strategies and tackle the challenges that await you in the game.



VARIETY OF ENEMIES AND BOSSES
Every angel of death needs worthy opponents. Regular and elite infernals will try to stop you in the air and on the ground to defend their tombs. Bosses are also uniquely designed and have multiple phases, making each encounter feel tense and exciting.




SAVE YOUR LOVED ONE
The game's storyline adds another layer of depth to the gameplay experience. You will embark on a journey to uncover the secrets of Resaract and AI duality, facing tough choices and unexpected twists along the way.

2342390.name: SUGAMENIA
2342390.about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in SUGAMENIA, a 2D action platformer, where you'll have to solve puzzles in an epic adventure.


Play as Violet, a fearless space explorer marooned on this unknown planet, and your powerful ally, Suichi, a flying robot that can deploy bombs, be used as a platform, offer advice in order to find hidden treasures, and many more features.



Live an epic venture in a hostile world full of dangers where you'll have to showcase your skills. Prove your worth with your weapon and mastery of jumps in this action platformer. Fortunately, you're not alone. The company of a extraordinary drone will help you solve puzzles necessary to progress in the adventure. His name is Suichi, and he has very useful abilities like being a flying platform to reach high places, launching peculiar bombs that can roll into the most intricate spots, or helping you find hidden objects to improve your health and other secrets.

KEY FEATURES


  • A play-style unlike any other game... with Suichi!
  • Original chiptune music
  • Retro Pixel-art graphics, reminiscent of the NES
  • Head-scratching puzzles with unique and fun mechanics
  • Free exploration of a large map
  • Unique and colorful enemies
  • Extremely challenging bosses

2342400.name: WAT?
2342400.about_the_game:
WAT? is a first-person sandbox game with dark humor in an open world. The game takes place in a small town. The protagonist of the game is an elderly blogger named Bill Board. Today is Saturday and the grandson came to visit Bill. Bill and his grandson decided to fry potatoes for lunch, but there were too many potatoes, so they decided to treat people on the street, and at the same time stream. True, not everyone likes fried potatoes, which means they can attack you, so sometimes you have to defend yourself. For protection, you can use both an ordinary banana and a real weapon. All this can be bought in the store.

The player's task is to treat as many people as possible with fried potatoes. If you don’t want to do this, then the game has a sandbox mode where you can just walk around the city and play a joke on people. The main thing to remember is that if you break the law a lot, the police will start looking for you.

Help Bill feed as many people in the town as possible and stay alive.
