2342410.name: I Thought There'd Be Stars...
2342410.about_the_game:
"I remember being disappointed. I remember looking up at the night sky and feeling this great sadness. Honestly, I thought there’d be stars..."

Far out in the deepest reaches of space, a young man dreams of seeing the ruins of old earth. He dreams of setting foot on its soil and breathing in its air. He smiles to himself and goes back to painting. Beside him, reading her book, is his only real friend. Sully's the reason he's on this ship in the first place. He smiles again and reaches for another pot of paint.

Sully awakes on cold stone, the sound of pounding rain filling her world. She slowly gets to her feet, the endless rain soaking her to her skin. She looks back at the smoldering wreck of her old life and looks up at the endless black sky.

"At the end, I always thought there'd be stars..."

Follow a starship engineer through through the wreckage of her life as she desperately strives to be rescued from the storm-tossed hellscape she's crashed on. However, it's not just the rain that chills Sully to the bone but the memory of what she's left behind

Features:

  • Intricate Crafting System to help Sully survive her harsh environment

  • Fight to survive the cold and hunger on a planet wracked by constant thunderstorms

  • Follow Sully's journey through loss, grief, and hope

  • Beware what lurks in the storm...

2342430.name: Elysium Heights
2342430.about_the_game:
Elysium Heights is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel where you play as Catherine, a small town girl that recently moved in to New York.

One morning on her day off, she receives a call from her boss with an unexpected offer to work that night at a fancy event in one of the most luxurious buildings in the city: Elysium Heights.
The outcome of that night will change Catherine’s life forever...

In this game you’ll have to make decisions that will cause unique and distinct interactions between all characters.

Sex, money, lust, romance, cheating, corruption... What will she find?

The choice is yours.

2342480.name: Dubspace - Chapter 1
2342480.about_the_game:
Dubspace revolves around physical interactions that rely on forces and impulses. Mailcom navigates the zero-gravity environment using his jetpack, as well as weapons, pushing and pulling objects and obstacles. He may move fast, but he must be careful.

Mailcom will explore dark and foreboding space stations, each with its own unique environment and set of challenges. These stations are filled with obstacles, traps, and other hazards.

Launching a heavy object into the path of an enemy, redirecting the projectile with a well-timed push or solving an environmental puzzle, players must make use of properties such as mass and bounciness to their advantage.

Enemies come in many forms and shapes, spawned in a variety of ways to create endless combat situations. With a choice of weapons, grenades and items at their disposal, players can eliminate enemies in any way they see fit.


NOTE: Controller is required for local multiplayer

2342550.name: TOONCOP
2342550.about_the_game:
Play for Free. Survive the Cartoon Apocalypse.

Tooncop is a fast-paced, first-person horde shooter prototype where you take on waves of chaotic, rogue cartoon enemies spilling into the real world.

There’s no pay-to-win, no microtransactions, and no cosmetic grinding—just raw arcade-style gameplay focused on survival, score chasing, and moment-to-moment chaos.

Each run gives you 15 minutes to survive increasingly aggressive enemy waves, collect XP, chain power-ups, and push for high scores. The game is designed to be simple, snappy, and satisfying—with a growing emphasis on muscle memory and flow state combat.

Whether you're testing your reflexes or just blasting rogue Pomchis for fun, Tooncop is all about gameplay first.

💡 This is an early prototype created by a solo developer. Expect frequent updates, new maps, and evolving mechanics as the project grows.

Play now for free on Steam and help shape what comes next.

2342610.name: CarLife Simulator
2342610.about_the_game:
CarLife Simulator is a realistic car driving simulator with fun and challenges for the driver. Ideal for learning how to drive a car in different conditions, off-road, cities, racing tracks for every taste, all this is available in CarLife Simulator.

Cars. Over 40 vehicles, each unique, from family sedans to rare hypercars.

Game world. An open world with a big city, interesting places full of secrets, beautiful views from the top of a mountain, or a crystal clear lake far from civilization. Racing tracks that challenge you to complete the lap as quickly as possible.

Realistic and smart AI. It is present in the game world in the form of traffic, but also in the form of rivals on the track.

Quests. From racing with merciless rivals who strive to cut and leave you behind, to passing the track for a certain time on a wet track where you have to prove your skills in combat with your car.

Photorealistic graphics. Draws you into the game more, which makes the atmosphere even more interesting and immerses you in dozens of hours of exploring the game world.

Gamepad and steering wheel support. By connecting your device, you can feel like a real driver. You can drive both automatic transmission and manual.

Attention to detail. All maps are made in detail, as well as cars. Each model is unique, each map has different interesting places and easter eggs. Cars are as close to reality as possible.

Photo mode. Realistic photo mode that allows you to take beautiful photos inside the game.

Regular updates. Every month updates are released where new cars, maps, quests, and many different goodies are added.

2342630.name: Battles In Space
2342630.about_the_game:
Battles in space is a Sci fi version of a classic board game. Place your fleet and fire away at enemy locations. Play with a friend on local mode or vs an AI.
Enjoy this classic board game brought to the PC. This is your chance to take your fleet to the next level.

How to Play

Select to play against an AI or another player locally. Place your ships. Then select the areas you want to strike.

2342690.name: Call of Boba
2342690.about_the_game:
🧋A relaxing game set in a cozy town

In this game, players returned to a charming little town where they become the savior of a struggling boba tea shop. With your help, the owner of the shop will be able to make the best boba tea in town and attract customers from all over!

🧋Use boba milk Tea ingredients to fight

But that's not all, as the sun sets in the small town, a mysterious and dangerous world awakens. Using your trusty boba tea weapons, known as Bobas, you will defeat enemies and gain new inspiration for your boba tea creations.

🧋Play at your own pace

As you progress through the game, you will also have the chance to develop relationships with various NPCs, possibly even falling in love with them. The game's storyline is enriched by a variety of town tasks, mini-games, and exciting fishing quests that will keep you engaged and entertained for hours.

2342700.name: Marsel - The Alien Clown
2342700.about_the_game:
Story

Marsel is an alien who has land crashed on Earth and needs to repair his spaceship to return to his planet. However, the parts he needs for the repair are found only at Circuses on Earth! Not only that, but some spare parts are only available in the past or the future!

Marsel will need to search for these parts while avoiding being discovered and caught by the Earthlings inhabiting the Circus, but all of them are highly trained performers! Marsel will face many challenging obstacles and enemies in this exciting platform game.

Will you help Marsel complete his mission and return safely home?

References

Marsel, the Alien Clown is a tribute to the platform games genre that millions of children around the globe enjoyed in the 80s and 90s. Today, those children have become adults and, like us here at 1up, haven't stopped dreaming about the references from our childhood. We love to remember the colorful world of Mario Bros, the addictive gameplay of Rayman, and the thrilling adventure of Pitfall.

Gameplay

Marsel, the Alien Clown is a 2D platform video game that combines classic gameplay mechanics with state-of-the-art design technology. The goal is to help Marsel complete a series of levels by jumping, running, and avoiding obstacles while collecting objects and power-ups.

Marsel has one essential ability in the game: he can time travel to the past and the future. This game mechanic will generate different and lively gameplay.

2342710.name: Space Pirates for Life
2342710.about_the_game:
Space Pirates for Life

Crash-landed. Outnumbered. Outgunned.
You are a space pirate stranded on a bizarre alien planet where every step could be your last. Hack, slash, and platform your way through a relentless retro-style gauntlet built for hardcore players.

Not for the casual gamer. Are you up for the challenge?

Features

  • ⚔️ Tight 2D combat & precision platforming

  • 🎶 Exclusive unlockable track from Tidal Rave — only in this game

  • 🏃 Speedrunning in mind — built-in timers, stats, and replayability

  • 💀 For true challengers — deaths are part of the journey

  • 📊 End-game stats to track your performance and bragging rights

  • 🔊 Catchy retro-inspired soundtrack to fuel your runs

Why Play?

If you love Celeste, Hollow Knight, or Super Meat Boy, and you crave the rush of mastering brutal levels, Space Pirates for Life is for you.
Every death teaches you. Every run makes you faster. Every victory feels earned.

💾 Add to your Wishlist now and prove you have what it takes to survive.

2342720.name: Halftime Builders
2342720.about_the_game:
Horde Survivor and Base Defense mashup


Halftime Builders is a Horde Survival. Kill enemies in different ways depending your class, learn different blueprints as you level up, mount your defense and die. Buy upgrades from the shop and start again!

  • 5 different bosses
  • 4 classes with different playstyles, be a mobile mech or mount your fortress
  • Compete with other players for the best highscore
  • Combine different buildings to balance the best offense/defense
  • Combines elements from Tower Defense, Horde Survivor and Roguelike games!

Different class with different playstyles!


  • Build a stronghold


  • Form your destruction convoy


  • Or be a giant mecha

2342730.name: Zero Vortex
2342730.about_the_game:
Zero Vortex is an all-new retro six-degrees-of-freedom shooter experience!


  • Navigate interconnected rooms that shuffle randomly
  • Explore multiple levels split into three episodes


  • Upgrade your weapons with multiple different upgrade tree's
  • Find powerups like an afterburner or a cloaking device
  • Beware of environmental hazards such as lava and corrosive gas


  • Clarity: All enemies look different at a glance
  • Retro: pixelated textures and low-poly 3D models
  • Bespoke soundtrack using General MIDI, inspired by 90s games

Dive into a world of mind-bending levels and intense battles.

2342750.name: Shadows of Duat
2342750.about_the_game:
Egypt, 1923. A young archaeologist discovers the gigantic tomb of an unnamed pharaoh. As she and her team descend into the tomb, it seems to come alive and closes completely, plunging them into darkness. Pharaoh has awakened from his eternal sleep, as well as his armies who impatiently await his orders.

Shadows of Duat is an old school survival horror set in Egypt. An indie game with the essence of the classics of the genre, but modern gameplay, with realistic graphics, immersive sound and over-the-shoulder view. A difficult and terrifying challenge only for the bravest.

This story takes place entirely inside a colossal Egyptian tomb full of secrets to discover, puzzles, traps, curses and spooky enemies, which you will have to face through your wits, due to the shortage of ammunition.

There are 4 main characters that you can embody: the Archaeologist, the Engineer, the Mercenary and the Sage. Each one has their own unique abilities and will allow you to experience the story from a different point of view.

The game is full of references and curiosities from Ancient Egypt, since its levels are based on the Egyptian underworld described in the Book of Gates.

In the darkness of the tomb, you must be alert to every sound, every mural or statue, which will give you clues about the dangers lurking around every corner. The tomb is alive and sometimes the same corridor can lead to different places with new threats, so the tension is constant. The scary thing is not being alone in the dark. It's not being alone in the dark.

The puzzles will be a recurring mechanic and the keys to solving them are in the details. Your observation capacity and your ingenuity will be rewarded. But often to fail can mean suffering a fateful fate.

Shadows of Duat rewards exploration, as the labyrinthine paths of the tomb hold many secrets, curiosities, and even unique items.

There is no single way to end this adventure. There are multiple endings that you will be able to see depending on your decisions. Choose wisely, because the life or death of the characters and even the fate of humanity will depend on it.

2342780.name: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad
2342780.about_the_game:
Live the life of a rookie paramedic through frantic minigame action and a wild, funny story. Juggle waves of patients with a battle-like triage system; master dozens of treatment minigames; and win the city's recognition from the rival fire department in this paramedic action drama!

2342830.name: Skedaddling In Egypt
2342830.about_the_game:
Skedaddling In Egypt is a fast paced first person speedrunning game where you're looking to escape your crumbling tomb. Play as an ancient pharaoh and use your parkour skills and mummy wrappings to swing and slide through the elaborate burial crypt. Avoid falling rocks, traps, and quicksand on your way to the exit and compete to see who can escape the fastest in five unique levels.

Parkour!




Use your wrappings to grapple through the tomb while maintaining speed.



Slide and maneuver through the tomb to avoid falling rocks, traps, and quicksand.

2342860.name: Twell
2342860.about_the_game:
This adventure is about you as a player waking up in this world named Twell. You don't have any memory from before and the only thing you can do now is explore what this world has to offer. You will explore 8 unique dungeons, discover many secrets and visit multiple populated locations.

This is an adventure game full of puzzles and with a simple action battle system. It is made in RPG Maker XP. This free game will to entertain you as a player with a variety of challenges and motivating you to explore what it offers, without too much talking and too much grinding.

Why is it free?
I get this question a lot. I truly hope that you will play the game and enjoy it. That's more important to me.


- Every dungeon has unique puzzles, enemies, bosses and theme.
- Use key items to solve puzzles and uncover new areas.
- The look of the character depends on which equipment you wear.
- Visit many locations with unique characters to interact with.
- Choose which type of sword you want and which skills you want to learn.
- Side quests are available to you at the start, solve them whenever you want.
- Feel free to play the game in your own order. No hand-holding, but it's clear where to go next.
- The game keeps your progress when it's game over, you just choose a location to start.
- You can unlock extra challenges for Battle Mode.
- You can also start the game on hard difficulty for some extra challenge.

2342870.name: The Chronicles of Eleos: The Hall of Azaron
2342870.about_the_game:
The Chronicles of Eleos: The Hall of Azaron is a classic RPG where we control an archaeologist wizard on a journey through the continent of Eleos, a place with various peoples and cultures and full of mysteries and craziness just waiting for a nosy enough wizard to reveal them.

During your journey you'll make choices that will alter certain aspects of the plot, even interfering with the endings you may have. Choices really make the difference, being able to change who lives or dies, when to form a friendship or an enmity and why not even a romance, who to ally with or who to face. All this is in your hands during your journey across the continent.

the Plot

Millennia ago, the legendary wizard Azaron mastered magic and passed his knowledge on to his apprentices in the court of Azaron. However, in the present day in Eleos, magic is frowned upon and Azaron and its legendary court of wizards is nothing more than a myth, it's up to you now to prove the existence of Azaron and perhaps improve people's view of magic or even make it worse?

wizards Use Magic Don't they?

Yes they do, but don't feel trapped by it, in the game we have a system of perks that can be acquired and eventually unlocking a class change.

There are 5 specialized classes to choose from, each for a different type of gameplay.

Want to slam your staff on your enemies' heads instead of using magic? Of course, why not, pick the Battle Mage specialization and show them that a staff isn't just for casting fireballs.

And what about Summons? The druid will give you everything you need to commune with nature while your summons wipe out the enemies.

These and other Specializations Await You.

but What About Magic?

Ah yes! In the game we have 10 different elements and every creature in the world has its weaknesses and strengths, it's up to you to test or look for knowledge in books or talking to NPCs. There are over 80 spells for you to learn, whether by finding a book in a ruin, buying it from a book seller or even learning it from another mage.

is This A Lonely Journey?

It can be if you want, but if you prefer to be accompanied there are 7 party companions that can be recruited, apart from summons and casual company for one quest or another.

speaking Of Quests...

In addition to the plot, the cities and maps of the five chapters are filled with quests ranging from the classic “they stole my goat” to “I found an ancestral relic that will destroy the world”, but none of that is our hero’s business, which he can simply ignore everything and move on, interfering or not is your choice and may or may not come back to haunt you later.

Store artwork made by Sette aka yispySOFT.

2342880.name: RFA Station
2342880.about_the_game:
A distress call was received from space station RFA-1. The entire crew was urgently evacuated and sent to a nearby station.

Several employees are lost.

As a specialist in engineering department, you were sent to check the system data and equipment of the ship.

But a system failure at the station turned out to be work of an alien invasion, the entire station is captured by their robots.

Nothing remains but to enter into an unequal battle with uninvited guests.

Now your new task is to safe your life and leave the ship.

Game Features:

  • Beautiful graphics.

  • Spectacular fights.

  • Good optimization.

  • 3 types of weapons.

  • 6-5 levels.

  • 2 types of robots.

2342920.name: OBSCURA
2342920.about_the_game:
I once heard a story...

There's a marketplace under the mountain where anything can be bought and sold. Visitors wear masks to become faceless strangers. It's home to the unscrupulous, the outcast, and the desperate.

You're one of the desperate.

Strangers with their own secrets and ambitions can show you ways through the market. They'll guide you to your goal, but don't trust them to have your best interests at heart.

Features

🔹First chapter available as a demo, second chapter of three available in early access.

🔹Choose the protagonist's name, pronouns, and mask.

🔹Four mysterious love interests.

🔹Over 200k words (70k in the demo, 130k in the early access release)

🔹A dark, mature story with many ways to fail.

🔹Timed choices! Or turn them off for an easier game.

🔹Original music by Cajsa.

🔹Use the default, OpenDyslexic, or Atkinson Hyperlegible font for ease of reading.

Characters

Keir - Sarcastic Thief

"When I compliment you — if that ever happens — you’ll know."

Where there is a market, there are thieves. Keir steals to feed hungry mouths, but never forget that to survive at the fringes requires the most ruthless kind of pragmatism.

Cirrus - Humble Priest

"Penance is of the utmost importance here, and I think you'd best keep that soul of yours unblemished."

The church of the Lunar God offers sanctuary to all who come to its doors and Cirrus will give aid to those who request it. But there is no such thing as a gift in the market, and whatever aid Cirrus grants, he will want something in return.

Francesco - Spirited Adventurer

"There are so many sensations I've never felt before, and I'm making it my mission to finally live my life to the fullest!"

Sweet and sun-kissed, people such as him does not typically come to the marketplace. Can you trust this seemingly innocent man, in a place where everyone keeps dark secrets and appearances could be the most misleading of all?

Oleander - Merchant Gadfly

"You want my attention? You've got it, minx. Meet me later and you'll see what that gets you."

A market needs things to sell, and Oleander is happy to provide anything you can ask for, at a price. Hedonic and charming, he makes all his work into games, but he won't say to what end he's playing.

Vesper - Cursed Protagonist

"The people down here have beautiful taste..."

No one goes under the mountain without a good reason. Unfortunately, you have a great reason. Whatever you were aboveground, now is the time to abandon it.

Choose between 3 different masks

Streamer Policy

All information is available on our website, but in short: show as much of the demo content (Chapter 1) as you like, you may stream paid content freely as long as there is commentary, but VODs of paid content should only show ~20% of the script; this currently comes out to approximately 30-60 minutes of material for Chapter 2 total depending on reading speed.

2342930.name: Evil Superhero VR - Superhero Simulator
2342930.about_the_game:
BUILT FOR: Quest 1 and 2 Headsets Only. Additional Support coming in the future!

This game world is massive, and includes: A large open world with a procedural environment, an entire ocean, Airplanes you can laser out of the sky...

Unlimited Enemies you can Slice to bits with your Laser Vision, cars you can blow to pieces, and a Procedural AI Dismemberment System implemented into almost every NPC.

So you can slice up and kill almost ANYONE in this game: civilian and enemy alike! Whether by accident or choice... It's up to you!

You can also fly at Supersonic speeds through the world. No one can escape you once you've set your sights on them.

You are Superhuman. And you can do whatever the f*** you want.

Prepared to have the most fun in VR that you have ever experienced!!!

Super strength

Superhero Landing

2342940.name: Wisp Catacombs
2342940.about_the_game:
What makes Wisp Catacombs a unique rogue-like game?


  • The enemy diversity. (Seeing a dancing cactus, a shotgun urchin, and a crystal golem is rare sight!)
  • Fast movement. (Invincible dashes, quick turns, and a standstill healing system require skill.)
  • The choices the player(s) can make. (Will the players trust or confront their creator?)
  • The player(s) can start as one class and finish with completely different abilities.
  • Local 4-player mode. (You can play up to 4 players without any compromises - the game will adapt its difficulty scaling (loot prices, enemy damage/health, rewards, etc.) depending on the player count.)
  • Brutal difficulty. (Don’t take this part lightly.)

What are the main gameplay Features?


  • Players can use their dash to dodge projectiles. It’s fast and effective.
  • No ammo: when you attack, you lose energy! The energy is also your health!
  • Swappable abilities: 2 attack types (simple and area), an ultimate attack, and a passive stat.
  • Items which upgrade your base stats. A battery can gives you more energy (health), a vacuum can upgrade your regeneration, etc.
  • 6 power types, 100+ total powers! Experiment with each attack!

The player(s) can explore 6 worlds that each have their enemies, bosses and unique twists.

Explore the different features of the worlds...

With 6 worlds, you will have to adapt to different combat styles and strategies. You will survive against fire snakes, big scarabs, bats, creepy spiders and ... Urchins?

Each enemy has their own little twist.

Some enemies will interact with each other to create new attacks. You’ve got to create a strategy unique to specific enemy groupings. And each enemy will have its own story that you will need to find!

Play up to 4 players against the monsters!

Wisp Catacombs can be played up to 4 players. Level configurations are randomly generated, having multiple different room types such as shops, chests, puzzles and enemies. Explore diverse worlds and face hardcore challenges with the scalable difficulty system. Oh, don't worry, it won’t be too difficult! The wisps will be able to choose their difficulty… But at what cost?

You will see a lot of bullets...

You will have to confront bosses that vomit copious amounts of projectiles! You can manage, though: with 150+ powers distributed in multiple types of elements, strategic maneuvers will lead you to victory! Players can switch between playstyles, and approach challenges in different ways. This keeps the gameplay exciting.

Secrets and wonders.

Despite having randomly-generated worlds, there are secret paths and shortcuts that experienced players can use not only to their advantage, but also to discover fascinating endings. And the secrets don’t stop at the first playthrough – beating the game with each class in a specific way will uncover the elusive “true path.” Will you be the first to discover it?

2342950.name: God Of Weapons
2342950.about_the_game:
The world was once a bright and beautiful place, filled with light and wonder. But one day, an evil force swept across the land, stealing away the world's light and plunging it into darkness. As a result, chaos and destruction spread across the world, and many feared that the darkness would never end.

In this action roguelike, survive hordes of monsters on every level with automatic weapon attacks. Dodge and collect loot to improve your chances in the next round. It's all about strategy, reflexes, and smart movement.

Collecting weapons and accessories and strategically organizing them in your inventory is crucial to your survival. Your inventory space is limited, hence before putting in a new item, you'll need to consider its strengths and weaknesses and how it fits into your overall strategy.

Careful management of your inventory can make the difference between victory and defeat. As you progress through the game, you will amass an arsenal of powerful weapons and accessories, making you an unstoppable force to be reckoned with.
2342950.supported_languages: English, Vietnamese, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil

2342980.name: It Comes In Waves
2342980.about_the_game:
It all started when you left…
In "It Comes In Waves", you'll play as a lone outcast on a dangerous desert planet, trying to grow a specimen to bring to The Sanctuary. How can you grow anything in a world this barren?

It is a very personal, experimental and minimalist game.


The World
Eremar Prime is a harsh and unforgiving place. You'll need to scavenge for resources, fight off raiders and make tough choices to survive. You can also visit the local town (but don't expect a welcoming crowd).


Gameplay
"It Comes In Waves" is a minimalist game that combines exploration, combat, and resource management in a unique way. Water is the main resource. It constantly evaporates if you are out in the desert, so you will need to collect more or improve your equipment’s efficiency. Otherwise, you WILL die.

If you die, there is no reloading. You have to start fresh.

2342990.name: Armor Blitz
2342990.about_the_game:
Armor Blitz is a perfect couch game with friends or go online to battle in various multiplayer modes. Destroy other tanks, grab boosts and navigate through dozens of maps in single player or co-op campaigns; fight other players in PVP or teams mode in this game that hearkens back to the classic tank games like Combat, Triple Action, and Armor Battle. Get fun byte-sized rushes of adrenaline as you try to defeat your enemies!

Key Features:
  • 1 to 4 players
  • Game modes: PVP, Teams, Single Player or Co-op Campaigns
  • Over a dozen environments, like desert, forest, winter, lava to fight in
  • 25+ levels in Campaign mode
  • 12 Tanks, each with a main canon, and secondary weapon to annihilate your enemies.
  • In-game boosts to collect to give you an advantage, like triple shot, speed increase, etc.
  • Multiple weapons to use, like railgun, flame thrower, AOE bomb, ricochet, triple shot.

Come blitz with us and have a fun, action-packed break from your daily grind...like we used to when visiting the arcade back in the classic 80s!

2343000.name: Wyrd Gun
2343000.about_the_game:
Breed the ultimate gun and struggle survive on a harsh planet!

Guns!

Have you ever wanted your shotgun and your bazooka to procreate? Do you fantacize about your sniper and your machine gun gettin down and durty? In Wyrdgun not only is this a reality... its a necessity.

Every gun has 16 mutatable stats and can gain 32 additional special stats through breeding that greatly change the gun!

Aliens!

Kill loads of freaks!

Heaps of em!

Planet!

Fight on an open world, procedurally generated, fully destructible, desert planet!

Mutations!

Gain wings, grappling webs, invisibility, and more.

Mutations are the progression system of Wyrdgun and persist across runs!

Perks!

Wyrdgun has a modular perk system. Each perk contains a trigger and an effect. For example: hp is low => slow time, on kill => create a nova, or on dig => + digspeed!

There are 28 triggers and 45 effects to choose from!

2343060.name: Undead Fortress
2343060.about_the_game:
An ancient legacy regeneration plan that summons ancient creatures through mystical rituals. And you are unfortunately chosen, and all you have to do is to explore the laboratory in the mist, destroy five totems and kill the bloodthirsty beasts

Note: The game contains horror and horror elements, and the shooting difficulty is relatively high

Feature:

  • Leveling up

Killing zombies and cyborgs can increase combat experience.

Leveling up allows for skill points, improving weapon performance, or enhancing personal abilities.

There are nearly 20 types of skill points to choose from, enhancing weapons, melee combat, scavenging, and survival skills.

 

  • Quick advancement and resource gathering

The resources on the map are limited and random;

the bullets in the boxes are also random.You must collect the most weapons and resources within a limited time to prepare for confrontation.

 

If you want to challenge hard mode, remember to plan your advance route and manage the consumption of different weapon ammunition.

 

  • Be prepared to face the Bloodthirsty

The Bloodthirsty can launch surprise attacks from the shadows at any time.

After being injured, it will retreat to recover health and attack you again when you are least prepared.

 

You can take the initiative to destroy 5 totems to break the Bloodthirsty's armor, or collect heavy weapon ammunition, defend your position

2343100.name: Titanic II: Orchestra for Dying at Sea
2343100.about_the_game:
2023 Independent Games Festival Nuovo Award Nominated
and 2022 AMAZE Berlin Audience Award Winner

The Much Anticipated Sequel

This Tragedy Features

  • First Person Exploration
  • ~40minute gameplay
  • Bass Blasted Celin Dion
  • Beloved and Familiar Characters
  • No Jump Scares
  • Plenty to Be Scared Of

2343110.name: Virballs
2343110.about_the_game:
Stop Dr. Corvid's Elemental Chaos

Dr. Corvid, a mad scientist with a penchant for chaos, has unleashed his latest experiment — the Virballs, virus-like creatures that manipulate elemental forces. Now, entire planets are overrun with these mischievous entities, spreading fire, wind, and electrical havoc across the galaxy.

As ORB, an Object Removal Bot armed with rocket-powered claws, it’s up to you to track down these volatile creatures, harness their powers, and save the galaxy from Corvid’s creations before it’s too late.

Collect, Combine, and Conquer

Dive into this thrilling, action-packed platformer and stop the spread of Dr. Corvid’s chaos. Here’s what you’ll be doing in Virballs:

Capture and Combine

Grab Virballs with ORB’s grappler claws and fuse their elemental properties — Earth, Water, Fire, Electricity, Air, and Slime — into unique hybrid weapons. Experiment with more than 40 different combinations to unlock powerful new ways to battle enemies.

Fast-Paced Platformer

Run, jump, and blast through levels packed with enemies, traps, and environmental puzzles. With ORB’s trusty blasters, thrusters, and claws, you’ll conquer every obstacle in your way.

Purge the Infested Worlds

Six unique planets have been infested with Dr. Corvid’s Virballs. Each planet poses new threats and requires creative use of Virball powers to clear the infestation.

Save the Floobers

The adorable, peaceful Floobers are in danger - help the Floober King rescue his people and evacuate to their ship!

Epic Boss Battles

Challenge ultra-powerful Virball bosses to unlock new elemental Cores, expanding ORB’s arsenal and unlocking even more devastating weapon combinations.

A Growing Galactic Adventure

Begin your journey in Steam Early Access, with more planets and missions added over time. The full game, featuring all six planets, launches in early 2025!

2343120.name: Deep Space Scoundrel
2343120.about_the_game: Deep Space Scoundrel is a rogue-like space adventure where you use a variety of classic arcade mechanics to explore the universe, customize your ship, land at spaceports, and fraternize with other aliens and low-lives. Use a galaxy of customizable guns and ship parts to build the perfect battle unit and blast through the epic armies hunting you down.

2343130.name: Hollow Mission
2343130.about_the_game: In this <u>Single player</u> game, you will follow a soldier<u> first-person Pov</u>, that has been send out to find out what has happened to one of their camps that has made it go complete dark. You will have to <u>explore</u> the area to find out what has happened and be on high alert because who knows what is lurking around. As you play you will expect to do mini puzzles and have to explore to find a way to the next area while evading or confronting what lies ahead you will also find little snippets of the lore of this camp.

2343140.name: My Bath Tub Companion
2343140.about_the_game:
Relax & recover in this short free 3D environment where you take control of your favorite bath tub girl. My Bath Tub Companion is an experience, to induce a calm & peaceful (and mildly horny) feeling. You'll feel satisfied sitting back, feel yourself relax as you watch her relax.

Watch her from a distance, become her rubber duck toy, or see through her eyes. Take control and watch her enjoy herself with props around the room.

Gain answers to some of life's biggest questions, like: What is my girlfriend doing when she is in the bath tub for so long? How did we use up so much hot water on the utility bill? Why is there a charge for 50 rubber ducks on my credit card?



People have places to be, stress to worry about, but not you.
Sit back, relax, listen to the sounds, enjoy the soothing visuals. Relaxation is the key to a blissful bath tub experience, and we've got you covered. Calm music & a beautiful girl to look at.

Features List

  • Create ducks in the bath tub
  • Possess the rubber duck & see what she does with it
  • Possess her to see through her eyes
  • Relaxing music

About

This is a fun project we decided to work on together to develop our skills. If you like what you see, consider joining our Discord to see our latest art & full game releases as they come.

2343150.name: Yokai Hero
2343150.about_the_game:
Yokai Hero is the ultimate 2D platforming experience where you take the role of a hero trying to fight evil in a way to protect and help humanity. This Mario-themed game offers exciting, fast paced platforming, intense gameplay and one of a kind game worlds for you to explore. On top of that, Yokai Hero is deeply inspired by the Japanese mythology, but we added our own spin to the hero and his own adventures.

Yokai Hero story

In a distant past very close to our time, a corrupted meteor hits Japan, and it ends up turning all the life forms into Yokai. You take the role of one of the few Yokai that maintained their individuality after this event. Your focus is to enter the realm of Yogideon, also known as the realm of evil. Once you go there, you will need to do everything you can in order to restore humanity as quickly as possible.

Unlock new characters

As you play Yokai Hero, you will be able to collect a huge range of coins. These coins can be used in order to unlock new characters, bullets, but also a few special characters too. It’s a great way to continue playing, because even if you start with 2 different playable characters, you always have the opportunity to unlock more if you want.

Exciting boss battles

Yokai Hero has 70 levels, and after every world you have to defeat its end boss. Each one of the bosses has its own set of attacks, and you need to learn those in order to try and defeat them. That’s where Yokai Hero shines, because you get to test all kinds of moves and attacks as you get closer to the boss battles.
Yokai Hero continues the Mario legacy in a fresh way, with one of a kind gameplay mechanics, stunning game worlds and exceptional world bosses. If you enjoy platform games, try out Yokai Hero today and test your skills, and save the world!

2343160.name: ROGUE-FP
2343160.about_the_game:
ROGUE-FP is a blend of old school classic roguelike gameplay with new school first person controls and perspective. There is no movement grid and no rigid turn system to slow you down.

Synopsis

The Fighters guild has a high bar for entry. They want you to delve deep into the Dungeons of Doom and return to the surface with the Amulet of Yendor! A perilous quest few have completed, for within the dungeon are terrible monsters, devious traps, and mystifying magical items.

To survive you'll have to identify the dungeon's items, navigate it's procedurally generated dark labyrinths, and fight your way past it's monsters. With enough skill and a decent amount of luck they say it can be done. Give it your best shot!

Features

Just like in the roguelike days of yore, there are

  • Procedurally generated levels!

  • Perma-death!

  • More than an alphabet's worth of monsters!

  • Many magic items with different effects including rings, weapons, potions, scrolls, and wands!

  • Yummy slime molds!

But in ROGUE-FP there’s also

  • First person controls

  • A innovative smooth turn system

  • No grid to restrict your movement

  • Multiple bonus dungeons

  • Hacked off bits of monsters to stick onto your armor

  • ASCII art sprites

  • Dungeonsynth soundtrack

  • A difficulty level for every level of skill, including one that removes item identification

  • Your personal gold hoard that grows larger with every run

2343170.name: PolyFight
2343170.about_the_game:
JUST FIGHT

There's a simple pleasure to jumping into a quick match against a friend or foe. With a minimalist art style and straight-forward controls you'll feel at home in the familiar game-play yet challenged by the adaptability of your opponents. PolyFight is a test of your reaction time, positional play, and accuracy with a mouse.

Up to 8 players!

NO ROUND THE SAME

Each round greets you with a refreshed layout of moveable walls. Could there be a mountain of obstacles between you and your opponent? Could there be nothing? Will you get lucky and spawn behind cover? How quickly can you adapt to the changing environment?

CUSTOMIZE

Squares, purples, triangles, yellows. There's a shade and shape for every player to play their way.

2343220.name: CLAMPSHIP
2343220.about_the_game:
CLAMPSHIP is a falling-block puzzle game flipped on its head.

Use your spaceship to clamp and launch blocks where they need to go. Choose from a wide selection of tools and build your dream ship to maximize productivity AND capital gains!

You've played *that other game* for hours!?

Yet, it only had one level, a few pieces, and ZERO explosions...
Is your attention really this easy to grab? Luckily, at Mandel’s Broth Inc., we’ve made it our mission to weaponize your nostalgia!

FEATURES of TetraTasker's basic employment package:

  • Build your own Ship! Grow from a poor little cruiser into an unwieldy surplus-labor-value accumulating machine!
  • Upgrade your tools! Clamping is only the beginning; unlock laser rays, electromagnetic beams, grappling hooks and much more!
  • Lore! Yes! Lore! A falling-block puzzle game with a story. Finally! Truly what they've been missing all along.
  • Clear-a-thon! Line clears, Match clears, Pack clears, Demolition clears, and more! Combine them to make some space and tons of profits!
  • So many blocks! Tetrominoes are SO outdated. Enter the *future* and play with pieces of all shapes and sizes! Watch out for fragile, explosive, sticky packages, and the likes!
  • Emphasis on player creativity! Design the game yourself! We can't be bothered with it anymore. Attach passive modules to your ship that change the way you play!
  • Level Creator! Use our patented structure designer to shape dozens of levels to whatever best fits our needs.
  • Achievements! At Mandel’s we applaud hard work, this is why you’ll get rewarded for your most exceptional feats with salary bonu- Uh.. Tokens of our sincere gratitude!
  • AND here's the best part… For each copy of this game you buy, WE MAKE MORE MONEY! Wowow! What a deal!

Still not sure if you have what it takes to become a TetraTasker?

-Are you a team player?

-Can you handle our infinitely self-similar solar systems?
-Ever wondered why Jupiter is dying?
-Do you have 2 or more limbs?
-Is the hum of a DieSun Sphere™ soothing to your ears?
-Do you love soup?

If you answered Yes or No to one or many of these questions, this game is for you!

No time to lose!

Take control TODAY over your means of production thanks to our ingenious neo-enterprising Boss-Hustle-Grind triangular hiring schemes!

*ships are leased, tools are rented, profits are Mandel’s*

SPONSORED BY MANDEL'S GAMES - TETRONOMICS DIVISION #LIJZ0ST

2343230.name: ITERAZERS
2343230.about_the_game:
About ITERAZERS

ITERAZERS is a PvE shooter game where players engage in battles against enemy AI while enhancing themselves through customization. To save the game world that has been overrun by enemy AI, let's emerge victorious in battles against these adversaries!



Adjust Parameters with Customization!

Players can adjust various parameters through customization. Basic parameters such as "movement speed" and "durability," as well as attack parameters like "bullet speed," "trajectory," and "rate of fire," can all be adjusted.
Parameters also include "bullet effects" that grant special effects to attacks. There are effects related to the trajectory of bullets such as "acceleration," "curve," and "tracking," as well as special bullet effects like "expansion" and "absorption." By combining these, players can create their own custom bullets to suit their preferences.



Win Powerful Parameters by Defeating Enemy AI!

By defeating enemies, you can acquire new bullet effects and customization points. Increasing bullet effects will allow you to build powerful bullets.
However, enemy AI is also customized with various combinations like players and awaits them. Win against all enemy AI and uncover the secrets hidden in the world of ITERAZERS!

2343240.name: Wretched Depths
2343240.about_the_game:
Sam, an avid fishing fan, has traveled to the remote Twin Pines to cast into the mysterious Lake Imperium. However as she begins to adjust to her surroundings. Odd and unexplainable events begin to occur left and right in a town where the people seem strange, and the fish even stranger.

Play as Sam and fish to your hearts content, sell the fish you've caught, collect better gear, and use it to explore deeper into the depths of the lake. But, be warned as no one knows what lies at the bottom of Lake Imperium. Do you really want to find out what lurks below...?

Wretched Depths is a PSX-style horror-fishing game created by students in the University of Utah's Entertainment Arts & Engineering capstone class.

Key Features:

  • A dynamic fishing system

  • A manageable, grid-based inventory

  • An environment filled with unique fish

  • Strange encounters wherever you look

  • A system of equipment upgrades and collectables

2343250.name: Mommy Milkers Miko
2343250.about_the_game:
An evil ninja clan is amassing power, they've struck a deal with a Demon and are using it's blood to upgrade their footsoldiers.
The one sent to stop them is none other than Mio, An experienced ninja sworn to protect the freedoms of women and commoners everywhere.

Can she execute the demon before the evil clan can raise their army? Or will she fall and become their slave?


Features
  • Simple RPG with no level system; utilise items and accessories to make it through. Absolutely no grinding for EXP!
  • Skip combat by approaching the enemy from behind.
  • A clothing system.
  • Live2d animation to bring our titular miko to life.
  • Explore the map with a grappling hook

Expected completion time: 50 minutes

2343270.name: Samurado
2343270.about_the_game:
Carve a path through your enemies. Leave none alive.


You are an avocado.
You are also a samurai.

How is this possible? Don't question it....just go with it.

Your wife and children were lost to an avocado toast MASSACRE.
You must TRAIN and achieve Samurai mastery if you are to defeat the evil chef that guacamurdered your only loves.

Melee or Ranged. Choose.


Ok well actually, you don't need to choose. Be careful though! You throw your boomerang sword as your ranged attack, but you need BOTH swords in order to block. Pick your timing with care.

Blood. So much blood.


No enemies have any right to be this cute. For that they must bleed.

Game Features. And Other Stuff...Yea.

  • Click your mouse till your hand is on fire!
  • Uber-satisfying, splittery, splattery, goopy, shlorpy enemy deaths.
  • Procedural levels for a different playthrough, everytime.
  • Epic boss battle
  • Seriously, he's an avocado in a samurai hat. What more could you ask for?

2343290.name: Axe Party VR
2343290.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Party! 🪓🪓🪓


Axe Party VR is a virtual reality axe-throwing experience. Compete against your friends or your own high score with 3 exciting and challenging game modes.
Unlike other titles, our multiplayer is contained in a single VR headset allowing you to show off your axe-throwing skills and compete with your friends locally, without having to purchase multiple devices.

Game Modes

  • 1. Classic Axe Throw: 5 throws per round. 3 rounds. Highest score wins.
  • 2. BreakRoom: A room of fun gadgets and breakables.
  • 3. Axe Hunt: Hunt virtual birds with axes.

2343320.name: Stellar Empires
2343320.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Stellar Empires, a strategy game where you take control of an Empire, lead it to complete domination by colonizing new planets! The goal of the game is simple - the player has an initial planet and he has to control the armies to capture the enemy planets.

Features:

  • Online multiplayer up to 4 players.
  • Ability to play against AI.
  • Availability of 20 challenges.
  • Massive Short-Session Battles.
  • Tree abilities.
  • Availability of an automatically generated map.
  • Simple and clear gameplay.

2343330.name: Skippy's Diner
2343330.about_the_game:
Skippy’s Diner is a short, but fun horror game that features great pixel art and 2d style 90s arcade aesthetic while also creating a spooky and scary environment. Skippy’s Diner is where you will be working. You are a 16 year old teenager who has just applied for the job of making coffee here. It is about taking orders, making coffee, keeping the customers happy, but also while still trying to maintain a clean work space at the end of your shift.

You start off outside of your apartment, you have to get to work on your little red bike, it’s much quicker than walking.



When you make coffee simply grab coffee from the shelf, place it in the coffee maker, and serve when ready. But be aware, customers start to say some pretty odd stuff, it almost feels like the dinner is haunted. You go through multiple days of work. The levels are split up into days, Day 1, Day 2, Day 3 etc. Only on the 5th day things start to go south as Skippy himself finally approaches you, your only hope for survival is to avoid him completely and make it back to your apartment safe and sound.

2343340.name: I Can See You
2343340.about_the_game:
I Can See You plunges you into a bone-chilling first-person horror experience, meticulously woven from real accounts of home invasions in America's remote locales. This game is not just a journey, but an ordeal where every shadow whispers danger.


Key Features:



  • State-of-the-Art Graphics: Powered by the advanced Lumen and Nanite technologies, the game delivers ultra-realistic AAA visuals that make every moment intensely lifelike.
  • Immersive UI Design: We've embraced a minimalist, modern, and clean user interface, emphasizing a seamless blend of gameplay and realism.
  • Narrative Through Environment: The story unravels through the setting itself - explore and interact with your surroundings to uncover the haunting tale that lies within.
  • Intense Horror Experience: Simulating the terror of a home invasion, this game is a test of nerves - hide, strategize, and when necessary, confront your unseen enemy.
  • Survival Strategy: You are prey in this game, and survival means thinking fast. Your choices are limited and critical, so every move counts.
  • ]Global Accessibility: Supporting multiple languages including English, German, Portuguese, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, and Russian, to welcome players from across the globe.



"I Can See You" is more than a game; it's an exercise in survival, a challenge to your senses and your wit. Do you have what it takes to survive?

2343350.name: KILLING DREAMWORKS
2343350.about_the_game:
It's a murderous adventure filled with whimsy, grotesque ghosts and high-powered weapons. It may take a little bit of strategic thinking and a little bit of luck to complete this big adventure. If you encounter setbacks, try a few more times and rationally allocate the resources in your hands, and there may be a solution. When you no longer meet the current difficulty of the game, remember to properly increase the number of monsters before the game starts, and you will discover a new world.
QQ：883417277

Cards：Killing monsters has a chance to get rich cards. Draw cards to randomly get weapons, props, passive skills, etc., so that you can be full of combat power at any time.

AI teammates：There are many different types of AI teammates with special skills in the game. Find and use their powerful abilities to help you complete the final mission.

Squad mode：You can enter the squad mode at any time in the game to edit your squad formation or configure the cards you own to deal with various dangerous situations.

Weather：A changeable and random weather system, each weather that is randomly and dynamically switched will have an important impact on the game process.

2343370.name: The Last Root
2343370.about_the_game:
The Last Root follows a young cactus on a quest to save her family and world from the hold of an evil dictator. Join her as she gains friends, defeats enemies in party-based combat, explores her diverse world - and maybe even saves the day.


  • A robust cast of lovable (and hateable) characters from aloe to ZZ
  • Complex villains who are more than simply villainous
  • An immersive pixel-art world with a variety of cultures and terrain
  • A morality system that will determine your fate
  • Find and grow your own seedlings; a unique and customizable class of fighters
  • Help your teammates in battle with interactive assist minigames
  • Plants, of course!

2343380.name: Rabbit Simulator
2343380.about_the_game:
Experience heart-pumping action and intense bullet-hell gameplay in Rabbit Simulator, the ultimate action-adventure game. With challenging enemies and a variety of exciting weapons and power progression, you'll feel the adrenaline rush as you blast and slash your way through each level.

Featuring 1 HP and no perma-death, Rabbit Simulator keeps the action fast-paced and thrilling. And with guns resetting every level, you'll have to master your skills and strategy to progress through the game.

But Rabbit Simulator isn't just about combat - you'll also encounter a variety of puzzles and mini-games that will challenge your mind and keep you engaged.
With diverse environments and unique challenges in every level you will be immersed in the experience.

So get ready for the ultimate action game and try Rabbit Simulator today!

Features
• 1 HP
• No perma-death
• Guns reset every level
• Power progression
• Challenging enemies

Accessibility Features

- Key bindings
- Casual mode
- Playable on all resolutions

Premise

Enter a world where every step forward is a step into darkness. Experience a haunting narrative that unfolds through a series of striking cutscenes, each one telling a story of loss, despair, and desperation. With little dialogue, the stark imagery and evocative music will draw you deeper into the story, immersing you in a world where things only seem to get worse.

2343470.name: Unwashed
2343470.about_the_game:
Unwashed is an intense story horror game where players must avoid becoming dirty to survive against scary creatures and solve puzzles.

Storyline

After a big resource war, the Lumina project was born with the aim of creating a new, perfect world. AA, a robot sent to test Lumina, becomes sentient. AA sets out on an adventure to seek answers about its existence and uncover the dark secrets of the Lumina project, which may be linked to the disappearance of Dr.Tempus, the famous scientist.

Progression

The primary goal of the game is to complete the level and advance the story. To achieve this, players must survive encounters with the Herbizide and solve puzzles along the way.

Dirtiness

Dirty areas are scattered around the level, making the player dirtier as they pass through. The level of dirtiness indicates how clean the player character is. The dirtier the player becomes, the slower their movement and the louder the noise they create. This impacts their ability to stealthily maneuver and escape.

Cleaning

Players have various ways to clean themselves, such as shaking their body, using air vents, or utilizing cleaning stations. The choice depends on the level of dirtiness and how clean they wish to be.

Herbizide

A true terror in the game. In each level, players must avoid enemies (Herbizide), each with their own strategy.

Narrative

The main game story unfolds through cutscenes and gameplay actions within the levels. Additional side stories are revealed through diaries or notes that players can discover during their exploration. These side stories can also be metaphorically conveyed through interactive objects that players can inspect and examine.


*The game is currently a work in progress, and we reserve the right to change or modify the game content and information on the store page as needed.

2343480.name: Just Find It
2343480.about_the_game:
Dive into a world of differences to discover! Comb through dozens of Find the Difference levels for contradictions and collectibles.   • Accessibility for color blindness (turn on/off and adjust intensity)

  • Accessibility for the deaf or hard of hearing (displays icons + extended subtitle)

2343640.name: OttoPunks: Gangs of Bosphorus
2343640.about_the_game:
Explore the Vibrant World of Ottoman Punk


This is a journey through a fictional Istanbul that blends traditional Ottoman culture with modern lifestyle. Fight enemies, find allies, uncover mysteries, and explore a world of chaos and survival. We are trying to develop a new direction and a unique experience for players who enjoy RPGs, adventures and action.

Dynamic Storytelling


There's no clear-cut good or bad, only decisions. Your choices will shape the world around you, just like in real life. Your decisions have consequences. You can be diplomatic, or take a more aggressive approach. We give you the freedom to play your way.

Fight Enemies & Befriend Allies


You'll need to fight against enemies to survive. You can also befriend allies who will help you along the way. Your actions will have consequences, and you can choose to be political or aggressive as you see fit. The game's storyline will change according to your behavior, so be careful with the decisions you make.

Solve Mysteries


You have to solve puzzles and unravel the mysteries behind murders and dark relationships between powerful individuals. The game features storytelling and roleplaying elements that enable you to make decisions that will determine your fate in this chaotic world. Will you survive long enough to uncover the truth?

Inventory System and Crafting


Manage your inventory, craft useful items, and use survival mechanics to keep yourself alive. Inventory system and crafting mechanics will enable you to create items that will help you survive.

Discover Hidden Lore & Ottoman Slang


You'll uncover hidden stories and lore by finding clues scattered throughout the city. Also you'll learn some authentic Ottoman street slang that will transport you deeper into this unique world.

Modern and Traditional Arts


The game also features street art and eclectic music elements from real-world artists, adding an authentic touch to the Ottoman punk style. The artwork and design blend together to create a unique and immersive world that players will love to explore.

Are you ready to explore a world where traditional and modern collide, and danger lurks around every corner?

2343650.name: Waven

In a flooded world where only a few islands have survived the rising waters, you play a seafaring adventurer searching for answers to this great upheaval. Long ago, gods and dragons ruled the world. Today, magic remains but what of the mythical beings of yesteryear?

At the dawn of a new era, choose your hero, equip your best spells and set sail for an incredible odyssey. Sail from island to island in a vast world full of colorful creatures, gain power, refine your strategy and uncover the secrets of a world adrift.

WAVEN is a new roleplaying game experience that is accessible, fun and immersive. It combines adventure and turn-based strategy, inspired by the best tactical RPGs, with deckbuilding mechanics and valuable items to collect. It can be played for free online on PC, Mac, smartphone and tablet.

Alone or with friends, face off against multitudes of burlesque monsters of increasing difficulty. Master the elements, cast powerful spells, summon mythical companions and battle your enemies in close combat or from a distance to defeat them and win tons of loot!

Gain experience to upgrade your hero and prove your valor by entering the doors of the "Kolossium" to challenge other players and become a legend yourself!

TACTICAL RPGs REVISITED

WAVEN takes inspiration from the combat and progress systems of the best tactical RPGs while building on the strategic depth of turn-based combat and deck building. The result? An explosive and joyful combo!

LIVELY TURN-BASED COMBAT

Prepare your deck before each battle and use every ruse available to you to take home the victory! Play in your own style! Your options are practically unlimited when combining the many character archetypes, spells, equipment and companions available.

ALL MODES ARE YOURS

PvE, PvP : take advantage of each game mode to express yourself! Fight monsters to harvest resources and win equipment, and challenge other players to climb to the top of the rankings!

PLAY AS A GREAT HERO

Win battles, earn experience, spells and companions, customize your equipment and deck, and take your strategy to new heights.

A CROSS-PLATFORM ADVENTURE

Continue your adventure wherever you are! Enjoy WAVEN on PC, Mac, smartphone or tablet with the same account.

AN ORIGINAL UNIVERSE WITH A UNIQUE GRAPHIC STYLE

Explore a colorful heroic fantasy world inside a distinctive graphic universe, the "Krosmoz", a persistent world that has existed for years in video games, animated series and much more.

2343660.name: The Old Man and His Cat
2343660.about_the_game:
Amb el suport de:

Welcome to our heartwarming game, where players take on the role of a cute and hungry cat on a quest for food in a quaint coastal town. The game is filled with charming gameplay, beautiful graphics, and a touching storyline that will warm your heart.

As you roam the town in search of food, you stumble upon a grumpy old man who has a stash of food. However, you soon discover that the old man is actually a talented artist who has lost touch with his family and friends after the loss of his wife. With your help, he can reconnect with his loved ones and find happiness once again.

The town is filled with interesting characters and delightful mini-games, such as solving puzzles and completing quests. Each interaction with the characters brings you closer to the old man and his journey towards rediscovering his passion for art and life.

In addition, the game's stunning graphics and immersive sound design transport players to a serene and peaceful coastal town that is full of life and detail. The world is alive with colorful flora and fauna, and the soundtrack perfectly captures the mood of the game, immersing players in the experience.

Overall, our game is a delightful and heartwarming experience that is perfect for players of all ages. Join our furry hero on a journey of friendship and self-discovery, and help the old man find the joy of life once again.

  • ---------------------------------------------------------

Embark on a heartwarming journey with 'The Old Man and His Cat' - a captivating narrative puzzle game that puts you in the paws of Domino, a street cat who finds a new friendship in the company of a widower in his mid-70s. As fate intertwines their lives, it's up to Domino to give back the man's selfless act and bring joy back into his world. Will you guide Domino on this extraordinary adventure and witness the transformative power of love and companionship?

2343780.name: THE SONG OF THE NIGHTRIDER
2343780.about_the_game:
GAME IN DEVELOPMENT


THE SONG OF THE NIGHTRIDER is a single player MUSIC ADVENTURE GAME in development. It features three completely new ways of dynamic interaction through sound. SHADOWCATCHING is the first of these main acoustic features to be presented to the public.

DEMO


After sunset the curse of the Nightrider not only transforms most living creatures into shadows but also traps their souls in the form of floating sound orbs which contain their precious magic. From age to age SOUND WITCHES and SHADOWCATCHERS have therefore ventured out into the dark to wake up and steal from the Nightrider's dangerous realm.



Experience the totally new interactive music of SHADOWCATCHING. Its RHYTHMIC GAMEPLAY is challenging by design and best played with a game controller (keyboard control is supported too). To deliberately set the player’s focus on the acoustic potential of the gameplay the threat of discovery by the Nightrider as well as the sword fighting remain deactivated.



Play one stage with THREE INCREASING DIFFICULTY LEVELS (mist/rain/snow). Each level requires more musical skills till you reach actual game difficulty. But be warned: Your cute opponent may become frustrating deadly if you don't learn to trust your ears and head the hints in the sound design as well as the few tutorial instructions.

GAME STORY

Every evening, the setting of the sun heralds a curse over this world. THE RISE OF THE NIGHTRIDER. His eternal bond with the darkness tyrannises the villages, hunting down whomever dares to disturb the peace of his beloved Night. Only an unlikely triad of fate could threaten his deadly reign of silence: THE SPELL OF A SUFFERING HEART, A SWORD CALLED ECHO and THE LONG-FORGOTTEN ARTS OF SURFING THE SOUND...


OVERALL GAMEPLAY


LEARN POWERFUL MELODIES AND RHYTHMS. Close your eyes, listen to see and discover a dark world full of sound. Sneak out at night to go SHADOWCATCHING with rhythmic tunes. Learn the arts of ECHO FENCING and how to defend yourself against BATTLE MUSIC. Gather NPC companions and lead them through relentless MUSIC SIEGES while building a SINGING FORTRESS FOR YOUR DREAMS.

2343880.name: The Diary
2343880.about_the_game:
The Diary is a 2D suspenseful narrative puzzle game that revolves around several distinct "diaries," including a journal full of life but full of doubts, two investigative notebooks written by different people, and the planner's diary, which will all be displayed before you.

By solving each page's puzzle, you will turn the pages and gradually gain insight into a heart-stopping missing case. From different perspectives, you will uncover the buried past behind the case.

· Open an unknown diary and search for its owner while solving puzzles

· Among 6 characters, whose perspective are you reading the diary from?

· With multiple reversals, the answer may be right in front of you or it may never appear

2343890.name: AutoBulletSurvivor
2343890.about_the_game:
AutoBulletSurvivor


Jump right into the world of AutoBulletSurvivor! This thrilling roguelike game challenges you to survive on a post-apocalyptic surface devastated by nuclear war. As the protagonist, you must collect items on the surface and evade increasingly powerful enemies to stay alive.

The surface has been laid waste by nuclear war. The few remaining normal humans have taken refuge underground, creating shelters. You must venture to the surface to gather necessary supplies for the shelter. Grow stronger with the items you collect in this perilous environment.

  • Survival on the Surface: Strategize to survive against increasingly powerful foes.
  • Item Farming: Collect a variety of items to sell or enhance for growth.
  • Shelter Supply: Gather essential supplies for the underground shelter and trade with residents for greater rewards.
  • Pixel Art Style: Explore the apocalyptic world with unique pixel art graphics.
  • Random Skills: Collect random skills to enhance your survival on the surface.

The player's goal is to collect various items on the surface, level up, and become stronger. Gather more items to enhance yourself and survive battles against enemies.

Experience the thrill of survival in AutoBulletSurvivor and become the ultimate survivor in a world devastated by nuclear war!

2343900.name: Project Werewulf
2343900.about_the_game:
Project Werewulf is a 3D third person adult survival horror game with a female protagonist. Story driven linear gameplay with semi-open world elements.

The heroine has been kidnapped and imprisoned in a cruel station far away from civilization, stalked by a werewolf bringing hell with him.

Can she escape this nightmare station? Will she be able to discover why the werewolf is hunting her?

List of features:

The game contains 31 story mission levels, 10 safe zone levels, and 8 challenge levels.

Storyline with dark and claustrophobic atmoshpere.

Voiced, cinematic cutscenes

Interaction with friendly and hostile NPC's.

Character customization.

Challenging but fair gameplay

High quality graphics and sex animations

2343910.name: Brageskålen
2343910.about_the_game:
Your choices matter

Brageskålen is a Norwegian visual novel where the player's choices drive the story. You play as a young skald on Veøya in the year 986. An important part of the game is performing kvad, a nordic form of poetry which will influence how people view you, from romantic poems to heroic tales. The game's backdrop and story are based on historical sources.

A big battle is brewing, and Veøya's warriors are sending ships to fight the Jomsvikings. A mystical curse flips everything on its head as the able-bodied men of Veøya all get sick. You and your friends are the only ones who can figure out who is behind the curse. Can you solve the mystery?

2343920.name: Trackline Express
2343920.about_the_game:
Get your tickets to ride the Trackline Express today! Small disclaimer: there might be some missing rails sections. And occasional barbarian attacks. But don’t worry, our trains are the most reliable out there. Some just require a few upgrades here and there. Other than that, a perfectly fine ride is awaiting for you!
Did we mention wildfires?



Trackline Express is a train builder where you need to reach the stations while keeping your passenger safe from attacks and wildfires. Gather wood, rocks, ores, coal, and then transform them into various resources to create new buildings and equipment using blueprints that you unlock along the way.

The game offers a unique blend of gameplay elements that could appeal to players who enjoy strategy and resource management and to those looking for a more relaxed and cozy gaming experience with occasional exciting twists.



There aren't many resources in the desert, so you’ll have to think about how to use them in the best possible way.





You’ll need to collect enough coins to unlock blueprints in order to build anything. Once a blueprint is unlocked, it’s freely available. Coins are rare around there, so use them wisely.





With enough resources and the right blueprints, you can create multiple buildings and equipment to help you keep going forward and survive. What will you build first? A mine to get the coal for the train? Or maybe a well for your water tank? Unless you choose equipment to defend yourself against an upcoming threat... Each game is different and might require different prioritizations. Adaptation is key.





Attacks are frequent. You’ll have to fight to protect your convoy. Fortunately there are a few items you can use. As more passengers arrive, you’ll have to be more creative with how you use them.





Feed your train with coal, build new wagons and new equipment to defend against, well, basically everything. Try to automate things to keep moving as the game gets harder and harder with time and distance.





Bring your friends along for a ride! Join forces to tackle challenges on a journey to the final destination with Trackline Express multiplayer mode. Unite your strengths, strategically plan your next steps and defeat incoming threats!





You just want to play during a short break? We got you covered! The game comes with a Daily Challenge mode. Every day, a new randomly generated map will be available for everyone, so you can challenge yourself and your friends!





- high replayability value
- many items to gather and craft
- multiple game modes
- online and local (LAN) multiplayer mode (experimental)
- mini quests to complete
- random deterministic map generator

2343930.name: Eyes of War
2343930.about_the_game:
Eyes of War blends RTS and Action RPG elements, creating a medieval warfare game where you can switch between the two gameplay approaches. In strategy mode, you build and develop your castle and make your army. In character mode, you control each unit from a third-person perspective, smoothly transitioning between soldiers to feel the battle up close and maintain your troops.

Compete with friends or AI in supported maps with up to 4 players, striving to become the ruler of the map. Continue your battles with the Strategy Game Mode and different game modes like the Arena Game Mode.

Build your castle, develop your city, create your army, and defeat your rivals!

Be Part of the Army!

In Strategy Mode, wage war with other players by developing your castle and army. Take control of any unit at any moment in the game. Manage and experience the war atmosphere in character mode. Be a leader and a hero by living the battle firsthand!

Feel Your City and Environment Up Close!

See the details of every corner of the maps up close in Character Mode. Roam within the city you built with great dedication and become one of the heroes defending your city against rivals!

Fight Against Real Players With Your Strategies

Join online battles with up to four players. Fight against opponents for resources and the control of the kingdom. Use your strategies against real players, but watch out! The opponents won’t stand there watching your plans unfold…

Prove Yourself Across Different Modes!

In Battle Mode, build your army and take command of large scale battles with smart tactical decisions. In Arena Mode, enter one on one duels and fight your way to the top. For an even greater challenge, step into Survival Arena Mode where you choose a unique character and fight to survive as the pressure intensifies with each wave.

Build one of the Four Nations!

Engage in the struggle among four nations, each with its own unique culture, weakness, and strengths. Diversify your strategy by using units with different advantages from each nation and dominate your enemies!

2343990.name: Sliming
2343990.about_the_game:
The game Slimeing is full of unique mechanics and obstacles. In this game, you control a character called Slime and must bounce it through the air to reach the destination. The obstacles become increasingly difficult, making it very challenging to clear each level. However, the sense of accomplishment you feel when you finally clear a level is unparalleled.

In addition, this game has a unique theme. The cute character of Slime, the way it bounces, and the design of the obstacles all contribute to the game's casual atmosphere.

It's a game where you can feel a sense of achievement in the process of facing countless challenges and failures. You can enjoy many unique mechanics and obstacles along with the theme. Keep challenging yourself endlessly towards your goal and experience the thrill of overcoming your own limits.

2344020.name: Silver Box Classics
2344020.about_the_game:
This collection brings back a gathering of adaptations of the events in the first four Dragonlance role-playing modules, at the beginning of the War of the Lance. These were the first games that brought the world of D&D to PC. Silver Box Classics contains of the following titles: Heroes of the Lance, Dragons of Flame, War of the Lance and Shadow Sorcerer.

HEROES OF THE LANCE
Discover the world of Krynn in this D&D epic. Control the Companions of the Lance (they aren’t Heroes until they succeed!) in their quest to recover the Disks of Mishakal. Only this can defeat the Queen of Darkness and restore the balance between Good and Evil.

DRAGONS OF FLAME
Takhisis, Queen of Darkness, and her Draconian hordes have overrun much of the homeland Krynn, even the elven armies of Qualinost, valiant in their resistance to this evil power, struggle on the edge of defeat. It is only the returning Companions of the Lance that can halt this wave of tyranny before Krynn is consumed by evil. Freed from captivity by an elven assault column, the Companions under the guiding direction of the cleric Goldmoon and bolstered by their success at recovering the mystical Disks of Mishakal, can once again restore a belief in the gods and unify the inhabitants of Krynn against the power of Takhisis. Rescue slaves held by the ravaging Dragonarmies in the foul fortress of Pax Tharkas.

WAR OF THE LANCE
That's the first D&D computer wargame. Prepare for fierce battles and all-out war when the forces of Whitestone clash against the evil Highlord Dragonarmies. The prize: absolute rule over all Ansalon on the Dragonlance game world of Krynn. Send forth your diplomats to forge treaties and gain the allies that will swell the numbers of your troops. When words fail, armies of human, draconians, ogres, dwarves, elves, dragons, and other creatures may prove more persuasive.

SHADOW SORCERER
Shadow Sorcerer is a tie-in with the Dragonlance series of novels. The player controls a party of four adventurers that have just rescued 800 slaves and must shepherd them through the wilderness before the evil Dragon army catches up with them. There are three levels to the game: - Strategic, where the player must move the refugees safely through the wilderness. - Tactical, where the party explores dungeons and other areas of interest, searching for information and treasure to assist the escape. - Political, where the players must deal with the refugee leaders and convince them to continue following the party. All three take place in real-time with the evil dragons constantly on the adventurers' heels slowly picking off the escapees.

Each of these gaming gems brings its own unique flare and adventure for you to enjoy, ranging from platform to real-time combat experience.

2344040.name: Lovers in Playa Rosa
2344040.about_the_game:
Tina Lee is having a rough spot in life right now. The bar she co-owns with her best friend is losing money and she’s just found out that her husband of 3 years is cheating on her. Broke and depressed, she’s at a loss as to exactly what she should do with her life. Then suddenly a golden opportunity comes out of nowhere leading her to a resort town in Mexico called “Playa Rosa”. Here she has both the opportunity to sell her bar and perhaps even explore her own romantic feelings towards other women as she meets two very interesting ladies in this tropical paradise…



“Lovers in Playa Rosa” is a Romantic Comedy Visual Novel and Yuri Dating Sim where you play as barkeeper Tina Lee as she takes a trip to Mexico to improve her fortunes and explore lesbian love!



1. A romantic and hilarious storyline
2. Beautiful Anime style artwork
3. Classy and cool smooth and tropical jazz soundtrack
4. Multiple romanceable characters and endings

2344060.name: Dimensional Animals
2344060.about_the_game:
Dimensional Animals is a metroidvania adventure about five cute animal friends with crazy abilities in a peculiar quest.

Through exploration, meet and partner up with new animals! You'll then be fused together, having access to their skills all at once!

  • One HUGE interconnected multi-dimensional level - You'll explore multiple dimensions with your sci-fi empowered animals. Traverse through portals to find new areas, uncover new unlockables and learn new skills!
  • Exploration comes with rewards! - Find up to 50 hidden diamonds and 25 health orbs to unlock new colors for your pets and improve your survivability by increasing your maximum health.
  • Tight and juicy - Controls are fine tuned so that it's fun to climb and teleport around the game's environments!
  • Eye candy - Visuals are inspired by retro games and animation movies. Expect some colorful, cute and nostalgic sights!
  • Original soundtrack - Dimensional Animals will literally be music for your ears, with a soundtrack that changes depending on the gameplay situation!
