2344070.name: 恶灵植物园：梦兆温室-Precognition Dream's Greenhouse
2344070.about_the_game:
序言

也许是突然出现、也许早有预兆。一种奇特的疾病根纹症开始在世界上流行，同时世界各地自然灾害频发，人类陷入恐慌与不安中。因感染根纹症而失忆的主角多塞珥需要尽快找到治疗疾病的方法。侵入大脑的病症时刻威胁着自己的生命，在“友人们”的协助下，多塞珥前往家族的旧宅，那里的地下研究所中也许存在着治疗的药物。而与解药一起被找寻的，还有那些丢失的记忆与埋藏的秘密。
脑海中回响的呼唤，到底来自何处？
……


《梦兆温室》是一款含有恐怖要素的视觉小说+RPG场景探索类游戏。
玩家将与主角多塞珥·亨特一起见证各种各样的梦境与回忆，一边寻找治疗身体的方法，一边重新认识身边的友人，在旅途中了解家族的历史与末日的真相。


♦ 丰富的剧情内容和大量CG插画，全篇共7个章节，计划将有6个结局。
♦ 在视觉小说的叙事基础上，融入了RPG探索和少量QTE、解谜环节。
♦ 含有原创音乐与轻量的音游要素。
♦ 特设的收集页面，除主线剧情之外，通过收集“回忆碎片”可以了解更多关于角色们的小故事。



多塞珥·亨特

2344110.name: Secrets of Wynne
2344110.about_the_game:
Secrets of Wynne is a puzzle adventure game: journey across a mysterious island, solving puzzles and overcoming challenges while meeting the vibrant, quirky characters that populate the world.


Explore a colorful, cozy, open world filled with surprises. Every cave has something to discover, every house has someone to befriend. From peaceful farming villages to burning forests to dank caves, there's a new frontier waiting for you.


The landscape is dotted with puzzles to unravel. Some will test your observation skills, others your logic and reasoning. Wynne has code breaking, augmented reality, block pushing, word games, and other tricks for you to outwit.


Things on Wynne are not what they seem. A force prevents anyone from leaving. Creatures speak in riddles. An old race is contending with an adversary living in the shadows. Uncover the story, piecing together the clues to find one of the 3 possible endings.

Key Features

  • Open ended exploration. Discover the world on your terms.
  • Challenging puzzles that test your logic, reasoning, and observation.
  • Charming, vibrant characters.
  • 3 possible endings.

2344130.name: Kings Love
2344130.about_the_game:
ABOUT THE GAME


Play as an honorable king that is in dire need of a queen. After a long and bloody war the realm is finnaly at peace. But the throne is not secure! Bring peace to the kingdom by finding a wife in the world of Kings Love.

There are many different beings that live in the realm of men, perhaps the next queen could be an elf, orc or something else! Its up to the player to find his wife!

GAMEPLAY


The player is free to explore the town and countryside in a non linear way. In the world of Kings Love there are many characters that need your help and by completing their quests the player can unlock various romantic partners.

However the world is also filled with many dangers so its important to be prepared. The main character can level up, purchase new weapons and train to become stronger in order to face any mighty opponent.

The goal of the game is to find and marry the next queen of the land, it can be anyone you choose!

The Exotic Dancer


A mysterious dancer that just moved to your realm, likes brave and strong men.

GAME FEATURES


  • Meet over 10 different women
  • Explore the world of Kings Love
  • Help the villagers with their needs
  • Fight dangerous enemies

2344180.name: Realm Divided
2344180.about_the_game:
Tactical Hex-Based Gameplay

Engage in deep, strategic gameplay as you gather resources, build fortifications, and marshal your forces in this turn-based strategy game. Each match is kept fresh and unpredictable as you gather faith and use abilities that can change the nature of events on the battlefield.

Competitive Multiplayer

Compete against fellow players in a quick-paced but tactical battle to wrest control of the aurin crystals and power your lodestone before the other player.

             

Story-Driven Singleplayer

Explore the ancient conflict between the noble Sentinels and the infernal hordes of The Fallen as you fight over The Crossing, a breach in the impenetrable barrier that has separated the two forces for hundreds of years.

2344190.name: Riverflow
2344190.about_the_game:
A simple yet elegant one-stroke puzzle game.

In this game you need to make the river flow through all the dry and barren blocks of soil. Once the river flows through, it will turn into a green block of grass. If you successfully make every blocks turn to green, you win the level! However, every block should only be passed once. You should carefully use your intelligence to let the RIVER FLOW!

The game contains 5 tiers of levels, in each tier it has 125 levels with unique solution.

2344240.name: StreetStep: 21st Century Basketball
2344240.about_the_game:
A Basketball Battle for the Ages! Think fast and use stylish moves to dunk on the competition!

Take on your friends in the freshest 3 on 3 College Basketball League!
Elite Players battle it out equipped with the hottest skills the world's ever seen!
Shoot with precision from Downtown, or take it to the paint to unleash a Showstopping Dunk!
The defense in this Town is no joke, but a well timed "Street Step" can unleash the full power of your Offense!

Features
-Fast paced and frantic head to head action! Ball against your friends on the couch or against an array of challenging CPUs!
-Eight unique teams with their own strengths and weaknesses, along with eight alternate Loadouts with their own unique properties!
-A challenging arcade-style gauntlet, with eight unique routes! Rep your favorite team, take on the best in the country, and soar to the top of that Bracket!

Notes
Platform supported: Windows 7+
Input supported: Xinput (Xbox One/Series Controller recommended), Keyboard

2344320.name: Eldegarde
2344320.about_the_game:
Eldegarde is a third-person action PvPvE RPG featuring distinctive fantasy classes. Go on adventures solo or with friends to search for treasures, level up, and defeat any who stand in your way.



Choose between 6 iconic classic fantasy classes to level up: the Warrior, Rogue, Hunter, Priest, Wizard and Paladin, each with their own character model, armor, weapons and skills.

Explore 5 unique zones with up to 32 different creature encounters. Embark solo or with up to 2 others in either PvE Expeditions, PvPvE Extraction or fast-paced Arenas.


Bring your best gear and potions into every adventure, but beware. Death comes at a cost, and in PvPvE, others can claim what’s yours.

When you can't find the loot you want, craft it with Eldegarde's rich crafting and progression system. 

Earn reputation with the vendors in Stonehaven to unlock new crafting recipes. Build your Lodge and unlock furnishings like the Forge to process Ore, the Bed to earn Rested Experience, or the Critter Habitat where you house Goldgrubs to spin golden thread for passive income!

KEY FEATURES

  • Level up six unique classes, each with powerful abilities, weapons, and gear sets with powerful and unique perks.

  • Play solo or with up to two friends in cooperative party-based adventures.

  • Explore and conquer five distinct maps, each filled with challenges, treasures, and secrets to uncover.

  • Embark on PvE Expeditions beginning at Goldbrook Farmstead, where you’ll hunt down Mor’thog the Cruel, a menace threatening the people of Eldegarde.

  • Brave the PvPvE Extraction Mode, where greater rewards come with greater risks—if you fall, your loot is lost to those who survive.

  • Enter the Arena for fast-paced, skill-based PvP combat - no gear loss, just pride on the line.

  • Build reputation with five key vendors in Stonehaven, unlocking exclusive gear, crafting recipes, and rare materials.

  • Expand and furnish your personal lodge with functional buildings such as the Forge, Loom, Tanner, Critter Habitat, and Transmutation Device to enhance your crafting and progression.

  • Complete 17 Campaign questlines that uncover the lore of Eldegarde and reward you with powerful treasures.

  • Take on over 110 rotating quests from the Quest Board, refreshed daily and weekly for endless challenges and rewards.

  • Experience seasonal resets that wipe progression and usher in new content, updates, and world-changing events—everyone starts fresh, every season.

A LIVING WORLD

Eldegarde has tons of content planned for the futures. Some highlights of content to look out for in the future are:

  • New Class: Witch

  • New Epic Zone: Karth

2344350.name: Farm Day 2023
2344350.about_the_game:
Farm Day 2023 is a fun and addictive farming simulation game that challenges players to develop their farming capabilities and turn their small village into a bustling metropolis. With beautiful and fun buildings, expansions, and a variety of crops to grow, players must manage their farmfields, produce goods, and deliver orders to their citizens and neighbors to keep them happy and earn cash and XP.

The game offers a large campaign with many levels to progress through, providing players with hours of fun and engaging gameplay. The cartoon-style graphics and animations give the game a charming and whimsical feel, making it suitable for players of all ages.

Players can also decorate their farm with a variety of beautiful decorations, making their fun farm city unique and adding to the immersive gameplay experience.

The game's relaxed gameplay style allows players to take their time and enjoy the farming experience, without the pressure of strict time limits or intense competition. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the farming simulation genre, Farm Day 2023 offers something for everyone.

2344390.name: TetraMage
2344390.about_the_game: In TetraMage you step into the sandals of the legendary hero himself, the master of Tetromino magic and unwanted guest in the realm of the gods: the TetraMage. Use your skill and cunning in arranging falling blocks to cast powerful spells and destroy your enemies! Gather experience points and items in battle to customize your character! Success will require adaptability, as each game of TetraMage is randomized and unique, and death is permanent! Failure is fun! Do you have what it takes to snatch the Secret of Immortality from the jealous grasp of the gods and escape in one piece?

2344410.name: Danger in Body
2344410.about_the_game:
Welcome to Danger in Body, the turn-based tower defense game that will put your strategic skills to the test! In this thrilling game, you are a cell in the human body that must defend itself against a dangerous virus invasion.

Each round is an epic battle, with increasingly challenging waves of enemies. You must use your resources wisely to build towers and fortifications that will help stop the viruses' advance.

But it's not just about building towers that will ensure your victory. You must also stay vigilant, using your intelligence and tactical ability to defeat the enemies. With each new wave of viruses, new challenges and obstacles will be presented, testing your ability to think quickly and adapt to difficult situations.

With vivid and exciting graphics, a pulsating soundtrack, and addictive gameplay, "Danger in Body" is a game that will keep you entertained and hooked for hours on end. You are the last hope of the human body - so get ready to fight for your right to live!

2344450.name: Scroter
2344450.about_the_game:
Collect devastating power-ups and unleash chaos on your opponents to claim the crown!

Touch your opponents when you are invulnerable or escape if they are!

Trick your opponents using a combination of skill-based movement and powerups to reach the crown in special levels!

Dodge deadly lasers and precarious ledges to stay in the game - quick reflexes are key to victory!

Be careful which buttons you touch - some hold surprises that can help or destroy you!



  • Challenge your friends or AI opponents in thrilling and chaotic PVP battles up to 4 players
  • Unleash a barrage of explosive power-ups, including bombs, rockets, mines, and turrets
  • Become smaller, faster and invisible to avoid your opponents or strike them
  • Strike your enemies when you have the yellow glow and dodge their assaults when they have the upper hand
  • Reach the crown in some special levels to win instantly the round
  • Disable weapon power-ups and challenge your friends in a peaceful gameplay mode
  • 60 unique levels with explosive surprises, lasers, buttons and bombs
  • Physics-Based movement, watch out to fall down!

2344520.name: Diablo® IV
2344520.about_the_game:
Diablo® IV is the ultimate action-RPG experience with endless evil to slaughter, countless abilities to master, nightmarish dungeons, and legendary loot. Embark on the epic campaign solo or with friends, meeting memorable characters through a gripping story in a beautifully dark world, or explore an expansive end game: battle iconic bosses for powerful loot, fight back the encroaching onslaught of Hell in Helltides, master the Forge to create your ultimate weapons and progress powerful characters, with cross-play and cross-progression on all available platforms.

Welcome to Hell

Discover the critically acclaimed franchise that defined the Action RPG genre. As the battle between the High Heavens and Burning Hells rages on, hatred devours Sanctuary as evil spreads and a new wave of cultists and worshippers arise to embrace Lilith’s coming. Only a brave few dare to face this threat and bring light to the all-consuming darkness.

Expansive Open World

Forge your own path through the corrupted lands of Sanctuary, an ever-growing, fully explorable world teeming with challenges, quests, enemies, and loot. Join your fellow adventurers, rescue and retake besieged towns, delve into nightmarish dungeons and uncover lost secrets as you fight back evil. The many zones of Sanctuary are yours to explore, and with rotating areas of extreme peril like World Bosses and Helltide, danger lurks at every turn.

Immersive Character Development

Create and customize your character to face the encroaching darkness. Choose from one of five classes and build your hero with skills, abilities and cosmetics, creating a champion that is uniquely your own. Grow stronger as you progress through powerful Skill Trees and develop even more unique end game specializations with Paragon Boards.

Legendary Gear, Epic Battles

Discover and experiment with a vast arsenal of powerful weapons, armor and more to fight back against the demons threatening Sanctuary. Explore unique combinations, create your own upgrades and collect a plethora of powerful tools to battle in immersive, action-packed combat against the deadliest of enemies.

Seasons & Events

The tales of Sanctuary continue to unfold. Create Seasonal Characters and join in fresh adventures - master new mechanics and take on the latest threats in each new Season. Complete harrowing feats of the Season Journey and earn new Battle Pass rewards. Plus, sharpen your swords and get in the spirit of the seasons when Limited-Time Events sweep through Sanctuary.

End Game Undertakings

There’s even more Diablo® IV to explore as you reach higher levels and more fearsome World Tiers. Face the greatest challenge yet as you take on the most powerful demons in The Pit, steel yourself against Uber Bosses to reap uber unique rewards, fight back overflowing armies of Hell as Helltides emerge across Sanctuary, battle larger-than-life World Bosses, and master the Forge to create the mightiest weapons fit for a hero.

2344550.name: MageCraft
2344550.about_the_game:
Magic Meets Strategy


MageCraft is all about using magic to outsmart enemies in close-quarters turn-based encounters. Stay behind cover and keep your foes at bay, while raining down a wide variety of spells to overcome the odds.

Discover Shadowy Secrets


Meet a team of young wizards at the beginning of their magical education. Apprenticed to the most powerful sorcerer known to history, but stalked by mysterious enemies. Hardly having even begun, these magicians will have to contend with unexpected enemies and insidious dark magic.

Build Your Spell Book


The main progression of MageCraft is in learning new spells for your team to wield in battle. Each wizard has their own specialization, and can gain increasingly powerful magic which they will need to take on the dangerous enemies the game presents. Balance the massive damage-dealing elemental magic with the strategic AoE nature spells or wield the power of time itself to give yourself an upper hand in combat! With many devastating spells available to acquire, you will always be finding new ways to outwit your enemy.

2344570.name: Mugen RPG
2344570.about_the_game:
"You are the best of this lot."

Wield high-tech firearms, rockets, and lasers against incoming enemy hordes! This action Roguelike hinges on pivotal "Quest Param" choices that forge your path to power. Unearth ancient artifacts that unlock revolutionary combat tactics.

《Mugen RPG》 is a top-down, fast-paced action Roguelike game. As a newcomer struggling to survive, you'll be thrown into a life-or-death trial across different worlds. Relying on cutting-edge weaponry and the emergent enhancements found in battle, you must fight through a hail of bullets against tides of enemies and formidable bosses. Every adventure is a fresh start. Acquire "Quest Params" through combat and freely construct your unique fighting style. Will you become a master of firepower clearing screens in an instant, or an unshakeable bastion on the battlefield? Your choices define everything.

Core Features:

  • Infinite Build Possibilities: A vast array of "Quest Params" offers endless combinations to create your ultimate combat form.

  • Auto-Fire, Focus on Strategy: Weapons attack automatically, letting you concentrate on movement, decision-making, and high-skill maneuvers.

  • Challenge the Unknown: Encounter diverse enemy swarms with distinct behaviors and uniquely designed powerful Bosses. Every encounter is a new test.

  • Mysterious Artifacts, Turn the Tide: Find and wield ancient creations holding mysterious powers; they will bring unexpected variables and aid to your adventures.

2344580.name: Meeple Jump
2344580.about_the_game:

Chill in some lava in the casual Meeple Jump! platformer! Make your way from level to level, collecting stuff, and having a good time. Just... don't mind the Meeple's blank stare

SIMULATION CURRENTLY CONTAINS

2344620.name: Sculpture of Chance
2344620.about_the_game:
Sculpture of Chance is a roguelike deckbuilding adventure where you hack, modify and tinker with a mysterious slot machine. Assemble your symbols, grab your tools and embark on an ecstatic journey. Crank that lever and give it a spin!

Deckbuilding



Delve into a rich variety of deep strategies and build the ultimate deck from 100+ symbols. Add, swap and upgrade your symbols as you keep spinning those reels. When you get a combination, you will be rewarded with coins, tools, trinkets, or even more symbols. Symbols symbols symbols! There are cute fruit buddies, advanced machineries, friendly monsters, delicious hot dogs, pizza, tiramisu I'm getting distracted, but you get the point: Symbols!

Tools



Make every spin count! A little handy work never hurt no one: If you're unhappy with the results, grab a crank and readjust the reel. Need an additional payline? Use your pen and draw it in. Supercharge your symbols with batteries, find hidden keys to unlock treasure chests and use powerful weapons to kill evil foes. Mastery of your tools is essential if you want to build the most magnificent Sculpture of Chance!

Stages



Explore lush forests, ancient caverns and futuristic mega cities! Nuclear wastelands, a pompous castle, a secret lab! A tower high in the clouds, a dome deep under the sea, alien planets! Along the way, you will meet mysterious strangers, make new friends and fight intimidating monsters. If you ask me, that sounds like a blast! So, what are you waiting for? Embark on your quest to succumb yourself to the will of chance build the most magnificent Sculpture of Chance!

2344630.name: Galactic Conquest Battle Infinity
2344630.about_the_game:
- Galactic Conquest Battle Infinity is a real-time strategy game set in the Space.
- Factions fighting for galactic supremacy.
- Design of asymmetric factions.
- Grid based building placement.
- Four playable and one non-playable factions
- Multiplayer up to 4 People online
- Single Player Mode

In the year 3200. The Ethernal ore used as fuel for spaceships was beginning to run out and became harder to come by, sparking a galactic war for control of the Ethernal ore, The Emperor Erick V Proclaimed a challenge, “The faction with the most Eternal will rule the entire galaxy, with no rules on how the factions can achieve the goal.”

2344680.name: Super VHS
2344680.about_the_game:
"Neon. Door. Neon. Door. Neon. Door."

Maybe you know this place. Maybe you've seen it before. Maybe every place actually exists in the screen, now, and it's just as good as going there. Exactly the same, in fact. 

LIFE AT LFVCR

Our warehouse features ultramodern personal computing and classic analog entertainment systems, familiar and foreign: landline phones, spinning wheels, hydraulic set changers, Milwaukee pachinko, and more. A home-away-from-home, scattered with books, posters, boxes, bottles, and VHS tapes. At Lightning Fast, you're family™.

Hypercassette Tape Systems provided courtesy of SPAR Heavy Electric.

A COP FROM THE FUTURE OF SPACE

I THINK THESE VHS TAPES ARE HAUNTED DUDE

THE COLD RUSHES IN

A murmur of something - signal, voice, mechanical or electronic maybe, music, repeating - lifts above the static, just for a moment. Pause. Turn. Try again, you can find it. Just try again.

2344710.name: Duckified: Cosmic Legends
2344710.about_the_game:
Duckified: Cosmic Legends is a side-scrolling, rhythm-based, action, musical, platformer game set across a wide variety of universes, timelines, and eras.

Across 12 different and dynamic universes, players will battle, dance, race, and sing off against otherworldly demons, gigantic robotic megalomaniacs, an ancient deity turned businessman, a raging band of racing raccoons, a gross and all-consuming virus, and more.

Cosmic Legends combines a multitude of gameplay styles, primarily focusing on time-based platforming and accuracy-based combat.

Throughout its whopping 66 levels (split across 13 Worlds and 3 Acts), your goal is to score as many style points in as little time as possible. Collect Duckies, Secrets, and Wristband Pieces to advance your way through, and once you beat a level your performance will be graded on a scale: F D C B A S

Achieve S Rank in Time and Style, collect all your Duckies, and you'll officially earn your P RANK in a level.

P Rank every level in an Act, and you'll earn a secret level ;)

"To defeat these ancient gods, myths, and rulers: you'll truly have to become... a legend."

Somewhere in space, in a retro-futuristic world inhabited by a kingdom of ducks:

The royal Prince Joe Duck is enjoying his life of luxury, relaxation, and power. Until one day, when his evil twin brother, Jasper Duck, beckons him down underground, unveiling his newfound power.

After a heated battle, Joe is banished across the multiverse by his brother; forced to fight his way back, searching timelines for his power, meeting unlikely allies, facing his own fears, and working his way home to challenge his chaotic brother.


Duckified: Cosmic Legends has a stacked cast and crew behind it! As the game grows in development, the cast will too!

Welcome to Peanut Butter Jelly Wars, a thrilling real-time strategy (RTS)-lite game where players face off in an epic battle to determine which spread reigns supreme!

2344820.name: Puzzle Wizards
2344820.about_the_game:
Puzzle Wizards is a cozy co-op cross-platform puzzle MMO from the creators of Puzzle Pirates. Master the harvest, crafting and battle puzzles to go on exciting adventures with friends in the wilds. Earn valuable resources and treasures to build and customize your village and home with furniture and decorations. Win funky familiars and craft fancy robes, hats, wands and more. Team up and work together with your fellow Wizards to build and decorate Guilds and restore the world!



Seasonal event! Fairyland has been disrupted by the wicked SoloGro Bros, a cult-like group of technology entrepreneurs led by visionaries who believe that all anyone needs is SoloGro™, their terrible-tasting 'decentralized' energy drink. Help the poor Fairies throw off the yoke of these mono-crop fanatics by untangling their SoloGro vines, curing innocent crops infected by SoloGro™ fever, battling Bros who have had one-too-many Gro's and using their bean bombs to blow up their own infernal SoloGro Generators. Earn fabulous Fairy loot, furniture, clothes and familiars as rewards from grateful Fairies, build a Fairy house in your village and a Shop in your Guild to welcome them to the wizarding world.



Puzzle Wizards is powered by three puzzles: Harvest, Mixing and Battle. Each have their purpose in the heartwood realms:
  • Harvest: use your match-3 skills to gather resources from the world.
  • Mixing: craft clothes, hats, wands, potions and other useful items with this line-drawing puzzle, whilst fending off the challenges of naughty ingredients.
  • Battle: defeat the enemy spirits of the Wildwoods with the fast-paced battle puzzle, sliding to make four tile and larger matches and flipping attacks back to your foes.



Voyage into the wildwoods on solo and co-operative adventures to gather resources, recipes and rare drops. Wilds are themed as Sun, Moon and Star with inner, middle and outer difficulties. Adventures are in quick, bite-sized chunks of around fifteen to thirty minutes of fun. Wildwood clearings can be chained together, increasing in difficulty as you progress. Difficulty is adapted to the number of players in your party -- it's possible to solo or play in a group of four or more -- and it's easy to drop in and drop out without stranding your team-mates.



The arch-wizard has entrusted you with your own village. The place has fallen on hard times! You'll need to clear the tangled woods with magical sparks from adventures, rescue lost villagers, rebuild theirs shops and redecorate with crafted items and loot from the wilds. Build, expand and customize your own house and fill it with a menagerie of magical familiars. The village is your personal space and a solo progression path, developing your access to cosmetics and empowering items like wands, charms and potions.



Puzzle Wizards has a full friend system and will add your Steam friends who are playing automatically. There is chat built-in to the game. You can also meet new friends adventuring and in Wizard Guilds. The game is friendly and co-operative: there's no place for negative behavior and bad language is filtered.



Wizards band together to form Guilds to bravely explore the dangerous middle and outer wilds, facing down scary monsters and other spirits. You'll need to help out with construction work to build the Guild Towers that will grant your guild access to the most challenging wilds and lairs. Relax in the Wizards Tavern after adventures and challenge each other wand duels. In the future we'll be adding more social 'parlor' games and tournaments, too!



Puzzle Wizards' content will expand with seasonal theme releases offering new adventures, loot and advanced gameplay challenges. Themes released so far: Halloween, Winterfest, Lunar Love Dragon and our current seasonal theme, Fairyland vs. the Sologro™ Bros.

2344880.name: Scrap Warden
2344880.about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey as a Scrap Warden, entrusted with the crucial task of cleaning up space debris. But here's the catch - what you do with this salvaged scrap is up to you! Gather enough scrap material to unlock a plethora of random upgrades, enabling you to fortify your armor, craft formidable weapons, and push your existing systems to epic limits.
Yet, be warned! Treacherous enemies and hazardous elements lurk within these celestial spaces. Conquer challenges and earn achievements to accumulate progress points, allowing you to level up permanent bonuses that aid in your progression through increasingly challenging areas.
As you master your skills, unlock advanced weaponry, gain access to new clearing areas, and confront powerful bosses that guard the gates. Break down scrap, upgrade your ship, and restore order to the vast expanse of the universe! Are you ready to wield the power of scrapping?

2344890.name: 破洞小世界 呆望窗  Hole Small World

Timeline:
  • Over time, the choice of explorable scenarios will increase and the in-scene will become more dangerous.
  • Correspondingly, the help that camps can provide will increase.
  • Careful allocation of time in camp is a key factor in helping you achieve victory.
Clues:
  • Characters can get a variety of clues through dialogue with NPCs or in-game behavior.
  • Depending on the time period, different clues may be obtained.

2344990.name: Trolley Problem
2344990.about_the_game:
Incurable disease, "Sleep syndrome"
Those with sleeping syndrome fall asleep until the moon is full and die when the moon begins to fade.
On the night of the full moon, while the world is drowning in sorrow, a girl sets out on a journey to save the townspeople.


"Trolley Problem" is an action-puzzle game set in a world made up of hundreds of countries.
Players make full use of the rich gimmicks and brains of each country to guide the main character Lily, who manipulates a magical trolley, and deliver the “fruit of heart” to the people of the town.



◆Delivery to Town

The player guides the main character "Lily" in four directions, "up, down, left, and right", and delivers the fruit of heart to four countries.
Her magical trolley is a very fast vehicle, but it can't turn on the way and keeps going until it hits a rock. The player should think about the way to reach the town and lead the hero to the town.


◆A Kind Girl? A Ruthless Savior?
The fruit of heart is the only fruit in the world that can cure Sleeping Syndrome.
In order to save the people, the hero must deliver this fruit to the town with a magic minecart. However, the fruits are very perishable and bruised berries do not cure Sleeping Syndrome.



Each map may have residents living in that country.

“Will you run over the residents and deliver the fruit to the town without damaging it?”
"Will you accept the risk of spoiling the fruit and deliver it to the town without getting your hands dirty?"

Or, any other else choice?

The story moves in different directions, depending on the player's guidance.





Two-step Hint Function
It may take a little ingenuity to get the character to reach the town as intended. If you can't reach the goal as planned, ask for help from the friends you met in the story. No matter how difficult the road is, he will surely help you.

There are two types of hints: "abstract hints" that teach you how to think about directions, and "concrete hints" that teach you halfway through directions to towns. Both hints can be given according to the player's needs, so it will prevent situations where the game is too difficult to reach the goal or the hint makes the game too difficult.






◆Battle with The Enemy.

Possibly, depending on the player's guidance, you may sometimes face the enemy. But don't worry. Let's move the character as before to avoid the attacks, while paying attention to the attacks that fly from the opponent,
What kind of battle awaits depends on your guidance.

Hexoria features inspiration from city-builder card games like Stacklands, survival games like Frostpunk and cultist elements from Cult of the Lamb. Will you choose to focus on building your village, or will you seek to gain more power through dark magic and manipulation? It's up to you to decide in this thrilling adventure!

As the days went by, the ghosts became more and more aggressive, and the humans began to feel helpless in their presence. But there was a group of beings who wouldn't give up so easily: the cats.
The cats, known for their cunning and bravery, began patrolling the streets at night, searching for any signs of the ghosts. When they found one, they pounced on it without fear, clawing, biting and shooting until it disappeared.

2345100.name: OffiAtrix: Rise of the Team Leader

Hello everyone,

So, what's the game about?

✄---

With the rise of AI, a crisis has struck. Offiatrix Corp., once a brilliant corporation, gathers the Board of Directors. On the agenda: staff cuts and budget reductions.

They quickly decided who to lay off and who to keep working on those fascinating presentations no one ever reads.

Everything was going according to plan... until the bosses touched the sacred — zeroed out the coffee budget.

And then the employees realized: this is WAR! A real. Corporate. Meat grinder!

  • In IT, team-building turned into a battle for the last sugar packet.
  • Marketing is crafting shields out of flip charts.
  • Accounting is brewing coffee over candles.


🔑 Key Features:

1. Lead Your Dream Team: Recruit office warriors with top-notch coffee brewing skills and hidden discontent. Manage them wisely, remembering that each of them drinks coffee faster than you can say, "Urgent meeting in my office!".

2. Epic Office Battles: Find out who’s cooler — marketers or accountants. The battle isn’t just for the seat by the window! The winners aren’t the strongest but the ones who hit "send report" on Friday at 5:59 PM.

3. Training and Upgrades: Spend your hard-earned cash to upgrade your HQ — from one cooler that growls when dispensing water to two or three coolers that can sing "Happy Birthday" in harmony. And a trained fighter will always grab the last cookie from the box first.

4. Hilarious Storyline: Dive into the world of office life, meet teams of other players... and destroy them. Share stories of how someone didn’t notice a rat stealing half a sandwich off their keyboard again. Every day brings new drama. Discover the true magic of life: everything on the verge of a corporate nightmare.


🎮 Offiatrix: Embrace the chaos, become an unrivaled leader, and show everyone that in the office hierarchy, you are the God of War! 👑

Let the office war begin!

✄---

Thanks for reading,
Andrew, co-owner of Offiatrix Corp.

RUN FOR YOUR LIFE - Hunt down and clear the horde of zombies.
PROTECT THE STREET - Defend the barricades from being destroyed.
COLLECT COINS - Collect the coins target to win the level.
STAY ALIVE - Survive until the timer ends.
KILL ZOMBIE BOSS - Survive long enough to kill the zombie boss at the end of the level!

At the end of each level, you can spend your coins in the shop for weapons upgrades. You can also unlock additional characters to take on your journey to rid the neighbourhood of zombies!

2345360.name: Dungeon of Insanity
2345360.about_the_game:
RESOURCES

  • Three sinister floors to explore within the dungeon, with diverse enemies, traps, puzzles and secrets.
  • Choices allow for multiple story branches where you determine your own destiny.
  • Charismatic and fun NPCs that will help (or hinder) you throughout the game.
  • Lots of items, artifacts, weapons and curses for you to loot and enjoy throughout your adventure.
  • Procedural map generation. Each time you enter the dungeon, it will be different.
  • Battles against several eccentric and extremely challenging bosses.
  • Get ready to plunge into the depths of insanity.

HISTORY

You, a legendary warrior who died decades ago, have been resurrected through a black magic ritual. Your objective now is to enter the Dungeon of Insanity and rescue the princess. But for that you'll have to go through several challenges, face terrible enemies and, in the end, face the most bastard of all villains: the necromancer.


Choose your champion, hone your skills in the Lionstone kingdom camp, find treasure, gather the most powerful ancient relics and be prepared to face insane enemies, ranging from skeletons and bats, to big swords that spit small swords! Stay tuned, because at the end of each floor of the dungeon there is a massive and menacing master waiting for you for a supreme challenge!

CONSEQUENCES

Along your journey, you will be faced with several choices.
  • Which artifact to get?
  • Use a cursed weapon?
  • Free a crazy prisoner?
  • Betray the king's trust?
  • Save the life of a ham villager?

From small to big choices, all your decisions have consequences that will reverberate throughout the journey. Think carefully about what you're going to do, because although you can return to the dungeon as many times as you want, even after being killed several times, the choices made during the journey are permanent. After all, it's not possible to go back in time... right?

COMMUNITY


If you like what you've seen so far, consider joining our Discord server to stay up to date on development, meet the developers, and get early access to news, screenshots, videos, and demos!

2345370.name: Digs Mini Icy
2345370.about_the_game:
Digs Mini Icy is a mini adventure starring Warf. It incorporates mechanics similar to old classics like Sokoban, but with uniquely designed puzzles and added features. Warf is stuck in an icy mountain and must find his way while collecting gems and overcoming various obstacles like slippery grounds, dangerous lava, funky launchers and more. Only true masters can pass these challenges.

Digs: Icy is a mini game based on our original game, Digs, and features 50 levels. If you want to assist Warf further, you can wishlist Digs.

2345380.name: 100% Challenge
2345380.about_the_game:
• Control the Core to capture objects of the same color and avoid touching those of a different color. Doing this will create a progress bar that, when completed, allows you to advance to the next level.
  • If you touch the wrong colors, you will create a color barrier that will make it difficult to capture the right objects. You can eliminate it by touching it with objects of the same color.
  • Complete the progress bar 10 times to beat the 10 levels and earn the maximum reward. Doing it quickly and without taking damage will give you the highest score.
  • In each attempt, you will earn progress points that you can use to acquire new skills and go further and further.







Single player modes:

  • Tutorial will teach you the basics of the game.
  • Arcade allows you to earn points by completing matches, with which you can unlock upgrades.
  • Horde is an endless arcade mode where you can challenge yourself to see how far you can go.
  • Ultimate Challenge is the real challenge where you can configure your skill tree and post your score on the World Ranking until you become the best.



Two player modes:

  • Coop is the Arcade mode where two players collaborate to progress and earn skill points.
  • Versus is a Horde mode for two players where the last one surviving wins. Try pushing your opponent or swapping the color barrier with them!





  • The Ultimate Challenge is a special game mode where you can configure which skills you want to activate. The more difficult you make it, the higher score you can get.
  • The result you get in Ultimate Challenge can be posted on the World Ranking and show the world who is the best at the 100% Challenge.







We love creating games, we are learning, and this is our first game! For this reason, we really appreciate constructive feedback that can help us improve.

Please expect to find in this game a small, simple, arcade-style, casual, challenging, and replayable scoring game. The goal is to beat your previous record, unlock skills to go further and further, and compete for the best score worldwide.

As it is a simple game, we have prepared a Demo version where you can learn and enjoy most of the available mechanics. If you feel like seeing everything, showing off your skills in the world ranking, or simply supporting us to continue with future projects, you can contribute by purchasing the full version.

We have tried to add some extra modes that we hope you will really enjoy.

Other features and accessibility


Easy or difficult? We have tried to make a game with mechanics that are easy to understand and remember so that everyone can enjoy it. But we have also made sure that difficulty is a determining factor in progressing. We hope that the skills you acquire will allow everyone to achieve their own balance where they feel comfortable and have fun participating in the challenge!

Colorblind mode: We know that the game mechanics require distinguishable color palettes, so we have included a modified color mode for colorblind people that can be activated in the settings. Unfortunately, we cannot verify its effectiveness, but we hope that everyone who wants to can enjoy the game. If you want us to improve any aspect of accessibility, you can also leave us a comment.

Languages: We want the game to be accessible to everyone, so this page and part of the game content have been translated using an automatic translator. If we have included any errors or used inappropriate language, please let us know so that we can try to correct it.

Attribution


The SFX are royalty-free, and some of them were downloaded from FreeSFX and Freesound.

The game soundtrack, as well as the music that can be heard in the trailer, is the work of Kevin MacLeod. You can find more information about the titles included in the credits within the game.

Trailer track title: Rhinoceros

Some cuts and small modifications were made to this audio track to adjust it to the needs of the trailer. You can listen to the original work on the author's website.

Thank you!


Thank you very much for taking the time to read this message.

Good luck in your games!

2345410.name: Molecular Warfare
2345410.about_the_game:
Molecular Warfare is a top-down shooter with beautiful graphics.

An excellent dynamic shooter with 2D top-down graphics, which has many maps, several modes, various types of weapons. Do not let you get bored with a lot of maps for different modes such as: Island, Port, Cave, Village, Warehouse, and many more.

Why is it worth downloading and playing the game?
Firstly, beautiful and pleasant graphics, secondly, convenient controls, and thirdly, constant updates with new content :)

Come into Molecular Warfare, upgrade your skills,
earn a level and enjoy!

2345430.name: Escape From Crimson Manor: Trapped Together
2345430.about_the_game:
ESCAPE FROM CRIMSON MANOR: TRAPPED TOGETHER

Two Minds, One Escape. The Ultimate Co-op Puzzle Experience.

Escape from Crimson Manor: Trapped Together is first and foremost a test of communication and deduction. Set in a sprawling, interconnected Victorian mansion, this game brings the intricate puzzle design of The Inheritance of Crimson Manor into a dedicated two-player experience.

🗝️ THE MAIN EVENT: Co-op Puzzle Campaign (2 Players) "Trapped Together"

Designed for those who value logic over panic. In this full narrative campaign, you cannot die. There is no monster chasing you—only the mansion itself stands in your way.

  • Separated but Connected: Wake up in opposite wings of the mansion. You cannot see what your partner sees; voice communication is your only tool.

  • Pure Deduction: Without the threat of death, take your time to solve complex mechanical puzzles and decipher cryptic riddles in a stress-free environment.

  • Exchange Mechanics: One player has the recipe, the other has the ingredients. Master the dumbwaiter system to trade tools, keys, and crucial clues between floors to progress together.

🩸 BONUS MODE: Asymmetric Survival (3v1) "The Blood Harvest" [NOT AVAILABLE IN DEMO]

Looking for adrenaline after the puzzles? Switch gears in this high-stakes replayable mode where survival is not guaranteed.

  • The Alchemist vs. Survivors: One player becomes the obsessed Alchemist, hunting up to three Survivors.

  • The Hunt: Unlike the main campaign, here death is real. The Alchemist uses the dumbwaiters to ambush victims and drain their essence to become younger and faster.

  • The Escape: Survivors must use stealth and sabotage to locate blood vials and break the lockdown before they are bled dry.

KEY FEATURES

  • Two Distinct Experiences: A pure brain-teasing Co-op Campaign and a heart-pounding Asymmetric Horror mode included in one package.

  • Dynamic Mansion: 2 Floors, 2 Wings, and a Central Hub interconnected by a web of tunnels.

  • Gothic Atmosphere: An immersive Victorian setting expanded with enhanced visuals and new dark zones.

  • The Anemia System (PvP Only): In the Blood Harvest mode, health is a resource. Losing blood blurs vision and slows movement—manage your vitality to survive.

2345440.name: Piscirazzi: Fish Photo Shooter
2345440.about_the_game:
Take Dazzling Photos


Embark on an underwater photography challenge, where every round you must take the perfect shot with a limited number of photos. Succeed, and you'll get to choose a camera upgrade for future shots. Fail, and it's game over.

Improve Your Abilities

Snap Them All


Understand the unique habits of each species and where to find them and you'll soon be able to snap them all! But don't worry, the depths of the ocean hold no danger for an experienced diver like you. Every dive in Piscirazzi is a new journey full of wonder and discovery!

2345470.name: Amazing Trip to Europe - Hidden Objects
2345470.about_the_game:
🎒 Grab your backpack and get ready for a cozy Hidden Object Journey across Europe!
Take a relaxing journey through 30 stunning locations, from the 🗼 Eiffel Tower in Paris to the 🏛️ Colosseum in Rome. Search and find hundreds of hidden items, collect ✉️ postcards and 💎 diamonds, and enjoy the beauty of Europe in this cozy Hidden Object game designed to help you unwind.

With its peaceful atmosphere, 🎨 colorful artwork, and 🎶 calming music, this game offers a truly cozy puzzle experience. Whether you’re a Hidden Object fan, a travel lover, or simply looking for a casual way to relax, Amazing Trip to Europe is the perfect cozy escape after a long day.

✨ Features:

  • 🌆 Explore 30 beautiful European locations filled with hidden objects.

  • ✉️ Collect postcards and 💎 diamonds as cozy rewards.

  • 🌿 Relaxing atmospheres and 🎶 calming background music.

  • 🎯 Multiple game modes for added variety and cozy challenges.

  • ⏳ Hours of fun for Hidden Object fans of all ages.

🌟 Discover Europe like never before – in the coziest Hidden Object journey you’ll ever take! .

2345480.name: Alien Planet Survival
2345480.about_the_game:
This is a 2D open world survival game. It is more like an idle automation game. There is no need to run around the map. It is not difficult. As long as you have time, everyone can pass the level without dying.
You drift in space and land on a random planet. By collecting materials, you can survive, develop civilization technology, and conquer more planets.


  • Pre-produce primitive tools, then unlock power to start automated production.
  • With a day and night system, you need to build a fire, or lights to deal with the night.
  • With a hunger system, you need to collect food.
  • Able to fish, cut trees, mine, hunt, industrial automation

2345490.name: 星辰大海
2345490.about_the_game:
游戏简介

《The Galaxy》是一款以塔防为核心玩法的游戏。在游戏中，玩家将扮演一位能够在宇宙中“看到”航道的探星舰船长，体验和一众美少女船员探索星空，并和各种各样的宇宙生物战斗的故事。

游戏特色


爽快并且充满策略性的塔防玩法
游戏内的每张战斗地图都提供了独特的塔防玩法，通过设定自然地整合在一起：比如玩家可以在“探星船左右翼”体验到类似《植物大战僵尸》的经典塔防玩法，在“探星船甲板”体验到通过设置障碍物和塔来控制敌人进攻路径的塔防玩法，在“探星船舰桥前”体验到类似《明日方舟》的塔防玩法。

性格各异并且具有深度的美少女船员
在《The Galaxy》中，玩家有机会遇到或者招募各式各样的美少女作为探星船的船员。这些船员有着各种各样的技能，比如有些船员能帮助玩家保护探星船，另外一些船员则提高探星船上各模块的产能。玩家还可以通过各种方法提高船员对玩家的好感度，并最终解锁特殊剧情和衣着。

有趣并且充满挑战的养成系统
在《The Galaxy》中，所有船员都有着丰富的成长要素，玩家能通过战斗、收集素材、打造装备等多种方法提高船员能力甚至解锁新的技能，新的动作甚至衣着。在给予玩家巨大成就感的同时也不会让玩家感到厌烦。

丰富并且细致的探星船改造系统
玩家可以改造自己的探星船。《The Galaxy》为玩家提供了种类繁多的探星船改造项目。玩家在战斗中可能获得各种材料，还可以和黑市商人交易，换取普通渠道无法获得探星船改造材料或者蓝图。

2345500.name: Red Lands
2345500.about_the_game:
Red Lands takes place in a colorful world where the grass is red, the wood blue and the stone yellow. These lands are still largely unexplored and only populated by cats in some small tows connected by railroads. Despite its cute appearance, the nature there is harsh and filled with dangerous animals.



Lieutenant Cosh is in charge of building a new railroad to connect two distant towns separated by a particularly wild region scattered with crumbling ruins left by ancient peoples. He will have to explore forests, caves and dungeons, collect resources and build towns.



Red Lands is a classic RPG in a colorful world with a traditional/bluegrass music atmosphere.

2345540.name: Perfect Hand of Nostalpix [REMASTER]
2345540.about_the_game:
Perfect Hand of Nostalpix is a remaster of the 1989 digital card game classic. Defeat your foes with a deck you tweaked to perfection by collecting, upgrading and evolving each card, in this blast from the past enhanced with new mechanics!

▪▪▪▪▪▪ SET IN THE SAME UNIVERSE CARD NOVA HYPER ▪▪▪▪▪▪

Cloth-exploding dramatic card game, wishlist now and follow us on Kickstarter!!

DOMINATE YOUR OPPONENTS

Master the game mechanics and plan using cunning strategies to trap your opponents and destroy them with the power of your monsters, orbs and runes.

BUILD YOUR DECK

Build the best possible deck across the cards in the game.

Pick your monsters while paying attention to their runes. Find the best objects to enhance your current strategy, and nothing can stand in your path!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CARDS

Ponder which card to upgrade, evolve, and awake. Customize their effects with powerful runes, seeking the best synergies that fits your play style.

All to reach the perfect hand of Nostalpix.

2345550.name: Meow Legion

Meow Legion is a game about assembling an army of cats to defend against waves of enemies.

  • I made this game because I like cats.
  • controller recommended.
  • Left mouse button/RT to shoot.
  • Right mouse button/LT to recall cats.
  • Recall allows your cats to defend for you and pick up items.

  • Total 10 types of cats
  • You get stronger every time you lose. You will receive a random meow card, each with different attribute bonuses for each cat.

2345570.name: Stellar Stroll
2345570.about_the_game:
Embark on a thrilling interstellar journey with your fuzzy co-pilot in this exhilarating space adventure game. As your furry friend is a rookie in space exploration, your guidance and expertise will be crucial to navigate the perils of the cosmos.



Key Features

  • Master your spaceship: Pilot your craft with precision, utilizing your knowledge of physics and expert piloting skills to traverse the vastness of space.
  • Protect your companion: Keep a watchful eye on your furry sidekick as you maneuver through obstacles, shielding them from harm by blocking incoming debris with your ship or guiding them to safety.
  • Laser gun at your disposal: Utilize your spaceship's laser gun to blast away incoming space debris, clearing a path for both you and your fuzzy friend.
  • Docking capabilities: Invite your companion to dock their ship with yours, allowing them to experience the awe-inspiring wonders of the universe up close and personal.
  • Unforgettable cosmic journey: Explore the breathtaking beauty of outer space with your furry companion by your side, creating lasting memories as you uncover the mysteries of the cosmos together.

Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure, piloting your ship and safeguarding your endearing partner as you uncover the marvels of the universe!

2345590.name: Puzzlepops! Plus
2345590.about_the_game:
Cute lollipops. Serious puzzles. A game about candy that will truly test your problem-solving skills. Puzzlepops! Plus includes both the original Puzzlepops! and Puzzlepops! Trick or Treat for well over 200 deliciously challenging puzzles.

(Please note: currently only mouse controls are supported for Puzzlepops! Plus)



A brain-bending game of logic that mixes a traditional sliding puzzle with the art of candy making and beautiful minimalist visuals. Slide pieces of candy along lollipop sticks and combine them to complete each Pop! Plan your moves carefully and use tricky contraptions to freeze, melt, squash and swap candy.



• SOLVE some of the most challenging and varied puzzles by building weird and wacky lollipops.

• DISCOVER different contraptions and confectionery that will put your puzzle-solving skills to the test. These Pops are no child’s play!

• UNLOCK puzzle sets and progress from Trainee to Sweet Savant. Can you complete all the Puzzlepops?
2345590.reviews:
“If you’re sick of matching three of a kind but still want some candy in your puzzle game, Puzzlepops! is well worth checking out.”
Gamezebo

AppUnwrapper

2345630.name: The Gap
2345630.about_the_game:
Years ago, my daughter went missing. After a time, everyone gave up hope of finding her... They moved on.
But not me. I know my daughter is alive. She is out there somewhere, waiting for me. Needing my help.
Last night I got this letter...

The Gap is a short first-person horror experience taking place in a ghostly abandoned house on a lonely street corner. You don't know what forces compelled you to come here, but it is clear someone is living inside.

Features
  • An atmospheric, horrifying environment hand crafted to take advantage of your fear of the dark.
  • An engaging linear narrative.
  • A Free Roam gamemode letting you explore the game world without the confines of the linear story.
  • Minimal gameplay mechanics typical of walking simulator genre.

It will sometimes be necessary that you delve into near complete darkness to proceed. I have given you a small body light to aid you in this.

It is not recommended for lower end systems.

2345640.name: Forbidden Fantasy The RPG
2345640.about_the_game:
Embark on an unforgettable journey to the world Nephalia, teeming with peril, magic, and awe as you embark on a quest to rescue the realm from encroaching fog of corruption. Tailor your character, select weapons and classes, and enlist either virtuous or malevolent mercenaries to aid you in combat.

Join the female protagonist and her party as you explore the vast world consisting of 4 major nations filled with interesting dialogue, dangerous quests and nefarious enemies that will progressively shape your experience.

With every decision you make, the NPCs' reactions will change, unlocking hidden paths and endings that you won't want to miss!
Rest up and recover with camping mechanics but beware of enemy attacks if you sleep without a campfire!

Recruit allies with the mercenary system, each with unique skills and personalities that will assist you in your battles.
Equipment, item loots are generated based on the class you choose, so you will not waste any equipment on your playthroughs!
With over 1000+ items, weapons and equipment aiding you in your perilous adventurer, you will get to enjoy high replay value as they get carried over to the New Game+!

Get ready to make tough choices that will determine female protagonist's fate and uncover all the hidden endings that await in Forbidden Fantasy The RPG!!

2345660.name: 謳歌的聖女
2345660.about_the_game:
「choirsaintess 」talk about a teenager YI-CHA-SI accidentally travelled through a different world, Because of an opportunity to embark on a journey to find a way to go home

During the journey, he gradually found that he had been associated with the world in the past, not by chance。

After consulting with all forces, he gradually recovered the lost memories of the past and reminded him of the most important things he had lost in the world。

■In the traditional turn-based RPG game, each character has his own talent skills, up to 9 available characters and 17 occupations for you to explore

■It has a complex equipment synthesis system, allowing you to match with character talents to create your own unique gameplay

■There are three difficulty modes to choose from, a multi-week system, and a large number of hidden elements are waiting for you to explore

2345700.name: Heart Of Nadia
2345700.about_the_game:
The Shining City is a city-state, a developed scientific and cultural center, where people from neighboring countries flock in search of a better life. A city where science and magic created a stunning tandem, a city that could withstand the forces of nature, able to withstand any adversity. It seemed that nothing could shake the tranquility of its inhabitants. But this city has its own dark secrets and secrets that he tried to hide. But there will come a time when it will have to pay the price.



Kara is a rich educated girl looking for her place in life. She dreams of making life in the city better and in many ways does not agree with the existing rules. She sincerely wants to save the inhabitants from the impending threat.



Sora is Kara's loyal friend and guardian. A slave in the past and now the most dangerous of the Shining City's warriors. He has lost his freedom and his ability to make choices. Perhaps Kara can fix that?



Kalem is a miraculously surviving merchant that Kara and her company met in the desert. Charming, well-read, romantic, but at the same time, little is known about him. How did he end up in the middle of the desert? Can he be trusted? Or will he lead the heroine into a new trap set by ancient forces?



Alek cares only about himself, and sees the world in very dark colors. It was influenced by his past, which cannot be forgotten, and the present in which he is forced to exist. Will Kara be able to restore his faith in humanity?

Game Features:

* Beautiful illustrations.
* Traveling through the mysterious desert and meeting ancient and powerful creatures
* Each character has its own unique story and plot development

2345740.name: Rogue Tactics
2345740.about_the_game:
The end of the universe. Humanity has disappeared, and the stars have gone out. However, humanity was able to leave something behind.

The World of Ideas.

Everything is relative in this world, and in the great void, ideas begin to materialize. As one of the self-aware ideas, you strive for the ultimate materialization of the world of ideas, but the battle for it will not be easy.

Rogue Tactics is a turn-based tactical roguelike inspired by games like Kings Bounty and Into the Breach.

Features:

  • Collect a unique squad of creatures with their own strengths and weaknesses.

  • Fight in deep tactical battles with the impact of landscape on combat.

  • Combine creatures to create stronger ones.

  • Collect a variety of spells that can turn the tide of battle.

  • Find "Ideas" with their unique effects.

  • Replayability - procedural generation and a vast amount of content (Over 200 creatures, 120+ spells, and around 300 "Ideas") make each run unique.

  • Lots of unlockable content.

  • Twitch integration, allowing interaction with the chat.

2345770.name: SuperPantsu Tentikun
2345770.about_the_game:
Grab passing characters into your cosy lockers and give them ecstasy while extracting the energy needed to grow into a strong little tentacled monster. Infect lockers and spread copious amounts of love and pleasure while unlocking new abilities and growing ever stronger.

Tentikun is an idle clicker-like game where you try to infect lockers, broom closets, elevators, and toilet stalls with Tentikun’s tentacles.

When a character passes in front of one of these you need to quickly grab them into the locker without any other characters noticing else the action will be reported and an officer might appear and seal one of your lockers.



Lockers will automatically pleasure the character and release them when done but you can enter the locker to speed up the process, or to simply watch the lewd action.

Pleasuring a character in a locker will generate Energy and Lust points. The Energy is used to grow new tentacles in lockers while the Lust Points can be used to upgrade Tentikun or even unlock new types of Tentacles.



Your goal is to reach Tentikun's peak evolution by unlocking its pocket dimension where you can customize and play with its harem.
2345770.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

2345810.name: CRANE GAME QUEST
2345810.about_the_game:
-Game Features

This simulation game realistically recreates Japanese crane games. Not only does the arm move based on physics, but it also replicates elements of real crane games, such as 'LIFT ACTION' and 'TWISTING'. Furthermore, thanks to a proprietary algorithm, you can employ many of the techniques used in real crane games.

-Game Flow

Just like in a real arcade, you can explore the stage, choose a machine to play, and enjoy the crane game. This game features two modes.

   - Quest Mode: Collect prizes while meeting specific conditions. Clearing quests unlocks new quests, new prizes, and new stages.

   - Free Play Mode: Play the crane game freely within a set budget (you can only play stages and win prizes that have been unlocked in Quest Mode).

Collect all prizes across every stage and master the crane game.

-Notes

Generative AI is used for the prize designs in this game. Prize designs are subject to change without notice.

2345840.name: 看事
2345840.about_the_game:
This is an independent game, a purely independent game. The story and text are written by myself, and the graphics are drawn by myself. This is a visual novel with approximately 500,000 words, including some gameplay elements. Currently, the plan is to have both a story mode and a gameplay mode. However, the story is the main product, while the gameplay is a complimentary feature. I guess the results may not satisfy you, so please focus on the story.

As for the shortcomings, they are also quite prominent. The personal style is overly obvious. There simply isn't another text game like this. Firstly, the writing style of this game is colloquial, reminiscent of storytelling scripts. Secondly, the author of this game is short on funds, so all the illustrations are crudely drawn by himself. However, I have done my best. I also wanted to use AI, but the style doesn't suit my writing. Therefore, players, please forgive me! [I have heard a saying in the gaming world: as long as there is love, the illustrations will look cool.]

2345870.name: Tile Lands
2345870.about_the_game:
Tile Lands is a minimalist, City Building strategy game about managing and optimising buildings using a limited deck of tiles. Enjoy Tile Lands as a peaceful escape to your own minimalist town, enjoying the tranquility of organising neat districts and maintaining optimal building distribution. For those wishing to embrace the challenge, Tile Lands provides a focus on hitting high scores - pay attention to the requirements of your buildings and place tiles strategically to best optimise your town.

GAMEPLAY

In Tile Lands, you play tiles onto a finite grid of spaces from your procedurally generated deck. Tiles can be placed onto the grid either adjacent to a tile already on the grid, or as a replacement for a tile already on the grid. Placing a tile onto another tile of the same type will clear that space. Placing tiles will score points depending on how well you satisfy the conditions of that tile. Once you gather enough points, you'll be given a choice of Tile Packs to add new tiles to your deck - the game is over when you run out of tiles.

FEATURES

What Tile Lands Offers:
  • Relaxing, atmospheric gameplay
  • The feel of classic tile laying board games like Carcassonne
  • A highly replayable, arcade like experience
  • A satisfying balance between strategy and puzzle mechanics

What Tile Lands Doesn't Offer:
  • Intense medieval combat
  • Resource management
  • Pre-written storyline or cinematics
  • Online multiplayer

THE TEAM AND A THANK YOU

Tile Lands was developed by Shiba Dog Studios - a two person indie studio in the UK comprising a Game Designer/Programmer and a Graphic Artist. We worked in collaboration with a second Programmer and a Sound Designer to bring together this peaceful little toy. We'd like to thank you for taking the time to look at our game - please don't hesitate to reach out to us if you have any questions, feedback, issues or even just to say hi! Our inbox is always open :)

2345890.name: Things to get
2345890.about_the_game:
In this game, the user must pick up objects that will help him and solve the puzzles and finish the tasks. With each finished task the user will go to the next level. The user must look for objects that will help him solve the puzzles.
With each chapter finished the next chapter will be released. The player must look for objects in the scene that can help in solving the puzzle and pick them up, when the puzzle is finished it will open the door that will allow you to go to the next chapter. Some chapters do not require solving puzzles, but performing a sequence of tasks to complete. Other chapters require the player's skill in moving the character using the controller or keyboard keys, or running and dodging obstacles. In chapters where small skulls appear, it means that the character is at risk of dying, in these chapters you need to be more careful. When all chapters are finished the player wins.

2345910.name: Within a Dead City
2345910.about_the_game:
It ain't easy running an Adventurer's Guild.


You have to deal with monster attacks, angry gods, and cowardly heroes. Money can solve a lot of problems (and motivate cowardly heroes), but a good strategy demands more than just bags of cash. You'll need to guide heroes as they grow from rookies into champions.

Let someone else do the dangerous work

There's riches to be found inside the dead city. Hire foolhardy and fearless adventurers to bring it back to you! Heroes will act on their own accord: slaying monsters, raiding lairs, and defending your guild outpost. Try to keep them out of trouble - their greed can lead them to bite off more than they can chew.


Find forbidden knowledge within ancient ruins

The old gods are jealous gods, and they will do all they can to keep their temples safe from intruders. Balance economic growth against steadily growing corruption. Defend your outpost from the encroaching monster lairs. Research ancient technologies and cast powerful spells. If you and your heroes can survive in the ruins, you'll be wealthy beyond your wildest dreams.
2345910.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese

2345920.name: 蕾拉 Layla
2345920.about_the_game:
“Layla” is a walking simulation and visual novel combined game about a story of memories of old times.

A journey back to the hometown
Come to Alaska in the 1950s, live here for a year and experience the landscape in all seasons.

A story of a family and a little bear
See how a bear and a family are connected by memories of the past.

And a beautiful old time
A gentle bedtime story, hope you can accompany the story, forget some unpleasant things and relax your mood.

“Layla” is my first game developed independently, I hope you can enjoy it.
Have a good day!

2345930.name: HELL OF VERDUN
2345930.about_the_game:
HELL OF VERDUN is a first person horror game in which you'll experience the horrors of the First World War.
Will you manage to discover all the secrets and escape from this hell? It's up to you, soldier.


In HELL OF VERDUN is set in World War I in 1916, thousands of soldiers had already fallen.
As a German soldier, Hanz Meier, you are there. Your troops should attack the French fort near Verdun.
But everything will be different, the attack will not take place, but a whole new hell will arise.


In HELL OF VERDUN, explore the trenches surrounding the Battle of Verdun.
Explore the horrors of the First World War and uncover its dark secrets
Terrible War.

INVESTIGATION


Find objects and personal writings


The horrors of war



Contents
  • Explore the trenches at Verdun.
  • Discover the secrets of this hellish place
  • Solve riddles
  • Discover real writings of soldiers from the First World War and more!
2345930.supported_languages:
English*, German
*languages with full audio support

2345940.name: Lost Lands
2345940.about_the_game:
You are the first one in these Lost Lands. It is time to build, explore and discover! The wondrous old world holds a lot of mysteries, and you get to be the one to uncover them.

You start with a lonely bonfire and a lot of unexplored lands around you. Uncover the territory around to discover new places to build, supplies to gather, ruins to explore, runestones to study…

Each building in Lost Lands has a function and many open up new ways to interact with the world. Build a lumberjacks shack - now you can chop down the forest tiles for wood. Or cut down thorns blocking your way. Or.. many other things. As you expand, so does your toolbelt.

Each Jarl you start the game with has a personal approach to building the settlement - with unique construction trees, talents and goals. Use their strength to adapt to the situations you find yourself in!

Every playthrough has a unique landscape, environment and climate! As days and nights go by, so will the seasons, each bringing about changes to your town and the surroundings. Each season also comes with its own set of normal, and sometimes bizarre weather conditions. Prepare for the harsh winter, and use the conditions to your advantage.

There is nothing to worry about. You cannot lose the game. Grab hot cocoa, wrap yourself in the blanket, relax, and enjoy the process.

2345960.name: FloCity
2345960.about_the_game:
By learning from the playful connections between desire and time pressure in Amsterdam’s city growth in golden age, FloCity simplify the economic mechanics of energy flow. The way of digging freeform canal networks for run-time AI shipping provides unique perspective and experience for city builder. Cities grow by reforming shorelines, smoothing AI traffic flow, developing plots around the busy ports.


Start canal puzzle...

AI ships transport resources from the sinking donut to the inner ports of the hungry cities. Digging efficient canal network is like solving puzzles for smooth AI traffic.


Build adventure...

Urban-scale valves interact with AI ships, including transformable architectures, changeable corridors, falling sculptures, and more!


Driving economy by AI cargo ships...

FloCity creates a run-time energy loop for growing cities: canal digging for AI ships - accelerating traffic - busy ports - boosting land value around the ports - rising skylines - traffic jams - canal digging… The challenge is to build enough houses before the resource island sinks.


From citizens’ perspective...

A variety of minimalist architectures can be generated, from Mediterranean to Kyoto, from Soviet cities to space. After fast-forward city growth, FloCity provides relaxing inner space of yacht, airship, and space capsule for urban meditating.


The sinking donut reminds us to rethink the relationship between desire and speed of resource consumption.

FloCity is about energy, mass and time.
