2345980.name: CultGame
2345980.about_the_game:
Create your own cult, perform forbidden rituals, and crusade against the filthy non-believers. It's time to play god. CultGame is a retro cult simulator RPG where you start your own cult in a procedurally generated dark fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

Create and customize a cult, where beliefs serve as a system of perks and upgrades

Uniquely generated worlds with their own histories, characters, and factions

4X-strategy gameplay where you conquer the hearts and minds of citizens and insinuate your religion into government

Take control of your cultists to go on missions for religious violence or to ask people out on dates

Perform rituals to give your cult an advantage toward its mission, such as summoning powerful units, or turning your foes inside out and exploding their tibia

2345990.name: My First Grade Fantasy Adventure
2345990.about_the_game:
The Learning Adventure series is back! Are you looking for a fun and interactive way for your child to improve their reading, writing, and math skills? Check out our fun educational game today! Designed specifically for first graders, our game is packed with fun and challenging activities that will keep your child engaged and motivated to learn. Our game's vibrant visuals and upbeat soundtrack combine to create a fun and engaging educational experience that your child is sure to enjoy.

The range of skills and topics addressed by our game is extensive.
👉 Interactive games help first graders reinforce their letter recognition, phonics, and basic reading
👉 Engaging math exercises can support number recognition, counting, basic addition/subtraction
👉 Problem-solving challenges and logical thinking can encourage first graders to think critically
👉 Matching games or sequencing activities, enhance first graders' memory and cognitive skills
👉 Focus on teaching social skills, recognizing emotions, and understanding punctuation marks

Through interactive exercises and games, your child will develop critical thinking skills, problem-solving abilities, and a love of learning that will serve them well throughout their academic journey. We have brought back the coin/reward system to allow parents to monitor their child’s progress. We assure you that your child can be learning safely, free from all ads and aps that collect your private information, and at an accurate level.

This has proven to be fantastic early learning games app for first graders ages 6-8 years old and even for second-graders! See below for just some of what they will learn.

Consonant sounds: First graders learn to recognize and produce the different sounds made by consonant letters in words, helping them develop their reading and phonics skills.

Word families: First graders explore word families, which are groups of words that share the same ending sound or spelling pattern, helping them build their vocabulary and understanding of phonics.

Sequencing Words: First graders practice arranging words in a logical order to create meaningful sentences and stories, developing their comprehension and language skills.

Nouns, Plurals, & Pronouns: First graders learn to identify and use nouns (people, places, things), plurals (more than one), and pronouns (words that replace nouns), improving their grammar and communication skills.

Comparing and Arranging Numbers: First graders learn to compare numbers (greater than, less than, equal to) and arrange them in ascending or descending order, building their number sense and mathematical reasoning.

Time and Money: First graders explore concepts of time (reading clocks, understanding hours, minutes) and money (identifying coins, understanding their values), developing practical skills for everyday life.

Single and Two-Digit Basic Math: First graders learn foundational skills in single-digit addition, subtraction, and begin to work with two-digit numbers, laying the groundwork for further mathematical operations.

Number Patterns: First graders identify, extend, and create patterns using numbers, helping them recognize and predict numerical sequences, fostering critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

Fostering curiosity and love for learning in the second installment of the Early Education series. Interactive and engaging educational games can spark curiosity, ignite a love for learning, and motivate first graders to explore and discover new knowledge and skills.

2346000.name: The Way of Death
2346000.about_the_game:
The Way of Death is a souls-like game set in a world inspired by feudal Japan from the Edo period. Take the challenge in the arcade sword combat system prepared for a group fight in a top-down perspective. Defeat opponents and bosses, explore full of secrets surroundings, and overcome death as you battle in the Afterlife.

MAIN FEATURES

SKILFUL COMBAT SYSTEM
Your sword is the most helpful tool to survive. Learn how to use it and become a better swordsman. You will be surrounded by dangerous monsters many times. The proper tactic is required to beat them. Also, thrilling duels on swords await you. Parry all the hits and beat the enemy.



DEATH IS THE CONTINUATION
Death is an inherent element of the game. After death, fight your way back to life with the new, unique Afterlife mechanic.



MYSTERIOUS WORLD
Walk across mysterious terrain and reveal its secrets. Perhaps, the reality is not as simple as it seems. Do not be afraid to get off the main path; maybe you will find something unexpected.

2346010.name: Neon Magic: Witch shop
2346010.about_the_game:
Neon Magic: Witch shop is a game about developing and operating a witch's shop high in the sky. Adventurers from various worlds need your services. Mutants, robots, anthropomorphic frogs and cats, mushrooms, demons, various heroes, and other fairy tail things will come to your store. Provide them with quality and they will reward you with gold.

The witch's shop not only sells various junk but also offers a range of services such as healing, curse removal, and more.

development:

Develop and improve your store. Upgrade the workshop to produce new goods and expand the store's assortment. Install billboards and expand warehouses. Improve the greenhouse and alchemical laboratory. Do everything to build the best store of all sorts of things in the entire multiverse.

management:

Monitor the quantity of resources and fuel for producing goods. Order ingredients for potions or grow them in your greenhouse. Keep the tower clean and prevent mushrooms, parasites, or curses from appearing. Bargain with customers to make more money or give discounts to increase the store's reputation. Hire assistants who will clean the store or unload goods.

Process ingredients, obtain essences. Experiment to discover new recipes and brew potions in an animated cauldron-demon from another world. Enchant weapons and armor, staffs, grimoires, and scrolls. Create expensive legendary artifacts and animated objects. Become a great potion maker and enchanter.

Only you can choose how to run the business. Become a business shark in the field of selling fantasy junk.

2346140.name: I commissioned some frogs
2346140.about_the_game:
A hidden object game where you must find all the frogs and flies to complete each level.

Key features:

❓1500+ Hidden objects total
🐸750+ Frogs
🪰750+ Flies
🖼️ 15 unique artworks
💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck
♻️ Restore a small number of hidden objects to a painting so you can find them again!
🎵 Music and ambiance for each artwork
⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel
💾 3x save slots
🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again
🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level

Context:

The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many frogs and flies as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 15 art pieces to choose from, and 1500+ hidden objects, you will have a lot of searching to do.

Controls:

Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden object, click it and it will disappear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom.

Difficulty:

A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck.

Get immersed:

Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for everything.

Replayable

You can restore a small number of hidden objects back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few hidden objects left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 3 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

2346150.name: EOL: End Of Line
2346150.about_the_game:
EOL:End of Line is a 4x turn-based strategy game where you fight for control of the System from AI control programs.  Expand your control by sizing System nodes, then exploit those nodes using buildings to extract resources to fuel your expansion and ultimately the extermination of the AI programs.

 

How will you claim the System?

Build a number of different structures and units to help grow your control while balancing resource extraction vs consumption.

 

How will you grow your control?

Distribute your structures across the system to capture unique resource nodes to give your buildings an output boost?

Utilize the games Synergy system by placing the same extraction building next to each other to boost output and create specialized extraction zones?

 

How will you keep your control?

Will you utilize the system topography to create barriers and choke points allowing for your slow heavily armored Tanks to maintain supremacy?

Maybe a system of Portals and Electrical Metallic Tubing to create a network that allows you to quickly deploy units around your territory?

Take the fight to the AI with fast lightly armored Scouts to disrupt the AI’s supply chain starving it of vital resource?

 

On to the next System!

Victory or Defeat it is never the same game twice as each System is generated to be a new and distinct experience.

2346160.name: GachaHell
2346160.about_the_game:
GachaHell


In this breakneck, arcade-style, game, you'll take control of Flow, Macho, and Jade - three idols who were fired from their dream gig for being too... different. But don't count them out just yet - with your help, they'll fight to climb the ranks and become the ultimate 5-star idols!

Choose from three thrilling game modes as you strive to reach the top. But be warned: the competition is fierce and the stakes are high. You'll need to quickly feed weaker idol units to your own to level up and reach a coveted 5-star rating. But if you're not careful, you could end up as level fodder yourself!

The world of this fictional mobile gacha game is not for the faint of heart. It's a cutthroat place where only the highest star idols will survive. Do you have what it takes to lead Flow, Macho, and Jade to their dream in this GachaHell?

Credits


Nickireda - Game Director, Programmer, Designer
BobberWCC - Lead Artist, Animations, Marketing Material
MapleJava - UI Design/Developer, Additional Art
Princess Sylvysprit - Music, Additional SFX
Kobayashi’s Ego - Video Editing, Trailer
DariusSheeno - Video Optimization
Seth_Windam - Ideation/Concept
Grunku - Logo

2346180.name: Final Gun: A Multiplayer Arms Race
2346180.about_the_game:
Experience the ultimate adrenaline-fueled rush with Final Gun - the fast-paced, multiplayer top-down shooter game where your aim and reflexes will be put to the test!



Engage in an epic arms race up to 4 players as you fight for the title of the ultimate gun master. Progress through an arsenal of lethal weapons by taking out your opponents and dominating the arena. Are you ready to take your place at the top of the leaderboard?



With fast-paced gameplay and thrilling matches, Final Gun is the perfect game for all shooter fans.

2346230.name: Ravenwood
2346230.about_the_game:
Ravenwood is a rogue-like survival game with some RPG aspects, survive as long as you can. Grow stronger for every run and advance in the realms of Ravenwood.

BATTLE THE REALMS

As the heroic protector of Ravenwood, you'll explore a vast, enchanting worlds filled with mystical creatures, realms and ancient secrets. Armed with powerful magic, you'll vanquish the forces of darkness and face ever-evolving challenges. Experience dynamic gameplay as you harness the full power of ancient spells, farm for gold, and strengthen your hero through every victory and defeat.

MYSTICAL POWERS

As you gain experience and level up, you'll unlock the ability to upgrade your spells, enhancing their power and versatility. Experiment with different combinations and discover new ways to harness your magical abilities. With every playthrough, you'll encounter different challenges and opportunities, ensuring a fresh and unique experience each time you dive into the Realms.

MADE FOR REPLAYABILITY

With replayability in mind, no two expeditions are ever the same. Before setting out on your next run, you can visit the village merchant. There, you can purchase powerful upgrades and unique items to bolster your hero's abilities. Strategize, enhance your skills, and prepare for the unknown as you dive back into the ever-evolving realms of Ravenwood. Will you rise to the challenge and uncover all the secrets hidden within? The choice is yours!

2346280.name: Don't Be Scared Of The Factory
2346280.about_the_game:
Grab your notepad, your flashlight, and maybe a couple friends, as you embark on a number of treacherous expeditions to close the curtains on a very secretive organisation rumoured to be conducting and creating abominations through the art of human experimentation.



Gather as much evidence as you can while ensuring to stay out of sight to cease operations in this organisation and save future factory workers from becoming nothing more than a memory by exploring the plethora of abandoned factories that were once under the ownership of the institute. Using the journalism skills that you’ve built up for years, walk inside and find absolutely anything and everything that can be used against the organisation and find out the actual truth about just what sort of freaks of nature have been brought into this desolate place by the butcherous organisation - and get this place shut down permanently.



Just make sure to tread carefully when you step through those factory doors, it would be wise to heed the local’s warnings about the figures in the shadows and the eyes that spy around every corner. While the documents on such figures are seemingly incomplete and are claimed to not exist, it would be wise to follow the information they give if you can find them. They know much more than you do, after all.



If you’re ever feeling like your pockets of cash are getting a little too full, why not head down to the shop? You can purchase all kinds of unique little gadgets and trinkets that you can use during your escapades through the darkness. Just be sure to watch your head when the crates come-a knocking!

Don’t be scared of the factory… you haven’t even opened the doors yet.

Wishlist "Don't Be Scared Of The Factory" now to stay up to date on the latest news and updates!

2346290.name: Attack From The Void
2346290.about_the_game:
Shoot them, blow them up, kill them with fire. Explore ships invaded by alien creatures.
Attack From The Void is a top-down shooter with elements of survival horror, where you can only see what the character can see.




Find weapons, ammo, and items that will help you survive. Unlock new areas and rescue any surviving member of the crew.

2346320.name: Astral Guardian
2346320.about_the_game:
In the year 3200, humans on Noahstar engaged in intense battles for survival. They found that only by manufacturing and upgrading various towers could they deal with the invading monsters. These towers were made of a combination of high technology and magic, and could shoot various types of weapons and spells, such as rockets and magic lightning.

Each person had their own responsibilities and tasks. Some people manufactured towers, some researched magic, some managed resources, and some fought. They worked closely together, constantly improving the ability and efficiency of the towers, while also upgrading their own skills to better deal with the increasingly powerful monsters.

As time passed, humans gradually mastered the skills to deal with the monsters. However, just when they felt victory was within reach, the monsters became even stronger and more cunning, keeping humans in a state of constant challenge and progress.

After years of battle, humans finally defeated the invading monsters and achieved victory. However, they also realized that maintaining ecological balance and protecting this beautiful planet was the true challenge. They decided to continue to work hard and strive for a better future.

You can build towers, upgrade towers, delete towers,
LAN connection, multiplayer collaboration, battle,ect.
Monsters will appear in waves within the specified time. Once the life of the player's castle is 0, the game will fail. Max waves of monsters are over, the player's castle life>0, the game wins.
In the battle mode, the player whose castle life is 0 loses, and the other side wins.

2346360.name: Witchy Woes
2346360.about_the_game:
When a power hungry, egotistical young witch disobeys her school’s headmasters, she is cast out and exiled. Play as Devious Donna as she wreaks havoc on those who have wronged her. Harness the dark arts and exact your revenge on the masters of magic.

Witchy Woes is a top-down shooter with a blend of magic & mayhem. Play as Devious Donna, an exiled witch, who seeks revenge on the headmasters of her coven. Harness the power of Dark Magic and begin your reign of terror by destroying those who stand in your way.


Harness the powers of magic and unlock new weapons to continue your reign of terror!

Explore the darkest corners in the world of magic.

Sneak past enemies as you traverse through the witch’s territory, bypass the guards and unleash mayhem!

Destroy those who stand in your way!

Defeat each of the headmasters as you exact your revenge!

Rapid Ryan’s Arcade: Experience a collection of bonus games including Peg Solitaire, Carrot Sweeper & more!

2346370.name: Hentai MatureCat
2346370.about_the_game:
Hentai MatureCat is a relaxing puzzle game.
With the theme of mature cat and 24 unique sexy girls.
Enjoy sexy girls pictures and relaxing music to complete the puzzle.

GamePlay

Swap puzzle pieces to complete levels and unlock more viewing modes.
Watch the full picture after completing the puzzle.

Feature

  • Sexy girls pictures & Relaxing music
  • Fullview mode after completing a level
  • "Enter" key to quickly complete the current level

2346390.name: where is my cat
2346390.about_the_game:
Game features:

Creating a terrifying atmosphere:
The game creates a tense and thrilling atmosphere of horror through exquisite scene design, realistic sound effects, and lighting effects. The abandoned medical school building, gloomy corridors, bloodstained laboratories... every place is filled with danger and unknowns.



Diversified enemy design:
The enemies in the game include various terrifying creatures, ghosts, and mutants. They have different attack methods and abilities, and players need to use wisdom and courage to face their challenges.



Action shooting mechanism:
The game adopts a smooth action shooting mechanism, and players can use various weapons and props to eliminate enemies. At the same time, the game also incorporates action elements such as dodge, dodge, and counterattack, making the battle more exciting and tense.

Simulation and daily life:
The player will play the role of a brave gatekeeper guarding the abandoned medical school, not only facing various threats from terrifying creatures, but also protecting their little black cat and uncovering the terrifying secrets behind the medical school.

2346410.name: Border Pioneer
2346410.about_the_game:
Border Pioneer is a pixel art city-building game that combines survival and defense elements. Fresh from the academy, you must prove your worth by venturing into the frontiers. Face local dangers, manage resources, construct towns, and expand the kingdom's borders into uncharted territories!

Build Your Village

Build Your Town from Scratch

Transform barren lands into bustling settlements! Start with basic structures and gradually unlock new buildings and units as you progress.

Collect And Expand Your Deck!

Build Your Deck!

Choose from over 200 unique cards to construct your perfect deck. Use your cards with skill and timing to overcome challenges and build your town efficiently.


Fend Off Enemy Assaults!

Defend Against Relentless Threats

At the end of each month, enemies will attempt to destroy the town you so carefully built! Fortify your defenses and repel increasingly powerful waves of attackers!

Prove Your Worth as a Pioneer

Manage resources, plan your town's layout, and make crucial decisions to ensure your town's survival and growth.

Border Pioneer offers a unique blend of city-building strategy and defensive gameplay. Can you tame the wild frontier and become the world’s most legendary pioneer?

2346420.name: 屌丝变美女：夺命轮回
2346420.about_the_game:
游戏简介：
《屌丝变美女：夺命轮回》是一款含有搞笑、恐怖和剧情推理的视觉小说。普普通通的外卖骑手刘诞深夜送单被一辆电动车撞倒，醒来之后发现自己变成了漂亮的女生，离奇的是还莫名卷入连环凶杀案，而现在的这副身体就是下一个受害者……


游戏剧情：
我叫刘诞，今年27岁，毕业好几年当过主播、做过代练、写过网文、干过推销，现在是一名光荣的外卖骑手，每天早出晚归努力工作，偶尔与好友撸个串儿、开个黑、刷刷小视频就是我的全部日常。然而，一天夜里刚刚送完单准备收工，突然被一辆电动车撞倒……白开水一般平淡的生活彷佛被倒入滚烫的油锅，奇怪的事情就此展开……


■ 屌丝与美女意外互换身体室友更是冷艳美女；
■ 深夜里收到奇怪的新闻报道发现惊人的秘密；
■ 接连发生多起奸杀案，受害者皆为年轻女性；
■ 互换后的身体莫名成为下一个受害者……
■ 怎样才能保住性命？
■ 杀人凶手究竟是谁？

友情提示：这是一款文字剧情游戏包含一定的惊悚要素，不同的选择最终会影响故事的结局。

单线游戏时长2小时左右，虽然短暂但我认为却是有趣的一段体验。如果大家因为游戏时长短而不能满足的话，可以通过steam进行退款，我依然感谢大家能够花时间体验这款自制的独立游戏。

2346440.name: Ninja Sneaking VS
2346440.about_the_game:
Important: This game requires at least 2 players.
You can play online by using Remote play together.

Asymmetrical competitive action game.

The intruder player aims for the goal at the right end of the screen in each stage.
Points are awarded in the order in which they reach the goal.
The player with the most points at the end of a given stage wins.

One of the players turns to the enemy side to interfere with clearing the stage.
One of the players takes turns to be the tracker for each stage. The player sets traps & manipulates enemy ninjas to prevent them from interfering with the player.


The number of traps in a stage changes depending on the difficulty level.
The number of traps is 30. The number of traps changes for each stage.
You can enjoy different combinations each time!
2346440.supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish - Spain

2346450.name: Rhythm Rabbit
2346450.about_the_game:
Gameplay

In Rhythm Rabbit, you move automatically on the beat of the music, but the amount of steps (shown by the number of notes) changes on each move. You will have to quickly decide on which way to go, as the rabbit won't stop moving on the beat. The goal of each stage is to get to the carrot.


Features

  • 4 themed worlds to hop through
  • Wide range of enemies and environmental challenges
  • Incredibly challenging boss stages
  • Unlockable skins and soundtracks
  • Played with controller, mouse, keyboard or touchscreen
  • Also playable without sound

2346470.name: All Goblin
2346470.about_the_game:
You are a goblin, an alien species recently brought to the brink of extinction. You must find your way out of the temple, turned prison, by any means necessary.
Find strange creatures, obscure and hidden secrets. Bring honor to your goblin ancestors!

.

  • Explore the temple mega-structure by opening shortcuts leading back to where you started, allowing for easy traversal through the building.
  • Unlock upgrades to make your journey easier.
  • Use your trusty automatic slingshot to stay safe from those that wish to catch you.
  • Make sure you are prepared for the final battle.


Other Features:
  • Giant tower with a generator powering a single elevator
  • Funny little names for each area
  • Jumping puzzles
  • Future updates to the game, it's an ever expanding creature

*Many goblins were harmed in the making of this game, don't let their sacrifice be in vain.*

Move: WASD
Run: Left Shift
Aim: Right Mouse Button
Pick up objects while aiming by pressing E
Fire With Left Mouse Button While Aiming

2346490.name: Loop
2346490.about_the_game:
Loop is a fun puzzle game that will exercise your brain! Get lost in a world of grid systems and colorful stones. Your goal is to move the stones up, down, left, and right to place them in their correct positions. But be careful, each stone moves at the same time, and if there is no grid cell available in the direction it needs to go, it will be teleported to the opposite side of the grid!




With its minimal graphics and enjoyable music, Loop provides a calming atmosphere that will envelop you. If you want to exercise your brain and experience a new puzzle game, Loop is just for you!
2346490.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Spanish - Spain

2346500.name: Desert Island in Summer?
2346500.about_the_game:
Hikaru sets off for a fun-filled summer vacation at his university's club retreat. However, a sudden fierce storm blows in, causing their boat to drift off course, leading to them being stranded. Will Hikaru be able to make a girlfriend before they manage to escape this predicament?

  • Adventure Game

  • Pixel Art

  • Pure Love Story

  • Conversation Only, No Combat

  • Includes Mini-Games
2346500.supported_languages: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

2346510.name: Rainbowcore Hypernova
2346510.about_the_game:
Welcome to Rainbowcore Hypernova, the explosively fun and absurd fighting game experience!

  • Choose from seven vibrant and colorful characters, each representing a different color of the rainbow.
  • Master the easy-to-learn controls with just three buttons and a variety of motion inputs.
  • Engage in fast-paced and dynamic battles with a unique arsenal of moves for every character.
  • Immerse yourself in a banger soundtrack that blends epic music with absurd mouth noises.
  • Explosive visuals set against the backdrop of a surreal underground mushroom cave.
  • Connect with other players seamlessly through peer-to-peer rollback netcode gameplay.
  • Best of all, Rainbowcore Hypernova is completely free to play!

Join the Rainbowcore Hypernova community and unleash your inner fighter. Show off your skills and become the ultimate Rainbowcore Hypernova champion!

Epilepsy warning: This game contains many flashing images and animations

2346530.name: Foresia -The Lust Curse-
2346530.about_the_game:
STORY


Foresia is a rare High Elf living in the Spirit Tree Forest.
Suddenly, monsters set fire to her village and Foresia is captured and enslaved. With the help of the spirit, she manages to escape but is plagued by a curse she cannot resist.
In order to break free from her unjust situation, Foresia travels to the village of Crossleven, accepting quests from the guild, gathering information, honing her skills, and seeking the truth...

GAME PLAY

This game is an action game with a simple "automatic aiming" feature.
In the action part, the screen displays a top-down diagonal view. Move Foresia skillfully to achieve victory.
Use "bow and arrow," "homing magic," and "ultimate magic" to attack.
Use "shield magic" to defend.

2346540.name: Amulet of Iovar
2346540.about_the_game:
Description

For eons, the ancient wizard Iovar has sought godhood. In his never-ending quest, he's built a huge dungeon full of critters big and small. Now, hes finally crafted an amulet worthy of gods.

You, along with many others, have heard of Iovars mission. Time has come, as you and a colorful cast of critters strike to steal godhood from under Iovars nose. Delve deep into the Dungeon of Iovar, and prove godhood is rightfully yours!

Features

  • Fully randomly generated dungeon
  • 8 Classes to play
  • 90+ Monsters to fight, including 6 powerful bosses
  • 30+ Weapons to wield
  • 60+ Armor pieces to wear
  • 200+ Items to use
  • Cast spells by mixing and matching different spell elements and types
  • Manage your hunger and weight
  • Use potions, scrolls, wands and other items
  • Enchant gear for additional strength
  • Unlock information about items and critters with Tomes of knowledge

2346550.name: Rise of Eros
2346550.about_the_game:
At the dawn of the world, two originary deities were created from humanity's most primal desires: the god Eros and the goddess Aphrodite. With the development of civilization, the flourishing of different desires and drives led to the birth of more and more deities, and eventually erupted in a Great War of the Gods. Eros emerged victorious, yet his betrayal at the hands of Aphrodite left him sealed away inside an ancient Relic, and the world abandoned to an age of godlessness.



Several millennia later, various civilizations have flowered on the continent of Dienne, tenaciously clinging on in the absence of protection by the deities. While searching for a way to bring her boyfriend back to life, Inase, a scholar of ancient societies, accidentally breaks the seal and awakens Eros. To reclaim his powers and piece together his fragmented memories, he sets out on a journey with his newfound concubines…



[AAA: The Next Generation in Adult Gaming]

Rise of Eros is the world's first AAA-tier adult game. Each goddess's lifelike expressions and skin textures are rendered with the use of high-spec character modeling and a bespoke shader.

Each charming goddess is waiting for you to conquer her, whether in uniform, corsets, or fancy dress. Stir up their passions and experience otherwordly pleasures.



[Easy to Pick Up: Thrillingly Smooth Combat]

Whether adventuring through the story or hacking away in Boss battles, the combat is designed to be intuitive and responsive. Unleash earth-shaking special moves and dominate the battlefield.



[Do It Your Way: Build Your Party]

You'll get to know goddesses with unique powers throughout your adventures. Face each new challenge by working out your strongest party and gear combos and creating your own combat style. Claim exclusive Relics to boost the power of your Ultimate skills and turn the tables on your enemies.



[360-Degree Angles: Explore Your Goddesses' Favorite Positions]

Cultivate Intimacy with your goddesses and you'll find them in steamy scenes where you can freely adjust the pacing and angles, come to understand what turns them on, and uncover their favorite positions to discover joys that transcend the mortal realm.

*Please note that game accounts registered on different platforms are not interchangeable or transferable.

2346560.name: D.C.K.: Dock Chess King
2346560.about_the_game:
Attention Chess players! Are you looking for a new challenge? Look no further than Dock Chess King! This exciting game provides hundreds of days to test your strategic thinking. With easy-to-use features and intuitive design, anyone can become a Chess King in no time.




  • Challenge your tactical skills with a fun and addictive chess puzzle.
  • Experience the thrill of improving your dock.
  • Survive hordes of boss wishes while control ships, cargos and puzzle.
  • Develop your dock until you can retire as Dock Chess King!




Revolutionary game about Chess Puzzle! Test your skills in this brain-boosting game and challenge yourself. Whether you're a beginner or a grandmaster, don't miss this opportunity to sharpen your chess moves and become the ultimate Chess King. Get ready to get hooked on this amazing game!

2346570.name: Songs of Life
2346570.about_the_game:
In the late Eastern Han Dynasty, a mysterious illness ravages the land, bringing continuous disasters and wars. In such dire times, death may seem like a blessing. Enter a girl who claims to be the true Hua Tuo, the renowned physician Zhang Zhongjing who longs for peace, and Dong Feng, the medical master behind Qing Nang Shu and Shanghan Lun. These three individuals, each from different walks of life, unite on a tumultuous journey, their fates intertwined. After enduring great sorrow and sacrifice, can they uncover the truth and stop the mastermind behind the calamities?

Experience a card-driven narrative adventure, engaging puzzle-solving mini-games, and rich lore explanations that delivers a deeply immersive storytelling experience.

Throughout your journey, you will treat a variety of patients and navigate the world of figures like Cao Cao and Yuan Shao, biding your time to unveil the massive conspiracy lurking behind the epidemic.
2346570.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

2346580.name: Sentimental Death Loop
2346580.about_the_game:
※All characters involved in sexual content are over the age of 18.

＜About＞

Just as you begin to settle in for a fun day at your best friend's house, something changes in her and she kills you. And not just once—she ends your life time and time and time again.
Your goal is to escape from this endless loop of despair.

＜SYSTEM＞

■Jump through time to change your destiny!

The investigation portions of the game are rendered in three-quarter view.
Work toward your escape by searching rooms for the items and clues needed to solve puzzles and disarm traps. Time travel to obtain new, useful information capable of changing your destiny.
Your goal is to use the methods available to you and escape the never-ending loop of death.

■Your dear friend stalks toward you with a knife.Use the items at your disposal to escape!

Nemu may try to corner you while you're investigating a room.
Use the items around you to stop her and make your escape, otherwise you'll be killed and sent back in time!

■How many times must you be robbed of hope?!
Your actions will lead you to a number of different endings.
However, it seems like only sadness and despair await you each and every time. Will you really manage to escape this cycle of death?!

CHARACTER

2346650.name: PUYM : Lake
2346650.about_the_game:
Pick Up Your Masks : Lake proposes you to manage to throw FFP masks in a trash can.

Mimi the cat is waiting for you to tell him when to throw the masks. You'll have to think and solve the puzzles that are found throughout 100 levels and pass each challenge that 12 communities offer you.

You have to click on the paw in the bottom right corner of the screen to drop each mask. Avoid the obstacles or use them to break the record for each level.

If you manage to succeed in the 96 accessible challenges, you will reveal the last 4 levels in the middle of the lake.

Good luck to you!

2346660.name: DFHack - Dwarf Fortress Modding Engine
2346660.about_the_game:
DFHack is an add-on for Dwarf Fortress (search for it here on Steam!) that enables mods and tools to significantly extend the game. The default DFHack distribution contains a wide variety of these tools, including bugfixes, interface improvements, automation agents, design blueprints, modding building blocks, and more. Third-party tools (e.g. mods downloaded from Dwarf Fortress Steam Workshop or the forums) can also seamlessly integrate with the DFHack framework and extend the game far beyond what can be done by just modding the raws.

DFHack’s mission is to provide tools and interfaces for players and modders to:

  • expand the bounds of what is possible in Dwarf Fortress
  • reduce the impact of game bugs
  • give the player more agency and control over the game
  • provide alternatives to toilsome or frustrating aspects of gameplay
  • make the game more fun

Our online Quickstart Guide (see the "View the website" link in the sidebar) will help you get up to speed with how to use DFHack. It's also available in-game via the quickstart-guide command.

The best way to make feature requests or report problems is to open an Issue on our GitHub issue tracker (see the "Stats" link in the sidebar).

When reporting problems, links to your zipped, uploaded savegame and mods are immensely helpful, and issues with attached savegames and mods get fixed faster. We need a zip of your mods because we can't load your savegame without them.

DFHack installs directly into your Dwarf Fortress directory, so be sure to install it to the same Steam library and drive as Dwarf Fortress. If you are on Linux, both games must also have the same "Compatibility" setting (e.g. "Steam Linux Runtime 1.0 (scout)").

It is not a problem if you already have DFHack manually installed and are switching to Steam. You can subscribe to the Steam version and it will absorb the installed files. Your saved DFHack configuration in the dfhack-config directory is safe. No additional steps are necessary.

2346710.name: Protolife: Other Side
2346710.about_the_game:
Protolife: Other Side - is arcade game which can also be called as "reverse tower defense". You have to lead squads of alien creatures though the ever-growing defense line on miltiple locations. The more creatures you save the easier it will be to reach the main goal: find the interplanet transport and evacuate.

Plot

One year passed since Protolife game events. Mankind started colonization of new planet. It was called Planet of Leonov (aka Leo-Nóva). The alien biotechnologies was found on this planet too. But this time the alien core was found and blasted with orbital strike, avoiding heavy ground combat.
Alien overseer who also acts as backup core decides to evaculate survived creatures from planet. He's scared. Scared not of humans.

Features

  • 5 species of creatures with own abilities
  • 4 common abilities
  • 6 zones with different level architecture
  • partially destructible landscape
  • familiar towers and buildings from original Protolife (as enemies this time)
  • new towers and buildings
  • each level must be beaten several times in order to evacuate as much creatures as possible. Each attempt is harder than the previous one.
  • special missions which affect the other levels

Controls

Keyboard, keyboard+mouse or gamepad. You directly control leader's movement, other creature follow the leader. Also you may activate one of the abilities for the whole squad.

2346730.name: Day at the Races
2346730.about_the_game:
Although luck plays a part in this game, each horse and jockey commence with their own randomly generated attributes and skills which change accordingly as the game progresses. Other factors such as track conditions, distances, barrier positions, the health and fitness, running style and determination of each horse, together with your ability to “pick a winner” will influence the outcome of each race.

The aim of this arcade-style horse racing game is to win enough money to purchase, maintain and enter your horse in the prestigious Day at the Races Cup, held on the 5th race of the final day.

GOOD LUCK!

Features:

* Races held on 5 different track surfaces over a variety of distances.

* 5 races per day with a choice of a 10, 20 or 30 day simulated event.

* Study the form guide for upcoming races, as well as horse and jockey career statistics to help you "pick a winner".

* Will you be tempted to risk using illegal means to win a race?

* Buy or sell your horse at auctions.

* Enter your horse in, and attempt to win the prestigious "Day at the Races" cup to secure your place in horse racing history.

**NOTE**

PLEASE CHECK YOUR DISPLAY SETTINGS

This game cannot be played on monitor resolutions lower than 1920 x 1080 and Windows display scaling must be set to 100%

2346760.name: Inpulse
2346760.about_the_game:
You are Flute, a shapeshifting creature who plays music to move. Collect Notes Like Ammo and fire them outwards to move through the air.

Collect notes to fill your octave.

Play notes to move. Hit them to move again.

7 Notes, 7 Movesets.

Each of the 7 notes has its own unique movement mechanic, tone, and color. Note effects stack with one another. Evey note order determines a different melody and a different move sequence, allowing for deep combos and complex routing through levels.

Music Driven Design

Experience a single evolving piece of music as the level progresses in a multi-genre fusion inspired soundtrack. Every level unlocks a little bit more of the song

Sight-read and Sight-hear Platform Challenges

Notes harmonize to the music — hear what went wrong before seeing how it played out. Evey sound effect dynamically adjusts to what the music is doing, so you can hear correct and incorrect inputs.

Notes are color coded interconnected — every mechanic in the game is integrated in a single color-language, which you decipher more of as you play.


Quicksaves and Quickloads:

Never get stuck in a level. Inpulse comes with emulator-style savestates which load instantaneously. Saves are mapped to your controller by default and increment automatically so that you never have to worry about overwriting past progress.

Input Playback:

Read levels like music. Every level comes with a full replay and a DDR-style input screen teaching you how to play.

Builtin TAS Support:

Record your own replays and send them to your friends. Speed them up or slow them down to learn from them. Replays are fully compatible with savestates and will splice together to create a perfect run.

The Game Is the Level Editor:

Pause the game at any moment and modify the level. The game is the editor, unlocking new features as you progress through the game.

Photoshop-Style Layer Support

Separate Levels into Photoshop-style layers which move and can be drawn upon independently. Export levels into an image, draw ontop of it, and hotload it back into the game on the fly.

Autotune the game to Your Music

Add a song to your level file and specify the musical scale. Every sound effect in the game will adjust to match the composition.

Built by Kaizo Veterans:

Designed with love by early founders in the kaizo scene. Playtested by a roster of world-record holders and esport veterans. We want you to experience kaizo like we did, and we want you to succeed at it.

2346780.name: ALL IN THE GAME: Crime Strategy
2346780.about_the_game:
BECOME THE NUMBER ONE KINGPIN

ALL IN THE GAME is a turn-based strategy and management game where you start off with a small criminal gang to become the dominant criminal empire controlling the entire city. Claim your very own street corner, start expanding your territories, become rich through illegal means and launder your money by investing into (more or less) legit businesses.

But remember – the streets have fierce competition and other gangs will try to beat you to it – to make sure they know their place, send out your gangsters to teach them a painful lesson, robbing them of their hard-earned cash or burning down their buildings!

FEATURES

  • Three breeds of criminals – Recruit fierce Soldiers, money-smart Middlemen and tech-savvy Experts to do your bidding.

  • Choose your path – Do you want to become the most infamous street gang in the city or stay under the radar? Are you in it for the money or the respect? Will you cooperate with the authorities or rise against them? The choice is up to you!

  • Gang warfare – If other players get cocky, pay them a visit with a baseball bat or get some real firepower from the black market.

  • Claim the corners – A crime gang is nothing without a turf of their own - use your gang members capture territory that earns you cash through protection money.

  • Expand – Invest the ill-gotten gains from robberies and drug trade to buildings, then fill them with drug labs, smuggling rings and other criminal enterprises.

  • Beat the system – Can't hide all that blood money between the couch cushions? No problem - launder your dirty cash by investing it on legit businesses and the authorities will be none the wiser!

  • Lightning-fast multiplayer – ALL IN THE GAME features both online and hot-seat multiplayer for up to 8 players. Have a chill game with your friends or use the turn timer to ensure that the flow of the game doesn't get interrupted.

2346810.name: Scholar's Mate - First Move
2346810.about_the_game:
In Scholar's Mate First Move you will play as Judith, a young college student who was going back home after finishing the semester. After waking up disoriented in an abandoned hospital room, she will try to escape and get back home safe. Exploration and ingenuity will be your only chance to get out of this strange and dark place alive.

Will you succeed?





  • A first-person horror experience in the purest "EscapeRoom" style.
  • Investigate, think and solve.
  • Original voices and music.
2346810.supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

2346840.name: One-Eyed Likho
2346840.about_the_game:
Don’t Go Looking For Evil, You May Find The Likho…

One-Eyed Likho is a mystical first-person horror adventure in which you have to find Likho and escape your own evil fate.

Features

  • Folk horror – Explore a game world inspired by a Slavic fairy-tale recorded in the early 19th century

  • Story-focused exploration – Progress through the game to uncover secrets and learn the whole truth

  • Unique style - A captivating world rendered in mesmerizing greyscale

  • Burn mechanics – Solve fire-based puzzles and light your way with matches

Authentic fairy tale

The game is inspired by the Slavic fairy tale “The One-eyed Likho”. Likho, is an embodiment of evil fate and misfortune in Slavic mythology, a creature with one eye, often depicted as an old, skinny woman in black (Лихо одноглазое, One-eyed Likho).

Grim, dark, folk horror

Embark on an exhilarating journey through a haunting realm brought to life from a forgotten Slavic fairy tale of the 19th century. Immerse yourself in a captivating world rendered in mesmerizing greyscale.

Find Likho and escape your own evil fate

Explore, investigate, and solve puzzles to progress and uncover the secrets to learn the whole truth.
2346840.supported_languages:
English, Russian*, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Polish, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

2346870.name: The Big Lez Video Game
2346870.about_the_game:
This is the official Big Lez Video Game, a 3rd and 1st person shooter with the original Big Lez Show locations and characters.

The current playable game modes are: deathmatch, battle royale, free roam and infected (campaign and other game modes will also be coming in the future).

You can play as Big Lez, Mike Nolan, Donny, Sassy, Clarence, Warning Guy, King Laranox and even a choomah! Every character has two specific special abilities that can be used during combat (such as Mike Nolans super exhale or Lez's stealth mode), use these to get the upper hand against other players. This game also features a variety of guns and the possibility to create your own preferred loadout.

Lastly the game features plenty of easter eggs from the show, so keep an eye out and see what you can find!

2346880.name: Multiverse GO
2346880.about_the_game:
Multiverse GO is a turn-based puzzle adventure set in a group of multiple universes. You can explore the multiverse and face challenges. The game focuses on forward thinking to progress through levels.

In Multiverse GO, you’ll experience :





- Challenging puzzles that put your skills to the test.
- Fight or go peacefully, overcome the different types of enemies.
- Complete all levels and unlock new universes.
- Different, alive, and intriguing environments.
- Powerful unique bosses in each different universe.

Collect all the cases and learn all the secret information about the multiverse

2346890.name: Bananaguy
2346890.about_the_game:
You know what would be cool? A banana in gold of course! :O And so Bananaguy set out to find the legendary golden banana...

Bananaguy is about exploring goofy and playful worlds collecting "Power Coins" along the way which are used to travel to new worlds. Each coin features its own little bizzare adventure.

Content

  • Three colorful, funny and diverse worlds with goofy ahh inhabitants, nonsensical adventures and many secrets
  • 80+ Power Coins to collect! Each one offering a unique experience!
  • Banan! :O

2346900.name: Bonds of Unity
2346900.about_the_game:
Take arms and launch toward the various lands of Riostea! Bonds of Unity is a fast-paced first-person shooter where synergy between different kinds of weapons is needed to take down various-sized enemies. Comes with a challenging single-player experience with brutal enemies, bizarre weapons, and fast movements to provide an intense first-person shooter experience that requires both quick reflexes and continuous shooting. Whether you explore the various lands of Riostea or go straight for a head-to-head fight against bosses, you will constantly unlock weapons and equipment for various actions, such as dealing damage, crowd control, movement enhancement, or buffing other weapons. You can also create your very own gun to use in-game and share it with other players using the weapon creation tool!

GAMEPLAY:
An all-out shooting experience with no stopping or taking cover. Defeating enemies is the only way to recover health, encouraging an offensive gameplay. The synergy between the guns in your loadout is necessary, as straight-up shooting an enemy might not be viable or effective; you might need to stun enemies, lure them to a trap you've set up, charge a weapon for massive burst damage, or even use the environment's different hazards for your advantage. Think of it as Doom 2016, but with less gore and more spontaneous strategies.

STORY: Riostea, a distant and unusual planet, is made of countless floating islands. No two islands are alike; they all have distinct environments and inhabitants. Utopia, an infamous island on Riostea, is known for its most wanted quirk: blessing its inhabitants with peace. but after centuries of its existence, Utopia has been cut to pieces by greedy leaders of various other islands who want to live upon it all by themselves. Each has taken a piece and fused it with their own island. With no one else having the necessary fighting skills to take down these leaders and reunite Utopia in one piece, this leaves you as Utopia's last and only hope.

2346930.name: Clueless Crosswords
2346930.about_the_game:
Overview

Clueless Crosswords is a fresh take on the traditional crossword puzzle. In the absence of clues you can complete the puzzles using any words you like (as long as they fit in the puzzle grid). However, you can only use each word once on any given puzzle, even on subsequent replays, making each replay more difficult to complete than the last.

Gameplay

In Clueless Crosswords you attempt to complete crossword puzzles without the aid of clues. You can use any words you like to complete the puzzle, but the more words you add the harder it becomes to think of new words that will fit around the letters that are already in play.

Once a word has been used it cannot be used again on that puzzle, even on subsequent replays, which makes each replay harder to complete than the last.

Complete puzzles to earn stars, which in turn unlock more puzzles for you to play.

Are you smart enough to be completely clueless...?

2346980.name: Magic Bean🍃
2346980.about_the_game:
Magic Bean

This is the ultimate test of skill and determination : 🫘Magic Bean🍃 , an intense platformer❕

Each level is designed to push the limits of your abilities, with precision timing and quick
reflexes required to overcome the obstacles in your path. With mind-bending level design, and increasing difficulty,
Magic Bean will keep you on the edge of your seat as you strive to reach new heights.

This game is only for the players looking for a real chalenge, it's super hard and there is no mercy❕⚔️💀

Climbing


In Magic Bean you have to jump from platform to platform to reach the next stage, but be careful: if you fall you have to start again, so don't confuse speed with precipitation !

Upgrade


You can unlock teleporters, buy tools, improve them and improve your character.
Choose wisely, because your choices can greatly influence your success.

Tools


There are tools that are like skills that can be unlocked and can be a great help in your climb.

Hard Challenge

Good luck, you will need it❗

2347000.name: Panzer Party
2347000.about_the_game:
Welcome to Panzer Party!


Ever wondered what tanks do in their free time? Now you know, THEY PARTY.

Fight your way through various maps against online players in this epic top down physical shooter.

Features

  • Top down physics driven shooting
  • Up to 8 player Steam Direct multiplayer
  • Various levels and game modes
  • Tank customization, express yourself with your own unique tank
  • Levels that adapt according to the music playing

2347030.name: Princess Survivors
2347030.about_the_game:
• Princess Petorine takes back the castle.
  • The wizard Melona pursues her master.
  • The kunoichi Kuno chases after the stolen Book of Secrets.
  • Rosalie, the dark elf who protects the elf village.
Each of the four protagonists has a story to tell.


Strengthen your skills by defeating enemies and shopping in a shop!
Even if you don't have any money, you can still shop by part-time job.

Prorogue

Princess Petorine wakes up with a great tremor.
A curse overflows the sealed door and possesses the soldiers.
She escapes from the castle in the nick of time and meets companions who help her.
The adventure to reclaim the castle begins.

2347040.name: RC Revolution
2347040.about_the_game:
Experience the Thrill of RC Revolution!

Welcome to the exhilarating world of radio-controlled car racing, where unforgettable moments of intense immersion await you! The game seamlessly combines strategy, skill, and speed to offer an experience that stands as a timeless classic in the realm of competitive racing.

Multiplayer Mayhem and Cooperative Gameplay

Dive into the heart-pounding multiplayer mayhem with a wide array of competitive and cooperative modes. Race against your friends or team up with them to share victory on a split screen. Each race presents an opportunity to push your limits and climb the ranks in our rewarding progression system!

Variety of Cars, Tracks, and Customization Options

Choose from a diverse collection of cars and tracks, each with its own unique challenges and characteristics! Customize your car to suit your racing style and witness firsthand how it affects your performance on the track.

Easy to Pick Up, Difficult to Master

Our game strikes the perfect balance between accessibility and challenge! With realistic and aesthetic physics, a variety of gameplay options, and a relentless focus on fun, we cater to both casual gamers and seasoned veterans. Enjoy exhilarating drifts, power slides, overtaking maneuvers, crashes, and collisions as you hone your skills on the track!

Replayability with a Creative Track Builder

The fun doesn’t stop at just racing! Unleash your creativity with our intuitive and customizable track builder. Design your own tracks, complete with clever obstacles and hazards. Set up your own championship events using our championship editor, adding to the replayability and competitive spirit of the game.
2347040.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian

2347080.name: Frosthaven
2347080.about_the_game:
From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN!

An evolution of the FROSTHAVEN board game experience, the dark fantasy tactical RPG serves as a spiritual successor to Gloomhaven and is developed by Snapshot Games. Players can expect deep mechanics and challenging yet immensely satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer. Seasoned veterans of the original board game or Gloomhaven will feel right at home venturing into the unforgiving and treacherous northern frontier of FROSTHAVEN. Newcomers can start their first adventure with difficulty modes tailored to their skill level. Improved UX and quality-of-life features will ensure all players can enjoy their experience.

The brand-new character classes, each featuring unique playstyles and abilities, makes it so that every decision matters. Players must balance risk and reward, working towards the best synergies between the classes comprising their party. Carefully managing resources is paramount to progress through a gripping campaign, set in a vast world filled with menacing enemies and diverse environments.

FEATURES

  • UNIQUE CHARACTERS - Choose from six starting character classes—including the Banner Spear, Boneshaper, Drifter, Geminate, Blinkblade, and Deathwalker

    • Additional classes will be unlocked as you progress your campaign

    • Each class features its own unique abilities and playstyle to master

  • DEEP, TACTICAL COMBAT - Engage in deep, tactical turn-based combat, testing your skills against an array of new enemies and formidable bosses

    • Utilize an ability card system that requires careful planning to unleash devastating attacks, execute powerful combos, and try keeping your party members alive

  • BUILD YOUR OUTPOST - Manage the Outpost, constructing and upgrading various buildings, unlocking new game features and mechanics

  • A STUNNING WORLD TO EXPLORE – A stunning art style, highly detailed models and textures, and expressive animations all bring the world of FROSTHAVEN to life

    • Be ready to explore diverse biomes, changing seasons, and dynamic environments as your adventure progresses

  • AN EVER-GROWING EXPERIENCE - The Early Access release launches with 35+ quests across Acts 1 and 2, with over 130 total quests planned for the campaign as development continues

    • The included Tutorial allows both new and old players to get accommodated with the basic mechanics and gameplay

  • CO-OP ONLINE MULTIPLAYER – FROSTHAVEN supports 2-4 players so you can play with your friends anywhere and at any time

2347090.name: Landline
2347090.about_the_game:
Prevent murder cases with the rotary dial telephone. You can only make one call per turn.



It was a peaceful evening, until you realize there's a murderer in the hotel on the other side of the street.

Now, you need to use your telephone to prevent a catastrophe. Distract the murderer by calling the hotel's staffs, guests, and visitors. Who and where to call is entirely up to you.

Each person in the hotel will react differently to your call. You can ask hotel staffs for room service, call guests to the reception, etc. Keep the victims away from the murderer's sight.

Landline is a puzzle thriller that lets you use your own solutions.

2347120.name: My Kingdom for the Princess
2347120.about_the_game:
The very first of its kind game based on Casual Strategy and Time-management!

Leading the main character player moves along the progress map, completing levels to achieve the main goal of the game, due to the plot. Tasks includes the repair of objects of the territory, creating of new ones to restore the Kingdom, crafting, building, collect and use the resources, and more.
It's a click-play game, but it's not that simple: you have to think through your actions in order to succeed!

It's up to you, Arthur, a brave knight, to restore the land and escort Princess Helen back to her father, King Olgert :
One day Princess Helen traveled across the lands to visit her uncle King Sigmund. The king was eating and waxing nostalgic, when all of a sudden... A tornado came and wrecked havoc on the lands. Animals, houses, and even people flew through the air. King Sigmund's castle somehow withstood the storm. But his troubles had only just begun.. The tornado woke Firemouth the dragon, who, according to legend, could not sleep until he ate 37 people. The legend might be wrong, but the dragon had already eaten eight people, and didn't seem the least bit ready to go back to sleep.
And what's more, Princess Helen found out that during the tornado, her father, King Olgert, had been struck by lightning. Nobody knew whether he would live or die. She needed to return home immediately but all the roads were in ruins, the hamlets were destroyed, and a hungry dragon circled over the land.
Arthur, a knight famed for his wit and courage, answered duty's call. Not only would he have to escort the princess, but he would also have to restore the ruined lands. King Sigmund promised him a shiny new castle as a reward for successfully completing the quest.
But everyone knows that good knights don't care about rewards. They are only concerned with heroic deeds and love!

Main game-features:
- a skillful combination of time-management, casual simulator and strategy
- more than 50 levels in 4 fabulous locations
- addictive mini-games
- excellent graphic performance
- hard working employees
- a variety of game tasks
- romantic fairy tale story

Restore the fairy Kingdom and find out how the romantic adventure will end!

2347180.name: Cat & Gold
2347180.about_the_game:
Synopsis
In order to protect the peace of the cats, you (the cat) have been ordered to retrieve the gold nuggets from the evil dog.
Throw koban to punish the bad dog, retrieve the gold nuggets placed in the buildings, and escape in a balloon!
Sneak into various buildings and use gimmicks and equipment to accomplish your mission!
You (the cat) are the only one who can restore peace to the cats!

Overview
The game is a side-scrolling 3D action game. You can move forward, backward, left and right, jump, and throw gold (koban).
The purpose of this work is for players to collect gold nuggets and clear all stages within the time limit.

Game features
・Collect gold nuggets and escape. Please enjoy the gestures of cute cats.
・There are 10 stages. There is a high difficulty mode.
・ You can buy items at the shop with cat food that can be picked up in the game. It can be strengthened with a cat, so you can easily capture it.
・There is an additional mode to change the player character.

highlighted.name: Clear normal difficulty with the cat.

highlighted.localized_name: Clear hard difficulty with the cat.
highlighted.name: Clear hard difficulty with the cat.

highlighted.name: Clear normal difficulty with the dog.

2347190.name: Lunar Legacy
2347190.about_the_game:
Unjustly accused of a terrible crime, Soyeon finds herself in the Kingdom of Spirits. She cannot return home, and a cruel punishment looms ahead: death. How will she survive in a strange and incomprehensible world? How much can one trust the suspiciously friendly spirits? From whom should she seek support—the beautiful and mysterious moon prince or the sarcastic but charming dokkaebi?


The sarcastic dokkaebi is clearly not thrilled with Soyen's presence, but despite this, he's always there to help...even if he doesn't miss an opportunity to let another caustic comment loose. Can she trust someone who has trapped her in a strange and unfamiliar world, or are his motives more complex than they first appear?


The handsome prince of the Moon Kingdom is always polite and courteous, showing true sympathy for Soyeon. But is his sincerity to be trusted? What lurks behind the dragon prince's friendly mask?



- 2 love interests with full English voiceover
- 2 routes revealing the story from different angles
- More than 10 unique illustrations
- Interactive elements and hidden object scenes

Visual Novel, Otome.
2347190.supported_languages:
English*, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain
*languages with full audio support

2347200.name: CETERIS Paribus
2347200.about_the_game:
Kai is in big trouble! Economics homework is due tomorrow and it’s too late to study. Luckily, Professor Pavlos lives right next door! Pavlos will not only help Kai complete their homework on time, but also explain economics practically, through the different ways it affects our lives.

Follow Kai across Pavlos’ house, discovering pieces of the old professor’s life in every room. Each piece teaches Kai something new about economics, in a simple and contextual way. Complete all rooms and finish Kai’s homework and you too will know the basics of economics!

In Ceteris Paribus you will:


  • Navigate a charming environment built in Unreal Engine;
  • Experience a combination of classic point-and-click adventure and hidden object games;
  • Discover open and secret rooms in Pavlos’ house, filled with memories and references to real historical events;
  • Learn more about economics in a fun way, maybe understanding terms such as “inflation” and “cryptocurrency” for the first time;
  • Decide for yourself if Pavlos is really a vampire or not.

Kai is anxiously awaiting your help!

2347210.name: They Bite!
2347210.about_the_game:
Can you survive amongst the nibbly creatures you find yourself surrounded by after a recent chemical spill in the area?

Take on the challenge for staving off the undead using a variety of weaponry, all in the glorious first-person perspective. Share the fun with up-to 4 of your buddies and see who can smash the most Zeds to shreds! If you can survive until extraction is available, then you get to keep the loot!

Two Game Modes


They Bite! offers two modes for taking on the undead - in the Arcade Mode mode you and upto 3 friends can try to survive until you are able to extract from the area, fighting off endless attackers across a variety of interesting maps. Gain points and experience to unlock new paths and areas in each map, and uncover the secrets and missions hidden throughout for a real challenge (and a reward for your efforts of course)

In the single-player Adventure mode (coming soon), you take on the Zeds and explore at your leisure travelling from map-to-map to gain resources to help survive for as long as you can in the world.

Progression and Rewards


Both you're avatar and your weaponry can all be improved as you gain experience. Level up your stats to make you faster, stronger and tougher than before. In addition, gain proficiency with each weapon through gameplay, meaning as you gain experiencing using a weapon, you can increate its stats such as range, damage, ammo capacity etc to help you take on the Zeds, and win!

Grow your arsenal


You start off with your trusty pistol and an axe, but you will find weapons to rent scattered around the maps and once you have enough money, you can purchase new, better guns and equipment to help you out next time.

2347280.name: Usurper
2347280.about_the_game:
Push your King forward to play your cards on the front lines. Stockpile your Power to afford expensive and powerful units like the Queen and Cannon.





Draft new cards, upgrade your Ruler, and choose powerful gambits to create game-breaking synergies. Build your deck YOUR way and master 4 unique Factions to become the ultimate champion.





One well-placed unit is the difference between victory and defeat. Place new units to counterattack your enemy and swing the battle in your favor. Master your strategy to defeat 13 unique bosses.





Defeat the Overlord in a roguelike campaign with 8 starting decks and 10 difficulty levels. Build your own Custom Deck and challenge other players in online multiplayer.

2347290.name: Sea Chronicles
2347290.about_the_game:
You're stranded on a sinking ship with a limited set of items. Combine them creatively to unlock new locations, uncover hidden secrets, and discover multiple endings - each choice brings a wild outcome!

Key Features:

  • Pop-Culture References: A world filled with quirky, nostalgic nods (mostly from SpongeBob)  to keep you looking for easter eggs along the way.

  • Bugs Collecting: Hunt down rare and ridiculous bugs scattered throughout the world. Some are dangerous. Some are just weird. All of them are worth finding.

  • Death is Just Part of the Journey: Made the wrong move? Congrats, you found another ridiculous way to die.

  • Absurd Humor and Puzzles: Enjoy bizarre challenges, unpredictable twists, and lmao moments as you make your way through the story.

highlighted.localized_name: Boom! And The Pirate Is Gone!
highlighted.name: Boom! And The Pirate Is Gone!

2347320.name: Dirty Aim Trainer VR
2347320.about_the_game:
Aim Trainers in VR tend to never be useful and are always short with what they offer and lack enough customization to be personalized.

Dirty Aim Trainer VR "aims" to be immersive and easy to use while offering the best training sessions any VR Aim Trainer can offer.

With multiple tasks improving flicking, tracking, reaction time, peaking, holding angles, tracking and much more.



You should have no problem finding the task that helps work on the problem your having, and getting personal based feedback.

Want custom music to train to? With a custom music system you can easily import any mp3 files into the game.

Dirty Aim VR tries it's best to be relaxing but effective at the same time.

We understand the struggle of learning VR Shooters and that's something Dirty Aim VR hopes to help and make the process easier for beginners or hardcore players.

2347340.name: Slidemagi
2347340.about_the_game:
Slidemagi is a turn-based strategy game in which units move by sliding the lines of the board. As a powerful Mage, you wield a deck of cards to cast spells and summon unique units, each with special abilities, to fight under your command.

Slidemagi is a duel between two mages on a 10x10 board. Each turn, you can make one move, which consists of one of the following:

  • Move a unit (the entire row moves).

  • Cast a Spell (summon a new unit or cast a defensive/attacking spell).

At the end of each move, all of the player's units will attack in all four directions, if possible.

Each player has 16 cards to use in battle, which they can select before entering the fight. 

The objective of the game is to defeat the enemy mage in battle mode or eliminate all enemy units in waves mode.

The game has two main modes of play: adventure mode, where you progress to unlock new spells and units, and player vs. player magical combat, where each Mage uses their deck to defeat the opponent.

Features:

Sliding: Units move by sliding the lines. When the move is made, all your units will execute their action. The position of units is important.

Squeezing: By sliding, other units can become squeezed into their line, allowing dangerous terrain to be placed beneath them.

Mages and Spells: You are the Mage! You must defeat the enemy in a magical combat. Use your deck of cards to cast powerful spells and summon new units.

Graves and Raise Dead: When a unit dies, a grave appears, which the Necromancer can revive. As all objects lock the line on the edge when sliding, this is a fundamental part of the game, leading to open or closed games.

Chain Reactions: Certain moves can cause chain reactions. For example, killing enemies and having a Necromancer to revive them in the same turn.

Deck Building: Before going into the battle, choose a set of spells from the available spell cards. Deck composition will depend on your strategy and the characteristics of the terrain you'll be playing on. The deck is shuffled, and you will have five spells available at any given time. Chance also plays a role.

Spell Cards and Units: There are dozens of unit types and spells to use and combine to craft your strategy. Each type of unit performs a specific action. For example, Spiders shoot a web that traps the enemy and makes them very vulnerable; Scorpions, poison their enemies, etc. There are melee and ranged units, weak and powerful units, grounded and flying units, etc.

Many Modes of Play: Dive into adventure mode to discover and master new spells, or enjoy friendly competition in both local and online multiplayer magical duels.

Slidemagi is a game with an original design, developed by BATOVI Games, a studio from Montevideo, Uruguay.
2347340.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian

2347350.name: On The Brink
2347350.about_the_game:
Use Capri's gravity manipulation to slingshot across the universe as she embarks on a mission to liberate a forgotten dimension from the clutches of an all-powerful being. Solve puzzles, uncover mysteries, and shatter space-time itself in this snappy sci-fi action platformer.

What lies in the dimensions above our own?


  • An original sci-fi narrative set in the far reaches of the universe following Capri's fight to right cosmic wrongs and save PROJECT: Almagest.
  • High-speed movement is interwoven with unique puzzle mechanics sure to engage hypothalamuses and prefrontal cortexes alike.
  • Galaxy distribution across the universe is dynamic and infinite. Stay conscious, or be lost in the infinite aether.
  • On The Brink has subtitles available alongside controller support for both Windows and Mac OSX.
  • Recommended for third-dimensional beings. Playable in the second dimension, with decreased performance.

2347360.name: Into The Backrooms
2347360.about_the_game:
Explore and survive levels based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level features different ways to escape with dangers along the way. Explore the seemingly infinite expanse of eerily familiar levels in the backrooms for a taste of the game's creepy maze-like twists and turns.


The game's immersive experience is enhanced by its lifelike graphics, minimal user HUD, and somber ambiance.


Find your way through seemingly infinite levels. Every level has different twists, turns, exits, and enemies.

"If you're not careful and no-clip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms, where it's nothing but the stink of old moist carpet, the madness of mono-yellow, the endless background noise of fluorescent lights at maximum hum-buzz, and approximately six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms to be trapped in. God save you if you hear something wandering around nearby, because it sure as hell has heard you."

2347380.name: Witch's Garden
2347380.about_the_game:
《魔女的花园》由日本美少女游戏知名大厂Windmill Oasis（风车社）为纪念品牌成立十周年所倾力打造的奇幻恋爱大作，和旗下两大名作系列《Happiness!》与《祝福的钟声》共享世界观，并拥有多达6条故事线。本作同时也是业内第一部搭载E-Mote动态立绘演出系统的作品，当年一经公布便引起业界震动，并在美少女游戏大赏中荣获诸多奖项。

本次我们携手风车社对原版游戏进行了强化制作。强化版拥有1920X1080的高清画质，并升级了内置的Emote系统数据，对UI中的功能也进行了优化新增，还增加了对新近系统的兼容支持。游戏内置简体中文、繁体中文与日文三版本并支持随时切换，也支持Steam成就、云存储等功能，并适配Steam Deck游玩，并将支持大量额外内容。

《魔女的花园》由知名原画师Ko-cha担当企划、原画与角色设计（代表作《Happiness!》系列、《祝福的钟声》系列）；由资深剧本家保住圭（代表作《纯白交响曲》）与高岛荣二（代表作《仰望夜空的星辰》）共同编写剧本；遥空、夏野冰、樱叶月、成濑未亚、川岛梨乃等多位人气声优为本作角色倾情献声；著名音乐团体Elements Garden为本作打造音乐与歌曲。由人气歌手佐藤广美与飞兰联袂献唱的主题曲《Witch’s Garden》充满激情，令人一听难忘。
