Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

2347390.name: MeowGun: Hell Denizen
2347390.about_the_game:
In a time of scum and villainy, evil demon overlords and insidious space invaders, a ravaged world cried out for a hero.

A catgirl/half-demon/(who knows???) codenamed MeowMeow is forced to do slave labour. Treated like trash by the demons, she lives a miserable life and all that she wants is another cat. Humanity is on its last legs. She's had enough and decides to fight back!

Start a rebellion and make the demons shake in their boots! Overthrow the evil demon rulers and their minions! Save the animals! Maybe the humans as well if they play nice. Meow a lot. (???)

Features:

  • MeowMeow's journey takes you through 30 levels of demon infested industrial complexes, cityscapes, decayed forgotten places and snowy northern Finland. Plenty of secrets to discover and wandering lost kittens to rescue!

  • A psychedelic/acid/techno/trance SoundTrack!

  • Meow button, silly voicelines, a cutegore aesthetic and tons of dorky pop culture references to experience!

  • 17 weapons with alternate firing modes. You have weapons like automatic Magnum Pistols, a double barreled Shotgun, a rapid fire Machinegun, a powerful Railgun, a guided Missile Launcher and a high tech Plasma Rifle.

  • 3 kinds of throwable bombs and a Power Meow that can blast enemies around!

  • 32 different kinds of enemies ranging from easy cannon fodder Troopers to dangerous Demon Knights, blood thirsty Brute Butchers, strange Dimensional Shamblers and cybernetic Alien Hunters. Boss monster encounter in each of the 5 episodes.

  • Optional gameplay modifiers to fine tune the game's difficulty.

  • There's also a Survival mode where you fight against the ever-growing army of the demons in the deathmatch levels until they overwhelm you.

  • Play up to 4 player local split screen multiplayer in co-op, deathmatch and survival modes. XInput compatible controllers/gamepads needed for split screen multiplayer. There is an auto aim setting that can be used when playing with gamepads.

  • Meowpedia - A big glossary of all the in-game statistics, items, guns, and enemies in the game with tons of informative yet silly descriptions.

  • Optional 256 color palette shader for a more retro look.

  • Nonstop Mäyhem!

2347410.name: The Phoenix Initiative
2347410.about_the_game:
Play as Florence Phoenix, the last surviving astronaut of the Phoenix Initiative, on a post-apocalyptic Earth transformed into a desolate wasteland by the very technology meant to save it. Project Genesis's nanotech terraformers have run rampant, mutating life and creating hostile Crystal Beasts that roam the unforgiving landscape.

Embark on a desperate mission to reclaim Earth, where danger lurks around every corner and extreme weather conditions are constant threats. Scavenge for supplies, fend off vicious creatures and harness the energy of the Genesis Crystals, the unique artifacts that may hold the key to humanity's survival and the rebirth of the planet.

Build your colony and use your wits and combat skills to face formidable obstacles and challenges. With breathtaking top-down graphics and relentless gameplay, The Phoenix Initiative offers an intense and captivating experience that will keep you enthralled.

Are you ready to rise from the ashes and take on the mission to save humanity from extinction? The dawn of Earth's rebirth awaits. Play The Phoenix Initiative now and embrace your destiny!

Build your home
Build and defend your home in a world overrun by mutated humans! Strategically construct turrets, traps, and more to withstand waves of relentless attackers. With an extensive base-building system and dynamic enemy AI, no two battles will be alike. Can you survive the horde and protect what's yours?


Mine and gather resources
Embark on a journey through a post-apocalyptic world where resources are scarce and survival is key. Explore a randomly generated world and mine for valuable resources to take back to your base. Use these resources to build and upgrade your character, allowing you to face even greater challenges and become the ultimate survivor. With obstacles and enemies at every turn, can you gather enough resources to secure your future in this harsh world?


Dynamic Weather System
Embark on your perilous journey as you deal with unpredictable and dangerous weather conditions. Explore and face the challenges of dynamic weather events, from meteorite showers to toxic atmospheres. Stay alert and adapt to the changing environment to survive, but be warned – one wrong move could mean certain death.


Hard MODE ACTIVATED
Step into a brutal world where survival is a constant battle. Explore a dangerous earth filled with enemies waiting to take you down. With only a few hits until you're defeated, you'll need to be strategic in order to progress. This is a test of your skill and resilience, where every decision could mean the difference between life and death. Do you have what it takes to emerge victorious in this intense and unforgiving environment?


Character Development
With each level gained, you'll have the chance to enhance your skills and abilities with a choice of three unique upgrades. Will you choose to boost your combat prowess, improve your survival skills, or unlock powerful new abilities? The choice is yours but choose wisely - the fate of your journey rests in your hands. With procedurally generated levels and endless replayability, this game will keep you hooked for hours on end. So, what are you waiting for? Level up and discover your true potential in this epic roguelike adventure.
2347410.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Thai*

2347440.name: The Feudal
2347440.about_the_game:
"The Feudal" is a card strategy game set in a medieval setting, with additional text quests and original design.

Each of the two decks provides two choices, and all subsequent cards after that choice affect one of the four resources more significantly, while the others are affected to a lesser extent. So, after choosing one of the two decks, you're essentially selecting one of two branches—there are four branches in total. To gain access to the other deck, you need to pick the second option in the dialogue on almost every card, except for the first ones.

Alongside this, some cards (almost all of them by release) will unlock access to story-driven text quests, where you'll be able to get to know the main character and the other characters that influence their fate.

2347460.name: Survival Sprint
2347460.about_the_game:
How to play

Choose and match different weapons and supportive items to resist enemy attacks. Your goal is to do your best to survive!
Also, use your unique active skills when necessary!
(Tips: Some collocations will have unexpected effects!)

Game Features

2347610.name: Glory or Dominance - The World Of Kleiverog
2347610.about_the_game:
The New MMORPG Fantasy Game Glory or Dominance - Game Info


Glory or Dominance is a massive online multiplayer roleplay game with a social and competitive nature, which is in advanced development, and I hope very soon you can dive into an amazing adventure with amazing graphics, sound, effects and huge possibilities, full of action, fantasy, puzzles, riddles, mysteries, victories, losses and strong emotions.
The game is based on the fantasy genre where magic, mystical creatures, secret societies and cults and what not are present. In the world of Glory or Dominance, you manage, develop and defend your territory, by means of your: Main character, Generals and small armies with which you fight for supremacy over the others.

Glory or Dominance is a Massively Multiplayer Online Fantasy game based on a rich story, open world, where you win and defend your place by creating friendships, guilds, alliances and following the path of diplomacy or war with others. Some of the main things in the world of Glory or Dominance are item creation, resource mining, territory exploration, trading, piracy, seafaring, hunting, fighting monsters or bandits, capturing castles, territory battles, boss battles, creating of clans and alliances, politics, quests and challenges and much more.
Here it all depends on you and your imagination!

The Kingdoms:


The action of the game takes place in the World of Kleiverog which consists of six kingdoms:

• Witera - Kingdom of Human

- The human race is one of the six ancient races, renowned for its generosity and pursuit of new discoveries and conquests. They are also the FOUNDERS of the “Great Trade Guild”, which hold the rights to trade and deliver goods and cargo in all regions. Also they have very strong Carpenters Guild, the Bounty Hunters Guild (which deals with the search for criminal elements in all territories), as well as the Builders Guild (whose services everyone uses to improve their defense facilities).

...........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

• Xeivar – The Demon Kingdom

- The people of Xeivar are not very different in appearance from the human race, but they possess a spiritual energy that is fueled by Fire and when they are threatened or angry, their bodies and eyes are enveloped in flames (Fire Aura) which gives them a rather sinister appearance and because of this others call them Demons and take care not to mess with them. Because of their Aura of Fire, the people of Xeivar call themselves “the Children of Fire”. They have highly developed Alchemy and possess the largest library of Ancient Lore gathered over centuries stored in the “Sacred Temple - Atherzon” of the Fire Mages in Xeivar, where fire mages study old scrolls and ancient books as they develop their spells and train their skills.

...........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

• Eidrall – Kingdom of the Elves

- Elves are a race whose people live entirely in harmony with nature, believing themselves to be the only intelligent creatures in the World of Kleiverog. The territory they inhabit is extremely rich in nature and inhabited by many rare mystical creatures, the Elves draw their vital energy from nature, are known for their skilled archers, as well as for their powerful Wizards “Druids” and their healing and strengthening spells. They have knowledge and experience in making healing and strengthening potions, as well as powerful bows made from a unique wood that only grows in very small areas in their territory, renowned masters in making jewelry and magical paints and elixirs. They hardly allow others to enter their domains without special approval from their rulers. They defend their lands and are territorially aggressive towards almost everyone!

...........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

• Brukus - Land of the Orcs

- A race of fearless warriors possessing incredible strength. Large and strong, they are not interested in others and their political games and intrigues, they make compromises very hard and quickly solve “small disputes” and problems through their Strength. Brave warriors who bow to no one! They are known as much for their Strength as for their leather goods, which they process according to their secrets and ancient recipes to be as strong as iron and as light as silk, and for their amulets of protection and spells. They often hunt in Elven territories and hunt “sacred” animals for skin or bones, which is the main reason why the Elves hate them and call them “Barbarians”, but this does not bother them much, as a true Orc would say - the Stronger one, has the right, so what…?

...........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

• Hodura - The Kingdom of the Dwarves

- Small in stature, but very hardy and cunning, they are the Masters of Steel and masters of the “Treasures of the Underworld”. Their territory is large, mostly mountains and hard to pass rocky areas, but it is the perfect place for them to mine and extract valuable resources, iron, silver and crystals. The blades and armor forged by their Masters are unmatched in strength. They aren’t particularly friendly unless they have a use for it. They prefer not to get involved in conflict and hoard their wealth for themselves, which is why their fame as misers is known throughout the World of Kleiverog. They hate the Orcs… Everyone knows their story how a glorious expedition to search for new deposits in Orc Territory and their attempt to take advantage of them by “cunning” ended badly and cost them great humiliation… they(the Orcs) beat them very hard and forbade them to show up in their territory. But that doesn’t make them any less powerful, especially when it comes to trading or enhancing weapons and metal armor by inscribing runes and magic patterns… there are no better than them at it!

...........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

• Pireoris - Or the “cursed”

as others call them because of their ability and need to “feed” on soul energy. Pireoris are actually people from the land of Witera Kingdom, but during the “Great Battle of the Alliance” (until then Witera was one with Pireoris and ruled by two brother kings) a terrible tragedy happened. The final attack unleashes a powerful ‘contagion’ that mows many of the alliance’s warriors and they can no longer eat meat normally as it becomes poisonous to them, but they also gain the terrifying ability to ‘Drain’ life energy from any living thing. Which leads to the division of the territory, with all those affected along with their families being banished and founding the Kingdom of Pireoris. They hate Humans and consider themselves “Touched by the Power of the Etherium”, according to their beliefs, THEY are entitled to rule over Kleiverog. Since they cannot eat like everyone else they have found a way (via “Life Crystals”) to collect small amounts of life energy from animals and transfer it into fruits and vegetables so that they can get enough from their food. They, the Pireoris, state that they do not KILL living things to EAT them, and this makes them superior to the others they call “Carnivores”! The Kingdom of Pireoris is known for their dangerous witches, producing magic crystals, magic powder, and potions that are highly sought after and highly valued by everyone in Kleiverog. They often make raids into Hodura territory, where they obtain large quantities of crystal and instill hatred and fear in the Dwarves, who claim that they just like to harass them.

...........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

Combat Systems:


In Glory or Dominance there are several types of combat systems known as: Player vs Player, Co-Op Battles, PVE, clan wars, Fortress Battles, fortifications and instances, Pirate battles, as well as several types of arenas where, if you wish, you can prove yourself and win rewards, glory and popularity.
The game Glory or Dominance is an open world where PvP and PVE Battles throughout the territory are allowed, but are determined by some rules depending on the territories or instances that affect your reputation!
When you play, you interact with the entire eco-system of the game and the servers as, your actions can determine or create events, directly or indirectly influence the development of the world!

Trade:


The Glory or Dominance game world has various trading systems where you can (together or individually with friends) own shops with vendors, stalls, participate in public or private auctions, transport and guard cargo by land or sea, to sell or buy stolen goods and items (the latter is at your own risk, “All or Nothing” and may result in you being wanted and hunted by other players - “Bounty Hunters” or go to jail if you are not careful 😊, but if you are a skilled pirate or robber, you know that you can also take advantage of corruption to “save your skin” more easily ).
– Choices and Decisions are entirely yours, as well as their consequences! 😊
You just have to choose the Kingdom you want to defend, and which cause you will support!

2347740.name: VenusBlood GAIA International

Centuries have passed, and the world has grown still, heralding the beginning of the Twilight Age. Now, the oceans have receded, birthrates have plummeted for all races, and an unknown plague ravages the land. Grotesque creatures of unknown origin roam the lands...

However, hope shines amidst the darkness. A new energy source discovered by Theofrad, the Archduke of the Sorcerous City of Energeia, may hold the key to saving the realm -- Ether. The Holy Dragon Empire Granleyd has outlawed the use of Ether as heresy, declaring a holy war on Energeia. And so begins Theofrad's uphill battle against the Empire, all for the sake of saving the world.

Join Archduke Theofrad in his efforts to save a decaying world in the Twilight Age with the power of Ether and his revolutionary Arcane Avatar Theory! As the underdog in the war against the Empire, he cannot stand against them in a direct confrontation. However, through clever use of the Labyrinth defense system present in the Sorcerous City of Energeia, he can ensnare and trap invading forces before closing in and wiping them out. Aided by his Succubus Secretary, Rein; Artificial Embryo, Lala; and a mysterious young girl known as Titie, Theofrad prepares the labyrinth to welcome any would-be invaders.

With the power of Ether, Theofrad is willing to fight against a world unified against him to save it from decay.

Set traps, position your defenders, and brace yourself for the enemy invasion.

You are the master of the labyrinth, and these invaders are but pieces on a board that you control...

With three divisions of six units each, you enter battle...with all 18 units! Decimate the enemies trapped in your labyrinth with the full force of three divisions!

During certain Event battles, you can face off against other battalions of three enemy divisions, but sometimes, you will enter battle against a colossal foe, taking it on with all three of your divisions to eke out a narrow victory!

Units can be customized in many different ways!

Raise them, assign them to a division, give them equipment, and place them as defenders in the labyrinth or put them into an assault team to directly attack invaders!

Depending on the decisions you make throughout the game, the story may progress down different paths, and there are also multiple endings available!

Make your choices wisely, for they will influence the ultimate ending to your story...

Multiple difficulty settings offer a wide range of gameplay options. For those who want to skip the gameplay and just enjoy the story, use the easy mode's "Win Skip" function to skip battles or even entire maps altogether. Hardcore fans, use the New Game Plus mode that allows you to carry over progress from your previous run and challenge the newly unlocked higher difficulty levels for a more challenging experience! In fact, if story isn't really your thing, there is a dungeon defense only mode available where all story content is cut!

“D-Life's story is presented when players leave the game idle on the menu for a couple of minutes, or on the game's store page for an inquisitive reader. With the expansion of technology, scientists have discovered a new form of electron-based life. The player's task is to take photos of these life forms while fulfilling certain criteria defined by the game.”
9/10 – CUBED3

“Conway’s simulation is at the core of D Life, the latest effort from Mindware’s Mikito Ichikawa (aka Micky G. Albert). Here, a fluid light show flows across the vertically-oriented playfield. The borders optionally display instructions imitating the appearance of a table-top machine, with a hundred-yen sticker helping to suggest the feeling you’re stumbled on an obscure arcade relic. This illusion of D Life being a forgotten game from the ’80s is assisted by 8-bit fonts and a blissful soundtrack from Yuriko Keino, who wrote the music for Super Pac-Man and Dig Dug. Expectedly, earning a spot on the local leaderboard earns a chiptune serenade that is unbearably soothing. Like Namco’s games of old, there are even different tunes for first and second place.”
83/100 – Tech-Gaming

2347980.name: On a Summer Night
2347980.about_the_game:
"Today, I would like to tell you about one night.
One night that changed my life."

Tokyo suburbs. Japan, early 2000's.
You're an overworked employee going home on a wet and hot summer night.
At the station, you discover that your bag is missing after you've been hit by... something unknown.
Lights are dim and weird people are roaming in the empty streets. How the hell are you supposed to get home now?

With anime-esque graphics and a dark sense of humor, On a Summer Night is the first commercial game of Team Wagashi.

Trigger warning: death, school bullying, suicide, arson, alcoholism, car accident

2348000.name: Bullet Heck
2348000.about_the_game:
All attacks you cast as as dangerous to yourself as they are for your opponent. By casting a card you are increasing everyone's risk, can you control your attack output or will you crumble under the pressure?



Don't like what you see? Are you colorblind? Or maybe you want to listen to other songs?

  • Import your own legally obtained music files
  • Pick and choose your cards for Deck Battle Mode
  • Find matches with specific groups of people using Group Codes
  • Hide your lobby from the public lobby browser
  • Maybe a "little" something else?????



And I mean it! No micro-transactions for gameplay features here, the only person who won't like this deal is an accountant.

2348030.name: The Riddler
2348030.about_the_game:
Are you ready for a puzzle game unlike any other? Look no further than "The Riddler", an intellectual conversation game that will challenge your mind and transport you to a world of intrigue and mystery.

The true magic of "The Riddler" lies in the thrilling experience of interaction with a powerful artificial intelligence (based on ChatGPT) that is specifically tuned for crafting riddles on the fly and speaking about the subjects of those riddles.

This means that every time you play, you will encounter brand new challenges that will keep you on your toes and test your puzzle-solving skills to the limit.

Immerse yourself in a world of diverse characters, each with their own unique style of dialogue and riddles. As you engage in dialogue with them, you will feel like you're having a conversation with a real person.

🌟 "The Riddler" offers two gameplay modes: 🌟
  • The classic mode is perfect for those who crave a challenge, with a limit of 3 questions per riddle, a limit on wrong answers, and a ticking game timer to keep you on your toes.
  • In "free for all" mode you have the freedom to skip riddles, ask unlimited questions, and even use a text prompt to specify a unique subject for riddles to be crafted for you.

Did you know that "The Riddler" is not just another puzzle game, but a groundbreaking fusion of AI and human creativity? Check out these intriguing facts:

3️⃣ AI played a substantial role in developing the game code, demonstrating the potential for AI-human collaboration in the gaming industry.
4️⃣ Even this very page description was crafted with the help of AI, highlighting the versatility of artificial intelligence in various applications.

您可以在游戏中选择当一个“幻化大师“可以给客户带来更好看，更炫酷的皮肤，也可以当一名天下闻名的”厨师”提供客户药物支持带来收益，又或则你可以选择当一名天下闻名丧胆的“附魔师”给客户带来更厉害的装备属性，让客户的战力更上一层楼。作为特殊职业的你，既有收益，又有名气，名利双收 ，其他职业敬请期待..........
